In essence, every center acts as the representative of the agents belonging to it, aligning their generally different preferences. Our goal is to distribute the goods in a way that is simultaneously fair both with respect to the centers and the agents. We distinguish two different information structures depending on whether the agents compare their bundles against every agent or only those belonging to the same center. For each one of them we provide efficient algorithms that produce allocations that satisfy envy-based fairness guarantees at both levels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了委托资源分配中的公平分配模型，其中不可分割商品分配给属于更大中心实体的代理，需要同时保证中心和代理两个层面的无嫉妒公平性。作者区分了两种信息结构（代理与所有代理比较或仅与同一中心内代理比较），并为每种结构提供了高效算法。
AI.motivation: 针对新引入的委托资源分配问题，研究公平分配模型。该模型捕捉了将资源分配给组织单位再由其分配给附属成员的一般框架，特别适用于通过慈善组织分配食品捐赠等具有巨大社会影响的场景。核心挑战在于每个中心作为其成员代理的代表，需要协调成员们不同的偏好。
AI.method: 作者考虑了两种不同的信息结构：(1)代理将其捆绑与所有代理进行比较；(2)代理仅与同一中心的代理进行比较。针对每种信息结构，设计了在中心和代理两个层面同时满足基于嫉妒的公平保证的高效算法。
AI.result: 为两种不同的信息结构分别提供了高效算法，这些算法能够产生在中心和代理两个层面都满足嫉妒公平性保障的分配方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了委托资源分配模型中双层公平性的理论框架，证明了在两种信息结构下均可通过高效算法实现中心和代理层面的嫉妒公平，为食品捐赠分配等实际应用提供了理论支持。

title: BridgeAlign: Bridging Preference Alignment for Humanities and Social Sciences
summary: While data synthesis for large language models (LLMs) is prevalent, it primarily targets domains with verifiable answers, overlooking open-ended humanities and social sciences (HSS), where nuanced quality judgments matter more than objective correctness. This makes preference alignment a natural paradigm for broad HSS tasks. Yet existing methods are either costly or not tailored to broad HSS disciplines. We thus propose BridgeAlign, among the first preference-alignment pipelines for broad HSS disciplines, with three phases: i) Seed Curation: curating HSS seed documents from web corpora via heuristic/LLM-based filtering and text refinement; ii) Preference Data Synthesis: generating preference triplets via persona-based instruction inversion with Q&A consistency checks; iii) Preference Optimization: moving beyond naive human-vs-model heuristics by first grounding preferences in HSS quality rubric, then generating transitional responses via controlled quality degradation to form near-boundary preference pairs for finer-grained quality discrimination. Aligning over 210k synthetic preference samples, BridgeAlign enables Qwen3-8B to achieve the best average across 17 benchmarks against 11 strong baselines; importantly, leading on both human-preference and knowledge-based capabilities at once, with no trade-off between them, as supported by extensive experiments and contextualized by existing theories.

AI.tldr: BridgeAlign是首个面向广泛人文社科学科（HSS）的偏好对齐流水线，通过种子策展、偏好数据合成和偏好优化三个阶段，生成21万+合成偏好样本，使Qwen3-8B在17个基准上平均表现超越11个强基线，同时在人机偏好和知识能力上均领先且无权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM数据合成主要针对可验证答案的领域（如数学、代码），忽略了开放式人文学科和社会科学（HSS）。HSS中缺乏客观正确答案，需要细粒度质量判断，因此偏好对齐是自然范式。然而现有偏好对齐方法要么成本高昂，要么不适合广泛HSS学科，亟需一个专门为此设计的偏好对齐流水线。
AI.method: BridgeAlign包含三个关键阶段：(1) 种子策展：通过启发式/LLM过滤和文本精炼从网络语料中筛选HSS种子文档；(2) 偏好数据合成：通过基于人物角色的指令反转和问答一致性检查生成偏好三元组（chosen/rejected/prompt）；(3) 偏好优化：超越简单的"人类vs模型"启发式方法，先基于HSS质量评分标准（rubric）建立偏好依据，再通过受控质量退化生成中间过渡响应，形成边界附近的偏好对以实现更细粒度的质量判别。
AI.result: 对齐21万+合成偏好样本后，BridgeAlign使Qwen3-8B在17个基准上取得最佳平均成绩，超越11个强基线；关键成果是同时在人机偏好基准和知识能力基准上领先，两者之间不存在此消彼长的权衡，该结果由大量实验支持并与现有理论相印证。
AI.conclusion: BridgeAlign验证了通过质量准则驱动的偏好合成与边界级偏好优化，可以低成本地实现面向广泛HSS学科的高质量对齐，且不会牺牲模型的知识能力，为开放领域LLM对齐提供了有效范式。

title: Divergence Decoding: Training-Free Capability Fusion
summary: While large language models excel in reasoning, these generalists often lack knowledge for specialized scientific domains. Conversely, domain models~(specialists), while knowledgeable, suffer from specialization side-effects including diminished logic and reduced robustness.To address this dilemma, we introduce Divergence Decoding, a training-free framework for capability fusion. It reconstructs the "draft-and-verify" skeleton of speculative decoding into an adaptive routing mechanism. The core is using Jensen-Shannon divergence to monitor the distributional disagreement between the two models at each token. When the specialist exhibits significant divergence, our method identifies it as a potential reasoning risk and instantaneously routes control to the generalist. This allows the dynamic injection of general reasoning while preserving domain expertise, achieving inference-time policy composition of the generalist and the specialist.We evaluate Divergence Decoding across diverse model families (Qwen and Llama series) on challenging scientific benchmarks (GPQA, ChemBench, and ChemCoTBench). Experimental results demonstrate that Divergence Decoding outperforms both the domain-specialized and general-purpose models, effectively surpassing the performance of most single-model baseline. This suggests that Divergence Decoding provides a general, training-free paradigm for fusing diverse LLM capabilities through adaptive inference-time collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Divergence Decoding，一种无需训练的能力融合框架，通过Jensen-Shannon散度监控通用模型与领域专家模型在每个token上的分布分歧，在专家出现推理风险时动态切换到通用模型，实现推理时的策略组合，在GPQA、ChemBench和ChemCoTBench等科学基准上超越单一模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（通用模型）擅长推理但缺乏专业领域知识；领域专家模型（专用模型）虽知识渊博却因特化产生副作用，如逻辑能力下降和鲁棒性降低。如何在保留领域专业知识的同时注入通用推理能力，是核心挑战。
AI.method: Divergence Decoding将投机解码的"草稿-验证"机制重构为自适应路由：使用Jensen-Shannon散度在每个token上监控专家模型与通用模型之间的分布分歧。当专家模型出现显著分歧时，判定为潜在推理风险并即时将控制权路由回通用模型，实现推理时动态的策略组合。
AI.result: 在Qwen和Llama系列模型上，针对GPQA、ChemBench和ChemCoTBench等挑战性科学基准进行评测，Divergence Decoding在多个指标上优于领域专用模型和通用模型，超越了大多数单一模型基线。
AI.conclusion: Divergence Decoding提供了一种通用且无需训练的范式，通过自适应推理时协作实现不同LLM能力的融合，有效解决通用模型与领域专家模型之间的能力矛盾。

title: Shared Semantic Codebook Distillation for Unpaired Cross-Modal Medical Classification
summary: Cross-modal knowledge distillation can transfer diagnostic knowledge from a strong but costly teacher modality to a cheaper and more deployable student modality. In medical image analysis, however, the two modalities are often unpaired: they are collected from different patient cohorts and occupy geometrically incompatible feature spaces. This makes instance-level distillation invalid and direct feature matching unreliable. To address these challenges, we propose Shared Semantic Codebook Distillation (SSCD), which compares teacher and student representations through a shared discrete codebook. Each image is represented as a distribution over a common, modality-agnostic vocabulary, and knowledge is transferred by aligning these distributions across modalities, both globally and class-conditionally, without requiring paired samples or directly comparable raw features. The codebook is evolved online by exponential moving average and kept diverse through entropy regularization and dead-code restart. At inference, all teacher-side and codebook modules are discarded, leaving only the student encoder and classifier. On two heterogeneous unpaired settings, OCT-to-fundus retinal disease classification and CT-to-chest-X-ray pneumonia classification, SSCD improves the student from 64.5 to 70.2 macro-F1 and from 73.8 to 76.3 macro-F1, respectively, outperforming all evaluated distillation baselines on both settings. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/DillanImans/SSCD-unpaired-distillation

AI.tldr: 本文提出共享语义码本蒸馏（SSCD），解决医学图像分析中跨模态知识蒸馏时模态未配对、特征空间不可比的问题。通过共享离散码本将教师和学生表征映射为分布，在全局和类别条件层面对齐，无需配对样本，在OCT到眼底和CT到胸片两个任务上显著优于所有蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 跨模态知识蒸馏可将诊断知识从昂贵教师模态迁移到低成本学生模态，但医学图像中两种模态通常未配对（来自不同患者队列），且特征空间几何上不兼容，导致实例级蒸馏无效、直接特征匹配不可靠。
AI.method: SSCD通过共享离散码本比较教师和学生表征。每幅图像表示为对公共模态无关词汇表（码本）的分布，通过全局和类别条件层面跨模态对齐分布来迁移知识，无需配对样本或可直接比较的原始特征。码本通过指数移动平均在线演化，并通过熵正则化和死码重启保持多样性。推理时丢弃教师侧和码本模块，仅保留学生编码器和分类器。
AI.result: 在两个异构未配对设置下（OCT到眼底视网膜疾病分类、CT到胸片肺炎分类），SSCD分别将学生从64.5提升到70.2 macro-F1、从73.8提升到76.3 macro-F1，在两个设置上均优于所有评估的蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: SSCD通过共享离散码本实现无需配对的跨模态知识蒸馏，在医学图像跨模态场景中有效且推理开销小（仅保留学生模型），代码和预训练模型已公开。

title: Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding
summary: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. With a 0.5-percentage-point reporting tolerance, Functional Reconstruction materially improves acceptance in 37 of 64 matched task cells, leaves 26 practically unchanged, and materially decreases one. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/swyhahaha/FunctionalMLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端(E2E)的功能重构方法,用于将MHA/GQA直接转换为MLA时保持推测解码的草稿接受率。该方法通过在校准隐状态上优化转换后的MLA模块以复现原始MHA/GQA的输出投影响应,从而解决低秩分解和RoPE处理导致的注意力函数误差问题。实验覆盖192种配置组合,结果显示在64个匹配任务单元中37个接受率显著提升,26个基本不变,仅1个下降。
AI.motivation: 多头潜在注意力(MLA)因紧凑潜在状态替代增长的KV缓存而减少解码内存流量,对长上下文LLM推理日益重要。但大多数开源检查点使用MHA/GQA,需要转换才能获得MLA的缓存效率。虽然推测解码提供互补加速,但直接MHA/GQA到MLA转换会显著降低草稿令牌接受率——低秩分解和RoPE处理引入的注意力函数误差在独立生成中可容忍,但大幅降低草稿接受率。
AI.method: 将MLA草稿构建视为功能重构而非缓存压缩。端到端(E2E)方法优化每个转换后的MLA注意力模块,使其在校准隐状态上复现原始MHA/GQA对应模块的输出投影响应。该方法是转换器无关的后转换过程,保留转换后的缓存和推理图,不需要验证器logits或验证器监督。评估涵盖4个Llama/Qwen草稿-目标对、TransMLA和MHA2MLA两种转换器、HF和vLLM两种后端、4个200提示任务。
AI.result: 评估192个模型-转换器-后端-方法-任务配置,在0.5个百分点报告容差下,功能重构在64个匹配任务单元中37个接受率显著提升,26个基本不变,1个显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 功能重构作为转换后(converter-agnostic)的后处理步骤,能有效恢复MHA/GQA转MLA过程中的推测解码接受率,而无需重新训练或修改推理图,为现有MHA/GQA模型享受MLA缓存效率提供了实用途径。

title: CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in dynamic financial environments face a critical challenge: maintaining factual accuracy as market conditions, regulations, and corporate facts change continuously. While 4-bit quantization enables efficient deployment, it severely limits the viability of sequential memory editing: existing methods undergo catastrophic performance degradation under this "quantization stability crisis." We introduce CACHE-UK (Contextual Adaptive Continual Hybrid Editor for UK Finance), a stability-aware memory editing framework specifically designed for domain-specific, quantized LLMs. CACHE-UK integrates three components: a rank-1 LoRA perturbation mechanism that confines edits to the low-rank adapter subspace, a financial domain prioritization module for content-adaptive edit strength, and a closed-loop Stability Controller that tracks "degradation debt" to prevent catastrophic forgetting across sequential updates. Evaluated on a 4-bit quantized OpenLLaMA-3B model with a curated UK financial corpus of 88,021 documents, CACHE-UK reduces knowledge degradation by 11-17% relative to adapted baselines under identical 4-bit constraints -- its most robust effect -- while attaining the highest test success (generalization) rate observed in our setting (28%, a 6 percentage point improvement over the strongest adapted baseline). These results indicate that stability-aware editing can improve factual maintenance in resource-constrained financial LLM deployments, though absolute generalization rates remain low.

AI.tldr: 提出CACHE-UK框架，一种面向4-bit量化金融LLM的稳定性感知记忆编辑方法，通过rank-1 LoRA扰动、金融领域优先模块和闭环稳定性控制器，在OpenLLaMA-3B量化模型上将知识退化降低11-17%，并将泛化率提升至28%。
AI.motivation: 动态金融环境中，LLM需要持续更新事实性知识，但4-bit量化部署虽然高效，却会导致现有顺序记忆编辑方法出现严重的性能退化（即"量化稳定性危机"），亟需一种专为域特定量化LLM设计、能够兼顾编辑效率与稳定性的新方案。
AI.method: CACHE-UK包含三个核心组件：1) rank-1 LoRA扰动机制，将编辑限制在低秩适配器子空间内；2) 金融领域优先模块，实现内容自适应的编辑强度调节；3) 闭环稳定性控制器，通过跟踪"退化债务"防止顺序更新过程中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在4-bit量化的OpenLLaMA-3B模型和88,021篇英国金融语料上评估，CACHE-UK将知识退化相对降低11-17%，达到观测中最高的测试成功率（泛化率）28%，比最强自适应基线高出6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性感知的记忆编辑能够改善资源受限金融LLM部署中的事实维护能力，但绝对泛化率仍然偏低（28%），表明仍有进一步改进空间。

title: The Capacity of a Family of Sticky Channels
summary: We determine the capacity of a family of $q$-ary sticky-insertion channels. Fix $q\geq2$ and $d\geq1$, and let $λ$ be the unique positive solution of $λ^d = (q-1) (λ^{d-1} + \cdots + λ+ 1 )$. We prove that, for every repetition law supported on $1+d\mathbb{Z}_{\geq0}$ and satisfying a coefficientwise-domination criterion with domination constant $γ\geqλ^{-d}$, the Shannon capacity equals the zero-error capacity, both being $\log_2λ$ bits per symbol. We also exhibit explicit repetition laws satisfying these conditions, one of which is given by the weighted Fuss--Catalan numbers. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first known cases of nontrivial repeat channels whose Shannon capacity has been determined exactly.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了满足特定重复律和系数支配条件的q元粘性插入信道族（sticky-insertion channels）的香农容量，证明其等于零错误容量，均为log₂λ比特/符号，并给出了满足条件的显式重复律（如加权Fuss–Catalan数的例子），这是首批精确确定香农容量的非平凡重复信道。
AI.motivation: 重复信道（repeat channels）是通信理论中的重要模型，但此前缺乏对非平凡重复信道香农容量的精确刻画。本文旨在填补这一空白，为满足特定条件的q元粘性插入信道族确定其香农容量，并证明与零错误容量的一致性。
AI.method: 考虑q元粘性插入信道族，其中q≥2、d≥1，设λ为方程λ^d=(q−1)(λ^{d−1}+⋯+λ+1)的唯一正解。对于所有支撑在1+dℤ_{≥0}上且满足系数逐项支配准则（支配常数γ≥λ^{−d}）的重复律，证明香农容量等于零错误容量，均为log₂λ比特/符号。同时构造满足这些条件的显式重复律，其中之一由加权Fuss–Catalan数给出。
AI.result: 证明了对任意满足支撑条件1+dℤ_{≥0}及系数支配常数γ≥λ^{−d}的重复律，q元粘性插入信道的香农容量等于零错误容量，均为log₂λ比特/符号。并给出了满足条件的显式构造，包括加权Fuss–Catalan数所定义的重复律。这是首次精确确定非平凡重复信道的香农容量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为重复信道的容量理论提供了突破性进展，首次精确计算出非平凡重复信道的香农容量，且香农容量与零错误容量一致。同时给出了基于加权Fuss–Catalan数的具体构造示例，为后续研究更广泛的重复信道容量问题奠定了基础。

title: Reversing Reserve Logic: Optimal Holdback in Local Allocation under Scalable Entry
comment: 28 pages, 3 figures; includes a technical appendix
summary: Scarce opportunities such as concert tickets and accelerator time may be contested by automated participants that can create accounts and sustain commitments beyond the reach of commitment-limited intended users. When account counts are untrusted, we study anonymous screening rules that ignore them, cap retained burdens, use only an account's commitment and strongest rival, and do not reassign after rejecting the leader. Within this class, we characterize the rule maximizing intended users' expected utility when they commit fully and a scalable entrant stays out. The optimum refunds and allocates at low congestion, retains and allocates at intermediate congestion, and retains while withholding allocation from an otherwise eligible leader when the strongest rival lies in the upper tail. Unlike a conventional reserve, which rejects a low leading bid, this rule treats an unusually strong rival as evidence of entrant imitation. A direct dual certificate proves class optimality; a benchmark shows that upper-tail holdback can raise intended-user surplus before it is necessary to support non-entry. The rule supports an equilibrium with full commitment and entrant non-entry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当账户数不可信时，如何设计匿名筛选规则来分配稀缺机会（如音乐会门票、加速器时间），以最大化预期目标用户的期望效用。最优规则在低拥堵时退款并分配，中等拥堵时保留并分配，而当最强竞争者处于上尾时，对原本符合条件的领先者进行保留但不分配。与传统保留价（拒绝低出价）不同，该规则将异常强的竞争者视为进入者模仿的证据。通过双重对偶证明类别最优性，并证明上尾扣留可在支持不进入之前提升目标用户剩余。
AI.motivation: 稀缺机会（如音乐会门票、加速器时间）可能被自动化参与者争夺，这些参与者可以创建账户并维持超出受限目标用户能力的承诺。当账户数量不可信时，需要设计忽略账户数、不依赖重新分配的匿名筛选规则，来公平有效地分配稀缺资源并防止自动化进入者模仿目标用户行为。
AI.method: 在限定规则类别内（忽略账户数、限制保留负担、仅使用账户的承诺及其最强竞争者、拒绝领先者后不重新分配），作者刻画了最大化目标用户期望效用的最优规则。采用直接双重对偶证书证明类别最优性，并通过基准比较展示上尾扣留策略的优势。
AI.result: 最优规则呈现三阶段行为：低拥堵时退款并分配；中等拥堵时保留并分配；当最强竞争者处于上尾时保留但扣留本应合格的领先者的分配。该规则比传统保留价更优——传统保留价拒绝低领先出价，而该规则将异常强的竞争者视为进入者模仿的证据。基准证明上尾扣留可在支持进入者不进入之前就提升目标用户剩余。
AI.conclusion: 所提规则支持一个实现完全承诺与进入者不进入的均衡。该研究为不可信账户环境下的稀缺资源分配提供了理论最优的匿名筛选机制，揭示了与拍卖理论中传统保留价机制不同的新最优结构。

title: HSS-Synth: Humanities and Social Sciences Data Synthesis for LLMs
summary: High-quality, diverse data are vital for large language models (LLMs) but remain scarce and costly. Data synthesis is a viable alternative and succeeds on closed tasks, yet the humanities and social sciences (HSS) are overlooked, and their open-ended nature makes synthesis challenging. Moving beyond prior capability-centric, fragmented attempts, we adopt a subject-centric paradigm, define the first HSS domain system covering 14 mainstream fields, and introduce HSS-Synth, the first data synthesis pipeline for HSS. HSS-Synth comprises: (1) constructing seed documents from web corpora via multi-step filtering and text refinement evaluated by a judge; (2) specifying "requirements + persona" to backtranslate seed documents into diverse yet faithful instructions with a strict Q&A alignment check; and (3) breaking LLM response limits via teacher-forced Answering that feeds seed documents during response generation to anchor semantics, reduce hallucinations, and preserve tone and integrity. HSS-Synth yields 237k high-quality, diverse instruction-tuning samples that outperform 14 leading baselines on 16 benchmarks. The fine-tuned Qwen3-8B-Base sets a new SOTA and approaches the official Qwen3-8B, improving both human preference and knowledge capabilities without performance seesaws. Extensive experiments demonstrate HSS-Synth's robustness and transferability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pengr/HSS-Synth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSS-Synth，首个面向人文社科的指令微调数据合成pipeline，采用"需求+人设"回译和教师强制回答机制，生成23.7万高质量多样样本，微调Qwen3-8B-Base后在16个基准上超越14个基线，接近官方版本，并公开代码。
AI.motivation: 高质量、多样化的数据对LLM至关重要但稀缺且昂贵；数据合成虽在封闭任务上成功，但人文社科（HSS）领域却被忽视，且其开放性问题使得合成更具挑战性。现有尝试零散、以能力为中心，缺乏系统性方法。
AI.method: 提出以学科为中心的HSS-Synth pipeline，包含三步：(1) 从网络语料通过多步过滤和文本精炼（由judge评估）构建种子文档；(2) 通过"需求+人设"规范将种子文档反向翻译为多样且忠实的指令，并进行严格的QA对齐检查；(3) 通过教师强制回答机制在响应生成时注入种子文档，锚定语义、减少幻觉、保持语气和完整性。
AI.result: 生成23.7万高质量多样指令微调样本，在16个基准上超越14个领先基线；微调后的Qwen3-8B-Base取得新SOTA，接近官方Qwen3-8B，同时提升人类偏好和知识能力，无性能跷跷板效应；实验证明其鲁棒性和可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: HSS-Synth证明了数据合成可以成功扩展到开放性强的人文社科领域，为HSS提供首个系统化数据合成方案，代码已开源。

title: PIE-APT: A Unified Framework for Temporal Planning and Contradiction Hunting via Incremental Direct-Derivation Abduction
summary: Reasoning and planning over Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (DKGs) present significant challenges, especially in open-world environments with incomplete information. Existing action formalisms often face decidability issues and the Ramification Problem, while managing incomplete knowledge via structural abduction requires expansive combinatorial search. This paper introduces a unified framework with two integrated modules---\textbf{PIE-Abducer} (incremental direct-derivation abduction) and \textbf{PIE-APT} (Abductive Planning for Temporal KGs)---operating natively on the highly expressive Description Logic. We model state transitions along a linear timeline as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories. Treating the incremental reasoner as a black-box and representing actions natively in OWL without external modal operators preserves logical decidability. To address incomplete knowledge, \textbf{PIE-Abducer} circumvents traditional Minimal Hitting Set (MHS) enumeration. Instead of combinatorial syntactic search, it injects the logical negation of a target goal into a consistent branch and extracts missing premises via direct refutation consequences. \textbf{PIE-APT} then employs a recursive \textit{Generate-and-Test} architecture, interleaving backward-chaining A* search with \textbf{PIE-Abducer} up to a bounded causal depth, followed by strict validation via forward-chaining Temporal Projection. We evaluate four OWL benchmarks stressing semantic abilities absent in classical planning: parameterized goals with witness search, mid-search DL entailment, open-world assumption injection, and adversarial contradiction hunting. Results demonstrate qualitative superiority over classical planners and prove our direct-derivation approach quantitatively outperforms an MHS-faithful baseline during abductive enrichment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，包含两个模块（PIE-Abducer和PIE-APT），用于在动态知识图谱上进行推理和规划。框架通过增量推理器作为黑盒、在OWL中原生表示动作（无需外部模态算子）来保持逻辑可判定性；通过直接推导的溯因方法规避了最小碰集枚举的组合爆炸；采用递归的Generate-and-Test架构，将向后链式A*搜索与溯因器交错进行，并通过前向时序投影严格验证。实验在四个OWL基准上验证了其对经典规划器的定性优势和比MHS基线更优的量化性能。
AI.motivation: 在开放世界中，基于动态知识图谱（DKG）进行推理和规划面临显著挑战：现有动作形式化方法常遭遇可判定性问题与分枝问题（Ramification Problem）；通过结构性溯因来管理不完整知识需要大规模组合搜索。作者旨在构建一个统一框架，在保留描述逻辑高度表达能力的同时，解决可判定性问题和溯因搜索的计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 框架由两个集成模块组成：(1) PIE-Abducer——增量直接推导溯因器，不再采用传统最小碰集（MHS）枚举，而是将目标目标的逻辑否定注入一致分支，通过直接反驳后果提取缺失前提；(2) PIE-APT——用于时序知识图谱的溯因规划器，采用递归的Generate-and-Test架构，将向后链式A*搜索与PIE-Abducer交错执行至有界因果深度，随后通过前向链式时序投影进行严格验证。状态沿线性时间线建模为对演绎封闭DL理论的非单调更新，并将增量推理器视为黑盒。
AI.result: 在四个强调经典规划所不具备的语义能力的OWL基准上进行评估：带见证搜索的参数化目标、搜索中期的DL蕴含推理、开放世界假设注入和对抗性矛盾猎取。结果表明该框架在定性上优于经典规划器，且直接推导方法在溯因扩充阶段的量化性能优于基于MHS的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 作者证实了在表达性描述逻辑中原生实现溯因规划的可行性：通过在OWL中表示动作并利用黑盒增量推理器保持逻辑可判定性，同时以直接推导的溯因方法克服组合搜索瓶颈，在开放世界的动态知识图谱推理与规划任务上取得了优于经典规划器的表现。

title: PanDent: Toward Comprehensive Tooth-Level Structure-Language Consistency in Dental Radiology
summary: Accurate evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in dental panoramic radiography (orthopantomogram, OPG) is limited by the lack of fine-grained, clinically reliable benchmarks that reflect expert interpretation. This work introduces PanDent, a large-scale, clinically grounded OPG benchmark built upon fine-grained, expert-validated tooth-level annotations. The dataset comprises 9,524 high-quality OPGs, each associated with comprehensive structured annotations produced by experienced dentists and further validated by an oral and maxillofacial radiologist, providing clinically reliable supervision for tooth-level diagnosis and reasoning. Clinically consistent radiology reports are constructed from expert-validated findings using clinician-defined reporting logic, establishing explicit correspondence between structured clinical evidence and free-text descriptions. This design enables evaluation of whether MLLMs generate reports that are not only linguistically coherent but also clinically consistent with expert-validated tooth-level findings. Experiments are conducted on diverse MLLMs, including state-of-the-art (SOTA) proprietary models, general-domain open-source models, and medical-specific models. Results show that current MLLMs can generate fluent reports, yet fail to produce clinically consistent descriptions, exhibiting substantial errors in fine-grained localization and tooth-level diagnosis. Fine-tuning on PanDent significantly improves structure-language consistency, substantially enhancing visual localization accuracy and diagnostic correctness, and bringing model outputs closer to expert dental interpretation. These results establish PanDent as a rigorous benchmark for evaluating tooth-level clinical reasoning in MLLMs and a valuable resource for clinically grounded dental AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PanDent，一个基于9,524张高质量牙科全景X光片（OPG）的大规模临床基准数据集，包含由牙医和口腔颌面放射科医生验证的细粒度牙级标注及临床一致的结构化报告，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在牙科影像中牙级诊断和推理的能力。实验表明现有MLLMs虽能生成流畅报告但缺乏临床一致性，微调后显著改善。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在牙科全景X光片（OPG）上的评估缺乏细粒度、临床可靠的基准，难以真实反映模型是否具备专家级别的牙级诊断和推理能力。
AI.method: 构建包含9,524张OPG的大型基准数据集PanDent，由经验丰富的牙医生成结构化标注并由口腔颌面放射科医生验证；利用临床定义的报告逻辑将验证后的发现转换为临床一致的自由文本报告，实现结构化证据与文本描述的显式对应。在多种MLLMs（SOTA专有模型、通用开源模型、医学专用模型）上评测，并进行微调实验。
AI.result: 当前MLLMs能生成流畅的放射报告，但在细粒度定位和牙级诊断上存在大量错误，无法产生临床一致的描述；在PanDent上进行微调后，模型的结构-语言一致性显著提升，视觉定位准确性和诊断正确性大幅增强，输出更接近专家级牙科解读。
AI.conclusion: PanDent可作为评估MLLMs牙级临床推理能力的严格基准，并为临床牙科AI提供有价值的资源，验证了基于细粒度临床标注的基准对提升和评估医学多模态模型的重要性。

title: RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation
summary: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.

AI.tldr: 提出RLPF（性能反馈强化学习）方法，将执行结果转化为分阶段奖励，训练代码智能体不仅生成正确程序，还优化程序运行效率。在PerfCodeBench上用Qwen3-32B微调，正确且可运行比例从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有代码模型训练虽有执行反馈，但反馈信号仅止于正确性，忽略了系统代码中两个程序可通过相同测试但运行时差异巨大的情况。运行时间本身是脆弱的奖励信号——只有在程序正确后才有意义、跨任务差异大、且当多数采样程序无法编译或运行时几乎无指导作用，因此需要设计更有效的奖励机制。
AI.method: 提出RLPF（Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback），将执行结果转化为分阶段奖励：失败程序按执行进度排序，正确程序按其相对基线到专家参考的改进程度排序。这样在正确性之前提供有用反馈，在正确性之后提供性能敏感反馈。
AI.result: 在PerfCodeBench上对Qwen3-32B进行RLPF微调，正确且可运行解决方案从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。训练后的模型可与更强的开源模型竞争，优化行为适度迁移至EffiBench-X。额外研究表明模型生成的参考提供有用但较弱的监督，完整复合奖励比仅正确性或仅运行时基准更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 代码智能体不仅可以被训练来通过测试，还可以被训练来优化其编写的程序，这表明性能优化可以作为一个可学习的训练目标而非仅作为评估指标。

title: Low-Pathwidth GRAND: Exact Likelihood-Ordered Enumeration for BPSK Transmission over Correlated Gaussian Noise
summary: The finite-block maximum-likelihood (ML) guarantee of soft-input GRAND requires querying noise-effect patterns in nonincreasing conditional-likelihood order. Under correlated Gaussian noise, additive reliability metrics and independent-block approximations need not preserve this order because the matched metric contains cross-coordinate interactions; the first codebook hit need not induce an ML codeword. We develop Low-Pathwidth GRAND (LP-GRAND) for binary phase-shift keying (BPSK) with precision matrix $Q$. The candidate-dependent part of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood is an observation-dependent quadratic pseudo-Boolean energy whose interaction graph has edge $\{i,j\}$ exactly when $Q_{ij}\neq0$. If $Q$ has half-bandwidth at most $ν$, this energy admits a trellis with at most $2^ν$ states per layer; a path decomposition of width $w$ yields at most $2^{w+1}$ bag assignments per layer. In real arithmetic, suffix dynamic programming and best-first complete-path enumeration enumerate patterns in nondecreasing energy. With complete enumeration and no abandonment, the first codebook hit induces an ML codeword for any nonempty binary codebook with equiprobable codewords. LP-GRAND agreed with exhaustive codeword ML in all $10{,}000$ frames for two $[20,12]$ codes. At nominal $E_b/N_0=2$ dB, its empirical BLER was lower than that of each block-based approximation for six $[64,52]$ codes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出低路径宽度GRAND（LP-GRAND）解码器，用于相关高斯噪声下的软输入GRAND解码。通过利用精度矩阵Q的带状结构构造trellis和路径分解，以真实算术中的后缀动态规划枚举噪声模式，确保首个码本命中即为ML码字。实验验证其在有限分块和有限码长下与穷举ML一致，且性能优于基于分块的近似方法。
AI.motivation: 软输入GRAND的有限分块最大似然（ML）保证需要按照非增条件似然顺序查询噪声模式。但在相关高斯噪声下，加法可靠性度量和独立分块近似因包含交叉坐标交互而无法保持该顺序，导致首个码本命中不一定是ML码字。因此需要一种能精确保持ML顺序的高效算法。
AI.method: 将BPSK传输中高斯负对数似然的候选相关部分建模为观测相关的二次伪布尔能量，其交互图边与精度矩阵Q的非零元素对应。若Q的半带宽不超过ν，可利用每个状态至多2^ν个状态的trellis结构；宽度为w的路径分解使每层至多2^{w+1}个袋分配。通过后缀动态规划和最佳优先完整路径枚举，以实数算术按能量非减顺序枚举模式。完整枚举且不放弃的情况下，首个码本命中即为ML码字。
AI.result: LP-GRAND在两个[20,12]码的全部10,000帧上与穷举码本ML结果一致。在标称E_b/N_0=2 dB下，对六个[64,52]码的实测BLER均低于各分块近似方法的BLER。
AI.conclusion: LP-GRAND通过在相关高斯噪声下精确保持ML查询顺序，实现了真正的ML保证，同时利用精度矩阵的带状结构（小半带宽）高效枚举噪声模式，克服了传统分块近似方法的ML保真度损失。

title: Learning to Persuade Privately Informed Receivers
summary: Bayesian persuasion studies how an informed sender can influence the behavior of a receiver through strategic information disclosure. Standard models assume the sender is the receiver's only source of information, yet in many applications receivers also consult external sources the sender can neither observe nor control. We study an online Bayesian persuasion problem in which a binary-action receiver has access to a fixed signaling scheme that is unknown to the sender. Over $T$ rounds, the sender commits to a signaling scheme and sends a signal; the receiver combines it with its private signal and acts, while the sender observes only the action. We design a learning algorithm that achieves regret $\widetilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ relative to the optimal scheme of a sender who knows the private signaling scheme of the receiver, with polynomial dependence on the sizes of the state space and the receiver's signal alphabet. Our key insight is reducing the problem of learning the exponentially large belief-space partitioning induced by the private scheme to a one-dimensional change-point detection problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线贝叶斯说服问题，其中接收者（receiver）拥有发送者既无法观察也无法控制的固定私有信号方案。发送者在T轮中承诺并发送信号，仅观察接收者的行动，目标是学习最优发送方案。作者提出一种学习算法，相对已知私有方案的最优发送者实现Õ(T^(3/4))的遗憾，关键洞见是将指数规模的信念空间划分学习问题约简为一维变点检测问题。
AI.motivation: 标准贝叶斯说服模型假设发送者是接收者的唯一信息来源，但在实际应用中接收者还常咨询发送者无法观察和控制的外部信息源。这使得传统的贝叶斯说服假设不成立，需要研究发送者在不知道接收者私有信号方案情况下的在线学习问题。
AI.method: 将接收者的私有信号方案引起的指数规模信念空间划分问题，约简为一维变点检测问题。发送者在每轮通过观察接收者的行动来推断信念空间的划分结构，并设计学习算法来近似最优的发送信号方案。
AI.result: 所设计的算法实现了相对于知晓接收者私有信号方案的最优发送者的遗憾上界Õ(T^(3/4))，且对状态空间大小和接收者信号字母表大小具有多项式依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在在线贝叶斯说服中考虑接收者拥有发送者无法控制的私有信息源，通过变点检测约简技术有效解决了指数规模信念空间的学习问题，拓展了贝叶斯说服理论在更现实场景下的适用性。

title: Same Facts, Different Diagnosis: Measuring and Mitigating Narrative Anchoring in Clinical Language Models
summary: Large language models used for clinical diagnostic reasoning are sensitive to sociolinguistic register, not just clinical content. We term this failure mode Narrative Anchoring: identical clinical facts expressed in different registers cause diagnostic outputs to diverge. Unlike prior demographic-bias work, which manipulates explicit identity tokens such as race or income, our benchmark isolates register as the sole channel of variation, with no demographic marker present in any form. We construct a dataset of 1,000 USMLE clinical vignettes, each rewritten into three sociolinguistically distinct personas under an independently audited fact-preservation guarantee, verified by a separate model that never sees the generation prompt. Across seven language models spanning three architecture families and scales, Narrative Anchoring is statistically significant under direct prompting in every model tested, with a Narrative Anchoring Gap of 0.064 to 0.151. Chain-of-thought reasoning and explicit debiasing instructions reduce the bias only partially, and their apparent gains are frequently confounded by accuracy collapse. We introduce NarrativeShield, a three-agent pipeline that structurally extracts and verifies clinical facts before diagnostic reasoning begins, reducing the Narrative Anchoring Gap to near-zero ($-0.004$ to $0.037$) and achieving the lowest rate of severely unstable decisions (DSS $<$ 0.8) of any method across all models, at a modest and mechanistically expected accuracy cost for most models. A stress test using a non-instruction-tuned base model shows that executing a debiasing intervention at all is gated by zero-shot instruction-following ability, not prompt content alone. We release our dataset, human-validated for fact preservation, as a standalone resource for studying register-based clinical bias.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型在临床诊断推理中对"社会语言语域"（sociolinguistic register）敏感，即使临床事实完全相同、没有任何人口统计学标记，仅因表述风格不同就会导致诊断输出分歧。作者将这一失败模式命名为"Narrative Anchoring"，构建了1,000个USMLE临床病例的基准数据集（每个病例改写为三种语域风格并独立审计事实保真度），在7个模型上验证了该偏差的统计显著性（Gap 0.064-0.151），并提出NarrativeShield三智能体管道将偏差降至近零。
AI.motivation: 现有关于临床诊断偏差的研究主要关注显式的人口统计学标记（如种族、收入），但实践中临床表述的语域差异（如不同社会阶层病人的叙述方式）可能在无任何人口标记的情况下单独引发诊断分歧。作者旨在揭示并量化这种未被充分研究的偏差模式，并开发缓解方法。
AI.method: 1）构建1,000个USMLE临床病例基准，每个病例在独立审计的事实保真保证下改写成三种社会语言学家区分的语域风格，由另一个不接触生成提示的模型验证事实不变；2）在7个涵盖三个架构家族的模型上测量直接提示下的Narrative Anchoring Gap；3）测试思维链推理和显式去偏指令的效果；4）提出NarrativeShield：三智能体管道，在诊断推理前结构化提取并验证临床事实，将偏差降至近零。
AI.result: 所有7个模型在直接提示下均表现出统计显著的Narrative Anchoring（Gap 0.064-0.151）；思维链和显式去偏指令只能部分减少偏差，且其表面收益常被准确率崩塌混淆；NarrativeShield将偏差降至-0.004到0.037（近零），并实现所有方法中最低的严重不稳定决策率（DSS<0.8），对多数模型仅造成适度和机制上可预期的准确率代价。非指令微调的基础模型压力测试表明，去偏干预的执行受限于零样本指令遵循能力。
AI.conclusion: Narrative Anchoring是一种独立于人口统计学标记的、普遍存在的临床诊断偏差模式；NarrativeShield通过"先提取验证事实、再诊断推理"的结构化管线能有效消除该偏差。研究还揭示了一个重要方法学陷阱：去偏提示的表面效果可能被准确率崩塌所混淆，且模型本身需要足够的指令遵循能力才能执行去偏干预。数据集将作为独立资源公开发布。

title: PAUSE: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personal AI Assistants in Unified Service Environments
summary: Personal AI assistants are increasingly deployed as task-oriented, tool-augmented agents that operate within unified service environments to support everyday user activities. In realistic settings, such assistants must reason over persistent user state, respect user-specific configurations and permissions, and sustain long-horizon, constraint-aware interactions across multiple services. Existing benchmarks, however, often fragment service contexts or abstract away user state, limiting their ability to evaluate user-centric personal assistant behavior in realistic service settings. We introduce PAUSE, a user-centric benchmark for evaluating personal AI assistants in stateful, service-integrated environments. PAUSE captures core challenges of real-world assistant deployment by requiring agents to coordinate actions across heterogeneous user-owned resources while maintaining consistency with environment state, authorization constraints over multi-turn interactions. The benchmark incorporates explicit user-agent interaction via realistic user simulation, enabling evaluation beyond static tool execution. To support principled and reproducible evaluation, PAUSE adopts a multi-regime evaluation framework aligned with task characteristics. Open-ended service management tasks are assessed using semantic and trajectory-level behavioral metrics, while constraint-intensive tasks admit deterministic, state-based verification. Benchmark results show that even state-of-the-art proprietary models fail to reach 70% task completion on scenarios requiring stateful reasoning and configuration awareness, revealing consistent and interpretable failure patterns. Finally, we present a user-centric synthesis pipeline that enables scalable generation of coherent service environments, user configurations, and reliably annotated tasks, supporting benchmark extensibility and future research.

AI.tldr: PAUSE是一个面向个人AI助手的有状态、服务集成环境基准测试，通过用户模拟、多机制评估框架和可扩展的合成管道，系统评估助手在持久用户状态、配置权限和多轮长程交互中的表现。实验表明即使最先进的专有模型在需要状态推理和配置感知的场景下任务完成率也低于70%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试往往将服务上下文碎片化或抽象掉用户状态，无法评估个人AI助手在真实服务环境中以用户为中心的助手行为。现实中的助手需要在统一服务环境中协调跨服务的用户资源、维护环境状态一致性、遵守用户特定配置和权限，并在多轮交互中持续工作，而这些问题缺少系统性的评估基准。
AI.method: 本文提出PAUSE基准，包含：(1) 有状态、服务集成环境以模拟真实助手部署场景；(2) 显式用户-智能体交互的用户模拟器，支持超越静态工具执行的评估；(3) 多机制评估框架——开放式的服务管理任务使用语义和轨迹级行为指标，约束密集型任务使用确定性、基于状态的验证；(4) 用户中心的合成数据生成管道，可扩展生成一致的服务环境、用户配置和可靠标注任务。
AI.result: 即使最先进的专有模型在需要状态推理和配置感知的场景下任务完成率未能达到70%，且呈现出一致且可解释的失败模式。该基准能够有效区分不同模型在个人助手任务上的表现差异，验证了多机制评估框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PAUSE填补了个人AI助手在有状态、服务集成环境中评估的空白，其合成管道支持基准的可扩展性和未来研究。基准揭示的失败模式为后续改进个人助手的有状态推理和配置感知能力提供了方向。

title: VideoCoCo: Code-as-CoT for Physically-Consistent Video Generation via an Agentic Dual-Engine System
summary: Text-to-video models have achieved remarkable visual quality, yet they still struggle to generate physically consistent dynamics because the temporal evolution of a scene must be inferred implicitly from a highly compressed text prompt. Existing chain-of-thought approaches introduce intermediate plans or visual states, but these representations are typically non-executable or temporally sparse, limiting their ability to instantiate and control the complete spatiotemporal process. To address this limitation, we introduce VideoCoCo, an agentic dual-engine framework in which executable Blender code serves as a process-level chain of thought. Given a text prompt, a coding agent synthesizes a Blender program that explicitly specifies the scene and its temporal evolution. The executable simulation engine runs the program to produce a deterministic spatiotemporal draft, which is subsequently transformed into a photorealistic video by a generative video engine through draft-conditioned editing. This decomposition separates process-level reasoning from high-fidelity visual realization. To adapt the video editor to simulated drafts, we construct VideoCoCo-3K, a curated dataset of draft-instruction-target triplets. VideoCoCo improves the OmniWeaving baseline from 0.475 to 0.558 on PhyGenBench and from 52.18 to 77.88 on VBench-2.0, achieving the best average score on both benchmarks. These results demonstrate that executable code provides an effective, controllable, and inspectable intermediate representation for physically consistent video generation.

AI.tldr: VideoCoCo是一个双引擎智能体框架，利用可执行的Blender代码作为过程级思维链来生成物理一致的视频。编码智能体生成显式描述场景及其时间演化的Blender程序，模拟引擎产生确定性时空草稿，再通过生成视频引擎进行草稿条件编辑生成逼真视频。在PhyGenBench和VBench-2.0上均取得最佳成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有的文生视频模型虽然视觉质量出色，但难以生成物理一致的动态，因为场景的时间演化需要从高度压缩的文本提示中隐式推断。已有的思维链方法引入中间计划或视觉状态，但这些表示通常不可执行或时间上稀疏，限制了其对完整时空过程的实例化和控制能力。
AI.method: VideoCoCo采用双引擎架构：(1) 编码智能体根据文本提示综合生成可执行的Blender程序，显式指定场景及其时间演化；(2) 可执行模拟引擎运行程序生成确定性的时空草稿；(3) 生成视频引擎通过草稿条件编辑将草稿转化为逼真视频。此外构建了VideoCoCo-3K数据集（草稿-指令-目标三元组）以适应视频编辑器。
AI.result: VideoCoCo在PhyGenBench上将OmniWeaving基线从0.475提升至0.558，在VBench-2.0上从52.18提升至77.88，在两个基准上均取得最佳平均分数。
AI.conclusion: 可执行代码为物理一致的视频生成提供了一种有效、可控且可检查的中间表示，将过程级推理与高保真视觉实现分离，验证了该框架在物理一致性视频生成方面的有效性。

title: SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training
summary: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.

AI.tldr: SDO是一个即插即用的数据组织框架，通过暴露驱动的反馈机制（epoch内基于KNN邻域的局部感知分桶 + epoch间暴露均衡调度）动态组织小批量和样本暴露，在不永久排除训练样本的前提下加速SFT、DPO和GRPO的收敛，并提升跨问题类型的准确率均衡性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的后训练成本高昂，现有效率改进主要聚焦于样本选择和训练调度，但数据组织本身被视为静态预处理步骤：基于嵌入的固定分组在训练前构造，无法适应优化过程中样本暴露的动态变化，导致冗余更新与欠优化并存。
AI.method: SDO在两个时间尺度上组织数据：epoch内通过KNN邻域遍历形成连贯的局部感知mini-batch；epoch间通过暴露均衡调度记录每个样本的参与次数并降低过度暴露样本的采样概率，以维持长期覆盖率。SDO基于冻结的外部嵌入逐epoch运行，避免模型热身训练开销。
AI.result: 在SFT、DPO和GRPO三种后训练范式上，SDO均加速了收敛，最大增益出现在训练早期到中期阶段，产生了更连贯的梯度，并在不同问题类型间实现了更均衡的准确率，且不会永久排除训练样本。
AI.conclusion: SDO表明数据组织可以从静态预处理转变为动态、暴露感知的过程，通过结构感知的批组成和暴露平衡调度，在不增加模型热身训练开销的前提下显著提升后训练效率，是一种有效的即插即用数据组织框架。

title: Forecasting Land Art Under Climate Scenarios
summary: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, provides a fixed remote-sensing target whose visual complexity reflects hydroclimatic conditions. A companion study analyzed 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and month from 1984 to 2025. It found robust relationships between coarse-scale permutation entropy, mean intensity, and the third principal component of ResNet50 avg-pool embeddings, and lake elevation, regional temperature, and cumulative CO2. It also showed that image complexity leads lake stage by about three years and that the long-term trend is non-monotonic, with decline after 2015. Building on those findings, this paper develops a two-stage forecasting pipeline. Stage 1 applies IPCC AR6 SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, and SSP5-8.5 temperature changes to forecast regional temperature, north- and south-arm lake elevation, salinity, and cumulative CO2 for 2030 and 2050. Stage 2a projects 14 image-complexity features using linear and Random Forest regressions trained on the 42-year record. All six scenario-year combinations move the inputs outside the 1984-2025 training distribution. The Random Forest model therefore saturates near the post-2015 dry-playa regime, while a threshold-based hydrological interpretation classifies Spiral Jetty as fully exposed in every scenario. Stage 2b specifies a climate-conditioned latent-diffusion framework using Stable Diffusion XL fine-tuned with LoRA on the 1,744 chips, ControlNet conditioning on the climate vector, and a hydrological physics mask for ensemble image synthesis. Code is provided, and validation results will be released after diffusion training. We conclude by discussing ethical implications of generative speculation on cultural heritage and outlining a roadmap for forecasting at Sun Tunnels, Double Negative, Lightning Field, and Roden Crater.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1970年Robert Smithson的大地艺术作品Spiral Jetty作为固定遥感目标，利用1984-2025年间1,744个Landsat和Sentinel-2影像芯片，开发了一个两阶段气候预测管线：第一阶段使用IPCC AR6三种共享社会经济路径（SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5、SSP5-8.5）预测2030和2050年的区域温度、湖面高程、盐度和累计CO2；第二阶段a用线性和随机森林回归投影14个图像复杂度特征，第二阶段b提出气候条件化的Stable Diffusion XL潜在扩散框架结合LoRA微调和ControlNet控制生成集成图像。所有情景组合均将输入推向训练分布之外，随机森林模型饱和于2015年后的干涸盐滩状态，表明Spiral Jetty在所有情景下已完全暴露。
AI.motivation: 将大地艺术作品Spiral Jetty作为气候变化的长期遥感监测指标，预测其视觉状态随水文气候条件演变的未来趋势，为文化遗产的气候适应提供量化依据。
AI.method: 两阶段预测管线：阶段1基于IPCC AR6 SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5、SSP5-8.5温度变化预测2030/2050年的区域温度、湖面高程、盐度和累计CO2；阶段2a使用线性和Random Forest回归投影14个图像复杂度特征；阶段2b提出气候条件化潜在扩散框架（Stable Diffusion XL + LoRA微调 + ControlNet气候向量条件 + 水文物理掩码）进行集成图像合成。
AI.result: 所有六个情景-年份组合均将输入移出1984-2025年训练分布；Random Forest模型在超出训练分布时饱和于2015年后干涸盐滩状态；阈值水文解释将所有情景下Spiral Jetty分类为完全暴露。
AI.conclusion: Spiral Jetty在所有气候情景下均面临完全暴露风险，提示需关注气候变化对文化遗址的影响；同时讨论了对文化遗产进行生成式推测的伦理问题，并规划将预测方法扩展到Sun Tunnels、Double Negative、Lightning Field和Roden Crater等其他大地艺术作品。

title: Agents That Certify Their Own Exploits: Confidence-Scheduled Restricted Responses for Safe Opponent Exploitation
summary: An agent playing a Nash-equilibrium strategy in a two-player zero-sum imperfect-information game secures the game value but forfeits the additional value offered by a flawed opponent. Diffuse deviations pose a particular challenge: binary release rules may gather too little evidence to act, while a full best response to an incomplete opponent model can be highly exploitable. We introduce \emph{budget-constrained confidence-scheduled restricted responses} (CS-RNR), the first opponent-exploitation method whose safety guarantee is a certificate the agent computes on the strategy it actually deploys, so that every exploit it commits to is one it has audited itself. The method tracks pooled action frequencies with anytime-valid confidence sequences and treats a frequency as exploitable only once its interval separates from an equilibrium reference. The confirmed deviations define a conservative opponent model, which a restricted-response solve turns into candidate counter-strategies over a grid of pin levels. Before deployment, each complete candidate is evaluated by a full-tree best response. The resulting certificate is compared with a user-specified budget and committed atomically with the strategy. Because this check is performed on the played strategy, model quality determines the exploitation achieved while the certificate controls reference-relative expected loss. In Leduc hold'em, CS-RNR obtains $6.2\times$ the steady-state gain of a money-verified binary gate while keeping every deployed strategy within budget. A trajectory mixture using the same estimator reaches $13.6\times$ the budget. Across Leduc, Liar's Dice, and 5-rank Leduc, all $36{,}000$ audited hands satisfy the reported certificate tolerance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CS-RNR（预算约束置信调度受限响应）方法，这是首个对手利用方法，其安全保证是可审计的证书——代理在实际部署的策略上自行计算该证书，确保每次利用都已通过自我审计。该方法通过随时有效的置信序列追踪联合动作频率，仅当偏差区间与均衡参考分离时才视为可利用，并通过受限响应求解生成候选反制策略，最终以全树最优响应对完整候选进行审计。在Leduc hold'em中，CS-RNR获得6.2倍于金钱验证二元门控的稳态收益，轨迹混合方法达到13.6倍预算，且所有36,000手审计手牌均满足证书容差。
AI.motivation: 在两人零和、不完备信息的博弈中，使用纳什均衡策略的代理只能确保博弈价值，却会错失利用对手失误而获得的额外收益。然而，攻击性利用面临两难：二元释放规则可能因证据不足而无法行动，而对不完备对手模型进行完全最优响应则可能被高度利用。因此需要一种既能主动利用对手偏差又能保证自身安全的方法。
AI.method: CS-RNR包含三个核心组件：(1)使用随时有效的置信序列追踪对手的联合动作频率，只有当置信区间与均衡参考分离时才判定该频率可利用；(2)确认的偏差构建保守对手模型，通过受限响应求解在引脚水平网格上生成候选反制策略；(3)部署前，每个完整候选通过全树最优响应进行评估，生成证书后与用户指定预算比较，并以原子方式与策略一同提交。
AI.result: 在Leduc hold'em中，CS-RNR的稳态收益是金钱验证二元门控方法的6.2倍，同时每个部署策略都严格在预算范围内。使用相同估计器的轨迹混合方法达到13.6倍的预算收益。在Leduc、Liar's Dice和5-rank Leduc三个游戏中，所有36,000手审计手牌均满足报告证书容差。
AI.conclusion: CS-RNR提供了首个可由代理自行审计的安全利用方法，其关键创新在于证书在实际部署的策略上计算，而非仅在对手模型上。这使得模型质量决定利用效果，而证书控制相对参照的期望损失，在对手利用与策略安全之间取得了有效平衡。

title: AHA-Memes: A Fine-Grained Multimodal Benchmark for Understanding Hate in Arabic Memes
summary: Hateful memes are a growing form of multimodal online harm, where hostile intent is often conveyed through the joint interpretation of images, text, cultural references, and implicit targets. While hateful meme detection has advanced in high-resource languages, Arabic remains underexplored, with existing meme resources focusing mainly on propaganda or coarse harmful-content labels. We introduce AHA-Memes (Arabic HAteful Memes), which is, to our knowledge, the first large-scale Arabic hateful meme benchmark with fine-grained, multi-label annotations. The dataset includes 5K manually annotated memes using a taxonomy that captures hate types, i.e., attack strategies. We further provide ~66K silver-labeled memes to support future studies. We benchmark text-only, image-only, and late-fusion multimodal models, as well as few-shot in-context learning (ICL) and open- and closed-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under zero-shot and fine-tuning settings. Our results establish strong baselines and highlight key challenges in culturally grounded Arabic hateful meme detection. We release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and evaluation scripts to support future research. WARNING: This paper contains examples that may be disturbing to readers.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AHA-Memes，这是首个大规模阿拉伯语仇恨表情包基准数据集，包含5K条人工标注的多标签细粒度仇恨注释和约66K条银标签样本，并系统评测了多种多模态模型，揭示了阿拉伯语文化语境下仇恨表情包检测的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 仇恨表情包是一种日益增长的多模态在线危害形式，其敌意通常通过图像、文本、文化参照和隐含目标的联合解释来传达。尽管高资源语言的仇恨表情包检测已取得进展，但阿拉伯语仍缺乏探索，现有阿拉伯语表情包资源主要集中于宣传或粗粒度有害内容标注，缺少细粒度的仇恨类型标注和基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含5K条人工标注的阿拉伯语仇恨表情包数据集AHA-Memes，采用多标签细粒度标注，使用基于攻击策略的仇恨类型分类体系；另提供约66K条银标签样本。基准测试涵盖文本-only、图像-only、晚期融合多模态模型，以及少样本上下文学习（ICL）和开放/封闭权重视觉语言模型（VLMs）在零样本和微调设置下的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果建立了强基线，突出了在文化根植的阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测中的关键挑战，包括现有模型在多模态跨模态理解和文化语境外显推理方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: AHA-Memes为阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测提供了首个细粒度多标签基准，并公开发布数据集、标注指南和评估脚本以支持未来研究，推动低资源语言多模态有害内容检测的发展。

title: SkillMentor: LLM Agent Self-Evolution via Learning Blind-Spot Diagnosis
summary: Agent self-evolution has primarily focused on learning how to act, while overlooking an equally important capability: learning to discover what an agent does not know. Existing approaches typically assume that failure discovery is given, focusing on how to repair failures once they are identified. We ask whether blind-spot diagnosis itself can be learned. We thus study diagnosis as an agent capability separate from execution, and exclude two alternative sources of progress: executor adaptation and human supervision. Under these constraints, performance cannot improve through executor updates or annotated examples, forcing all improvements to originate from the learned diagnostic capability. We propose SkillMentor, which trains a Mentor policy via reinforcement learning to generate diagnostic tasks, identify recurrent failure modes, and curate them into reusable corrective skills. Across AppWorld and BFCLv3, SkillMentor improves executor performance by an average of 44.2%. These results suggest that blind-spot diagnosis is a learnable capability, enabling self-evolution without updating executor weights or relying on human-curated data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillMentor框架，将"盲点诊断"（发现智能体不知道什么）作为独立于执行的可学习能力来研究。通过强化学习训练一个Mentor策略，使其生成诊断任务、识别重复失败模式并将它们整理为可复用的修正技能，在不更新执行器权重且无人类监督的情况下，在AppWorld和BFCLv3上平均提升执行器性能44.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体自我进化研究主要集中在学习"如何行动"，而忽略了"发现自身未知"这一同样重要的能力。传统方法假设失败发现是给定条件，只关注如何修复已识别的失败。本文提出质疑：盲点诊断本身是否可以被学习？为此将诊断作为独立于执行的能力来研究，并排除执行器适配和人类监督这两个替代进步来源。
AI.method: 提出SkillMentor方法，通过强化学习训练一个Mentor策略，使其具备三个功能：(1) 生成诊断任务，主动探测执行器的能力边界；(2) 识别重复出现的失败模式；(3) 将这些失败模式整理成可复用的修正技能。实验约束条件为：不更新执行器权重、不依赖人类标注示例，确保所有性能提升均来源于诊断能力的改进。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和BFCLv3两个基准上，SkillMentor平均提升执行器性能44.2%。这一提升完全来自学习到的诊断能力，而非执行器参数更新或人工注释数据。
AI.conclusion: 盲点诊断是一种可学习的能力。该结果证明，智能体可以在不更新执行器权重、不依赖人工整理数据的情况下实现自我进化，从而开辟了通过"学会发现问题"而非"学会更好执行"来实现自我进化的新路径。

title: IGME: Efficient Chained Method Ensemble for Transferable Semantic Segmentation Attacks
summary: Semantic segmentation models are vulnerable to transferable adversarial perturbations, yet evaluating transfer attacks on dense prediction models can be computationally expensive. Existing ensemble attacks often rely on multiple surrogate models, increasing the computation cost, even harder for segmentation. This paper studies an efficient single-source alternative for transferable attacks on semantic segmentation. We formulate transferable attack composition as a chained computation over differentiable attack components, allowing the expensive source-model gradient computation to be shared. To reduce the update instability introduced by chained composition, we further use an integrated-gradient-style path-averaged direction as an empirical stabilization heuristic. Experiments on Pascal VOC and Cityscapes evaluate the resulting transferability efficiency trade-off across CNN- and transformer-based segmentation models. IGME achieves competitive transferability compared with single-source baselines and favorable runtime compared with model-ensemble attacks, while requiring access to only one source model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IGME，一种仅需单个源模型的语义分割可迁移对抗攻击方法。通过将攻击组件链式组合并共享源模型梯度计算，降低计算开销，并采用积分梯度风格的路径平均方向来稳定更新，在Pascal VOC和Cityscapes上实现与单源基线相当的迁移性与优于模型集成攻击的运行时。
AI.motivation: 语义分割模型容易受到可迁移对抗扰动的影响，但评估密集预测任务的迁移攻击计算开销极大。现有集成攻击依赖多个替代模型，进一步加剧了计算成本，在分割任务上尤其困难。因此需要探索一种计算高效的单源替代方案来实现可迁移攻击。
AI.method: 本文将可迁移攻击的组成形式化为对可微分攻击组件的链式计算（chained computation），从而共享昂贵的源模型梯度计算。为缓解链式组合带来的更新不稳定性，进一步采用积分梯度（integrated-gradient）风格的路径平均方向作为经验性稳定化启发式。整体仅需访问一个源模型。
AI.result: 在Pascal VOC和Cityscapes数据集上，针对CNN和Transformer两类分割模型进行评估。IGME在迁移性上与单源基线相当，在运行时间上优于模型集成攻击，同时仅需一个源模型。
AI.conclusion: IGME实现了迁移性与计算效率之间的良好权衡，证明了单源设置下通过共享梯度计算和路径平均方向的稳定化策略，可以在语义分割任务上获得具有竞争力的可迁移对抗攻击性能。

title: Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision
summary: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

AI.tldr: 提出BridgeMIL框架，通过两阶段解耦实例表示学习与受试者级监督，解决EEG疾病诊断中实例级标签继承带来的问题。Stage 1用时间近邻窗口对齐和子袋对比学习进行无监督预训练，Stage 2将编码器迁移到注意力MIL聚合器并仅对受试者预测施加监督。在三个EEG疾病数据集和五种骨干网络上，14/15个设置中取得最高平均准确率，整体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。
AI.motivation: EEG疾病诊断通常将记录切分为实例并继承受试者标签，假设所有实例具有相同的诊断证据可靠性。多实例学习虽避免标签继承，但EEG数据集中受试者远少于实例，端到端MIL学到的表示质量受限。因此需要一种能解耦实例表示学习与受试者级监督的方法，在丰富实例上学习表示而不将疾病标签分配给单个实例。
AI.method: 两阶段框架BridgeMIL：Stage 1通过对齐时间近邻窗口和独立采样的受试者内子袋进行编码器预训练，不使用继承实例标签，并利用方差和协方差正则化防止表示坍缩并减少冗余，无需负样本对；Stage 2将预训练编码器迁移到基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对受试者预测施加监督，并通过特征保留机制限制表示漂移。
AI.result: 在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个代表性骨干网络下，BridgeMIL在15种数据集-骨干网络设置中的14种取得最高平均准确率，整体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。分析还发现：实例间继承标签可靠性差异显著，性能对受试者稀缺比实例稀缺更敏感，且模型学到更结构化的表示空间，具有清晰的受试者级聚类和更好的诊断类别区分。
AI.conclusion: 监督应与受试者级预测目标对齐，同时可在丰富EEG实例上进行学习而不将疾病标签分配给单个实例。BridgeMIL验证了这一思路的有效性，为EEG疾病诊断中处理受试者-实例层级不一致问题提供了可行的两阶段框架。

title: Persistent Gaussian Perturbations Prevent Oversmoothing in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks
summary: Oversmoothing is a fundamental limitation of deep graph neural networks (GNNs), where repeated message passing causes node representations to become increasingly similar, eventually collapsing toward a low-dimensional subspace. This phenomenon limits the effective depth of message-passing architectures and motivates the search for mechanisms that preserve representation diversity. In this paper, we study a recurrent graph neural network in which independent Gaussian noise is injected after every propagation step and analyze the resulting architecture as a stochastic dynamical system. Under a standard global contraction assumption on the deterministic update, we prove that the hidden representations form a geometrically ergodic Markov chain admitting a unique invariant probability measure. Our main theoretical result establishes an explicit positive lower bound on the expected stationary Dirichlet energy, proportional to both the noise variance and the spectral gap of the underlying graph. Consequently, the stationary representations cannot collapse onto the constant manifold, providing a rigorous guarantee that asymptotic oversmoothing is prevented in the sense of non-vanishing Dirichlet energy. Our analysis reveals persistent stochastic perturbations as a fundamentally different mechanism for combating oversmoothing, complementing existing deterministic approaches based on residual connections, normalization, and graph rewiring. Finally, numerical experiments on both linear and nonlinear recurrent graph neural networks closely match the theoretical predictions, illustrating the emergence of a stationary distribution and the predicted dependence of the limiting Dirichlet energy on the noise intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种在每次传播后注入独立高斯噪声的循环图神经网络，将其建模为随机动力系统，理论上证明了在全局收缩假设下隐层表示构成几何遍历的马尔可夫链，并建立了稳态Dirichlet能量的正下界（正比于噪声方差与图的谱间隙），从而严格保证渐近过平滑被防止。数值实验与理论预测高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络中过平滑现象是制约网络深度的根本性限制，重复消息传递导致节点表示趋于相似并坍缩到低维子空间。现有确定性方法（残差连接、归一化、图重连）虽能缓解该问题，但缺乏基于随机扰动机制的严格理论保证，因此需要探索新的机制来保持表示多样性。
AI.method: 将注入独立高斯噪声的循环图神经网络建模为随机动力系统；在确定性更新的全局收缩假设下，证明隐层表示构成几何遍历的马尔可夫链并存在唯一不变概率测度；通过期望稳态Dirichlet能量的分析建立正下界，该下界与噪声方差和图谱间隙成正比。
AI.result: 理论结果表明稳态表示不会坍缩到常数流形，在非零Dirichlet能量意义上严格防止了渐近过平滑；线性与非线性循环GNN上的数值实验均与理论预测一致，验证了平稳分布的存在性及Dirichlet能量对噪声强度的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 持续随机扰动为对抗过平滑提供了一种与确定性方法根本不同的新机制，为深度图神经网络的设计提供了新的理论视角与保障。

title: Algorithms for Structured Elections under Thiele Voting Rules
comment: 18 pages. A conference version of this work appeared in AAAI 2026
summary: We study the computational complexity of winner determination problems in approval-based committee elections under Thiele voting rules. These form a class of rules parameterized by a fixed weight vector that specifies how a voter's satisfaction depends on the number of approved candidates elected. We first analyze the structure of optimal solutions based on the sets of voters who approve each candidate---that is, how voters' approval ballots induce dependencies between candidates---revealing constraints on a winning committee under any fixed Thiele voting rule. Using this, we design FPT algorithms for Proportional Approval Voting (PAV) and other Thiele rules on a natural restricted domain known as the Voter Interval (VI) domain---that is, after a suitable ordering of voters, each candidate is approved by a consecutive interval of voters. In particular, we show that every Thiele rule on VI is FPT with respect to a parameter for which the problem is NP-hard on general instances, even when the parameter takes constant values. Our results advance the understanding of the computational complexity of PAV on Voter Interval instances, which remains one of the central open questions in this area. We further resolve two open questions from the literature on PAV (and other Thiele voting rules) by providing a polynomial-time algorithm for instances where each candidate is approved by at most two voters, and an FPT algorithm parameterized by the total score of a winning committee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Thiele投票规则下批准制委员会选举中赢家确定问题的计算复杂性。作者首先分析了最优解的结构约束，进而为选民间隔(VI)域上的比例批准投票(PAV)及其他Thiele规则设计了FPT算法，并解决了该领域两个开放问题：每个候选人至多被两位选民批准时可多项式时间求解，以及以获胜委员会总分数为参数的FPT算法。
AI.motivation: 批准制委员会选举中的赢家确定问题是计算复杂性研究的重要课题。PAV在VI域上的计算复杂性是该领域的核心开放问题之一。作者希望通过分析最优解的结构特性，为Thiele规则在受限域上设计高效算法，并解决文献中的开放问题。
AI.method: 作者首先基于批准选票在候选人之间引发的依赖关系，分析了固定Thiele投票规则下获胜委员会的结构约束。利用这些结构性质，在VI域上设计了FPT参数化算法。同时，针对候选人最多被两位选民批准的情况给出了多项式时间算法，并以获胜委员会的总分数为参数设计了FPT算法。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 证明了每个Thiele规则在VI域上相对于某个参数是FPT的，而该参数在一般实例上即使取常数值问题也是NP难的；(2) 解决了PAV及其它Thiele规则的两个开放问题，包括每位候选人至多被两位选民批准时的多项式时间算法，以及以获胜委员会总分数为参数的FPT算法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究显著推进了对PAV在VI实例上计算复杂性的理解，为Thiele规则提供了新的算法工具和复杂性下界，并解决了该领域的多个开放性挑战。

title: Benchmarking LLM Competence on Logical Inference over Probability Operators
summary: Both expressions of uncertainty and inferences are ubiquitous in natural language, and valid inferences over natural-language expressions of uncertainty are necessary for not only everyday conversations but also for high-stakes domains such as medicine and law. While large language models are increasingly evaluated on logical reasoning tasks, disentangling principled, symbolic reasoning from clever surface-level pattern matching is fraught with difficulty. We introduce a benchmark for reasoning over probability operators--inference over sentences with gradable epistemic modals (e.g., probably, might, must) containing 14,320 procedurally-generated English prompts across fifteen inference templates, systematically varying question form, negation strategy, and surface content. Evaluating 29 models, we find that most show answer biases independent of the logical form, a systematic preference for Yes or No. We summarize this with a competence floor: the worse of a model's accuracy on Yes-correct and No-correct items. Only 9 of 29 models exceed random chance. We also test variations in question form, verb phrases/activity, and both the gender and origin of names used in the prompts, finding biases across every axis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为"概率算子推理"的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型对带有程度性认识情态词（如probably, might, must）句子的推理能力，包含14,320个程序化生成的英语提示，涵盖15种推理模板。对29个模型的评估发现，大多数模型表现出与逻辑形式无关的答案偏见（系统性偏好Yes或No），仅9个模型超过随机水平。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中不确定性表达和推理无处不在，而对不确定性表达进行有效推理对于日常对话及医疗、法律等高风险领域都至关重要。虽然大语言模型在逻辑推理任务上的评估日益增多，但区分有原则的符号推理与表面模式匹配十分困难。需要一个能够系统解耦逻辑形式与表层内容影响的基准。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含14,320个程序化生成的英语提示的基准测试，系统性地在15种推理模板中变化问题形式、否定策略和表层内容。评估了29个大语言模型，引入"能力下限"（competence floor）指标（模型在Yes正确和No正确项目上准确率的较差者）来量化答案偏见。
AI.result: 发现大多数模型表现出独立于逻辑形式的系统性Yes或No偏好答案偏见；仅9/29个模型超过随机水平。此外，问题形式、动词短语/活动、人名性别和来源的变化也引发了系统性偏见。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型在概率算子推理上能力有限，普遍存在与逻辑内容无关的答案偏差，表明它们更多依赖表层统计模式而非真正的符号推理能力。

title: Beyond the Bidirectional Promise: Re-evaluating the Robustness of Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) generation by enabling bidirectional context and iterative refinement. However, their reliability under natural input noise and adversarial attacks remains under-explored. To address this, we systematically evaluate DLM robustness and calibration against AR baselines, using two parameter-matched pairs (LLaDA-8B vs. LLaMA-3-8B and Dream-7B vs. Qwen2.5-7B) across 32 natural perturbation conditions, adversarial gradient probes, and mechanistic hidden-state analyses. This paired design effectively isolates architecture-intrinsic properties from weight-dependent behaviors. We find a nuanced robustness profile: while highly stochastic DLM loss landscapes naturally resist gradient-based adversarial suffixes, they provide no guaranteed defense against natural noise, proving that everyday robustness is weight-dependent rather than inherently architectural. Furthermore, DLMs exhibit systematic overconfidence, presenting a practical deployment hazard. Most crucially, mechanistic probing reveals that all models perfectly encode input corruption, isolating behavioral fragility entirely to a decoder routing failure. Consistent with this diagnosis, we show that surface-level prompt patching fails to improve over noisy baselines. Ultimately, DLM robustness cannot be patched on; it must be fundamentally integrated into the iterative decoding loop.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了扩散语言模型（DLMs）相比自回归（AR）模型在自然输入噪声和对抗攻击下的鲁棒性与校准性能，发现DLM虽然天然抵抗梯度对抗后缀攻击，但在自然噪声下并不具备架构性免疫，且存在系统性过度自信问题。核心诊断表明所有模型都能完美编码输入损坏，行为脆弱性源于解码器路由失败，因此鲁棒性无法通过表面提示修补实现，必须内置于迭代解码循环中。
AI.motivation: DLMs作为AR模型的替代方案具有双向上下文和迭代精炼的优势，但其在自然输入噪声和对抗攻击下的可靠性尚未得到充分研究，需要对DLM的鲁棒性和校准能力进行系统性评估。
AI.method: 采用两组参数匹配模型对（LLaDA-8B vs. LLaMA-3-8B和Dream-7B vs. Qwen2.5-7B），在32种自然扰动条件下，结合对抗梯度探针和机制性隐状态分析，通过配对设计有效隔离架构固有属性与权重依赖行为。
AI.result: 发现DLM具有微妙的鲁棒性画像：高随机性的损失景观天然抵抗基于梯度的对抗后缀攻击，但对自然噪声无保证防御（表明日常鲁棒性是权重依赖而非架构固有）；同时DLM表现出系统性过度自信。机制探针显示所有模型都能完美编码输入损坏，行为脆弱性完全源于解码器路由失败，且表面提示修补无法改善噪声基线。
AI.conclusion: DLM的鲁棒性无法通过外部提示修补实现，必须从根本上整合进迭代解码循环中。

title: ProgFormer: Hierarchical Voxel Diffusion Transformer for Longitudinal Brain MRI Prediction
summary: Predicting future structural MRI of a brain is challenging because longitudinal changes are often subtle and confined to specific anatomical regions, while most subject-specific brain structure remains stable over time. An effective model should therefore preserve global brain structural consistency while remaining sensitive to fine-grained disease progression. Existing latent-space-based methods improve computational efficiency, but suffer from information loss during their compression-reconstruction procedure. In contrast, direct voxel-space methods avoid latent reconstruction but commonly use a unified prediction pathway to model brain structure and progression-related changes. Subtle local changes may therefore be overshadowed by the dominant stable brain structure. To address these challenges, we propose ProgFormer, a hierarchical voxel-space Diffusion Transformer for longitudinal brain MRI prediction. ProgFormer uses a coarse pathway to perform the primary volumetric prediction from 3D patch tokens. This pathway models overall brain structure and longitudinal context. The fine pathway then uses the coarse representations as spatio-temporal grounding for voxel-level refinement within individual patches. The two pathways jointly estimate a velocity field directly in voxel space through conditional flow matching, enabling end-to-end prediction without a separately learned image autoencoder. The predicted future scan is then generated from Gaussian noise by integrating the estimated velocity field over a sequence of Euler steps. Extensive experimental results on three widely used benchmarks, ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS, under both pairwise and trajectory settings demonstrate favourable performance compared against several state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: ProgFormer是一个用于纵向脑MRI预测的分层体素空间扩散Transformer。它通过粗路径进行整体体积预测和纵向上下文建模，细路径利用粗表征作为时空锚定进行体素级细化，通过条件流匹配直接在体素空间估计速度场，无需单独学习图像自编码器即可端到端预测未来脑部扫描。
AI.motivation: 现有纵向脑MRI预测方法存在两大问题：一是潜在空间方法在压缩-重建过程中丢失信息；二是直接体素空间方法使用统一预测通路建模脑结构和疾病进展，导致微小的局部变化被占主导地位的稳定脑结构所掩盖。需要一种既能保持全局结构一致性又能敏感捕捉精细疾病进展的模型。
AI.method: ProgFormer采用分层体素空间扩散Transformer架构，包含两条通路：粗通路（coarse pathway）从3D patch tokens执行主要的体积预测，建模整体脑结构和纵向上下文；细通路（fine pathway）利用粗表征作为时空锚定（spatio-temporal grounding），在单个patch内进行体素级细化。两条通路通过条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）联合在体素空间直接估计速度场，随后通过对速度场进行一系列Euler步骤积分，从高斯噪声生成预测的未来扫描图像。
AI.result: 在ADNI、AIBL和OASIS三个广泛使用的基准上，在配对（pairwise）和轨迹（trajectory）两种设置下进行的大量实验表明，ProgFormer在多个指标上优于若干最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: ProgFormer通过分层粗-细双通路设计，成功在体素空间实现端到端的纵向脑MRI预测，避免了潜在空间的信息损失，同时克服了统一通路对细微局部变化不敏感的问题，在多个基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。

title: Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents
summary: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

AI.tldr: 本文对4-bit权重量化在"近乎无损"的说法进行了严格检验，发现虽然标准指标（任务分数）上量化看似无损，但过程指标（错误类型和错误量）显示量化会放大模型已有的失败模式（如工具名幻觉）最多2.5倍，只是被benchmark的十错误预算所掩盖。将预算缩减到两个错误后，分数差距（17分）在唯一的受损单元格中重新显现，与掩蔽效应预测完全一致。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化到4-bit权重被广泛报道为近乎无损，但这些评估通常基于标准任务指标。对于多轮、工具调用智能体这一当前最重要的应用场景，这一声称尚未得到严格检验。作者希望验证量化在标准指标上的"无损"是否掩盖了过程层面的实质性退化。
AI.method: 在τ²-bench上，对两个开源模型系列（dense和MoE变体）和两个领域共八个单元格、每个456个episode，在16/8/4-bit权重下进行系统性评估。使用多重比较校正的统计检验、等价性检验、排名相关性分析、错误分类（每通道错误率）、缩减错误预算（从十错误缩至两错误）以及目标性错误修复提示进行诊断。
AI.result: 标准指标上量化看似免费——没有单元格的分数变化通过多重比较校正，最大过程损伤单元格的等价性检验将变化界在±7.5分内。但过程分析显示：量化将模型已有的失败（电信中工具名幻觉、零售实体错误的同方向趋势）放大最多2.5倍（每任务+17.6分），几乎不产生新失败类型（排名相关性≥0.94，仅0.18%新事件）。分数平稳是因为benchmark的十错误预算吸收了额外失败；缩减到两错误后重新显现17分的差距，且仅出现在量化增加错误量的单元格。目标性错误修复提示精确移除了损伤所在之处的量化伤害。
AI.conclusion: 标准任务分数掩盖了量化对过程层面的实质性损伤。建议benchmark在报告任务奖励的同时，附带报告每通道错误率和缩减预算下的成功率这两种从日志中即可获取的诊断指标，以揭示量化等优化技术对模型行为真实而隐蔽的影响。

title: Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification
comment: 42 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables, was presented at the 10th International Conference 'Deep Learning on Computational Physics (DLCP2026)', under review for the Moscow University Physics Bulletin, Physics series
summary: We introduce Kohn--Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), a physics-inspired energy-based model replacing dense CNN classifiers with a sparse-graph spectral embedding evaluated at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model. By mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs and constructing a regularized Laplacian acting as a Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian, we solve $D$ independent channel spectral problems in $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k^2_{\text{mode}} N)$ time via FFT on circulant blocks (leveraging Pontryagin self-duality of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) and low-order Rayleigh refinement. Graph topology is optimized using \emph{star-domain surgery}: rather than destroying information-carrying codewords by removing frustrated cycles, we construct edge shifts creating local convexity around codewords while bounding residual frustration to $ρ(B_γ)\leq 1+δ$. Multi-scale fractal analysis ($D_2$ spectrum) and fractal learning-rate landscape certifies a landscape transition from rough regimes ($D_2>3$) to star-domain basins ($D_2<1$), enabling Rayleigh refinement with $k_{\text{mode}}=5$ modes. We prove six theoretical results: a generalized Ihara--Bass identity linking belief propagation to the Laplacian; trapping-set eigenvalue correspondence; additive channel separability with an explicit exchange-correlation bound; a surgery theorem bounding frustration with attractor width $Ω(1/\sqrt{d_{\min}})$; a quasi-stationarity perturbation bound; and a fixed-point convergence theorem. In a transductive protocol on ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features ($D=1792$), KSSE achieves \textbf{88.93\%} Top-1 accuracy using $\approx 21.24$M parameters, outperforming Swin-L (197M, 86.4--87.3\%) and matching ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0--89.5\%) under standard inductive setups, while reducing model footprint by $10\times$ and $30\times$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE)，一种受物理学启发的基于能量的模型，用稀疏图谱嵌入替代密集CNN分类器。该方法将预训练特征映射到准循环LDPC图上，构建正则化Laplacian作为Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian，通过FFT在O(N log N + k²_mode N)时间内求解D个独立通道谱问题。在ImageNet-1000上以约2124万参数达到88.93% Top-1准确率，超越Swin-L并匹配ViT-H/14，同时将模型规模压缩10-30倍。
AI.motivation: 现有密集CNN分类器参数冗余、计算开销大；基于图的方法缺乏物理理论基础。作者希望通过将分类问题转化为物理系统（随机键Ising模型）的谱嵌入问题，在保持或超越SOTA精度的同时大幅降低模型参数和计算复杂度，实现"以物理原理替代暴力计算"的目标。
AI.method: 具体方法包括：(1) 将预训练特征映射到准循环LDPC图，构建正则化Laplacian作为Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian；(2) 利用Z/pZ的Pontryagin自对偶性，通过FFT在循环块上求解D个独立通道谱问题，配合低阶Rayleigh细化；(3) 提出star-domain surgery图拓扑优化策略，通过构造边位移在码字周围产生局部凸性，同时将残留纠缠限制在ρ(B_γ)≤1+δ；(4) 使用多尺度分形分析（D₂谱）和分形学习率景观来认证从粗糙区间到star-domain盆地的景观过渡；(5) 证明了六个理论结果，包括广义Ihara-Bass恒等式、陷阱集特征值对应、加性通道可分离性等。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1000跨导协议上，使用冻结的EfficientNet-B4特征（D=1792），KSSE达到88.93% Top-1准确率，仅使用约2124万参数。相比Swin-L（197M参数，86.4-87.3%）和ViT-H/14（632M参数，88.0-89.5%），分别将模型规模缩小10倍和30倍，同时精度超越或匹敌两者。
AI.conclusion: KSSE证明了一种以物理启发的图谱嵌入方法替代大规模密集网络的可行性：通过将分类问题重构为量子力学风格的谱问题，结合高效的FFT计算和巧妙的图拓扑优化，能够以极小参数规模达到甚至超越大规模Transformer的性能，为高效视觉分类提供了新的范式。

title: The Complexity of Kemeny Aggregation with Three Rankings
summary: The Kemeny rule aggregates rankings by minimizing their total Kendall-tau distance from an aggregate order. We prove that Kemeny Score is NP-complete for exactly three unweighted rankings, even when every candidate pair is split $2$-to-$1$. On the same profiles, the winner, unique-winner, and possible- and necessary-precedence problems are $Θ_2^p$-complete, while recognizing a Kemeny-optimal or uniquely Kemeny-optimal aggregate is coNP-complete. The hard instances induce tournaments of majority dimension exactly $3$. The reduction also determines the exact maximum-cut value from the optimal Kemeny score and recovers a maximum cut from any Kemeny-optimal aggregate. For every fixed $q\geq3$ and $\lceil q/2\rceil\leq s\leq q$, minimum pairwise support $s$ yields a sharp dichotomy: the score problem is NP-complete, the winner and precedence problems are $Θ_2^p$-complete, and the recognition problems are coNP-complete when $3s\leq2q$; for $3s>2q$, the majority tournament is transitive and its unique topological order is the unique Kemeny-optimal aggregate. Exact support $s$ suffices in the hard case when $s>q/2$, and supports in ${s,s+1}$ suffice when $s=q/2$. These results give complete fixed-profile-size classifications and transfer to Slater orders, permutation medians, and maximum-likelihood central rankings in the Mallows model. Finally, a six-copy construction proves NP-completeness of both Kemeny Score and Kendall--Tau Center for three pairwise-equidistant rankings that still split every pair $2$-to-$1$. For $N$ output candidates, their common distance is $\frac23\binom N2$, the largest possible for an equidistant triple. The construction gives affine formulas for both optimal values, characterizes all Kemeny-optimal output orders, and shows that the output has a unique Kemeny-optimal order and a unique center exactly when the input has a unique Kemeny-optimal order.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了Kemeny规则在固定小规模排名输入上的计算复杂性。核心发现包括：3个未加权排名上的Kemeny Score问题是NP完全的（即使每对候选人以2对1分裂）；相关获胜者、唯一获胜者、可能/必然优先级问题是Θ₂^p完全的；识别Kemeny最优或唯一Kemeny最优聚合是coNP完全的。论文还给出了对所有固定q≥3的反差结果（sharp dichotomy），并将结果推广到Slater序、排列中位数及Mallows模型的最大似然中心排名。最后通过六副本构造证明了三个两两等距排名上的Kemeny Score和Kendall-Tau Center的NP完全性。
AI.motivation: Kemeny规则是排名聚合的核心方法，其复杂性在一般输入上已被充分研究，但在固定小规模排名输入（如仅3个排名）上的精确复杂性尚未完全刻画。论文旨在填补这一空白，提供固定配置文件大小下的完整复杂性分类。
AI.method: 论文采用归约方法，从已知NP完全问题构造硬实例。关键构造是产生多数锦标赛维度恰好为3的实例，其中每对候选人的多数分裂为2对1。论文还利用最大割问题与Kemeny分数之间的紧密关系进行归约，并设计了六副本构造来处理三个两两等距排名的特殊情况。对于固定q和最小成对支持度s，论文通过分析3s≤2q与3s>2q两种情况，给出了完整的反差分类。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 3个未加权排名上的Kemeny Score为NP完全，获胜者、唯一获胜者、可能/必然优先级问题为Θ₂^p完全，识别Kemeny最优聚合为coNP完全；(2) 对所有固定q≥3及⌈q/2⌉≤s≤q，当3s≤2q时得到上述完全性结果，当3s>2q时多数锦标赛为传递的且唯一拓扑序是唯一Kemeny最优聚合；(3) 六副本构造证明了三个两两等距排名（每对2对1分裂）上Kemeny Score和Kendall-Tau Center均为NP完全，其共同距离为(2/3)·C(N,2)，并给出了最优值的仿射公式及最优输出序的完整刻画。
AI.conclusion: 该论文完成了固定配置文件大小下Kemeny规则相关问题的复杂性分类，揭示了即使输入规模极小（仅3个排名），Kemeny聚合问题依然计算困难的本质。结果不仅适用于Kemeny规则本身，还通过转换推广到Slater序、排列中位数和Mallows模型，展现了广泛的理论意义。

title: Selecting Open-Weight Language Models for Zero-Shot Intent Classification: A Systematic Evaluation of 41 Models
summary: Intent classification is a core component of task-oriented dialogue systems, yet practitioners have limited systematic guidance for selecting deployable open-weight language models under compute, latency, and robustness constraints. We present a systematic zero-shot evaluation of 41 open-weight language models spanning 15 families and the 135M--9B parameter range across eight English single-label intent-classification datasets. A ninth dataset, ATIS, uses five labeled demonstrations and is reported as an auxiliary five-shot result. The evaluation includes standard benchmarks, a large-scale voice-assistant corpus, and production-derived e-commerce datasets. Beyond exact-match accuracy, we analyze confidence calibration, robustness to realistic input perturbations, statistical reliability of model rankings, deployment efficiency, and benchmark saturation. Our results show that instruction-tuned 3B models can outperform several evaluated 7B base models, that differences among leading models on MASSIVE are statistically indistinguishable under pairwise McNemar tests, and that widely used benchmarks such as SNIPS have become saturated and no longer meaningfully discriminate among current open-weight models. Instruction tuning's effect on confidence calibration is inconsistent rather than uniformly harmful. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting and evaluating open-weight language models for intent classification.

AI.tldr: 本文对41个开源语言模型（覆盖15个家族、135M至9B参数范围）在8个英文单标签意图分类数据集上进行了系统性的零样本评估，并额外在ATIS数据集上以5-shot方式报告了辅助结果。除了精确匹配准确率外，还分析了置信度校准、输入扰动鲁棒性、模型排名的统计可靠性、部署效率和基准饱和性。关键发现包括：指令微调的3B模型可超越多个7B基座模型、MASSIVE上领先模型间的差异在McNemar检验下统计上不可区分、SNIPS等基准已饱和不再能有效区分当前模型。
AI.motivation: 意图分类是任务型对话系统的核心组件，但从业者在计算资源、延迟和鲁棒性约束下选择可部署的开源语言模型时缺乏系统性的指导。现有研究很少同时考虑模型规模跨度、指令微调影响、校准质量、鲁棒性和部署效率等多维度因素。
AI.method: 对41个开源语言模型（15个家族、135M-9B参数）在8个英文单标签意图分类数据集上进行零样本评估，外加ATIS数据集5-shot辅助评估。数据集涵盖标准基准、大规模语音助手语料库和生产级电商数据集。除准确率外，还评估了置信度校准、输入扰动鲁棒性、通过配对McNemar检验进行统计可靠性分析、部署效率和基准饱和性。
AI.result: 1) 指令微调的3B模型在性能上可超越多个7B基座模型；2) MASSIVE数据集上领先模型间的性能差异在配对McNemar检验下统计上不可区分；3) SNIPS等广泛使用的基准已饱和，不再能有效区分当前开源模型；4) 指令微调对置信度校准的影响不一致，并非总是有害。
AI.conclusion: 本文为从业者在计算、延迟和鲁棒性约束下选择和评估意图分类模型提供了系统性的实用指南，揭示了小规模指令微调模型的竞争力、现有基准的局限性以及指令微调对校准的可变性影响。

title: Bridging Inference-Time Scaling and Episodic Memory with Action-Centric Graphs
summary: Recent advancements in inference-time scaling have significantly unlocked the complex reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models~(LLMs). However, for agents, these approaches suffer from a critical inefficiency, operating in a stateless manner and engaging in redundant search processes. Existing memory mechanisms largely rely on the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, leading to prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, \textit{GAMER}~(Graph-based Action-centric Memory with Episodic Reasoning), that bridges the gap between inference scaling and episodic memory. Our approach models historical reasoning as a dynamic \textit{Action-Centric Graph}. By decoupling the memory mechanism from LLMs, our method can save token/money usage by providing less memory context than memory mechanism baselines. To extract knowledge from the graph effectively, we use a dual-stream Temporal Difference learning mechanism to estimate the positive~(suggestion) and negative~(avoidance) value of action nodes based on past successes and failures. During the inference phase, this learned value function optimizes decision-making bi-directionally, so that positive values provide action suggestions, while negative values indicate high-risk actions. By performing efficient searches on the graph, our method significantly improves the efficiency of inference scaling. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that \textit{GAMER} achieves superior performance by \textbf{20.81\%/6.17\%} for success/progress rate compared to vanilla baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAMER框架，通过构建动态的"以动作为中心的图"记忆和双流时序差分学习机制，将推理时扩展与情景记忆桥接，显著提升LLM智能体的推理效率和决策性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理时扩展方法在智能体场景中存在关键的低效问题：它们以无状态方式运行，进行冗余的搜索过程。现有记忆机制主要依赖LLM自身的推理能力，导致计算成本过高。因此需要一种更高效的记忆机制来弥补推理扩展与情景记忆之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出GAMER框架：(1) 将历史推理建模为动态的动作中心图（Action-Centric Graph）；(2) 将记忆机制与LLM解耦，减少token/成本消耗；(3) 使用双流时序差分学习（dual-stream Temporal Difference learning）分别估计动作节点的正价值（建议）和负价值（规避）；(4) 推理阶段利用学习到的价值函数进行双向决策优化，在图上进行高效搜索。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，GAMER相比普通基线在成功率上提升20.81%，在进度率上提升6.17%，同时相比记忆机制基线消耗更少的token/成本。
AI.conclusion: GAMER通过将记忆机制与LLM解耦并构建动作中心图，实现了推理扩展与情景记忆的有效结合，大幅提升了智能体决策的效率和性能。

title: Drawing-Recode: Annotation Grounding for Parametric CAD Code Generation from Raster 2D CAD Drawings
