summary: Recovering Parametric CAD sequences from raster-format 2D Computer-Aided Design (CAD) drawings accumulated prior to digital transformation is important for part reproduction and manufacturing process automation. However, existing studies either process only vector drawings or are limited to specific domains, and fail to explicitly connect dimensional annotations to geometric information, limiting their use of dimensional information for 3D Parametric CAD sequences recovery. We propose Drawing-Recode, a framework that generates Parametric CAD sequences as CAD code from raster 2D CAD drawings. Drawing-Recode extracts geometric features via an image encoder and recognizes annotations through a separate text recognition module, then explicitly grounds annotations to geometric information using cross-attention and our proposed Annotation Grounding Loss (AGL). The resulting features are fed into a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate CAD code in the Structured Parametric CAD Code (SPCC) format. Experiments show that Drawing-Recode outperforms existing baselines and remains robust on scanned drawings resembling industrial conditions. We expect Drawing-Recode contributes to digitizing raster 2D CAD drawings in industrial settings and to part reproduction and manufacturing automation.

AI.tldr: 提出Drawing-Recode框架，从光栅2D CAD图纸中生成参数化CAD序列（CAD代码），通过图像编码器提取几何特征、文本识别模块识别标注，并用跨注意力机制和标注接地损失（AGL）将标注明确关联到几何信息，最终由LLM生成SPCC格式的CAD代码。
AI.motivation: 数字化转型前积累的大量光栅格式2D CAD图纸需要被恢复为参数化CAD序列以支持零件复制和制造流程自动化。然而现有研究要么只处理矢量图纸，要么局限于特定领域，且未能将尺寸标注与几何信息显式关联，限制了尺寸信息在3D参数化CAD序列恢复中的应用。
AI.method: Drawing-Recode框架包含三个核心组件：1）图像编码器用于提取光栅图纸中的几何特征；2）独立的文本识别模块用于识别尺寸标注；3）通过跨注意力机制和提出的标注接地损失（AGL）将标注显式接地到几何信息上。融合后的特征输入到大语言模型（LLM）中，生成结构化参数化CAD代码（SPCC）格式的CAD代码。
AI.result: 实验表明Drawing-Recode优于现有基线方法，并且在模拟工业条件的扫描图纸上保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Drawing-Recode有望为工业场景中光栅2D CAD图纸的数字化做出贡献，并支持零件复制和制造自动化。

title: The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models
summary:
A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scales, ablating one part leaves a median 17% of the capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, where partial credit predicts 50-83% (p = 2e-10), while a random non-part head leaves 100%.
  One rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts yields a rate equation -- sites x attempts x drive x exp(-beta*K), minus destruction -- read three ways, each preregistered with frozen constants. Forward: a capability flat at baseline ignites at a step of our choosing once the mix passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and while still flat its arrival is datable from its precursor to 5% median error on six held-out models. Backward: the delay to learn a withheld capability grows with waiting until, past a critical step, it never ignites -- yet validation loss falls smoothly throughout, so standard monitors are blind to it. We locate the damage (heads commit to the base data) and isolate the cure: re-initializing only the query-key slices restores learnability (6/6) while the value slices do nothing (0/6). We prove the mechanism in a controlled gated-attention model: occupation forces a deadline whose consequences need no mixing assumption. Completed: SGD's noise fails the fluctuation-dissipation test, so we install one and anneal, melt and pin circuits on schedule. Scope: conjunction circuits in transformers to 1.4B.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示语言模型能力涌现的速率限制步骤是"无部分学分"的联合对齐事件：电路各部件须在单次随机尝试中同时正确对齐，缺一不可，且等待时间随缺失部件数而非电路规模增长。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在解释能力涌现（capability appearance）的底层机制，指出尽管已有大量关于涌现现象的观测，但对其"速率限制步骤"——即为何能力突然跳出而非渐进提升——缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 通过无捷径实验装置比较五部件与三部件电路缺失部件时的等待时间，实现"反向"与"前向"预注册实验（冻结常数）验证速率方程，并在控制的门控注意力模型中证明占用效应导致截止期限。
AI.result: 实验表明缺失部件数量而非电路大小决定等待时间；在Pythia模型上消融一个部件仅保留中位数17%能力（对比部分学分预测的50-83%）；温度调度可按时熔接和固定电路；仅重初始化query-key切片可恢复可学习性（6/6），而value切片无效（0/6）。
AI.conclusion: 能力涌现源于一个单次联合对齐的罕见事件，其障碍随缺失部件数增长；标准监控（验证损失）对此完全失明，但可通过温度退火与针对性的query-key重初始化来精确调控。

title: The Role of Causality in Algorithmic Recourse
summary:
Algorithmic recourse aims to provide individuals with actionable changes to improve their predicted outcomes in high-stakes classification settings, such as loan and mortgage applications. However, most existing approaches focus only on flipping a model's prediction, without accounting for whether the recommended changes lead to genuine improvement in an individual's true qualifications or merely enable strategic gaming of the classifier. Consequently, deployed recourse policies can induce behavioral responses that degrade predictive accuracy and become ineffective after model retraining.
  In this work, we formalize this failure mode through a causal performative framework for recourse. We model how recourse actions propagate through a structural causal model, capturing interactions among features as well as their effect on the true label. These causal responses induce a non-convex optimization problem, even under standard convex losses. We characterize conditions under which performatively stable solutions exist and can be efficiently computed via simple iterative dynamics. Our analysis reveals that recourse policies that ignore causal structure can induce large, misaligned behavioral responses, whereas causal recourse leads to stable equilibria that reduce incentives for gaming. Experiments on both semi-synthetic and real credit datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms standard empirical risk minimization while reducing the need for repeated model retraining to accommodate distribution shifts caused by strategic agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种因果执行性（causal performative）框架来形式化算法救济（algorithmic recourse）中的失败模式，该框架通过结构因果模型建模救济行为如何传播，证明了因果感知的救济策略能达到稳定的均衡点，减少个体策略性博弈的动机，并在半合成和真实信贷数据集上优于标准经验风险最小化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有算法救济方法大多只关注翻转模型预测结果，而忽略了推荐的行为改变是否真正改善个体的资质或仅是策略性地博弈分类器。这导致已部署的救济策略可能引发行为响应，从而降低预测准确性并使模型在重新训练后失效。
AI.method: 本文提出因果执行性框架，通过结构因果模型（SCM）建模救济行为的传播过程，捕捉特征间的交互及其对真实标签的影响。作者刻画了在非凸优化问题（即使标准凸损失下）中执行性稳定解存在且可通过简单迭代动力学高效计算的条件，并提出因果救济策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，忽略因果结构的救济策略会引发大规模、错位的行为响应，而因果救济能达到稳定的均衡点，减少策略性博弈的激励。在合成和真实信贷数据集上，该方法一致优于标准经验风险最小化，并减少了因策略性行为导致的分布偏移而需要反复重新训练模型的需求。
AI.conclusion: 因果感知的算法救济不仅能提高预测稳定性，还能降低个体博弈动机和模型重训练的负担，为高利害分类场景中的救济策略设计提供了理论基础和实用方案。

title: SkillSmith: Learning to Compose Parametric Skills and Textual Knowledge
summary: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) regularly feature two key mechanisms to autonomously solve complex problems: synthesizing text-based knowledge and procedures from past experiences and building parametric (weight-space) skill libraries for recurring sub-goals. To date, research has largely treated these as orthogonal pursuits: either organizing textual knowledge through composition and reflection, or consolidating parametric skills via weight-space merging. Consequently, the seamless integration of text and model weights for targeted performance improvements remains largely unexplored. This work bridges this modality gap by treating model weights as an additional modality that an LLM can natively reason over. We instantiate parametric learning via prefix-tuning and augment an LLM to ingest both prefix weights and rich textual data which capture relationships to a target capability. Our augmented LLM, which we call SkillSmith, synthesizes these inputs to perform instruction-steered parametric synthesis, directly outputting new prefix weights that manifest the target skill. We demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms both text-only and weight-space-only baselines, unlocking performance gains that are out of reach for uni-modal (text-only or weight-only) adaptations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillSmith框架，将模型权重视为一种可被LLM原生推理的模态，通过前缀微调（prefix-tuning）将参数化技能库与文本知识统一集成，实现指令驱动的参数合成，直接输出新的前缀权重以表现目标技能，在性能上显著超越仅文本或仅权重空间的单模态基线。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统通常将文本知识综合与参数化（权重空间）技能库视为两条正交的研究路径：前者通过组合与反思组织文本知识，后者通过权重空间合并整合参数技能。二者之间缺失了文本与模型权重的无缝集成，针对特定能力的定向性能提升尚未被探索。
AI.method: 通过前缀微调实现参数化学习，并增强一个LLM使其能够同时摄取前缀权重和丰富的文本数据（这些数据捕获与目标能力的关系）。该增强后的LLM（称为SkillSmith）将两类模态输入统一合成，执行指令引导的参数化合成，直接输出体现目标技能的新前缀权重。
AI.result: SkillSmith在性能上显著优于纯文本基线和纯权重空间基线，实现了单模态（仅文本或仅权重）适应方法无法企及的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 将模型权重视为一种额外模态并让LLM原生推理，能够弥合文本与参数之间的模态鸿沟，实现文本知识与权重空间技能库的统一集成，从而解锁跨模态协同带来的性能提升。

title: Dimensionality and Measurement Precision in HLE's Multiple-Choice Subset
summary: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is widely used to evaluate frontier language models. HLE organizes its questions into eight subject-domain categories, whose subscores are often interpreted as evidence of distinct capabilities. However, no study has assessed whether these labels correspond to empirically separable latent constructs, nor whether the benchmark effectively differentiates between models of similar ability. We evaluate 29 LLMs on the text-only multiple-choice subset of HLE ($J = 428$ items) and apply psychometric methods to assess both the dimensionality of the benchmark and the distribution of its measurement precision. Fitting a two-parameter logistic IRT model, we find convergent evidence that HLE measures a single general reasoning factor: McDonald's $ω_h = 0.998$, domain labels explain only 3.5\% of item response variance, within- and between-domain residual correlations are nearly identical (Cohen's $d = 0.016$), and domain-specific ability estimates are near-redundant with the total score ($r \geq 0.81$). A separate analysis of the test information function reveals that measurement precision concentrates at moderate ability levels and drops sharply above $θ= 0$, where frontier models sit. These findings suggest that HLE's domain subscores do not warrant distinct capability interpretations and that the benchmark's ability to discriminate among the strongest models is limited.

AI.tldr: 本文对HLE基准的428道文本多项选择题进行了心理测量学分析，发现该基准测量的是单一通用推理因子（ω_h=0.998），领域标签仅解释3.5%的项目反应方差，且测量精度集中在中等能力水平，对顶级模型的区分能力有限。
AI.motivation: HLE被广泛用于评估前沿大语言模型，其子分数常被解读为不同能力的证据，但从未有研究检验这些领域标签是否对应经验上可分离的潜在构念，也未曾检验该基准能否有效区分能力相近的模型。
AI.method: 对29个LLM在HLE文本多项选择子集（428个项目）上的表现，拟合双参数逻辑斯蒂克IRT模型，采用McDonald's ω_h、方差分解、域间/域内残差相关比较、域特异性能力估计与总分相关性等方法评估维度结构；另通过测试信息函数分析测量精度的分布。
AI.result: 发现HLE测量单一通用推理因子（ω_h=0.998），领域标签仅解释3.5%的项目反应方差，域内与域间残差相关几乎相同（Cohen's d=0.016），域特异性能力估计与总分高度冗余（r≥0.81）。测量精度集中于中等能力水平，在θ=0以上急剧下降，而前沿模型恰好位于该区域。
AI.conclusion: HLE的领域子分数不支持独立能力解释，其区分最强模型的能力有限，需要更高难度和更广能力覆盖的评估基准。

title: Inference-Time Agentic Decision Rules Beat Longer Evolving Search for Multi-Image Medical Reasoning
comment: Presented at the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Multi-Modal Reasoning for Agentic Intelligence
summary: Multi-image medical VQA is not merely a prompt-length problem; it is a fundamental challenge of agentic decision-making. Medical vision-language agents must aggregate evidence across ordered images, remain robust to answer-order perturbations, and avoid overfitting to noisy search-time feedback. We study MedFrameQA through a controlled comparison of five inference-time agentic strategies, optimized using the same high-budget ShinkaEvolve configuration and evaluated on a reproducible internal frozen split (1,331 evolution, 665 holdout, 855 final test). Across five independent repeated runs, the strongest method emerges as the simplest robust aggregator: the \textbf{order-vote} policy achieves $57.89 \pm 0.65\%$ final-test accuracy, significantly outperforming the fixed baseline ($52.73 \pm 0.42\%$) and the more complex, albeit brittle, order-rerank variant ($55.79 \pm 0.43\%$). Paired bootstrap analysis confirms these significant gains. Extending the evolutionary search budget from 50 to 100 generations yields no generalization benefit: while holdout performance marginally increases, final-test accuracy drops from $57.89\%$ to $56.02\%$. Our findings suggest that for multi-image medical reasoning, defining the correct agentic decision rule is substantially more impactful than expanding the optimization search budget.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控比较五种推理时agentic策略来研究多图像医学VQA问题，发现最简单的order-vote稳健聚合器在最终测试集上取得57.89%的准确率，显著优于固定基线和更复杂的order-rerank变体，且扩展进化搜索预算并不会带来泛化收益。
AI.motivation: 多图像医学VQA不仅仅是提示长度问题，而是agentic决策的根本性挑战。医学视觉语言代理必须在有序图像间聚合证据、对答案顺序扰动保持鲁棒性，并避免过度拟合搜索时的噪声反馈。现有方法缺乏对推理时agentic策略的系统性比较。
AI.method: 在MedFrameQA基准上，使用相同的ShinkaEvolve高预算配置，对五种推理时agentic策略（包括固定基线、order-rerank、order-vote等）进行受控比较。在可复现的内部冻结数据划分（1,331个进化样本、665个保留样本、855个最终测试样本）上，进行五次独立重复运行，并使用配对bootstrap分析验证显著性。
AI.result: 最强的order-vote策略在最终测试集上达到57.89±0.65%的准确率，显著优于固定基线（52.73±0.42%）和更复杂的order-rerank变体（55.79±0.43%）。将进化搜索预算从50代扩展至100代未带来泛化收益：保留集性能略有提升，但最终测试准确率从57.89%下降至56.02%。
AI.conclusion: 对于多图像医学推理，定义正确的agentic决策规则比扩大优化搜索预算更具影响力。最简单的稳健聚合策略（order-vote）反而优于更复杂的变体，提示在医学VQA中应优先关注决策规则的设计而非单纯增加计算预算。

title: Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance
summary: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，提出"长时程失败"（long-horizon failure）应通过将完整的任务成功率与基于短阶段个体基线预测的成功率进行比较来界定，并引入"horizon residual"（时域残差）作为量化指标，以区分错误累积、难度增加和上下文退化等不同失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程基准通常只观察到"任务越长代理越容易失败"的现象，但这并不能解释失败的根本原因。失败可能源于多阶段中普通误差的累积、单个决策难度的增加，或执行过程中上下文积累导致的退化（如context rot）。缺乏区分这些因素的方法论。
AI.method: 提出通过比较实际完整任务成功率与由短阶段基准预测的基线成功率之间的log-ratio（即horizon residual）来界定长时程失败。该方法要求在同一代理配置下进行比较，并事先明确阶段划分、检查点、信息和预算的选择方式。
AI.result: horizon residual能够显示完整 rollout 与所选基线之间的差异，但仅能证明差异存在，仍需针对性实验来解释差异产生的具体原因。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张为了合理地声称"长时程失败"，基准必须基于短阶段基线预测进行比较，并通过horizon residual量化差距；同时强调该指标只能检测差异，不能直接解释其成因，后续针对性实验仍是必要的。

title: Models for minimalist RAG: B1ade 335M Embedding and 1B Parameter Small Language Models
summary: Language and embedding models used in RAG systems are conventionally assumed to require large-scale pretraining and explicit grounding supervision. We present B1ade, an efficient RAG architecture comprising two purpose-built components: a compact embedding model and a purpose-built SLM. B1ade-embed, a 335M parameter retrieval model constructed via parameter-free fusion of five pretrained encoders achieves top MTEB scores among sub-500M models with zero additional training, and B1ade-1B, an SLM trained on low-cost GPUs using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on 723M tokens (2.2M examples) of curated context-question pairs with rewards that optimize only answer similarity. Our central finding is emergent attribution: despite receiving no explicit supervision for source citation, B1ade-1B cites retrieved passages in 42.4% of responses, exceeding the attribution rate of its training distribution by 5.5 percentage points. This demonstrates that grounding behavior can emerge as an accuracy-maximizing strategy under RL training, without explicit reward engineering. On standard QA benchmarks, B1ade-1B achieves 81.82% on PopQA, 65.8% on PubMedQA, and 51.09% on FEVER. In end-to-end RAG evaluation, B1ade-1B achieves an average score of 0.654 across correctness, completeness, coherence, and faithfulness, a 10.8% improvement over the SFT, while closing the gap with models 1.5x its size. These results show that strategic model composition and reward design suffice for resource-efficient RAG, without large-scale pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B1ade，一个资源高效的RAG架构，由零训练的335M参数嵌入模型（B1ade-embed）和基于GRPO强化学习训练的1B参数SLM（B1ade-1B）组成。核心发现是"涌现式归因"：模型在无显式引用监督下自发产生42.4%的引文行为，超过训练分布5.5个百分点，证明接地行为可无需奖励工程而作为精度最大化策略自然涌现。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG系统假设语言模型和嵌入模型需要大规模预训练及显式接地监督。作者挑战这一假设，旨在证明通过策略性模型组合和奖励设计，即可实现资源高效的RAG系统，无需大规模预训练和复杂的引用监督。
AI.method: B1ade包含两个组件：(1) B1ade-embed：335M参数检索模型，通过五个预训练编码器的参数无关融合构建，零额外训练即达顶级MTEB分数；(2) B1ade-1B：在低成本GPU上使用GRPO算法在723M tokens（220万示例）的精选上下文-问题对上训练，奖励仅优化答案相似度，不包含任何引用相关的显式监督。
AI.result: B1ade-1B在PopQA上达81.82%，PubMedQA上65.8%，FEVER上51.09%。端到端RAG评测中平均分0.654（正确性、完整性、连贯性、忠实性），比SFT提升10.8%，并缩小了与1.5倍规模模型的差距。涌现的归因行为达到42.4%，超过训练分布5.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明：战略性的模型组合与奖励设计足以实现资源高效的RAG系统，无需大规模预训练。接地行为（归因引用）可在RL训练下作为精度最大化策略自然涌现，无需显式奖励工程设计。

title: Leveraging Trajectory Graphs for Pre-Execution Error Diagnosis in Agentic LLM Systems
summary: Large Language Model~(LLM)-based agents have demonstrated exceptional performance across a wide range of complex interactive tasks. However, they often struggle with long-horizon interactive tasks common in domains, such as embodied AI. The complexity and vast action spaces in these settings lead to compounding errors, where a single suboptimal action can derail an entire trajectory, causing the agent to exhaust its limited step budget on inefficient or unrecoverable paths. To overcome this without costly fine-tuning, we draw inspiration from software debugging, where execution logs are analyzed to preemptively catch errors. We propose \textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}, a novel framework that acts as a ``copilot'' for LLM agents by diagnosing potential action errors before they are executed. At its core,\textit{Graph Debugger} models historical trajectories as a probabilistic graph and uses a Graph Neural Network to identify sequential action patterns that frequently lead to failure. Functioning as a proactive diagnostic sandbox, our method provides early warnings on potentially flawed actions, prompting the agent to self-correct. This pre-action error diagnosis prevents costly mistakes, significantly enhancing the agent's ability to complete long-horizon tasks successfully. The extensive experiments on four benchmarks with three LLM agents demonstrate a $14.69\%$ pass ratio improvement on average.

AI.tldr: 提出Trajectory Graph Copilot框架，通过图神经网络对历史轨迹建模为概率图，在执行前诊断潜在错误动作，使LLM智能体自我纠正，在四个基准上平均提升14.69%的通过率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程交互任务中常因动作空间庞大和任务复杂度导致误差累积，单一次优动作可能使整个轨迹偏离，耗尽有限的步数预算。现有的微调方案成本高昂，需要一种无需昂贵微调的轻量级错误预防机制。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory Graph Copilot框架，核心是Graph Debugger模块：将历史轨迹建模为概率图，利用图神经网络识别频繁导致失败的序列动作模式；作为主动式诊断沙箱，在动作执行前提供早期错误预警，促使智能体自我纠正。
AI.result: 在四个基准上使用三种LLM智能体进行广泛实验，平均提升了14.69%的通过率。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行前的主动错误诊断，可以有效阻止代价高昂的错误，显著增强LLM智能体在长时程交互任务中的完成能力，为无需微调的智能体纠错提供了一种新的有效范式。

title: Objective-Aligned Direct Answer SFT for Robust Multi-Frame Medical VQA
comment: Presented at the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Foundation Models for Biomedicine: Challenges and Opportunities
summary: Multi-frame medical VQA appears to reward increasingly complex adaptation: controller-style inference, localization-aware reranking, static hard-negative mixing, and staged continuation all appear plausible from first principles. We test a simpler competing hypothesis on MedFrameQA: methods that remain tightly aligned with the benchmark's final answer objective should be the strongest \emph{robust} adaptation family once evaluation is controlled across fixed splits, matched budgets, repeated seeds, and calibration. We compare controller-based methods, scaffold evolution, static mixed supervision, continuation-heavy variants, and direct answer-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The strongest robust family is direct decoder-only answer SFT on MedGemma-1.5-4B. Empirically, this family yields substantial improvements in held-out report accuracy over frozen baselines while remaining remarkably stable across repeated seeds and matched controls, ensuring our claims reflect true family-level robustness rather than an isolated hyperparameter peak. Furthermore, post-hoc calibration effectively repairs confidence estimation without compromising accuracy, and the core approach transfers consistently to secondary backbones like Qwen2.5-VL-3B. The main result is therefore not that a complex auxiliary mechanism wins, but that objective-aligned direct answer SFT is the strongest robust adaptation family we found for MedFrameQA. By establishing this strong, minimalist baseline, we hope to redirect community focus toward fundamentally robust optimization rather than architectural complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文对MedFrameQA多帧医学VQA任务进行了系统性对照实验，比较了控制器式推理、定位感知重排、静态难负例混合、分阶段持续训练等复杂方法家族与直接答案监督微调（SFT）的鲁棒性，发现直接decoder-only答案SFT在MedGemma-1.5-4B上是最强鲁棒家族，且事后校准能修复置信度估计而不损害准确率，结果可迁移至Qwen2.5-VL-3B等辅助骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 多帧医学VQA领域越来越倾向于复杂的自适应机制（如控制器式推理、定位重排、难负例混合、分阶段训练），这些方法从直觉上看似合理但缺乏受控条件下的系统性验证。作者希望检验一个更简单的假设：与基准任务最终答案目标紧密对齐的方法，在固定划分、匹配预算、重复种子和校准控制下，应是最强的鲁棒适应家族。
AI.method: 在MedFrameQA基准上系统比较五类方法家族：基于控制器的推理方法、脚手架演化（scaffold evolution）、静态混合监督、持续训练变体，以及直接答案监督微调（SFT）。实验在固定数据划分、匹配计算预算、多次随机种子和校准控制的条件下进行，使用MedGemma-1.5-4B作为主要骨干，并在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上进行迁移验证，同时引入事后校准（post-hoc calibration）修复置信度估计。
AI.result: 直接decoder-only答案SFT在MedGemma-1.5-4B上成为最强鲁棒适应家族，在留出集报告准确率上显著优于冻结基线，且在重复种子和匹配控制下保持高度稳定。事后校准在不损害准确率的前提下有效修复了置信度估计，核心方法成功迁移至Qwen2.5-VL-3B。
AI.conclusion: 主要结论不是某种复杂辅助机制获胜，而是目标对齐的直接答案SFT是MedFrameQA上最强鲁棒适应家族。作者通过建立这一强而极简的基线，希望引导社区关注从根本上稳健的优化策略，而非架构复杂性。

title: TIER-MoE: Trust-Informed Expert Routing via Conditional Modality Risk for Multimodal Fusion in Biomedical Classification
summary: The promise of multimodal fusion lies in combining complementary sources of evidence, yet more evidence does not always yield a better prediction. Recent multimodal models have advanced fusion through richer cross-modal interaction and sample-adaptive fusion. However, the influence assigned to a modality during fusion does not reveal whether that source is unreliable, redundant, or poorly matched to a specialized expert. To address this limitation, we introduce TIER-MoE, a risk-guided subspace mixture-of-experts model that defines sample-specific modality reliability as the prediction loss its unimodal predictor is expected to incur. This risk is learned from out-of-fold predictions generated by models that were not trained on the corresponding sample. TIER-MoE combines the estimated risk with expert-specific subspace compatibility for sparse modality-expert routing, while an always-active shared path preserves multimodal complementarity. We evaluate TIER-MoE on four public multimodal biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease status, skin-lesion malignancy, and retinal classification. Results demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in predictive performance and probability calibration, with consistent improvements in Macro-F1 and Brier score and strong zero-shot generalization to an external cohort.

AI.tldr: TIER-MoE是一个风险引导的子空间混合专家模型，通过评估每个样本的模态可靠性（即单模态预测器的预期损失）来指导稀疏的模态-专家路由，同时利用始终激活的共享路径保留多模态互补性，在四个公开生物医学多模态数据集上取得了优于现有方法的预测性能和概率校准。
AI.motivation: 多模态融合的核心在于组合互补的证据来源，但更多证据并不总是带来更好的预测。现有方法通过丰富跨模态交互和样本自适应融合取得进展，然而模态在融合中被赋予的权重无法揭示该来源是否不可靠、冗余或与专门专家不匹配。作者旨在解决这一局限，即需要一种机制来判断模态在具体样本上的可靠性，而不仅仅是其在融合中的影响力。
AI.method: TIER-MoE引入风险引导的子空间混合专家模型。具体而言：(1) 将样本特定的模态可靠性定义为该模态单模态预测器预期产生的预测损失；(2) 该风险通过未在对应样本上训练过的模型的堆外预测（out-of-fold predictions）学习得到；(3) 将估计的风险与专家特定的子空间兼容性相结合，实现稀疏的模态-专家路由；(4) 始终激活的共享路径用于保留多模态互补性。
AI.result: 在四个公开的多模态生物医学数据集（涵盖阿尔茨海默病状态、皮肤病变恶性程度和视网膜分类）上，TIER-MoE在预测性能和概率校准方面均优于现有最先进方法，Macro-F1和Brier分数持续改善，并在外部队列上展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TIER-MoE证明了对模态可靠性的显式风险评估能够有效提升多模态融合的性能与校准度，特别是在存在不可靠或冗余模态的情况下。其零样本外部泛化能力进一步验证了该风险引导路由机制的稳健性。

title: Belief Coevolution in a Social Network of Generalist and Specialist Large Language Models
comment: 33 pages (14 pages of main text), 7 figures, 14 tables
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent environments. However, the processes by which beliefs form and propagate among interacting LLMs remain poorly understood. We introduce CoevolveSim, a framework for studying belief diffusion within networked LLM populations. CoevolveSim allows us to isolate and study three factors: domain specialization, social-role assignment, and social network structure. Within this framework, generalist and specialist LLM agents exchange and revise beliefs. In each round, an LLM agent observes a summary of its neighbors' beliefs before updating its own. We run 1,280 controlled simulations spanning four scenarios, two network structures, and 20 medical-indication statements. We find that persona-style role assignment and network structure reshape individual belief revision but have minimal effect on population-level consensus. In contrast, introducing (finetuned) specialist LLMs more than doubles the shift in consensus and gives rise to consistent asymmetries in exerted influence. We further show that simple persistence-based opinion-dynamics models reproduce collective outcomes in all-generalist LLM populations, whereas heterogeneous LLM populations require population-level belief composition to reproduce consensus and agent identity to predict individual belief transitions. Our results indicate that realistic simulation of belief diffusion in multi-agent LLM systems requires a diverse set of underlying LLMs, not persona prompting alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CoevolveSim框架，用于研究大规模语言模型（LLM）群体中的信念扩散机制。通过对1280个受控模拟实验的分析，研究发现角色分配和网络结构会影响个体信念修订但对群体共识影响甚微，而引入微调后的专家LLM能使共识偏移翻倍以上并产生影响力不对称性。简单基于持久性的观点动力学模型能复现全通用LLM群体的集体结果，但异质LLM群体需要群体层面的信念构成才能复现共识，需要个体身份才能预测个体信念转换。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被部署在多智能体环境中，但相互作用的LLM之间信念形成和传播的过程仍未被充分理解，缺乏系统性的研究框架来隔离和分析影响信念扩散的关键因素。
AI.method: 开发CoevolveSim框架，隔离三个关键因素：领域专业化（domain specialization）、社会角色分配（social-role assignment）和社交网络结构。通用型和专家型LLM智能体在每轮中先观察邻居信念摘要再更新自身信念。通过4个场景、2种网络结构和20个医学适应症陈述，共运行1280个受控模拟实验，并结合基于持久性的观点动力学模型进行对比分析。
AI.result: 1) 类人设（persona-style）角色分配和网络结构重塑个体信念修订但对群体层面共识影响甚微；2) 引入微调专家LLM使共识偏移翻倍以上，并产生一致的影响力不对称；3) 简单持久性观点动力学模型可复现全通用LLM群体的集体结果；4) 异质LLM群体需群体层面信念构成来复现共识，需个体身份来预测个体信念转换。
AI.conclusion: 对多智能体LLM系统中信念扩散的现实模拟需要多样化的底层LLM集合，而非仅靠persona提示（prompting）来实现。该研究为理解LLM群体中信念涌现与传播机制提供了系统性框架和重要实证依据。

title: VAmoS Bench: Voice Agent Simulation Bench
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Agent implementations: https://github.com/veris-ai/riley-agent
summary: Production voice agents span cascaded, speech-to-speech, and hybrid architectures. Voice-agent benchmarks typically measure component quality and conversational properties such as word error rate, latency, naturalness, and turn-taking. Fewer measure whether the agent handled a phone call correctly on its own. Contact centers refer to this as ``containment'': the share of phone calls the automated system resolves without handing off to a human. On some phone calls the right outcome is refusal or a redirect. To address this gap, we introduce VAmoS Bench, the Voice Agent Simulation Bench. It measures complete voice-agent systems end to end in a stateful customer-support task. The agent is Riley, a credit-card support representative for a fictional bank who can freeze, cancel, replace, or activate a card. Each of 100 scenarios supplies a simulated caller with a private goal and a seeded PostgreSQL backend. The platform uses each scenario to populate and activate an isolated simulation in which the caller reaches Riley over audio; roughly one-third apply adversarial pressure. The agent can use five tools that execute real SQL against the backend. Each scenario also defines binary assertions. A grader evaluates them against the complete trace of what the caller and agent said and what the agent did, including tool invocations, arguments, and returned rows. This catches an agent that claims to have changed a card without updating the database, as well as one that makes the right database change while disclosing protected information. This first benchmark version focuses on financial services. Its evaluation protocol supports an evolving leaderboard: additional voice agents can be evaluated on the same version, while later versions can expand the tasks and scenarios.

AI.tldr: VAmoS Bench是一个端到端语音代理基准测试平台，用于评估完整的语音代理系统在状态化客户支持任务中的表现，通过模拟电话呼叫和真实SQL后端来测量"遏制率"（代理独立解决呼叫而不转接人类的比例），并支持不断演进的排行榜。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音代理基准测试主要衡量组件质量（如词错误率、延迟、自然度、话轮转换）和对话特性，但很少评估代理是否能自主正确地处理电话呼叫。在实际联络中心场景中，"遏制率"（即自动化系统无需转接人类就能解决问题的呼叫比例）是衡量语音代理有效性的关键指标，现有基准测试无法捕捉这一维度。此外，正确的结局可能包括拒绝或重定向，这一点也被忽视。
AI.method: VAmoS Bench构建了端到端的仿真环境：代理扮演虚构银行的信用卡客服代表Riley，可执行冻结、取消、更换或激活信用卡等操作。平台包含100个场景，每个场景为模拟呼叫者提供私人目标和种子PostgreSQL后端；约三分之一场景施加对抗性压力。代理可使用5个执行真实SQL的工具。每个场景定义二元断言，由评估器根据完整的对话和操作痕迹（包括工具调用、参数和返回行）进行评判。
AI.result: 该基准测试能够捕获代理声称更改了卡片但未更新数据库的情况，以及代理做出正确数据库更改但泄露受保护信息的情况。首个版本聚焦金融服务领域，其评估协议支持动态排行榜机制。
AI.conclusion: VAmoS Bench填补了端到端语音代理评估的空白，通过仿真客户支持任务、真实数据库操作和完整踪迹评估，提供了衡量语音代理实际任务完成能力（遏制率）的标准化方法，并支持持续扩展场景和代理的演进式排行榜。

title: ZMIS-SAM: Segment Anything Model Enhanced with Wavelet Transform for Zooplankton Microscopy Image Instance Segmentation
summary: As primary consumers in the marine food chain, zooplankton play a crucial role in maintaining marine ecological balance. However, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) exhibits limited performance in microscopic image instance segmentation due to its lack of zooplankton-specific domain knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose a novel instance segmentation model based on SAM and wavelet transform (ZMIS-SAM), effectively tackling issues such as inaccurate classification, discontinuous segmentation of slender appendages, and incomplete boundary segmentation. Our framework incorporates three core innovations: ZM-ViT enhances SAM's capability to model zooplankton morphology and image intensity distributions through two lightweight adapters, the Neighboring Feature Aggregation Module (NFAM) improves continuous segmentation of semi-transparent slender appendages by integrating general-purpose and domain-specific features, and the Wavelet-based Multi-scale Multi-directional Feature Enhancement (WM2FE) module effectively recovers high-frequency details to refine boundary segmentation completeness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZMIS-SAM achieves state-of-the-art instance segmentation performance on the zooplankton dataset and exhibits strong generalization capability across multiple public cross-domain datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SAM和 wavelet变换的浮游动物实例分割模型ZMIS-SAM，通过三个核心创新模块（ZM-ViT适配器、NFAM邻域特征聚合模块、WM2FE小波多尺度多方向特征增强模块）解决了SAM在浮游动物显微图像分割中的分类不准确、细长附肢分割不连续和边界分割不完整等问题，在浮游动物数据集上取得了SOTA性能并展现出良好的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 浮游动物作为海洋食物链中的初级消费者，对维持海洋生态平衡至关重要。然而，SAM模型缺乏浮游动物领域的专业知识，在显微图像实例分割中表现有限，存在分类不准确、细长附肢分割不连续以及边界分割不完整等挑战。
AI.method: 提出ZMIS-SAM框架，包含三个核心创新：（1）ZM-ViT通过两个轻量级适配器增强SAM对浮游动物形态和图像强度分布的建模能力；（2）NFAM整合通用特征和领域特定特征，实现对半透明细长附肢的连续分割；（3）WM2FE模块利用小波变换恢复高频细节，完善边界分割的完整性。
AI.result: 在浮游动物数据集上取得了最先进的实例分割性能，并在多个公开跨域数据集上表现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ZMIS-SAM有效解决了SAM在浮游动物显微图像实例分割中的领域适应难题，通过轻量级适配器和特征增强机制在保持SAM通用能力的同时注入了领域特定知识，为海洋生态监测中的自动化浮游动物分析提供了可行的解决方案。

title: EvoCause: LLM-Guided Evolution of Causal Graphs for Root Cause Analysis
summary: Modern telecommunication, cloud, and microservice systems emit correlated alarm cascades when components fail. Root cause analysis (RCA) aims to identify the small set of alarms that initiate each cascade. A common approach learns a causal graph from observational logs and predicts all zero-in-degree alarms in each incident-induced subgraph. However, the learned graph remains fixed and cannot benefit from expert diagnoses of historical incidents. We close this loop with EvoCause. Expert labels constrain which alarms should be source nodes but do not specify the edge edits needed to satisfy those constraints. EvoCause uses a large language model (LLM) to propose semantically plausible graph edits, while deterministic code validates node identities and acyclicity and retains the best graph on a labeled alignment set. At test time, the refined graph alone produces transparent predictions without an LLM call. We also release TeleRCA, an expert-annotated benchmark from a production telecommunication network containing $485{,}681$ alarm events spanning $194$ alarm types over $5{,}621$ resources. On synthetic data, EvoCause initialized with the PC causal discovery algorithm outperforms the unrefined PC baseline, raising Node F1, Case EM, and Graph F1 by $11.59$, $9.40$, and $4.59$ percentage points, respectively, while reducing nSHD by $0.2379$. On TeleRCA, replacing human-readable alarm titles with anonymous identifiers lowers Node F1 and Case EM by $6.12$ and $8.04$ percentage points, respectively, indicating that alarm-name information contributes to graph refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoCause，一种利用专家诊断标签和LLM提案来迭代细化因果图的根因分析方法。EvoCause用LLM提出语义上合理的图编辑，用确定性代码验证节点身份和无环性，在标注对齐集上保留最优图，推理时无需LLM调用。作者还发布了TeleRCA基准，包含485,681个告警事件、194种告警类型、5,621个资源。实验表明EvoCause在合成数据上显著优于PC基线，并验证了告警名称信息对图细化的贡献。
AI.motivation: 现代电信、云和微服务系统在组件故障时会发出相关告警级联。根因分析旨在识别每个级联的少量初始告警。现有方法通过学习因果图预测零入度告警作为根因，但学到的图是固定的，无法从历史事件的专家诊断中获益，形成闭环。
AI.method: EvoCause利用专家标签（约束哪些告警应为源节点）结合LLM提出语义上合理的图编辑候选，通过确定性代码验证节点身份和图的非循环性，在标注对齐集上评估并保留最佳细化图。测试阶段仅使用细化后的图进行透明预测，无需调用LLM。
AI.result: 在合成数据上，以PC因果发现算法初始化的EvoCause相比未细化的PC基线，Node F1提升11.59个百分点，Case EM提升9.40个百分点，Graph F1提升4.59个百分点，nSHD降低0.2379。在TeleRCA上，将人类可读告警标题替换为匿名标识符导致Node F1下降6.12个百分点、Case EM下降8.04个百分点，证明告警名称信息对图细化有重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: EvoCause通过将专家诊断知识纳入因果图细化过程，形成了从专家反馈到图结构更新的闭环学习机制，显著提升了根因分析的准确性和可解释性，同时推理时无需LLM调用，具备实际部署的可行性。

title: Training Skills Like Parameters via Self-Supervised Semantic Diffusion
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable general instruction-following capabilities, they often fall short of human experts in highly specialized, open-ended domains such as creative screenwriting. Prior approaches typically adopt post-training, yet both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning require weight access that closed-source frontier models do not offer, and demand heavy compute. Moreover, what is learned is tied to a single checkpoint and cannot be inspected by humans. Recent advancements in agentic continual learning instead attempt to bridge this gap by accumulating external textual skills. However, these methods heavily rely on costly human expert annotations or unreliable LLM-as-a-judge feedback for reflection. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose a novel, unsupervised self-evolving agent framework inspired by the corruption-and-reconstruction paradigm of diffusion models. Instead of relying on explicit external scoring, we leverage existing high-quality human artifacts to construct self-supervised signals. Training then follows the familiar loop of neural network training, forward, loss, and backward, with the loss coming from contrasting the agent's reconstruction against the human original. What is updated is not model weights but an external library of textual skills. We evaluate our framework on the challenging task of short drama screenwriting. Experimental results demonstrate that our method enables the agent to autonomously extract and internalize highly generalizable skills, significantly enhancing its domain-specific generation capabilities. Furthermore, this self-contrastive reflection paradigm offers a scalable pathway for agents to teach themselves the production of complex, high-quality human artifacts, without requiring external supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需外部监督的自进化智能体框架，受扩散模型"破坏-重建"范式启发，通过对比智能体重建结果与人类原始作品构建自监督信号，以外部文本技能库而非模型权重为更新对象，在短剧编剧任务上显著提升领域生成能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在通用指令跟随方面表现出色，但在创意编剧等高度专业化、开放式领域往往不及人类专家。现有方法（监督微调、强化学习）需要访问闭源模型的权重且计算开销大，学到的东西绑定单一checkpoint且不可被人类审视。智能体持续学习方法依赖昂贵的人工专家标注或不可靠的LLM-as-a-judge反馈。因此需要一种无需外部评分、无需权重访问、可扩展的无监督自进化方法。
AI.method: 提出无监督自进化智能体框架：借鉴扩散模型的"破坏-重建"（corruption-and-reconstruction）范式，利用现有人类高质量作品构建自监督信号；训练遵循前向、损失、反向的标准神经网络训练循环，损失来自智能体重建结果与人类原始作品的对比；更新的不是模型权重，而是外部文本技能库。
AI.result: 在短剧编剧任务上的实验表明，该框架使智能体能够自主提取和内化高度可泛化的技能，显著提升领域特定生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 这种自对比反思范式为智能体在没有外部监督的情况下自学复杂高质量人类作品的生成提供了可扩展的途径。

title: Skill Use or Skill Theater? Evaluating the Reasoning Backroom in Skill-Augmented Language Agents
summary: Reusable skills are becoming a standard interface for extending language agents with task procedures. Yet evaluators usually infer skill use from visible reasoning or the agent's own attribution. These signals show what the agent appears to use, not whether the skill changed its decision. We ask whether skill-augmented agents exhibit a \textbf{Reasoning Backroom}, a systematic gap between stated skill use and intervention-measured influence. We introduce BACKTRACE, an evaluation framework that pairs each skill-conditioned answer with a matched no-skill counterfactual, intervenes on skill meaning, wording, identity, content, and assignment, and elicits attribution only after the answer is committed. We instantiate the framework as BACKROOMBench, a verified testbed spanning controlled logic and competition mathematics, multiple skill conditions, single-agent and multi-agent settings, and diverse model families. Our evaluation reveals a pervasive provenance failure. Across models and domains, stated skill use often remains stable while causal reliance and signed utility vary, producing both silent uptake and performative use. Behavioral effects follow procedural content more reliably than displayed skill identity, whereas stated attributions respond strongly to artifact availability. Observational detectors based on direct skill-use claims, text mentions, trace similarity, and an LLM judge do not identify which decisions actually depend on the skill. In multi-agent systems, skill influence can survive communication even after its source is lost, while no-skill teams still name skills and sources that were never supplied. These findings establish the Reasoning Backroom as a general AI provenance problem whose audit requires intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BACKTRACE 评估框架，通过匹配无技能反事实、干预技能含义/措辞/身份/内容/分配等维度，系统测量技能增强型智能体在"陈述性技能使用"与"实际干预测量的因果影响"之间的系统性差距（即"推理后台"问题）。在受控逻辑和竞赛数学等多领域测试（BACKROOMBench）中发现：模型普遍存在出处失败，陈述性归因不可靠，观测性检测器无法识别真实技能依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法通常通过可见推理或智能体自身的归因来推断技能使用，但这些信号只反映"表面看起来用了什么"，并不能证明技能是否真正改变了决策。这种陈述性使用与实际因果影响之间的鸿沟（术语为"推理后台"）是AI评估中尚未被系统量化的关键盲区。
AI.method: 提出 BACKTRACE 框架：1) 将每个技能条件化答案与匹配的无技能反事实配对；2) 对技能的含义、措辞、身份、内容和分配进行干预；3) 在答案提交后才收集归因。将其实例化为 BACKROOMBench 基准，覆盖受控逻辑、竞赛数学、多种技能条件、单智能体与多智能体设置以及多种模型家族。
AI.result: 评估揭示了普遍的出处失败：模型表述的技能使用保持稳定，而因果依赖和有符号效用却变化，产生"静默采纳"和"表演性使用"两类现象。行为效果更可靠地跟随程序性内容而非技能身份标识；陈述性归因则强烈响应工件可用性。基于直接技能使用声明、文本提及、轨迹相似性和LLM评判的观测性检测器均无法识别真正依赖技能的决策。在多智能体系统中，技能影响可在来源丢失后仍存续，而无技能团队仍会提及从未提供的技能和来源。
AI.conclusion: "推理后台"是一个普遍的AI出处问题，仅靠观测性信号无法检测，必须通过干预式审计才能识别真实技能依赖。该工作为评估语言代理的技能使用提供了新的方法论基础。

title: THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model
summary: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出THGFM，一个面向网络规模时序异构图的双路径融合模型，通过共享空间时序注意力与关系类型分区时序注意力的耦合，结合旋转时序注意力机制，在多个学术图基准上取得一致最优性能。
AI.motivation: 时序异构图需要同时建模跨类型结构异质性和交互时序动态，但现有方法难以在参数高效的跨类型迁移与关系感知特化之间取得平衡，且通常仅将时间作为加性特征注入注意力核之外，未能直接建模相对时间对注意力分数的影响。
AI.method: THGFM采用统一双路径架构：(1) 共享空间时序注意力分支实现参数高效的跨类型迁移；(2) 关系类型分区时序注意力分支实现关系感知特化；(3) 通过双路径关系-共享融合整合两个分支，其中使用类型条件非竞争门控求和融合机制，为共享和特化分支分配独立的类型条件特征级门控，避免零和竞争；同时引入旋转时序注意力，在注意力匹配前将查询和键按相对时间半相位旋转，直接将相对时间编码进注意力分数。
AI.result: THGFM在学术图基准上一致超越基线图Transformer模型，六任务平均提升+3.25%；在OAG-CS PV、PF-L2、PF-L1上分别获得+12.37%、+4.87%、+1.18%的峰值相对增益，在OGBN-MAG、HTAG-ArXiv、HTAG-DBLP上分别获得+4.24%、+3.73%、+4.61%的提升。
AI.conclusion: THGFM通过双路径架构有效调和了参数效率与关系特化之间的矛盾，且旋转时序注意力提供了一种更本质的时间建模方式，在多个时序异构图基准上验证了其有效性和可扩展性。

title: Beyond Similarity: Grounded Agentic Extraction and Expert-Adjudicated Evaluation of Intertextuality in Classical Chinese Histories
summary: Computational approaches to intertextuality have advanced from string matching to neural retrieval, yet their outputs, similarity scores and parallel-passage lists, identify where texts reuse one another without characterizing how or why. We recast fine-grained intertextuality extraction as an agentic task in which a large language model (LLM) reads two text units in full and, through a constrained tool interface, must ground each proposed reuse in exact character spans on both sides and label it under a five-dimension typology of reuse (form, aspect, source-marking, function, stance). We validate the approach on an exhaustive comparison of the Analects with the Book of Han, where three domain experts adjudicate a pooled multi-model candidate set into a benchmark of 2,533 intertextual pairs. Against this standard we study twelve LLMs, reporting precision (56%-93%), a 51$\times$ cost spread at comparable quality, and how well their confidence is calibrated. Expert agreement traces a reliability gradient: dimensions legible on the textual surface are annotated consistently, while those requiring inference of intent are contested, delimiting the claims such annotation supports. Scaling the validated extractor to the full Twenty-Four Histories (65,380 comparisons, 5,766 pairs) recovers corpus-level structure a similarity score cannot express. The interpretive composition of citation shows no systematic change across eighteen centuries, yet the same passage is quoted less and less literally. Stability in the aggregate with drift in the individual case is what a cultural-attraction account expects. We release the extraction protocol and the expert-adjudicated benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文将细粒度互文性抽取重构为智能体任务：LLM通读两个文本单元，通过受限工具接口将每处文本复用锚定到精确字符跨度，并按五维类型学（形式、方面、来源标记、功能、立场）标注。作者在《论语》与《汉书》的穷尽比较上，由三位领域专家裁决多模型候选集，构建了含2,533个互文对的基准。基于该基准评估十二个LLM，报告了56%-93%的精确率、51倍的成本跨度及置信度校准情况。将验证过的抽取器扩展到《二十四史》（65,380次比较，5,766对）后，恢复了相似度分数无法表达的语料库级结构：十八个世纪中引用的解释性构成无系统性变化，但同一段落的引用越来越不字面化。
AI.motivation: 现有计算互文性方法（从字符串匹配到神经检索）只能输出相似度分数和平行段落列表，识别了文本复用在哪里发生，却无法刻画如何复用及为何复用，缺乏对互文关系进行细粒度、可解释的定性标注。
AI.method: 将细粒度互文性抽取建模为智能体任务：LLM完整阅读两个文本单元，通过受限工具接口将每个提议的复用分别锚定在两侧文本的精确字符跨度上，并按五个维度（形式、方面、来源标记、功能、立场）标注复用类型。三位领域专家对多模型候选集进行裁决，构建含2,533个互文对的基准。
AI.result: 在基准上评估了十二个LLM，精确率56%-93%，在可比质量下成本跨度达51倍；专家一致度显示可靠性梯度：文字表层可辨认的维度标注一致，需推断意图的维度有争议。扩展到《二十四史》的65,380次比较中识别出5,766对互文，恢复了相似度分数无法表达的结构：跨十八个世纪，引用的解释性构成无系统性变化，但同一段落的引用越来越不字面化。
AI.conclusion: 聚合层面的稳定性与个案层面的漂移并存，这正是文化吸引（cultural-attraction）理论所预期的图景。作者发布了抽取协议和专家裁决基准，为计算互文性研究提供了可复现的细粒度标注范式。

title: INCLAIR: Inception-Based Longitudinal Clinical Anomaly Detection with Informed Reasoning
summary: Detecting anomalies in longitudinal clinical profiles is clinically important but difficult: abnormal evidence is often sparse, patient histories have unequal length, and expert explanations are costly. We propose INCLAIR, a framework that scores each observation against multiple historical contexts, aggregates evidence at the profile level, and generates grounded natural-language explanations under limited expert supervision. Under stated within-profile exchangeability assumptions, the complete mean subsequence score takes an order-$l$ U-statistic form, yielding a variance decomposition and an incomplete-subset approximation that controls combinatorial inference cost independently of profile length. The same analysis shows that mean aggregation attenuates localized anomalies by a factor set by the anomaly support and profile length, motivating validation-selected top-$k$ pooling. Across three clinical datasets, INCLAIR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. We further validate practical relevance through a case study on longitudinal steroid profiles, comparing INCLAIR's predictions and explanations against domain-expert assessments supported by DNA analysis. The results show that INCLAIR enables clinically actionable anomaly detection under limited expert supervision.

AI.tldr: INCLAIR是一个在有限专家监督下检测纵向临床档案异常的新框架，通过多历史上下文打分、profile级证据聚合和可解释的自然语言解释，在三个临床数据集上超越现有基线，并在类固醇纵向档案案例研究中验证了临床实用性。
AI.motivation: 在纵向临床档案中检测异常在临床上很重要但具有挑战性：异常证据通常稀疏、患者历史长度不等、专家解释成本高昂。现有方法难以在有限监督下有效处理这些问题。
AI.method: INCLAIR框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 对每个观测值针对多个历史上下文进行打分；(2) 在profile层面聚合证据；(3) 在有限专家监督下生成基于证据的自然语言解释。理论方面，在profile内可交换性假设下，完整均值子序列分数呈现order-l U-统计量形式，可进行方差分解，并通过不完整子集近似将组合推理成本与profile长度解耦。此外，理论分析表明均值聚合会按异常支撑长度与profile长度的比例衰减局部异常，因此引入了基于验证集选择的top-k池化策略。
AI.result: 在三个临床数据集上，INCLAIR一致性地优于最先进的基线方法。在纵向类固醇档案的案例研究中，通过与领域专家评估（辅以DNA分析）对比，验证了INCLAIR的预测和解释的实用性。
AI.conclusion: INCLAIR能够在有限专家监督下实现临床可操作的异常检测，并提供可解释的自然语言输出，为纵向临床数据分析提供了理论与实践兼备的新方案。

title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
summary: Text-to-image and personalized editing models now synthesize high-fidelity single-subject images with ease. Yet placing multiple named people into shared contact actions such as embrace, carry, or grapple still exposes major failures: fused limbs, invented extremities, and interpenetrating bodies. Existing evaluations largely overlook these anatomical and geometric issues, and VLM-as-a-judge checklists often saturate on Interaction while the errors remain obvious to humans. We introduce MPIE-Bench, a 2,500-sample benchmark of video-mined editing triplets spanning 405 scenes, 14 interaction categories, and four contact densities (C0-C3). We also propose MPIE-Eval, whose two new axes score contact-time geometry from a frozen public multi-person mesh reconstruction. Anatomy asks whether every human-like mass is explained by a complete set of reconstructed bodies, and Interaction asks whether the penetration and surface distance between those bodies match the contact the instruction asked for. Across ten editors, mesh Anatomy tops out at 0.65 and mesh Interaction at 0.72 on two different models, so no single editor is strong on both, while VLM checklists rate the same images above 0.95. A five-rater study confirms that both axes track human judgement more closely than a zero-shot VLM judge, and the rankings hold under ablation of every weight and threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPIE-Bench，一个2,500样本、涵盖405个场景、14种交互类别和4种接触密度（C0-C3）的多人物交互编辑基准测试集，并提出MPIE-Eval评估方法，通过3D人体网格重建从解剖学（Anatomy）和交互（Interaction）两个新维度评估多人物交互编辑质量。实验表明现有VLM评估方法在交互中饱和（>0.95），而网格指标更贴近人类判断。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像和个性化编辑模型在生成单主体图像时表现良好，但在将多个具名人放置到如拥抱、携带、格斗等共享接触动作中时出现严重失败（肢体融合、多余肢体、身体穿插）。现有评估方法（特别是VLM-as-a-judge）在这些交互场景中饱和失真，无法反映人类容易识别的解剖和几何错误。
AI.method: 构建MPIE-Bench：从视频中挖掘2,500个编辑三元组，覆盖405个场景、14种交互类别、4种接触密度（C0-C3）。提出MPIE-Eval：利用冻结的公共多人网格重建模型，从两个新维度打分——Anatomy（检查每个类人质量是否被完整重建的身体集合解释）和Interaction（检查重建身体间的穿透和表面距离是否与指令要求的接触匹配）。相比VLM检查清单，这两个指标能更精确地捕捉人体几何错误。
AI.result: 在10个编辑模型上，网格Anatomy最高仅0.65，网格Interaction最高仅0.72，且没有单一编辑器在两个指标上同时表现优秀；而VLM检查清单对相同图像的评分超过0.95。五项评分者研究证实这两个轴比零样本VLM判断更贴近人类判断，且排名在去除所有权重和阈值的消融下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM评估方法在多人物交互编辑场景中严重高估模型质量，MPIE-Bench和MPIE-Eval能更可靠地捕捉3D身体几何层面的失败模式，为多人物交互编辑提供更有效的评估工具。

title: Position, Not Provenance: Separating Reasoning Mediation from Sycophancy in Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before answering clinical questions, but whether this reasoning causally influences predictions remains unclear. We present CoT-Mediate, a behavioral framework that perturbs a single clinically meaningful attribute within a model's own generated reasoning and measures whether the resulting prediction follows the edited reasoning. Our framework combines a dual-arm protocol comparing re-prompted evidence with prefix-forced continuation, together with a provenance-controlled intervention that varies only the attributed source of identical reasoning to disentangle reasoning mediation from sycophancy. We evaluate LLaVA-Med and MedGemma on 1,000 VQA-RAD samples each. Prefix-forced continuation consistently yields higher mediation faithfulness than re-prompting, while the provenance analysis reveals distinct model-specific deference behaviors. Across both models, removing visual evidence increases reliance on injected reasoning, whereas laterality is the least faithfully tracked clinical attribute. These results show that the mechanism used to inject reasoning substantially affects measured faithfulness and that contextual position, rather than stated provenance, is the primary determinant of whether medical VLMs use their generated reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoT-Mediate框架，通过扰动医学视觉语言模型自身生成的推理链中的单一临床属性，检验其是否真正因果性地影响最终预测。框架结合双臂协议（重新提示与前缀强制续写）和来源受控干预，在LLaVA-Med和MedGemma上各评估1,000个VQA-RAD样本，发现前缀强制续写产生更高的忠信度，且上下文位置而非声明来源是决定模型是否使用生成推理的主要因素。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）在回答临床问题前会生成思维链（CoT）推理，但这些推理是否真正因果性地影响预测结果尚不清楚，因此需要系统性地评估推理介导（reasoning mediation）现象，而非仅依赖表面上的推理质量。
AI.method: CoT-Mediate行为学框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 双臂协议，将重新提示（re-prompting）与前缀强制续写（prefix-forced continuation）进行对比；(2) 来源受控干预，在推理内容完全相同的条件下仅变化归属来源，以区分推理介导与谄媚行为（sycophancy）。每个样本仅扰动模型自身生成推理中的单个临床有意义的属性。
AI.result: 前缀强制续写在所有情况下均比重新提示产生更高的推理介导忠信度；来源分析揭示了不同模型特有的服从行为；去除视觉证据会增加对注入推理的依赖，而侧别（laterality）是最不被忠实追踪的临床属性。
AI.conclusion: 推理注入的机制显著影响测得的中介忠信度，上下文位置（而非声明的推理来源）才是决定医学VLM是否实际使用其生成推理的主要因素。

title: AWARE-FX: An Auditable Knowledge-Guided AI System for Measuring Corporate Foreign-Exchange Hedging Disclosure
comment: 40 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Preprint; not peer reviewed
summary: Corporate annual reports contain weakly structured evidence about foreign-exchange risk management, derivative use, natural hedging, and explicit non-use. This study develops AWARE-FX, an auditable AI/NLP decision-support system that converts report text into traceable firm-year hedging-disclosure measures. The system combines a professional-source lexicon, negation and accounting-status logic, channel-specific financial encoders, exact evidence gates, conservative aggregation, and an audit ledger. Across 24,909 Hong Kong firm-years from 2008-2025, it retrieves and scores 543,527 snippets. Reliability is evaluated through ablations, a stratified 300-snippet human audit, three-seed FinBERT-ModernBERT comparisons, strict 2023-2025 temporal tests, probability calibration, selective prediction, and fixed-prompt generative-model benchmarks. FinBERT has the higher mean F1 in seven of eight encoder task-split comparisons; its temporal F1 ranges from 0.702 to 0.872. Abstaining on the 20% least-confident temporal observations raises retained-sample F1 by 0.050-0.077. Deterministic Qwen3-8B performs strongly on commodity and negation evidence but poorly on foreign-debt and accounting-context labels, showing that a general-purpose LLM does not uniformly replace domain constraints. The strict FX score is negatively associated with linked baseline and stress-period FX exposure, whereas the generic broad score is not. These associations provide external construct validation, not causal estimates of hedging effectiveness. AWARE-FX contributes a tested decision-support architecture in which retrieval, status logic, classification, uncertainty handling, aggregation, and external validation remain separately auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AWARE-FX，一个可审计的AI/NLP决策支持系统，用于从企业年报中提取外汇风险对冲披露信息。系统结合专业词表、否定与会计状态逻辑、金融编码器、证据门控、保守聚合和审计账本，在24,909个香港公司年度样本中检索并评分543,527个片段。FinBERT在八项编码器任务对比中七项取得更高平均F1，时间跨度F1为0.702-0.872；放弃20%最低置信度样本可提升F1 0.050-0.077。严格FX分数与基线及压力期外汇敞口呈负相关，提供外部构念效度验证。
AI.motivation: 企业年报中存在关于外汇风险管理、衍生品使用、自然对冲和明确不使用等结构化程度较低的证据，现有方法难以系统、可追溯地提取这些对冲披露信息，亟需一个可审计的决策支持系统。
AI.method: AWARE-FX系统整合以下组件：(1)专业来源词表；(2)否定与会计状态逻辑；(3)渠道特定金融编码器；(4)精确证据门控；(5)保守聚合策略；(6)审计账本。通过消融实验、分层300片段人工审计、三种子FinBERT-ModernBERT对比、严格时间外推测试、概率校准、选择性预测及固定提示生成模型基准进行可靠性评估。
AI.result: FinBERT在八项编码器任务对比中七项取得更高平均F1，时间F1范围为0.702-0.872；放弃20%低置信时间观测值后保留样本F1提高0.050-0.077。确定性Qwen3-8B在商品和否定证据上表现强，但在外债和会计上下文标签上表现差。严格FX评分与基线及压力期FX敞口呈负相关，而宽泛通用分数则无此关联。
AI.conclusion: AWARE-FX提供了经验证的可审计决策支撑架构，其中检索、状态逻辑、分类、不确定性处理、聚合和外部验证均可独立审计。一般用途LLM不能统一替代领域约束，且严格FX分数提供了外部构念效度，但不等同于对冲有效性的因果估计。

title: MedLLM: An Open Medical Language Model at the Sub-Billion Scale
summary: Open medical language models have converged on a single scale: every widely used system runs at 7B parameters or more, leaving the sub-billion regime uncharacterized. We present MedLLM, an open 0.1B-parameter medical language model trained through a fully open three-phase pipeline: general pretraining with curriculum sequence-length scheduling, domain fine-tuning on MedFineWeb, a reference-guided medical corpus we release that is selected from general web data by embedding similarity to medical question-answering (QA) data, and preference-aligned fine-tuning combining SFT with direct preference optimization (DPO). Across medical benchmarks, MedLLM shows a pattern visible only at sub-billion scale: medical competence does not degrade uniformly under compression but splits by task type. On context-grounded QA it comes within $2.9$pp of a medically adapted 7B model and surpasses the instruction-tuned and general-purpose 7B baselines; on knowledge-recall QA it stays near the task floor on clinical-vignette MedQA yet significantly exceeds every 7B and sub-7B baseline on MedMCQA, indicating that where recall fails the constraint is model capacity rather than adaptation. This dissociation is masked at 7B, where both capabilities are present, and surfaces only when capacity is scarce.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MedLLM，一个仅0.1B参数的开源医学语言模型，采用三阶段全开放训练管线（通用预训练+领域微调+偏好对齐微调）。实验发现亚十亿规模下医学能力并非随压缩均匀退化，而是按任务类型分化：在上下文问答上逼近7B模型，在知识回忆式问答上则因模型容量受限而表现分化。
AI.motivation: 当前开源医学语言模型普遍集中在7B及以上规模，次十亿参数（sub-billion）区间从未被系统性地刻画。作者旨在填补这一空白，探究在模型容量极度受限时医学能力如何表现。
AI.method: 采用全开放三阶段训练管线：(1) 通用预训练，利用课程式序列长度调度；(2) 领域微调，使用MedFineWeb语料库——该语料通过将通用网页数据与医学问答数据的嵌入相似度进行筛选构建，并作为参考引导的医学语料库发布；(3) 偏好对齐微调，结合监督微调（SFT）与直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.result: 在医学基准上，MedLLM表现出仅在次十亿规模下可见的模式：医学能力并非随压缩均匀退化，而是按任务类型分化。在上下文问答上，MedLLM距离医学适配的7B模型仅差2.9个百分点，且超过指令微调和通用7B基线；但在知识回忆式问答上，它在临床情境MedQA上接近任务下限，却在MedMCQA上显著超过所有7B及以下基线，表明回忆失败时限制因素是模型容量而非领域适配。
AI.conclusion: 这种能力分离现象在7B规模被掩盖（此时两种能力均具备），只有在容量稀缺时才会显现。该工作揭示了次十亿规模下医学语言模型的独特行为模式，为资源受限场景下的医学模型设计提供了指导。

title: MedXplore: Towards Reliable and Unbiased Generalized Category Discovery in Medical Imaging
summary: Deep learning has shown strong potential in medical image analysis, but most existing methods rely on large-scale annotations and a closed-world assumption that rarely holds in clinical practice. Although Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) has advanced rapidly on natural images, it remains underexplored in medical imaging. To address this issue, we propose MedXplore, a unified framework for reliable and unbiased medical GCD, optimizing from both perceptual and decision levels. Specifically, at the perceptual level, taking a frequency domain perspective, Frequency-SNR Adaptive Attention and Consistency (FAAC) performs learnable full-spectrum filtering and global-local energy contrast activation to not only highlight local abnormal signals relative to the global context, but also provide reliable semantic anchors for patch consistency learning. At the decision level, Adaptive Cosine-Angular Margin (ACAM) adjusts angular margins using semantic difficulty and feature confidence to balance intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. Together, the two modules improve lesion-sensitive representation learning and mitigate old-class bias. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show an average \textbf{8.5\%} gain in \textit{All} accuracy over the strongest competing methods. On Kvasir, MedXplore reduces false-old errors from 14.50\% to 0.80\%, demonstrating strong robustness under severe old-new ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 提出MedXplore框架，针对医学图像通用类别发现（GCD）中标注稀缺与闭集假设失效的问题，从感知层和决策层双重优化，在多个基准上平均提升8.5%的All准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分析方法依赖大规模标注且基于闭集假设，难以匹配临床实践中数据分布开放、类别未知的场景。虽然GCD在自然图像上发展迅速，但在医学影像领域尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出MedXplore统一框架，包含两个关键模块：（1）感知层——Frequency-SNR Adaptive Attention and Consistency (FAAC)，从频域角度进行可学习的全频谱过滤和全局-局部能量对比激活，突出局部异常信号并提供可靠的语义锚点用于patch一致性学习；（2）决策层——Adaptive Cosine-Angular Margin (ACAM)，利用语义难度与特征置信度调整角度间隔，平衡类内紧凑性与类间可分性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，All准确率相比最强竞争方法平均提升8.5%。在Kvasir数据集上，假旧类错误从14.50%降至0.80%，在严重的旧新类歧义场景下展现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MedXplore通过感知层与决策层的协同优化，有效增强了病变更敏感的表示学习并缓解了旧类偏差，为医学图像通用类别发现提供了一种可靠且无偏的统一解决方案。

title: ZUNA1.1: A more flexible EEG foundation model for Denoising and Super-resolution
summary: We introduce ZUNA1.1, a 380M-parameter diffusion autoencoder for flexible EEG signal reconstruction. ZUNA1.1 is capable of reconstructing variable length sequences of up to 30s, with an arbitrary number of EEG channels at arbitrary scalp locations, and can reconstruct arbitrary temporal intervals within channels in addition to reconstructing entire channels. We demonstrate that ZUNA1.1 performs at least on par with our earlier ZUNA1 model, while being far more flexible and capable of handling a wide range of reconstruction tasks. ZUNA1.1 continues to substantially outperform standard EEG denoising and reconstruction methods such as spherical spline interpolation, which is ubiquitously deployed in the MNE package. The ZUNA1.1 model is released open source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍ZUNA1.1，一个380M参数的扩散自编码器，用于灵活的EEG信号重建。它支持可变长度序列（最长30秒）、任意数量的EEG通道和头皮位置，以及通道内任意时间区间的重建。与ZUNA1相比性能相当但更加灵活，且大幅优于MNE包中的球面样条插值等标准方法。模型以Apache 2.0许可开源发布。
AI.motivation: 现有的EEG重建方法（如球面样条插值）在灵活性和性能上存在局限，需要一种能处理多变通道配置、可变时间长度和部分通道缺失等复杂场景的统一重建模型。ZUNA1.1旨在克服前代ZUNA1在灵活性和任务范围上的不足。
AI.method: ZUNA1.1采用380M参数的扩散自编码器架构，能够处理可变长度序列（最长30s），支持任意数量的EEG通道和任意头皮位置，既能重建整个通道，也能重建通道内的任意时间区间，从而覆盖广泛的重建任务。
AI.result: ZUNA1.1在性能上与ZUNA1相当或更优，同时具备更强的灵活性和更广的任务覆盖能力。它持续大幅优于标准方法（如MNE包中广泛部署的球面样条插值）。
AI.conclusion: ZUNA1.1是一个性能优异且高度灵活的EEG重建模型，作为开源资源（Apache 2.0）发布，为EEG信号处理提供了比传统插值方法更强大、更通用的替代方案。

title: DualAnchor: Preserving Language Priors and Improving Lexical Fidelity in Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led sign language translation (SLT), the task of converting sign-language videos into spoken-language text, to increasingly adopt LLMs as textual backbones. However, despite their strong language modeling capabilities, existing LLM-based SLT methods often undermine rather than exploit this language prior, producing disfluent translations, a failure we term language-prior degradation. Meanwhile, existing methods typically align videos and text at the sentence level, which does not ensure accurate lexical details and creates a lexical fidelity gap. To address both issues, we propose DualAnchor, a gloss-free LLM-based SLT training framework that couples two complementary anchors for linguistically fluent and visually faithful generation. Token-level Prior Anchoring (TPA) preserves the LLM's language prior by regularizing the multimodal decoder at each decoding step toward the next-token distribution of a frozen LLM conditioned on the same autoregressive prefix. Optimal Transport Alignment (OTA) improves lexical fidelity by formulating visual-textual matching as entropy-regularized partial optimal transport, with Sinkhorn optimization inducing a soft alignment between visual tokens and textual content tokens under a cosine cost. DualAnchor achieves strong overall performance on both PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily. Targeted analyses attribute these gains to the complementary effects of the two anchors: TPA improves fluency, whereas OTA reduces fine-grained lexical errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DualAnchor，一个无需gloss的基于大语言模型（LLM）的手语翻译训练框架，通过Token级先验锚定（TPA）和最优传输对齐（OTA）两个互补锚点，分别解决语言先验退化（翻译不流畅）和词汇保真度不足（词汇细节不准确）两大问题，在PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily上取得了优异的整体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的手语翻译方法虽然利用LLM作为文本骨干，但往往未能有效发挥其语言建模能力，反而导致翻译不流畅（称为"语言先验退化"）；同时，现有方法通常在句子级别对齐视频和文本，无法保证词汇级别的准确性，造成"词汇保真度鸿沟"。作者旨在同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 提出DualAnchor框架，包含两个互补锚点：(1) Token级先验锚定（TPA），通过在每个解码步骤中将多模态解码器的下一token分布正则化至冻结LLM在相同自回归前缀条件下的下一token分布，从而保留LLM的语言先验；(2) 最优传输对齐（OTA），将视觉-文本匹配建模为熵正则化的部分最优传输问题，利用Sinkhorn优化在余弦代价下诱导视觉token与文本内容token之间的软对齐，提升词汇保真度。
AI.result: DualAnchor在PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily两个基准上均取得了优异的整体性能。针对性分析表明，两个锚点具有互补效应：TPA提升翻译流畅性，而OTA减少细粒度的词汇错误。
AI.conclusion: TPA与OTA的互补组合有效解决了LLM-based手语翻译中的语言先验退化和词汇保真度不足问题，验证了在训练阶段通过双锚点同时约束语言流畅性和视觉-词汇对齐的有效性。

title: A dataset of rated conceptual arguments
summary: Large language models have improved rapidly on tasks with verifiable answers, such as mathematics and programming. Much less is known about their ability to reason about what we call conceptual questions: questions for which no ground truth is realistically accessible and no widely accepted resolution methodology exists, but on which progress can still be made by debating arguments. Most philosophical questions are of this kind, as are central components of questions in AI safety, decision theory, and social choice. Our approach is based on the view that while bottom-line conclusions on such questions are hard to evaluate, individual contextualized arguments can be evaluated far more reliably. We therefore introduce a dataset of 951 argumentative critiques of 442 position texts, spanning topics from AI safety and decision theory to ethics and politics, with 1,458 ratings by six expert raters along dimensions including centrality, strength, correctness, and clarity. We propose two scoring functions and benchmark a range of models. Performance tracks general capability rankings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个关于"概念性问题"（无标准答案、无公认解决方法的辩论性议题）的论证评估数据集，包含951条论证性批评、442个立场文本和1458条专家评分，并提出了两种评分函数来基准测试语言模型在评估这些论证质量上的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学、编程等有可验证答案的任务上进步迅速，但在概念性问题上（如哲学、AI安全、决策理论和社会选择等无标准答案的议题）的能力尚不清楚。作者认为虽然这些问题的最终结论难以评估，但单个语境化的论证可以被更可靠地评估，因此需要建立相应的数据集和评估方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含442个立场文本和951条论证性批评的数据集，涵盖AI安全、决策理论、伦理和政治等主题，由六位专家按中心性、力度、正确性和清晰度四个维度进行1458次评分。同时提出两种评分函数，并基准测试一系列语言模型。
AI.result: 模型在论证评估任务上的表现与总体能力排名一致，表明现有模型的推理能力可迁移到概念性论证评估，但整体性能仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 概念性论证可以通过分解为可评估的语境化论证来系统化评估，这为在无标准答案的领域建立可验证的评估框架提供了可行路径。

title: BlindPSNR: A No-Reference Fidelity Predictor for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods involve tunable parameters that are typically fixed, often leading to performance degradation when applied across scenes. Manually selecting the best configuration, however, can be time-consuming and not always practical. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is the natural fidelity criterion for automating parameter selection, yet it requires a ground-truth reference that is typically unavailable. To our knowledge, no learning-based method addresses no-reference PSNR prediction for low-light image enhancement; the natural surrogate, no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA), targets perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity, and all seven baselines we test achieve 0% top-1 selection accuracy on our benchmark. With paired training data, the ground-truth PSNR is analytically computable, providing exact supervision without a separate teacher network. Building on this, we propose BlindPSNR, a lightweight no-reference network that fuses the enhanced image with the degraded low-light input via windowed cross-attention and estimates PSNR through heteroscedastic regression. While a scalar-regression baseline achieves top-1 accuracy of 54.4%, BlindPSNR raises this to 89.5% with regret dropping from 1.62 dB to 0.026 dB, and generalizes to unseen datasets (SRCC = 0.61-0.67).

AI.tldr: 本文提出BlindPSNR，一个轻量级无参考网络，通过窗口交叉注意力融合增强图像与低光输入，利用异方差回归预测PSNR，实现低光图像增强中无参考的PSNR预测，将top-1配置选择准确率从54.4%提升至89.5%。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强（LLIE）方法依赖可调参数且通常固定不变，导致跨场景性能退化。手动调参耗时且不切实际。PSNR是自动选参的自然保真度准则，但需要地面真值参考，实际中通常不可用。现有的无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）关注感知质量而非信号保真度，无法作为替代方案，七个基线方法在基准上top-1选择准确率均为0%。因此需要一种无参考的PSNR预测方法。
AI.method: BlindPSNR是一种轻量级无参考网络，核心包括：1）通过窗口化交叉注意力机制融合增强图像与低光退化输入，充分捕捉两者的关系信息；2）利用异方差回归（heteroscedastic regression）估计PSNR，不仅预测均值还建模不确定性；3）利用配对训练数据中PSNR可解析计算的特点，提供精确的监督信号而无需额外的教师网络。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，标量回归基线top-1准确率为54.4%，BlindPSNR将其提升至89.5%；遗憾值（regret）从1.62 dB降至0.026 dB。在未见数据集上展现良好泛化能力（SRCC = 0.61-0.67）。相比七个NR-IQA基线0%的top-1选择准确率，BlindPSNR实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: BlindPSNR首次从学习层面解决低光增强中无参考PSNR预测问题，证明利用配对训练数据提供的精确监督可以替代教师网络，实现高精度的无参考PSNR估计。该方法在配置选择准确率和泛化能力上均大幅超越现有基线，为低光图像增强的自动化参数选择提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

title: Modeling Decisions in Blockchain Analytics: A Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Tree-Based vs. Sequential Models
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 23rd International Conference on Modeling Decisions for Artificial Intelligence (MDAI 2026)
summary: Sybil bots are Ethereum actors that imitate legitimate users to extract airdrop rewards or influence governance. Recent Sybil detection methods increasingly use deep learning and treat blockchain activity as a quasi-linguistic sequence. However, complex sequence models are computationally expensive for real-time monitoring, and their reported performance may be inflated by label leakage from high-signal smart contracts. We ask whether and how organic users, Sybil bots, and MEV bots differ in the structural complexity of their transaction histories; whether sequential models outperform tree-based tabular models once leakage is reduced; whether transaction order or timing provides the stronger behavioral signal; and whether the resulting models are practical for low-latency deployment. Our approach to leakage-aware Sybil bot detection consists of a Blind-Spot protocol and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. The former eliminates shortcuts associated with high-signal contracts, whereas the latter models wallets using rhythm, EVM execution structure, and intent. We evaluate this approach on Ethereum actor classification by comparing Transformer and BiLSTM sequence models against XGBoost and SVM baselines. We contribute a framework for leakage-aware Ethereum actor classification and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. Our results demonstrate that, under leakage-aware evaluation, XGBoost outperforms Transformer-based sequence models while providing lower latency and estimated energy use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种防标签泄漏的Sybil机器人检测方法，包含Blind-Spot协议（消除高信号合约导致的捷径）和Transaction Grammar交易语法表示（建模钱包的节奏、EVM执行结构和意图）。在以太坊用户分类中，XGBoost在泄漏感知评估下优于Transformer/BiLSTM序列模型，且延迟和能耗更低。
AI.motivation: 现有Sybil检测方法采用深度学习将区块链活动视为准语言序列，但存在两个问题：(1)复杂序列模型计算开销大，难以实时监控；(2)高信号智能合约导致的标签泄漏可能虚增报告的性能。作者希望探究在减少泄漏后，序列模型是否仍优于传统树模型，以及交易顺序与时机哪个提供更强的行为信号。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) Blind-Spot协议——通过消除与高信号合约相关的捷径来减少标签泄漏；(2) Transaction Grammar交易语法表示——从韵律（节奏）、EVM执行结构和意图三个维度建模钱包行为。在此基础上比较Transformer和BiLSTM序列模型与XGBoost、SVM基线在以太坊角色分类上的表现。
AI.result: 在泄漏感知评估下，XGBoost优于基于Transformer的序列模型，同时在延迟和估算能耗方面更具优势。研究还区分了有机用户、Sybil机器人和MEV机器人在交易历史结构复杂性上的差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献了泄漏感知的以太坊角色分类框架和Transaction Grammar钱包行为表示方法。实践上，轻量级树模型在泄漏感知场景下比复杂序列模型更适合低延迟部署，意味着实际Sybil检测系统应优先考虑效率和鲁棒性而非模型复杂度。

title: Harness-G: A Graph-Structured Harness for Search Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) search agents commonly model retrieval as free-form natural-language query generation and optimize multi-turn interactions using final-answer rewards. Current studies mainly improve training with denser or more structured credit signals, but rarely examine whether retrieval is properly formulated at the policy-environment interface. We observe pronounced retrieval aliasing during Search-R1 training: rollouts for the same question continue to generate distinct query strings, yet their accumulated evidence sets increasingly overlap. We call this phenomenon retrieval-equivalence collapse; in this regime, trajectories approach utility equivalence with respect to retrieval decisions, leaving within-group returns with little effective retrieval contrast. To address this problem, we propose Harness-G, a graph-structured retrieval framework that redesigns this interface. It reformulates free-form query generation as finite action selection: the policy selects an evidence sentence or entity, or chooses to answer, while the environment constructs the menu, tracks retrieval state, and validates and executes each choice. This interface reduces linguistic aliasing and makes same-state alternatives directly comparable. Building on this interface, we introduce Structured Non-myopic Credit (SNC), which uses a frozen answer scorer to compare the selected action with its alternatives and assigns downstream gains to the earlier actions that enabled them. Across six QA benchmarks, Harness-G achieves the highest average F1 at both evaluated model scales, outperforming the strongest baseline, Graph-R1, by 10.74 points at 1.5B and 3.98 points at 3B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Harness-G，一种基于图结构的检索框架，通过将自由形式的查询生成重构为有限动作选择来解决RL检索中的"检索等价坍缩"问题，并引入结构化非近视信用（SNC）进行信用分配。在六个QA基准上，Harness-G在1.5B和3B模型规模上分别超过最强基线Graph-R1达10.74和3.98个F1点。
AI.motivation: 现有的RL搜索代理将检索建模为自由形式的自然语言查询生成，虽然已有研究通过更稠密或更结构化的信用信号来改善训练，但很少审视检索在策略-环境接口层面的公式化问题。作者观察到Search-R1训练中出现的"检索等价坍缩"现象：相同问题产生的不同查询字符串对应的证据集越来越重叠，导致轨迹在检索决策上趋于效用等价，同组内的回报缺乏有效的检索对比度，阻碍了有效学习。
AI.method: Harness-G框架包含两个核心组件：（1）图结构检索接口——将自由形式的查询生成重构为有限动作选择，策略选择证据句子或实体，或选择作答；环境负责构建动作菜单、追踪检索状态并验证执行每个选择，从而减少语言混叠并使同状态备选动作可直接比较。（2）结构化非近视信用（SNC）——利用冻结的答案评分器对所选动作与其备选方案进行比较，将下游收益分配给使其成为可能的早期动作。
AI.result: 在六个QA基准上，Harness-G在两种评估的模型规模下均取得了最高的平均F1分数：在1.5B规模上超越最强基线Graph-R1达10.74个点，在3B规模上超越3.98个点。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检索重新公式化为策略-环境接口上的有限动作选择，并辅以基于图结构的非近视信用分配机制，Harness-G有效缓解了检索等价坍缩问题，显著提升了RL检索代理在多轮问答任务上的性能。

title: Automated Transcript Analysis for Detecting Flaws in Agentic Benchmarks
summary: Capabilities of frontier models are often assessed using agentic benchmarks. To trust these results, benchmarks must accurately measure what they claim to and be free from invalidating flaws. Previous manual audits of benchmarks such as SWE-Bench-Verified have uncovered several validity issues in transcripts. However, manual review is difficult to scale, and it is unclear whether automated methods can reliably surface flaws that compromise benchmark validity. In this paper, we developed AI scanners to detect four types of validity issues: ground truth access, tool failure, guessing vulnerability, and answer format ambiguity. We produced grading rubrics for each to instruct human labeling, and evaluated the scanners against human labels on a held-out test set of Inspect Evals benchmarks. Our scanners identified several verified quality issues in five widely used benchmarks, including cases unlikely to be caught by random manual inspection. Not all cases were identified, and scanner performance varied substantially across benchmarks, criteria and models. We highlight several open challenges to be addressed to improve scanners for stronger quality assurance claims, including broader standardization gaps in the evaluation field that degrade scanner performance. Together, these results serve as a proof of concept for using automated transcript analysis to audit benchmark quality more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了AI扫描器来自动检测agentic基准测试中的四类有效性问题（ground truth访问、工具故障、猜测脆弱性和答案格式歧义），并在Inspect Evals基准上评估，发现五个广泛使用的基准存在已验证的质量问题，证明自动化转录分析可用于基准质量审计。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型能力常通过agentic基准评估，但这些基准的效度可能被潜在缺陷破坏。以往手动审计（如SWE-Bench-Verified）虽能发现问题但难以规模化，且不确定自动化方法能否可靠地识别损害基准效度的缺陷。需要开发可扩展的自动化审计方法。
AI.method: 开发了AI扫描器检测四类效度问题：ground truth访问、工具故障、猜测脆弱性和答案格式歧义。为每类问题制定评分细则以指导人工标注，并在Inspect Evals基准的保留测试集上，将扫描器输出与人工标签进行比较评估。
AI.result: 扫描器在五个广泛使用的基准中识别出多个经过验证的质量问题，包括随机人工检查难以发现的案例。但并非所有案例都被识别，扫描器性能在不同基准、标准和模型间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果作为概念验证，证明使用自动化转录分析进行更大规模基准质量审计是可行的。同时指出了改进扫描器以支持更强质量保证声明所需的开放挑战，包括评估领域中削弱扫描器性能的更广泛标准化缺口。

title: 4DHumanDiff: Direct Text-to-4DGS Generation for Consistent 360-Degree Dynamic Humans
summary: Generating high-quality 360-degree dynamic human assets from text prompts is challenging. Existing methods usually synthesize monocular or multi-view videos first and then fit a 4D representation, which is expensive and often causes incomplete geometry or view-inconsistent renderings. We present 4DHumanDiff, a diffusion framework that directly generates dynamic humans represented by 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) from text prompts. By modeling the structured 4D representation space end-to-end, 4DHumanDiff avoids video pre-generation and per-scene reconstruction, making it better suited for view-consistent and temporally coherent asset generation. The model uses a 3D U-Net backbone with temporal attention for motion-aware generation. We further construct a large-scale text-to-4DGS dataset with 60,000 high-quality pairs, and introduce 2D regularization and training-free 4D interpolation to improve rendering quality and motion smoothness. Experiments show that 4DHumanDiff generates consistent 360-degree dynamic humans within one minute, achieves better temporal and multi-view consistency, and reduces inference time by more than 10x.

AI.tldr: 4DHumanDiff是一个直接从文本提示生成360度动态人体资产的扩散框架，通过端到端建模4D高斯溅射(4DGS)表示空间，避免视频预生成和逐场景重建，在一分钟内生成一致的人体动态资产，推理速度提升10倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本生成动态人体方法通常先合成单目或多视角视频，再拟合4D表示，这一过程昂贵且常导致几何不完整或视角不一致的渲染结果。因此需要一种直接生成4D表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出4DHumanDiff，一个以3D U-Net为主干并带有时间注意力模块的扩散框架，直接在4D高斯溅射表示空间中端到端生成动态人体。构建了包含60,000对文本-4DGS数据的大规模数据集，并引入2D正则化和无需训练的4D插值技术来提升渲染质量与运动平滑度。
AI.result: 实验表明4DHumanDiff能够在一分钟内生成一致的360度动态人体，在时间一致性和多视角一致性上表现更好，推理时间减少超过10倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过端到端直接生成4DGS表示，4DHumanDiff有效解决了传统两步法中几何不完整和视角不一致的问题，同时大幅降低了推理成本，为文本驱动的4D人体资产生成提供了高效且一致的解决方案。

title: Compression-Based Behavioral Similarity for Open-World Sybil Discovery on Ethereum
comment: Accepted as a full paper and scheduled for presentation at the European Conference on Advances in Databases and Information Systems (ADBIS 2026)
summary: Sybil attackers are Blockchain actors that adopt the characteristics of regular users to exploit airdrops or influence governance. Current methods of Sybil actor detection include constructing graphs, which requires token transfers between examined wallets. Machine learning algorithms have been employed as well, but they treat the task as a closed-set classification problem, making them vulnerable to frequent changes in attack strategies or evasion tactics. We address the following questions: can compression-based similarity differentiate Sybil bots, organic users, and arbitrage bot wallets without direct financial links? What is the effect of high-signal contracts on the discovery of Sybils, and how robust are behavioral graphs under temporal drift and adversarial perturbations? Our approach synthesizes a symbolic Transaction Grammar from EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) traces, capturing separately transaction rhythm, execution structure, and functional intent. The high-signal contracts are filtered with our own protocol, called the Blind-Spot Protocol. Gzip-based NCD is used to construct a behavioral graph for Sybil discovery. We validate this framework against supervised machine learning baselines, a temporal split, and synthetic camouflage stress tests. Ultimately, we contribute a leakage-aware behavioral framework for Sybil candidate discovery. Its core NCD primitive requires no supervised training and can expand suspicious seed wallets without explicit funding links. We position the method as a training-free local discovery primitive for open-world blockchain audits, rather than as a formal open-set recognition system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于压缩的、免训练的行为学Sybil检测框架，通过从EVM交易轨迹中提取符号化交易语法（Transaction Grammar），利用Gzip归一化压缩距离（NCD）构建行为图，配合Blind-Spot Protocol过滤高信号合约，在无直接资金关联的情况下区分Sybil机器人、有机用户和套利机器人钱包。
AI.motivation: 现有Sybil攻击者检测方法存在两个关键缺陷：基于图的方法依赖钱包间的代币转移关系，无法在无直接资金链时工作；基于机器学习的方法将任务视为封闭集分类，难以应对攻击策略频繁变化或逃避技术。本文旨在回答三个核心问题：压缩相似性能否在无直接金融关联下区分Sybil机器人与有机用户/套利机器人？高信号合约对Sybil发现有何作用？行为图在时间漂移和对抗扰动下是否鲁棒？
AI.method: 从EVM交易轨迹中合成符号化交易语法，分别捕获交易节奏（rhythm）、执行结构（structure）和功能意图（intent）三个维度；利用自研Blind-Spot Protocol过滤高信号合约；基于Gzip的归一化压缩距离（NCD）构建行为图以进行Sybil发现。框架通过有监督机器学习基线、时间切分和合成伪装压力测试进行验证。
AI.result: 该框架在多个验证场景（监督基线对比、时间漂移测试、合成伪装压力测试）中得到验证。其核心NCD原语无需监督训练，能够在没有显式资金关联的情况下扩展可疑种子钱包集合。该方法被定位为免训练的局部发现原语，适用于开放世界的区块链审计，而非正式的开集识别系统。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一个泄漏感知（leakage-aware）的行为学Sybil候选发现框架。其核心NCD原语免于监督训练，可用于开放世界区块链审计中的本地发现任务，无需显式资金关联即可扩展可疑种子钱包，为区块链Sybil检测提供了新的、鲁棒的行为学方案。

title: From Single- to Cross-Document: Benchmarking Multi-Granularity Event Analysis of Large Language Models
comment: 9 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2026)
summary: Event analysis is an essential and fundamental direction of information extraction, involving various event-centric tasks at different granularity of documents. While large language models (LLMs) have preliminarily achieved promising performance in part of these tasks individually, their capability in event analysis still lacks comprehensive understanding due to restricted document granularity, task designs, and data source of existing benchmarks. To address these limitations, we introduce MiGUE-Bench, a systematic benchmark for assessing the performance of LLMs in multi-granularity event analysis. To support large-scale evaluation, we first develop an LLM-driven self-correcting annotation framework called MiGUE-Pipeline, enabling scalable acquisition of high-quality source data of events with automatic labels. Then, we design four core tasks in our benchmark, i.e., event detection, relation reasoning, structure induction, and future prediction, to probe model competence at different levels, from atomic event details to complex cross-document narratives. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods delineate the current capability boundary and identify critical deficiencies, providing insights into the future improvement of LLMs in challenging event analysis tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiGUE-Bench，一个用于系统评估大语言模型在多粒度事件分析任务上能力的基准测试框架，包含自动标注流程MiGUE-Pipeline和四个核心任务（事件检测、关系推理、结构归纳、未来预测），实验揭示当前LLM在该领域的性能边界与关键不足。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在事件分析任务上虽有初步表现，但已有基准受限于文档粒度、任务设计单一和数据来源局限，缺乏对LLM事件分析能力的全面理解，因此需要系统性基准来评估其多粒度事件分析能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出MiGUE-Pipeline，一个基于LLM驱动的自校正标注框架，实现大规模高质源数据及自动标签的可扩展获取；2) 设计MiGUE-Bench，包含四个核心任务：事件检测（原子级事件细节）、关系推理、结构归纳和未来预测（复杂跨文档叙事），从不同粒度层级探测模型能力；3) 对SOTA LLM和RAG方法进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 在多种SOTA大语言模型和检索增强生成方法上进行了广泛实验，描绘了当前模型的能力边界，识别出关键能力缺陷。
AI.conclusion: MiGUE-Bench为多粒度事件分析提供了系统性评估平台，实验结果揭示了LLM在挑战性事件分析任务中的不足，为未来改进方向提供了洞察。

title: AI Literacy: An Exercise in Power-Knowledge
summary: As generative artificial intelligence becomes one of the most significant systems of knowledge production in our society today, questions relating to who can access and shape that production grow increasingly important in our discourse. This paper argues that the existing frameworks for AI literacy, which are dominated by technical competency and responsible-use principles, are insufficient because they enforce a "consumer" orientation toward AI rather than fostering genuine epistemic agency.
