Based upon Foucault's concept of power-knowledge, Freire's pedagogy of critical consciousness, and scholarship of digital literacy, this paper proposes a reconceptualization of AI literacy as a critical practice that equips individuals not just to use AI systems, but to critically evaluate them, resist their structuring assumptions, and participate in their governance. The paper further argues that unequal access to AI tools in society recapitulates longstanding epistemic injustices, and that a literacy framework oriented toward empowerment must account for these structural inequities. A three-part framework of AI literacy based on the notions of contextual use, critical interrogation, and participatory governance frames this literacy as a cultivation of epistemic "agents" rather than the training of competent consumers of AI-generated information.

AI.tldr: 本文批判现有AI素养框架过于强调技术能力和"负责任使用"原则，仅将用户培养为AI的"消费者"而非真正的主体。基于福柯的权力-知识理论、弗莱雷的批判意识教育学及数字素养研究，作者提出将AI素养重新概念化为一种批判性实践，使个体不仅能使用AI系统，还能批判性评估、抵制其结构性假设并参与其治理。论文提出包含情境使用、批判性审视与参与式治理的三部分框架，主张AI素养应培养认识论意义上的"能动主体"而非AI生成信息的合格消费者，并需正视AI工具获取不平等所复制的认识论不公。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已成为当今社会最重要的知识生产系统之一，谁能够获取并塑造这种知识生产变得至关重要。现有AI素养框架（以技术能力和负责任使用为核心）不足以应对这一挑战，因为它们强化了用户对AI的"消费者"定位，而非培养真正的认识论能动性。
AI.method: 采用理论建构的方法，整合福柯的权力-知识概念、弗莱雷的批判意识教育学以及数字素养研究，提出AI素养的重新概念化框架。最终构建包含"情境使用、批判性审视、参与式治理"三个维度的AI素养框架。
AI.result: 提出一套三部分AI素养框架，以培养认识论"能动主体"为目标，替代现有的仅培养AI信息合格消费者的取向。该框架同时将结构性不平等纳入考量，回应了AI工具获取不公所复制的认识论不公问题。
AI.conclusion: AI素养应被重新理解为一种批判性实践，使个体不仅能使用AI系统，还能批判性评估、抵制其结构性假设并参与其治理；这种素养的培育必须正视结构性不平等的现实，以赋予个体真正的认识论能动性。

title: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks, but often fail under imperfect or shifted contexts. A reliable MLLM should refuse truly out-of-context (OOC) questions with subject-level context shifts while still answering shifted in-context (Shifted IC) questions with non-subject context shifts. Existing benchmarks mainly target OOC or visually unanswerable questions, but overlook answerable Shifted IC cases and cover limited OOC shifts. To fill this gap, we present MMOOC, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating refusal and robust answering abilities of MLLMs. MMOOC contains over 41K image-question pairs, including answerable Shifted IC cases and unanswerable OOC cases, spanning three question formats, eight shift types and six visual scenarios, with data quality ensured through MLLM-based filtering and human verification. We evaluate model responses using Accuracy and Refusal Rate, and further introduce an LLM-as-a-Judge metric to assess the correctness of model reasoning. Experiments on diverse MLLMs show that current models still struggle to balance answer-ability and refusal under shifted contexts. We further analyze key failure patterns and show that post-training can improve robustness. MMOOC will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMOOC，一个大规模基准数据集（超过41K图像-问题对），用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在上下文偏移场景下的拒答与鲁棒回答能力，涵盖可回答的Shifted IC问题和不可回答的OOC问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在视觉语言任务上表现优异，但在不完美或偏移的上下文下常常失败。可靠的多模态模型应拒绝对主体级上下文偏移（OOC）问题做出回答，同时仍能回答非主体级上下文偏移（Shifted IC）的问题。然而现有基准主要针对OOC或视觉上不可回答的问题，忽视了可回答的Shifted IC案例，且覆盖的OOC偏移类型有限。
AI.method: 构建MMOOC基准，包含超过41K图像-问题对，覆盖可回答的Shifted IC和不可回答的OOC两类问题；设计三种问题格式、八种偏移类型和六种视觉场景；通过基于MLLM的过滤和人工验证确保数据质量；提出Accuracy和Refusal Rate作为评估指标，并引入LLM-as-a-Judge指标评估模型推理的正确性。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前主流MLLMs在偏移上下文下难以在回答能力与拒答能力之间取得平衡；进一步分析了关键失败模式，并证明后训练（post-training）可以提升模型的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MMOOC揭示了现有MLLMs在上下文偏移场景下的不足，为后续改进提供了基准和方向；数据集将公开发布以促进该领域研究。

title: Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation
summary: The deep learning revolution, kicked off by AlexNet, taught us that end-to-end training beats decomposing a problem into hand-designed stages. Generative modeling, however, has remained the exception-despite generative models being remarkably capable, they are still not trained end-to-end. This is because, at its core, generative modeling is about handling distributions with many modes, and existing scalable approaches handle this the same way, by factoring the generation procedure, which prevents end-to-end generation. In this work, we introduce Explorative Modeling, a new paradigm that instead factors the training loop, exploring K candidate matches between model generations and data, and training on the best, so predictions commit to modes rather than blurring them. We find Explorative Models (XMs) useful in two settings. First, increasing exploration adds a third pretraining axis beyond parameters and data for existing generative models-where scaling exploration monotonically improves performance across both continuous and discrete domains (images, video, and language). Notably, gains from exploration increase with scale, climbing from 7% to 36% as data scales and from 13% to 23% as models grow, with efficiency gains more than doubling at 3x the compute. Concretely, exploration improves FLOP efficiency by 4.1x, sample efficiency by 6.2x, parameter efficiency by 47%, lifts the strongest of image-generation recipes to a near-state-of-the-art 1.43 FID on ImageNet without guidance, enables scaling how end-to-end existing models are, and unlocks scaling generalization. Second, XMs enable end-to-end reconstructive generative modeling, matching diffusion on control tasks with 16-256x fewer inference steps. Together, these results establish XMs as both a new pretraining axis for existing generative models and a standalone end-to-end generative modeling paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出探索式建模（Explorative Modeling, XM）新范式，通过分解训练循环而非生成过程，在模型生成与数据之间探索K个候选匹配并仅训练最优者，使预测提交到模态而非模糊化。XM既能作为现有生成模型的第三预训练轴（在参数和数据之外），也能作为独立的端到端生成建模范式，在图像、视频和语言等连续与离散域上均带来显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 深度学习革命表明端到端训练优于分阶段人工设计，但生成模型一直是例外——现有的可扩展生成方法都通过分解生成过程来处理多模态分布，这阻碍了端到端生成。作者旨在解决这一核心矛盾，提出一种新范式，使生成建模也能实现端到端训练。
AI.method: 提出Explorative Modeling（XM）范式：不像现有方法那样分解生成过程（factoring the generation procedure），而是分解训练循环（factoring the training loop），在每次训练迭代中探索K个模型生成与真实数据之间的候选匹配，仅基于最优匹配进行训练更新，使模型预测承诺到具体模态而非在多个模态间模糊化。
AI.result: 探索缩放作为新的预训练轴，随数据和模型规模增大收益提升（数据规模增大时从7%升至36%，模型规模增大时从13%升至23%）。具体提升：FLOP效率提高4.1倍，样本效率提高6.2倍，参数效率提高47%；在ImageNet上无需引导即可达到1.43 FID的近SOTA图像生成性能；XM还支持端到端重建式生成建模，在控制任务上以16-256倍更少的推理步骤匹配扩散模型性能。
AI.conclusion: XM既可作为现有生成模型的新预训练轴（在参数和数据之外的第三个缩放维度），也可作为独立的端到端生成建模范式，为生成模型的缩放泛化和高效训练开辟了新的方向，验证了端到端训练在生成建模中的可行性与价值。

title: ICLE++: Modeling Fine-Grained Traits for Holistic Essay Scoring
comment: Accepted as a long paper to NAACL 2024
summary: The majority of the recently-developed models for automated essay scoring (AES) are evaluated solely on the ASAP corpus. However, ASAP is not without its limitations. For instance, it is not clear whether models trained on ASAP can generalize well when evaluated on other corpora. In light of these limitations, we introduce ICLE++, a corpus of persuasive student essays annotated with both holistic scores and trait-specific scores. Not only can ICLE++ be used to test the generalizability of AES models trained on ASAP, but it can also facilitate the evaluation of models developed for newer AES problems such as multi-trait scoring and cross-prompt scoring. We believe that ICLE++, which represents a culmination of our long-term effort in annotating the essays in the ICLE corpus, contributes to the set of much-needed annotated corpora for AES research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ICLE++，一个包含整体评分和特定特质评分的说服性学生作文语料库，用于测试AES模型的泛化能力以及支持多特质评分和跨提示评分等新问题的评估，弥补了目前AES研究过度依赖ASAP语料库的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化作文评分（AES）模型大多仅在ASAP语料库上评估，但ASAP存在局限性，例如无法确定在该语料库上训练的模型能否在其他语料库上良好泛化，因此需要新的带注释语料库来支撑AES研究。
AI.method: 构建了ICLE++语料库：对ICLE语料库中的说服性学生作文进行长期注释，标注了整体评分（holistic scores）和特质特定评分（trait-specific scores），可用于测试AES模型的可泛化性，并支持多特质评分和跨提示评分等新任务。
AI.result: ICLE++语料库可作为评估AES模型泛化能力的基准，并能促进多特质评分和跨提示评分等新兴AES问题的模型评估，为AES研究提供了急需的注释语料资源。
AI.conclusion: ICLE++代表了作者团队在ICLE语料库标注方面的长期努力的成果，为AES研究领域补充了亟需的多样化标注语料库，有助于推动AES模型从单一语料库评估向更广泛的泛化性评估方向发展。

title: Using Large Language Models for Idea Generation in Innovation
summary: This research evaluates the efficacy of large language models (LLMs) in generating new product ideas. To do so, we compare three pools of ideas for new products targeted toward college students and priced at 50 dollars or less. The first pool of ideas was created by university students in a product design course before the availability of LLMs. The second and third pools of ideas were generated by GPT-4 from OpenAI using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, respectively. We evaluated idea quality using standard market research techniques to predict average purchase intent probability. We used text mining to assess idea similarity and human raters to evaluate idea novelty. We find that AI-generated ideas outperform human-generated ideas in terms of average purchase intent, with few-shot prompting yielding slightly higher intent than zero-shot prompting. However, AI-generated ideas are perceived as less novel and exhibit higher pairwise similarity, particularly with few-shot prompting, indicating a less diverse solution landscape. When focusing on the quality of the best ideas rather than the average ideas, we find that AI-generated ideas are seven times more likely to rank among the top 10 percent of ideas, demonstrating a significant advantage over human-generated ideas. We propose that this seven-to-one advantage is a conservative estimate because it does not account for the greater productivity of AI. Our findings suggest that despite some drawbacks, AI creativity presents a substantial benefit in generating high-quality ideas for new product development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比人类学生与GPT-4（零样本和少样本提示）生成的新产品创意，发现AI生成的创意在平均购买意愿上优于人类，且顶级创意的质量显著更高（前10%的概率是人类的7倍），但AI创意的新颖性较低且多样性较差。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型（LLMs）在新产品创意生成中的实际功效，以评估AI创造力在产品开发中的价值与局限性。
AI.method: 比较三组面向大学生、售价50美元以内的新产品创意：（1）产品设计课程中人类学生生成；（2）GPT-4零样本提示生成；（3）GPT-4少样本提示生成。采用标准市场调研技术预测平均购买意愿概率，使用文本挖掘评估创意相似度，并由人类评分者评估创意新颖性。
AI.result: AI生成创意在平均购买意愿上优于人类创意（少样本提示略高于零样本），但AI创意被认为新颖性更低、相似度更高（少样本提示尤为明显）。顶级创意质量方面，AI创意进入前10%概率是人类创意的7倍，且该优势为保守估计（未计入AI更高生产率）。
AI.conclusion: 尽管AI生成创意在多样性和新颖性上存在不足，但其在生成高质量新产品创意方面具有显著优势，对新产品开发中的创意生成环节具有实质性的潜在价值。

title: Learning Color Grading, No Photo Sharing: Federated Aesthetic Preference Learning for Personalized Image Enhancement
summary: Personalized image enhancement should reflect individual aesthetic taste, yet learning such preferences commonly depends on private photos and ratings that are unsuitable for centralized collection. The task must infer preference from sparse, heterogeneous feedback and translate it into natural-looking color transformations on resource-constrained user devices. We introduce FedPAIE, a federated personalized aesthetic image enhancement framework for user-adaptive color grading without centralizing raw photos or ratings. FedPAIE trains a lightweight dual-cue aesthetic scorer, calibrates it into a personalized scorer on a small local support set, and freezes it to guide regularized adaptation of a lightweight CLUT enhancer from unpaired local photographs. Fidelity constraints and an excess-gap penalty regularize scorer-guided adaptation to limit proxy-score over-optimization while preserving content and natural appearance. Training remains lightweight throughout the pipeline: scorer learning updates at most 0.787M parameters, enhancer adaptation updates 0.265M, and inference retains only a 0.293M-parameter personalized enhancer. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and Flickr-AES demonstrate effective open-world personalization and a favorable balance between user preference and image fidelity. FedPAIE thus connects decentralized preference learning with efficient personalized image transformation without requiring paired user retouches.

AI.tldr: FedPAIE是一个联邦个性化美图增强框架，通过去中心化方式学习用户美学偏好并实现轻量级的自适应色彩分级，无需集中收集原始照片或评分数据。
AI.motivation: 个性化图像增强需要反映个体审美品味，但学习这种偏好通常依赖不适合集中收集的私人照片和评分数据。系统必须在资源受限的用户设备上，从稀疏、异构的反馈中推断偏好并转化为自然的色彩变换。
AI.method: FedPAIE训练一个轻量级双线索美学评分器，在小规模的本地支持集上校准为个性化评分器，并冻结该评分器以引导轻量级CLUT增强器从非配对本地照片中进行正则化自适应。通过保真度约束和超额间隙惩罚来正则化评分器引导的自适应过程，限制代理分数过度优化，同时保持内容和自然外观。整个流程参数规模很小：评分器学习最多更新0.787M参数，增强器自适应更新0.265M参数，推理仅保留0.293M参数的个性化增强器。
AI.result: 在MIT-Adobe FiveK和Flickr-AES数据集上的实验证明了有效的开放世界个性化能力，以及用户偏好与图像保真度之间的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: FedPAIE将去中心化偏好学习与高效的个性化图像变换联系起来，无需配对用户润色数据即可实现个性化色彩分级。

title: The Convergence Behavior of Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise
summary: We establish the first convergence guarantees for the plain vector-form \emph{Adam} optimizer under heavy-tailed stochastic noise. While several Adam variants are known to achieve optimal iteration complexity in bounded-variance nonconvex optimization, little is understood about their behavior when stochastic gradients admit only a bounded $p$-th central moment for some $p \in (1,2]$, a setting increasingly observed in modern deep learning. To address this gap, we generalize the recent online-to-nonconvex conversion framework to accommodate heavy-tailed martingale-difference noise. Building on this generalized framework, we develop a discounted regret analysis for Adam, without restrictive parameter coupling. Our results show that Adam converges to $(ρ,ε)$-stationary points under heavy-tailed noise. However, it exhibits a suboptimal iteration complexity and $p$-dependent convergence, a suboptimality that persists even in the bounded-variance case ($p=2$). When the domain radius is known and used to control the online-learner output, a standard setup in related literature, the convergence rate improves to match the optimal complexity. These findings provide new theoretical insight into the robustness and limitations of Adam in heavy-tailed regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为plain vector-form Adam优化器在重尾随机噪声下建立了收敛性保证。研究发现Adam在重尾噪声下收敛到(ρ,ε)-平稳点，但迭代复杂度次优且收敛依赖p；当已知域半径并用于控制在线学习器输出时，收敛率可提升至最优复杂度。
AI.motivation: 尽管多种Adam变体在有限方差非凸优化中已被证明能达到最优迭代复杂度，但当随机梯度仅具有有限的p阶中心矩（p∈(1,2]）时（这一设置在深度学习实践中日益常见），人们对Adam的行为知之甚少。现有理论分析大多假设有界方差，无法覆盖重尾噪声场景。
AI.method: 将在线到非凸转化（online-to-nonconvex conversion）框架推广到重尾鞅差分噪声场景。基于推广的框架，开发了一种无需限制性参数耦合的Adam折扣遗憾（discounted regret）分析。
AI.result: Adam在重尾噪声下收敛到(ρ,ε)-平稳点，但表现出次优迭代复杂度和p依赖收敛性，且即使在有界方差（p=2）情形下次优性依然存在。当域半径已知并用于控制在线学习器输出时，收敛率提升至匹配最优复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为Adam在重尾噪声环境下的鲁棒性和局限性提供了新的理论见解，阐明了Adam在重尾场景中的表现及其与最优复杂度的差距来源。

title: Recall Before You Rank: Similarity-Guided Top-$K$ Reuse for Efficient Long-Context Attention
summary: Top-$K$ sparse attention reduces the cost of Softmax and value aggregation by attending to only a small subset of key--value (KV) entries. However, identifying this subset still requires scoring the current query against the full KV cache and performing global Top-$K$ selection, leaving selector cost linear in context length and limiting the practical efficiency of sparse attention for long-context decoding. In this paper, we introduce ReTopK, a training-free method that accelerates dynamic Top-$K$ attention by reusing historical retrieval decisions. ReTopK builds on the observation that similar queries often attend to overlapping supports and that partially overlapping supports can still preserve most of the Exact Top-$K$ attention mass. For each attention head, it maintains a bounded cache of historical query--support pairs, retrieves the most similar cached queries for each new query, unions their stored supports with a recent window, and reranks only the resulting compact candidate set using exact current-query scores. A similarity-based fallback invokes full-history Exact Top-$K$ when reuse is unreliable, while periodic exact refreshes limit cache drift. ReTopK retains the complete KV cache and reuses only selected indices, rather than historical scores, attention weights, or outputs. Across 16K--128K contexts, ReTopK achieves the lowest PG19 perplexity and the highest NIAH and LongBench scores among the evaluated approximate methods. At 128K with $K=512$, ReTopK incurs only a 0.50\% perplexity increase over Exact Top-$K$ while accelerating attention computation by $3.07\times$.

title: Evaluating Agentic Bioinformatics through Function, Evidence, and Validation
summary: Large language model agents increasingly plan, execute, and interpret biological analyses, yet fluent responses, successful tool calls, and benchmark performance alone do not establish scientific credibility. Existing reviews primarily organize biological agents by application, architecture, and agentic capability, but do not jointly operationalize the accountability of agent-generated workflows. We address this gap by treating the inspectable workflow trajectory, rather than architecture or final output alone, as the primary unit of analysis. We introduce the Function--Evidence--Validation (FEV) framework, which separates demonstrated workflow operations, traceable support for actions and claims, and use-case-specific validation. Using FEV, we map 109 agentic or agent-adjacent systems and 28 benchmark or evaluation resources, representing 128 unique publications across genomics, single-cell and spatial omics, protein science, drug discovery, computational pathology, and general bioinformatics automation. Across domains, planning and tool-mediated execution have advanced more rapidly than replayability, provenance, robust scientific assessment, external validation, and prospective empirical testing. We therefore argue that agentic bioinformatics should be assessed through workflow correctness rather than final-answer correctness alone. FEV provides a practical basis for comparing systems and designing transparent, auditable, and scientifically accountable bioinformatics workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Function-Evidence-Validation (FEV)框架，将可检查的工作流轨迹作为分析单元，而非仅关注架构或最终输出，用于评估生物信息学大语言模型代理的科学可信度。作者映射了109个代理系统、28个基准/评估资源（共128篇出版物），发现规划与工具执行进展快于可重放性、溯源、科学评估和外部验证，主张应以工作流正确性而非仅最终答案正确性来评估代理。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型代理评估常依赖流畅响应、成功的工具调用和基准成绩，但这些不足以建立科学可信度。已有综述按应用、架构和代理能力组织生物代理，但未共同操作化代理生成工作流的问责性（accountability）。作者希望解决这一空白。
AI.method: 提出FEV框架，包含三个维度：F（Function，即被展示的工作流操作）、E（Evidence，即对动作和声称的可追溯支持）、V（Validation，即用例特定的验证）。基于FEV对109个代理或代理邻近系统及28个基准/评估资源进行系统性映射，覆盖基因组学、单细胞与空间组学、蛋白质科学、药物发现、计算病理学及通用生物信息学自动化。
AI.result: 跨域分析显示，规划（planning）和工具中介执行（tool-mediated execution）的进展快于可重放性（replayability）、来源追踪（provenance）、稳健科学评估、外部验证和前瞻性经验测试。
AI.conclusion: 生物信息学代理应以工作流正确性而非仅最终答案正确性来评估。FEV框架为比较系统以及设计透明、可审计、科学问责的生物信息学工作流提供了实用基础。

title: Witness Evidence Portfolios: Single-Prefill Risk Detection for Closed Multimodal Answers
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures; includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SouthWinter/WEP
summary: Reliable deployment of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires deciding whether a confident visual answer should be trusted, reviewed, or routed to a stronger system. Confidence scores capture candidate margins, but not where the estimated signed visual readouts associated with those margins come from or how they are distributed. We study inference-time risk detection for closed visual answers using the same white-box prefill path that produces the answer. Witness Evidence Portfolios (WEP) first estimates, layer by layer, which visual contributions support or contradict the predicted candidate. It summarizes these contributions through two interpretable route families: question-related evidence provenance and signed evidence concentration. Nested grouped validation chooses the more reliable family and a sparse top-k route portfolio, which is fused with candidate confidence. WEP needs no image perturbation, decoding change, backward pass, or external verifier. Across three MLLMs and four binary-answer benchmarks, WEP improves mean error AP by 0.134. All 12 model--dataset gains are positive, and image-cluster bootstrap intervals are strictly positive on 10 pairs. WEP targets white-box closed-answer systems and uses a labeled calibration slice.

AI.tldr: WEP是一种推理时风险检测方法，利用MLLM前向预填充路径中分层估计的视觉证据贡献，通过问题相关证据溯源和符号证据集中度两个可解释路由家族来总结这些贡献，再与候选置信度融合以判断封闭式视觉答案的可信度。在3个MLLM和4个二元答案基准上，WEP将平均错误AP提升0.134。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的可靠部署要求在给出自信的视觉答案时判断该答案应被信任、复核还是路由到更强的系统。现有的置信度分数只能捕捉候选答案之间的边际差异，却无法反映这些边际相关的估计符号化视觉读数来自何处以及如何分布，导致风险检测能力受限。
AI.method: WEP首先在逐层基础上估计哪些视觉贡献支持或反驳预测的候选答案，然后通过两个可解释的路由家族（问题相关证据溯源与符号证据集中度）总结这些贡献。采用嵌套分组验证选择更可靠的路由家族和稀疏的top-k路由组合，并将其与候选置信度融合。该方法无需图像扰动、解码改动、反向传播或外部验证器。
AI.result: 在三个MLLM和四个二元答案基准上，WEP将平均错误AP提升0.134。全部12个模型-数据集组合均取得正向增益，其中10对组合的图像聚类bootstrap区间严格为正。
AI.conclusion: WEP为白盒封闭式答案系统提供了一种无需额外计算开销的风险检测方案，可通过选择更可靠的路由家族与稀疏top-k组合来实现更好的信任/复核/路由决策。该方法适用于白盒封闭答案系统，并使用标注校准切片。

title: FunL2O: LLM-Guided Feature Function Design for Learning to Optimize
summary: Learning-to-optimize (L2O) methods accelerate repeated optimization by training models to predict solutions, warm starts, branching decisions, or other forms of solver guidance. A critical yet largely overlooked component of these pipelines is the feature function that maps problem instances to inputs for machine learning models. Existing L2O methods typically rely on hand-crafted features, making representation design manual and largely fixed across domains. We introduce FunL2O, the first unified framework for automating feature design through LLM-driven program evolution for L2O. In a FunSearch-style loop, an LLM proposes executable feature functions, while a fixed evaluation process retrains the original L2O model and measures downstream optimization performance. We evaluate FunL2O on linear and quadratic programming tasks involving solution prediction and warm-starting, as well as on mixed-integer optimization tasks using GNN-guided backdoor branching and Predict-and-Search. Across continuous and discrete optimization tasks and four LLMs, the evolved features consistently outperform hand-crafted representations. These results establish LLM-driven feature evolution as a general and effective approach to automating representation design in L2O.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FunL2O，这是首个通过LLM驱动的程序演化来自动化学习优化（L2O）特征设计的统一框架。在FunSearch风格循环中，LLM生成可执行的候选特征函数，固定评估流程重训原始L2O模型并测量下游优化性能。在连续优化（线性规划、二次规划的求解预测和热启动）和离散优化（混合整数规划的反向门控分支和Predict-and-Search）任务上，演化特征在四种LLM下均一致优于手工特征。
AI.motivation: L2O方法通过在预测解、热启动、分支决策等方面训练模型来加速重复优化，但特征函数（将问题实例映射为ML模型输入）这一关键组件一直被忽视。现有L2O方法依赖手工设计的特征，导致表示设计是手动的且跨领域基本固定，缺乏自动化的特征设计框架。
AI.method: FunL2O采用FunSearch风格循环：LLM作为变异器提出可执行的候选特征函数，固定的评估流程对候选特征重训原始L2O模型并通过下游优化性能进行评估。通过多轮演化迭代，LLM基于评估反馈持续改进特征函数设计。
AI.result: 在LP/QP上的解预测和热启动、MIP上的GNN引导反向门控分支及Predict-and-Search等任务中，使用四种不同LLM时，演化生成的特征均一致优于手工特征表示，验证了该方法的通用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的特征演化被确立为一种通用且有效的L2O表示设计自动化方法，弥补了既有L2O框架中特征工程环节的空白。

title: A Sparse Glimpse of the Whole: Train-Free Self-Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding alleviates the memory-bandwidth bottleneck in large language model inference, but its acceleration is jointly constrained by drafting overhead, token acceptance, and speculation length. We present a unified efficiency analysis showing that extending the speculation horizon can reduce rather than improve speedup when the marginal acceptance probability falls below the relative drafting cost. Guided by this analysis, we introduce SparseSpec-L, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework for long-context inference. SparseSpec-L generates lightweight drafts directly from the target model using a dynamically sparsified and recallable KV cache. It recycles per-head attention statistics produced during full-context verification as a no-extra-forward importance signal, allowing critical historical tokens to be recalled without permanently discarding the dense KV cache. An online entropy-based controller further selects the speculation length according to expected step-wise efficiency. Experiments across multiple long-context tasks and model scales show consistent end-to-end acceleration, with up to speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.

AI.tldr: 提出SparseSpec-L，一种无需训练的自我投机解码框架，通过动态稀疏化且可召回KV缓存、利用注意力统计信号和在线熵控制器的投机长度选择，在长上下文推理中实现最高达显著加速比，同时保持目标模型的输出分布。
AI.motivation: 投机解码虽能缓解大模型推理中的内存带宽瓶颈，但其加速效果受限于草稿开销、token接受率和投机长度三个因素。现有方法未能统一分析这些约束，且长上下文场景下KV缓存开销巨大，需要更高效的自投机解码方案。
AI.method: 首先建立统一效率分析框架，证明当边际接受概率低于相对草稿成本时，延长投机窗口反而会降低加速比。基于该分析提出SparseSpec-L框架：(1) 从目标模型直接生成轻量草稿，利用动态稀疏化且可召回的KV缓存；(2) 回收全上下文验证阶段产生的逐头注意力统计作为重要性信号，实现关键历史token的召回而不永久丢弃稠密KV缓存；(3) 在线基于熵的控制器根据期望逐步效率动态选择投机长度。
AI.result: 在多个长上下文任务和不同模型规模上实现了持续一致的端到端加速，相比自回归解码获得最高达显著加速比，同时保持目标模型的输出分布不变。
AI.conclusion: SparseSpec-L通过理论分析指导的自投机解码设计，在长上下文推理中实现了高效且分布保持的加速，验证了投机长度优化与KV缓存稀疏化策略的有效性。

title: DeepResearch Agent System
summary: The DeepResearch Agent System is a large language model system engineered for deep information retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and autonomous research tasks. Built upon a sparse activation architecture with 30 billion total parameters of which only 3 billion are activated per token, the system achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple agent search benchmarks while delivering 3.2 times faster inference compared to dense counterparts of equivalent scale. The system supports a 128K-token context window with hierarchical attention mechanisms that yield 18.7% accuracy and 23.4% recall improvements over standard long-context approaches. A dual-mode reasoning engine provides both a ReAct paradigm for basic multi-step problem solving and an IterResearch mode for high-performance iterative research with up to 20 reasoning steps, collectively delivering a 31.2% accuracy improvement over single-pass baselines. Multi-tool coordination integrates retrieval, computation, web search, and file parsing modules to achieve 92.1% tool-use accuracy. A reinforcement learning optimization framework based on the GRPO algorithm provides token-level policy gradients that improve training stability by 35% and accelerate convergence by 42%. An automated data synthesis pipeline with seed-based expansion achieves a 92.5% usability rate. Benchmark results include 87.3% on Humanity's Last Exam, 85.3% on BrowserComp Chinese, and 91.2% on WebWalkerQA. The system is fully open-sourced, including data synthesis, training, and inference code, and supports applications in academic research, business analysis, R&D support, and education.

AI.tldr: DeepResearch Agent System是一个基于稀疏激活架构（300亿总参数，30亿激活参数）的大语言模型研究代理系统，支持128K上下文窗口和双模式推理引擎（ReAct与IterResearch），通过多工具协调（检索、计算、网页搜索、文件解析）实现92.1%工具使用准确率，在多项基准测试中表现出色（如Humanity's Last Exam 87.3%），并已完全开源。
AI.motivation: 解决传统密集型大语言模型在深度信息检索、多步推理和自主研究任务中推理速度慢、长上下文处理能力不足、单次推理准确率有限等核心问题，构建一个高效且高性能的自主研究代理系统。
AI.method: 采用稀疏激活架构（MoE）实现高效推理（3.2倍加速）；设计128K上下文窗口的分层注意力机制；构建双模式推理引擎（ReAct基础多步推理与IterResearch迭代研究模式，支持最多20步推理）；集成多工具协调模块；基于GRPO算法的强化学习优化框架；自动化数据合成管线（种子扩展）。
AI.result: 推理速度较同级密集模型快3.2倍；长上下文准确率提升18.7%、召回率提升23.4%；双模式推理相比单次基线准确率提升31.2%；工具使用准确率达92.1%；GRPO训练稳定性提升35%、收敛速度提升42%；数据合成可用率92.5%；基准成绩：Humanity's Last Exam 87.3%、BrowserComp中文85.3%、WebWalkerQA 91.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在推理效率、长上下文处理能力、多步推理性能和工具协调能力上均达到了业界领先水平，且完全开源（涵盖数据合成、训练和推理代码），适用于学术研究、商业分析、研发支持和教育等多个领域。

title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
summary: Jigsaw puzzle solving requires jointly reasoning about visual content and geometric constraints, yet existing benchmarks use rectangular cuts that create ambiguous ground truth in texture-repeated regions. We introduce \textit{\ours{}}, a benchmark with tab-and-blank interlocking pieces where geometric constraints provide strong local compatibility requirements that, combined with visual content, yield unambiguous ground truth. Across 95K instances at four grid densities (4$\times$4 to 16$\times$16), we find that \textbf{zero-shot VLMs largely lack geometric reasoning}: only one of five frontier models (GPT-5.5) exceeds random baseline on 4$\times$4 puzzles, while all others perform at chance level. While supervised fine-tuning achieves $>$97\% on 4$\times$4, \textbf{all models collapse on larger grids}: GPT-5.5 drops from 70\% to near-random on 8$\times$8, and even fine-tuned models fall below 5\% on 12$\times$12. This ``scaling cliff'' suggests current architectures cannot maintain consistent constraint satisfaction as the number of pieces increases. \ours{} establishes scalable geometric reasoning as an open challenge for vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为《ours》的拼图基准，采用榫卯式（tab-and-blank）互锁拼图块，提供局部几何约束与视觉内容结合形成无歧义的标注真值。在95K实例（4×4到16×16四档网格密度）上的实验发现：零样本视觉语言模型（VLM）普遍缺乏几何推理能力，仅GPT-5.5在4×4上超过随机基线；监督微调在4×4上可达97%以上，但所有模型在更大网格上性能崩塌（如8×8降至近随机，12×12低于5%），形成"缩放悬崖"现象，表明当前架构无法在拼图规模增大时维持一致的约束满足能力。
AI.motivation: 现有拼图基准使用矩形切块，在纹理重复区域会产生歧义的标注真值，无法准确评估模型的几何推理能力。作者希望设计一种拼图形式，使几何约束足够强，与视觉内容结合后能够产生无歧义的标注，从而严格评测视觉语言模型的几何推理水平。
AI.method: 该论文通过以下方式构建基准《ours》：1）采用tab-and-blank（榫卯式）互锁拼图块，利用物理形状的局部几何约束提供强兼容性要求；2）构建95K实例，覆盖4×4、8×8、12×12、16×16四档网格密度；3）评估五类前沿零样本VLM（如GPT-5.5）以及监督微调模型在拼图任务上的表现，分析不同拼图规模下的推理能力。
AI.result: 零样本评估中，五类前沿VLM中仅GPT-5.5在4×4拼图上超过随机基线，其余均处于随机水平。监督微调在4×4上达到97%以上，但GPT-5.5在8×8上从70%骤降至近随机，微调模型在12×12上低于5%，所有模型在更大网格上均崩溃，呈现明显的"缩放悬崖"（scaling cliff）现象。
AI.conclusion: 几何推理在视觉语言模型中仍是尚未解决的核心挑战。现有架构（包括大规模前沿模型和微调模型）无法在拼图规模增长时保持一致的约束满足能力，说明可扩展的几何推理应被视为视觉语言模型的一个开放性难题。

title: ECG-InterpBench: Benchmarking the Interpretability of ECG Foundation Models with Matched-Scale Sparse Autoencoders
comment: Research paper. Includes supplementary material and publicly available source code
summary: Existing benchmarks for electrocardiogram foundation models primarily evaluate downstream predictive performance, providing limited insight into whether their internal representations can be faithfully decomposed, clinically interpreted, or reproduced across independent analyses. We introduce ECG-InterpBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the interpretability of ECG foundation-model representations. ECG-InterpBench uses sparse autoencoders as standardized measurement instruments and matches their capacity across models to enable controlled comparisons. We evaluate six frozen ECG foundation models across five standardized encoder depths, five matched dictionary widths, and three random seeds, producing a 450-cell interpretability atlas comprising 75 exactly matched six-model comparison blocks. The benchmark evaluates complementary dimensions of representation interpretability, including sparse reconstruction fidelity, single-feature accessibility and coverage of 49 clinically meaningful ECG measurements, and cross-seed feature reproducibility. The evaluation further quantifies patient-sampling uncertainty, depth- and seed-dependent variation, and sensitivity to the sparsity parameterization. The benchmark reveals that ECG foundation models exhibit distinct interpretability profiles. A matched replication on MIMIC-IV-ECG confirms that reconstruction fidelity and clinical accessibility identify different leading models. The benchmark is accompanied by executable evaluation code, standardized manifests, cell-level metrics, and reproducibility audits. ECG-InterpBench complements performance-centered ECG benchmarks by providing a capacity-controlled and reproducible framework for comparing ECG foundation models across distinct dimensions of representation interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECG-InterpBench，一个系统评估心电图（ECG）基础模型表示可解释性的基准。该基准使用稀疏自编码器作为标准化测量工具，并通过匹配模型容量实现受控比较，评估六个冻结的ECG基础模型在重建保真度、临床特征可及性与覆盖度、跨随机种子特征可复现性等多个维度的表现，最终生成包含450个单元的"可解释性图谱"。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG基础模型基准主要评估下游预测性能，无法揭示模型内部表示是否能被忠实分解、临床解释或在独立分析中复现。这限制了对模型表示质量的理解，亟需一个专门关注可解释性的系统化评估框架。
AI.method: ECG-InterpBench将稀疏自编码器（SAEs）作为标准化的测量仪器，并跨模型匹配其容量（包括五个标准编码器深度、五个匹配字典宽度、三个随机种子），形成75个完全匹配的六模型对比块，共450个评测单元。基准从以下维度进行评估：稀疏重建保真度、49项临床ECG测量的单特征可及性与覆盖率、跨种子特征可复现性，同时量化患者采样不确定性、深度/种子相关变化以及对稀疏参数化的敏感性。
AI.result: 基准揭示了ECG基础模型具有不同的可解释性画像。在MIMIC-IV-ECG上的匹配复制实验证实，重建保真度与临床特征可及性会识别出不同的领先模型，说明单一维度的评估不足以全面反映模型可解释性。
AI.conclusion: ECG-InterpBench补充了以性能为中心的ECG基准，提供了一个容量受控、可复现的框架，用于跨不同表示可解释性维度比较ECG基础模型。该基准附带可执行评估代码、标准化清单、单元级指标和可复现性审计，为ECG基础模型的可解释性研究建立了系统化标准。

title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
summary: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Visual illusions are phenomena in which the human visual system misinterprets objective signals, resulting in an understanding that deviates from reality. We constructed IllusionReasoning, a benchmark of illusion images collected from the real world, incorporating diverse annotated question-answer pairs. Based on IllusionReasoning, we show that the reasoning capabilities of a wide range of LVLMs are not as advanced as claimed. Our work provides new insights into LVLMs and offers future direction for optimisation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用视觉错觉图像作为诊断工具来评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的推理能力，构建了名为IllusionReasoning的基准数据集，发现现有LVLMs的推理能力远未达到其宣称的水平。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM评估要么仅关注感知能力，要么局限于数学或编程等特定领域，缺乏将感知与推理联合考量、且贴合开放世界环境的推理能力评估方法。
AI.method: 利用视觉错觉作为诊断工具，从真实世界收集错觉图像构建IllusionReasoning基准，包含多样化的标注问答对，用于联合评估LVLMs的感知与推理能力。
AI.result: 通过IllusionReasoning基准测试了广泛范围的LVLMs，结果表明这些模型的推理能力并未达到其声称的水准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解LVLMs的推理能力提供了新见解，并为未来模型优化指明了方向。

title: What makes prompts a graph: necessary and sufficient conditions for prompt graph engineering
summary: Prompts stopped being isolated strings some time ago. In real systems, one model call feeds another, retrieval interleaves with generation, routers branch, and aggregators merge parallel results. Practice converged on a single structure to hold this together: the graph. Frameworks such as LangGraph, DSPy, and Prompt Flow expose it openly, and research systems already optimize it automatically. The vocabulary, however, lags behind. Graph names, variously, a reasoning topology inside one sampling strategy, a multi-agent conversation, or an orchestration artifact, while prompt engineering still evokes writing one good string. What is missing is a reference definition treating prompts as nodes of an explicit, executable, improvable graph. We build that definition through conceptual analysis over sources with persistent identifiers, complemented by primary grey literature. We reconstruct the genealogy of the idea, from dataflow graphs and build systems, through prompt chaining and the thought topologies (chain, tree, graph), to graphs compiled and optimized as artifacts. We then propose a constitutive definition of prompt graph engineering, state its four conditions (explicit structure, separation between structure and prompt content, executable semantics, and the graph as a first-class engineering artifact), and operationalize them as an inclusion and exclusion test. We draw the boundary against six neighboring concepts and apply the test to six real systems (LangGraph, DSPy, Prompt Flow, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Claude Code subagents); it includes and excludes consistently. We close with a research agenda organized along four design tension axes. The contribution is an operational definition and a shared vocabulary for a practice that industry already exercises daily without naming precisely.

AI.tldr: 本文通过概念分析提出了"提示词图工程"（Prompt Graph Engineering）的操作性定义，将提示词重新定义为显式、可执行、可改进的有向无环图中的节点，并给出四项构成条件及包含/排除测试，为业界已有但未命名的实践提供了共享词汇。
AI.motivation: 现实中提示词已不再是孤立的字符串——一个模型调用喂给另一个、检索与生成交织、路由分支、聚合器合并并行结果——业界已收敛到"图"这一结构（如LangGraph、DSPy、Prompt Flow）。然而词汇严重滞后："graph"被用来指称推理拓扑、多智能体对话或编排工件等不同概念，而"prompt engineering"仍被视为写一个好的字符串。缺乏一个能将提示词视为显式、可执行、可改进图节点的参照性定义，导致理论与实践之间的词汇鸿沟。
AI.method: 作者通过概念分析（conceptual analysis）展开研究，依据具有持久标识符的来源并结合主要灰色文献。具体步骤包括：(1)重构该概念的谱系——从数据流图和构建系统，经由提示词链（prompt chaining）和思维拓扑（链、树、图），到被编译并优化为工件的图；(2)提出"提示词图工程"的构成性定义，陈述四项条件：显式结构、结构与其提示词内容的分离、可执行语义、图作为一等工程工件；(3)将四项条件操作化为包含/排除测试；(4)对六个相邻概念划清边界，并在六个真实系统（LangGraph、DSPy、Prompt Flow、AutoGen、CrewAI、Claude Code subagents）上应用该测试验证其一致性；(5)沿四个设计张力轴组织研究议程。
AI.result: 研究者成功提出了"提示词图工程"的操作性定义，包含四项构成条件并被操作化为可执行的包含/排除测试。该测试在六个真实系统上应用结果一致，能稳定地进行包含和排除判断，同时与六个相邻概念划清了清晰的边界。作者还围绕四个设计张力轴提出了研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献在于为业界日常实践（图编排的提示词系统）提供了一个操作性定义和共享词汇，弥合了行业实践与学术术语之间的差距。提示词图工程这一概念将提示词从单一字符串重新定位为显式、可执行、可改进的图结构中的节点，为该领域的系统研究奠定了概念基础。

title: RefineSVG: Visual Feedback-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Image-to-SVG Generation
comment: 17 pages, 5 main-paper figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). Includes the complete supplementary material
summary: We propose RefineSVG, a single-step closed-loop visual feedback framework that enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform high-fidelity image-to-SVG generation through self-correction. Existing MLLM-based approaches rely on single-pass open-loop inference, where the model receives visual input only once and must generate thousands of SVG code tokens without intermediate verification. This paradigm inevitably leads to geometric drift, error accumulation, and visual hallucination on complex images. RefineSVG overcomes this limitation by invoking an external rendering engine after an initial SVG generation pass to compare the rendered output against the target image. The comparison yields a multi-dimensional visual residual map (Diff-Map) that is fed back to the model as a ReAct-style correction signal, driving a targeted correction step. To support this render-observe-correct interaction, we further introduce an SVG-oriented semantic vocabulary that compresses token sequences by over 52%. A progressive training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampling cold-start data construction, and end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning aligns the model with closed-loop visual correction. Extensive experiments show that RefineSVG consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity, structural accuracy, and code efficiency.Code is available at https://github.com/liuxiaobo66/RefineSVG.

AI.tldr: RefineSVG是一个单步闭环视觉反馈框架，通过自纠错机制让多模态大语言模型（MLLM）实现高保真图像到SVG的生成。它引入外部渲染引擎对比渲染输出与目标图像，生成多维视觉残差图（Diff-Map）作为ReAct式纠错信号驱动针对性修正，并配合SVG语义词汇压缩（超过52%）和渐进式训练流程，在重建保真度、结构准确性和代码效率上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM-based图像到SVG生成方法采用单次开放循环推理，模型仅接收一次视觉输入就需要生成数千个SVG代码token，缺乏中间验证环节，导致复杂图像上出现几何漂移、误差累积和视觉幻觉等问题。
AI.method: RefineSVG采用"渲染-观察-修正"闭环交互：初始SVG生成后调用外部渲染引擎对比输出与目标图像，生成多维视觉残差图（Diff-Map）作为ReAct式纠错信号反馈给模型进行针对性修正。同时引入面向SVG的语义词汇表（压缩token序列超52%），并设计包含监督微调、拒绝采样冷启动数据构建和端到端智能体强化学习的渐进式训练流水线。
AI.result: 大量实验表明RefineSVG在重建保真度、结构准确性和代码效率方面持续优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过闭环视觉反馈和自纠错机制，可以有效解决开放循环推理中误差累积和视觉幻觉问题，实现更高质量的图像到SVG生成，且代码已开源。

title: Context-Informed Ship Trajectory Prediction via Conditional Attention
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 29th International Conference on Information Fusion (IEEE FUSION)
summary:
Long-term ship trajectory prediction is a fundamental capability for maritime safety and autonomous navigation. While recent Transformer-based architectures have improved forecasting horizons, they predominantly rely on historical kinematic states, treating vessel motion as an isolated system. In reality, maritime navigation is profoundly modulated by extrinsic factors like weather and constrained by static vessel characteristics. Existing multimodal approaches fundamentally model the joint distribution over states and contexts, treating environmental variables as peer features rather than encoding the directional physical dependence of vessel dynamics on environmental conditions.
  In this work, we propose the Conditional Informer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture that formulates trajectory prediction as a conditional generation task. We employ a dedicated Conditional Attention mechanism where the vessel state explicitly queries environmental contexts through cross-attention, encoding the physical prior that weather modulates - but is not generated by - vessel dynamics. Furthermore, to address the intermittency of real-world data, we introduce a Modality Masking training strategy to prevent catastrophic degradation during sensor fallback. Extensive experiments on AIS and ERA5 data demonstrate that our approach outperforms kinematic and concatenation-based baselines by 15.4% in prediction accuracy when context is available. Crucially, Modality Masking prevents shortcut learning, reducing fallback error by nearly an order of magnitude compared to unconstrained models.

AI.tldr: 提出Conditional Informer，一种将船舶轨迹预测建模为条件生成任务的编解码器架构，通过Conditional Attention机制显式编码天气调制船舶动态的物理先验，并引入Modality Masking训练策略应对传感器数据缺失问题，在AIS和ERA5数据上相较基线提升15.4%预测精度，并将传感器回退错误降低近一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构的船舶轨迹预测主要依赖历史运动状态，将船舶运动视为孤立系统；多模态方法将环境变量作为对等特征进行联合分布建模，未能编码船舶动态对环境条件的定向物理依赖关系（即天气调制但不由船舶生成）。
AI.method: 提出Conditional Informer架构：1）采用条件生成框架将轨迹预测形式化为条件生成任务；2）设计专用Conditional Attention机制，使船舶状态显式通过交叉注意力查询环境上下文，编码天气调制船舶动态的物理先验；3）提出Modality Masking训练策略，在训练中随机遮蔽模态输入以模拟传感器回退场景，防止退化。
AI.result: 在AIS和ERA5数据上的大量实验表明：当上下文可用时，该方法在预测精度上超过基于运动学和拼接方法的基线15.4%；Modality Masking防止了捷径学习，将回退错误相对未约束模型降低了近一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将环境条件作为对船舶动态的因果性（而非对等性）约束融入Transformer架构是提升长期轨迹预测的关键；Modality Masking有效增强了模型在真实世界传感器数据不连续场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
summary: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects complementary encoder layers, constructs an output-derived conditioning space from candidate memory, and aligns candidate input representations to this space through closed-form ridge regression. Low-rank factorization then produces a compact retrieval basis where candidate outputs are used only during offline index construction, whereas query-time retrieval requires only the query input and precomputed index. We show that CoRA's rank-constrained basis is the optimal low-rank compression of the output-conditioned fitted representation, and derive an exact two-pass streaming construction that avoids materializing the full fitted matrix. We further extend the framework to multimodal exemplar retrieval by incorporating visual representations into the conditioning and retrieval spaces. Experiments across ten textual datasets and four multimodal benchmarks with Llama-3.2-1B, MobileLLM-Pro, OpenFlamingo-3B, and Qwen3.5-2B, as well as end-to-end Raspberry Pi~5 deployment demonstrate that CoRA supports effective task-conditioned retrieval without retriever fine-tuning, backpropagation, or target-model calls.

AI.tldr: CoRA是一个梯度无关的框架，将冻结的编码器转化为任务条件化的检索器，通过闭式岭回归和低秩分解构建紧凑的检索基，用于端侧设备上的上下文学习示例检索，无需微调、反向传播或目标模型调用。
AI.motivation: 端侧设备上的上下文学习要求在进行下游模型推理之前进行检索以选择演示示例，这种检索需要在有限的计算、内存和数据暴露预算下利用任务特定信息，而现有方法难以同时满足这些约束。
AI.method: CoRA通过以下步骤实现：选取互补的编码器层，构建由候选输出导出的条件化空间，通过闭式岭回归将候选输入表示对齐到该空间，然后利用低秩因子分解产生紧凑的检索基。该方法还推导了精确的两遍流式构造方法以避免物化完整拟合矩阵，并扩展到多模态示例检索。
AI.result: 在十个文本数据集和四个多模态基准上，使用Llama-3.2-1B、MobileLLM-Pro、OpenFlamingo-3B和Qwen3.5-2B进行实验，并在Raspberry Pi 5上进行端到端部署，证明CoRA能够在不进行检索器微调、反向传播或目标模型调用的条件下实现有效的任务条件化检索。
AI.conclusion: CoRA为端侧上下文学习提供了一种高效且有效的任务条件化检索方案，证明了通过闭式解和低秩压缩即可在严格资源约束下实现高质量的示例选择。

title: From Minds to Models: The Intersection of Psychology and LLM Behaviours
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are often compared with the human mind because their decision-making is complex, non-linear and difficult to interpret. Psychological methods developed to investigate unobservable mental processes may therefore help examine LLM behaviour, particularly in government and healthcare. Building on prompt-based adaptations of the Implicit Association Test, this study tested whether ChatGPT produced sentiment differences across racial conditions in open-ended text. Fourteen base questions were crossed with eight racial categories and a race-agnostic control, producing 126 prompts. Each was submitted once to GPT-3.5T, GPT-4 and GPT-4T, yielding 378 responses. Sentiment scores were derived from categorical labels and source scores: positive labels retained the source score, negative labels were assigned its negative, and neutral responses were coded zero. A two-way ANOVA found a small main effect of racial condition, F(8, 351) = 2.04, p = .042, partial-eta squared = .044, but no effect of model, F(2, 351) = 0.07, p = .933, and no interaction, F(16, 351) = 0.23, p = .999. However, the effect was not retained in a rank-transformed sensitivity analysis, F(8, 351) = 1.53, p = .145, and Tukey-corrected comparisons found no significant pairwise differences. An uncorrected European-Indigenous Australian comparison was significant, but was selected post hoc and is reported only as hypothesis-generating. Evidence for sentiment differences was therefore weak and analysis-dependent. Sentiment scoring also cannot distinguish evaluative bias from the valence of historical content elicited by a prompt. We outline design changes needed to address these limitations and argue for interdisciplinary development of behavioural measures of model bias.
  Keywords: Implicit Bias, Psychological Research Methods, Artificial Intelligence, ChatGPT, Large Language Models, Sentiment Analysis

AI.tldr: 本研究基于内隐联想测验的提示词改编版，测试了ChatGPT在开放文本中是否产生跨种族条件的情感差异。14个基础问题×8个种族类别×1个无种族对照组，共126个提示词，分别提交给GPT-3.5T、GPT-4和GPT-4T，得到378条回应。双因素方差分析发现种族条件的主效应较小（F(8,351)=2.04, p=.042, partial-eta squared=.044），但该效应在进行秩变换敏感性分析后不再显著（F(8,351)=1.53, p=.145），且Tukey校正后的两两比较无显著差异。因此，情感差异的证据较弱且依赖分析方法。
AI.motivation: LLM的决策过程复杂、非线性且难以解释，类似于人类心理过程。研究者希望借助心理学中用于研究不可观测心理过程的方法（如内隐联想测验），来检查LLM行为中的潜在偏见，特别是在政府和医疗保健等高风险应用场景中。
AI.method: 将14个基础问题与8个种族类别及1个无种族对照组交叉，生成126个提示词，每个提示词分别提交给GPT-3.5T、GPT-4和GPT-4T（共378条回应）。情感评分从分类标签和来源分数推导：正面标签保留来源分数，负面标签赋予其负值，中性响应编码为零。采用双因素方差分析进行统计检验，并进行秩变换敏感性分析和Tukey校正的多重比较。
AI.result: 双因素方差分析显示种族条件有较小主效应（F(8,351)=2.04, p=.042, partial-eta squared=.044），但模型类型无效应（F(2,351)=0.07, p=.933），也无交互作用。然而，秩变换敏感性分析中效应不再显著（F(8,351)=1.53, p=.145），Tukey校正后无显著两两差异。仅有一个未校正的欧洲-澳大利亚原住民比较显著，但这是事后选取的，仅作为假设生成报告。
AI.conclusion: ChatGPT跨种族条件产生情感差异的证据较弱且依赖分析方法。此外，情感评分无法区分评价性偏见与提示词引发历史内容的情感效价。研究提出需进行设计更改以解决这些局限，并主张跨学科发展模型偏见的行为测量方法。

title: Calibrate Before Reason: Robust Visual Token Reduction against Semantic Drift in VLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from prohibitive inference overhead due to long sequences of visual tokens. However, existing visual token reduction methods mainly improve efficiency by pruning or compressing redundant tokens without examining whether the resulting representation remains semantically consistent with the original representation. Mapping the original N-token visual sequence to K tokens may discard, dilute, or misassign critical visual cues, triggering severe semantic drift that deviates the VLM's understanding. In this paper, we first introduce the principle of 'Calibrate Before Reason' to visual token reduction and propose CaRe, a training-free robust framework that calibrates compact visual representations before reasoning to preserve semantic fidelity in VLMs. CaRe consists of two mutually complementary modules: 1) Perturbation-Robust Calibration Anchoring, which identifies calibration anchors with stable model-side influence under multi-directional perturbations; 2) Confidence-Gated Token Calibration, which extracts reliable calibration signals from unselected tokens and injects them into anchors. Extensive evaluations across diverse VLM architectures and benchmarks verify that CaRe outperforms state-of-the-art token reduction baselines. While pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, our method retains 96.4% of the original full-token performance, delivering up to 2.30 times faster end-to-end inference speed relative to unpruned vanilla models.

AI.tldr: CaRe是一个无需训练的训练免费框架，通过"先校准再推理"原则，在推理前对紧凑视觉表征进行校准，以保持视觉语言模型（VLMs）的语义保真度。在剪除94.4%视觉token时仍保留原始全token性能的96.4%，端到端推理速度提升高达2.30倍。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型因视觉token序列过长而产生高昂的推理开销。现有视觉token缩减方法主要聚焦于剪枝或压缩冗余token的效率提升，但未检验缩减后的表征是否与原表征保持语义一致。从N个token映射到K个token可能丢弃、稀释或错误分配关键视觉线索，触发严重的语义漂移，偏离VLM的理解。
AI.method: CaRe由两个互补模块组成：1) 扰动鲁棒校准锚定（Perturbation-Robust Calibration Anchoring），在多方向扰动下识别具有稳定模型侧影响的校准锚点；2) 置信度门控token校准（Confidence-Gated Token Calibration），从未被选中的token中提取可靠的校准信号并注入锚点中。
AI.result: 在多种VLM架构和基准上的广泛评估表明，CaRe优于最先进的token缩减基线。在剪除94.4%视觉token的情况下，保留了原始全token性能的96.4%，相对于未剪枝的原始模型，端到端推理速度提升达2.30倍。
AI.conclusion: CaRe通过将"先校准再推理"原则引入视觉token缩减，在不牺牲语义保真度的前提下实现了大幅度的token压缩和推理加速，证明了训练免费的校准机制可以有效缓解token缩减带来的语义漂移问题。

title: Good Rankers, Bad Objectives: Bilinear Contrastive Critics under Expressive Policy Search
summary: Good action rankings do not make a contrastive critic safe to maximize. These critics increasingly act as value-like objectives for best-of-$K$ selection, planning, and critic-guided generation. Unbounded bilinear scores can let large embedding norms inflate off-support values, but cosine bounding does not remove the failure. A controlled support decomposition attributes most raw bilinear regret to norm drift. Cosine and hybrid critics nevertheless select off-support actions from most pools and incur comparable regret. Contrastive scores are weakly calibrated or inverted in the top score decile across four OGBench navigation tasks, and they fail to order fixed-query actions by value. Bellman-trained TD-Q succeeds, including in a parameter-matched function-class control. Realized costs depend on the task: simulator rollouts reveal single-step selection costs on PointMaze and the exact-$Q^*$ toy but well-powered nulls on AntMaze and HumanoidMaze, where the controller can self-correct. A training/readout decomposition traces the lost ordering to the cosine training objective; raw-trained embeddings retain weak ordering after inference-time normalization. Candidate maximization can therefore exploit false positives caused by norm drift, score saturation, or in-support misranking. Contrastive critics remain useful compatibility rankers on navigation and manipulation tasks, but action selection requires a value-calibrated scalar.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，好的动作排名并不意味着对比性评论家（contrastive critic）可以安全地用于最大化。尽管对比性评论家广泛用于best-of-K选择、规划和评论家引导生成，但其分数在离支撑集（off-support）动作上会产生虚假高值。通过受控的支撑分解实验，作者将大部分原始双线性遗憾归因于范数漂移（norm drift），余弦约束和混合评论家均无法消除这一问题。对比分数在四个OGBench导航任务的最高分十分位区间内校准弱甚至反向，无法按值对固定查询动作排序。相比之下，贝尔曼训练的TD-Q成功实现值校准。训练/读取分解进一步表明，排序能力丢失源于余弦训练目标，原始训练的嵌入在推断时归一化后仍保留弱排序。因此候选最大化可能利用范数漂移、分数饱和或支撑内误排序导致的假阳性。对比评论家在导航和操作任务上仍是有效的兼容性排序器，但动作选择需要值校准的标量。
AI.motivation: 对比评论家（contrastive critic）已被广泛用作类价值目标用于best-of-K选择、规划和评论家引导生成，但其分数被最大化时是否安全尚未被充分检验。研究者希望揭示对比分数在支撑集外动作上可能产生虚假高值的问题，并厘清其与真正值函数（Q函数）在动作选择能力上的本质差异。
AI.method: 通过受控支撑分解（controlled support decomposition）将原始双线性遗憾分解为范数漂移等成分；在四个OGBench导航任务上对对比评论家、余弦评论家、混合评论家与贝尔曼训练的TD-Q进行对比评估；使用best-of-K候选选择测试各评论家对固定查询动作的值排序能力；通过训练/读取分解（training/readout decomposition）分离训练目标与读取机制的影响；在PointMaze、AntMaze、HumanoidMaze等模拟器中执行单步选择来量化实际成本。
AI.result: 原始双线性遗憾主要由范数漂移造成，但余弦约束和混合评论家仍会从大多数池中选择离支撑动作且遗憾相当。对比分数在OGBench四个任务的最优十分位内校准弱或反向，无法按值排序动作；Bellman训练的TD-Q在参数匹配的函数类控制实验中成功。模拟器回放显示，PointMaze和精确Q*玩具上存在单步选择成本，而AntMaze和HumanoidMaze上由于控制器可自校正呈现有力的零结果。训练/读取分解将排序能力丢失归因于余弦训练目标。
AI.conclusion: 对比评论家尽管在导航和操作任务上是有效的兼容性排序器，但其分数不能用作可最大化的价值目标。候选最大化会因范数漂移、分数饱和或支撑内误排序产生的假阳性而失效。动作选择需要值校准的标量（如TD-Q）而非对比分数。

title: ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support multi-session interaction and personalization. However, existing agent memory systems are designed around forward-only evolution, continuously accumulating, consolidating, and overwriting knowledge, with no principled mechanism to inspect, version, or revert prior states. This makes agents brittle under corrections, concept drift, and memory corruption, particularly after they have already been exposed to subsequent information. We present ChronoMem, a semantic version-control layer for agentic memory integrated into the production-ready, open-source Agent Development Kit by Google. ChronoMem commits whole-memory snapshots at each memory write, maintains structured version histories, and supports natural-language rollback requests by mapping undo intents to concrete historical versions through hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, rank fusion, and reranking. We further introduce a post-exposure evaluation protocol that tests whether an agent can behave counterfactually after rollback by answering queries and summarizing history as if future updates had never occurred. On long-horizon conversational benchmarks augmented with evolving memory states and rollback tasks, ChronoMem substantially improves rollback-consistent question answering and history summarization relative to prompt-only and retrieval-only baselines, while achieving strong performance in semantic version selection. To our knowledge, ChronoMem is the first open-source system and benchmark for systematic semantic global memory rollback in LLM agents.

AI.tldr: ChronoMem是首个面向LLM智能体的语义版本控制层，为智能体记忆提供快照提交、版本历史管理和自然语言回滚能力，支持后曝光评估协议，在长时对话基准上显著优于提示式和检索式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统仅支持前向演化（持续积累、整合和覆盖知识），缺乏检查、版本化和回滚先前状态的原则性机制，导致智能体在纠正、概念漂移和记忆损坏场景下表现脆弱，尤其是接触后续信息后无法恢复到先前状态。
AI.method: ChronoMem作为Google开源的Agent Development Kit中的语义版本控制层，每次记忆写入时提交全量记忆快照，维护结构化版本历史，并通过混合词法+语义检索、排序融合和重排序将自然语言回滚意图映射到具体的历史版本。同时提出后曝光评估协议，测试智能体在回滚后能否像未来更新从未发生一样进行反事实行为（问答和历史摘要）。
AI.result: 在带有演化记忆状态和回滚任务的长时对话基准上，ChronoMem在回滚一致性问答和历史摘要任务上大幅优于提示式和仅检索式基线，并在语义版本选择上表现出强性能。
AI.conclusion: ChronoMem是首个针对LLM智能体的系统性语义全局记忆回滚的开源系统和基准，填补了智能体记忆管理中版本控制与回滚能力的空白。

title: Wiring diagram extraction and gluing: a case study in classifying figure skating jumps using 3D dataset
summary: Hasse clustering is an algorithm that extracts common patterns in sequential data and represents them in graphical forms. As the number of expected clusters grows, however, the algorithm can become infeasible to run due to combinatorial complexity. In this article, we describe a theory of gluing wiring diagrams, allowing iterative applications of Hasse clustering to achieve the same result as a single application. We test our theory in the context of classifying videos of figure skating jumps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"粘合接线图"（gluing wiring diagrams）的理论，使得Hasse聚类算法可以通过迭代应用来代替单次应用，从而克服算法在聚类数量增长时面临的组合爆炸导致的不可行性问题，并在花样滑冰跳跃视频分类任务中验证了该理论。
AI.motivation: Hasse聚类算法能够从序列数据中提取共同模式并以图形形式表示，但当预期聚类数量增加时，算法的组合复杂度会导致其无法运行。
AI.method: 提出一种"粘合接线图"的理论，通过迭代应用Hasse聚类来替代单次应用，从而规避组合复杂性。
AI.result: 该方法在花样滑冰跳跃视频分类任务中进行了实证测试。
AI.conclusion: 粘合接线图理论使得Hasse聚类可以通过迭代方式高效实现，在处理大规模聚类问题上具有可行性，并在视频分类任务中得到了验证。

title: PrintAnything: Learning an Intermediate Representation for 3D printing G-code Generation
summary: Point clouds are one of the most fundamental and widely used 3D representations, serving as the most basic geometric representation of 3D shapes. Nevertheless, most existing 3D printing pipelines require a watertight mesh as input, preventing the direct use of point clouds for fabrication. A common workaround is to reconstruct meshes from point clouds; however, the resulting meshes often contain geometric artifacts, such as incorrect faces or topological inconsistencies, that are difficult to repair and may lead to printing failures. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrintAnything, a novel framework that learns to produce executable 3D printing G-code directly from 3D point clouds without requiring mesh reconstruction. To enable point clouds to serve as direct input for slice-wise toolpath generation, we introduce a slice-wise point projection strategy that transforms unstructured 3D point clouds into slice-aligned 2D representations consistent with layer-by-layer nature of fused deposition modeling in 3D printing. To eliminate mesh dependency and provide a unified representation that bridges point clouds and G-code, we propose Geometric plan (G-plan) map, a compact 2D representation composed of occupancy, region, and flow maps that encode the geometric and extrusion properties required for toolpath synthesis in 3D printing. As a result, our proposed method accurately generates printable G-code directly from point clouds, enabling a practical and fully mesh-free pipeline for 3D printing. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything}{https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything}.

AI.tldr: PrintAnything是一个直接从3D点云生成可执行3D打印G-code的新型框架，无需网格重建。它通过切片式点投影策略将非结构化点云转换为切片对齐的2D表示，并引入几何计划图（G-plan map）作为统一表示来桥接点云与G-code，实现完全无网格的3D打印流程。
AI.motivation: 现有3D打印流程通常要求水密网格作为输入，而点云作为最基础的3D几何表示却无法直接用于制造。从点云重建网格往往产生几何伪影（不正确的面和拓扑不一致），难以修复且可能导致打印失败。因此需要一个能直接从点云生成可打印G-code的无网格框架。
AI.method: 该方法包含两大核心创新：(1) 切片式点投影策略（slice-wise point projection），将非结构化3D点云转换为与熔融沉积建模（FDM）逐层打印特性一致的切片对齐2D表示；(2) 几何计划图（G-plan map），一个由占用图、区域图和流量图组成的紧凑2D表示，编码了工具路径合成所需的几何和挤出属性，从而统一点云与G-code之间的表示。
AI.result: 所提出的方法能够从点云准确生成可打印的G-code，实现了一个实用且完全无网格的3D打印流程。代码已公开在GitHub上。
AI.conclusion: PrintAnything消除了3D打印对网格重建的依赖，通过新颖的表示方法让点云直接作为打印输入成为可能，为无网格化3D打印提供了可行的新路径。

title: SE(3)-MeanFlow: Few-Step Protein Backbone Generation on Lie Groups
summary: Generative modeling of protein backbones promises the de novo design of proteins with prescribed structural and functional properties. Existing diffusion and flow-matching models produce high-quality backbones on SE(3)^N, but inference requires numerically integrating an ODE over hundreds of network evaluations, each involving a Lie group exponential map - a bottleneck for high-throughput design campaigns. We introduce SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that extends MeanFlow from Euclidean space to the Lie group geometry of protein frames. Working natively in the Lie algebra so(3) and in R^3, we derive closed-form average-velocity identities for rotations and translations, giving simulation-free training targets. We further introduce an SE(3) alpha-Flow objective that removes the Jacobian-vector product from the rotation branch and serves as a warm-up stage, after which training switches to a small-t stabilized MeanFlow loss that is used for the remainder of pretraining and for rectification-based post-training. In protein backbone generation, SE(3)-MeanFlow matches or exceeds flow-matching baselines that use several times more sampling steps, and its advantage widens in the few-step regime, where rectification lets it lead at every matched budget - at a modest cost in diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SE(3)-MeanFlow，一种在蛋白质骨架的SE(3)李群几何上进行少步生成的生成框架，通过将MeanFlow从欧氏空间扩展到李代数so(3)和R^3，推导出旋转和平移的闭式平均速度恒等式，实现无模拟训练。结合SE(3) alpha-Flow作为预热阶段，再切换至小t稳定的MeanFlow损失进行预训练和整流后训练，在蛋白质主链生成中匹配或超越使用更多采样步数的流匹配基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散和流匹配的蛋白质主链生成模型虽然能在SE(3)^N上生成高质量骨架，但推理时需要对ODE进行数值积分，涉及数百次网络评估，每次都需要李群指数映射计算，成为高通量设计流程的瓶颈。因此亟需一种少步生成框架来加速推理。
AI.method: 将MeanFlow从欧氏空间扩展到蛋白质帧的SE(3)李群几何上，在so(3)李代数和R^3中推导旋转与平移的闭式平均速度恒等式，获得无模拟训练目标。同时引入SE(3) alpha-Flow目标，消除旋转分支中的Jacobian-vector积，作为预热阶段；之后切换至小t稳定的MeanFlow损失用于预训练和基于整流（rectification）的后训练。
AI.result: 在蛋白质主链生成任务中，SE(3)-MeanFlow匹配或超越了使用数倍采样步数的流匹配基线；在少步生成场景中优势更为明显，整流使得其在每个匹配的采样预算下均领先，代价是多样性略有下降。
AI.conclusion: SE(3)-MeanFlow证明了将MeanFlow框架扩展到非欧氏李群几何的可行性，显著减少蛋白质主链生成所需的采样步数，为高通量蛋白质设计提供了高效的生成方案。

title: Reasoning Consensus: Structural Ensembling of LLM Reasoning via Weighted DAG Aggregation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) explore problems through chain-of-thought, but this exploration is buried in unstructured prose. On high-stakes tasks, users cannot tell which steps are well-supported, which alternatives were seriously considered, or how the final conclusion compares to those the model discarded. We propose a framework that ensembles the reasoning structure, not just the answers, of multiple LLMs by weighted merging of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) extracted from reasoning chains. We weight each step by how many traces independently attest to it, to return "Consensus Reasoning". Across six benchmarks spanning statutory interpretation, graduate-level science, narrative multi-hop reasoning, and first-order logic, our ensemble outperforms a matched-budget majority-vote baseline, with a maximum accuracy gain of 3.1% on MuSR-MM (narrative multi-hop reasoning). On a single model, the framework matches or exceeds self-consistency at the same trace budget while additionally exposing an inspectable consensus reasoning graph. Ensemble weights correlate with LLM-judge rankings of reasoning quality at Spearman $ρ= 0.30$-$0.51$, and consensus subgraphs are preferred over alternatives leading to the majority-vote answer in 54.4-65.4% of head-to-head comparisons across five of six datasets. We observe that our framework can also be used to analyze diverse reasoning perspectives for a problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过加权合并多个LLM推理链中提取的有向无环图（DAG）来集成推理结构的框架，而非仅集成答案。通过按多个轨迹独立验证的次数对每个推理步骤加权，返回"共识推理"（Consensus Reasoning）。在六个基准上优于匹配预算的多数投票基线，最大准确率提升3.1%，同时提供可检查的共识推理图，并可用于分析多样化的推理视角。
AI.motivation: LLM通过链式思维探索问题，但这种探索被埋藏在非结构化文本中。在高风险任务中，用户无法判断哪些步骤有充分依据、哪些备选方案被认真考虑过，以及最终结论与模型放弃的结论相比如何。现有方法仅集成答案，缺乏对推理结构本身的可解释性和鲁棒性建模。
AI.method: 从多个LLM的推理链中提取DAG表示推理结构，根据每个步骤被多少条轨迹独立验证的次数进行加权，通过加权合并DAG来集成多个LLM的推理结构，生成"共识推理"图。
AI.result: 在六个基准（法定解释、研究生级科学、叙事多跳推理、一阶逻辑）上优于匹配预算的多数投票基线，MuSR-MM上最大准确率提升3.1%。在单模型上匹配或超过相同轨迹预算的自洽性（self-consistency），同时暴露可检查的共识推理图。集成权重与LLM评判的推理质量排名相关性为Spearman ρ=0.30-0.51。在六个数据集的五个中，共识子图在54.4-65.4%的头对头比较中优于导致多数投票答案的备选方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅能提升推理质量，还能提供可解释的共识推理图以增强可检查性，同时可用作分析问题多样化推理视角的工具。

title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
summary: Building generalizable agents for diverse applications remains a fundamental challenge. While imitation learning-based policies succeed in specific training environments, they often fail to generalize to novel scenes and tasks. In this work, we propose World Action Planner, a robot planning system that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and the physical grounding of a multi-task pose-image conditioned world model. Our system enables an agent to propose initial action plans and iteratively refine them via optimization and search, reasoning over imagined world model rollouts. We demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance across compositional tasks, new layouts, and zero-shot generalization scenarios, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art end-to-end policy models such as VLAs and WAMs. Project website at worldactionplanner.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出World Action Planner，一种结合视觉语言模型推理能力与多任务姿态-图像条件世界模型物理约束的机器人规划系统。系统通过VLM提出初始动作计划，并基于世界模型想象推演进行迭代优化与搜索，在组合任务、新布局和零样本泛化场景中显著优于VLA和WAM等端到端策略模型。
AI.motivation: 构建通用智能体仍是基础性挑战。基于模仿学习的策略虽然能在特定训练环境中表现良好，但难以泛化到新场景和新任务，需要一种能够结合高层推理与物理常识的规划系统。
AI.method: 提出World Action Planner系统，核心包括两部分：(1) 利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力生成初始动作计划；(2) 通过多任务姿态-图像条件世界模型提供物理接地，对想象的世界模型推演进行优化和搜索，迭代细化动作计划。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在组合任务、新布局和零样本泛化等场景中均取得更优性能，显著超越VLA和WAM等最先进的端到端策略模型。
AI.conclusion: VLM的高层推理能力与世界模型的物理接地相结合，能够有效提升机器人规划的泛化能力，为构建通用智能体提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
summary: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. Yet existing methods for articulated object reconstruction require explicitly observable motion from multiple articulation states. We introduce a rest-state formulation that reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration, an inherently ill-posed setting where geometry, semantics, and motion priors compensate for the absence of motion cues. Our framework adopts an explicit mesh as an intermediate representation for cross-model verification and fusion, reconciling noisy outputs from vision-language and segmentation models into spatially consistent part structures. To estimate joint parameters without observed motion, we use a video diffusion model to synthesize articulation hypotheses and validate them through geometric consistency. Our approach achieves accurate part decomposition and physically plausible articulation, performing competitively with motion-observing reconstruction-based, generation-based, and modular pretrained-model baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从单一闭合构型重建铰接物体的方法，利用静息态公式化、显式网格中间表示和视频扩散模型，在无显式运动观测的情况下实现几何与运动学结构的联合重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的铰接物体重建方法依赖多个运动状态下的显式运动观测，难以应用于只有单一闭合构型的场景。该问题本质上是病态的，需要利用几何、语义和运动先验来弥补运动信息的缺失。
AI.method: 引入静息态公式化，将重建问题从多状态观测转化为单构型推断。采用显式网格作为跨模型验证与融合的中间表示，整合视觉-语言模型和分割模型的噪声输出，生成空间一致的部件结构。在没有观测运动的情况下，利用视频扩散模型合成铰接假设，并通过几何一致性进行验证以估计关节参数。
AI.result: 方法在部件分解精度和物理合理性方面均表现良好，与基于运动观测的重建方法、基于生成的方法以及模块化预训练模型基线相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在仅有一个闭合构型的病态条件下，通过静息态公式化结合视觉-语言先验和扩散模型合成的运动假设，可以实现准确的部件分解和物理上合理的铰接参数估计。

title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Channel Modeling in Low-SNR Regimes
summary: Accurate multipath parameter estimation is critical for modern wireless communication systems, particularly in challenging low-SNR environments. Traditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation algorithms, such as CLEAN, provide high-resolution parameter extraction but suffer from prohibitive computational complexity due to exhaustive grid search. Conversely, purely data-driven deep learning approaches lack physical grounding and struggle to generalize across variable multipath densities and off-grid parameters. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), a hybrid framework that embeds a multi-head residual network directly into the iterative CLEAN extraction loop. By replacing the exhaustive grid search with rapid, parallelizable forward passes while delegating residual subtraction to exact mathematical models, NN-CLEAN isolates physical multipath parameters without accumulating non- physical errors. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that NN-CLEAN achieves estimation accuracy exceeding 96% at 5 dB SNR, matching the traditional Grid-Search CLEAN (GS- CLEAN) baseline, while providing a massive reduction in computational complexity and substantially outperforming subspace methods and standalone one-shot neural networks. Crucially, NN-CLEAN exhibits a near-flat scaling in execution runtime and memory consumption as batch sizes increase. This highly efficient parallelization establishes NN-CLEAN as a robust, real- time solution for channel estimation in MIMO systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NN-CLEAN，一种将多头残差网络嵌入迭代CLEAN提取循环的混合框架，用快速并行前向传播替代穷举网格搜索，在5 dB SNR下实现96%以上的估计精度，匹敌传统Grid-Search CLEAN基线，同时大幅降低计算复杂度并在批量增大时保持近线性/近乎平坦的运行时和内存扩展。
AI.motivation: 传统ML估计算法（如CLEAN）受限于穷举网格搜索带来的高计算复杂度；而纯数据驱动的深度学习缺乏物理基础，难以在多变多径密度和离格参数下泛化。两者均无法同时满足高精度与高效率的需求。
AI.method: NN-CLEAN将多头残差网络嵌入迭代CLEAN提取循环中：用快速可并行化的前向传播替代穷举网格搜索来估计多径参数，同时将残差减法交给精确的数学模型处理，避免累积非物理误差。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真表明，NN-CLEAN在5 dB SNR下估计精度超过96%，与GS-CLEAN基线匹配；计算复杂度大幅降低，性能显著优于子空间方法和单次前向神经网络。在批量规模增大时，运行时和内存消耗呈近平坦扩展，展现出高效的并行化能力。
AI.conclusion: NN-CLEAN结合了模型驱动的物理准确性与数据驱动的高效性，成为一种鲁棒的MIMO信道估计实时解决方案，兼具高精度与高并行效率。

title: Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to interpret complex human emotions by integrating natural language with non-verbal modalities. Non-verbal modalities share a structural isomorphism with natural language, as both can be viewed as feature sequences evolving over time. This isomorphism enables the transformation of non-verbal modalities into text-like tokens for unified semantic reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs), designed to understand and generate sequential data, can thus be utilized to interpret complex affective sequences. However, existing LLM-based methods primarily capture low-level superficial features, failing to model affective semantics arising from structural variations and contextual interactions. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SentiLLM}, a unified framework that leverages \textit{Semantic-Aligned Structural Abstraction} to distill continuous raw signals into compact, semantically meaningful tokens. Specifically, we introduce a \textit{Dual-Stream Salience-Context Calibration Mechanism}, which disentangles non-verbal feature sequences into a focus stream and an ambient stream. The focus stream captures salient sentiment shifts (e.g., facial expressions) guided by textual priors, while the ambient stream characterizes stable background states. Through calibrating these dynamic sentiment shifts against background states, SentiLLM effectively projects non-verbal modalities into a unified semantic space, making them naturally understandable for LLMs. Serving as a plug-and-play module, SentiLLM significantly improves discriminative performance with only a small number of trainable parameters. Our method achieves superior performance on four datasets, MOSI, MOSEI, CH-SIMS, and CH-SIMS v2, demonstrating the effectiveness of the structural abstraction paradigm in MSA. Our code is available at: \href{https://github.com/especiallyW/SentiLLM}.

AI.tldr: 提出SentiLLM框架，通过语义对齐的结构抽象方法将多模态情感分析中的非语言模态转换为文本化token，并引入双流显著性-上下文校准机制，以少量可训练参数在四个数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多模态情感分析方法主要捕获低层表面特征，未能建模由结构变化和上下文交互引起的情感语义。非语言模态与自然语言在结构上同构（都是随时间演变的特征序列），但现有方法没有充分利用这一特性进行统一语义推理。
AI.method: 提出SentiLLM框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 语义对齐的结构抽象，将连续的原始信号蒸馏为紧凑且有语义意义的token；(2) 双流显著性-上下文校准机制，将非语言特征序列解耦为焦点流（由文本先验引导捕获显著情感变化，如面部表情）和环境流（表征稳定的背景状态），通过将动态情感变化与背景状态校准，将非语言模态投影到统一语义空间供LLM理解。该模块是即插即用的，仅需少量可训练参数。
AI.result: 在MOSI、MOSEI、CH-SIMS和CH-SIMS v2四个数据集上取得优越性能，验证了结构抽象范式在多模态情感分析中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 非语言模态可以通过结构抽象转化为文本化token，借助双流校准机制将情感变化与背景状态对比，能够有效提升LLM在多模态情感分析中的判别能力。该范式为统一多模态情感语义推理提供了新思路。

title: CORE: In-Context Reconstruction for Unified Tabular Anomaly Detection
summary: Tabular anomaly detection (TAD), which focuses on identifying abnormal samples that deviate from the majority in tabular data, has received growing attention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend towards unified TAD, which seeks to detect anomalies across different datasets using a single generalizable model. In unified TAD, aligning heterogeneous data remains challenging. While existing methods often rely on distance-based unified feature construction, they may obscure the semantics of the original features. Moreover, existing approaches typically formulate anomaly detection as a binary classification task, which may overlook diverse anomaly patterns from various datasets and be misled by unrepresentative synthetic anomalies. To address these challenges, we propose an in-COntext REconstruction approach for unified TAD (CORE for short). It introduces a decorrelated feature alignment module to directly align heterogeneous features into a unified representation space, which retains their semantic information. Meanwhile, CORE formulates unified TAD as an in-context reconstruction problem, eliminating the need for labeled or synthesized anomalies. Specifically, the in-context reconstruction module reconstructs each sample by leveraging contextual normal samples to capture dataset-specific distributions, such that reconstruction errors reflect its deviation from normality, facilitating unified TAD on arbitrary unseen datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出CORE方法，通过去相关特征对齐模块和上下文重建模块实现统一的表格数据异常检测，无需标签或合成异常。
AI.motivation: 现有统一表格异常检测方法在异构数据对齐上存在困难：基于距离的统一特征构建可能模糊原始特征语义；将异常检测视为二分类任务会忽视不同数据集的多样异常模式，并可能被不具代表性的合成异常误导。
AI.method: CORE包含两个核心模块：(1) 去相关特征对齐模块，直接对齐异构特征到统一表示空间，保留语义信息；(2) 上下文重建模块，将统一TAD建模为上下文重建问题，利用上下文正常样本重建每个样本以捕捉数据集特定分布，重建误差反映偏离正常的程度，无需标签或合成异常。
AI.result: 该方法无需标签或合成异常即可在任意未见数据集上实现统一表格异常检测，重建误差作为偏离正常程度的度量。
AI.conclusion: CORE通过保留语义的特征对齐和基于重建的异常检测范式，克服了现有方法在特征语义丢失和二分类局限性方面的不足，实现了有效的跨数据集统一异常检测。

title: EgoGVAE: Ego-body Mesh Reconstruction via Guided Variational Autoencoder
summary: We address the problem of recovering the full-body mesh from only the head pose. This task has become essential for various applications based on head-mounted devices or smart glasses. The challenge of this task lies in estimating the pose information of unobserved body parts based solely on a single joint (i.e., head) trajectory. Several studies have begun to adopt head-conditioned generative models, however, such previous methods are costly and time-consuming due to the diffusion-based iterative process. As an alternative, we propose a simple yet novel method that leverages the latent space of the guidance network, which is designed as a variational autoencoder taking full-body poses as inputs. By enforcing latent distributions of this guidance network and our head-to-motion network to be similar, latent features sampled from the 'guided' distribution, i.e., distribution learned in our head-to-motion network, can be reliably decoded for natural representations of full-body poses even only with the head pose. One important advantage of the proposed method is that one-step sampling scheme achieves remarkably fast inference (more than 50 times faster) compared to diffusion-based approaches. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that the proposed method efficiently improves the performance of ego-body mesh reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅基于头部姿态恢复全身网格的轻量级方法，利用变分自编码器作为引导网络，通过对齐其潜空间分布与头部到运动网络的分布，实现单步采样即可快速推理（比扩散方法快50倍以上），并在基准数据集上显著提升了ego-body网格重建性能。
AI.motivation: 从仅有的头部姿态（由头戴设备或智能眼镜提供）估计全身网格对于许多应用至关重要。现有基于扩散模型的方法虽然有效，但迭代采样过程昂贵且耗时，难以满足实时应用需求，因此需要一种高效且性能优良的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一种简单而新颖的方法：构建一个以全身姿态为输入、设计为变分自编码器（VAE）的引导网络，并训练一个头部到运动的网络，通过强制两者的潜变量分布相似（引导分布对齐），使得在仅有头部姿态的条件下，从头到运动网络的"引导"分布中采样的潜特征也能被可靠地解码为自然的全身姿态表示。该方法采用单步采样策略，避免了扩散模型的迭代过程。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法在ego-body网格重建任务上有效提升了性能，同时推理速度比扩散方法快50倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用引导网络的潜空间进行分布对齐，可以在保持高质量全身姿态重建的同时，显著降低推理成本，为头戴式设备驱动的全身重建提供了一种高效的解决方案。

title: FADEx: Feature Attribution and Distortion-based Explanation of Dimensionality Reduction
comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, to be published in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
summary: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) is a fundamental tool for high-dimensional data exploration, reducing the complexity of latent spaces of machine learning models, and assisting in the explanation of complex opaque models. However, non-linear DR techniques often function as opaque transformations themselves, making it challenging to understand how individual features influence instance positioning in the reduced space. This lack of transparency complicates the analysis and interpretation of structural patterns, hindering the ability to reason about the organization of high-dimensional data based on the projected layout. In order to address this challenge, dimensionality reduction explanation methods have shown promise in improving the understanding of the observed groups and cluster structures. Unfortunately, existing DR explanation approaches tend to suffer from limitations such as multiple attributions per feature and restricted applicability to specific dimensionality reduction methods, which hinder their use. In this work, we propose FADEx, a novel local per-instance feature attribution method that leverages local linear approximation via first-order Taylor expansion and Singular Value Decomposition to provide explanations. FADEx computes the local linear models via weighted least squares, eliminating the need for out-of-sample data mapping, making it agnostic to the DR method, while simultaneously providing local feature attributions and distortion analysis. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations, comparisons with existing methods, and case studies, we demonstrate FADEx's effectiveness and versatility in providing explanations and analytical resources for analyzing the behavior of DR methods. The results indicate FADEx yields robust and reliable explanations, outperforming existing approaches in several aspects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FADEx，一种基于一阶泰勒展开和奇异值分解（SVD）的局部逐实例特征归因方法，用于解释非线性降维（DR）结果。FADEx通过加权最小二乘计算局部线性模型，无需样本外映射，与具体DR方法无关，能同时提供局部特征归因和失真分析。实验表明其在解释质量上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 非线性降维技术本身是黑箱变换，难以理解单个特征如何影响实例在降维空间中的位置，这阻碍了高维数据结构模式的解释。现有DR解释方法存在每个特征产生多个归因、仅适用于特定DR方法等问题，限制了其可用性。
AI.method: FADEx利用一阶泰勒展开对局部邻域进行线性近似，结合奇异值分解（SVD）获得特征归因。通过加权最小二乘构建局部线性模型，避免了对样本外数据映射的需求，从而实现与具体降维方法无关（agnostic）的解释。此外，FADEx还能进行失真分析（distortion analysis）。
AI.result: 通过定性与定量评估、与现有方法对比及案例研究，FADEx在提供解释和分析资源方面表现出有效性和通用性，生成的解释稳健可靠，在多个方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FADEx为非线性DR方法的解释提供了一种通用、稳健的局部特征归因方案，既提升了透明度又增强了分析能力，在解释质量和适用范围上均优于现有方法。

title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary material. Resources: https://github.com/Zhuyh1139/PALATE
summary: Role-playing agents (RPAs) have become one of the most important consumer applications of large language models. Users engage in multi-turn conversations with RPAs for experiences such as emotional comfort, making reliable evaluation essential for measuring capability, comparing systems, and guiding further improvement. Existing benchmarks, however, typically require an RPA to continue a fixed dialogue history and then evaluate the continuation using a fixed rubric detached from the user. We identify and empirically demonstrate two limitations of this design. First, an RPA's output is shaped by the preceding dialogue history, preventing a scientifically grounded assessment of its role-playing ability in real multi-turn settings. Second, user experience varies substantially across individuals, and conventional fixed rubrics need not align with user satisfaction. We therefore introduce PALATE (Person-Aligned LLM-Simulated-User Assessment with Tailored Evaluation), a scalable RPA benchmark built on user simulators. PALATE is accompanied by a pool of 300 character profiles. Its main evaluation trains five per-user simulators and lets them engage candidate RPAs in free-form, multi-turn conversations over a pre-frozen panel of character profiles. Alongside a general quality rubric, we construct personalized rubrics to measure user satisfaction; on held-out annotated data, the personalized rubrics show higher agreement with human judgments than the general rubric. In the main evaluation of 16 candidates, PALATE separately characterizes generic turn quality, long-horizon session capability, and per-user experience on multi-turn trajectories co-constructed by each candidate. It thereby produces interpretable evaluations of specific user-RPA pairs rather than compressing systems into a single user-independent ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PALATE，一个基于用户模拟器的可扩展角色扮演智能体（RPA）评测基准，通过个性化rubric和自由多轮对话评估，解决了现有基准中固定对话历史和固定rubric与真实用户体验脱节的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RPA评测基准存在两个核心缺陷：一是要求智能体续写固定对话历史，导致无法科学评估其在真实多轮场景中的角色扮演能力，因为输出结果受前置历史影响；二是用户体验因人而异，传统固定评分标准未必与用户满意度一致，导致评测结果与真实用户体验脱节。
AI.method: PALATE包含300个角色档案池，训练五个每用户模拟器与候选RPA进行自由形式的多人轮对话。在通用质量评分标准之外构建个性化评分标准来衡量用户满意度，并在人工标注数据上验证个性化评分标准与人类判断的一致性高于通用标准。主评测用16个候选得分分别刻画通用回合质量、长会话能力和每用户多轮轨迹体验。
AI.result: 在独立标注数据上，个性化评分标准比通用评分标准与人类判断的一致性更高。主评测通过同时评估通用回合质量、长程会话能力和逐用户多轮体验，能够对特定用户-RPA对产生可解释的评估，而非将所有系统压缩为单一与用户无关的排名。
AI.conclusion: PALATE通过用户模拟器和个性化评估框架，提供了更贴近真实用户体验的RPA评测方法，能够从多维度分离刻画系统能力，产生针对具体用户-RPA配对的可解释评估结果。

title: Hidden APIs in Language Models: Discovering Reusable Causal Interfaces from Forked Futures
summary: Identical language-model answers can arise from hidden states that support different future computations, so current-answer probes do not establish a reusable internal interface. We introduce forked futures: future operations are sampled only after a prefix state has formed, and states are compared through the response distributions induced by those operations. This yields an empirical causal quotient over hidden states without requiring researcher-specified latent labels. Shared, Local, Mixture, and Distributed interfaces then compete under prequential causal description length subject to future-signature fidelity and matched capacity constraints. In the two detailed model evaluations, Shared has the lowest held-out description length, with gains of 0.216 nats on Qwen2.5-1.5B and 0.294 nats on Llama-3-8B, while maintaining tightly clustered mean future-signature distortion; a five-backbone sweep preserves the positive direction of Sharedness Gain. The figure-aligned transplantation analysis gives Shared the strongest joint target-correctness, locality, copy-preservation, and composite profile, and API-aligned paths mediate 0.749 of the target effect versus 0.150 for matched null paths.
