In the blind four-class model-organism test, 14/16 architectures are recovered, with one observed non-Shared to Shared error among 12 non-Shared organisms. These results support an economical reusable causal interface within the tested operation banks, while keeping the claim explicitly conditional on the candidate architectures, interventions, and held-out futures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"forked futures"方法，通过在未来操作采样后比较响应分布来衡量隐藏状态间是否存在可复用的因果接口。在多个端到端模型评估中，Shared接口在预序列因果描述长度上表现最优，支持存在经济可复用因果接口的结论。
AI.motivation: 现有方法用当前答案探针来测试隐藏状态，但相同的语言模型输出可能来自支持不同未来计算的隐藏状态，因此无法确立可复用的内部接口。本文旨在不依赖研究者预设潜在标签的情况下，经验性地衡量隐藏状态之间的因果等价性。
AI.method: 引入"forked futures"框架：在前缀状态形成后才采样未来操作，通过操作诱导的响应分布比较状态。提出四种接口竞争模型（Shared、Local、Mixture、Distributed），在匹配容量约束和未来签名保真度下，用预序列因果描述长度（prequential causal description length）作为准则进行评估，并配合移植分析和盲测四类模型生物体测试。
AI.result: Shared接口在Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3-8B上分别获得0.216和0.294 nats的最低held-out描述长度；五骨干扫描保持Sharedness增益的正方向；移植分析中Shared具有最强的联合目标正确性、局部性、复制保持和复合画像；API对齐路径中介0.749的目标效应（对照零路径0.150）；盲测中14/16架构正确恢复。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的操作库范围内，结果支持存在经济可复用的因果接口，但结论明确限定于候选架构、干预和held-out未来操作，不宣称跨所有场景的普适性。

title: DS@GT ARC at ImageCLEFmedical 2026: Architectural Diversity for Concept Detection and Foundation-Model Scaling for Caption Prediction in Medical Image Analysis
summary: We describe the DS@GT submissions to the ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 challenge, which continues a long-running benchmark on the ROCOv2 dataset with two tracks: Concept Detection (Task 1), assigning UMLS Concept Unique Identifiers (CUIs) to radiology images, and Caption Prediction (Task 2), generating natural-language captions. For Task 1, our primary submission was a three-way late-fusion ensemble of ConvNeXt-V2, BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16, and DenseNet-169 with a regularized ''Honest Threshold Tuning'' procedure designed to avoid validation overfitting on rare concepts; this submission ranked first on the official submission with a primary $F_1$ of $0.5790$ and a secondary $F_1$ of $0.9657$. In parallel, we submitted a training-free KNN retrieval pipeline over frozen BiomedCLIP embeddings, which reached a primary $F_1$ of $0.5780$ and a secondary $F_1$ of $0.9599$-essentially matching the fine-tuned ensemble on the primary track at a fraction of the cost. For Task 2, our submissions included a fine-tuned Gemma-3 27B model (overall $0.3571$, ranking third in the official submission), a fully fine-tuned BLIP pipeline with custom Vizwins merging ($0.3564$), and a zero-shot MedGemma-4B run with a PubMed-style prompt ($0.3186$), spanning a wide range of model scales and training costs. Code: https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-caption-2026.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DS@GT团队在ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026挑战赛中的系统提交方案。任务1（概念检测）中，冠军方案是ConvNeXt-V2、BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16和DenseNet-169的三路晚期融合集成，配合正则化的"诚实阈值调优"方法，取得主F1为0.5790、次F1为0.9657的成绩；另有无需训练的KNN检索管线以极低代价取得接近的性能。任务2（字幕生成）中，团队提交了微调的Gemma-3 27B（排名第三）、完整微调的BLIP管线及零样本MedGemma-4B等多种规模模型。
AI.motivation: 该工作旨在参与ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026挑战赛，该挑战赛基于ROCOv2数据集持续评估医学影像理解中两个关键子任务：将放射影像映射到UMLS概念唯一标识符（CUIs）的概念检测任务，以及生成自然语言字幕的字幕预测任务。团队希望探索不同规模和训练成本的方法在这些任务上的性能边界。
AI.method: 任务1采用三种主流卷积/多模态模型（ConvNeXt-V2、BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16、DenseNet-169）的三路晚期融合集成，并提出正则化的"诚实阈值调优"（Honest Threshold Tuning）程序以缓解稀有概念上的验证集过拟合。同时构建了基于冻结BiomedCLIP嵌入的训练免费KNN检索管线作为低成本对照。任务2分别采用微调的Gemma-3 27B大语言模型、带自定义Vizwins合并的BLIP全微调管线，以及带PubMed风格提示的零样本MedGemma-4B，覆盖不同模型规模和训练预算。
AI.result: 任务1中，集成方案在官方提交中排名第一，主F1为0.5790，次F1为0.9657；KNN检索管线主F1达0.5780、次F1为0.9599，在主干任务上几乎与微调集成持平但成本大幅降低。任务2中，Gemma-3 27B取得0.3571的总体得分排名第三，BLIP管线得0.3564，零样本MedGemma-4B得0.3186。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在医学影像概念检测任务中，晚期融合集成配合理想的阈值调优策略可以获得最优性能，而无需训练的检索式方法在主要指标上也能逼近微调集成，体现了计算效率与性能之间的良好权衡。在字幕生成任务中，更大规模的语言模型（Gemma-3 27B）表现优于BLIP等视觉-语言模型，但较小模型的零样本能力也值得关注。

title: Schreier-Coset Graph Rewiring
summary: The information flow in the graph neural networks (GNNs) is fundamentally constrained by over-squashing, where structural bottlenecks impede long range information propagation. Graph-rewiring methods, which modify graph topology, have been extensively used to alleviate this. However, existing approaches often introduce prohibitive structural and computational bottlenecks, fail to preserve the critical properties of original graphs, and increase the edge counts massively. We introduce a novel method Schreier-Coset Graph Rewiring , a group-theoretic rewiring method that augments the input graph with a Schreier-Coset graph derived from a special linear group. Our method provides theoretical guarantees, a graph that exhibits spectral gap and a bounded effective resistance, creating a low-resistance bypass for long-range communication. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that SCGR reduces effective resistance by 5-40% across various learning tasks, effectively mitigating connectivity bottlenecks while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于群论的图重连方法——Schreier-Coset图重连（SCGR），通过将输入图与从特殊线性群导出的Schreier-Coset图相结合，缓解图神经网络中的过压缩（over-squashing）问题，同时提供谱间隙和有界有效电阻的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络中的信息流受到过压缩现象的根本制约，即结构瓶颈阻碍了长距离信息的传播。现有的图重连方法虽然被广泛用于缓解此问题，但往往引入严重的结构和计算瓶颈，无法保持原始图的关键属性，且会大幅增加边数。
AI.method: SCGR是一种群论图重连方法，将一个从特殊线性群（special linear group）导出的Schreier-Coset图增强到输入图上。该方法提供理论保证，使得增强后的图具有谱间隙（spectral gap）和有界的有效电阻（bounded effective resistance），从而为长距离通信构建低电阻旁路。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，SCGR在各种学习任务中将有效电阻降低了5-40%，有效缓解了连接瓶颈，同时保持了具有竞争力的准确率。
AI.conclusion: SCGR通过群论工具优雅地解决了GNN中的过压缩问题，在保证理论性质（谱间隙与有界有效电阻）的同时，避免了现有重连方法的结构和计算开销，为图神经网络的长距离信息传播提供了新的有效途径。

title: AutoSupervision: Closing the Feedback Loop in Scientific Workflows with Grounded Revision Verification
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled AI systems to assist scientific research and peer review. However, an essential capability for reliable AI-assisted scientific workflows remains underexplored: verifying whether reviewer feedback leads to meaningful and evidence-supported manuscript improvements. We introduce AutoSupervision, which evaluates whether scientific manuscript revisions genuinely address reviewer concerns through grounded evidence. AutoSupervision leverages transparent peer-review records as a natural source of supervision, where reviewer comments specify scientific concerns, author responses describe claimed resolutions, and revised manuscripts provide evidence of changes. Given reviewer comments, author responses, and revised manuscripts, models must characterize reviewer concerns, determine whether concerns have been addressed, and identify supporting manuscript evidence. We construct AutoSupervision from 56,000 Nature Communications articles and corresponding review records. Then we conducted experiments on LLMs, the ablation study, and the case study. Our results show that while LLMs perform well in characterizing reviewer concerns, with GPT-5.5 achieving a score of 0.754, evidence-based verification remains the primary bottleneck, with the best-performing model reaching only 0.501.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoSupervision，一个评估科学稿件修订是否切实解决评审意见的基准任务与数据集，基于56,000篇Nature Communications文章的公开同行评审记录构建。实验表明LLM在刻画评审关注点方面表现良好（GPT-5.5达0.754），但基于证据的验证仍是主要瓶颈（最佳模型仅0.501）。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型已能辅助科学研究和同行评审，但AI系统可靠地验证"评审反馈是否导致有意义且基于证据的稿件改进"这一关键能力尚未被充分探索。现有方法缺乏对修订是否真正回应评审关切的系统评估框架。
AI.method: AutoSupervision利用透明的同行评审记录作为天然监督信号：评审评论阐述科学关切、作者回复描述解决方案、修订稿件提供变更证据。模型需完成三项任务：刻画评审关切、判断关切是否被解决、识别支持性稿件证据。基于56,000篇Nature Communications文章及对应评审记录构建基准数据集，并进行LLM实验、消融研究和案例研究。
AI.result: LLM在特征化评审关切方面表现较好，GPT-5.5达到0.754分；但基于证据的验证能力显著不足，最佳模型仅获得0.501分，表明这是当前AI辅助科研工作流的主要性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: AutoSupervision填补了AI辅助科研工作流中"证据支持的修订验证"这一空白。当前模型虽能理解评审关切，但在严格验证修订是否真正基于证据解决问题方面仍存在显著局限，需要进一步研究以提升该能力。

title: SCOPE: Synthetic Conditional Objectives for Policy Evolution in Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 43 pages; Kiet, Duc, and Bang contributed equally
summary: Black-box combinatorial optimization requires systematically identifying high-quality solutions under a limited evaluation budget, yet the unknown objective function provides little guidance for deciding where the search should explore next. We introduce SCOPE, a general framework for Synthetic Conditional Objectives for Policy Evolution in Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization. Rather than directly optimizing the inaccessible objective, SCOPE learns a set of synthetic objectives conditioned on the accumulated search history, where each objective is designed to expose a distinct and potentially useful preference over candidate solutions. These objectives are then used to evolve search policies that generate diverse candidates, whose true quality is subsequently assessed through black-box evaluations. The outer loop adaptively updates and selects synthetic objectives according to how effectively their induced policies discover promising regions. In contrast, the inner loop returns a portfolio of top-performing policies to reduce the risk of relying on a single surrogate preference. This formulation reframes objective design as a mechanism for guiding policy exploration, enabling the search process to exploit observed evidence while maintaining structured diversity across discrete solution spaces. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark problems demonstrate that SCOPE consistently improves black-box search performance under limited evaluation budgets and generalizes well across diverse combinatorial structures.

AI.tldr: SCOPE是一个用于黑盒组合优化的通用框架，通过学习历史搜索条件化的合成目标来引导策略演化，在有限的评估预算下持续提升搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 黑盒组合优化中，未知的目标函数无法为搜索提供方向性指导，使得在有限评估预算下如何系统地识别高质量解成为挑战。
AI.method: SCOPE学习一组基于累积搜索历史条件化的合成目标，每个目标编码不同候选解的偏好；利用这些目标演化搜索策略以生成多样化候选解；外层循环根据策略发现优质区域的效果自适应更新和选择合成目标，内层循环返回一组顶层策略组合以降低依赖单一代理偏好的风险。
AI.result: 在多个基准问题上，SCOPE在有限评估预算下持续提升了黑盒搜索性能，并在多种组合结构上展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE将目标设计重新定义为引导策略探索的机制，使搜索过程能够利用观测证据的同时在离散解空间中保持结构化多样性，为黑盒组合优化提供了新的有效范式。

title: Private Face Recognition Training Dataset Publication via Identity-Decoupled and Geometry-Preserving Face Distillation
summary: Publishing private face recognition~(FR) training datasets is privacy-sensitive because faces expose identity information. Private FR training dataset publication mitigates this risk by releasing protected proxies as substitutes for private training faces. However, training FR models with such data introduces an identity paradox: \emph{the identity cues that make released faces useful for recognition supervision are also the cues that make them linkable to real individuals.} A protected face should be decoupled from the original identity, yet still behave as a reliable identity sample for training. Removing these cues too aggressively may destroy the class structure needed for recognition learning, whereas preserving them too faithfully may increase source-identity linkability. We argue that this paradox stems from conflating source-aligned identity semantics with recognition-useful proxy identity geometry. The former should be suppressed to reduce linkage to private individuals, while the latter should be preserved for FR learning. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{Private Face Distillation}, an identity-decoupling and geometry-preserving framework. It uses Orthogonal Geometry Preservation to construct decoupled proxy identities from private identity representations while maintaining hyperspherical geometry, and Relational Topology Alignment to preserve identity relations for recognition learning. Experiments across multiple domain-shifted FR scenarios show that Private Face Distillation achieves stronger utility than the evaluated publication baselines. On IJB-C surveillance, it improves $\mathrm{TAR}@\mathrm{FAR}{=}1\text{e-}{3}$ by 3.94\% over the baseline while reducing source-identity linkability. These results suggest that private FR training dataset publication should decouple source-identity correspondence while preserving proxy identity geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Private Face Distillation（私有面部蒸馏）框架，通过解耦源身份语义和保留识别有用的代理身份几何结构，解决了私有面部识别训练数据集发布中的"身份悖论"问题，在降低源身份可链接性的同时提升了识别模型效用。
AI.motivation: 发布私有面部识别（FR）训练数据集涉及隐私风险，因为人脸会暴露身份信息。私有FR训练集发布通过释放受保护的代理数据来替代私有训练人脸，但面临一个身份悖论：使释放人脸对识别监督有用的身份线索，恰恰也是使其可链接到真实个体的线索。过度去除这些线索会破坏识别学习所需的类别结构，而过度保留则会增加源身份可链接性。
AI.method: 提出Private Face Distillation框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 正交几何保持（Orthogonal Geometry Preservation）——从私有身份表示中构造解耦的代理身份，同时维持超球面几何；(2) 关系拓扑对齐（Relational Topology Alignment）——保留身份间的关系以支持识别学习。该框架将源对齐身份语义（应被抑制以减少隐私链接）与识别有用的代理身份几何（应被保留用于FR学习）进行解耦。
AI.result: 在多个域偏移FR场景下的实验表明，Private Face Distillation相比评估的发布基线取得了更强的效用。在IJB-C监控场景中，在FAR=1e-3条件下TAR提升3.94%，同时降低了源身份可链接性。
AI.conclusion: 私有FR训练数据集发布应当解耦源身份对应关系，同时保留代理身份几何结构。这一思路为隐私保护的人脸识别训练数据发布提供了有效的框架。

title: Latent States in Neural Networks: Recovering the Temporal Structure of Drifting Data from Model Weights
summary: A temporally drifting data stream may pass through discrete regimes rather than changing continuously. We ask whether such regimes are recoverable from the weights of models trained on the stream, using a hidden Markov model (HMM) fit to the chronologically ordered trajectory of those weights. We study this question in two domains known to drift over time: multimodal misinformation detection, using the Fakeddit dataset; and sentiment analysis, using the Yelp dataset. We train classifiers on consecutive temporal windows and fit an HMM to the trajectory of their aligned weights, recovering latent states that partition each timeline into coherent phases. On both datasets, classifiers generalize better to data from windows sharing the state of their training window than to windows across state boundaries. This within-state transfer advantage survives a control for temporal proximity and modestly exceeds the advantage recovered by a naive partition into contiguous states of equal size. Although the states are estimated solely from model weights, they correlate more strongly with shifts in the data's class distribution than with the weight-space geometry used to estimate them. After class divergence and lag are residualized out, the within-state advantage exceeds its permutation null on both tasks, indicating that the states recover structure relevant to transfer beyond the data distribution. Every effect replicates on both tasks but is attenuated on Yelp, whose label distribution is more temporally stable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否从时序漂移数据流上训练出的模型权重中，通过隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）恢复数据流所经历的离散状态（regimes）。在Fakeddit多模态虚假信息检测和Yelp情感分析两个任务上，基于模型权重的HMM状态能划分出连贯的时间阶段，且分类器在同状态窗口间的迁移效果显著优于跨状态窗口，即使控制时间邻近性后该优势依然存在，表明模型权重中蕴含了数据分布之外的、对迁移有用的离散结构。
AI.motivation: 时序漂移的数据流有时并非连续变化，而会经历离散的状态切换。作者想知道这种离散状态是否可以从训练模型的权重轨迹中恢复出来，从而为适应式学习、迁移学习等下游任务提供可解释的阶段划分依据。
AI.method: 在Fakeddit（多模态虚假信息检测）和Yelp（情感分析）两个数据集上，按连续时间窗口训练分类器；将各窗口训练得到的模型权重按时间顺序对齐成轨迹，对其拟合HMM以恢复隐状态；用隐状态将时间线划分为若干阶段，并通过跨窗口迁移实验评估这些状态的有效性。同时设置了时间邻近性控制和等分连续区间的对比基线，并通过置换检验、残差化等手段排除数据类别分布变化的干扰。
AI.result: 两个数据集上，分类器在同状态窗口之间的迁移效果优于跨状态边界窗口，且该优势在控制时间邻近性后仍然存在，并略高于等分连续区间的简单划分。HMM状态与数据类别分布的变化相关性更强；在残差化处理类别差异和时间滞后后，同状态迁移优势仍显著高于置换零假设。所有结论在两个任务上都得到复现，但在Yelp上效应较弱，因其标签分布更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 模型权重轨迹中确实编码了数据流所经历的离散状态信息，HMM可以有效恢复这些状态，且这些状态捕捉了超出数据分布本身、对跨窗口迁移有用的结构。该发现为从模型参数中识别数据阶段变化提供了新思路。

title: Beyond Feeling Better: Capability-Sustaining Emotional Dialogue as a Longitudinal Research Paradigm
summary: Emotional dialogue research includes two influential strategy traditions. Empathetic dialogue prioritizes understanding a speaker's emotional experience. Emotional support conversation selects and sequences support for the seeker's current needs. Sustained use introduces a further goal. Effective support should sustain users' capacities for emotion regulation, coping, self-endorsed decisions, and social connection across the interaction lifecycle. We propose capability-sustaining emotional dialogue (CSED) as a longitudinal research paradigm that aligns supportive strategy with this goal and organizes data, models, system design, evaluation, and governance around repeated use, non-use, transition, and termination. A targeted literature-and-corpus audit motivates this position. In a PRISMA-ScR-guided sample, 95% of 60 system-building papers pursue relief-oriented goals. None evaluates capability or longitudinal outcomes, and only 1 considers dependency, autonomy, or termination risk. In 300 ESConv supporter turns, capability-relevant functions appear in 43.0%, while generic suggestions account for 22.0%, compared with 4.0% reappraisal, 6.7% self-efficacy support, and 0.3% boundary behavior. We release a protocol for extending the audit to model behavior. An illustrative process model connects latent user capability to six design commitments, four evaluation timescales, and lifecycle constraints. The resulting agenda makes CSED testable across data, policy design, training, evaluation, and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"能力维持型情感对话"(CSED)这一纵向研究范式，强调情感支持对话不仅应缓解当下的情绪困扰，还应维持用户在情绪调节、应对、自主决策和社会连接方面的长期能力。通过针对文献和语料库的系统审计，作者发现现有研究几乎全部聚焦于即时缓解目标，缺乏对纵向能力结果的评估，并在此基础上提出了可测试的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有情感对话研究存在两大传统——共情对话侧重理解说话者的情绪体验，情感支持对话侧重选择和排序支持策略以满足求助者当前需求。但持续使用场景引入了一个被忽视的目标：有效的支持应贯穿互动生命周期维持用户的能力。作者通过文献审计发现，60篇系统构建论文中95%追求缓解导向目标，无一评估能力或纵向结果，且仅有1篇考虑依赖、自主性或终止风险，这构成了提出新范式的主要动机。
AI.method: 作者采用双重审计方法：(1)遵循PRISMA-ScR指南对60篇系统构建论文进行范围审查，评估其目标导向与评估指标；(2)对ESConv语料库中300条支持者话语进行能力相关功能标注分析。此外，作者提出了一个说明性的过程模型，将潜在的用户能力与六项设计承诺、四个评估时间尺度及生命周期约束联系起来，并发布了将审计扩展到模型行为的协议。
AI.result: 审计结果显示：在60篇系统构建论文中，95%追求缓解导向目标，没有论文评估能力或纵向结果，仅1篇考虑依赖、自主性或终止风险。在ESConv的300条支持者话语中，43.0%包含能力相关功能，而通用建议占22.0%；相比之下，重新评价仅占4.0%，自我效能支持占6.7%，边界行为仅占0.3%。这揭示了当前系统在能力维持方面的显著短板。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：情感支持对话需要从"即时缓解"导向转向"能力维持"的纵向范式。CSED范式将数据、模型、系统设计、评估和治理围绕重复使用、非使用、过渡和终止组织起来，使得情感支持系统在数据、策略设计、训练、评估和治理等多个维度上都是可测试的，为该领域的长期发展提供了新的研究框架。

title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Among existing policy optimization methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains particularly appealing because its learned critic can, in principle, provide token-level credit assignment. However, in mathematical reasoning tasks characterized by long reasoning horizons and sparse outcome rewards, reliable token-level credit assignment remains challenging. The standard critic often fails to accurately evaluate intermediate reasoning states, resulting in noisy advantage estimates and suboptimal policy updates. In this paper, we propose ReDiPPO, a Reference-guided and Discrepancy-aware PPO framework for mathematical reasoning. ReDiPPO introduces a reference-guided critic that uses reference answers as training-time privileged signals to provide more accurate value estimation. Meanwhile, it retains a standard critic and quantifies the token-level reference-standard discrepancy between the standard value estimate and the reference-guided value estimate. This discrepancy serves as an indicator of difficult reasoning states and is used to reweight the corresponding token-level advantages during PPO optimization. Extensive experiments on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ReDiPPO improves value-estimation accuracy and consistently outperforms strong policy optimization baselines, including PPO, DAPO, and GSPO, in final reasoning performance. Our code is available on https://github.com/cii030/ReDiPPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReDiPPO框架，通过参考引导的critic和"参考-标准"差异感知机制来改进PPO在数学推理任务中的token级信用分配，从而提升策略优化的准确性和最终推理性能。
AI.motivation: 在数学推理任务中，推理链长且奖励稀疏，标准PPO的critic难以准确评估中间推理状态，导致优势估计噪声大、策略更新次优。现有方法缺乏可靠的token级信用分配机制。
AI.method: ReDiPPO包含两个核心组件：(1) 参考引导的critic，利用参考答案作为训练时的特权信号以提供更准确的价值估计；(2) 保留标准critic并计算其与参考引导critic在token级上的"参考-标准差异"，该差异作为困难推理状态的指示器，用于对对应token的优势进行重新加权。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准上的大量实验表明，ReDiPPO提高了价值估计的准确性，并在最终推理性能上一致地优于PPO、DAPO和GSPO等强策略优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入参考答案作为特权信号并利用参考-标准差异进行token级优势重加权，ReDiPPO有效缓解了长推理链中critic评估不准确的问题，为数学推理的强化学习优化提供了更可靠的信用分配方案。

title: CXR-Retrieve: Compositional Text-to-Image Retrieval in Chest Radiography
summary:
Large chest radiography archives are difficult to search because most studies are paired only with free-text reports rather than structured clinical annotations. Vision-language models offer a natural interface for text-to-image retrieval, but current biomedical models are primarily optimized for report-to-image matching rather than for satisfying short clinical search queries. This creates an objective mismatch: a model may retrieve images related to words in the query while failing to satisfy the full clinical constraint, especially for conjunctions and negations such as ``atelectasis and no pneumonia.''
  We introduce CXR-Retrieve, a structured benchmark for compositional chest X-ray text-to-image retrieval. The benchmark contains 5,159 test images from the official test-split of MIMIC-CXR-JPG and 145 textual queries spanning single and conjunction findings, both positive and negative. Relevance is defined by whether a retrieved image satisfies all asserted pathology constraints, rather than by whether it matches a paired report.
  We further propose a label-aware contrastive fine-tuning objective for clinical retrieval. Our method attracts image-text pairs with compatible asserted pathology constraints, including shared confirmed absences, while explicitly repelling contradictory pairs. Starting from the in-domain CXR-CLIP checkpoint, our method improves Precision@5 over CXR-CLIP by 8.5 percentage points on two-pathology conjunctions and by 22.0 percentage points on negation queries. These results show that reliable chest X-ray retrieval requires training objectives that model not only which findings are mentioned, but also how they are clinically asserted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CXR-Retrieve基准和标签感知对比微调方法，解决胸部X光文本-图像检索中低结构化标注与临床查询语义（如合取和否定）不匹配的问题，显著提升了多病理合取和否定查询的检索精度。
AI.motivation: 大型胸部X光档案难以搜索，因为大多数研究仅配有自由文本报告而非结构化临床注释。现有视觉-语言模型主要优化报告-图像匹配，而非满足短临床查询，导致模型可检索包含查询词汇的图像，却无法满足完整临床约束（尤其是"合取"和"否定"等逻辑），存在客观目标不匹配的问题。
AI.method: （1）构建CXR-Retrieve基准：包含MIMIC-CXR-JPG官方测试集的5,159张测试图像和145个文本查询，覆盖单一及合取发现，同时包含阳性和阴性表述；相关性判定基于图像是否满足所有断言病理约束，而非匹配配对报告。（2）提出标签感知对比微调目标：吸引具有兼容断言病理约束（含共享确认缺失）的图像-文本对，显式排斥矛盾对，从CXR-CLIP检查点出发进行微调。
AI.result: 相比CXR-CLIP基線，在双病理合取查询上Precision@5提升8.5个百分点，在否定查询上提升22.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的胸部X光检索需要训练目标不仅建模"哪些发现被提及"，还要建模"这些发现如何被临床断言"，即需显式考虑病理的合取、否定等逻辑关系。

title: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Collider Physics with Multi-Domain Adaptation
summary: We present a lightweight approach to foundation modeling (\textbf{NEXUS}) that leverages pre-trained learning from collider physics data towards out-of-domain tasks in other scientific datasets, using a fully connected autoencoder model with approximately 3 million parameters. The model pre-trains with no supervision over a large-scale collision dataset from the Large Hadron Collider modeled by charged particle track features. Downstream tasks for collider analyses, such as kinematic regression and event classification, are developed on pre-trained model weights and achieve improved accuracy with only small labeled datasets when compared to equivalent architectures trained from scratch. The benefits of pre-training are additionally investigated through latent space interpretation and application to other domains, including gravitational waves, flood forecasting, and neural activity. Furthermore, the relative computational simplicity of NEXUS is demonstrated compared to transformer approaches at comparable scale, opening the door to power-efficient inference and real-time or edge applications of foundation models in scientific experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NEXUS，一个轻量级的科学基础模型，采用约300万参数的全连接自编码器架构，在大规模LHC对撞机数据上无监督预训练，可迁移至引力波、洪水预测和神经活动等跨域科学任务，且仅需小标注数据集即可在下游任务中取得优于从零训练的效果，计算复杂度远低于Transformer架构。
AI.motivation: 现有科学领域的基础模型多依赖Transformer架构，计算开销大、难以部署于实时或边缘计算场景。作者试图探索一种轻量化的基础建模方案，利用对撞机物理数据的大规模预训练，将学到的通用表征迁移到其他科学领域，同时保持较高的计算效率和可解释性。
AI.method: 采用约300万参数的全连接自编码器作为核心架构，在大型强子对撞机（LHC）的带电粒子径迹特征数据集上进行无监督预训练。预训练完成后，针对下游任务（运动学回归、事件分类等）在预训练权重基础上进行微调，并通过潜空间解释分析理解预训练获益的机制，同时将模型迁移应用到引力波、洪水预测和神经活动等异构科学数据集上验证跨域泛化能力。
AI.result: 预训练权重在小标注数据集上显著提升了运动学回归和事件分类的下游任务精度，优于同等架构从零训练的效果；模型成功迁移到引力波、洪水预测和神经活动等多个科学领域；相比同等规模Transformer方法具有明显的计算简便性优势，支持能效推理及实时/边缘应用。
AI.conclusion: NEXUS证明了轻量级基础模型在科学数据领域的可行性与有效性，表明全连接自编码器配合大规模无监督预训练能够产出可迁移的领域通用表征，为科学实验中的实时与边缘部署提供了新的可能性，是对Transformer范式之外的一种重要补充路径。

title: FinanceHarness: Autonomous Financial Deep Research Framework
summary: Powered by advances in LLMs and autonomous agents, deep research has become one of the most widely adopted agentic products. However, most deep research systems write general-purpose reports, which are inadequate for financial deep research. Financial research demands specialized knowledge to analyze historical patterns and forecast upcoming events. Automating financial deep research therefore requires both a layered harness to drive the research agent and a verifiable, point-in-time benchmark that prevents leakage of future information. We present FinanceHarness, a harness that runs finance-oriented tools and practitioner-guided workflows, automating financial deep research end to end: environment and data construction, the agent execution loop, and reward modeling. We further propose FinanceGym, comprising thesis-driven research questions and rubrics that combine pre-cutoff and post-cutoff criteria. Professional expert validation yields an 82% pass rate. Even leading LLMs and agents score below 40% on the rubrics, showing that FinanceGym is challenging and leaves substantial headroom. With the same open-weight backbone, FinanceHarness improves the overall rubric score from 25.3% to 32.4%. FinanceHarness is available at https://github.com/Yijia-Xiao/FinanceHarness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinanceHarness，一个用于自动化金融深度研究的嵌套式工具与工作流框架，以及FinanceGym，一个包含财报前/后双重标准的、可验证的时点基准测试集。专家验证通过率达82%，而顶尖LLM得分低于40%，证明基准具有挑战性。基于相同开源权重，FinanceHarness将整体评分从25.3%提升至32.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究系统（基于LLM和自主代理）主要生成通用型报告，无法满足金融深度研究的专业需求。金融研究需要专业知识来分析历史模式并预测未来事件，同时自动化该过程需要防止未来信息泄露的时点基准。因此需要专门的框架和可验证基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: FinanceHarness包含三层设计：(1) 环境与数据构建，运行金融导向工具；(2) 代理执行循环，由实践者指导的工作流驱动；(3) 奖励建模。FinanceGym基准则包含基于论点（thesis-driven）的研究问题和评分标准（rubrics），评分标准结合了截止前（pre-cutoff）和截止后（post-cutoff）双重标准，以防止信息泄露。
AI.result: 专业专家验证FinanceGym的通过率为82%；即使领先的LLM和代理在评分标准上的得分也低于40%，说明该基准具有挑战性且留有较大提升空间。在相同开源权重骨干模型下，FinanceHarness将整体评分从25.3%提升至32.4%。
AI.conclusion: FinanceHarness和FinanceGym为自动化金融深度研究提供了端到端的解决方案和严格的可验证基准。实验表明当前领先模型仍在该任务上有较大提升空间，而FinanceHarness确实能有效提升模型表现。系统已开源供社区使用。

title: HealthCAT: An Interpretable Encoder-only Transformer Framework for Health Indicator Prediction and Temporal Interpretation of Wearable Sensor Data
summary: Wearable sensors continuously capture fine-grained multivariate time-series data, providing opportunities to model behavioural patterns associated with health outcomes. However, existing deep learning methods prioritise predictive accuracy over interpretability, limiting their application in health research. In this study, we present HealthCAT, a flexible framework that integrates an Encoder-only Transformer with an Attentive Class Activation Token (AttentiveCAT) to generate class-specific, time-step-level interpretations. These interpretations can be mapped back onto behavioural cycles that are relevant to the domain (e.g., time-of-day), supporting individual-level analysis of wearable sensor data. We evaluated HealthCAT using two real-world wearable sensor datasets (306 participants in total). HealthCAT outperformed deep learning baselines by up to 17\% in F1-score and 12\% in accuracy on both datasets ($p<0.05$). In masking experiments, the time steps identified by HealthCAT carried significantly more predictive value than random selection across all masking conditions ($p<0.05$), indicating that the identified time steps are predictively informative. By coupling predictive performance with validated time-step-level interpretability, HealthCAT moves wearable sensor analysis beyond aggregated metrics towards temporal patterns that support health monitoring, behavioural pattern analysis, and intervention design in health research. The significance of this work is that it enables accurate prediction of health indicators from wearable sensor data while providing insights into when and how physical activity patterns occur, rather than relying solely on aggregated summary measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HealthCAT框架，结合Encoder-only Transformer与Attentive Class Activation Token（AttentiveCAT），在穿戴传感器多变量时间序列数据上实现高精度预测的同时提供类别特定、时间步级别的可解释性，通过真实数据集验证其在F1分数和准确率上优于基线模型，且识别的时间步具有显著预测信息价值。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在穿戴传感器数据分析中过度追求预测精度而忽视可解释性，限制了其在健康研究领域的实际应用——研究人员不仅需要知道预测结果，还需要理解行为模式何时发生、如何发生，而非仅依赖聚合指标。
AI.method: HealthCAT采用Encoder-only Transformer架构，集成Attentive Class Activation Token（AttentiveCAT）机制，生成类别特定、时间步级别的注意力加权解释；这些解释可映射回行为周期（如一天中的时段），支持个体层面分析。在2个真实穿戴传感器数据集（共306名参与者）上进行评估，并设计了掩码实验验证时间步的预测信息量。
AI.result: HealthCAT在两个数据集上相比深度学习基线模型F1分数最高提升17%、准确率最高提升12%（p<0.05）；掩码实验中，HealthCAT识别的时间步在所有掩码条件下均比随机选择携带显著更高的预测价值（p<0.05），证明其识别的时间步具有预测信息性。
AI.conclusion: HealthCAT将预测性能与经过验证的时间步级可解释性结合，将穿戴传感器分析从聚合指标推进到时间模式层面，可支持健康监测、行为模式分析和干预设计。其核心贡献在于不仅能准确预测健康指标，还能揭示体力活动模式发生的时间与方式。

title: FDDWAN: A Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Network for Watermarking Attack
summary: Existing invisible watermark removal methods often struggle to accurately capture the watermark-bearing features, leading to an unfavorable trade-off between watermark suppression and perceptual fidelity. In this paper, we propose the Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Watermark Attack Network (FDDWAN), a coarse-to-fine framework that performs watermark removal through wavelet-domain decomposition and residual diffusion refinement. In the initial stage, the Wavelet-based Frequency-domain Preliminary Attack Module (WFPAM) decomposes the watermarked image into low- and high-frequency subbands and applies frequency-specific attack strategies tailored to their respective contributions to watermark robustness and perceptual quality. In the next stage, the Frequency-domain Residual Diffusion Attack Module (FRDAM) separately models the residual distributions between the preliminarily attacked outputs and the corresponding watermark-free references during training. Rather than reconstructing the entire image, FRDAM selectively refines frequency-domain residuals, directing the diffusion process toward the remaining watermark related discrepancies while minimizing modifications to image content. Extensive experiments on CelebA and ImageNet across four representative watermarking schemes demonstrate that FDDWAN achieves a more favorable trade-off between watermark removal effectiveness and visual fidelity than conventional and learning-based attack methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FDDWAN，一种基于频域解耦的扩散水印攻击网络。该框架通过小波域分解（WFPAM）进行粗粒度的频率特定攻击，再通过频域残差扩散精化（FRDAM）细粒度地针对剩余水印相关差异进行选择性修复。实验表明其在抑制水印与保持视觉保真度之间取得了更优的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的不可见水印移除方法难以准确捕获携带水印的特征，导致在水印抑制与感知保真度之间存在不利的折中。研究者希望通过频域解耦和粗到细的框架来更好地分离水印噪声与图像内容，从而改善两者之间的权衡。
AI.method: FDDWAN采用粗到细的两阶段框架：(1) WFPAM将含水印图像进行小波分解为低/高频子带，并针对不同频率子带对水印鲁棒性和感知质量的贡献分别应用特定攻击策略；(2) FRDAM在训练时分别建模初步攻击输出与无水印参考之间的残差分布，不重建整幅图像，而是选择性精化频域残差，将扩散过程引导至剩余水印相关差异，最小化对图像内容的修改。
AI.result: 在CelebA和ImageNet数据集上，针对四种代表性水印方案的广泛实验表明，FDDWAN在水印移除有效性和视觉保真度之间取得了比传统方法和基于学习的方法更优的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 频域解耦结合残差扩散精化的粗到细攻击策略能够有效改善水印移除任务中鲁棒性与保真度之间的平衡，为不可见水印攻击提供了一种新的有效范式。

title: Sparsity Induced Identifiability in Matrix Tri-Factorisation
summary: Matrix factorisation is a fundamental tool for exploiting low-dimensional structure in high-dimensional data, with applications such as data compression, denoising, structure discovery, interpretable representation learning, and dimensionality reduction. Compared to conventional two-factor models, matrix tri-factorisation provides greater modelling flexibility, while sparsity constraints often improve both interpretability and recovery performance. Although the role of sparsity has been extensively studied for two-factor matrix factorisation, rigorous theoretical guarantees for general real-valued matrix tri-factorisation remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we establish, to the best of our knowledge, the first rigorous theoretical study for sparsity-induced identifiability in general real-valued matrix tri-factorisation. Our analysis is enabled by a novel decomposition strategy that transforms the original problem into two coupled auxiliary factorisation problems, while preserving the structural information necessary to the recovery of the original factor matrices from the observations. Building upon this decomposition, we derive recovery guarantees and structural consistency results that characterise how coefficient sparsity influences the sufficient recovery conditions, convergence behaviour, spectral approximation error, high-probability bounds, and structure preservation. Comprehensive Monte Carlo experiments validate the proposed theory and demonstrate close agreement between the theoretical results and empirical observations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对一般实值矩阵三因子分解（matrix tri-factorisation）在稀疏性诱导下的可辨识性进行了严格的理论研究，通过新颖的分解策略将原问题转化为两个耦合的辅助因子分解问题，推导了恢复保证和结构一致性结果，并通过蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论与实证的高度一致性。
AI.motivation: 矩阵因子分解是利用高维数据中低维结构的基础工具，广泛用于数据压缩、去噪、结构发现、可解释表示学习和降维。相较于传统的两因子模型，矩阵三因子分解具有更大的建模灵活性，稀疏约束通常能同时改善可解释性和恢复性能。虽然稀疏性在两因子分解中已有深入研究，但一般实值矩阵三因子分解的严格理论保证尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的分解策略，将原始的三因子分解问题转化为两个耦合的辅助因子分解问题，同时保留恢复原始因子矩阵所需的结构信息。基于该分解策略，推导了稀疏性如何影响充分恢复条件、收敛行为、谱近似误差、高概率界以及结构保持等方面的恢复保证和结构一致性结果。
AI.result: 建立了首个针对一般实值矩阵三因子分解中稀疏性诱导可辨识性的严格理论研究，刻画了系数稀疏性对充分恢复条件、收敛行为、谱近似误差和结构保持的影响。蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论结果与经验观察之间的紧密一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了矩阵三因子分解在稀疏性理论上的空白，为一般实值矩阵三因子分解提供了严格的恢复保证和结构一致性理论，并通过实验证明理论与实际表现高度吻合。

title: Memory Decoder at Scale: A Pretrained, Parametric Long-Term Memory
summary: Decoder-only language models entangle long-term memory and reasoning in a single parameter set, making it difficult to scale memory capacity independently. Memory Decoder introduces a parametric long-term memory module but only studies it at a relatively small scale. In this work, we present Memory Decoder at Scale, scaling memory models up to 6.9B parameters and pretraining them on 300B tokens. At this data scale, the combined cost of indexing and search makes a standard Faiss pipeline infeasible. We address this bottleneck with a distributed pipeline for Faiss indexing and retrieval, together with sparse, batch-wise loading of kNN distributions. Across model scales, we find that allocating more parameters to memory yields a better parameter-performance tradeoff than scaling the base model alone. On 17 benchmarks, pairing a 6.9B general memory with Pythia-410M raises its average score from 29.86 to 37.34, surpassing Pythia-12B (37.24) with 39% fewer total parameters. For Qwen3 Base models ranging from 0.6B to 14B, 1.7B domain memories improve the average score across the three domains by more than 9 points at every scale. Overall, our results demonstrate that independently scaling pretrained memory offers a more parameter efficient path to improving language model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Memory Decoder at Scale，将参数化长期记忆模块扩展到6.9B参数规模并在300B token上进行预训练，通过分布式Faiss索引/检索管道和稀疏批量kNN加载解决了大规模检索瓶颈，证明独立扩展预训练记忆比扩展基座模型更具参数效率。
AI.motivation: Decoder-only语言模型将长期记忆与推理纠缠在同一组参数中，难以独立扩展记忆容量。已有的Memory Decoder引入了参数化长期记忆模块，但仅在较小规模上进行了研究，缺乏在大规模数据下的可行性验证。
AI.method: 将Memory Decoder扩展到6.9B参数并在300B token上预训练；针对大规模下标准Faiss管道不可行的瓶颈，设计了分布式Faiss索引与检索管道，并采用稀疏、批量式的kNN分布加载策略。
AI.result: 在17个基准上，6.9B通用记忆配合Pythia-410B将平均分从29.86提升至37.34，超越Pythia-12B（37.24）且总参数减少39%。对Qwen3 Base模型（0.6B-14B），1.7B领域记忆在每个规模上均提升三个领域平均分超过9分。
AI.conclusion: 独立扩展预训练记忆是一种比扩展基座模型更具参数效率的路径，分配更多参数给记忆模块在参数-性能权衡上优于单独扩展基座模型。

title: HALO: Heterogeneous Admission through Localized Obligations for Safe Agentic Execution
summary: Recent agentic AI systems may return a heterogeneous response containing notices, requests, handoffs, and actions. Conditions can change before external use, so components from the same response need not remain supported together. Rejecting the whole response discards useful components, whereas checking components independently can leave a dependent without its prerequisite. We present Heterogeneous Admission with Localized Obligations (HALO), a runtime protocol that preserves supported components whose declared prerequisites also remain supported, rechecks each exact action before dispatch, and allows blocked actions to be replaced only by fresh candidates. HALO matched all 96 admission expectations and passed all 20 protocol tests. In structured-response replay, it retained 248/248 supported components, including 128/128 unaffected by unrelated changes, while a whole-response policy retained 0/248. Across ten cold-start PX4/Gazebo sessions, HALO blocked every tested stale route, observed no matching stale setpoint, and completed all fresh recoveries.

AI.tldr: 提出HALO（异构准入与局部义务）运行时协议，在代理系统返回异构响应后，仅保留其前置条件仍然受支持且被支持的组件，在派发前重新检查每个精确动作，并允许被阻塞的动作仅由新的候选替代，在测试中全部通过预期和协议检验，在结构化重放中保留了248/248个受支持组件。
AI.motivation: 现有代理AI系统可能返回包含通知、请求、移交和动作的异构响应。由于外部使用前的条件可能发生变化，同一响应中的组件不一定能继续得到支持。若整体拒绝会丢弃有用组件，而独立检查组件可能使依赖组件缺少其前置条件。
AI.method: HALO运行时协议：1）仅保留其声明的前置条件仍被支持的受支持组件；2）在派发前重新检查每个精确动作；3）允许被阻塞的动作只能由新的候选替代。
AI.result: HALO匹配了全部96个准入期望并通过了全部20个协议测试。在结构化响应重放中保留了248/248个受支持组件（包括128/128个不受无关更改影响的组件），而整体响应策略仅保留0/248。在十次PX4/Gazebo冷启动会话中，HALO阻止了每个测试的过期航线，未观察到匹配的过期设定点，并完成了所有全新恢复。
AI.conclusion: HALO通过细粒度的组件级准入控制和前置条件检查，在保留有用组件的同时确保系统一致性，相比整体响应策略显著提升了组件保留率，并在真实无人机仿真场景中验证了其有效性。

title: LoMeVQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Longitudinal Medical VQA
comment: 23 pages, 17 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/pepperbubble/LoMeVQA
summary: In clinical practice, patients often undergo multiple imaging examinations over successive visits, yielding longitudinal data. Modeling such temporal information is crucial for reliable assessment of disease progression and treatment response. However, despite the rapid advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), longitudinal medical visual reasoning remains largely underexplored. To fill this gap, we propose LoMeVQA, a comprehensive benchmark consisting of 206K longitudinal visual question answering (VQA) pairs for temporal medical image analysis. LoMeVQA covers five tasks: progress classification, progress description, progress report generation, differential region grounding, and differential region description. To construct the dataset, we develop an automated pipeline that (1) organizes patient records chronologically, (2) extracts clinically meaningful entities via a medical knowledge graph, and (3) models their temporal evolution to guide large language models in generating high-quality longitudinal VQA pairs. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that both general-purpose and medical-domain MLLMs perform poorly on LoMeVQA, revealing substantial limitations in temporal reasoning. To address these limitations, we introduce MedLong-8B, which achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct detailed analyses that uncover key failure modes and shed light on how to improve longitudinal medical visual reasoning. Our data is available at: https://github.com/pepperbubble/LoMeVQA

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoMeVQA——一个包含206K纵向医学图像视觉问答对的大规模基准，覆盖五个任务（进展分类、进展描述、进展报告生成、差异区域定位、差异区域描述），并引入MedLong-8B模型在全部任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中患者多次影像检查产生纵向数据，建模时间信息对疾病进展和治疗反应评估至关重要。然而，尽管多模态大语言模型(MLLM)发展迅速，纵向医学视觉推理仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: (1) 提出LoMeVQA基准：206K纵向VQA对，涵盖五个任务； (2) 构建自动化pipeline：按时间顺序整理患者记录→通过医学知识图谱提取临床相关实体→建模实体时间演化来指导LLM生成高质量纵向VQA对； (3) 提出MedLong-8B模型以提升纵向时间推理能力。
AI.result: 广泛评测显示通用型和医学领域MLLM在LoMeVQA上表现均不理想，暴露了时间推理能力的显著不足。MedLong-8B在全部任务上达到SOTA。详细分析揭示了关键失败模式和改进方向。
AI.conclusion: LoMeVQA填补了纵向医学视觉推理基准的空白，揭示了现有MLLM在此任务上的局限性，MedLong-8B提供了有效解决方案，且详细分析为后续研究指明了改进方向。

title: Expanding Data-Agnostic Pivotal Instances Selection Models with Proximity Trees and Ensemble Learning
summary: As decision-making processes grow more complex, machine learning tools have become essential for tackling business and societal challenges. However, many existing methods rely on decision-making procedures that are difficult to interpret. Since humans naturally make decisions by comparing new cases with a few representative examples, we aim to design an approach that selects such pivots to construct an interpretable predictive model. Inspired by decision trees, we propose a hierarchical, interpretable-by-design pivot selection model based on the similarity between pivots and input instances. Our method functions both as a pivot selection technique and a standalone predictive model. Extending beyond single pivots, we incorporate pairs of pivots that are used by proximity and oblique trees, as well as ensembles, which enhance the versatility and effectiveness of our proposal. Additionally, our approach is data modality-agnostic, leveraging pre-trained networks for data transformation. Experiments across diverse datasets, including tabular data, text, images, and time series, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming alternative instance selection strategies and achieving competitive results against state-of-the-art interpretable models while maintaining a minimal number of pivots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于层次化枢纽点（pivot）选择的可解释预测模型，通过选择代表性实例构建自解释的决策系统，适用于表格、文本、图像和时间序列等多种数据类型。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习决策方法难以解释，而人类自然倾向于通过与少数代表性案例比较来做决策，因此需要一种选择代表性枢纽（pivot）来构建可解释预测模型的方法。
AI.method: 受决策树启发，提出层次化的、设计即解释（interpretable-by-design）的枢纽点选择模型，基于枢纽点与输入实例之间的相似度进行预测。方法扩展了单枢纽点，引入成对枢纽点（借鉴proximity tree和oblique tree的思想），并支持集成学习。该方法同时作为枢纽点选择技术和独立预测模型使用，且不依赖特定数据模态，通过预训练网络进行数据变换。
AI.result: 在表格数据、文本、图像和时间序列等多种数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于其他实例选择策略，与最先进的解释性模型相比具有竞争力，同时仅需最少数量的枢纽点。
AI.conclusion: 提出的层次化枢纽点选择模型是一种多功能、跨模态的可解释预测方法，以极少的代表性实例实现竞争性预测性能，兼具解释性和有效性。

title: RepBench: Compiling Benchmarks into Capability Representations for Large Language Models
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, with appendices. Yanshi Li and Xueru Bai contributed equally
summary: Representation engineering reads and steers capability directions in large language models, yet methods are typically evaluated on paper-specific synthetic data. The resulting measurements are difficult to compare or reproduce and may reflect surface patterns rather than capabilities. We present RepBench, a benchmark-grounded data layer for capability-aligned representation probing. Crawling 13,427 benchmark papers yields a taxonomy of 182 capability clusters in 13 families; harvesting 353 public benchmark datasets yields 46,149 audited probe texts covering 94 capabilities, each supported by at least two independent benchmarks. This multi-benchmark design reduces dependence on any single source: raw per-text vectors exhibit no natural cluster granularity, whereas benchmark-pooled capability vectors show an interior clustering optimum at a small number of clusters on all 12 evaluated models, with low agreement to the human taxonomy. Under cross-benchmark transfer evaluation across twelve models completed by all four readouts, difference-in-means attains the highest model-level mean on ten models, while logistic regression wins the most capability-model cells. This disagreement shows that the readout method and aggregation criterion are meaningful evaluation dimensions. The pipeline, corpus, and evaluation code are released as a reusable closed-loop workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RepBench，一个基于基准测试的能力对齐表示探测数据层。通过爬取13,427篇基准论文（得到182个能力簇、13个家族）和353个公开基准数据集（得到46,149个审计探测文本、覆盖94种能力，每种能力至少由两个独立基准支持），实现了多基准设计以降低对单一数据源的依赖。跨基准迁移评估表明差均值法在12个模型的10个上取得最佳模型级均值，逻辑回归赢得最多的能力-模型单元，证明了读取方法和聚合标准是重要的评估维度。整套流程、语料库和评估代码以可复用的闭环工作流形式发布。
AI.motivation: 现有表示工程技术（读取和操纵大语言模型中的能力方向）通常使用论文特有的合成数据进行评估，导致测量结果难以跨论文比较和复现，且可能反映表面模式而非真实能力。作者旨在构建一个以基准测试为基础的统一数据层，使能力对齐的表示探测评估更具可比性、可复现性，并真正反映模型能力。
AI.method: RepBench包含两个核心组成部分：（1）通过爬取13,427篇基准论文构建了一个包含182个能力簇、13个能力家族的分类体系；（2）从353个公开基准数据集中收集46,149个审计探测文本，覆盖94种能力，每种能力至少由两个独立基准支持。评估流程包括：计算多种表示探测读取方法（如差均值法、逻辑回归等，共四种读取器），在12个模型上执行跨基准迁移评估，并分析原始文本向量与基准池化能力向量的聚类特性。
AI.result: 原始逐文本向量不显示自然聚类粒度，而基准池化的能力向量在所有12个被评估模型上都在少量簇处表现出内部聚类最优，且与人类分类体系的一致性较低。在跨基准迁移评估中，差均值法在12个模型中的10个上获得最高的模型级均值，而逻辑回归在最多的能力-模型单元上获胜，表明读取方法和聚合标准的选择会显著影响评估结果。
AI.conclusion: RepBench证明了读取方法和聚合标准是表示探测评估中不可忽视的维度。通过多基准支持和闭环可复用工作流设计，RepBench为表示工程研究提供了更可靠、可复现且具可比性的评估基础设施，有助于区分表面模式与真实能力方向。

title: Evaluating and Pricing Advertisements in AI-Generated Responses
summary: As search increasingly shifts toward LLM-driven answer engines, advertising is becoming embedded within the generated response itself and should therefore be evaluated for both user utility and commercial value. The key challenge is click-through intent: behavioural logs are unavailable, human annotation resists calibration, and frontier LLM judges conflate intent with linguistic fluency. These gaps compound, as principled pricing presupposes a continuous intent signal, while generating such a signal presupposes supervision that is currently unavailable. We construct the missing supervision through a psychologically grounded agent simulation framework, and distil it into a parameter-efficient evaluator that predicts click-through intent, together with the three companion dimensions of ad quality, as smooth, differentiable estimates. Validated through sign-certain behavioural perturbations, the evaluator surpasses frontier zero-shot judges on relevance sensitivity (79% versus 60-67%), tracks graded content degradation, generalises without error to 103 fictional products, and agrees with human preference in 86% of pairwise judgements across five annotators, with agreement rising in the evaluator's confidence. Upon its estimates we build the pricing layer directly, deriving the unique payment rule under which truthful bidding is optimal, demonstrating it on a best-of-k allocation, and extending the mechanism to non-monotone allocations. The same differentiable signal stands ready as a training objective for ad generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM驱动的答案引擎中广告嵌入的点击意图评估难题，构建了一个基于心理学启发的智能体模拟框架来生成监督信号，并将其蒸馏为参数高效的评估器，可预测点击意图及广告质量的三个伴随维度；在此评估器之上直接构建定价层，推导出唯一使诚实出价最优的支付规则，并扩展到非单调分配场景。
AI.motivation: 搜索正转向LLM驱动的答案引擎，广告嵌入在生成响应内部，需要同时评估用户效用与商业价值。核心挑战在于点击意图信号缺失：行为日志不可用、人工标注难以校准、前沿LLM评判器将意图与语言流畅性混淆。这些缺口相互叠加——原则性的定价预设了连续的意图信号，而生成该信号又预设了当前不可用的监督。
AI.method: 通过心理学基础的智能体模拟框架构造缺失的监督信号，并将其蒸馏为参数高效的评估器，输出点击意图及广告质量三个伴随维度的平滑可微估计。在评估器输出之上直接构建定价层，推导唯一使真实出价最优的支付规则，在best-of-k分配上验证，并扩展至非单调分配机制。
AI.result: 在符号确定的行为扰动验证下，评估器在相关性敏感性上以79%对60-67%超越前沿零样本评判器；能追踪分级内容退化；对103个虚构产品零误差泛化；与五位标注者的成对判断有86%的一致性，且一致性随评估器置信度上升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅提供了可用的点击意图评估信号，还证明了同一可微信号可直接用作广告生成的训练目标，形成了评估-定价-生成的闭环框架。

title: SPFM-Net: Semantic-Prior-Guided Frequency-Constrained Mamba for Invisible Watermark Attack
summary: Existing watermark attacks typically rely on predefined signal-processing operations or locally constrained restoration networks, making it difficult to capture the long-range dependencies of globally distributed watermark signals and resulting in an unfavorable trade-off between removal effectiveness and visual fidelity. In this paper, we propose SPFM-Net, a semantic-prior-guided and frequency-constrained Mamba framework for invisible watermark attack. SPFM-Net first employs high-ratio masking to disrupt the spatial coherence of invisible watermark signals, and then utilizes a partially fine-tuned pretrained Masked Autoencoder to reconstruct semantically consistent image from sparse observations while suppressing watermark-related information. A Multi-scale Residual Frequency Feature Interaction module subsequently aggregates watermark-related residual features across multiple receptive fields, while adaptively suppressing responses from watermark-irrelevant regions. To further capture the long-range dependencies of globally distributed watermark signals, a lightweight Mamba-based Global State-space Feature Modeling (GSFM) unit is introduced to separate watermark-related features from natural image content and suppress the remaining watermark traces. In addition, SPFM-Net is optimized using a multi-level objective that jointly imposes spatial-, frequency-, and edge-domain constraints, enabling effective watermark suppression while preserving perceptual quality. Extensive experiments on representative spatial-domain, transform-domain, orthogonal moment-based, and deep learning-based watermarking schemes demonstrate that SPFM-Net achieves a favorable trade-off between watermark attack effectiveness and perceptual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPFM-Net，一种基于语义先验引导和频率约束的Mamba框架，用于不可见水印攻击。该方法通过高比例掩蔽破坏水印空间连贯性、部分微调预训练Masked Autoencoder重建语义一致图像、多尺度残差频率特征交互模块聚合水印相关残差特征、轻量级Mamba全局状态空间特征建模单元捕获全局水印长程依赖，并采用多层次目标函数在空间、频率和边缘域联合约束，实现水印抑制与感知保真度之间的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有水印攻击方法通常依赖预定义的信号处理操作或局部受限的恢复网络，难以捕获全局分布水印信号的长程依赖关系，导致去除效果与视觉保真度之间难以取得理想平衡。
AI.method: SPFM-Net包含四个核心组件：(1) 高比例掩蔽模块破坏不可见水印的空间连贯性；(2) 部分微调预训练Masked Autoencoder从稀疏观测中重建语义一致图像并抑制水印信息；(3) 多尺度残差频率特征交互模块（MRFFI）跨多个感受野聚合水印相关残差特征，同时自适应抑制非水印区域响应；(4) 轻量级Mamba全局状态空间特征建模单元（GSFM）分离水印相关特征与自然图像内容并抑制残余水印痕迹。模型采用多层次目标函数实现空间、频率和边缘域联合约束。
AI.result: 在代表性的空间域、变换域、正交矩和基于深度学习的水印方案上进行的大量实验表明，SPFM-Net在水印攻击有效性和感知保真度之间取得了有利的权衡。
AI.conclusion: SPFM-Net通过语义先验引导与频率约束相结合的设计，有效解决了全局水印信号长程依赖捕获难题，在水印攻击任务中实现了去除效果与视觉质量的优越平衡。

title: Latent-Kernel Discrete Flow Maps for Few-Step Generation
summary: Discrete diffusion and flow-matching models denoise a sequence over many steps, but to keep each step cheap, they factorize the transition across positions and decide every token independently. This makes few-step generation challenging for text when the target couples two positions, such as a subject and a verb that must agree. An independent update commits to them separately, and many function evaluations are spent repairing the mismatch. Existing few-step methods buy back the lost correlation by distilling or rectifying a slow teacher, and so inherit the teacher's quality ceiling. We ask instead whether a model can express correlated steps natively, and answer with Latent-Kernel Discrete Flow Maps (LKF), a from-scratch flow-map kernel that is a mixture of M factorized components tied by a single shared latent. Conditioned on the latent, each component is cheap, and the mixture is summed over the latent in closed form for small M. We show that a single step places mass on correlated completions with the same sampling time complexity as a factorized model, since one latent is drawn per sequence and reused across the entire denoising trajectory. We also show that the Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) is a special case of our LKF model at M=1. The experiments for unconditional text generation on the One-Billion-Word (LM1B) and WikiText-103 benchmarks show that our LKF model learns strongly heterogeneous components and improves generative perplexity by 2.1x to 3.3x over the likelihood baselines without losing diversity. The gain grows with M, and at M=8, it surpasses distilled and rectified few-step samplers. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/lkf.git

AI.tldr: 提出Latent-Kernel Discrete Flow Maps (LKF)，一种从头训练的流图核，通过共享潜变量的M个因子化分量混合来原生表达相关性步骤，在少步文本生成中显著优于现有蒸馏/整流方法。
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散与流匹配模型在每步独立因子化地决定每个token，导致少步生成时难以处理涉及两个位置耦合的目标（如主谓一致），需要大量函数评估修复不匹配。少步方法通过蒸馏或整流慢速教师模型来弥补，但继承了教师的质量上限。
AI.method: LKF是一个混合M个因子化分量并由单一共享潜变量连接的流图核。给定潜变量后每个分量计算廉价，小M情况下混合在潜变量上以闭式求和。每序列仅抽取一个潜变量并在整个去噪轨迹中复用，因此单步采样时间复杂度与因子化模型相同。MDLM是M=1时的特例。
AI.result: 在LM1B和WikiText-103无条件和无条件文本生成实验中，LKF学习到强异构的分量，生成困惑度相比似然基线提升2.1x至3.3x，且不损失多样性。增益随M增大而增大，M=8时超越蒸馏和整流少步采样器。
AI.conclusion: LKF证明了从零训练的流模型可以原生表达相关性步骤，以与因子化模型相同的采样复杂度获得更强的少步生成能力，为少步文本生成提供了一条不依赖教师蒸馏的新路径。

title: LEEPS: Latent-Guided Explore-Exploit Prompt Sampling for Efficient RLVR in Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but prompt groups with identical rollout rewards consume generation budget without effective learning signals. Pre-rollout prompt selection can reduce this waste by screening prompts before rollout generation. However, existing pre-rollout methods struggle to balance exploitation and exploration: repeatedly exploiting historically informative prompts can narrow training coverage, whereas broader exploration can lower the fraction of informative prompts. To address these limitations, we introduce LEEPS, a Latent-Guided Explore--Exploit Prompt Sampler that adaptively balances the reuse of previously observed informative prompts with continued exploration of uncertain ones. LEEPS partitions candidates into exploit and explore portfolios and adaptively allocates rollout budget according to their recent non-trivial ratios. It further uses representation-space neighbors and historical rollout outcomes to prioritize uncertain prompts likely to yield non-zero reward variance, thereby making exploration more targeted without additional rollouts. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LEEPS achieves the highest average score at both model scales, with relative gains of 2.6\% and 3.7\% over the strongest baseline for Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 7B, respectively, and generally improves faster during the training process. It also achieves the highest average score across the three evaluated OOD general-reasoning benchmarks at both model scales and adds only about 2 seconds of online sampling overhead per training step. Code is available at https://github.com/ShuangLiangX/LEEPS.

AI.tldr: LEEPS是一个基于潜在空间的探索-利用提示采样器，用于在RLVR训练中自适应地平衡提示的利用与探索，通过历史奖励信息和表示空间邻居来筛选提示，在6个数学推理基准和3个OOD泛化推理基准上超越最强基线，仅增加约2秒的在线采样开销。
AI.motivation: RLVR中具有相同rollout奖励的提示组会浪费生成预算而不产生有效学习信号。现有的预rollout提示选择方法难以平衡利用与探索：过度利用历史信息丰富的提示会缩小训练覆盖范围，而更广泛的探索则会降低有效提示的比例。因此需要一种能自适应平衡两者关系的预rollout提示采样方法。
AI.method: LEEPS将候选提示划分为利用（exploit）和探索（explore）两个投资组合，根据最近的"非平凡比例"（non-trivial ratios）自适应分配rollout预算。它利用表示空间中的邻居和历史rollout结果来优先选择可能产生非零奖励方差的未确定提示，从而在无需额外rollout的情况下使探索更具针对性。
AI.result: 在6个数学推理基准上，LEEPS在两种模型规模下均取得最高平均分，相比最强基线在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B和7B上分别获得2.6%和3.7%的相对提升，且在训练过程中通常收敛更快。在3个OOD通用推理基准上也取得最高平均分，在线采样开销每训练步仅约2秒。
AI.conclusion: LEEPS通过自适应平衡探索与利用，有效减少了RLVR训练中的低效提示生成，提升了数学推理和泛化推理性能，同时保持极低的计算开销，展示了预rollout提示选择在提升RLVR效率方面的潜力。

title: Rehearse: Stepping Back from the Confidence Cliff in Self-Improving Autoresearch
summary: Autoresearch improves machine-learning code by proposing changes, running full training jobs, and keeping changes that improve the metric. The efficiency of this loop depends not only on generating ideas, but also on the agent's ability to decide, before spending a training run, whether a proposed modification is likely to work. We study how the reliability of this pre-execution judgment changes over the course of an autoresearch trajectory. In public AutoSOTA logs (Li et al., 2026; Tsinghua FIB Lab, 2026), the fraction of helpful modifications falls from 70% in the first two iterations to 43% by iteration 6+. On 296 same-baseline modification pairs from 39 paper-derived AutoSOTA tasks, each containing one modification that improved the metric and one that did not, with measured outcomes hidden, an LLM judge given candidate rationales but no prior-attempt history reaches 79.5% accuracy on the pairs where strict consensus returns a verdict. On the full 366-pair benchmark, however, this ability weakens substantially late in the loop. As successful changes accumulate, selective accuracy - accuracy conditioned on a strict-consensus verdict - falls from 82.8% to 56.9%, while the judge remains willing to decide. We call this operational pattern the confidence cliff. Rehearse implements the loop change as a lightweight skill for autoresearch loops: propose several ideas, compare them before execution, run the most promising, and judge with a focused memory of similar past attempts and outcomes. This focused outcome memory raises late selective accuracy to 83.5%. Across 4,000 budgeted training runs over three loops, Rehearse improves the endpoint under the same training-run budget on nanochat, image classification, and time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动研究（autoresearch）循环中预执行判断的可靠性问题，发现随着循环推进，智能体判断修改是否有用的准确率从82.8%降至56.9%（"置信度悬崖"），并提出Rehearse方法——通过聚焦的历史尝试记忆来提升后期选择性准确率至83.5%，在相同训练预算下改善三个任务的终点性能。
AI.motivation: 自动研究循环的效率不仅取决于生成想法，还取决于智能体在花费训练成本之前判断提议修改是否有效的决策能力。但随着成功修改不断累积，这种预执行判断能力显著退化，导致训练资源浪费，因此需要理解和改善这一能力衰减问题。
AI.method: 首先在公共AutoSOTA日志中发现"置信度悬崖"模式（有用修改比例从70%降至43%）；构建包含366对修改的基准测试集，用LLM法官在无先前尝试历史的情况下评估判断准确性；然后提出Rehearse方法——在循环变更中引入技能：提议多个想法、在执行前比较、运行最有前景者，并通过聚焦的相似过去尝试和结果记忆（focused outcome memory）进行判断。
AI.result: LLM法官在严格共识可判定的修改对上达到79.5%准确率；但在完整366对基准上，后期选择性准确率从82.8%降至56.9%。Rehearse的聚焦结果记忆将后期选择性准确率提升至83.5%。在4,000次预算训练运行中、跨越三个循环，Rehearse在nanochat、图像分类和时间序列预测任务上于相同训练预算下改善了终点指标。
AI.conclusion: 自动研究中的预执行判断存在"置信度悬崖"退化现象，但通过Rehearse这样的聚焦历史记忆机制可以有效缓解，显著提升后期判断准确率并改善资源利用效率，为构建可持续的自动机器学习研究循环提供了实用方案。

title: Hallucinations Leave a Grounding Signature:Verifier-Guided Decoding for Selective Object Correction
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate objects that are absent from an image. Despite recent progress, existing mitigation methods still lack reliable object-level grounding diagnostics and therefore tend to apply coarse-grained interventions, which can impair visual understanding, shorten responses, and reduce coverage of genuinely grounded objects. The key challenge is thus to detect, during generation, whether each emerging object mention is supported by reliable visual evidence, so that hallucination can be mitigated selectively. Yet output confidence reflects next-token plausibility rather than visual support, allowing language priors to make absent objects appear certain. We show that the missing diagnostic evidence is encoded in an Intrinsic Grounding Signature (IGS), a distributed signed attention pattern that remains informative for such confident hallucinations. Based on IGS, we propose Verifier-Guided Decoding (VGD), a decoding framework in which a lightweight verifier examines each emerging object mention, rolls back the KV cache when the mention is identified as high risk, suppresses the object and its synonyms, and regenerates the affected continuation. Because VGD intervenes only on object mentions identified as high risk, it reduces object hallucination while preserving the model's original visual understanding and grounded object coverage. Experiments on CHAIR and AMBER-G show that VGD achieves state-of-the-art object hallucination reduction: at @rec90, it cuts AMBER-G CHAIR by 43.6\% while retaining 99.6\% of grounded-object coverage, and reduces CHAIR-MSCOCO CHAIR$_i$/CHAIR$_s$ by 37.0\%/30.4\% without shortening captions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于内在接地签名（IGS）的验证器引导解码（VGD）框架，用于在图像生成过程中有针对性地减少大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的对象幻觉，同时保持其视觉理解能力和接地对象覆盖率。
AI.motivation: LVLM常常幻觉出图像中不存在的对象。现有缓解方法缺乏可靠的对象级接地诊断，往往采用粗粒度的干预方式，这会损害视觉理解、缩短响应并降低真正接地对象的覆盖率。关键挑战是在生成过程中检测每个新出现的对象提及是否有可靠的视觉证据支持。此外，输出置信度反映的是下一个标记的合理性而非视觉支持度，语言先验可能使不存在的对象看起来非常确定，因此需要更可靠的诊断信号。
AI.method: 论文发现缺失的诊断证据编码在内在接地签名（IGS）中——一种分布式的有符号注意力模式，即使对高置信度的幻觉对象也保持信息量。基于IGS，提出验证器引导解码（VGD）框架：一个轻量级验证器检查每个新出现的对象提及，当识别为高风险时回滚KV缓存，抑制该对象及其同义词，并重新生成受影响的后续文本。VGD仅在识别为高风险的对象提及上进行干预。
AI.result: 在CHAIR和AMBER-G数据集上的实验表明，VGD实现了最先进的对象幻觉减少效果：在@rec90指标下，AMBER-G CHAIR降低了43.6%且保留了99.6%的接地对象覆盖率；CHAIR-MSCOCO的CHAIR_i/CHAIR_s分别降低了37.0%/30.4%，且没有缩短生成的标题长度。
AI.conclusion: VGD通过在解码过程中选择性干预高风险的幻觉对象提及，在显著减少对象幻觉的同时几乎完全保留接地对象覆盖率，证明基于IGS的细粒度诊断能够在保持模型原生能力的同时有效缓解幻觉问题。

title: When Does Explicit View Routing Work? A Controlled Study of Multi-View Graph-Text Alignment
summary: Graph-text retrieval typically maps a graph and its description to a single embedding, even when a query concerns only one semantic aspect, such as a class label or molecular property. Multiple heads can separate these aspects, but a change in the query head may alter retrieval even when the wrong text is sent to that head. Such behavior demonstrates architectural channelization, not necessarily semantic routing. We examine the conditions under which this distinction can be resolved. Our controlled version of MV-GTA uses deterministic, verifiable text segments; isolated text encoders; view-specific graph heads; and relevance derived from external labels or RDKit descriptors. Correct routing and per-sample derangements form a causal test of whether retrieval depends on content. On BBBP and BACE, correct routing improves label and property nDCG by 0.305 to 0.685 over deranged training. The expected graph head exceeds the best wrong head by 0.303 to 0.453. Topology does not specialize consistently across the two datasets. In a matched three-seed comparison, one joint model obtains mean topology, label, and property nDCG of 0.720/1.000/0.877; three separately trained Single specialists obtain 0.633/0.976/0.859. Property paraphrase augmentation also improves unseen-template nDCG by 0.140 and 0.147 over a matched-exposure canonical control. Consistency and hard-template extensions, however, reduce canonical retrieval in some settings. The evidence is therefore limited to explicit, externally grounded label and property routing and observed multi-interface consolidation. It does not establish free-form routing, consistent three-view specialization, statistical equivalence to specialists, or superior downstream prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控MV-GTA实验研究了图-文本检索中多头架构的语义路由问题，证明当使用外部标签或RDKit描述符作为相关性依据时，正确的路由能显著提升检索性能，但该证据仅局限于显式、外部有依据的标签和属性路由，不适用于自由格式路由或多视图一致性特化。
AI.motivation: 现有图-文本检索通常将图及其描述映射到单一嵌入，即使查询只涉及一个语义方面（如类别标签或分子性质）。多头机制虽能分离不同方面，但改变查询头可能导致检索结果变化，即使错误文本被发送到该头，这反映的是架构通道化而非语义路由。作者旨在厘清这一区分并检验语义路由是否真正发生。
AI.method: 构建受控的MV-GTA实验：使用确定性、可验证的文本段；隔离的文本编码器；视图特定的图头；相关性来源于外部标签或RDKit描述符。通过正确路由与逐样本乱序（derangement）训练形成因果测试，并在BBBP和BACE数据集上进行多种配置的比较，包括联合模型与单独训练的单专业模型的匹配三种子对比，以及属性释义增强实验。
AI.result: 在BBBP和BACE上，正确路由比乱序训练在标签和属性nDCG上提升0.305至0.685；期望图头超过最佳错误头0.303至0.453。拓扑在两个数据集上未一致特化。三种子匹配比较中，联合模型在均值拓扑/标签/属性nDCG上为0.720/1.000/0.877，而三个单独训练的Single专家为0.633/0.976/0.859。属性释义增强在未见模板nDCG上比匹配曝光典范对照提升0.140和0.147，但硬模板扩展在某些设置下降低典范检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 证据仅支持显式、外部有依据的标签和属性路由以及观察到的多接口整合，但不足以建立自由格式路由、一致的三视图特化、与专家的统计等效性或更好的下游预测。

title: GGC: Selective Query Correction for Reliable Text-to-SPARQL Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in structured query generation, making them a natural choice for Text-to-SPARQL, which translates natural language questions into executable SPARQL queries over knowledge graphs. However, their initial outputs remain unreliable: generated queries may be executable yet semantically misaligned with input questions, leading to incorrect retrieval. To address this issue, we propose Generator-Gate-Corrector (GGC), a framework for reliable LLM-based Text-to-SPARQL generation. GGC first uses a Generator to produce an initial query, then applies a Gate to predict whether correction is needed, and finally invokes a Corrector only for selected high-risk queries. This selective correction mechanism avoids unnecessary modifications and reduces the risk of degrading originally correct queries. Experiments on MCQA show that GGC improves query-level accuracy from 90.23\% to 98.33\% while reducing inference overhead by 45\% compared with correcting all generated queries. Ablation studies show that the Gate is robust across thresholds and that Corrector training data composition affects correction effectiveness and stability. Overall, the results demonstrate that selective correction enhances the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of LLM-based text-to-SPARQL generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Generator-Gate-Corrector (GGC)框架，用于提升LLM在Text-to-SPARQL任务中的可靠性。通过引入门控机制选择性修正高风险查询，在MCQA数据集上将查询级准确率从90.23%提升至98.33%，同时相比全量修正降低了45%的推理开销。
AI.motivation: LLM在Text-to-SPARQL任务中虽已展现强大能力，但其初始输出仍不可靠——生成的查询可能可执行但与输入问题语义不对齐，导致错误检索。全量修正所有生成查询虽能改善质量，但会造成不必要的修改并引入推理开销，甚至可能降低原本正确查询的质量。
AI.method: GGC框架包含三个组件：1) Generator首先生成初始SPARQL查询；2) Gate模型预测该查询是否需要修正；3) 仅对Gate判定为高风险的查询调用Corrector进行修正。这种选择性修正机制避免了不必要的修改，降低了破坏原本正确查询的风险。
AI.result: 在MCQA数据集上，GGC将查询级准确率从90.23%提升至98.33%，同时相比全量修正方案降低了45%的推理开销。消融实验表明Gate在不同阈值下具有鲁棒性，且Corrector训练数据构成影响修正的有效性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性修正机制能够显著增强LLM-based Text-to-SPARQL生成的准确性、可靠性和效率，验证了"按需修正"策略相比"全量修正"策略在性能和成本之间取得更优平衡。

title: Guiding Large Language Models with Genetic Programming-Evolved Heuristic Knowledge for Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
summary: In dynamic multi-mode project scheduling, activities have alternative execution modes and uncertain durations, while precedence relations and limited resources constrain their execution. Heuristic priority rules support fast online decisions, but their design requires substantial domain expertise. Genetic programming (GP) hyper-heuristics can automatically evolve such rules. Large language models (LLMs), meanwhile, provide a flexible interface for interpreting scheduling information and explaining decisions. However, zero-shot LLM decisions may lack domain knowledge, consume many tokens, and vary across repeated queries. GP-evolved rules therefore provide a potential source of scheduling knowledge for guiding LLM decisions. Unlike existing LLM--GP hybrids that use LLMs to support heuristic evolution, we transfer knowledge in the reverse direction, using knowledge extracted from high-quality GP rules to guide an online LLM decision maker. We extract knowledge from high-quality GP rules and inject it through Feature Selection, Feature Hint, Rule Reference, and Rule Follow. These mechanisms are evaluated in terms of scheduling performance, token consumption, decision stability, and the feature focus expressed in generated rationales. GP-derived guidance generally improves the unguided LLM, but its representation matters. Simplifying the decision context or supplying explicit decision logic is more effective than highlighting important features. Feature Selection offers the best token efficiency, whereas Rule Follow achieves strong performance at greater token cost. Guidance also improves decision stability and changes the features expressed in generated rationales.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将GP进化出的高质量调度规则中的知识反向注入到大语言模型（LLM）在线决策器中，通过特征选择、特征提示、规则引用和规则遵循四种机制实现知识迁移，评估其调度性能、令牌消耗、决策稳定性和生成理由的特征关注度。
AI.motivation: 动态多模式项目调度中，启发式优先规则设计需要大量领域专业知识；GP超启发式能自动进化此类规则，但零样本LLM决策缺乏领域知识、令牌开销大且决策不稳定。现有LLM-GP混合方法主要利用LLM辅助启发式进化，本文希望反向利用GP规则中的调度知识来引导LLM决策。
AI.method: 从高质量GP规则中提取知识，通过四种机制注入LLM在线决策器：Feature Selection（简化决策上下文）、Feature Hint（强调重要特征）、Rule Reference（引用GP规则）、Rule Follow（遵循GP规则逻辑）。从调度性能、令牌消耗、决策稳定性及生成理由特征聚焦度四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: GP衍生的引导总体能提升无引导LLM的性能，但知识表征方式至关重要。简化决策上下文或提供明确决策逻辑比仅高亮重要特征更有效。特征选择在令牌效率上最优，规则遵循在更高令牌成本下取得强性能。引导还能改善决策稳定性并改变生成理由中的特征表达。
AI.conclusion: 从GP规则到LLM的知识反向迁移是可行的，且知识注入的表示形式对LLM调度决策质量有显著影响；简化上下文和显式决策逻辑是更有效的引导方式。

title: Thinking Once Is Enough: Intermediate-Layer Evidence Routing for High-Resolution VQA
summary: High-resolution visual question answering (HR-VQA) is often treated as a problem of insufficient evidence acquisition, where failing multimodal large language models must inspect images again through cropping, re-encoding, or multi-round search. We show that this view is incomplete: in many cases, fine-grained evidence has already survived visual encoding and become identifiable and influential within an intermediate-layer routing window, but is later diluted before answer generation. We propose Thinking-Once, a \textbf{training-free, single-visual-pass} evidence-routing method that reconstructs question-conditioned attention at this window, preserves core entity tokens and compact background context, and routes this evidence to later layers without extra visual encoding. Across five base models, Thinking-Once consistently improves or matches the corresponding base setting, increasing the average scores on V$^*$Bench, HRBench-4K, and HRBench-8K by \textit{+3.1}, \textit{+3.0}, and \textit{+2.7} points while reducing the average peak memory by about 4,GB. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, it improves the three benchmarks by \textit{+9.9}, \textit{+4.6}, and \textit{+5.5} points, raising the cross-benchmark mean from 72.5 to 79.1. With the ZwZ-8B base model, Thinking-Once reaches a mean score of 82.7. Against 11 open-source HR-VQA baselines, it obtains the best or tied-best score on all three benchmark averages and the best overall mean; for example, compared with DeepScan, it reduces V$^*$Bench inference time by \textbf{97.2\%} while improving the cross-benchmark mean from 77.8 to 79.1. These results show that HR-VQA can be improved by routing already encoded evidence rather than repeatedly acquiring new visual inputs. Code is available in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出Thinking-Once，一种免训练、单次视觉pass的证据路由方法，解决高分辨率VQA中细粒度证据在中间层被稀释的问题，不依赖额外的视觉编码即可提升多个基准分数并降低内存。
AI.motivation: 现有HR-VQA通常被视为证据获取不足问题，需要通过裁剪、重新编码或多轮搜索反复获取视觉信息。作者证明这一观点不完整：在许多情况下，细粒度证据已存活于视觉编码并可在中间层路由窗口中被识别和影响，但在答案生成前被稀释。因此需要一种能在中间层有效路由已有证据的方法。
AI.method: Thinking-Once在中间层路由窗口内重建基于问题条件的注意力，保留核心实体token和紧凑背景上下文，并将这些证据路由至后续层。该方法完全无需训练，且仅需单次视觉前向传播，不引入额外视觉编码开销。
AI.result: 在五个基础模型上一致改善或匹配基线效果：V*Bench、HRBench-4K、HRBench-8K平均分分别提升+3.1、+3.0、+2.7，平均峰值内存降低约4GB。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上三个基准提升+9.9、+4.6、+5.5，跨基准均值从72.5提升至79.1；在ZwZ-8B上达到82.7均值。对比11个开源HR-VQA基线，在所有三个基准平均分上取得最佳或并列最佳，综合均值最佳；相比DeepScan，V*Bench推理时间降低97.2%且跨基准均值从77.8提升至79.1。
AI.conclusion: HR-VQA可以通过路由已编码的证据而非反复获取新的视觉输入来改进，这为高分辨率视觉问答提供了一种高效且无需额外训练的新思路。

title: Subtract or Replay? Exact Deletion from Language-Model Memory
summary: Exact deletion from persistent language-model memory depends on how that memory represents a record. Addressable influence can be removed by algebraic decrement; influence transformed by later writes inside shared recurrent state requires rebuilding from before the write. We test this distinction in two pretrained models against explicit record-omitted references. First, we replace Gemma 3's global-attention layers with support-vector memory. After low-rank recovery at 1B, decrement and retained-key refit agree at the next-token output to median KL $5.4\times10^{-15}$ over 31 support-token deletions, with $+2.0\%$ perplexity relative to a matched fine-tune. A masked-refit proxy is indistinguishable from the never-ingested floor under elicitation, relearning, sampling, and LiRA attacks. At 4B and 12B, certificate ordering persists but utility cost rises to $11.2\%$ and $44.3\%$. Second, in a 48B Kimi Linear hybrid, additive writes admit a fixed decrement and diagonal decay a corrected one, whereas the delta rule makes $12$--$49\%$ of a record's contribution suffix-dependent. Checkpointed rewind-and-replay deletes real clinical records at contexts up to 18,842 tokens, matching never-ingested logits and all recurrent states bit for bit within a deterministic MLX implementation; replaying a correction provides exact amendment. Exact deletion is therefore a property of memory representation: subtract addressable records and replay entangled writes.

AI.tldr:
本文提出"精确删除"依赖于记忆表征方式：对于可寻址的影响力可用代数减法删除；对于在共享循环状态中被后续写入变换的影响力，需从写入前重建。作者在多个预训练模型上验证了这一区分。

在Gemma 3中，用支持向量记忆替换全局注意力层，1B规模下递减与保留键重拟合在下一位token输出上达到中位KL 5.4×10⁻¹⁵（31个支持token删除），困惑度相对匹配微调+2.0%；掩码重拟合代理在引发、重学习、采样和LiRA攻击下与从未摄入基线不可区分。4B和12B下证书排序保持但效用成本升至11.2%和44.3%。在48B Kimi Linear混合模型中，加法写入支持固定递减，对角衰减支持修正递减，而delta规则使记录的12%-49%贡献具有后缀依赖性。检查点回退重放（rewind-and-replay）在最长18,842 token临床记录上实现精确删除，在确定性MLX实现中匹配从未摄入的logits和所有循环状态（逐位一致）；重放修正实现精确修订。结论：精确删除是记忆表征的属性——减去可寻址记录，重放纠缠的写入。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的持久记忆中如何精确删除特定记录是一个关键但未被充分研究的问题。现有方法通常难以区分"可寻址影响"与"被后续写入在共享循环状态中变换的影响"，导致删除不彻底或效用损失过大。作者旨在厘清精确删除与记忆表征之间的关系，并提出系统性的删除策略。
AI.method: 作者提出一个理论区分框架：(1) 可寻址影响力可通过代数递减（algebraic decrement）直接删除；(2) 被共享循环状态中后续写入变换的影响力需通过从写入前状态重建（rebuilding）来处理。实证方法包括：在Gemma 3中用支持向量记忆替换全局注意力层，进行低秩恢复后进行递减与保留键重拟合对比；在48B Kimi Linear混合模型中分析加法写入、对角衰减和delta规则三种写入机制的删除特性，并实现检查点回退重放（rewind-and-replay）策略。
AI.result: 在1B Gemma 3上，递减与保留键重拟合在31个支持token删除上达到中位KL 5.4×10⁻¹⁵的高度一致，困惑度相对于匹配微调仅+2.0%；掩码重拟合在多种攻击下与从未摄入基线不可区分。4B和12B下效用成本分别升至11.2%和44.3%。在48B Kimi Linear中，delta规则导致12%-49%的记录贡献具有后缀依赖性（无法简单删除），而加法写入和对角衰减可修正删除。回退重放方法在最长18,842 token的临床记录上实现逐位精确的删除和修订。
AI.conclusion: 精确删除是记忆表征的属性而非通用算法问题：对于可寻址记录使用代数递减，对于纠缠的写入使用回退重放。不同模型架构（注意力、混合线性）和不同写入机制（加法、对角线衰减、delta规则）决定了删除的可行性与成本。当删除成本随规模上升显著增加（44.3%在12B），需要在记忆表征设计层面考虑可删除性。

title: Challenges in annotations by humans and LLMs: A case study of evaluative language
summary: In this paper, we draw a comparison between linguists in training, a trained linguist, and annotations generated by large language models (LLMs) to find out if they struggle with complex linguistic phenomena in a similar way. For this purpose, we analyse evaluative language in spoken popular science discourse, with the example of a corpus of English TED talk transcripts. We focus on the Appraisal theory and its Attitude subsystem, including the categories (classes) of Affect, Judgement, and Appreciation. In this context, Appraisal theory is an example of a highly subjective annotation task, making it a suitable example for the study of complex annotation challenges. First, we assess human annotations on a sentence level in specific scientific domains. Then, we develop three prompts and compare them for model performance for the automatic classification of Appraisal classes. We assess the performance of three LLMs using the best-performing prompt and finetune the model, reaching an F1-score of 0.77. We find that models perform best compared to annotations conducted by the trained linguist, while linguists in training do not reach high agreement scores. We conclude that LLMs can aid in complex annotation task resolution, opening new pathways for the complex theories annotated and analyzed in digital humanities studies.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了受训语言学家、受训中的语言学家以及大语言模型（LLMs）在复杂语言学现象标注上的表现，以英语TED演讲语料为对象，聚焦评价理论（Appraisal theory）中的态度子系统（Affect、Judgement、Appreciation）。研究发现LLMs的最佳表现与训练有素的语言学家的标注接近，F1得分达0.77，而受训中的语言学家一致性较低，表明LLMs可为数字人文中复杂理论标注任务提供辅助。
AI.motivation: 评价理论（Appraisal theory）是一种高度主观的标注任务，人类标注者（尤其是受训中的语言学家）在此类复杂标注中难以达到高一致性。作者希望探索LLMs是否能在此类复杂语言学现象的标注任务中表现良好，并比较其与不同层次人类标注者的差异。
AI.method: 研究以英语TED演讲语料为数据，聚焦口语科普话语中的评价语言，采用Appraisal理论及其态度子系统（Affect、Judgement、Appreciation）进行分类标注。研究流程包括：1) 在句子层面评估人类标注者在特定科学领域中的表现；2) 开发三种提示词（prompts）并比较LLMs的自动分类性能；3) 使用最优提示词评估三个LLM，并对最佳模型进行微调。
AI.result: 微调后的模型达到了0.77的F1分数。LLMs的表现最接近由训练有素的语言学家完成的标注，而受训中的语言学家未能达到较高的标注一致率。
AI.conclusion: LLMs能够助力解决复杂标注任务，为数字人文研究中复杂理论的标注与分析开辟了新途径。

title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. We further introduce SpatialCLI-Bench, a 516-example benchmark for compositional perception across localization, segmentation, depth, and pose. On MindCube, SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol with tools (72.1%), while retaining 73.8% without tools after internalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialCLI框架，赋予视觉语言模型（VLM）空间工具推理能力，并逐步内化专家视觉模型的感知能力，在组合感知任务上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 通用VLM能理解整体任务但常遗漏关键视觉细节，而专用视觉模型能捕捉细节却无法将其转化为任务级决策。这种能力错配限制了VLM在具身智能体中的应用。
AI.method: SpatialCLI采用三阶段框架：(1) Call：将专用视觉模型暴露为空间工具以增强VLM感知；(2) Learn：通过冷启动有监督微调（Cold-Start SFT）和智能体强化学习（agentic RL）改进工具使用；(3) Internalize：将成功的工具使用轨迹进行语言化，使VLM内化专用感知能力。同时提出SpatialCLI-Bench基准，包含516个覆盖定位、分割、深度和姿态的组合感知示例。
AI.result: 在MindCube基准上，SpatialCLI将Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct从29.3%提升至84.6%（带工具），超越GPT-5.6 Sol的72.1%（带工具）；内化后无工具情况下仍保持73.8%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: SpatialCLI证明了通过空间工具的调用、学习与内化，VLM可以有效弥合与专用视觉模型之间的感知能力差距，实现从工具依赖到自身能力内化的渐进式过渡。

title: SAFViT: Spatial Attention Fusion Gating for Vision Transformer-Based Nucleus Segmentation and Classification
summary: Accurate cell segmentation and classification are foundational to digital pathology, enabling quantitative tissue analysis for diagnosis and treatment planning. Encoder-decoder architectures that fuse multi-scale features through skip connections have become the dominant paradigm for this task, yet standard direct skip connections treat every spatial location equally, which leads to redundant and potentially conflicting information reaching the decoder. To overcome this problem, various gating mechanisms have been introduced, but most of them operate solely on filtering encoder information, neglecting the benefit of global contextual information from the decoder. This study proposes replacing conventional skip connections in a CellViT-based model with a novel Spatial Attention Fusion (SAF) Gating module. Each SAF gate concatenates the encoder skip and upsampled decoder features, compresses them through two pointwise convolutions with an intermediate ReLU, and applies a channel-wise softmax to produce a per-pixel "heatmap of trust" that sums to unity at every spatial location, allowing the network to learn where each source is most trustworthy. The resulting fused features improve the model's ability to detect the minority "Dead" class, which in turn enhances the multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ) on the PanNuke dataset. SAF Gating is compared against six gating alternatives including no gating, attention gates, squeeze-and-excitation, CBAM, cross-attention, and attentional feature fusion on PanNuke and MoNuSeg datasets. SAF Gating achieves the highest mPQ (0.471), a gain driven primarily by a 14.5-point improvement in Dead-class F1 score compared to ungated CellViT baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型空间注意力融合（SAF）门控模块，替换CellViT模型中的传统跳跃连接，通过结合编码器跳跃特征与上采样解码器特征，生成逐像素"信任热力图"，显著提升了PanNuke数据集上的病理图像细胞分割与分类性能（mPQ达0.471），特别是在少数类"Dead"细胞的检测上提升14.5个F1点。
AI.motivation: 编码器-解码器架构中，标准直接跳跃连接对每个空间位置不加区分地传递信息，导致冗余甚至冲突的特征到达解码器。现有多数门控机制仅用于过滤编码器信息，忽略了来自解码器的全局上下文信息的价值，限制了细胞分割与分类的性能。
AI.method: 在CellViT模型中提出SAF Gating模块替代传统跳跃连接。每个SAF门将编码器跳跃特征与上采样解码器特征拼接，通过两个逐点卷积（中间夹ReLU）压缩特征，再施加通道级Softmax生成逐像素"信任热力图"，该热力图在每个空间位置总和为1，使网络自主学习各特征来源的信任程度，实现自适应特征融合。
AI.result: 在PanNuke和MoNuSeg数据集上，SAF Gating与六种门控方案（无门控、注意力门控、SENet、CBAM、交叉注意力、注意力特征融合）进行了对比。SAF Gating取得了最高的mPQ（0.471），该提升主要由Dead类F1分数较无门控CellViT基线提升14.5个百分点所驱动。
AI.conclusion: SAF Gating利用解码器上下文信息进行特征门控，能够有效减少冗余和冲突信息的传播，增强模型对少数类细胞（尤其是Dead类）的检测能力，从而提升整体多类全景分割质量，是细胞病理图像分析中跳跃连接的有效替代方案。

title: Memory Efficient Tabular Foundation Models
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures Accepted at FMSD @ ICML 2026
summary: Tabular Foundation Models, such as TabPFN, have received a large amount of recent attention due to their performance on in-context tabular machine learning tasks, which often exceeds classical baselines. However, practical deployment considerations of these models has received less attention. In this paper we investigate the memory requirements for these models. We demonstrate that employing model compression approaches can enable memory reductions of up to 7.6 with similar levels of performance, reducing deployment requirements by nearly 87%. Our work provides insight to practitioners seeking efficient deployment of these models in practical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Tabular Foundation Models（如表征前馈网络TabPFN）在实际部署中的内存需求问题，通过模型压缩方法实现了最高7.6倍的内存缩减，同时保持相似的性能水平，将部署所需内存减少了近87%。
AI.motivation: Tabular Foundation Models（如TabPFN）在上下文表格机器学习任务中表现出色，常超越经典基线方法，但其实际部署时的内存需求问题鲜有研究关注。
AI.method: 采用模型压缩方法对Tabular Foundation Models进行优化，评估其在不同压缩策略下的性能与内存大小的权衡关系。
AI.result: 模型压缩方法可实现高达7.6倍的内存缩减，性能水平与原始模型相当，部署所需内存减少近87%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为需要在实际环境中高效部署这些模型的从业者提供了有价值的洞见和指导。

title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to a market-agnostic, supervised learning paradigm that relies on limited, static and human-annotated datasets, and thus are incapable of adapting to evolving market conditions. To address this limitation, we introduce FinSMART, the first market-aligned reinforcement learning framework for financial sentiment analysis, which directly optimizes sentiment signals using realized market outcomes.
