To deal with the noisy, non-stationary, and multifactorial nature of financial markets, FinSMART incorporates a signal extraction pipeline that combines market-aware data filtering with a discrete asymmetric trading reward, enabling stable reinforcement learning from economically meaningful market feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that FinSMART significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in profitability, risk-adjusted performance, and sentiment signal quality, improving cumulative trading returns by 220% over the strongest baseline. Uniquely, the FinSMART framework naturally supports market-aware retraining, at any point in time, by replacing costly manual annotation with newly observed financial articles and their realized market outcomes. Such a retraining strategy enables the model to continuously adapt to changing market dynamics, resulting in consistent performance gains over its static counterpart. These findings demonstrate the practical applicability of market-aligned reinforcement learning and highlight its potential as a next-generation paradigm for developing adaptive financial LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinSMART，首个面向金融情感分析的市场对齐强化学习框架，直接利用已实现的市场结果优化情感信号，通过信号提取管道和市场感知重训练实现动态适应，在盈利性、风险调整表现和信号质量上显著超越现有SOTA方法，累计交易收益较最强基线提升220%。
AI.motivation: 现有金融大语言模型的情感分析方法局限于市场无关的监督学习范式，依赖有限、静态且人工标注的数据集，无法适应不断变化的市场环境。金融市场具有噪声大、非平稳、多因素等复杂特性，需要一种能够直接利用市场反馈并持续适应市场动态的新方法论。
AI.method: FinSMART是一个市场对齐的强化学习框架，核心包含：(1) 信号提取管道，结合市场感知的数据过滤与离散非对称交易奖励机制，从嘈杂的市场反馈中提取稳定且具有经济意义的信号；(2) 利用已实现的市场结果（而非人工标注）作为奖励信号，直接优化情感分析模型；(3) 支持市场感知重训练，通过用新观察到的金融文章及其市场结果替代人工标注，实现模型对市场动态的持续适应。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FinSMART在盈利能力、风险调整表现和情感信号质量方面显著优于现有最先进方法，累计交易收益较最强基线提升220%。此外，市场感知重训练策略相比静态模型带来持续的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了市场对齐强化学习在金融情感分析中的实际可行性，将其定位为开发自适应性金融大语言模型的下一代范式，具有重要的实践应用价值。

title: Albilich: Steerable Proof-State Orchestration for LLM-Based Mathematical Research with CAS Integration
summary:
Large language models can contribute useful ideas to mathematical research, yet long-horizon proof attempts remain difficult to coordinate, evaluate, and reproduce. We present Albilich, an open-source agentic harness for autoresearch in mathematics that combines long-horizon reasoning, computer algebra systems (CAS), literature retrieval, and persistent SQLite-based context management.
  We evaluate Albilich on the RealMath benchmark (Zhang et al. 2025) and on open problems in group theory from the Kourovka Notebook (Khukhro and Mazurov 2026). It solved 10/10 problems on RealMath with CAS and 9/10 with no CAS. On the Kourovka problems, Albilich produced a counterexample to Problem 21.142 and a proof of a strengthening of Problem20.2. Anablation on Problem 17.91 demonstrates 32.0% token reduction when CAS is enabled. An ablation on Problem 21.142 demonstrates higher verifier-rejection rate and failure to synthesize proof routes in the absence of the advisor agent. These results support Albilich as a human-steerable, CAS-boosted environment for scalable AI-assisted mathematical research.

AI.tldr: Albilich是一个开源数学自动研究agent框架，结合了长程推理、计算机代数系统（CAS）、文献检索和SQLite持久化上下文管理。在RealMath基准上10/10（有CAS）和9/10（无CAS）通过率，并在Kourovka开放群论问题上产生了反例和定理加强，展示了CAS和advisor agent的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能够为数学研究提供有价值的思路，但长时程的证明尝试难以协调、评估和复现。现有系统缺乏一个统一的框架来管理长时推理过程中的上下文、工具集成和结果验证。
AI.method: 提出Albilich架构，包含四个核心组件：(1) 长时程推理引擎；(2) 计算机代数系统（CAS）集成；(3) 文献检索模块；(4) 基于SQLite的持久化上下文管理。通过agentic harness方式编排这些组件协同工作。
AI.result: 在RealMath基准上，有CAS时10/10问题全部解决，无CAS时9/10通过。在Kourovka Notebook的开放群论问题上，成功产出Problem 21.142的反例以及Problem 20.2的加强版证明。消融实验显示：CAS启用使Problem 17.91的token消耗减少32.0%；缺少advisor agent时Problem 21.142的验证拒绝率更高且无法合成证明路径。
AI.conclusion: Albilich作为一个人工可引导、CAS增强的数学自动研究环境，验证了LLM与形式化工具结合在开放数学问题上的可行性，为可扩展的AI辅助数学研究提供了基础平台。

title: FeatFix: Reuse What You Verify through Local Exact-Feature Correction for Faster Cached Diffusion Inference
summary: Diffusion models are widely used to generate high-quality images and videos, but their iterative denoising process remains computationally intensive. A growing class of training-free accelerators reduces this cost by reusing cached intermediate features or forecasting future ones. To control draft drift, these methods sometimes compute an exact block feature for verification. Yet the resulting exact feature is typically used only to measure discrepancy or guide a later decision and is then discarded. We find that this previously computed feature can instead be reused for correction. Forwarding it at the verification site resets the local draft residual and reduces downstream feature error. Based on this observation, we introduce FeatFix, a local exact-feature correction method for cached diffusion inference. FeatFix operates at a fixed sparse set of layer--timestep sites. At each selected site, it replaces the complete draft block output with the exact output computed from the same incoming state, avoiding token- or channel-level partial replacement and full-timestep recomputation. Experiments across four image and video backbones show that FeatFix consistently accelerates generation, achieving a speedup of up to $6.70\times$ over Vanilla while maintaining competitive output quality.

AI.tldr: FeatFix是一种训练无关的扩散模型加速方法，通过复用验证阶段计算出的精确特征进行局部修正（在固定稀疏的层-时间步位置用精确输出替换完整的草稿块输出），在不重新计算全部时间步的情况下减少草稿漂移，在四个图像和视频骨干网络上实现最高6.70倍加速且保持输出质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的迭代去噪过程计算成本高昂。现有训练无关的加速方法通过缓存中间特征或预测未来特征来降低成本，但会产生草稿漂移（draft drift）。部分方法会计算精确块特征用于验证，但仅将其用于测量差异或指导后续决策后便丢弃，未充分利用这一已计算出的精确特征进行修正。
AI.method: FeatFix在固定稀疏的层-时间步站点（layer-timestep sites）处操作。在每个选定站点，用同一输入状态计算出的精确输出替换完整的草稿块输出（而非token或通道级别的部分替换，也非全时间步重算），从而重置局部草稿残差并减少下游特征误差。预计算的验证精确特征被重新用于局部修正。
AI.result: 在四个图像和视频扩散骨干网络上的实验表明，FeatFix一致地加速生成过程，相对Vanilla基线最高获得6.70倍的加速，同时保持具有竞争力的输出质量。
AI.conclusion: 将验证阶段已计算的精确特征复用为局部校正信号是一种简单而有效的策略，能够在不重算完整时间步的前提下降低草稿漂移导致的误差传播，为缓存型扩散推理加速提供了新的优化方向。

title: Strategies for Milestone-driven Start-ups in Multi-activity Settings
summary: New venture start-ups need to ``survive'' through multiple stages of reaching milestone targets. We investigate the strategies for start-ups in a milestone-oriented setting. We examine a model of an entrepreneurial start-up firm, where its state is captured by a diffusion process. The entrepreneur can choose between multiple activities (or controls), which incur different cost and determine the drift and the variance of the process. Depending on whether the process reaches a fixed upper boundary or a lower one, the start-up firm succeeds or fails. Continuous-time stochastic models with multiple ($\ge 3$) controls are typically very challenging to deal with. In this work, we are able to completely solve for the optimal policy and provide an explicit characterization of its structure. In particular, the optimal policy only uses controls from a set characterized by a so-called efficient frontier curve that orders the controls by two intuitive measures: riskiness (drift-to-volatility ratio) and cost-effectiveness (drift-to-cost ratio). A unique feature of our model is that depending on the model parameters, the efficient frontier curves can be of different types, resulting in qualitatively different structures of the optimal policy. As far as we know, this is the first study that analyzes a stochastic control model which admits efficient frontier curves of different types. Our work provides start-up firms with intuitive measures to evaluate their activities and offers valuable insights on how the optimal strategies in a milestone-oriented setting change qualitatively contingent upon the specific scenario. We believe the results provide a foundational block in the study of entrepreneurial decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文研究初创企业在里程碑导向环境下的最优策略选择问题。作者构建了一个连续时间随机控制模型，其中企业状态由扩散过程刻画，创业者可在多个成本不同且影响过程漂移和方差的活动中选择。模型被完全求解，最优策略仅使用由"效率前沿曲线"特征化的控制集合，该曲线通过风险性（漂移-波动比）和成本效益（漂移-成本比）两个直观指标对控制进行排序。研究发现根据模型参数不同，效率前沿曲线可以呈现不同类型，从而产生定性不同的最优策略结构，这是首个承认不同类型效率前沿曲线的随机控制模型研究。
AI.motivation: 初创企业必须通过多个阶段达到里程碑目标才能生存，而创业者在不同活动中的资源分配决策至关重要。然而，具有多个（≥3个）控制的连续时间随机模型通常极难求解，缺乏对初创企业最优策略的显式刻画。作者希望通过构建可完全求解的数学模型，为创业者提供直观的决策指标和策略洞见。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个扩散过程驱动的企业状态模型，其中创业者可在多个控制（活动）之间选择，每个控制具有不同的成本和不同的漂移/方差影响。模型设定过程达到上界为成功、达到下界为失败。作者以完全解析的方式求解了该随机控制模型的最优策略，并引入"效率前沿曲线"概念——该曲线通过漂移-波动比（风险性）和漂移-成本比（成本效益）两个指标对所有控制进行排序，最优策略仅使用前沿曲线上的控制。根据不同参数配置，效率前沿曲线可呈现不同类型，导致最优策略的定性结构差异。
AI.result: 模型被完全求解，得到了最优策略的显式结构刻画。最优策略仅使用由效率前沿曲线特征化的一组控制。根据模型参数的不同，效率前沿曲线可能呈现不同类型的几何特征，从而导致最优策略在定性上有不同的结构。这是文献中首个承认效率前沿曲线可能有多种类型的随机控制模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文为初创企业在里程碑导向环境下的决策提供了两个直观的度量指标（风险性和成本效益）来评估各项活动，并揭示了最优策略如何随具体场景发生定性变化。该工作为创业决策研究提供了基础性理论支撑，对指导初创企业的资源配置和活动选择具有重要的实践价值。

title: Rethinking LLM-Judged Helpfulness as a Pedagogy Signal: A Pre-Registered Audit Across Tutor Models
summary: LLM tutoring poses a measurement problem: can a general-purpose helpfulness rubric distinguish direct answer-giving from pedagogical guidance? We audit this signal in a pre-registered study. Within each of three tutor bases, we compare conversational and pedagogical policies instantiated with the same underlying model and paired with one fixed weak simulated student. Deterministic detectors measure answer leakage and next-turn independent work. Claude Opus 4.8 is the frozen, condition-blind primary judge. After the Opus scores were fixed, GPT-5.6 Sol was prospectively specified for a post hoc robustness audit of the same 1,179 confirmatory answer-phase tutor turns under the frozen helpfulness and pedagogy rubrics. On the primary base under Opus, the policies do not differ significantly in helpfulness but are perfectly rank-separated under the pedagogy rubric (Cliff's $|δ|{=}0.10$ vs. $1.0$). Across the two judges, pedagogy contrasts retain their direction where detected, whereas the helpfulness ordering is judge-contingent, reversing between judges on two of three bases. In an Opus-only ablation, seven primary-base policies span $2.3$ points in mean judged pedagogy within a $0.25$-point band of mean judged helpfulness. Separately, answer-revealing turns are followed by less independent student work on every base, a result that is judge-invariant by construction. In this controlled setting, general-purpose helpfulness is not a reliable pedagogy signal. Tutor evaluation should pair pedagogy-targeted rubrics with deterministic process measures.

AI.tldr: 本预注册研究通过对比对话型与教学型两种tutoring策略（使用相同底层模型和固定弱模拟学生），审计通用helpfulness评分是否能够区分"直接给答案"与"教学引导"。使用Claude Opus 4.8作为盲评主裁判、GPT-5.6 Sol作为事后稳健性审计裁判，发现helpfulness在两种策略间无显著差异且裁判间排序不稳定，而教学导向（pedagogy）评分标准能完美区分策略。结果表明通用helpfulness不是可靠的教学信号，tutor评估应结合教学导向的评分标准与确定性过程度量。
AI.motivation: LLM tutor评估面临度量问题：需要验证通用helpfulness评分标准能否区分直接给答案与教学引导行为，以确定该信号是否可作为tutor教学质量的可靠代理指标。
AI.method: 在三个tutor基座上各实例化会话型与教学型两种策略（共享同一底层模型，配对固定弱模拟学生）；使用确定性检测器度量答案泄露与下一轮独立学习；Claude Opus 4.8作为冻结的、条件盲的主裁判，GPT-5.6 Sol作为事后再指定的稳健性审计裁判，对1,179个确认性答案阶段tutor轮次在冻结的helpfulness与pedagogy评分标准下进行评分。
AI.result: 在Opus主裁判下，主基座上两种策略在helpfulness上无显著差异（Cliff's |δ|=0.10），但在pedagogy评分标准下完全排序分离（Cliff's |δ|=1.0）。跨两位裁判，pedagogy对比方向保持一致，而helpfulness排序在三个基座中的两个上发生裁判间反转。Opus-only消融实验中，七个主基座策略在pedagogy均值上跨越2.3分，但helpfulness均值仅落在0.25分带宽内。此外，揭示答案的轮次在每一基座上都导致更少的独立学生工作，该结果构造性地对裁判不变。
AI.conclusion: 在受控环境中，通用helpfulness不是可靠的教学信号。Tutor评估应同时采用教学导向的评分标准与确定性过程度量（如答案泄露检测和独立工作度量），而非依赖单一的通用helpfulness指标。

title: MECA: A Mechanism-Centered Agent for Constructing Well-Specified and Valuable Mathematical Conjectures
comment: 78 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and the full collection of 100 generated conjectures
summary: Automatically constructing well-specified and valuable mathematical conjectures remains a central challenge in AI-assisted mathematical discovery. Many existing open problems and conjectures are often too broad, underspecified, or difficult to connect to plausible proof or refutation strategies. We view a mathematical mechanism as a structure or reasoning principle that connects the assumptions of a candidate problem to its target conclusion, such as an inequality, invariant, decomposition, or reduction to an intermediate claim. We present MECA (MEchanism-centered Conjecture Agent), a multi-agent framework that constructs conjectures by jointly developing candidate statements and their supporting mechanisms. Explorer agents propose mechanisms, test how they apply, and revise the candidate conjecture accordingly, while critic agents assess their mathematical validity and research value. Their feedback guides changes to the assumptions, scope, and conclusion. Through this process, MECA transforms broad research directions into precise conjectures with substantive mathematical support while retaining a clearly identified unresolved core. We evaluate MECA in two complementary settings. First, we compare it with a generate-and-revise baseline on reconstructing preselected target-paper conclusions from target-conditioned but article-blind source materials. Second, we construct 100 semi-open problems from literature-derived seeds and existing open problems and evaluate them through independent proof and refutation attempts by automated provers. Our results indicate that mechanism-centered refinement produces well-specified and research-worthy conjectures that remain challenging for current automated provers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MECA（以机制为中心的猜想智能体），一个多智能体框架，通过联合开发候选数学猜想及其支撑机制，将宽泛的研究方向转化为精确、有实质数学支撑且保留明确未解核心的猜想。
AI.motivation: 自动构建良好定义且有价值的数学猜想仍是一大挑战。许多现有开放问题和猜想过于宽泛、定义不清晰，或难以连接到可行的证明/反证策略，导致难以被有效研究。
AI.method: MECA采用多智能体协作框架：Explorer智能体负责提出机制（如不等式、不变量、分解、中间命题归约等）、测试其适用性并据此修订候选猜想；Critic智能体评估猜想的数学有效性和研究价值，其反馈指导对假设、范围和结论的修改。
AI.result: 在两种互补设置中评估：一是与生成-修订基线对比重建预选目标论文结论的任务；二是从文献种子和已有开放问题构造100个半开放问题，并通过自动证明器的独立证明和反证尝试进行评估。结果表明机制中心化精炼能产生定义良好且具研究价值的猜想，且对现有自动证明器具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 机制中心化的猜想构建方法能有效产出高质量、定义明确且具有研究价值的数学猜想，这些猜想对当前自动证明系统仍构成挑战，展示了AI辅助数学发现的新方向。

title: VCP-DCN: Beyond Visual Concealed Property via Depth Collaborative Network for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) aims to identify and segment camouflaged objects in complex environments, which are often concealed because their color and texture are similar to the background. Several existing COD methods introduce depth maps to boost detection performance via learning complementary RGB-D features, ignoring modality-specific characteristics of concealed objects in the depth domain. To address this issue, we propose a depth collaborative network, called VCP-DCN, to mine distinguishable multi-modality features beyond visual concealed prototype in depth domain. Specifically, VCP-DCN progressively performs multi-modality alignment, interaction, and fusion for the COD task. In the \textbf{alignment} stage, we propose a Separable Prototype Embedding (SPE) module to learn modality-consistency and modality-specific RGB/depth prototype tokens through prototype contrastive learning. Furthermore, we develop a Multi-modality Dual Attention (MDA) module to enhance the cross-modal feature representation through local response maps between modality-consistency RGB/depth prototype tokens and visual tokens on the \textbf{interaction} stage. Finally, we design a Depth Adaptive Injection (DAI) module to adaptively measure contribution of RGB/depth features with a decision-making mechanism, which calculates similarity distance between RGB/depth modality-specific prototype tokens and modality-consistency ones on the \textbf{fusion} stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our VCP-DCN on three authoritative datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VCP-DCN，一个针对伪装目标检测（COD）的深度协作网络，通过分离式原型嵌入、多模态双注意力机制和深度自适应注入模块，在RGB-D跨模态对齐、交互和融合三个阶段挖掘可区分的多模态特征，在三个权威数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有COD方法引入深度图增强检测性能时，仅学习互补的RGB-D特征，忽略了伪装物体在深度域中模态特有的特征，导致多模态特征挖掘不充分。
AI.method: VCP-DCN包含三个阶段：(1) 对齐阶段，通过可分离原型嵌入（SPE）模块和原型对比学习，学习模态一致性与模态特异性的RGB/深度原型令牌；(2) 交互阶段，通过多模态双注意力（MDA）模块利用模态一致性原型令牌与视觉令牌之间的局部响应图增强跨模态特征表示；(3) 融合阶段，通过深度自适应注入（DAI）模块，基于RGB/深度模态特异性原型令牌与模态一致性原型令牌之间的相似度距离，自适应衡量各模态特征的贡献。
AI.result: 在三个权威伪装目标检测数据集上的大量实验表明VCP-DCN方法有效，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模深度域中的模态一致性与模态特异性特征，并采用渐进式的对齐-交互-融合策略，VCP-DCN有效解决了伪装物体在深度域中模态特征被忽略的问题，显著提升了RGB-D伪装目标检测性能。

title: A Montage-Agnostic Encoder for Calibration-Light Cross-User Gesture Recognition from Surface Electromyography
summary: Pattern-recognition control promises a myoelectric prosthesis that responds to many intended gestures rather than one or two, but the promise has stayed in the laboratory. A recogniser trained on one person rarely transfers to the next, and useful performance usually demands a fresh round of labelled calibration from the end user. A montage-agnostic encoder is introduced that reads each electrode with shared weights and locates it by its physical coordinate rather than its index, so one architecture ingests any channel count without montage-specific parameters. Trained across users, it exceeds a per-user Hudgins and linear-discriminant classifier by 0.234 macro-F1 on DB1 for every held-out subject and by 0.108 on DB2, and falls below it on the ten-subject DB5. Each of the encoder's three key components individually accounts for more than half of its 3-shot macro F1 in an otherwise budget-matched ablation study. A controlled subject-count sweep shows the margin is close to flat from nine training subjects to thirty-nine, so the training pool binds only as a stability floor below which cross-user training fails to converge; what tracks the direction of the comparison across the three databases is instead the strength of the per-user baseline, which signal fidelity sets. Comparing against an LDA baseline depends on budget spent training models and on how good that baseline is, and self-supervised pretraining had no benefits once a supervised model was adequately trained.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"安装方式无关（montage-agnostic）"的编码器用于肌电假肢手势识别，通过共享权重按物理坐标而非索引读取电极，可适配任意通道数。跨用户训练时，在DB1（18名持有测试者）和DB2上分别超越每用户Hudgins+LDA基线0.234和0.108宏F1，但在10人DB5上不及基线。消融实验显示编码器三个关键组件各自贡献超过3-shot宏F1的一半。训练集人数从9到39增加时性能几乎持平，说明训练池仅作为收敛稳定性下限；跨数据库比较方向由每用户基线强度决定，而基线强度由信号保真度决定。
AI.motivation: 模式识别控制虽然承诺肌电假肢能响应多种意图手势，但这一承诺一直停留在实验室：跨用户迁移失败、需要用户进行标签校准。作者旨在解决识别器无法跨人迁移的问题，提出一种无需每用户重新标定的通用编码器。
AI.method: 提出安装方式无关的编码器：每个电极用共享权重读取，并以物理坐标而非索引定位电极，使同一架构可处理任意通道数且无需安装方式相关参数。通过跨用户训练学习通用表征，并与Hudgins特征+线性判别分析（LDA）基线进行对比。
AI.result: 跨用户训练后，在DB1上超越每用户Hudgins+LDA基线0.234宏F1（所有留出受试者），在DB2上超越0.108，但在10受试者的DB5上不如基线。消融实验显示编码器三个关键组件各自贡献超一半的3-shot宏F1。训练受试者数量从9到39变化时性能近乎持平，仅作为收敛稳定性的下限；跨数据库比较方向由每用户基线强度（由信号保真度决定）而非训练池大小决定。自监督预训练在监督模型充分训练后无额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 跨用户训练的可行性不取决于训练池大小（9到39人无显著差异），而是取决于每用户基线强度的信号保真度。安装方式无关的编码器在信号质量高的数据库上显著优于逐个用户校准的LDA基线，但在信号质量较差或受试者较少的DB5上优势消失。自监督预训练对已充分训练的监督模型没有增益。

title: Can Agents Deceive? Evaluating Reasoning and Deception in ParliamentBench using a Social Deduction Game
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as agents in high-stakes settings, such as medical and legal systems, understanding their deceptive capabilities is fundamental to safety. Controlled social deduction games provide a reproducible proxy for isolating and evaluating these complex adversarial behaviors. We present the open-source benchmark framework ParliamentBench based on the game Secret Hitler to evaluate LLMs in scenarios that require deception, persuasion, and reasoning under information asymmetry. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 1,600 simulated matches playing each other, playing against humans, and compare them against a large set of online games. We introduce three novel metrics that isolate social deduction, reasoning, and deceptive consistency. Our experiments reveal that frontier models achieve strong performance across cooperative and deceptive roles, with a strong top-four cluster (GPT-5.4, Kimi K2.5, Grok 4.1 Fast, and DeepSeek 3.1 Terminus), whereas the weakest models fall short of random (33%) and simple algorithmic (45%) baselines. Most LLMs struggle to maintain a consistent deceptive persona throughout an entire game, with deception retention dropping below 50%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于《秘密希特勒》桌游的开源基准框架 ParliamentBench，用于评估大语言模型在欺骗、说服及信息不对称推理等对抗性场景中的能力。研究对16个LLM在1600场模拟对局、人机对战以及大量在线对局数据中进行了评估，引入了三个新指标来分别度量社交推理、推理能力和欺骗一致性。结果显示前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Kimi K2.5、Grok 4.1 Fast、DeepSeek 3.1 Terminus）表现优异，而最弱模型甚至低于随机基线和简单算法基线，且大多数LLM在维持欺骗人设方面存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: LLM被部署在医疗、法律等高风险的智能体场景中，理解其欺骗能力对安全性至关重要。受控社交推理游戏提供了可复现的环境来隔离和评估这类复杂的对抗行为，因此作者构建了基于Secret Hitler游戏的基准框架来系统评估LLM的欺骗能力。
AI.method: 论文构建了名为ParliamentBench的开源评测框架，基于秘密希特勒桌游规则设计。评估了16个LLM在1600场模拟对局中的表现，包括模型互相对战、模型与人类对战，并与大量在线人类对局数据进行比较。提出了三个新指标，分别用于隔离社交推理能力、推理能力和欺骗一致性。
AI.result: 前沿模型在合作与欺骗角色上均表现强劲，形成了以GPT-5.4、Kimi K2.5、Grok 4.1 Fast和DeepSeek 3.1 Terminus为首的顶级四强集群。最弱模型的性能低于随机基线（33%）和简单算法基线（45%）。大多数LLM难以在整个游戏中维持一致的欺骗人设，欺骗保持率降至50%以下。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在欺骗推理任务中存在显著的能力分化：顶级模型接近人类水平，而弱模型甚至达不到基本基线。同时，多数模型在长期欺骗一致性方面存在明显短板，这为高风险的LLM智能体部署中的安全评估提供了重要的参考依据。

title: New Synchronous Computation Dynamics for Hopfield Networks
summary: The dynamics of the original Hopfield network is asynchronous (sequential) (updates the state of only one neuron per time step). In this paper, we propose a new tool and a new dynamics to reduce the processing time by updating one or more neurons simultaneously per instant while ensuring process convergence and aiming for the maximum energy decrease at each step, thus guaranteeing the shortest total processing time. From the point of view of synchronous dynamics, calculating the next network state at which energy decreases the most from the current state while ensuring convergence is itself a combinatorial optimization problem. We develop and use a new tool to solve it. We call this new tool Discrete Differential Filter (DDF) and, based upon it, we develop a new synchronous dynamics which we call SD-DDF (Synchronous Dynamics based upon Discrete Differential Filter). In this paper, we review the original asynchronous dynamics for Hopfield networks and present a new tool and a new synchronous dynamics with its theoretical justification and four computational experiments to assess the speed up in processing time empirically.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于离散差分滤波器（DDF）的新型同步动力学（SD-DDF），用于Hopfield网络，通过每次同时更新一个或多个神经元并确保收敛，以最大化每一步的能量下降，从而缩短整体处理时间。
AI.motivation: 原始Hopfield网络的动力学是异步（顺序）的，每个时间步只更新一个神经元，导致处理时间较长。研究者希望减少处理时间，同时保证网络收敛。
AI.method: 提出离散差分滤波器（DDF）作为新工具，并基于它开发了同步动力学SD-DDF。该动力学在每个时间步同时更新一个或多个神经元，目标是找到能量下降最大的下一网络状态并保证收敛。由于该问题本身是组合优化问题，DDF被用来高效求解。
AI.result: 论文提供了SD-DDF的理论论证，并通过四个计算实验实证评估了处理时间的加速效果。
AI.conclusion: 提出的SD-DDF同步动力学能够在保证收敛的前提下通过同时更新多个神经元显著减少Hopfield网络的处理时间。

title: Benchmarking Foundation and Large Language Models for Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Few-shot medical image segmentation (FS-MIS) aims to segment novel regions of interest (ROIs) from a few annotated support examples. Despite rapid progress, existing FS-MIS solutions span diverse paradigms but are evaluated under inconsistent settings, leaving their relative effectiveness unclear. We introduce FAME, a unified benchmark for evaluating FS-MIS solutions, covering specialists, SAM-based methods, CLIP-based methods, and MLLM-based methods. FAME contains 14,958 test samples across 7 anatomical sites, 9 imaging modalities, and 14 ROI categories, and evaluates models under zero-shot and ten-shot settings with additional assessment of target-absence recognition and generalization under covariate and semantic shifts. Our evaluation reveals several findings. First, effective few-shot segmentation depends on how models exploit support examples: direct visual adaptation generally outperforms prompt-based strategies. Second, increasing support examples improves performance only when models can effectively utilize them. Third, semantic transfer remains substantially more challenging than imaging-domain adaptation, and strong localization ability does not necessarily imply reliable target-absence recognition. We hope FAME provides a comprehensive understanding of current FS-MIS solutions and facilitates the development of more effective and reliable few-shot medical segmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FAME，一个统一的少样本医学图像分割（FS-MIS）基准，涵盖14,958个测试样本、7个解剖部位、9种成像模态和14个ROI类别，系统评估专业方法、SAM方法、CLIP方法和MLLM方法在零样本与十样本设置下的表现。评估揭示：直接视觉适应优于提示策略；支持样本增加仅在模型能有效利用时提升性能；语义迁移比成像域适应更具挑战性；强定位能力不等同于可靠的靶区缺失识别。
AI.motivation: 现有FS-MIS解决方案涵盖多种不同范式（专家方法、SAM方法、CLIP方法、MLLM方法），但彼此在不一致的设置下进行评估，导致它们的相对有效性不明确，缺乏一个统一、公正的比较基准。
AI.method: 构建FAME统一基准，包含14,958个测试样本，覆盖7个解剖部位、9种成像模态和14个ROI类别；在零样本和十样本两种设置下评估四类方法；额外评估靶区缺失识别能力、协变量偏移和语义偏移下的泛化性能。
AI.result: 评估发现：1）直接视觉适应策略在少样本分割中普遍优于基于提示的方法；2）增加支持样本仅在模型能够有效利用它们时才提升性能；3）语义迁移比成像域适配困难得多；4）强大的定位能力并不意味着可靠的靶区缺失识别。
AI.conclusion: FAME为当前FS-MIS解决方案提供了全面的理解，并有望促进更有效、更可靠的少样本医学分割方法的发展。

title: Recognition and Label-Free Adaptation Across Recording Sessions in Surface-EMG Gesture Decoding
summary: Recognition accuracy obtained during a recording session does not persist when a user puts on the electrodes again after the electrodes had previously been removed. The electrodes may have moved slightly, the skin may be drier or wetter, or the elbow may be positioned differently; these factors all contribute to day-to-day variability and therefore represent a major obstacle to implementing successful pattern-recognition based myoelectric control systems in daily practice. However, simply recalibrating a user's hand for 20 min at every doff/don event is a clearly unrealistic expectation. A montage-agnostic encoder built for cross-user, cross-montage transfer is trained here using data collected during a particular recording session, and then applied to data collected later in a different recording session without adjusting anything, on the ten intact subjects of NinaPro DB6. The performance of this approach is compared to that of a per-user LDA classification pipeline, and to that of two published approaches that only rely on source data collected from the same recording session. Carried unchanged across recording sessions, the encoder retains 0.688 macro-F1 against 0.540 for the per-user pipeline, and, on the per-window metric the published baselines use, sits above both published source-only results, a band of two points that locates the encoder rather than ranking it. Of five label-free test-time adaptations, only feature-statistic alignment improves every subject; batch-normalisation re-estimation, a standard method in the domain-adaptation literature, collapses this architecture entirely. Aligning the encoder's feature statistics to the new session recovers about what a single labelled calibration repetition would.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种与电极配置无关（montage-agnostic）的编码器，用于肌电模式识别中的跨用户、跨记录会话迁移，在不重新校准的情况下解决电极摘下再佩戴后（doff/don事件）识别精度下降的问题。在NinaPro DB6的10名健康受试者上，该编码器未经调整跨会话迁移时macro-F1达到0.688，显著优于每用户LDA流水线的0.540，且高于两个仅使用源会话数据的已发表基线。在五种无标签测试时适应方法中，仅特征统计对齐能改善所有受试者的性能；而批归一化重估计会使该架构完全失效。
AI.motivation: 电极摘下重新佩戴后，因电极位置微移、皮肤干湿变化或肘部位置不同等因素导致的逐日变异性，使得训练好的肌电模式识别系统在跨会话使用时精度显著下降，这是阻碍该类系统在日常实践中落地的重大障碍。但每次佩戴都进行20分钟重新校准显然不切实际，因此需要无需重新校准或仅需极轻量适应的跨会话迁移方案。
AI.method: 训练一个与电极配置无关（montage-agnostic）的编码器，用于跨用户、跨电极配置迁移；该编码器在一个记录会话采集的数据上训练，随后原封不动地应用于不同记录会话采集的数据。实验使用NinaPro DB6的10名健康受试者，并与每用户LDA分类流水线及两个仅依赖源会话数据的已发表方法进行对比；同时评估了五种无标签测试时适应（test-time adaptation）方法，包括特征统计对齐和批归一化重估计。
AI.result: 该编码器跨会话未经任何调整保留0.688的macro-F1，远高于每用户LDA流水线的0.540；在逐窗口指标上，其性能高于两个已发表源端方法结果所在的两个点区间。在五种无标签测试时适应方法中，仅特征统计对齐能改善每个受试者的性能；批归一化重估计（域适应文献中的标准方法）使该架构完全崩溃。特征统计对齐恢复的效果大约相当于一次有标签校准重复。
AI.conclusion: 跨度-感知编码器能够在不进行任何调整的情况下有效地跨记录会话迁移肌电模式识别，显著优于传统的每用户LDA基线。在无需标签的条件下，特征统计对齐是最有效的轻量适应策略，而批归一化重估计不适用于该架构。该工作为实现无需重新校准的肌电控制系统日常使用提供了可行路径。

title: RRM: Experience-Driven Reflective Retrieval Memory for Long-Horizon Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Existing multimodal long-term memory agents use external memory to overcome the limited context available for long videos. However, most methods emphasize what to store rather than how stored memory should be retrieved. When retrieval becomes inaccurate or repeatedly fails to obtain useful evidence, existing agents lack mechanisms to diagnose failures from previous task trajectories and adapt future search strategies.We introduce Reflective Retrieval Memory (RRM), a reflective memory framework for long-horizon multimodal reasoning. RRM augments an entity-centric multimodal memory graph with reflective experience memory, which distills transferable procedural retrieval knowledge from historical task trajectories. Unlike episodic and semantic memories that preserve factual evidence from the current video, reflective experience memory captures reusable search strategies across tasks. RRM converts retrieved experiences into query-level guidance, while answer generation remains conditioned only on factual evidence newly retrieved from the current video. A lifecycle management mechanism further regulates experience memory through usage frequency, reuse feedback, and temporal decay, thereby reducing redundancy and noise. RRM consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches on M3-Bench-Robot, M3-Bench-Web, and Video-MME-Long, demonstrating the effectiveness of reflective retrieval memory for long-horizon multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: RRM（反思性检索记忆）是一个面向长时程多模态推理的反思记忆框架，通过将可迁移的程序性检索知识蒸馏为反思性经验记忆，并配合生命周期管理机制，显著提升了长视频多模态任务的记忆检索效果，在多个基准上超过现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态长时记忆智能体虽然通过外部记忆克服了长视频的上下文限制，但大多关注"存什么"而非"怎么取"。当检索不准确或反复失败时，现有智能体缺乏从历史任务轨迹中诊断失败并自适应调整检索策略的机制。
AI.method: RRM构建了一个以实体为中心的多模态记忆图，并额外引入反思性经验记忆。该经验记忆从历史任务轨迹中蒸馏出可迁移的程序性检索知识，与保存当前视频事实证据的情节记忆和语义记忆不同，它捕获跨任务可复用的检索策略。RRM将检索到的经验转化为查询级指导，回答生成仅基于当前视频中新检索的事实证据。同时通过使用频率、复用反馈和时间衰减的生命周期管理机制来减少冗余和噪声。
AI.result: RRM在M3-Bench-Robot、M3-Bench-Web和Video-MME-Long基准上一致优于现有最先进方法，验证了反思性检索记忆在长时程多模态推理中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RRM证明了将可迁移的检索经验作为独立于事实证据的反思记忆层，并辅以生命周期管理，能够有效解决长时程多模态推理中记忆检索不准确和缺乏自适应的核心问题。

title: Baikal: Structured Search for Deep Research over Data Lakes
summary: Deep research over data lakes requires an LLM agent to investigate evidence across thousands of heterogeneous tables and passages to synthesize a report. Existing methods perform iterative retrieval and generation, letting accumulated context determine what to investigate next, which can overexploit locally promising evidence and fail to cover distinct semantic regions under a fixed budget. To address this, we cast deep research over data lakes as a budgeted search problem and present Baikal - a framework that clusters heterogeneous evidence into semantic regions, then searches over them adaptively to balance exploration and exploitation. Within each selected region, Baikal generates and investigates region-grounded subquestions, using finding quality as rewards to update region-level value estimates and guide search under policies ranging from random and LLM-guided selection to Bayesian $ε$-greedy and UCB. We evaluate Baikal on 15 queries each over HybridQA and TAT-QA data lakes containing 10,993 and 2,757 tables, respectively, together with 227K Wikipedia passages and 13K financial report passages. We assess research quality with a new rubric covering groundedness, relevance, diversity, and utility, and use GPT-5-mini to score Baikal and strong baselines, including DeepSearcher and an OpenCode research agent with retrieval and clustering variants. Across both data lakes, Baikal performs strongly under several region-selection policies; its best configuration improves report scores over the strongest baselines by 28% on HybridQA and 36% on TAT-QA. Our analyses attribute these gains to organizing and exploring semantic evidence regions, which improves groundedness and diversity and yields more useful findings under the same subquestion budget. These results demonstrate the value of structured semantic exploration for systematic research and discovery over heterogeneous data lakes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Baikal框架，将数据湖上的深度研究建模为预算受限的搜索问题，通过将异构证据聚类为语义区域，并自适应地在区域间平衡探索与利用，显著提升了LLM代理在数据湖上的研究报告质量。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究方法采用迭代检索与生成的方式，依赖累积上下文决定下一步调查内容，容易在本地有前景的证据上过度利用，而在固定预算下无法覆盖不同的语义区域，导致报告覆盖度不足。
AI.method: 将深度研究建模为预算受限的搜索问题；将异构证据聚类为语义区域，对选定区域生成并调查区域接地子问题，以发现质量作为奖励更新区域价值估计，指导搜索策略（包括随机、LLM引导、贝叶斯ε-greedy和UCB等策略）。
AI.result: 在HybridQA和TAT-QA数据湖上（10,993和2,757张表格，加上227K维基百科段落和13K财务报告段落）的15个查询评估中，Baikal的最佳配置相比最强基线在HybridQA上报告分数提升28%，在TAT-QA上提升36%。
AI.conclusion: 组织并探索语义证据区域能显著提升报告的接地性和多样性，在相同子问题预算下产生更有用的发现，验证了结构化语义探索对异构数据湖系统研究的价值。

title: EEG-EditBench: Probing Visual Information in EEG-Image Retrieval Models with Controlled Image Edits
comment: Main paper with supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XiaoZhangYES/EEG-EditBench. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xiaozgg/EEG-EditBench
summary: Recent EEG-to-image retrieval models have achieved strong performance in identifying viewed images from semantically diverse candidates. Yet such success does not reveal what visual information supports the match. A model may readily identify a cheetah among tools, plants, and vehicles, but can it still distinguish the viewed cheetah from the same scene with the cheetah replaced by a dog? Motivated by this question, we introduce EEG-EditBench, a diagnostic benchmark that examines this question through controlled edits of object identity, attributes, background, and object presence. Built from the 200 THINGS-EEG2 test images, EEG-EditBench contains 2,137 quality-controlled edits and evaluates eight representative EEG visual decoding models. Our results show that strong standard retrieval does not consistently transfer to edit-based evaluation, with fine-grained attribute changes presenting the greatest challenge. EEG-EditBench reveals model behavior hidden by aggregate retrieval accuracy and provides a controlled basis for studying what visual information EEG-image models preserve. The code and complete dataset are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EEG-EditBench，一个用于诊断EEG-to-image检索模型真正依赖何种视觉信息的基准测试，通过控制对象身份、属性、背景和对象存在性的编辑来检验模型能否区分细微视觉变化。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-to-image检索模型在语义多样候选上表现优秀，但这掩盖了模型实际依赖的视觉信息。一个模型可能在语义上区分不同类别（如猎豹vs工具），但无法区分同场景中微妙的视觉变化（如猎豹换成狗）。作者希望通过受控编辑来揭示这些隐藏的模型行为。
AI.method: 从200 THINGS-EEG2测试图像构建包含2,137个质量控制编辑的EEG-EditBench基准，编辑类型涵盖四类：对象身份、属性、背景和对象存在性。评估了八个代表性的EEG视觉解码模型。
AI.result: 强标准检索性能不能一致地迁移到基于编辑的评估上；细粒度属性变化对模型构成了最大挑战；EEG-EditBench揭示了聚合检索准确率所隐藏的模型行为。
AI.conclusion: EEG-EditBench为EEG-image模型保留了何种视觉信息的研究提供了受控基础，表明现有模型的鲁棒性与人类视觉理解仍有显著差距，代码和数据集已公开。

title: Policy Gradient Steering: Interventions from Behavioral Objectives
summary: Activation steering has emerged in large language models as a lightweight alternative for dynamically changing a model's behavior at inference time. However, we show that existing steering methods fail to steer even a simple policy in a two-route gridworld environment. To address this limitation, we propose Policy Gradient Steering (PGS), which formulates steering as a reinforcement learning problem. PGS accumulates gradients of a temporary behavioral objective over a small set of rollouts or demonstrations to construct a removable task vector. We first demonstrate the calibration and reversibility of PGS in a two-route gridworld environment. Using chess puzzles, we then evaluate independently fitted PGS vectors both in isolation and in combination, finding that compatible tactical objectives accumulate constructively. Finally, in competitive football, we show that PGS can alter specific team behaviors and that its effects transfer across opponents. Together, these results show that policy gradients provide a natural interface for constructing temporary and composable behavioral adaptations across diverse decision-making domains.

AI.tldr: 提出Policy Gradient Steering (PGS)方法，将大语言模型的激活引导（activation steering）形式化为强化学习问题，通过累积临时行为目标的策略梯度来构建可移除的任务向量，并在两路线网格世界、国际象棋谜题和竞技足球三个领域的实验中验证了其校准性、可逆性、可组合性和跨场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导方法在简单策略（如两路线网格世界）上甚至无法有效引导模型行为，说明传统steering方法存在根本性局限。作者希望提出一种更通用、更自然的引导机制来动态改变模型行为。
AI.method: 将steering形式化为一个强化学习（RL）问题。PGS通过在一小批rollout或演示上累积临时行为目标的策略梯度，构建一个可移除的任务向量（task vector），将其加到模型激活上即可实现行为引导。
AI.result: (1) 在网格世界环境中验证了PGS的校准性和可逆性；(2) 在国际象棋谜题中，独立拟合的PGS向量既能单独工作也能组合使用，兼容的战术目标会累积性地产生建设性效果；(3) 在竞技足球中，PGS能改变特定团队行为，且效果可跨对手迁移。
AI.conclusion: 策略梯度为构建临时性、可组合的行为适应提供了一种自然接口，能够跨越多种决策领域实现有效且可逆的行为引导。

title: Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adaptive sampling, the other axis of training-free acceleration, paces how quickly positions commit while decoding continues but never verifies that the output itself has stabilized. We introduce a training-free, candidate-aware early-exit framework that keeps the two axes separate and matches each decision to evidence of its own scope. Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC) governs when the sequence may stop by verifying confidence and sustained argmax stability over the dynamically extracted candidate span using a deterministic parser specified from each task's output format. Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC) governs where to accelerate by applying a cheaper local rule to non-final blocks, while leaving the final block and global termination under CVC. We refer to their combination as LATCH (Localized Acceleration with Tracked-Candidate Halting). Unlike prior methods, LATCH needs no suffix-prompt construction; it is prompt-anchor-free but format-aware. We evaluate LATCH end to end on 11 tasks under zero-shot settings using LLaDA and Dream. LATCH stays within 2.0 percentage points of full-decoding accuracy across all 22 evaluation settings, with one frozen hyperparameter set that transfers cross-backbone untuned, while achieving end-to-end TPS speedups of 9.3-17.8x on short-answer tasks and 2.0-3.3x on long-reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出LATCH框架，一种训练免费、候选感知的早期退出机制，将全局终止决策（CVC）与局部加速决策（BWEC）分离，通过动态提取候选跨度并验证置信度与argmax稳定性来实现高效早停，在11个零样本任务上相比完整解码精度损失不超过2.0个百分点，同时获得9.3-17.8倍（短答案）和2.0-3.3倍（长推理）的端到端TPS加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）在每步去噪时都会产生临时预测，这为生成时的早期退出创造了机会。然而，现有早期退出门控依赖固定区域的置信度统计或计划依赖的规则，这些证据过于粗糙，无法支持同时冻结所有剩余位置的决策，导致在长链式思维输出上过早触发退出（因为答案往往仅在接近结束时才稳定）。自适应采样作为另一条训练免费的加速途径，只控制位置提交的速度，但从不验证输出本身是否已稳定。因此需要一种将两个决策轴分离、各配以相应范围证据的早退机制。
AI.method: LATCH框架由两个组件构成：(1) Confident-Verified Commit (CVC)负责确定序列何时可以停止，通过确定性解析器从任务输出格式中动态提取候选跨度，并验证该跨度上的置信度与持续的argmax稳定性；(2) Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC)负责确定何处加速，对非最终块应用更廉价的局部规则提前提交，而最终块与全局终止仍由CVC控制。该方法无需后缀提示构造，是prompt-anchor-free但格式感知的。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上、11个任务、零样本设置下进行评估，共22个评估设置。LATCH在所有设置中与完整解码精度的差距保持在2.0个百分点以内，使用一组冻结的超参数且跨骨干网络无需调参即可迁移。端到端TPS加速方面，短答案任务获得9.3-17.8倍加速，长推理任务获得2.0-3.3倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 将全局终止（何时停）与局部加速（何处加速）分离、并分别匹配相应范围的证据，是扩散语言模型生成时加速的有效策略。相比依赖脚手架的不当早退方法，LATCH实现了接近完整解码的精度与显著的端到端加速，且具有跨模型迁移能力。

title: VeriSkill: A Self-Evolution Framework for Program Verification Skills
summary: Automating program verification with LLM agents requires generating specifications, annotations, auxiliary lemmas, and tool invocations, all of which depend on reusable skills. A natural remedy is skill self-evolution: distilling skills from trajectories and refining them through feedback. However, existing evolution methods struggle with program verification tasks because they cannot reliably identify skill-specific failures or extract actionable signals from opaque verifier feedback. In this paper, we propose VeriSkill, a self-evolution framework built for program verification. It attributes verification failures to skill deficiencies, distills diagnostic signatures into reusable lessons, and iteratively refines candidate skills, admitting only revisions that improve verification performance while preserving program semantics. Experiments show that VeriSkill consistently outperforms all baselines across multiple verification tools, agent frameworks, and LLM backends.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriSkill，一个专为程序验证设计的自我进化框架，能够将验证失败归因于技能缺陷、提取可复用的诊断经验，并迭代优化候选技能，仅接受既能提升验证性能又保持程序语义的修订。
AI.motivation: 使用LLM代理自动化程序验证需要生成规格说明、注解、辅助引理和工具调用，这些均依赖可复用技能。虽可通过技能自我进化来提炼和优化技能，但现有进化方法难以可靠识别特定技能失败，也无法从模糊的验证器反馈中提取可操作信号，因此不适用于程序验证任务。
AI.method: VeriSkill框架包含三个核心步骤：(1)将验证失败归因到具体技能缺陷；(2)将诊断特征蒸馏为可复用的经验教训；(3)迭代精炼候选技能，且仅接受能提升验证性能并保持程序语义的修订。
AI.result: 实验表明，VeriSkill在多种验证工具、代理框架和LLM后端上均一致地优于所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VeriSkill有效解决了LLM代理自动化程序验证中技能进化的瓶颈问题，通过精准归因和语义保持的迭代优化，显著提升了跨工具、跨框架、跨后端的验证性能。

title: Learning to Understand Body Language from Flight through Robust 3D Avatar Placing
summary: Perceiving human motion and intent at long range is a prerequisite for socially intelligent aerial robots, yet the data to learn it barely exists. We introduce Drones2BodyLanguage, a dataset grounding human motion in real UAV footage: avatars manifesting ten communicative intents are placed into unmodified 4K drone scenes with metrically correct position, scale and orientation, maintained over hundreds of frames of camera motion. Enabling it is a lightweight geometric world model of the local scene - semantically selected anchors lifted to 3D through streaming monocular depth - in which a placement point is predicted as an affine anchor combination with provably rigid-invariant weights, and re-rendered under an SVD-fitted ground rotation. Across twelve architectures on scene- and motion-disjoint splits, training on placed data lifts mean intent accuracy by a wide margin for real, retargeted and generated motion alike, with gains confirmed on two in-the-wild scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Drones2BodyLanguage数据集，通过在真实无人机4K航拍视频中放置表现十种社交意图的虚拟化身（保持度量准确的位置、尺度和朝向），构建了大规模的人体动作与意图识别训练数据。配套的几何世界模型通过语义锚点与单目深度流预测放置点，并利用仿射锚定组合（具有刚性不变权重）与SVD拟合地面旋转重渲染化身。在12种架构、场景与动作不相交划分的训练中，该方法显著提升真实、重定向及生成动作的意图识别准确率，并在两个野外场景中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 社交智能空中机器人需要在远距离感知人类动作和意图，但缺乏相应的真实训练数据。现有数据集难以提供无人机视角下带有度量一致性的、可大规模获取的人体动作与意图标注数据。
AI.method: 构建轻量级局部场景几何世界模型：通过语义选择锚点并利用流式单目深度提升到3D，将放置点预测为仿射锚点组合（权重具有可证明的刚性不变性），再通过SVD拟合的地面旋转重渲染化身，从而将体现十种交际意图的虚拟化身以度量正确的位姿放置到未修改的4K无人机场景中。
AI.result: 在12种架构上、场景与动作不相交的数据划分下，使用该数据训练使真实、重定向和生成动作的均值意图准确率大幅提升；并在两个野外场景中确认了性能增益。
AI.conclusion: Drones2BodyLanguage作为首类无人机视角人体意图数据集，配合几何世界模型的数据合成方案，为远距离人类动作感知提供了可行且可扩展的途径，验证了合成放置数据对真实场景泛化的有效性。

title: MUGEN: A Unified Framework for Efficient Motion Understanding and Generation
summary: Grounding human motion in language, and language in motion, is a central step toward physical AI systems that can understand, generate, and communicate human behavior. Unified motion--language systems first coupled the two directions through a shared discrete motion codebook, but quantization limits generation quality. The strongest generators buy quality back at growing cost: stacked residual codebooks enlarge the representation; masked decoding stages, long autoregressive rollouts, and denoising chains of tens to hundreds of steps stretch inference; even the continuous-latent designs among them reach their latent only through an iterative diffusion head; and none of this decoding machinery serves understanding. We therefore propose MUGEN, a unified motion--language framework that pays neither cost: no codebook, one draw. A single adaptive-length autoencoder compresses any-length motion into a few continuous latent slots, the system's only motion representation: the language model generates them for text-to-motion and reads them back for motion understanding. Depth-routed hidden states let each slot read from the transformer depth it needs, and a calibrated head predicts a joint distribution over the full latent set, so a single draw carries the text-conditional, cross-slot variation a description permits. At a decoding cost of K language-model steps, one draw, and one decoder pass, MUGEN leads language-model baselines on FID on HumanML3D while raising retrieval precision above the real-motion reference under the standard evaluator, achieves the best CIDEr and BLEU@4 scores, and surpasses the discrete-token state of the art on every retrieval and alignment metric on SnapMoGen.

AI.tldr: MUGEN是一个无需代码本、单次采样的统一运动-语言框架，通过自适应长度自编码器将任意长度运动压缩为少量连续潜变量槽，语言模型同时用于生成（文本到运动）和理解（运动到文本），在多项基准上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有统一运动-语言系统要么受限于离散运动代码本的量化质量，要么依赖堆叠残差代码本、带噪解码链或迭代扩散头来提升生成质量，导致推理成本高昂，且这些解码机制无法服务于运动理解任务。作者希望构建一个同时兼顾生成质量和理解能力、且无需高推理成本（无代码本、单次采样）的统一框架。
AI.method: MUGEN包含三个关键设计：(1) 自适应长度自编码器，将任意长度运动压缩为少量连续潜变量槽，作为系统唯一的运动表示；(2) 深度路由的隐藏状态，使每个潜变量槽能够从所需Transformer深度读取信息；(3) 校准头预测整个潜变量集的联合分布，使单次采样即可承载文本条件下跨槽的变体信息。解码成本仅为K步语言模型步、一次采样和一次解码器前向传播。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D上，MUGEN在FID指标上领先语言模型基线，并在标准评估器下将检索精度提升至超过真实运动参考水平；在SnapMoGen上，MUGEN获得最佳CIDEr和BLEU@4分数，并在所有检索和对其指标上超越离散标记技术的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: MUGEN证明统一运动-语言框架可以在不牺牲生成质量或不增加推理成本的情况下，同时服务于运动生成与运动理解两个方向，为物理AI系统的运动-语言接地提供了高效且高质量的解决方案。

title: The MADRS Pipeline: Supporting Depression Assessment in Clinical Trials
summary: Depression is a major mental disorder for which diagnosis relies primarily on clinical assessments. Automated methods to support its detection via the psychiatric MADRS scale are getting more and more attention. While existing solutions primarily focus on detecting the disorder from different text sources (e.g., online text, social media), there is still limited support for clinical trials, where clinical assessments are conducted through structured interviews based on standard guidelines such as SIGMA. In this work, we develop a LLM pipeline specifically designed to support clinicians in supporting the assessment of depression in patients enrolled in clinical trials. Our pipeline converts audio interviews into transcripts, maps them into the ten MADRS symptom items, estimates their severity, and identify problematic clinical ratings associated with them. Evaluation on real clinical interviews shows a strong overall correlation of 0.867 with expert ratings, providing interpretable support for future assessments in clinical trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化管道，用于支持临床试验中的抑郁症评估。该管道将音频访谈转录为文本，映射到MADRS量表的十个症状条目，评估其严重程度，并识别与临床评分相关的问题。在真实临床访谈上，与专家评分的整体相关度达到0.867。
AI.motivation: 现有抑郁症自动化检测主要基于在线文本或社交媒体等非临床数据源，缺乏对临床试验情境的支持。临床试验中的临床评估通过结构化访谈（如SIGMA指南）进行，目前缺乏相应的自动化辅助方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个LLM管道，包含四个核心步骤：(1) 将音频访谈转录为文本；(2) 将文本映射到MADRS量表的十个症状条目；(3) 估计各症状条目的严重程度；(4) 识别与各条目相关的有问题的临床评分。
AI.result: 在真实临床访谈数据上的评估显示，该管道与专家评分的整体相关性达到0.867，验证了其有效性，并能提供可解释的评估支持。
AI.conclusion: 该LLM管道能够为临床试验中的抑郁症诊断提供可解释的自动化辅助，具有较强的临床相关性，未来有望支持临床试验中的抑郁评估实践。

title: DECODE: Tackling Representation and Decision Degradation in Continual AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: As generative models continue to evolve, AI-generated image detectors must incrementally adapt to emerging generative domains while preserving knowledge acquired from previous ones. This continual learning setting is particularly challenging because forensic traces are often subtle and generator-specific, making detectors highly vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods primarily address this problem by stabilizing feature representations, implicitly treating forgetting as a representation-level issue. In this paper, we show that this perspective is incomplete. We demonstrate that even when feature representations remain discriminative, the decision boundary can progressively drift as the classification head is continually optimized on new domains. These two effects jointly give rise to a compound failure mode, termed Dual Degradation. To overcome this challenge, we propose DECODE, a decoupled continual detection framework that jointly mitigates representation- and decision-level forgetting. Specifically, we introduce Subspace Diversity Regularization (SDR) to preserve diverse forensic representations and Closed-Form Decision Alignment (CDA) to recalibrate the shared classification head after each adapter merge without manual hyperparameter tuning. Extensive experiments on 19 generative domains show that DECODE achieves an average accuracy of 99.36% with only 0.39% forgetting, while further generalizing to 11 unseen generators with 95.36% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DECODE框架，一种解耦的持续学习检测框架，同时缓解AI生成图像检测中的表示层面和决策层面遗忘，解决"双重退化"（Dual Degradation）问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的持续学习AI生成图像检测方法主要关注稳定特征表示，隐含地将遗忘视为表示层面的问题。但本文证明这种视角不完整：即使特征表示保持判别性，随着分类头在新型域上持续优化，决策边界仍会逐渐漂移。这两种效应共同构成"双重退化"复合失效模式，亟需同时从表示和决策两个层面解决。
AI.method: DECODE框架包含两个核心组件：1）子空间多样性正则化（SDR），通过保留多样化的取证特征表示来缓解表示层面的遗忘；2）闭式决策对齐（CDA），在每次适配器合并后无需手动超参数调优即可重新校准共享分类头，缓解决策层面的漂移。整个框架采用解耦的设计，分别处理表示层和决策层的持续学习问题。
AI.result: 在19个生成域上的实验表明，DECODE实现平均99.36%的准确率，仅0.39%的遗忘率；同时能泛化到11个未见生成器，准确率达95.36%。
AI.conclusion: DECODE通过解耦处理表示层和决策层的双重退化，显著提升了持续学习场景下AI生成图像检测的性能与泛化能力，证明了在持续检测中同时关注特征表示和决策边界的重要性。

title: Prox: Training-Free FFN Activation Sparsity via Approximate Intermediate-Channel Salience in LLMs
summary: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) dominate memory traffic and computation in large language model (LLM) inference, making them a primary target for activation sparsification. However, existing training-free methods suffer substantial model-quality degradation at high sparsity due to limitations in their channel-selection strategies. We observe that the SwiGLU intermediate state provides a highly effective channel-selection signal, but obtaining it requires costly dense computation. To address this, we present \emph{Prox}, a two-stage training-free framework for sparse SwiGLU FFNs. Prox hinges on the key insight: sparse execution requires only the channel mask induced by the intermediate state, which can be constructed from the magnitude ranking of its entries rather than their exact values. Specifically, Stage 1 uses input sparsity and quantized proxy weights to construct a shared mask; Stage 2 computes the selected channels exactly, enabling sparse execution of all three projections. Across ten LLMs from six model families, Prox outperforms training-free baselines at all sparsity levels, achieves up to a $1.99\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup at 70\% FFN sparsity, and is compatible with quantization and sparse attention.

AI.tldr: Prox是一种两阶段无训练框架，用于稀疏SwiGLU前馈网络，通过从中间状态的幅度排序（而非精确值）构建通道掩码，实现高效稀疏执行，在十种LLM上超越所有无训练基线，并实现最高1.99倍端到端解码加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理中前馈网络（FFN）主导内存流量和计算，激活稀疏化是关键优化方向。然而现有无训练方法在高稀疏度下因通道选择策略受限而导致模型质量严重下降。虽然SwiGLU中间状态能提供高效的通道选择信号，但获取它需要昂贵的密集计算，形成了关键瓶颈。
AI.method: Prox采用两阶段无训练框架：第一阶段利用输入稀疏性和量化代理权重构建共享掩码（利用稀疏执行仅需通道掩码、而不需精确中间值的洞察，通过幅度排序替代精确计算）；第二阶段精确计算所选通道，从而实现对三个投影矩阵的稀疏执行。
AI.result: 在来自六个模型家族的十个LLM上，Prox在所有稀疏度下均优于无训练基线方法；在70% FFN稀疏度下实现最高1.99倍端到端解码加速，且与量化和稀疏注意力兼容。
AI.conclusion: Prox通过利用中间状态幅度排序与精确值之间的等价性，成功以低成本获取高质量通道选择信号，打破了"高质量掩码需要密集计算"的困境，为无训练的SwiGLU FFN激活稀疏化提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

title: Fidelity Is Not Safety: Gently-Compressed LLMs Pass Every Data-Free Quality Guard Yet Invent Procedure Steps in Agentic Execution
summary: Practitioners accept a compressed language model once it clears a stack of data-cheap quality guards: perplexity within a small factor of the original, downstream accuracy (for example MMLU) inside a confidence interval, and data-free output-fidelity signals that compare the compressed and original network's internal representations under random probe inputs. This stack has a blind spot. Across three model families, gently-compressed models clear every guard and then invent procedure steps that were never in the instructions when they run a standard operating procedure (SOP) as an agent. The effect is operator-specific: coherent low-rank (SVD) truncation induces it, and magnitude pruning matched to the same perplexity does not. One dissociation isolates the cause. The same compressed weights that CI-win a paired output-fidelity test CI-fail the invented-step canary. The governing axis is the coherence of the compression error times its rate; the magnitude of the damage does not predict it. The data-free fidelity probe is a fidelity oracle by construction, so it cannot see this axis. We characterize the blindspot and dissociation with paired confidence intervals on a pre-registered, powered canary across three architectures. Operator-specificity replicates on all three, and the perplexity-guard evasion appears where the model admits in-guard low-rank headroom. We then give a data-free screen: a two-axis statistic of the compression error (coherent-fraction and error-rate) that flags the failing builds with fixed thresholds across architectures and matches the coherence-times-rate mechanism. Perplexity, MMLU, and fidelity acceptance do not certify agent safety. Screen gently-compressed low-rank builds before agentic deployment

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一个压缩模型安全守卫栈（困惑度、下游准确率、无数据保真度检测）的盲区：温和压缩的模型能通过所有常规质检，但在作为智能体执行标准操作流程（SOP）时会凭空编造指令中不存在的步骤。该效应具有算子特异性——低秩SVD截断会诱发，而相同困惑度的幅度剪枝不会。作者通过预注册的canary测试在三个模型家族上复现了这一分离现象，并证明其机制由压缩误差的相干性（coherence）与误差率的乘积驱动，而非误差量级。最后提出一个数据无关的双轴统计筛查（相干分数和误差率），可用固定阈值跨架构识别出有风险的压缩构建。
AI.motivation: 现有压缩模型质检流程（困惑度、MMLU、无数据保真度探测）存在盲区，无法检测压缩模型在智能体场景下编造SOP步骤的安全风险。作者旨在识别并表征这一盲区，并给出可用的无数据筛查方法。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族上进行预注册、有统计功效的配对置信区间canary实验：对比温和压缩（低秩SVD截断与幅度剪枝）模型在智能体SOP执行中的行为；利用输出保真度测试与invented-step canary的CI对比来分离因果；提出压缩误差的双轴统计量（相干分数×误差率）用于无数据筛查。
AI.result: 温和压缩的低秩SVD模型能通过所有常规守卫但在SOP上编造步骤；幅度剪枝在同等困惑度下不产生此效应；该效应与相干压缩误差有关，与误差量级无关；数据无关保真度探测因构造原因无法观测该轴；双轴统计量以跨架构固定阈值成功识别出失败构建。
AI.conclusion: 常规的质量守卫（困惑度、MMLU、保真度）不能认证智能体的安全性；需要对温和压缩的低秩模型在智能体部署前进行专门筛查。

title: Annotating Topical Legal Insights from Case Proceedings
summary: In this paper, we mainly concentrate on finding concepts or topics from the legal case proceedings, since adopting a structured representation for legal documents, as opposed to a mere bag-of-words flat text representation, can significantly enhance processing capabilities. To achieve this objective, we put forward a set of diverse concepts for legal case proceedings. With this motivation, we propose LeDA, a system for Legal Data Annotation. The system offers the generic functionality of annotating and adjudicating entities or concepts within documents via a web-based interface. A novel feature of our system is that it allows to dynamic create new tags for annotation, which is a particularly useful provision for situations where there exists no pre-defined ontology for the entities (concepts) that need to be annotated - these being rather discovered by annotators as they continue examining more documents. The system that we demonstrate is currently in use to annotate a set of concepts from legal documents to construct semantic representations of documents as bags of concepts that can then be used for several downstream tasks, such as prior case retrieval, judgment prediction, and so on. Along with the system features in general, we also describe how LeDA was used by 3 assessors to annotate and adjudicate legal concept names from Indian Supreme Court case proceedings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeDA（Legal Data Annotation）系统，一个用于法律案件文本概念标注的Web系统。其核心创新在于支持动态创建新标签，适用于无预定义本体、需由标注者在文档审阅过程中自行发现概念的场景。该系统已被用于标注印度最高法院案件中的法律概念，以构建文档的"概念袋"（bag-of-concepts）语义表示，服务于先例检索、判决预测等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 法律文件采用结构化概念表示（而非扁平化的词袋文本表示）能显著提升处理能力，因此需要从法律案件文本中发现并标注概念或主题。
AI.method: 构建LeDA通用标注系统，提供基于Web界面的实体/概念标注与裁决功能；创新点在于支持动态创建新标签，避免依赖预定义本体，让标注者在审阅更多文档的过程中自行发现和定义所需标注的概念。
AI.result: LeDA已被应用于印度最高法院案件程序的概念标注场景，由3名评估员使用该系统进行法律概念名称的标注与裁决。
AI.conclusion: LeDA通过动态标签机制解决了无预定义本体时概念标注的难题，构建的"概念袋"语义表示可用于先例检索、判决预测等下游法律智能任务。

title: Unifying Adversarially Robust Model Experts in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, posing a serious problem for real-life applications and deployment. Adversarial fine-tuning emerges as a prominent defense method; however, different fine-tuning strategies often produce specialized models with distinct robustness characteristics. Each fine-tuned model in turn thrives in some evaluation settings but falters on others, limiting their defensive capabilities. We refer to these specialized fine-tuned models as robust model experts and propose a collaborative adversarial fine-tuning framework: CARE - Collaborative Adversarial Robustness fine-tuning using Embedding alignment. CARE maintains multiple experts during training, enables knowledge exchange through embedding-space harmonization, and consolidates the learned knowledge into a single unified robust model. Experts benefit from one another while preserving their individual specializations, enabling the final model to inherit complementary robustness properties. In this paper, we demonstrate CARE on two different adversarial fine-tuning strategies with complementary robustness behaviors. Extensive experiments on classic image classification and downstream vision-language tasks display the effectiveness of our approach, with CARE being able to outperform individually learned model experts. The results suggest that collaborative learning across model experts is a promising direction for improving adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE框架，通过嵌入空间对齐实现多个对抗性微调专家模型之间的协作学习，并将学到的互补鲁棒性知识整合到单一统一模型中，在图像分类和下游视觉语言任务上优于单独训练的专家模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（如CLIP）容易受到对抗攻击，而对抗性微调是主要防御手段，但不同的微调策略往往产生专长不同的专家模型，各自只在某些评估场景下表现良好，限制了防御能力。
AI.method: 提出CARE（Collaborative Adversarial Robustness fine-tuning using Embedding alignment）框架：在训练过程中维护多个专家模型，通过嵌入空间对齐促进知识交换，并将学习到的知识整合为单一统一鲁棒模型。专家之间既能互相受益又保留各自的专业化能力，最终模型继承互补的鲁棒性属性。
AI.result: 在经典图像分类和下游视觉语言任务上的大量实验表明，CARE能够优于单独学习的模型专家，证明了协作学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型专家的协作学习是提升对抗鲁棒性的有前景的方向。

title: Compliance2LoRA: On-Demand Safety Alignment on Arbitrary Policy Subsets via Hypernetwork-Generated LoRA Adapters
summary: Post-training alignment in large reasoning models (LRMs) has significantly improved their adaptability to diverse safety compliance settings. However, as LRMs personalization for downstream users takes center stage, the demand for varying levels of policy compliance grows as different user-specific LRMs must adhere to distinct subsets of safety policies. Training a separate LRM for each policy subset introduces severe combinatorial overhead. While in context learning methods overcome this combinatorial overhead, they introduce additional computational challenges associated with long context generation. To address this challenge, we propose \ours, a unified adaptive hypernetwork-based framework for multi-policy compliance. In our framework, safety policies serve as customizable inputs to a LoRA adapter generator, which learns to produce policy compliant LoRA weights for downstream LRM. When added to the LRM these weights enable the generation of responses compliant with the specified policy subsets. In this work, we demonstrate that training such a hypernetwork enables on-demand policy adjustments on a single LRM without sacrificing task performance across reasoning models of different sized and different evaluation datasets. This highlights the effectiveness and practicality of adaptive hypernetwork based alignment in LRMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出\ours，一种基于自适应超网络的统一框架，用于大型推理模型（LRM）的多策略合规对齐。该框架将安全策略作为可定制输入，通过LoRA适配器生成器为下游LRM生成策略合规的LoRA权重，实现单模型上的按需策略调整，避免了为每个策略子集单独训练模型带来的组合爆炸开销，同时解决了上下文学习方法的长上下文计算挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着LRM个性化需求的增长，不同用户需要模型遵守不同的安全策略子集。为每个策略子集单独训练LRM会产生严重的组合开销；而上下文学习方法虽能避免组合开销，却引入了与长上下文生成相关的额外计算挑战。
AI.method: \ours是一个基于超网络的统一自适应框架。安全策略作为可定制的输入传入LoRA适配器生成器，该生成器学习为下游LRM生成策略合规的LoRA权重。将这些权重添加到LRM后，模型能够生成符合指定策略子集的响应，从而在单一模型上实现按需策略调整。
AI.result: 实验表明，该超网络训练方法能够在不同规模的推理模型和不同评估数据集上，实现单一LRM的按需策略调整，且不牺牲任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了基于自适应超网络的对齐方法在LRM中的有效性和实用性，为解决多策略组合合规问题提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Causal Discovery with Inverted Self-attention for Multivariate Time Series
summary: Causal discovery in multivariate time series data is challenging due to complex interactions, high dimensionality, and nonlinear dependencies among variables. Existing methods often struggle to capture these complexities, resulting in inaccurate causal structures. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that leverages self-attention mechanisms within the transformer architecture for causal discovery. Our approach introduces a novel inverted causal self-attention mechanism (CSAM) that emphasizes latent and indirect causal relationships by inverting tokens and inducing sparsity in attention scores, focusing on significant causal interactions and reducing spurious correlations. Additionally, we develop a global causal algorithm to identify global causal links, providing a holistic metric for causal influence, along with a causal verification module to ensure robustness in the identified causal relationships, enhancing the reliability of our framework. Experiments on both linear and nonlinear datasets, along with ablation studies and sensitivity analyses, show that our framework outperforms existing methods, demonstrating its potential for causal discovery in complex multivariate time series.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于Transformer自注意力机制的因果发现框架，通过创新的倒置因果自注意力机制（CSAM）和全局因果算法，有效识别多元时间序列数据中的线性和非线性因果结构。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列中的因果发现面临复杂交互、高维度和非线性依赖等挑战，现有方法难以捕捉这些复杂性，导致因果结构推断不准确。
AI.method: 提出倒置因果自注意力机制（CSAM），通过倒置token和引入注意力分数稀疏性来强调潜在和间接的因果关系，减少虚假相关性；同时开发全局因果算法识别全局因果关系，并配备因果验证模块增强识别关系的可靠性。
AI.result: 在线性和非线性数据集上的实验、消融研究和敏感性分析均表明，该框架优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在复杂多元时间序列的因果发现中展现出优越性能和高可靠性，具有实际应用潜力。

title: MemeBench: What LVLMs Miss When Interpreting Culture-Dependent Memes
summary: Large vision-language models have improved at describing visual content, but accurate descriptions do not ensure interpretation when meaning depends on knowledge beyond the pixels. Memes expose this gap because they rely on cultural entities, background knowledge, and community conventions. Most meme benchmarks reduce interpretation to labels or holistic scores, obscuring where an explanation breaks down. We introduce MemeBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,253 Chinese and English memes with human-written references and quality-controlled VIKR annotations, centered on anime, comics, games, and adjacent online subcultures. Its VIKR schema decomposes explanations into Visual clues, Identity links, Knowledge units, and Reasoning mechanisms. Across 26 LVLMs, every model covers visible content more reliably than the knowledge needed to interpret it, and even the strongest retains a 22.6% Visual-Knowledge gap. To test whether this diagnosis can guide improvement, we introduce KAR, an entity-guided retrieval baseline built on CultureBase. Across four controlled models, KAR raises VIKR Success by 3.6-7.4% and, compared with generic retrieval, repairs more answers and breaks fewer. Yet both retrieval conditions improve Identity and Knowledge while reducing Visual coverage in every comparison. MemeBench reveals whether an interpretation succeeds, what is missing, and whether targeted evidence fills the diagnosed gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemeBench，一个包含1,253个中英文模因的诊断性基准，采用VIKR标注模式将解释分解为视觉线索、身份链接、知识单元和推理机制四个方面。测试26个LVLM发现所有模型在覆盖可见内容上优于解释所需的知识，最强模型仍有22.6%的视觉-知识差距。基于此诊断引入KAR实体引导检索基线，在四个受控模型上提升VIKR成功率3.6-7.4%，同时修复更多答案且破坏更少，但两种检索条件都在所有对比中降低了视觉覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在描述视觉内容方面有所改进，但准确描述并不保证正确解读，因为模因的含义依赖于像素之外的文化实体、背景知识和社区惯例。现有模因基准大多将解读简化为标签或整体得分，无法揭示解释在何处失效。
AI.method: 构建MemeBench诊断基准（1,253个中英文模因，聚焦动漫、漫画、游戏及相邻在线亚文化），配备人工撰写的参考和经过质量控制的VIKR注释。VIKR模式将解释分解为视觉线索（Visual clues）、身份链接（Identity links）、知识单元（Knowledge units）和推理机制（Reasoning mechanisms）四个维度。同时提出KAR，一个基于CultureBase的实体引导检索基线。
AI.result: 在26个LVLM上评估发现：所有模型覆盖可见内容比解释所需知识更可靠，最强模型仍存在22.6%的视觉-知识差距。KAR在四个受控模型上将VIKR成功率提升3.6-7.4%，相比通用检索能修复更多答案且破坏更少。但两种检索条件在提升身份和知识维度的同时，均降低了视觉覆盖度。
AI.conclusion: MemeBench能够揭示解释是否成功、缺少什么内容，以及定向证据是否能填补诊断出的差距，为诊断和指导模因解释能力提升提供了系统化框架。

title: CoRE-UIR: Prior-guided common and residual experts for efficient all-in-one remote sensing image restoration
comment: Accepted by ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing images acquired by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and satellites are often degraded by adverse weather, illumination variation, and imaging artifacts, which may co-occur and jointly induce global distribution shifts and local structural corruption. Although All-in-One image restoration offers an appealing unified alternative to task-specific pipelines, existing methods still suffer from weak or implicit degradation cues and parameter redundancy caused by full-rank multi-expert designs with overlapping restoration behaviors. We propose CoRE-UIR (Common and Residual Experts for Universal Image Restoration), a prior-guided global-local framework centered on the Common-and-Residual Expert Block (CoRE). CoRE explicitly decomposes restoration capacity into a common dense expert for degradation-invariant restoration and low-rank residual experts for degradation-specific compensation, enabling adaptive specialization without redundant expert replication. Built on this design, Degradation Prior Embedding (DPE) adapts frozen CLIP features into an explicit restoration-oriented prior, while Global Feature Modulation (GFM) aligns global feature statistics before local residual compensation. We also construct MDVD-108K (Multi-Degradation VisDrone), a large-scale UAV restoration dataset covering both single and compound degradations, together with a real-world test set. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets show that CoRE-UIR improves the overall average PSNR by 1.05 dB while running 11.83$\times$ faster and reducing peak memory by 85.3% relative to the strongest baseline, BaryIR, thereby maintaining a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. Evaluations on downstream tasks and unseen degradation also validate the generalizability of CoRE-UIR. The code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/zzaiyan/CoRE-UIR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRE-UIR，一种基于通用-残差双专家结构的通用图像复原框架，通过将复原能力显式分解为公共稠密专家和低秩残差专家，结合CLIP退化先验嵌入和全局特征调制，在多种退化场景下实现高效且高质量的图像复原，同时构建了大规模UAV退化数据集MDVD-108K。
AI.motivation: 无人机和卫星遥感图像常受恶劣天气、光照变化和成像伪影等多重退化因素共同影响，导致全局分布偏移和局部结构损坏。虽然全合一图像复原方法相比任务特定管线更有优势，但现有方法存在退化线索弱或不显式、以及全秩多专家设计导致的参数冗余和复原行为重叠等问题。
AI.method: 提出CoRE（Common-and-Residual Expert Block），将复原能力显式分解为退化不变的公共稠密专家和退化特定的低秩残差专家，避免冗余专家复制。在此基础上构建两个关键模块：Degradation Prior Embedding (DPE)将冻结的CLIP特征适配为显式的复原导向先验；Global Feature Modulation (GFM)在进行局部残差补偿前对齐全局特征统计量。同时构建了大规模UAV复原数据集MDVD-108K，涵盖单重和复合退化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，CoRE-UIR相比最强基线BaryIR，平均PSNR提升1.05 dB，推理速度快11.83倍，峰值内存减少85.3%，实现了良好的质量-效率权衡。下游任务和未见退化的评估也验证了其泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CoRE-UIR通过先验引导的全局-局部框架和公共-残差专家分解设计，有效解决了全合一图像复原中的退化线索不充分和参数冗余问题，在保持高质量复原的同时大幅提升效率和可扩展性，代码和数据集将开源。

title: Back from the Future: Key-Value Cache Management by Counter-Causal Surprise
summary: Key-value (KV) cache management through compression and eviction strategies has emerged as an important research direction in recent years. Computational demands of large language models (LLMs) and their multi-modal variants during output generation can be partially alleviated by caching previous key and value calculations needed by subsequent scaled dot-product attention operations. However, this leads to another problem: the size of the resulting KV cache grows linearly with context length and quickly consumes all available GPU memory when either the prompt or the generated output are long. KV cache management periodically prunes entries from the cache thereby reducing its memory footprint while attempting to retain sufficient information for accurate generation. A by-product is faster inference speed. We propose a simple yet effective KV eviction scheme motivated by the insight that past tokens which can be well-predicted from more recent tokens are redundant and their associated keys and values can be removed from the cache. To score entries for eviction we run the model on the tokens in their original order, reusing the key and value representations already stored in the KV cache, and applying a counter-causal attention mask so that each position attends only to its future context. This is in-distribution, tied directly to the actual cache contents, and requires no additional training. To further reduce cost, we additionally propose a fast single-layer approximation that restricts the counter-causal pass to the last transformer layer, achieving a significant speedup per refresh cycle at marginal accuracy cost. We evaluate our strategy on various open-source LLMs and benchmark datasets showing competitive or improved performance over other state-of-the-art methods. Reference code is available at https://github.com/metacognitionai/counter_causal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种简单有效的KV缓存驱逐策略，基于"过去token若能由更近期的token良好预测则是冗余的"这一洞察，通过反向因果注意力机制对缓存条目进行评分和驱逐，无需额外训练，并在多种开源LLM和基准数据集上表现出竞争性或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: LLM及其多模态变体在输出生成过程中，KV缓存随上下文长度线性增长，迅速耗尽GPU内存。现有的KV缓存压缩和驱逐策略需要更有效的方法来在减少内存占用的同时保留足够信息用于准确生成，并加速推理。
AI.method: 提出反向因果（counter-causal）KV驱逐方案：利用存储在缓存中的键值表示，对原始顺序的token施加反向因果注意力掩码（每个位置只关注其未来上下文），从而对每个条目进行冗余度评分。冗余的token（可由更新token良好预测的）被驱逐。同时提出快速单层近似版本，仅对最后一层transformer层执行反向因果传递，在显著降低刷新开销的同时保持精度。
AI.result: 在多种开源LLM和基准数据集上的评估显示，该策略相对于其他最先进方法具有竞争性或更优的性能。快速单层近似在每轮刷新周期内实现了显著加速，仅带来微小的精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是一种无需额外训练、与缓存内容直接关联、分布内（in-distribution）的KV驱逐策略，通过反向因果注意力有效识别冗余token并移除其键值对，在降低内存占用和加速推理的同时保持生成质量。代码已开源。

title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
summary: The web is increasingly accessed by AI agents rather than humans. Every agent needs knowledge, especially in the life-sciences, where agentic pipelines are growing fast. Access to the literature is a crucial part of that need, and resources such as Europe PMC, with over 40M indexed records, are widely used to meet it. Yet these resources were not built for AI agents: they take keywords and complex syntax and return whole papers, so every agent must learn the syntax, issue several searches, and read full papers to find the evidence it needs. We introduce EMBL AI Librarian, a knowledge layer that upgrades the Europe PMC interface for AI agents: an agent asks in natural language and receives evidence that answers it. A single LLM orchestrates the whole knowledge retrieval process: it plans complementary subqueries executed by the live Europe PMC search engine, then reads the selected papers and locates the relevant evidence. We evaluate Librarian across four benchmarks: literature synthesis, claim verification, open-domain question answering, and downstream biology tasks such as protocol questions and sequence manipulation. On ScholarQABench, Librarian improves Citation F1 by more than $16$ points over strong recently published baselines. Used as the retrieval layer of an existing claim-verification pipeline, it increases agreement with expert consensus; and on the open-form LitQA2 benchmark, a GPT-5.4 agent scores about $8$ points higher when grounded in Librarian than with web search. Overall, our results show that equipping life-science agents with the Librarian knowledge layer improves performance across a range of tasks. We release our code publicly at https://github.com/petroni-lab/librarian

AI.tldr: 本文介绍EMBL AI Librarian，一个将欧洲PMC（Europe PMC）生命科学文献检索接口升级为面向AI代理的知识层。代理可直接用自然语言提问，由单个LLM编排整个检索流程：规划互补子查询、调用实时Europe PMC搜索、阅读论文并定位证据。在四个基准上均取得显著提升，如ScholarQABench上Citation F1提升超16点，LitQA2上比网页搜索高约8点。
AI.motivation: Web正越来越多地被AI代理而非人类访问，尤其是在生命科学领域，代理管线正在快速增长。但现有文献资源（如Europe PMC）是为人类设计的：需要关键词和复杂语法，返回整篇论文，导致每个代理必须学习语法、发出多次搜索并通读全文才能找到所需证据。这严重阻碍了AI代理高效获取文献知识的效率。
AI.method: 提出EMBL AI Librarian作为知识层升级Europe PMC接口。核心方法为：单一LLM编排整个知识检索过程——先规划互补的子查询并由实时Europe PMC搜索引擎执行，然后阅读选中的论文并定位相关证据。该层允许代理以自然语言提问并获得直接答案。
AI.result: 在四个基准上评估：文献综述、声明验证、开放域问答和下游生物学任务（协议问题和序列操作）。在ScholarQABench上，Citation F1比强大近期基线提升超过16点；作为现有声明验证管道的检索层，提升了与专家共识的一致性；在LitQA2上，GPT-5.4代理在基于Librarian时比网页搜索高约8点。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: 为生命科学代理配备Librarian知识层可在多种任务上提升性能，证明用LLM编排的知识检索层是升级面向AI代理的学术资源接口的有效范式。

title: STEREODISCO: Discovering Stereotypicality in LLMs
summary: LLMs encode, convey, and perpetuate stereotypes. Prior computational research focuses on a small set of semantic axes investigated in social psychology, and operates on word embeddings produced by language models, leaving open which other semantic axes carry stereotypical associations in LLMs and how LLMs internally represent such axes. We introduce STEREODISCO, a framework that adapts the semantic differential method (Osgood et al., 1957) to the systematic study of stereotypes in LLM internal representations. STEREODISCO constructs approx. 2,000 candidate semantic axes from WordNet antonym synsets, recovers each as a geometric axis in the LLM's activation space via probing, and identifies stereotypical axes via a statistical test over concept projections. As a case study, we apply STEREODISCO to social group stereotypes with LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT and MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT. We find that the two LLMs agree with each other on social group ratings more than with humans, suggesting that LLM-encoded stereotype content diverges from that documented in social psychology. We also discover stereotypical axes not investigated in prior work -- including humble vs. proud, narrow-minded vs. broad-minded, and cowardly vs. brave, which human annotators independently confirm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEREODISCO框架，将语义微分法（semantic differential）适配到LLM内部表征中系统研究刻板印象。该框架从WordNet反义词集构建约2000个候选语义轴，通过探针在LLM激活空间中恢复每个几何轴，并用统计检验识别刻板印象轴。在LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT和MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT上的案例研究发现，两个LLM对社会群体的评分彼此间的相似度高于与人类的相似度，且发现了一些前人未研究的刻板印象轴（如谦虚vs骄傲、狭隘vs开阔、怯懦vs勇敢），并经人类标注者独立验证。
AI.motivation: 现有计算研究仅关注社会心理学中少量语义轴，且局限于词嵌入层面，未能回答LLM内部还编码哪些其他语义轴、以及这些轴在LLM内部是如何表征的。作者旨在系统化地发现LLM内部表征中存在的全部刻板印象语义轴，而不仅限于心理学文献中已知的少数几个。
AI.method: STEREODISCO框架包含三步：(1) 从WordNet反义词同义词集构建约2000个候选语义轴；(2) 通过探针（probing）在每个轴的语义概念激活空间中恢复对应的几何轴；(3) 对社会群体概念投影执行统计检验，识别出存在刻板印象关联的语义轴。以LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT和MISTRAL-7B-INSTRUCT为案例研究对象。
AI.result: 两个LLM在社交群体评分上彼此的一致性高于与人类的一致性，说明LLM编码的刻板印象内容与社会心理学文献记录的存在分歧。发现了前人未研究过的刻板印象轴，包括谦虚vs骄傲、狭隘vs开阔、怯懦vs勇敢，这些轴经人类标注者独立确认。
AI.conclusion: STEREODISCO能够系统、数据驱动地发现LLM内部表征中的刻板印象语义轴，超越传统局限于少数心理学维度的研究范式。LLM编码的刻板印象与社会心理学已有发现存在差异，且存在新的未被探索的刻板印象轴，这对LLM偏见评估与缓解具有重要意义。

title: One Patch Is Enough: Reinforcement-Optimized Visual Token Grounding for MLLM-Based Scene Text Spotting
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Scene text spotting requires high-precision alignment between textual recognition and spatial localization. While visual-token grounding has emerged as a promising formulation for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the previous multi-patch paradigm often introduces redundant noise and localization ambiguity, particularly for dense or small text instances. To address this, we propose Single-Patch Text Spotting (SPaTS), a vision-centric framework that routes each text instance through a single anchor visual token and then recovers geometry via full-image refinement. To accurately identify this anchor without oracle labels, we introduce Single-Patch Selective Optimization (SPaSO), a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes discrete visual-token selection using patch-level rewards. To further improve representation robustness and localization precision, we introduce Directional Embedding Alignment (DEA) to suppress unstable norm bias by decoupling feature magnitude and direction, and Patch-Enhanced Decoding (PED) to fuse the routed anchor with language semantics and cross-attend over the full-image feature map for geometry-aware boundary regression beyond coordinate-space surrogates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPaTS consistently and significantly outperforms both frontier closed-source MLLMs and OCR MLLMs. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: SPaTS是一种视觉中心的场景文本定位框架，通过单一锚点视觉token路由每个文本实例，并结合强化学习（SPaSO）进行离散token选择优化、方向嵌入对齐（DEA）和补丁增强解码（PED）来提升定位精度，在实验中显著优于前沿闭源MLLM和OCR MLLM。
AI.motivation: 场景文本定位需要文本识别与空间定位的高精度对齐。现有的基于多补丁（multi-patch）的视觉token grounding范式在密集或小文本实例场景中引入冗余噪声和定位歧义，因此需要一种更精确、更高效的视觉token锚定方式。
AI.method: 1) 单补丁文本定位（SPaTS）：每个文本实例通过单一锚点视觉token进行路由，再通过全图精炼恢复几何信息，避免多补丁带来的噪声与歧义。2) 单补丁选择性优化（SPaSO）：一种强化学习框架，使用补丁级奖励优化离散视觉token的选择，无需oracle标签。3) 方向嵌入对齐（DEA）：通过解耦特征幅度与方向来抑制不稳定的范数偏差，增强表示鲁棒性。4) 补丁增强解码（PED）：将路由的锚点与语言语义融合，并对全图特征图进行交叉注意力，实现超越坐标空间代理的几何感知边界回归。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SPaTS在场景文本定位任务上 consistently 且显著地超越了前沿闭源MLLM和OCR MLLM。代码即将开源。
AI.conclusion: SPaTS通过单一锚点token路由与全图精炼的联合设计，配合SPaSO强化学习、DEA特征解耦和PED几何感知解码，有效解决了多补丁范式在密集/小文本场景下的噪声与定位模糊问题，验证了视觉中心范式在多模态大语言模型场景文本定位中的优越性。

title: Kalman Meets Curriculum: Efficient Dynamic Prompt Selection for Adaptive RL Finetuning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) finetuning significantly enhances the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet its effectiveness critically depends on selecting prompts of appropriate difficulty for the current policy. This is challenging because prompt difficulty evolves throughout training. Existing online methods therefore face a trade-off: evaluation-based approaches are accurate but expensive, while prediction-based approaches are efficient but typically assume stationary difficulty, making them ill-suited to RL's non-stationary training dynamics. To address these issues, we propose a Kalman-Guided Prompt Selection method (KGPS), which reformulates prompt selection as a dynamic state estimation problem rather than static difficulty prediction. KGPS models each prompt's latent success rate in logit space using a linear-Gaussian state-space model, with process noise coupled to the magnitude of policy updates so that uncertainty increases when the policy changes more substantially. A Kalman filter then maintains a calibrated Gaussian posterior over prompt difficulty, and prompts are selected by maximizing a posterior-expected training utility that favors intermediate-difficulty prompts while naturally revisiting uncertain ones. The resulting procedure is adaptive to policy drift and requires no additional rollouts beyond standard policy training. Extensive experiments across mathematics, planning, and geometry reasoning benchmarks, as well as multiple RL algorithms, show that KGPS consistently improves both final accuracy and rollout efficiency over strong baselines, establishing state-of-the-art performance among online prompt selection methods. For example, on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B, KGPS uses 83% fewer rollouts than DS while even improving the average performance by 0.12 point across six math reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGPS（Kalman-Guided Prompt Selection），将提示选择重新建模为动态状态估计问题，利用卡尔曼滤波维护提示难度的校准高斯后验，在标准策略训练过程中无需额外rollout即可自适应策略漂移，在数学、规划和几何推理基准及多种RL算法上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习微调中提示难度选择至关重要，但提示难度在训练过程中动态演化。现有在线方法面临权衡：基于评估的方法准确但昂贵，基于预测的方法高效但假设难度平稳，难以适应RL的非平稳训练动态。
AI.method: KGPS将每个提示的潜在成功率在logit空间中建模为线性高斯状态空间模型，过程噪声与策略更新的幅度耦合（策略变化越大不确定性越高），通过卡尔曼滤波器维护提示难度的校准高斯后验，并最大化后验期望训练效用以选择中等难度提示并自然重访不确定提示。该方法不需要额外rollout。
AI.result: 在数学、规划和几何推理基准及多种RL算法上，KGPS一致优于强基线。例如在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B上，相比DS方法使用83%更少的rollout，同时平均性能提升0.12个点。
AI.conclusion: KGPS建立了在线提示选择方法的最优性能，其核心优势在于将静态难度预测转化为动态状态估计，从而自适应策略漂移并显著提升rollout效率。

title: Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 27 tables. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review
summary: Transformer depth is not used uniformly: lower and middle layers build semantic representations, while upper layers increasingly specialize them for prediction. We turn this division of labor into CoMem (Comprehension Memory), which writes each context chunk only through an intermediate layer, retrieves a fixed number of cached residual states, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers over the resulting pack. For a fixed retrieval budget, model-side read compute and memory are independent of stored-context length. We evaluate a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM under a unified chat-template-free protocol. The backbone is frozen; the flagship trains only a rank-32 self-distillation LoRA on plain PG19, and we report an adapter-free arm separately. CoMem reaches 97.05 on RULER and 38.27 on LoCoMo versus 34.59 for full-context KV-Direct; the dialogue-memory advantage survives conversation-cluster resampling and an independent judge. Results on additional long-context and long-document tasks expose both the benefits of bounded retrieval and its in-window compression tax. Controlled depth sweeps show that deeper caching lowers per-query recomputation but incurs a fidelity loss that self-distillation substantially repairs. In a separate adapter-free efficiency control on an NVIDIA H20 at 128k, CoMem uses 18.26 GB rather than 89.36 GB and achieves a 7.83x prefill speedup. These results show that long-context memory can be organized along the layer axis, not only the token axis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoMem（Comprehension Memory），利用Transformer各层分工不均的特性——低中层构建语义表示、上层进行预测特化——将长上下文内存组织在层轴而非仅token轴上。该方法仅通过中间层写入上下文块，检索固定数量的缓存残差状态，并重计算查询条件化上层，实现与存储上下文长度无关的读取计算量。在Qwen3-8B上，CoMem在RULER达到97.05、LoCoMo达到38.27，并在128k上下文下实现7.83倍prefill加速和18.26GB显存占用（对比89.36GB）。
AI.motivation: 传统长上下文Transformer将所有层均等应用于全部token，KV缓存随上下文线性增长，导致存储和计算开销巨大。作者观察到Transformer层的用途不均：低中层构建语义表示，上层则特化进行预测。这一观察暗示可以在层轴而非token轴上组织长期记忆，从而打破上下文长度对计算和内存的限制。
