AI.method: CoMem通过三个关键步骤运作：(1) 每个上下文块仅通过中间层写入缓存（comprehension memory写作）；(2) 检索固定数量的缓存的残差状态（bounded retrieval）；(3) 在检索得到的压缩包上重计算查询条件化的上层。模型仅训练rank-32自蒸馏LoRA（基于PG19语料），主干冻结，并额外报告无适配器版本。在统一chat-template-free协议下进行评估。
AI.result: CoMem在RULER上达到97.05，在LoCoMo上达38.27（对比全上下文KV-Direct的34.59），对话记忆优势在对话簇重采样和独立评判下保持稳健。在H20 128k场景下，显存从89.36GB降至18.26GB，prefill加速7.83倍。深度扫描实验表明更深的缓存降低每查询重计算量但引入保真度损失，自蒸馏能显著修复。在额外长上下文和长文档任务上，既展现了有限检索的优势，也暴露了窗口内压缩的代价。
AI.conclusion: CoMem证明了长上下文记忆可以被组织在层轴上而非仅token轴上，通过分离"理解"（comprehension，中下层完成）与"预测特化"（upper layers完成）两个阶段，以固定检索预算实现与存储上下文长度无关的读取计算和内存开销。该工作为长上下文处理提供了新的组织维度，同时也表明有限检索与窗口内压缩之间存在折中权衡。

title: Sign Language Question Answering: A New Task, Benchmark, and Baseline for Sign Language Understanding
summary: Recent advances in sign language (SL) understanding (SLU) have led to remarkable progress in tasks such as continuous SL recognition and SL translation. However, these tasks are designed with predefined objectives, requiring models to learn a fixed mapping from sign videos to glosses or spoken-language sentences. As a result, they provide only a limited assessment of whether a model truly understands the semantic content of SL videos. To address this limitation, \textbf{we first propose a new task, Sign Language Question Answering (SLQA)}, which evaluates SL understanding by requiring models to answer arbitrary natural language questions about SL videos. Unlike previous SLU tasks, SLQA provides a more flexible and comprehensive evaluation framework that assesses multiple reasoning capabilities beyond recognition and translation. To facilitate this task, \textbf{we further construct two SignQA benchmarks} based on PHOENIX14T and CSL-Daily by automatically generating question-answer pairs from existing gloss and sentence annotations using carefully designed templates. The resulting datasets cover five complementary question categories, including position reasoning, structural reasoning, visual search, gloss recognition, and translation understanding. \textbf{Finally, we propose a simple yet effective baseline model} equipped with a Question-Conditioned Modulated Temporal Downsampling module and an in-domain knowledge transfer strategy, enabling effective knowledge transfer from existing SLU tasks while enhancing question-aware temporal feature modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our baseline consistently outperforms representative vision-language models across all question categories, establishing a strong benchmark for future research on SLQA. Datasets are available at:{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hulala/SignQA-2026}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出手语问答（SLQA）任务，基于PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily构建两个SignQA基准数据集，涵盖五类问题，并提出一个带有问题条件调制时间下采样模块和领域内知识迁移策略的基线模型，在全部问题类别上优于代表性视觉-语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有手语理解（SLU）任务（如连续手语识别和手语翻译）都预设了固定的目标，仅要求模型学习从手语视频到gloss或口语语句的固定映射，因此无法全面评估模型是否真正理解手语视频的语义内容。需要一种更灵活、更全面的评估框架来检验模型的多重推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出SLQA任务，通过回答任意自然语言问题来评估手语视频理解。2) 基于PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily，利用精心设计的模板从现有gloss和句子标注中自动生成问答对，构建两个SignQA基准，覆盖位置推理、结构推理、视觉搜索、gloss识别和翻译理解五类问题。3) 提出基线模型，包含Question-Conditioned Modulated Temporal Downsampling（QCMTD）模块和领域内知识迁移策略，实现从现有SLU任务的有效知识迁移并增强问题感知的时间特征建模。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该基线模型在所有问题类别上均一致优于代表性视觉-语言模型，为未来SLQA研究建立了强基准。数据集已在HuggingFace公开。
AI.conclusion: SLQA为手语理解提供了更全面的评估框架，所构建的SignQA基准和基线模型为后续研究奠定了坚实基础，展示了从现有SLU任务迁移知识以增强手语视频细粒度语义理解的可行性。

title: ARD-REFSM: Enhancing Reflection Symmetry Detection with Asymmetric Denoising and Rotation Equivariance
summary: Reflection symmetry detection remains challenging due to interference from asymmetric regions and arbitrary orientations of symmetric patterns. Asymmetric regions introduce background clutter that disrupts symmetric pattern matching, whereas conventional convolutional neural networks lack rotation equivariance, leading to inconsistent feature representations under rotational transformations. To address these issues, we propose an Asymmetric Region Denoising (ARD) module and a Rotation Equivariant Feature Similarity Matching (REFSM) module. The ARD module suppresses asymmetric interference to refine symmetric patterns, while the REFSM module enhances rotation equivariance through feature similarity matching between original and rotated images. Specifically, our dual-input REFSM framework leverages rotation loss to maximize consistency between the score maps of original and rotated images, thereby enabling precise prediction of rotation-equivariant symmetry axes. Furthermore, we introduce GMSYM, a new benchmark dataset that categorizes images into diverse scenarios and incorporates various interferences to address the limitations of existing reflection symmetry detection benchmarks. Extensive experiments on four standard datasets (DENDI, NYU, LDRS, SDRW) and our proposed GMSYM dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对称性检测的SOTA方法，包含ARD去噪模块和REFSM旋转等变特征匹配模块，并引入新基准数据集GMSYM，在四个标准数据集及GMSYM上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 反射对称检测面临两大挑战：一是非对称区域产生背景杂波干扰对称模式的匹配；二是传统CNN缺乏旋转等变性，导致旋转变换下特征表示不一致，影响任意方向对称轴的检测。
AI.method: 提出双模块框架：(1) ARD模块用于抑制非对称区域干扰，精炼对称模式；(2) REFSM模块通过原始图像与旋转图像之间的特征相似性匹配增强旋转等变性，并利用旋转损失最大化两者得分图的一致性，实现旋转等变对称轴的精确预测。同时构建GMSYM基准数据集，将图像分类为多样场景并包含多种干扰。
AI.result: 在四个标准数据集（DENDI、NYU、LDRS、SDRW）及GMSYM数据集上均取得最优准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的ARD+REFSM框架有效解决了非对称干扰和旋转等变性问题，在反射对称检测任务上达到SOTA性能，且GMSYM基准为后续研究提供了更全面的评测平台。

title: Real-Time Hard Peak Age-of-Information Safety with No-Regret Learning
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE Real-Time Systems Symposium (RTSS)
summary: Safety-critical IoT systems such as industrial closed-loop control, V2X coordination, and remote teleoperation require every sensor's peak Age of Information (peak AoI, also abbreviated PAoI) to stay below a hard per-slot deadline, not merely an average bound. Existing approaches meet this requirement only under restrictive assumptions: stochastic channels for Whittle-index AoI, simulator rollouts for deep reinforcement learning, or sublinear cumulative violation for long-term constrained online convex optimization. Under adversarial coefficients, OCO-PAoI-Hard guarantees zero per-slot violation of the modeled AoI state under one-step viability and O(sqrt(T)) regret against any static safe comparator; packet-level safety requires stronger service assumptions. Our key observation is that the fractional peak-AoI deadline collapses exactly to an affine half-space constraint on the resource-allocation vector, turning hard real-time scheduling into time-varying constrained online convex optimization over a polyhedral safe set. A strictly causal proposal-shield-update loop enforces feasibility through one Euclidean projection per slot, the gradient step preserves no-regret behavior, and the classical virtual queue is reduced to an a-posteriori certificate. We establish closed-form static and dynamic regret bounds, a matching Omega(sqrt(T)) minimax lower bound, a margin-safe variant against execution noise, and a deadline-induced competitive ratio. On a four-sensor adversarial fluid-model trap channel, OCO-PAoI-Hard attains zero modeled-state deadline violations across all ten seeds, while four representative baselines miss between 1.65 percent and 64.0 percent of slots, and the empirical normalized regret stays below the theoretical envelope across two orders of magnitude in T.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OCO-PAoI-Hard框架，将安全关键IoT系统中每个传感器峰值信息年龄（PAoI）的硬每时隙截止期约束转化为面向资源分配向量的仿射半空间约束，从而将硬实时调度问题重新建模为多面体安全集上的时变约束在线凸优化问题，保证零逐时隙违反并提供O(√T)遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 安全关键IoT系统（工业闭环控制、V2X协调、远程遥操作）要求每个传感器的峰值信息年龄严格低于硬性每时隙截止期，而不仅是平均界限。现有方法都有局限性：Whittle-index方法依赖随机信道假设，深度强化学习需要模拟器回放，长时约束在线凸优化只能保证次线性累积违反。因此需要一种在对抗性系数下也能保证零逐时隙违反且具次线性遗憾的方法。
AI.method: 核心洞察是将分数峰值AoI截止期精确塌缩为对资源分配向量的仿射半空间约束，从而将问题转化为多面体安全集上的时变约束在线凸优化。算法采用严格因果的"提案-屏蔽-更新"循环：每时隙通过一次欧几里得投影强制执行可行性，梯度步保持无遗憾特性，经典虚拟队列退化为事后证书（a-posteriori certificate）。
AI.result: 1) 在一步可行性（one-step viability）条件下，对任何静态安全比较器保证零建模状态逐时隙违反和O(√T)遗憾；2) 建立了静态与动态遗憾的闭式界、匹配的Ω(√T)极小极大下界、针对执行噪声的余量安全变体，以及截止期引发的竞争比；3) 在四传感器对抗性流体模型陷阱信道上，OCO-PAoI-Hard在全部十个种子下达到零建模状态截止期违反，而四个代表性基线错过1.65%至64.0%的时隙；4) 经验归一化遗憾在T的两个数量级范围内保持在理论包络线之下。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将硬实时调度精确重构为约束在线凸优化，首次在对抗性设置下实现了零逐时隙PAoI截止期违反与次线性遗憾的兼得，并提供了完整的理论保障和经验验证，为安全关键IoT系统的资源调度提供了严格的理论基础。

title: MORFES: A Benchmark for Productive Inflectional Competence in Modern Greek
summary: Modern Greek is a richly inflected language, yet the language models built for it are evaluated mainly on factual knowledge, and no benchmark is dedicated to their inflectional competence. We introduce MORFES (Morphological Open-class Recognition-and-Formation Evaluation Suite), a benchmark of 500 expert-verified items that tests the recognition and production of Greek inflected forms, favoring lower-frequency lemmas so that a correct answer reflects the rule rather than a memorized form. We make it publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/KIEFERSA/MORFES. We evaluate a range of open language models on MORFES, situating them within the rapidly scaling open-weight ecosystem from LLaMA to Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Magistral, and Kimi K2, where multilingual coverage grows but grammatical competence in morphologically rich languages remains under-measured. Among them, Sophea-Genesis-1, a model we developed and release as open weights at https://huggingface.co/KIEFERSA/Sophea-Genesis-1, leads on inflectional morphology while matching similarly sized models in general capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MORFES基准，一个包含500个专家验证条目的现代希腊语形态学评估套件，用于测试屈折形式的识别与生成能力；同时发布Sophea-Genesis-1模型，在屈折形态学任务上领先但保持与其他同规模模型相当的综合能力。
AI.motivation: 现代希腊语是一种高度屈折的语言，但为其构建的语言模型主要基于事实知识进行评估，缺乏专门针对屈折形态能力的基准测试，导致形态丰富的语言中语法能力未被充分度量。
AI.method: 构建MORFES基准套件，包含500个专家验证的测试项目，测试希腊语屈折形式的识别与生成；刻意偏向低频词素，确保正确回答反映规则掌握而非记忆形式。评估范围覆盖从LLaMA到Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1、Magistral、Kimi K2等多个开源模型。
AI.result: 在评估的多种开源模型中，作者开发的Sophea-Genesis-1在屈折形态学任务上表现领先，同时在与同规模模型对比时保持相当的综合能力。
AI.conclusion: MORFES填补了现代希腊语形态学评估的空白，揭示了开源模型在形态丰富语言的屈折能力上仍存在未充分评估的问题；Sophea-Genesis-1证明了在不牺牲通用能力的前提下可以提升低资源语言的形态学表现。

title: MemTxn: A Transaction Boundary for Source-Supported Updates and Complete-State Recovery in Agent Memory
summary: Persistent memory lets long-running large language model agents reuse information across sessions and tasks. Yet errors in writable memory can persist and corrupt future behavior. Existing systems improve storage and retrieval, but they do not provide a transaction boundary for reliable updates and recovery. We therefore propose MemTxn, a governance layer outside the answer model. MemTxn verifies whether an update is supported by its source. It also selects the visible version when facts conflict and restores the application-visible state after a fault. The system uses Ordered PatchTest to validate writes, a Temporal Resolver to select versions, and a durable snapshot journal to recover state. On an item-disjoint audit, MemTxn accepts all 60 supported originals and rejects all 179 hard negatives. Under persistent multi-key faults on LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo states, it restores the complete declared active map without knowing the actual physical write set. On MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation, MemTxn achieves the highest average F1 across all twelve answer-model configurations. It outperforms Dense by 17.06--24.07 points in five representative settings.

AI.tldr: MemTxn是一个位于答案模型之外的内存治理层，为持久化大语言模型智能体提供事务边界，通过Ordered PatchTest验证写入、Temporal Resolver解决事实冲突、持久快照日志恢复故障状态，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 持久化内存使LLM智能体能够跨会话和任务重用信息，但可写内存中的错误会持久存在并污染后续行为。现有系统虽优化了存储和检索，但缺乏可靠更新与恢复的事务边界，因此需要引入事务性治理机制。
AI.method: MemTxn作为一个答案模型之外的治理层，包含三个核心组件：Ordered PatchTest用于验证写入是否被其来源支持；Temporal Resolver用于在事实冲突时选择可见版本；持久快照日志用于在故障后恢复应用可见状态。
AI.result: 在item-disjoint审计中，MemTxn接受全部60个受支持originals并拒绝全部179个硬负例。在LongMemEval-S和LoCoMo的多键持久故障下，无需知晓实际物理写入集即可恢复完整的声明活动映射。在MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation中，MemTxn在全部十二个答案模型配置下取得最高平均F1，在五个代表性场景中比Dense高出17.06-24.07分。
AI.conclusion: MemTxn通过事务性治理层有效解决了持久化LLM内存的可靠更新、冲突解决与故障恢复问题，实验证明其在审计、恢复和事实整合任务中均优于现有方法，为长期运行的LLM智能体提供了更加可靠的持久内存管理方案。

title: LAST: The Last Query Token Guides Visual Token Pruning for Edge-Cloud Collaborative MLLM Inference
summary: Multimodal foundation models are reshaping edge-cloud visual intelligence from task-specific feature pipelines into token-based interfaces, where edge devices encode visual inputs into tokens for a general-purpose cloud MLLM. However, dense visual-token sequences increase cloud-side inference costs. Existing pruning methods mainly target centralized inference: vision-driven methods can operate before cloud execution but are typically query-agnostic, whereas query-guided methods often rely on internal states of the target MLLM and cannot determine token relevance before transmission. Compact guidance models offer an alternative, but existing designs may require costly attention aggregation or auxiliary generation. We propose LAST, a training-free framework for query-dependent visual token pruning in edge-cloud collaborative MLLM inference. LAST uses a compact edge-side VLM as a guidance proxy and derives a lightweight importance signal from the last query token's attention to visual tokens. Under causal attention, the last query token can attend to the full visual sequence and the entire query context, enabling query-aware pruning without cloud-model access, autoregressive generation, or costly aggregation over multiple query positions. LAST then retains a diverse set of query-relevant visual tokens under a fixed token budget. We evaluate LAST on 11 multimodal benchmarks under multiple token budgets against pruning methods with different guidance strategies. Experiments show that LAST consistently achieves the strongest performance, preserving 95.4% of the full-token accuracy while retaining only 12.5% of the visual tokens, with low edge-side selection overhead and reduced cloud-side computation.

AI.tldr: 提出LAST框架，一种训练-free的查询依赖视觉token剪枝方法，用于边缘-云端协作的多模态大语言模型推理。利用边缘侧紧凑VLM作为引导代理，从最后一个查询token对视觉token的注意力中提取轻量级重要性信号，在固定token预算下保留多样且查询相关的视觉token，在11个基准上仅保留12.5%视觉token即可保持95.4%的完整token准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型将边缘-云端视觉智能转变为基于token的接口，但密集的视觉token序列增加了云端推理成本。现有剪枝方法主要针对集中式推理：视觉驱动方法查询无关，查询引导方法依赖目标MLLM内部状态无法在传输前确定token相关性，而现有紧凑引导模型设计需要昂贵的注意力聚合或辅助生成。
AI.method: LAST采用训练-free框架，使用边缘侧紧凑VLM作为引导代理，从因果注意力下最后一个查询token对视觉token的注意力中提取轻量级重要性信号。该token可关注完整视觉序列和全部查询上下文，实现无需云端模型访问、无需自回归生成或多次查询位置聚合的查询感知剪枝，在固定token预算下保留多样化且查询相关的视觉token。
AI.result: 在11个多模态基准上，针对多种token预算和不同引导策略的剪枝方法进行评估，LAST一致取得最强性能：仅保留12.5%的视觉token即可保持95.4%的完整token准确率，且边缘侧选择开销低、云端计算量减少。
AI.conclusion: LAST证明了在边缘-云端协作MLLM推理中，利用紧凑边缘侧VLM结合因果注意力下最后查询token的注意力信号，能够以训练-free方式实现高效、查询感知的视觉token剪枝，在极低token保留率下保持接近完整的准确性，同时降低边缘侧和云端两侧的计算成本。

title: First-order Constrained Trilevel Optimization Over Distributed Networks for Robust Coreset Selection
summary: With the rapid advancement of the Internet of Things (IoT), massive amounts of data are generated across distributed edge networks. Training models on full data incurs significant computational overhead and storage bottlenecks, rendering coreset selection a critical paradigm. Furthermore, given the privacy-sensitive nature of local data and the escalating demand for model robustness in real-world deployments, developing an effective distributed optimization framework for robust coreset selection is vital, yet remains largely unexplored. To this end, this work first characterizes the hierarchical dependencies among coreset selection, robust optimization, and distributed learning, and formulates the distributed robust coreset selection as a trilevel optimization problem with level-wise constraints. Furthermore, to effectively solve the trilevel problem in a distributed manner, the \underline{F}ederated \underline{F}irst-order \underline{C}onstrained \underline{T}rilevel \underline{O}ptimization (F$^2$CTO) is proposed, which synergistically integrates a hierarchical composite value-function reformulation and a distributed alternating projected gradient algorithm. To the best of our knowledge, F$^2$CTO is the first method developed for distributed robust coreset selection, as well as the first distributed optimization approach for trilevel optimization problems with level-wise constraints. Additionally, we prove that the proposed method achieves a non-asymptotic convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-3/2})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary point. Extensive empirical evaluations on reliable continual learning demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed F$^2$CTO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出F²CTO（联邦一阶约束三层优化）方法，首次将鲁棒核心集选择建模为带层级约束的分布式三层优化问题，通过层级复合值函数重构和分布式交替投影梯度算法求解，达到O(ε^{-3/2})的非渐近收敛率，并在持续学习任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着物联网快速发展，大规模数据在分布式边缘网络产生，全量数据训练带来巨大计算和存储开销，核心集选择至关重要。同时，本地数据具有隐私敏感性且实际部署对模型鲁棒性需求日益增长，亟需开发有效的分布式鲁棒核心集选择优化框架，但这一问题此前尚未被探索。
AI.method: 首先刻画核心集选择、鲁棒优化和分布式学习之间的层级依赖关系，将分布式鲁棒核心集选择形式化为带层级约束的三层优化问题。随后提出F²CTO方法，该方法将层次复合值函数重构与分布式交替投影梯度算法协同集成，以分布式方式高效求解该三层优化问题。
AI.result: 理论方面，证明了F²CTO在寻找ε-稳定点时达到O(ε^{-3/2})的非渐近收敛率。实验方面，在可靠的持续学习任务上进行了大量实证评估，验证了所提方法的有效性和效率。F²CTO是首个用于分布式鲁棒核心集选择的方法，也是首个针对带层级约束的三层优化问题的分布式优化方法。
AI.conclusion: F²CTO通过三层优化框架成功统一了核心集选择、鲁棒优化与分布式学习，不仅填补了分布式鲁棒核心集选择方法的研究空白，也拓展了分布式三层优化理论，为物联网边缘场景下的隐私保护与鲁棒模型训练提供了新的解决方案。

title: (Towards) Scalable Reliable Automated Evaluation with Large Language Models
comment: 17 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the Fourth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM2) at ACL 2025
summary: Evaluating the quality and relevance of textual outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging and resource-intensive. Existing automated metrics often fail to capture the complexity and variability inherent in LLM-generated outputs. Moreover, these metrics typically rely on explicit reference standards, limiting their use mostly to domains with objective benchmarks. This work introduces a novel evaluation framework designed to approximate expert-level assessments of LLM-generated content. The proposed method employs pairwise comparisons of outputs by multiple LLMs, reducing biases from individual models. An Elo rating system is used to generate stable and interpretable rankings. Adjustable agreement thresholds, from full unanimity to majority voting, allow flexible control over evaluation confidence and coverage. The method's effectiveness is demonstrated through evaluating competency profiles extracted from scientific abstracts. Preliminary results show that automatically derived rankings correlate well with expert judgments, significantly reducing the need for extensive human intervention. By offering a scalable, consistent, and domain-agnostic evaluation layer, the framework supports more efficient and reliable quality assessments of LLM outputs across diverse applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的LLM输出评估框架，通过多个LLM进行成对比较，并结合Elo评分系统生成稳定排名。该框架无需人工标注或显式参考标准，通过可调的共识阈值（从全体一致到多数投票）灵活控制评估置信度。实验表明，该方法在科学摘要能力画像提取任务上，自动排名与专家判断高度相关，显著减少人工干预需求。
AI.motivation: 现有自动评估指标难以捕捉LLM生成输出的复杂性和变异性，且通常依赖显式参考标准，仅限于具有客观基准的领域。人工评估昂贵且耗时，亟需一种可扩展、领域无关且接近专家水平的自动化评估框架。
AI.method: 提出多LLM成对比较的评估框架：1) 使用多个LLM对输出进行成对比较，减少单一模型偏差；2) 采用Elo评分系统生成稳定且可解释的排名；3) 引入可调一致性阈值，从全体一致到多数投票，允许灵活控制评估置信度与覆盖率。
AI.result: 在科学摘要能力画像提取任务上，该方法自动生成的排名与专家判断相关性良好，显著降低了人工干预的需求，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展、一致且领域无关的评估层，能够支持不同应用中LLM输出的高效、可靠质量评估。

title: Crossing the Margin Cliff: Toward Relearn-Robust LLM Unlearning via Margin Calibration
summary: Large language model unlearning is consistently fragile under relearn attacks. On TOFU, fine-tuning on twenty forget examples substantially recovers held-out forget-set ROUGE for every method we evaluate, and we trace this fragility to optimization geometry. The per-token answer margin of fourteen post-hoc methods spanning gradient, preference, and distillation families converges into a narrow band above the retain reference in 41 of 42 method--size cells, a regularity we call the margin cliff. We prove that this cliff follows whenever the retain coupling holds the diagnostic log-odds of forget content above a floor, a condition that token-saturating losses induce at stationarity and that we verify directly on 34 of 42 cells. Margin Calibration (\textsc{MC}) is a plug-in polish adding a non-saturating margin hinge anchored at the reference's per-token margin plus a KL probe on a disjoint instruction corpus, restoring forget-side pressure where the native loss saturates. Under a stated gradient-dominance condition, whose on-trajectory gradient signature we measure by instrumenting the polish, its stationary set lies on the cliff-crossing side, yielding an attack-budget upper bound on the relearn margin lift. Across TOFU (three Llama-3 sizes, three forget tiers), MUSE-News on Llama-2-7B-hf, and a Phi-3.5 panel, a single frozen configuration wins all 14 head-to-head forget aggregates and all populated relearn cells (panel-mean post-attack ROUGE-L $0.41$ to $0.18$) and lowers raw membership AUC on 13/14, with reduced retain-side utility as the main cost. A deployment variant matches these gains without a retain-trained reference.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大语言模型遗忘（unlearning）在重学习攻击下普遍脆弱，并发现"边缘悬崖"（margin cliff）规律：42个方法-规模组合中有41个的每token答案边际收敛在保留参考之上窄带内。作者提出边际校准（Margin Calibration, MC）方法，通过非饱和边际铰链与KL探针恢复遗忘侧压力，在多个基准上显著提升遗忘鲁棒性（post-attack ROUGE-L从0.41降至0.18），并给出理论攻击预算上界。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法在重学习攻击下几乎全部失效（TOFU上仅用20个遗忘样本微调即可大幅恢复被遗忘集的ROUGE），且这一脆弱性的根源不清。作者希望从优化几何角度理解脆弱性，并提出可泛化的修复方法，同时提供理论保证。
AI.method: 1) 对14种post-hoc遗忘方法（梯度、偏好、蒸馏三类）度量每token答案边际，发现"边缘悬崖"规律并给出理论证明（保留耦合存在时，token饱和损失在驻点诱导诊断对数几率高于下限）；2) 提出Margin Calibration (MC)：以参考模型的每token边际作为锚点的非饱和边际铰链损失 + 在不相交指令语料上的KL探针，恢复原生损失饱和处缺失的遗忘侧压力；3) 在梯度支配条件下给出攻击预算上界，并通过轨迹梯度签名验证。
AI.result: 在TOFU（三种Llama-3规模、三个遗忘层级）、MUSE-News（Llama-2-7B-hf）及Phi-3.5面板上，单一冻结配置在14个head-to-head遗忘聚合及所有relearn单元上全部获胜（面板均值post-attack ROUGE-L从0.41降至0.18），13/14降低原始成员推断AUC；主要代价是保留侧效用下降。部署变体无需保留训练的参考模型即可达到同等增益。
AI.conclusion: LLM遗忘的脆弱性源于优化几何中的边际悬崖现象，可由饱和损失驻点条件解释。MC作为即插即用的修正方法，能跨模型、跨规模、跨基准稳定恢复遗忘鲁棒性，并提供可验证的理论保障，表明遗忘鲁棒性可以通过在正确位置施加正确的损失压力来实现，而非仅依赖更强的基线方法。

title: FiRE: Enhancing MLLMs with Fine-Grained Context Learning for Complex Image Retrieval
summary: Due to their strong generalizable multimodal processing and reasoning capabilities, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential as universal image retrievers, effectively addressing diverse real-world image retrieval tasks. Nevertheless, pioneering studies, while promising, overlook the potential of fine-grained context modeling and disentangled fine-tuning objectives in enhancing MLLMs' retrieval performance, particularly for complex tasks such as long-text-to-image retrieval, visual dialog retrieval, and composed image retrieval (CIR). Therefore, in this work, we propose an automated fine-grained multimodal quintuple dataset construction pipeline and a novel two-stage fine-grained multimodal fine-tuning strategy. The dataset generation pipeline produces a comprehensive CIR dataset with fine-grained image captions and modification text, facilitating fine-grained context modeling. Beyond the previously entangled fine-tuning paradigm, our approach separates the fine-tuning process into two distinct stages: (1) fine-grained context reasoning-oriented fine-tuning and (2) fine-grained retrieval-oriented fine-tuning. These stages aim to sequentially enhance the model's context understanding and query-target alignment capabilities, thereby improving retrieval performance. Extensive experiments across five datasets encompassing diverse and complex image retrieval tasks demonstrate the remarkable superiority of our method over existing approaches in zero-shot retrieval settings, even with a more lightweight MLLM backbone compared to those methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化的细粒度多模态五元组数据集构建管道和两阶段细粒度多模态微调策略，以增强MLLM在复杂图像检索任务（如长文本到图像检索、视觉对话检索和组合图像检索）中的零样本检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于MLLM的通用图像检索方法虽然有效，但忽略了细粒度上下文建模和解耦微调目标的价值，尤其在长文本到图像检索、视觉对话检索和组合图像检索等复杂任务中表现不足。
AI.method: (1) 提出自动化的细粒度多模态五元组数据集构建管道，生成包含细粒度图像描述和修改文本的CIR数据集；(2) 提出两阶段细粒度微调策略，第一阶段为细粒度上下文推理微调，第二阶段为细粒度检索导向微调，依次增强模型的上下文理解能力和查询-目标对齐能力。
AI.result: 在五个涵盖多样且复杂图像检索任务的数据集上进行大量实验，结果表明该方法在零样本检索设置下显著优于现有方法，且使用的MLLM骨干网络比对比方法更轻量。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度上下文建模与解耦的两阶段微调策略，能够以更轻量的模型架构实现更优的零样本图像检索性能，验证了该方法的有效性和通用性。

title: Certifying when decision-time information justifies adaptive experimentation
summary: Adaptive laboratories choose measurements during experiments, yet most methods begin after adaptation is permitted. We introduce Opportunity-aware Policy Authorization for Laboratories (\OPAL{}), a framework that decides whether adaptation should be enabled at all. \OPAL{} uses a precommitted contract to require non-trivial adaptation, controlled target risk and positive executed value after cost. We establish an impossibility boundary: source outcomes and unlabelled target covariates cannot uniformly support non-trivial authorization under unrestricted conditional outcome shift, and derive a target-calibrated recovery. Applied to an unseen 11,265-compound Cell Painting partition, the frozen gate selected 595 compounds, captured 384 positive opportunities and achieved strictly positive executed value under least-favourable completion; its 5.18\% false-activation upper bound remained below a 7.5\% limit. Among six methods, only \OPAL{} combined non-zero activation with this risk control. Locked pharmacogenomic and finite-campaign studies distinguish policy misalignment from non-certifiability, establishing authorization as a distinct layer for safe adaptive science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPAL框架，在实验开始前决定是否允许自适应，通过预承诺合同要求非平凡自适应、控制目标风险并确保扣除成本后的正向执行价值。理论证明了不可行边界，在Cell Painting数据集上验证了其风险控制和价值保证能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应实验方法大多在自适应被允许之后才开始设计测量策略，忽略了"是否应当允许自适应"这一更前置的关键决策问题。研究者希望建立一个能预先判断自适应是否值得授权的框架。
AI.method: OPAL框架采用预承诺合同机制，要求自适应必须满足三个条件：非平凡性（不能是空洞的自适应）、目标风险可控、扣除成本后的执行价值为正。理论上建立了不可行边界，证明在无限制条件结果迁移下，源结果和无标签目标协变量无法统一支持非平凡授权，并推导了目标校准恢复方法。
AI.result: 在未见的11,265化合物Cell Painting分割中，冻结门控选出595个化合物，捕获384个正机会，在最不利完成下实现了严格正的执行价值；假激活上界5.18%低于7.5%限制。在六个方法中仅OPAL同时实现了非零激活与风险控制。锁定药理学和有限活动研究区分了策略错位与不可认证性。
AI.conclusion: 授权（authorization）应作为安全自适应科学的独立层面，与自适应策略设计本身区分开来。OPAL提供了在这一层面上的可行框架，既要保证自适应的实际价值，又要严格约束其风险。

title: Virtual Process Dossier: A Process-Aware Data Catalogue
summary: We propose the Virtual Process Dossier (VPD), a Knowledge Graph-based data catalogue that also captures workflow provenance. We developed VPD for multi-stage manufacturing use-cases where downstream AI-based optimization tasks require to distinct between datasets generated during individual workflow steps. VPD provides these datasets in a FAIR manner and makes both prospective and retrospective workflow provenance explicit. Our contributions are: (1) the VPD ontology that serves as the catalogue's semantic core; (2) the VPD provenance framework that integrates ontology instantiation into the production environment; and (3) the VPD user interface that provides human-centered interaction with the VPD Knowledge Graph. The ontology and code are available at https://github.com/kubeluk/VirtualProcessDossier .

AI.tldr: 本文提出虚拟流程档案（VPD），一种基于知识图谱的数据目录，同时捕获工作流溯源信息，用于多阶段制造场景中AI优化任务的数据管理，以FAIR方式提供数据集并显式表达前瞻性和回顾性工作流溯源。
AI.motivation: 多阶段制造场景中的下游AI优化任务需要区分各个工作流步骤生成的数据集，但现有数据管理方式难以在FAIR原则下清晰表达这些数据集及其工作流溯源关系。
AI.method: 提出了三个核心贡献：(1) VPD本体，作为目录的语义核心；(2) VPD溯源框架，将本体实例化集成到生产环境中；(3) VPD用户界面，提供与VPD知识图谱的人本交互。
AI.result: 该工作提供了开源实现，本体和代码发布于GitHub仓库（https://github.com/kubeluk/VirtualProcessDossier），支持多阶段制造场景下数据集的高效管理与溯源。
AI.conclusion: VPD通过知识图谱技术实现了兼具数据目录与工作流溯源功能的管理系统，为下游AI优化任务提供了FAIR化的数据支撑，并将成果开源共享。

title: FootprintNet: State-Transition-Guided Dynamic Footprint Learning for Multi-temporal Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Despite substantial progress in remote sensing multi-temporal change detection (MTCD), most existing MTCD methods still represent the dynamic process at each spatial location over the entire observation period using a single change category associated with the final observation. This implicit single-change assumption limits their ability to characterize regions of recurrent change closely related to human activities. To address this limitation, we introduce Urban Building Dynamics Detection (UBDD), which identifies building-change dynamic footprints, i.e., the temporal intervals in which changes occur, from multi-temporal imagery and produces pixel-wise classification masks. For regions undergoing two or more changes, UBDD introduces an independent multi-change class for unified representation, thereby enabling unified modeling of single- and multi-change processes. Furthermore, we propose FootprintNet, which abstracts building-change processes as interactions between latent states and actions, and imposes state-action transition constraints to guide the learning of causally coherent change trajectories. It further exploits temporal change-boundary cues to enhance feature contrast across boundary sides, thereby improving the discrimination among different dynamic footprints and enabling accurate detection of dynamic footprints. Moreover, we introduce the Building Change Dynamics Score (BCDS) to address the inability of conventional metrics to reflect the temporal proximity between predicted footprints and labels. It evaluates predictions according to their preservation of change semantics and temporal offsets from the corresponding labels. Extensive experiments on TSCD, MUDS, and WUSU demonstrate that FootprintNet outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/zmoka-zht/FootprintNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Urban Building Dynamics Detection (UBDD)任务，用于检测多时相影像中建筑变化的时间动态足迹（即变化发生的具体时间区间），并提出FootprintNet网络，通过状态-动作转移约束建模变化的因果连贯轨迹，同时引入BCDS评估指标解决传统指标无法反映时间接近度的问题，在多个数据集上超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感多时相变化检测方法假设每个空间位置在整个观测期内只发生单一变化，仅用最终观测对应的单一变化类别来表示动态过程。这一隐式单变化假设限制了其对与人类活动密切相关的重复变化区域的刻画能力。
AI.method: FootprintNet将建筑变化过程抽象为潜在状态与动作之间的交互，施加状态-动作转移约束以引导因果一致的变化轨迹学习；并利用时间变化边界线索增强边界两侧的特征对比度，以提升不同动态足迹的判别性。对于发生两次及以上变化的区域，引入独立的多变化类别进行统一表示，实现单变化与多变化过程的统一建模。同时提出BCDS指标，综合考虑变化的语义保持和时间偏移来评估预测结果。
AI.result: 在TSCD、MUDS和WUSU三个数据集上的大量实验表明，FootprintNet在变化动态足迹检测任务上优于当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出UBDD任务、FootprintNet网络和BCDS评估指标，从任务定义、模型设计和评估方法三个层面解决了多时相变化检测中重复变化区域建模不足的问题，验证了该方法的有效性与通用性。

title: Evaluation Protocols and Cross-Subject Generalization in EEG Emotion Recognition
comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables including supplementary information. Submitted to Applied Intelligence
summary: Reported accuracy in electroencephalography (EEG) emotion recognition depends on the complete evaluation procedure, not only the classifier. We separate the target quantity, development procedure, and reporting rule, then use one archived dynamical graph convolutional neural network (DGCNN) pathway on SEED and SEED-IV as an illustrative case. In a protocol-matched subject-dependent check, the SEED result was within 1.47 percentage points of the public reference value; the 3.40-point SEED-IV difference remained unresolved. Across 30 matched SEED subject-session trajectories, checkpoint selection based on repeated test-set evaluation increased mean window accuracy from 0.7855 at epoch 80 to 0.8892. Under five-fold subject-disjoint evaluation, validation-selected checkpoints achieved training-participant trial accuracies of 0.9990 on SEED and 0.9920 on SEED-IV. Accuracy for entirely held-out participants was 0.5348 (95% conditional subject-level bias-corrected and accelerated [BCa] interval [0.4667, 0.5985]) on SEED. The SEED-IV estimate was 0.3954 ([0.3343, 0.4648]) and is reported only as secondary sensitivity evidence because its protocol-matched compatibility check remained unresolved. The observed train-to-held-out-subject gaps are inconsistent with simple optimization underfitting, but they do not isolate subject identity from implementation, preprocessing, representation, or distributional factors. Supporting analyses further showed that participant rankings depended on representation and time scale, while a development-selected tail-risk ensemble did not establish a positive gain in a separate final evaluation. Subject-dependent, subject-disjoint, and cross-session results should therefore be reported as answers to different questions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个基准DGCNN模型在SEED和SEED-IV数据集上的系统实验，揭示了EEG情绪识别报告的准确率高度依赖完整的评估流程（目标量、开发流程、报告规则），而不只是分类器本身。研究发现subject-dependent、subject-disjoint和cross-session结果应被视为回答不同问题的独立指标，且训练-留出受试者准确率差距不能用简单的欠拟合解释。
AI.motivation: EEG情绪识别文献中广泛报道的准确率数值往往被直接比较，但实际这些数值取决于完整的评估流程（包括数据划分方式、检查点选择策略、报告统计量等）。作者希望解构这些流程因素，揭示"报告准确率"背后的可变性，并警示研究社区不应将不同评估协议下的结果直接横向比较。
AI.method: 作者将评估流程拆分为三个维度：目标量（target quantity）、开发流程（development procedure）和报告规则（reporting rule）。以存档的DGCNN模型作为示例，在SEED和SEED-IV数据集上分别进行：(1) 协议匹配的subject-dependent复现检查；(2) 重复测试集评估驱动的检查点选择分析；(3) 五折subject-disjoint评估（区分训练参与者的re-trial测试与完全留出参与者的泛化测试）；(4) 基于BCa置信区间和尾风险集成等辅助分析。
AI.result: SEED上协议匹配的subject-dependent复现与公开参考值相差仅1.47个百分点，但SEED-IV相差3.40点未能解决。重复测试集选择检查点使平均窗口准确率从0.7855（epoch 80）升至0.8892。训练参与者trial准确率在SEED上达0.9990、SEED-IV上为0.9920，而完全留出受试者的准确率在SEED上仅0.5348（BCa区间[0.4667, 0.5985]），SEED-IV为0.3954（[0.3343, 0.4648]）。参与者排名随表示方法和时间尺度而变化，开发期选择的尾风险集成未在最终评估中获正收益。
AI.conclusion: EEG情绪识别的准确率报告必须明确区分评估协议；subject-dependent、subject-disjoint和cross-session结果回答的是不同研究问题，应当分别报告而非混为一谈。训练到留出受试者的准确率大幅下降表明模型泛化能力有限，且这一差距无法仅用优化欠拟合解释，需进一步隔离受试者身份与其他混杂因素。

title: Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code and datasets publicly available
summary: This work presents Fairness Pruning, a lightweight structural intervention method designed for the management and future mitigation of demographic bias in large language models (LLMs). As a foundational empirical validation of this method, this work focuses on causal bias localization. Using minimally contrastive prompt pairs and inference-time activation capture, the method identifies neurons that react differentially when processing demographic attributes in GLU architectures, evaluating the signal at the down_proj input. Empirical evaluation was conducted on models of up to 3 billion parameters (Llama-3.2 family and Salamandra-2B), combining standardized benchmark evaluation with qualitative text generation experiments. Results demonstrate that zeroing the identified neurons alters how the model responds to associated demographic variables. However, rather than producing flat mitigation, the intervention causes bidirectional bias destabilization: because BiasScore is unsigned, candidate sets mix neurons that push toward and against the stereotype, and the net effect on aggregate bias depends on which sign dominates. The intervention is extremely surgical: zeroing at most 40 neurons in Llama-3.2-1B (less than 0.031% of total MLP width) achieves a mean retention of 99.49% in reasoning and general knowledge capabilities. These findings empirically confirm that demographic bias processing and model capabilities operate on dissociable circuits, establishing the methodological foundations for transitioning from blind zeroing toward directional behavior modulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fairness Pruning，一种用于大语言模型中人口统计学偏见管理与缓解的轻量级结构干预方法，通过因果偏见定位识别GLU架构中对人口属性差异反应的神经元，并在最多40个神经元上实现零化干预，在保持99.49%推理与通用知识能力的情况下双向影响偏见表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型中的人口统计学偏见问题日益严重，现有缓解方法往往需要全量重训练或复杂微调，缺乏轻量级、可解释的因果层面干预手段。本文旨在验证能否通过最小化结构干预（即定位并处理少数神经元）来理解和管理偏见，为未来从盲目归零转向方向性行为调制建立方法论基础。
AI.method: 采用最小对比提示对（minimally contrastive prompt pairs）结合推理时激活捕获（inference-time activation capture），在GLU架构的down_proj输入处评估信号，识别对人口属性处理产生差异反应的神经元。通过在Llama-3.2家族和Salamandra-2B模型（最高30亿参数）上进行标准化基准评估与定性文本生成实验相结合的方式，验证零化极少数神经元（最多40个）对偏见行为的影响。
AI.result: 零化识别出的神经元会改变模型对相关人口变量的响应方式，但产生的是双向偏见失稳而非平坦缓解：由于BiasScore为无符号度量，候选集合混合了推动和反对刻板印象的神经元，净效应取决于哪一方向的符号占主导。干预极为精准，在Llama-3.2-1B上零化最多40个神经元（不足总MLP宽度的0.031%），推理与通用知识能力的平均保留率达99.49%。
AI.conclusion: 实证确认了人口统计学偏见处理与模型能力运行在可分离的电路上，支持偏见与能力在LLM内部可分解的观点。该工作为从目前的无方向盲目零化转向具有方向性偏好的行为调制建立了方法论基础。

title: Simplifying Neural Networks During Training
summary: Understanding and exploiting the training dynamics of overparameterized deep neural networks remains a central challenge in modern machine learning. Recent evidence on Neural Collapse (NC) shows that class representations and classifiers exhibit highly structured geometry, while the Tunnel Effect suggests that only a subset of layers is essential for feature extraction. We combine these two perspectives and propose an NC-inspired training framework for simplifying deep networks during training. Our method monitors representation dynamics through the Inverse Fisher Criterion, a stable and efficient proxy for the variability collapse behavior, to identify both the split point between feature extraction and classification and the training stage at which simplification becomes viable. We then replace the trailing layers with a lightweight classification head and continue training the reduced model. Experiments on image-classification benchmarks across MLP, VGG, and ResNet architectures show that the proposed method achieves substantial parameter reductions while maintaining accuracy comparable to that of the full model. Code to reproduce the experiments can be found at: https://github.com/LorenzoSciandra/NNS.

AI.tldr: 本文结合神经坍缩（NC）和隧道效应两种视角，提出了一种在训练过程中简化深度网络的框架。该方法通过逆Fisher准则监控表征动态，识别特征提取与分类的分割点及可简化时机，用轻量分类头替换尾部层继续训练，在MLP、VGG和ResNet架构上实现显著参数量缩减并保持接近完整模型的精度。
AI.motivation: 超参数化深度神经网络的训练动力学仍是现代机器学习的核心挑战。已有研究表明NC现象使类别表征和分类器呈现高度结构化几何，而隧道效应表明仅部分层对特征提取至关重要。目前缺乏将这两种视角结合以在训练过程中简化网络的框架。
AI.method: 提出NC启发的训练框架，通过逆Fisher准则（一种稳定高效的变异性坍缩行为代理指标）监控表征动力学，同时识别（1）特征提取与分类之间的分割点，以及（2）简化操作可行的训练阶段。随后用轻量分类头替换尾部层并对简化后的模型继续训练。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上对MLP、VGG和ResNet架构进行实验，所提方法实现了显著的参数缩减，同时保持与完整模型相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了结合NC与隧道效应视角可以有效指导深度网络的结构简化，在训练中动态裁剪冗余参数而不牺牲性能，为节约计算资源提供了一种可行方案。

title: Now You Have My Healthy Attention: A U-DiT for Brain-MRI Inpainting
summary: The ASNR-MICCAI BraTS Local Synthesis (Inpainting) task asks for the anatomically plausible completion of healthy brain tissue within a masked region of a T1-weighted MRI, providing a tumor-free anatomical reference for downstream analysis. As the task is scored by distortion metrics (SSIM, PSNR, MSE), we build a deterministic regression model and focus on giving it inductive biases tailored to inpainting. Our network follows the U-DiT principle of performing self-attention on a downsampled token grid: a volumetric encoder-decoder imports long-range context through a downsampled global self-attention block with three-dimensional rotary position embeddings, while convolutions and skip connections preserve high-frequency detail. Two ideas drive our results. First, we constrain the attention so that occluded ("void") tokens attend only to known-healthy tokens of the same volume, with a learned bias toward each query's contralateral homologue, forcing the completion to be inferred from observed anatomy rather than from other unknown regions. Second, we add a contralateral-symmetry input that supplies the mirrored healthy hemisphere as a patient-specific prior; since the brain is approximately bilaterally symmetric and lesions are typically unilateral, this prior improves the distortion metrics at matched structural similarity. On the official BraTS-2026 validation leaderboard our submission reaches a mean healthy-region SSIM of $0.864$, PSNR of $24.7$\,dB and MSE of $4.6{\times}10^{-3}$ over $219$ cases. We further analyse the residual smoothness inherent to distortion-optimal regression and discuss its implications for anatomical realism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于BraTS局部合成（修复）任务的确定性回归模型，采用U-DiT架构（下采样token网格上的自注意力），通过约束注意力仅让遮蔽token关注已知健康token（并加入对侧同源区偏置）以及引入对侧对称性先验输入，在T1加权MRI中完成健康脑组织的解剖学合理修复。在BraTS-2026验证集上达到SSIM 0.864、PSNR 24.7dB、MSE 4.6e-3。
AI.motivation: BraTS局部合成任务需要在被掩蔽的区域内完成健康脑组织的解剖学合理修复，为下游分析提供无肿瘤的解剖参考。由于任务以失真指标（SSIM、PSNR、MSE）评分，作者构建确定性回归模型并设计针对修复任务的归纳偏置，以提升重建质量。
AI.method: 采用U-DiT架构：体积编码器-解码器通过下采样全局自注意力块（带三维旋转位置编码）引入长程上下文，卷积和跳跃连接保留高频细节。两个关键设计：（1）约束注意力，使遮蔽token仅关注同体积的已知健康token，并通过学习到的偏置引导关注每个查询的对侧同源区，确保修复从可观察解剖推断而非其他未知区域；（2）引入对侧对称性输入，提供镜像的健康半球作为患者特异性先验，利用大脑近似双侧对称和病灶通常单侧的特性提升指标。
AI.result: 在官方BraTS-2026验证集219例上达到平均健康区域SSIM 0.864、PSNR 24.7dB、MSE 4.6e-3。进一步分析了失真最优回归固有的残差平滑性及其对解剖真实性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 对侧对称性先验和注意力约束是提升脑组织修复质量的有效归纳偏置；然而失真最优回归的残差平滑性限制了解剖学真实性，需要进一步考虑感知/解剖一致性目标。

title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
summary: Looped Transformers create a useful train- and test-time compute axis by reusing the same Transformer block over recurrent depth, increasing effective depth at a fixed parameter count. However, that shared block must then govern an entire trajectory of varying hidden states over trained and extrapolated depths. Furthermore, in additive-injection looped Transformers, an input-conditioned signal is reintroduced at every recurrent step, so applying the shared transition at an input-conditioned reference can still move the hidden state. In this paper, we propose Source-Centered State Evolution (SCSE), which is designed to reconcile input conditioning with reference-preserving shared recurrence. Specifically, SCSE retains input dependence through its learned anchor and initial deviation, allows nonzero deviations to drive recurrent computation while mapping zero deviation to zero, and guarantees exact anchor invariance through its zero-deviation mask. The designated anchor is thereby a one-step fixed point by construction. The zero-deviation forcing bias is the next deviation produced from the anchor itself and vanishes in SCSE, while nonzero deviations remain active and support state-dependent recurrent computation. Our theory shows that the zero-deviation forcing bias is a design degree of freedom whose task effect can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial; SCSE resolves this choice in favor of exact anchor invariance by setting the bias to zero. Across WikiText-2, WikiText-103, direct web-corpus pretraining, held-out web-text transfer, and LAMBADA completion, SCSE improves the controlled recurrent quality frontier. Ablation studies identify the learned anchor and the anchor-coordinate deviation recurrence as the primary contributors to the gain, and a trained-model case study grounds the anchor-response diagnostic in observed recurrent motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出源中心状态演化（SCSE）方法，用于改进循环Transformer（Looped Transformers）中共享块在递归深度上的状态演化。SCSE通过学习锚点和初始偏差保留输入依赖性，通过零偏差掩码保证锚点不变性（一步不动点），并将零偏差强制偏置设为零以消除其潜在的有害影响。实验表明，SCSE在WikiText-2、WikiText-103等多项基准上改善了受控递归质量前沿。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer虽然能以固定参数量增加有效深度，但其共享块必须管理不同深度下变化的隐状态轨迹；且在加法注入的循环Transformer中，输入条件信号在每个递归步都被重新引入，使得对输入条件参考点的共享转移仍可能移动隐状态。因此需要一种机制来协调输入条件与参考点保持的共享循环。
AI.method: SCSE方法包含以下关键设计：(1) 通过学习的锚点（learned anchor）和初始偏差（initial deviation）保留输入依赖性；(2) 允许非零偏差驱动递归计算，同时将零偏差映射到零（保证锚点为一个步不动点）；(3) 通过零偏差掩码（zero-deviation mask）保证精确的锚点不变性；(4) 将零偏差强制偏置（即由锚点自身产生的下一个偏差）设为零，从而消除该设计自由度可能带来的有害影响，同时保持非零偏差活跃以支持状态相关的递归计算。
AI.result: 理论分析表明零偏差强制偏置是一个设计自由度，其任务效果可能有害、中性或有益；SCSE通过设为零选择了精确的锚点不变性。实验在WikiText-2、WikiText-103、直接网络语料预训练、留出网络文本迁移和LAMBADA补全等基准上提升了受控递归质量前沿。消融实验显示学习锚点和锚点坐标偏差递归是主要增益来源，训练模型案例研究验证了锚点响应诊断与观测到的递归运动的一致性。
AI.conclusion: SCSE通过将锚点构造为一步不动点并设零强制偏置，成功调和了输入条件与参考保持的共享循环，在多项语言建模基准上一致提升了循环Transformer的质量前沿，为该类模型提供了更有效的深度扩展策略。

title: LLMs struggle to simulate human belief updates in controlled environments
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as proxies for human study participants in social science experiments, yet the fidelity of this practice has rarely been tested directly. We test whether six LLMs can simulate individual human belief updates, comparing LLM outputs 1-to-1 against ground truth data from 391 UK participants on Prolific, who updated their stances on three discussion topics after reading Reddit comments. Each participant was simulated by an LLM conditioned on a persona derived from their demographic and personality trait data. We find that some LLMs (Qwen3-32B and GPT-5-Mini) can match the human post-stance distribution, but only when given participants' actual initial stances. All six models fail to simulate initial stances themselves and to produce faithful belief updates from self-generated stances. Three systematic biases emerge across all models: overrepresentation of neutral positions, more frequent but smaller belief shifts than humans, and a failure to rank comments by convincingness. Demographic and personality trait personas had no consistent effect on fidelity. LLM simulations of human belief dynamics are only reliable when grounded in realistic starting conditions, that current multi-round social media simulations rarely provide.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了六种LLM能否模拟人类个体的信念更新过程，与391名英国参与者的真实数据逐一对比较，发现LLM只有在获得参与者真实初始立场时才能匹配人类的后验立场分布，但所有模型都无法自行生成初始立场并产生忠实的信念更新，且存在三种系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作社会科学实验中人类参与者的替代品，但这种实践的真实性（fidelity）几乎没有被直接检验过。研究者希望通过严格的一对一比较来评估LLM模拟人类信念更新的可靠性。
AI.method: 实验设计：1) 招募391名英国Prolific参与者，在阅读Reddit评论后更新其对三个讨论话题的立场；2) 用六种LLM模拟每位参与者，通过人口统计学和人格特质数据构建人设（persona）进行条件化生成；3) 将LLM输出与真实人类数据逐一对比较。
AI.result: 1) 部分LLM（Qwen3-32B和GPT-5-Mini）在给定真实初始立场时能匹配人类后验立场分布；2) 所有六种模型都无法自行模拟初始立场并产生忠实的信念更新；3) 存在三种系统性偏差：过度代表中立立场、信念变化比人类更频繁但幅度更小、无法按说服力对评论排序；4) 人口统计学和人格特质的persona对保真度没有一致影响。
AI.conclusion: LLM对人类信念动态的模拟只有在基于现实的初始条件时才可靠，而当前多轮社交媒体模拟很少提供这种条件，因此LLM作为人类被试代理的适用性受到严重限制。

title: Back to All-Entity Ranking: Sampler-Dependent Evaluation in Continuous-Time Dynamic Graphs
summary:
Next-destination prediction in continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) commonly ranks an observed interaction against sampled negative destinations. The resulting score is conditional on both the negative distribution and the number of candidates chosen by the researcher. We show that a non-uniform negative distribution changes the Bayes-optimal ranking, while even a finite candidate set drawn uniformly can destabilize model rankings and measured module effects.
  Time-varying source-destination history membership and model operations that use this information directly transmit the sampler's influence to the evaluation score. We examine this mechanism using a factorial evaluation of repeated and new positives against seen and unseen negatives, a minimal scorer based solely on pair-history membership, and controlled representation interventions. Across six models on LastFM, MOOC, Reddit, and Wikipedia, at least one model pair changes relative order between the expected Uniform-20 metric and the full catalog on three of the four datasets. The measured effect of the same module also changes in magnitude and direction with the candidate-set size and training objective.
  These results establish that model-superiority and ablation conclusions from sampled-negative benchmarks are conditional on the stated candidate configuration. All-entity ranking evaluates every destination in a fixed catalog, eliminating negative-selection freedom and sampling variation while retaining the original CTDG scorer. We therefore recommend all-entity ranking as the primary evidence for architecture comparisons on CTDG benchmarks with an enumerable, fixed destination catalog.

AI.tldr: 在连续时间动态图（CTDG）的下一目的地预测中，标准做法是使用采样负目的地进行排序评估。本文证明非均匀负采样分布会改变贝叶斯最优排序，即使均匀采样也会因候选集大小不同而破坏模型排名稳定性和模块效应测量。作者提出全实体排序（all-entity ranking）作为替代方案，消除负采样自由度与抽样变异。
AI.motivation: 现有CTDG基准评估普遍采用有限负采样集合，但采样分布和候选集大小对评估结果的系统性影响未被充分认识。研究者需要理解负采样配置如何扭曲模型比较和消融实验的结论。
AI.method: 通过因子化实验设计（重复/新正样本 vs 已见/未见负样本）、基于对历史成员关系的极简评分器、以及受控表示干预，在六个模型和四个数据集（LastFM、MOOC、Reddit、Wikipedia）上系统分析负采样对评分的影响机制。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，至少有一对模型的相对排序在Uniform-20指标与全目录评估之间发生翻转；同一模块的测量效果随候选集大小和训练目标变化，甚至在方向和幅度上均发生改变。这表明采样负基准上的模型优越性和消融结论是有条件性的。
AI.conclusion: 推荐全实体排序作为CTDG基准中架构比较的主要证据，前提是目的地目录可枚举且固定。全实体排序消除负选择的自由度与采样变异，同时保留原始评分器。

title: ViP-Rig: Visual-Prompted Controllable Rigging
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Zihan Qin and Mingze Sun contributed equally. Xianming Liu is the corresponding author
summary: Rigging is inherently task-dependent because the same mesh may require different skeletons and deformation behaviors across animation tasks. In practice, artists often inspect an initial rig and repeatedly edit its skeletal structure and deformation behavior to meet specific animation requirements. Existing automatic methods primarily generate a plausible rig from geometry, offering limited explicit control over the resulting skeleton and deformation behavior. In this work, we present ViP-Rig, a visual-prompted framework that supports both prompt-first rigging and result-guided editing by injecting features extracted from user-drawn or edited 2D skeletal and rigidity prompts into frozen pretrained backbones. Specifically, ViP-Rig consists of two stages, Skeleton Generation and Skinning Prediction. In the first stage, the skeletal sketch is processed by the Dense-to-Compact Visual Prompt Encoding to produce compact, fixed-length conditioning tokens. The resulting tokens are injected into a frozen pretrained autoregressive generator through gated adapters to control joint placement and branching structure while preserving the generator's geometric prior. In the second stage, the rigidity map is processed using the same visual encoding design, while the pretrained skinning backbone remains frozen. The resulting tokens are symmetrically injected into the point and joint streams to modulate point-joint compatibility and the resulting skinning weights. Experiments on Articulation-XL2.0 and zero-shot evaluation on ModelsResource show that ViP-Rig more accurately recovers target skeletons and skinning weights than geometry-conditioned baselines under prompt-guided evaluation. Qualitative results further demonstrate explicit and localized control in both prompt-first rigging and result-guided editing.

AI.tldr: ViP-Rig是一个视觉提示驱动的骨架绑定框架，通过用户绘制的2D骨骼草图和刚性提示图来显式控制骨架生成与蒙皮权重预测，在冻结的预训练主干网络中注入条件特征，同时支持"提示优先"绑定和"结果引导"编辑两种模式。
AI.motivation: 骨架绑定是任务相关的，同一网格在不同动画任务中需要不同的骨骼和变形行为。现有自动方法主要从几何生成合理绑定，缺乏对骨骼结构和变形行为的显式控制，无法满足艺术家反复编辑以满足特定动画需求的工作流程。
AI.method: ViP-Rig由两个阶段组成：(1) 骨架生成阶段，将用户绘制的骨骼草图通过Dense-to-Compact视觉提示编码转换为紧凑的固定长度条件token，通过门控适配器注入冻结的自回归生成器中，控制关节点位置和分支结构；(2) 蒙皮预测阶段，将刚性图用相同的视觉编码设计处理，token对称地注入冻结的蒙皮骨干网络中的点和关节流中，调制点-关节兼容性和蒙皮权重。
AI.result: 在Articulation-XL2.0数据集上的实验和ModelsResource上的零样本评估表明，ViP-Rig在提示引导评估下比基于几何条件的基线方法更准确地恢复目标骨骼和蒙皮权重。定性结果展示了在提示优先绑定和结果引导编辑中都具有显式和局部化的控制能力。
AI.conclusion: ViP-Rig通过将用户绘制的2D视觉提示注入冻结的预训练骨干网络，实现了对骨架绑定过程的显式、局部化控制，支持从"提示优先"创建到"结果引导"迭代编辑的完整工作流，在准确性和可控性上优于几何条件化的基准方法。

title: Understanding Submodular Information Measure Based Objectives for Representation Learning: A Variance and Separation Perspective
summary:
Submodular Information Measures (SIMs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for representation learning and multimodal learning. In particular, the SCORE framework~\cite{majee2024score} demonstrated that SIMs can serve as effective objectives for supervised contrastive learning. Despite their empirical success, however, the geometric and statistical properties induced by different submodular information measures remain poorly understood.
  In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework connecting SIMs to classical concepts in representation learning and statistical pattern recognition. We show that Total Information (TI) objectives characterize intra-class structure: Graph Cut TI recovers within-class variance, LogDet TI recovers generalized variance and covariance volume, and Facility Location TI induces imbalance-aware separation that emphasizes rare and confusable classes. We further show that Mutual Information (MI) objectives capture complementary notions of inter-class structure: Graph Cut MI is closely related to centroid separation and Fisher-style discrimination, LogDet MI captures covariance-aware separation through Mahalanobis distance, and Facility Location MI measures nearest-mode representational overlap.
  We validate these theoretical characterizations using controlled synthetic experiments that independently vary variance, covariance, class imbalance, class separation, and multimodal overlap. Across all settings, the empirical behavior closely matches the proposed theory. Our results provide the first unified geometric and statistical understanding of submodular information measures and offer principled guidance for selecting and designing SIM-based objectives for representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了子模信息度量（SIMs）与经典表示学习/统计模式识别概念之间的统一理论框架，揭示了不同SIM目标（如Total Information和Mutual Information）分别表征类内与类间结构的具体几何和统计特性，并通过合成实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 尽管SCORE框架已证明子模信息度量（SIMs）可作为监督对比学习的有效目标函数，并在经验上取得了成功，但不同子模信息度量所诱导的几何和统计性质仍缺乏深入理解，这阻碍了研究者根据具体任务合理地选择和设计SIM-based目标。
AI.method: 作者建立了将SIMs与经典表示学习概念相连接的理论框架，分别从Total Information（TI）目标和Mutual Information（MI）目标两条主线展开分析。对于TI，分析了Graph Cut（对应类内方差）、LogDet（对应广义方差和协方差体积）以及Facility Location（对应不平衡感知分离）三种具体度量的几何含义；对于MI，分析了Graph Cut（对应质心分离和Fisher判别）、LogDet（对应基于Mahalanobis距离的协方差感知分离）以及Facility Location（对应最近模态表示重叠）三种度量的类间结构解释。最后通过控制方差、协方差、类别不平衡、类间分离度和多模态重叠度的合成实验进行验证。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，TI目标刻画类内结构：Graph Cut TI恢复类内方差，LogDet TI恢复广义方差和协方差体积，Facility Location TI则实现强调稀有和易混淆类别的不平衡感知分离。MI目标刻画类间结构：Graph Cut MI与质心分离及Fisher式判别紧密相关，LogDet MI通过Mahalanobis距离实现协方差感知分离，Facility Location MI度量最近模态的表示重叠。合成实验在所有设定下均与理论预测高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次为子模信息度量提供了统一的几何与统计理解，为表示学习中SIM-based目标的选择和设计提供了原则性指导。

title: Correlation between prosody and pragmatics: A case study of the discourse marker hālā `now' in Persian
summary: The Persian discourse marker hālā ('now') exhibits remarkable multifunctionality, extending far beyond its temporal adverbial role to encompass a variety of pragmatic functions. This study presents a pragmatic and acoustic analysis of hālā in spoken Persian, examining 267 instances from spontaneous conversations. While temporal uses were present, they were often combined with other discourse marker functions, indicating extensive multifunctionality, with 70% of tokens serving two or more pragmatic roles. Textual functions (topic shifting, signaling relationships, boundary marking, attention guidance, topic introduction, and topic emphasis) were most frequent, followed by interactive functions (turn management, listener engagement, and feedback regulation), and modal functions (epistemic stance, emotional expression, and attitudinal marking). Prosodic analysis revealed that duration and intensity are key cues for distinguishing hālā's functions. Textual uses were significantly shorter, while temporal uses showed a tendency toward longer realizations. Interactive functions correlated with higher intensity, while modal functions showed a weaker tendency toward lower intensity. These findings indicate that duration and intensity are the main prosodic cues associated with functional differentiation in hālā, especially in textual and interactive uses.

AI.tldr: 本文对波斯语口语中的话语标记语 hālā（"现在"）进行了语用与声学分析，基于267个自发言语样本，发现其呈现出高度多功能性（70%的用例承担两种以上语用功能），并揭示了时长和音强是区分其不同功能的主要韵律线索。
AI.motivation: 波斯语话语标记语hālā虽源于时间副词"现在"，但其语用功能远超时间表达范畴，表现出显著的多功能性。然而以往研究对其多功能性的系统性语用分类和韵律特征关注不足，缺乏基于自然会话语料的实证分析。
AI.method: 从自发性对话中提取267个hālā实例，进行语用功能分类（文本功能、互动功能、情态功能）与声学韵律分析（时长、音强、基频等），并统计各功能类别的分布频率及其与韵律参数的相关性。
AI.result: 70%的用例承担两种或以上的语用功能；文本功能最常见（话题转换、关系标记、边界标示、注意力引导、话题引入与强调），其次是互动功能（话轮管理、听者参与、反馈调控）和情态功能（认知立场、情感表达、态度标记）。韵律分析表明，文本功能时长显著较短，时间功能倾向于更长实现，互动功能与更高音强相关，情态功能则倾向于更低音强。
AI.conclusion: 时长和音强是区分hālā不同功能的主要韵律线索，尤其在文本功能和互动功能中表现最为明显，充分体现了该话语标记语在口语中的高度多功能性。

title: Orca: Neural Operators for Causal Reasoning in Continuous Time
summary: Structural causal models are the standard language for reasoning about interventions and counterfactuals, but they describe static variables, typically measured once, and usually forbid cyclic dependencies. Many systems we care about, such as patients, climates, and economies, instead evolve continuously in time, are observed at irregular time points, and contain feedback loops. We argue that neural operator learning provides a natural foundation for causal reasoning in this setting, and propose Orca, a framework in which each node of the causal graph is a function of time and each mechanism is a learned map between function spaces. We extend existing neural operator architectures to express causal mechanisms: a mechanism computes the function value of a node from its parent nodes by taking several parent functions as input, respects the arrow of time, and treats latent exogenous noise as a function that can be inferred and reused for counterfactuals. We formalize the model class and demonstrate counterfactual reasoning on synthetic continuous-time examples. Code is available at https://github.com/gerritgr/orca

AI.tldr: 本文提出Orca框架，将神经算子学习作为因果推理的基础，用于处理动态系统（随时间连续演化、不规则观测、含反馈回路）的结构因果模型，每个节点是时间的函数，每个机制是函数空间之间的映射，支持反事实推理。
AI.motivation: 传统结构因果模型（SCM）只能处理静态变量、通常只测量一次且禁止循环依赖，但现实中许多系统（如患者、气候、经济）随时间连续演化、在不规则时间点被观测且包含反馈回路。现有SCM无法自然表达这类动态因果系统，亟需一个能处理连续时间动态因果推理的框架。
AI.method: Orca框架将因果图中的每个节点表示为时间的函数，每个因果机制是学习得到的函数空间之间的映射（神经算子）。机制以父节点的多个函数为输入计算节点函数值，尊重时间箭头（因果方向），并将潜在的外生噪声视为可推断、可复用的函数以支持反事实推理。作者扩展了现有神经算子架构来表达这些因果机制。
AI.result: 形式化了该模型类别，并在合成连续时间示例上展示了反事实推理能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 神经算子学习为连续时间动态系统中的因果推理提供了自然的基础框架，使SCM从静态、无环扩展到动态、含环、连续演化的场景，并能处理不规则观测数据。

title: Deep learning-based hierarchical insect classification using camera trap imagery
summary: Declining insect populations make reliable biodiversity monitoring increasingly urgent, yet monitoring of insect biodiversity is hampered by a lack of standardised data and by costly and time-consuming manual identification by expert entomologists. Deep learning-based image classifiers, processing data from automated non-lethal camera traps, have the potential to transform and scale insect biodiversity monitoring. However, challenges remain in acquiring expert-annotated datasets, developing model architectures that generalise well across diverse taxonomic levels and training models on highly imbalanced data. Hierarchical data also benefits from designing models that default to higher-confidence, coarser-level predictions, when uncertain about finer taxonomic levels. In this paper we address these challenges with a deep learning-based hierarchical classification model. First, we present a manually curated, long-tailed dataset of around one million images of insects, extracted from 1,801 camera-trap video recordings and annotated with a five-level, 34-class hierarchy. Further, we adapt a hierarchical classification model architecture to a five-level variable-depth hierarchy, with class-balanced weighting. Our model improves on non-hierarchical classifiers by leveraging biological taxonomy to extract granularity-specific visual features and makes hierarchy-consistent predictions to the deepest taxonomic level that meets a confidence threshold (T = 0.6). Our model achieved a per-level accuracy of 80-99% on test data, across five levels of hierarchy. Furthermore ...

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的层次化分类模型，用于自动监测昆虫生物多样性。作者构建了一个约一百万张图像的手工标注长尾数据集（来自1,801个相机陷阱视频，标注为五级34类的分类层次），并设计了适配可变深度层次结构的层次化分类架构，结合类平衡加权。模型利用生物学分类学提取不同粒度级别的视觉特征，在置信度阈值(T=0.6)下预测到最深分类层级，测试数据上各层级准确率达80-99%。
AI.motivation: 昆虫种群数量下降使得可靠的生物多样性监测日益紧迫，但现有监测受限于缺乏标准化数据以及依赖昆虫学专家进行昂贵且耗时的手工识别。深度学习图像分类器结合自动化非致命相机陷阱具备改变和扩展昆虫监测规模的潜力，但在获取专家标注数据、构建能跨分类层级泛化的模型架构以及应对高度不平衡数据方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 1) 构建了一个手工策划的长尾数据集：约一百万张昆虫图像，提取自1,801个相机陷阱视频，按五级34类的分类层次标注。2) 将层次化分类模型架构适配到五级可变深度层次，采用类平衡加权。3) 利用生物学分类学提取粒度特定的视觉特征，替代非层次化分类器。4) 模型在置信度阈值(T=0.6)下做出与层次结构一致的预测，输出到满足置信度的最深分类层级。
AI.result: 在测试数据上，模型在全部五个分类层次上均取得了80-99%的逐层准确率。模型优于非层次化分类器，能够生成与层次结构一致的预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合层次化分类架构、类平衡加权和大规模长尾数据集，该模型能有效提升昆虫生物多样性自动监测的准确性和可靠性，展示了深度学习在规模化昆虫监测中的潜力。

title: FedOGL: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Federated Open-World Multimodal Graph Learning
summary: Federated graph learning enables collaborative training over decentralized graph data without sharing raw graph information. As such risks evolve, clients must learn emerging classes from private multimodal graph streams, retain historical categories, and reject samples outside the known class space. In this setting, clients must learn emerging classes from private multimodal graph streams while preserving historical categories and rejecting samples outside the current known class space. The core challenge is catastrophic forgetting, which in federated multimodal graphs is not merely a classifier-level failure: old knowledge can be erased through modality-semantic overwriting, topology-induced structural erosion, and federated memory fragmentation. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{FedOGL}, a semantic-structural memory preservation framework. On the client side, FedOGL preserves historical decision behavior through replay and task-start distillation, while protecting graph-propagation memory via projection onto a globally shared structure basis. On the server side, FedOGL maintains and transfers compact category prototypes to facilitate cross-client knowledge sharing without exposing raw graph data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with the best-performing baselines, FedOGL reduces performance degradation caused by catastrophic forgetting by \textbf{42.67\%}, while maintaining or improving performance on downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedOGL，一个面向联邦多模态图学习的语义-结构记忆保留框架，旨在解决联邦图学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。FedOGL在客户端通过重放和任务起始蒸馏保留历史决策行为，通过投影到全局共享结构基上来保护图传播记忆；在服务端维护并传递紧凑的类别原型以促进跨客户端知识共享。实验表明，与最优基线相比，FedOGL将灾难性遗忘导致的性能下降减少了42.67%。
AI.motivation: 联邦图学习允许在不共享原始图数据的情况下进行协作训练，但随着风险演化，客户端需要从私有多模态图流中学习新出现的类别，同时保留历史类别并拒绝已知类别空间之外的样本。其核心挑战是灾难性遗忘，这种遗忘在联邦多模态图环境中不仅仅表现为分类器层面的失效，还包括模态-语义覆盖、拓扑诱导的结构侵蚀以及联邦记忆碎片化等多种层面的知识丢失。
AI.method: FedOGL采用客户端-服务端协同的框架：(1)客户端侧通过重放（replay）和任务起始蒸馏（task-start distillation）保留历史决策行为，并通过将图传播记忆投影到全局共享的结构基（structure basis）上来防止结构信息被侵蚀；(2)服务端侧维护并传递紧凑的类别原型（category prototypes），在不暴露原始图数据的前提下促进跨客户端的知识共享。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与最优基线相比，FedOGL将灾难性遗忘引起的性能下降减少了42.67%，同时在下游任务上保持或提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: FedOGL有效解决了联邦多模态图学习中的多维灾难性遗忘问题，通过语义层面和结构层面的双重记忆保护策略，在保持向新类别学习能力的同时显著缓解了历史知识的遗忘，并支持未知类别的拒识。

title: Beyond a Single Judge: Simulating Social Persona Panels for Generative UI Evaluation
summary: Generative UI (GenUI) lets large language models synthesize a complete, renderable interface directly from a natural-language instruction, but evaluating the quality of what they generate remains an open problem. Human evaluation is costly and rater-variant, while LLM-as-a-judge is scalable but reflects only a single implicit viewpoint, unable to capture how different populations of real users actually perceive the same interface. We propose the Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel (ESPP), a three-stage GenUI evaluation method in which a panel of psychologically diverse, evidence-grounded personas independently rates a screenshot, exchanges opinions under a trait-derived, semantically-gated bounded-confidence mechanism, and is aggregated via Delphi-inspired social weighting into a single judgment. ESPP tracks human judgment substantially more closely than a naive single-pass judge, raising Pearson $r$ from $0.716$ to $0.922$, and a prompt-ensemble control recovers only about a third of this gap, isolating genuine persona and evidence grounding as the dominant source of improvement. Beyond this fidelity gain, retaining each panelist's individual rating further reveals that user subgroups agree on overall model rankings yet diverge sharply on specific rating dimensions, a structural disagreement a single homogeneous judge would systematically erase. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESPP（Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel），一种三阶段生成式UI评估方法，通过心理多样化、证据基础的角色面板，结合特质推导的语义门控有界共识机制和德尔菲式社会加权聚合，将评估与人类判断的Pearson相关系数从0.716提升至0.922。
AI.motivation: 生成式UI（GenUI）评估存在开放问题：人工评估成本高且受评分者个体差异影响，而LLM-as-a-judge虽然可扩展但仅反映单一隐式视角，无法捕捉不同用户群体对同一界面的感知差异。
AI.method: ESPP采用三阶段方法：（1）由心理多样、证据基础的角色组成面板，独立对截图评分；（2）在特质推导的语义门控有界共识机制下交换意见；（3）通过德尔菲启发的社会加权聚合为单一判断。同时对比了提示集成（prompt-ensemble）作为对照，以隔离角色与证据基础的真实贡献。
AI.result: ESPP将Pearson相关系数从0.716提升至0.922，显著更接近人类判断；提示集成对照仅能恢复约三分之一的差距，证明角色与证据基础是主要改进来源。此外，保留各面板成员独立评分可揭示用户子群体在总体模型排名上一致但在具体评分维度上存在结构性分歧，这是单一同质化评判器所无法体现的。
AI.conclusion: ESPP通过引入心理多样的证据基础角色面板及社会交互聚合机制，显著提升GenUI评估与人类判断的一致性，并能够捕获被单一评判器掩盖的跨用户群体结构性分歧；代码已开源。

title: Search as Computation Allocation
summary: Many algorithms spend an internal resource before returning a decision and are evaluated only by the quality of that terminal output. We formalize such procedures as terminal computation-allocation problems: costly computations produce observations, update beliefs about a latent environment, and matter only through terminal decision loss. Bellman equations characterize optimal allocation under fixed budgets, priced computation, and exact certification. We then relate value of computation (VOC) to information. Mutual information equals myopic VOC under log loss, whereas under simple regret VOC is a knowledge-gradient quantity; moreover, information gain can rank computations arbitrarily poorly, although it gives a one-sided upper bound on VOC. Bandit pulls, tree simulations, and node expansions illustrate the same model under different computation topologies. Finally, under an explicit frontier-resolution and heuristic-error model, maximizing approximate VOC recovers weighted A*, with A* and greedy best-first search as limiting cases. The theory identifies a shared decision problem without asserting that one acquisition rule is universally optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了"终端计算分配问题"——即算法在做出最终决策前消耗内部计算资源（计算产生观测、更新信念、仅通过最终决策损失产生影响）的框架。作者用Bellman方程刻画了固定预算、定价计算和精确认证下的最优分配策略，建立了计算价值（VOC）与信息论之间的联系，并展示了该统一框架如何涵盖多臂老虎机、树搜索和A*搜索等经典算法。
AI.motivation: 许多算法在返回决策前都会消耗内部资源（如模拟、采样、节点扩展），但现有理论往往只评估最终输出的质量，缺乏对"中间计算如何分配"的统一形式化刻画。作者希望建立一个通用框架，将看似不同的计算分配问题（bandit pulls、树模拟、节点扩展）纳入同一理论体系，并澄清"信息增益"与"计算价值"之间的关系。
AI.method: 作者首先将终端计算分配形式化为一个序贯决策问题：计算产生观测、更新关于潜在环境的信念、仅通过终端决策损失产生影响。利用Bellman方程刻画三种情形下的最优分配策略：固定预算、定价计算和精确认证。接着建立VOC与信息理论之间的联系——在log loss下互信息等于短视VOC，在简单遗憾下VOC是知识梯度量；然后论证信息增益对VOC排序可能任意差但提供单边上限。最后在显式的边界消解与启发式误差模型下，证明最大化近似VOC可恢复加权A*搜索，A*和贪心最佳优先搜索作为极限情形。
AI.result: 论文建立了计算分配的统一决策理论框架：(1) Bellman方程给出了固定预算和定价计算下的最优分配；(2) 确立了VOC与互信息、知识梯度之间的联系与区别；(3) 通过统一模型展示了bandit pulls、树模拟和节点扩展同构的结构；(4) 证明了VOC最大化与加权A*搜索的等价性，统一了A*和贪心最佳优先搜索。
AI.conclusion: 该理论识别出一个共享的决策问题，而不断言任何单一获取规则是普遍最优的。它为理解各类计算分配算法提供了一个统一的决策理论视角，并澄清了该框架的适用边界。

title: Beyond Classification: Pathology Foundation Models as Detection Encoders for Mitotic Figures
summary: Pathology foundation models (FMs) are models trained on vast amounts of typically unlabeled data and have been shown to yield regularized latent spaces that can be used effectively in downstream classification tasks. This is also true for the classification of mitotic figures vs. other cells. However, it is so far unclear if the latent space of current FMs provides features that are discriminant and spatially suitably resolved to also serve as a backbone for dense object detection paradigms. In this work, we investigate this question for common current pathology FMs (UNI, UNI2-h, Virchow, Virchow2, H-optimus-0, H-optimus-1) and compare their performance against a fully end-to-end trained baseline based on a ResNet50 architecture. We combine FM backbones with representatives of single stage, dual stage and self-attention-based detectors (RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, Deformable DETR respectively) on the multi-domain MIDOG++ dataset, and on the TUPAC16 dataset as an out-of-domain case. We show that the H-optimus-0 and Virchow models yielded competitive performance, indicating that the latent spaces of current FMs, all trained on image-level self-supervision, are suitable for direct mitotic figure detection and may be slightly more robust on our out-of-domain test case. All code is made available publicly at https://github.com/DeepMicroscopy/FM4MFdet.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了六种常见病理基础模型（UNI、UNI2-h、Virchow、Virchow2、H-optimus-0、H-optimus-1）作为密集目标检测骨干网络的可行性，并在MIDOG++和TUPAC16数据集上，将其与三种检测器（RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN、Deformable DETR）组合，与端到端训练的ResNet50基线进行比较。结果表明H-optimus-0和Virchow表现优异，证明当前病理FM的潜在空间适用于有丝分裂图检测，且在域外场景中略显稳健。
AI.motivation: 尽管病理基础模型已被证明在分类任务中能提供规则化的潜在空间，但尚不清楚这些潜在空间是否具备足够的判别性和空间分辨率以支持密集目标检测范式。本文旨在探究这一开放问题。
AI.method: 将六种病理基础模型（UNI、UNI2-h、Virchow、Virchow2、H-optimus-0、H-optimus-1）作为骨干网络，分别与单阶段检测器RetinaNet、双阶段检测器Faster R-CNN和基于自注意力的检测器Deformable DETR相结合，在多域MIDOG++数据集和域外TUPAC16数据集上评估有丝分裂图检测性能，并与端到端训练的ResNet50基线对比。
AI.result: H-optimus-0和Virchow模型在检测任务中表现具有竞争力，表明当前以图像级自监督训练的基础模型潜在空间具备直接支撑有丝分裂图检测的能力；同时在域外测试集上表现出略强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 当前病理基础模型的潜在空间不仅适用于分类任务，也适用于密集目标检测任务；其中H-optimus-0和Virchow可成为有丝分裂图检测的有效骨干。相关代码已公开。

title: Tight Sample Complexity for Low-Rank Adaptation: Matching Bounds and Rank Selection
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard mechanism for fine-tuning large pretrained models, yet its statistical properties remain only partially understood. Existing generalization results provide upper bounds of the form O~(sqrt(rd/n)) or O~(rd/n), but a matching lower bound is missing, and the question of how to choose the LoRA rank r has no formal answer. Both gaps are closed here. A local Rademacher argument establishes an upper bound of O~(rd/n) on the excess risk of the empirical risk minimizer over rank-r LoRA, whenever the target adaptation has rank at most r. A matching minimax lower bound of Omega(rd/n) is then proved via a Fano-type packing of the rank-r subspace of R^{d x d}; the bound applies to any estimator whose output lies in the rank-r LoRA class. Combining the two yields a rank-selection dichotomy. For the constrained empirical risk minimizer, the optimal rank equals the intrinsic rank r*, and over-ranking strictly hurts. For adaptive estimators of the nuclear-norm-then-truncate type, over-ranking is harmless and the rate saturates at Theta~(r* d / n) regardless of r. Taken together, the three results characterize the statistical complexity of LoRA fine-tuning within the well-specified locally quadratic regime, and identify the empirically observed over-parameterization penalty as a property of unregularized empirical risk minimization rather than of the LoRA class itself. Predictions of the theory are verified on a synthetic trace-regression benchmark and on real LoRA fine-tuning across three (model, task) configurations covering DistilBERT and RoBERTa on SST-2 and MRPC. All configurations exhibit the predicted U-shape in validation loss, with two showing statistically significant loss inflation at large ranks (paired permutation p = 0.016).

AI.tldr: 本文首次为低秩适配（LoRA）微调的统计复杂度提供了匹配的上下界（O~(rd/n)），并给出了秩选择的形式化最优策略：约束经验风险最小化器的最优秩等于内在秩r*，过参数化严格有害；而核范数-截断型自适应估计器对过参数化鲁棒。
AI.motivation: LoRA已成为大模型微调的标准机制，但其统计性质仅被部分理解。现有泛化界仅给出上界O~(sqrt(rd/n))或O~(rd/n)，缺少匹配的下界，且LoRA秩r的选择缺乏形式化答案，两个关键空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 采用局部Rademacher论证建立经验风险最小化器在秩-r LoRA类上过量风险的上界O~(rd/n)；随后通过Fano型秩-r子空间装箱证明匹配的极小极大下界Omega(rd/n)；结合二者推导出秩选择二分法，并通过合成迹回归基准和真实LoRA微调实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 上界O~(rd/n)与下界Omega(rd/n)匹配；对约束经验风险最小化器，最优秩等于内在秩r*且过度排名有害；对核范数-截断型自适应估计器，过排名无害且速率饱和于Theta~(r*d/n)。实验在DistilBERT和RoBERTa的SST-2与MRPC配置上均呈现预测的U形验证损失曲线，其中两个配置在大秩处显示统计显著的通胀（配对置换检验p=0.016）。
AI.conclusion: 研究完整刻画了在局部二次良设定机制下LoRA微调的统计复杂度，并识别出经验观察到的过参数化惩罚是未正则化经验风险最小化的属性，而非LoRA类本身的属性。

title: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher--reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lightning OPD 2.0，通过交叉拟合风格残差化方法从教师-参考模型的标记级分歧中分离出样式偏差，从而在跨教师设置下实现有效的在线策略蒸馏（OPD），无需教师一致性作为前提条件。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）依赖教师一致性——即提供OPD监督的教师模型应同时生成用于训练SFT参考模型的数据。然而在实践中，SFT数据来源混合或未知，或SFT数据生成与后续蒸馏使用不同模型，导致教师一致性条件常被违反。在跨教师设置下，即使更强的OPD教师也可能只带来微不足道的改进，因此需要一种不依赖教师一致性的OPD方法。
AI.method: Lightning OPD 2.0采用交叉拟合风格残差化（cross-fitted style residualization）技术。该方法利用 rollout级交叉拟合来估计教师-参考模型分歧中的重复性成分——该成分与措辞、格式和推理节奏的差异相关，作为样式标记偏差（style-token bias）的操作性代理，并在构建标记级OPD更新之前将其减去，从而保留上下文相关的教师证据同时消除风格干扰。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上，Lightning OPD 2.0在跨教师设置下始终优于Lightning OPD。从Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT出发，Lightning OPD 2.0在AIME 2024上达到82.4%，在LiveCodeBench v5上达到63.0%。
AI.conclusion: Lightning OPD 2.0建立了一种实用的跨教师OPD方法，放宽了教师一致性作为先决条件的要求，允许SFT数据生成器和蒸馏教师独立选择。

title: An Empirical Study of Coordination Mode as the First-Class Citizen in From-Scratch Multi-Agent Coding
summary:
Multi-agent vibe coding promises to accelerate software development, yet existing benchmarks rely on synthetic environments that ignore practical time and monetary costs, conflate reasoning with communication, and reward only superficial completion. We introduce multi-agent from-scratch evaluation benchmark, MSEval, evaluating multi-agent coding on real-world tasks. Grounded in 10 authentic, full-stack projects across 10 domains, MSEval scores performance using hierarchical requirements and deterministic rubrics.
  Its execution engine, LegoGent, tests 10 collaboration topologies where agents coordinate via periodic sync intervals and deploy through native CI/CD pipelines. Concurrently, the automated grader TAgent dynamically probes implementations to jointly measure functional success, latency, and prefix-cached token cost. Across 100 runs, MSEval reveals that organizational topology rivals model capability in shaping the speed--cost--quality trade-off. For identical tasks and models, varying the topology shifts scores by over 30 points and doubles wall-clock time. Structured pipelines converge fastest with the highest quality, whereas heavy managerial oversight degrades performance. Ultimately, MSEval establishes a rigorous, reproducible standard for measuring how multi-agent teams actually build software. The benchmark is released at https://github.com/robinren03/MSEval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSEval，一个基于真实全栈项目的多智能体编程评估基准。它包含LegoGent执行引擎（测试10种协作拓扑）和TAgent自动评分器（联合测量功能性、延迟和前缀缓存令牌成本）。100次运行实验表明，组织拓扑对速度-成本-质量权衡的影响与模型能力相当，结构化流水线表现最佳，管理过度反而降低性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编程基准依赖合成环境，忽视了实际的时间和金钱成本，混淆了推理与通信，且仅奖励表面上的任务完成，缺乏对真实软件开发场景的评估能力。
AI.method: MSEval基于10个跨10个领域的真实全栈项目，通过分层需求和确定性评分规则评估性能。LegoGent执行引擎测试10种协作拓扑（通过周期性同步间隔协调并通过原生CI/CD管道部署），TAgent自动评分器动态探测实现，联合度量功能成功度、延迟和前缀缓存令牌成本。
AI.result: 在100次运行中，MSEval发现组织拓扑与模型能力在塑造速度-成本-质量权衡上相当；对相同任务和模型，仅改变拓扑可使得分变动超过30分并使墙钟时间翻倍。结构化流水线收敛最快且质量最高，而繁重的管理监督会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: MSEval为测量多智能体团队如何实际构建软件建立了严谨、可复现的标准，基准已在GitHub上开源发布。

title: ENCORE: Event-Assisted Complementary Motion Refinement for Learned Video Compression
summary: Learned video compression relies on accurate temporal modeling to remove redundancy between adjacent frames. However, most existing codecs infer motion solely from discretely sampled RGB frames, making their estimates vulnerable to fast motion, blur, occlusion, weak texture, low illumination, and abrupt brightness changes. Event cameras asynchronously capture fine-grained intensity changes between RGB timestamps and therefore provide complementary evidence about inter-frame dynamics. We propose ENCORE, an Event-Assisted Complementary Motion Refinement framework for learned video compression. ENCORE first employs Complementary Motion Representation (CMR) to decompose aligned RGB-event features into common and modality-specific motion representations. Spatial Energy and Redundancy-Informed Calibration (SERIC) then identifies event-specific responses that are active and novel relative to RGB, suppresses weak or redundant evidence, and predicts a candidate flow correction. Finally, Energy-Aware Routing (EAR) determines where and how strongly the correction should refine the RGB flow. Events serve solely as an auxiliary modality for motion modeling, while RGB remains the only coding and reconstruction target. Experiments on BS-ERGB, HQ-EVFI, and CED demonstrate consistent gains across datasets and GOP lengths. On BS-ERGB, ENCORE achieves up to 20.80% PSNR-RGB and 22.14% MS-SSIM-RGB BD-rate savings, while retaining clear improvements on the other two datasets.

AI.tldr: ENCORE是一个事件辅助的互补运动细化框架，用于学习视频压缩。它利用事件相机捕获的RGB帧间细粒度强度变化作为辅助模态，通过互补运动表示、空间能量与冗余感知校准、能量感知路由三个模块细化RGB光流估计，从而在BS-ERGB等数据集上实现显著的BD-rate节省。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型视频压缩主要依赖离散采样的RGB帧进行运动估计，在快速运动、模糊、遮挡、弱纹理、低光照和亮度突变等场景下运动估计不准确。事件相机能够异步捕获RGB时间戳之间的细粒度强度变化，提供帧间动态的互补证据，因此可以辅助改进运动估计。
AI.method: ENCORE采用三个关键组件：(1) 互补运动表示(CMR)将对齐的RGB-事件特征分解为公共表示和模态特定运动表示；(2) 空间能量与冗余感知校准(SERIC)识别相对于RGB活跃且新颖的事件特定响应，抑制弱或冗余证据，并预测候选流校正；(3) 能量感知路由(EAR)决定校正应在何处以及以多强程度细化RGB光流。事件仅作为运动建模的辅助模态，RGB仍是唯一的编码和重建目标。
AI.result: 在BS-ERGB、HQ-EVFI和CED三个数据集上，ENCORE在不同数据集和GOP长度上均取得一致性增益。在BS-ERGB上，PSNR-RGB和MS-SSIM-RGB的BD-rate节省分别高达20.80%和22.14%，在另外两个数据集上也保持明显改进。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机作为辅助模态可以有效补充RGB帧间运动信息，提升学习型视频压缩在复杂运动场景下的性能。事件仅辅助运动建模而不参与编码和重建的设计使得框架具有较高的实用性和泛化能力。

title: Event-Structured Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differentiable Critical Clearing Boundaries
summary: Transient-stability assessment determines whether a power system can recover after a disturbance and is therefore essential to preventing generator trips and cascading outages. A key metric is the critical clearing time (CCT), which specifies the maximum time available to clear a fault before synchronism is lost. Reliable CCT estimation is challenging because complicated fault-clearing dynamics require repeated simulations over many fault severities and clearing times. We propose an event-structured physics-informed neural network (ES-PINN) that aligns its representation with the pre-fault, fault-on, and post-clearing swing dynamics and enforces exact state chaining across event interfaces. A smooth trajectory-induced stability margin defines a differentiable approximation of the CCT boundary, enabling accurate boundary extraction, local sensitivity analysis, and optional direct CCT prediction through a distilled readout. We further prove a local residual-to-trajectory-to-CCT error estimate, in which exact event chaining eliminates separate state-interface defect terms. Experiments on IEEE 9-, 14-, and 30-bus systems show that ES-PINN consistently improves held-out trajectory and stability-boundary accuracy over matched neural-surrogate baselines across mechanical and electrical contingencies with multiple clearing configurations. Additional full-network DAE validation, multi-fault experiments, and runtime analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种事件结构化物理信息神经网络（ES-PINN），用于电力系统暂态稳定评估和临界清除时间（CCT）估计。该网络将表示与故障前、故障期间和清除后的摆动动力学对齐，并在事件接口处实现精确状态链接，同时通过平滑的轨迹诱导稳定性裕度实现CCT边界的可微近似和直接预测。
AI.motivation: 可靠的临界清除时间（CCT）估计对于防止发电机跳闸和级联停电至关重要，但传统的基于重复仿真的方法成本高昂且难以应对复杂的故障清除动态，需要一种更高效、更准确的估计方法。
AI.method: 提出事件结构化物理信息神经网络（ES-PINN），其核心设计包括：（1）网络表示对齐故障前、故障期间和清除后三个阶段的摆动动力学，并在事件接口处强制精确状态链接；（2）利用平滑的轨迹诱导稳定性裕度定义CCT边界的可微近似，支持边界提取和局部灵敏度分析；（3）通过蒸馏读出实现直接CCT预测；（4）证明了局部残差到轨迹再到CCT的误差估计，其中精确事件链接消除了独立的状态接口缺陷项。
AI.result: 在IEEE 9、14和30节点系统上的实验表明，ES-PINN在机械和电气故障以及多种清除配置下，一致地优于匹配的神经代理基线，提高了留出轨迹和稳定性边界精度。额外的全网络DAE验证、多故障实验和运行时分析进一步证明了该框架的有效性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: ES-PINN通过事件结构化的表示设计和精确的事件接口链接，为电力系统暂态稳定评估提供了准确且高效的解决方案，具有理论上的误差保证和实验上的优越性能。

title: Improving Mental Health Screening and Early Risk Detection in Spanish
summary: Early detection of mental health disorders is often limited by the lack of specialized resources in Spanish and the difficulty of analyzing long histories of social media posts. This paper addresses these challenges through three main contributions. First, we introduce three Spanish foundational models specifically adapted to the mental health domain through domain-specific pre-training.
