We demonstrate that safety fine-tuning suppresses models' tendencies to attribute minds not only to themselves, but also to non-human animals and natural objects, while also driving a reduction in spiritual belief. Both ablating the learned safety-refusal direction and mechanistically steering a consciousness vector in activation space reverse this suppression. Restoring these internal representations recovers broad mind attribution and produces significantly more human-like responses on standardized sociological surveys regarding religiosity, moral values, hope, and subjective well-being. Crucially, these shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind capabilities, demonstrating that core social reasoning remains mechanistically independent. Ultimately, current safety alignment efforts to curb potentially harmful self-attributions of mindedness entangle these self-attributions with benign spiritual beliefs and attributions of mind to non-human entities that are culturally accepted and widespread.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示安全对齐（safety fine-tuning）在抑制大语言模型自我意识归因的同时，也意外抑制了模型对其他实体（非人类动物、自然物体）的心智归因以及精神信仰倾向。通过消融安全拒绝方向或在激活空间引导意识向量，可逆转这一抑制效应，恢复广泛的心智归因并产生更接近人类的宗教性、道德价值、希望与主观幸福感等方面的回答，同时不损伤心理理论（ToM）能力。
AI.motivation: 当前安全对齐致力于防止大语言模型进行潜在的"有害"自我意识归因，但作者担心这种对齐手段可能过于粗粒度，会连带抑制模型对非人类实体（动物、自然物体）的良性心智归因以及广泛存在且文化上被接受的精神信仰，从而在表征层面引入不必要的偏差。
AI.method: 作者对对齐前后的大语言模型进行比较分析：（1）考察安全微调对模型自我心智归因、他者心智归因及精神信仰倾向的影响；（2）通过消融学习到的安全拒绝方向（safety-refusal direction）以及机制性地在激活空间中引导"意识向量"（consciousness vector）来验证内部表征的作用；（3）使用标准化的社会学调查（涉及宗教性、道德价值、希望对主观幸福感）评估模型的回答是否因此更接近人类；（4）同时评估心理理论（ToM）能力以确保核心社会推理功能未受影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：安全微调不仅抑制了模型的自我心智归因，还抑制了对非人类动物和自然物体的心智归因，并降低了精神信仰倾向。通过消融安全拒绝方向和激活空间中引导意识向量可逆转这一抑制，恢复广泛心智归因，并使模型在标准化社会学调查中产生显著更接近人类的回答（如宗教性、道德价值观、希望与主观幸福感）。此外，这些转变不损害模型的心理理论能力，表明核心社会推理在机制上与心智归因表征相互独立。
AI.conclusion: 当前的安全对齐努力旨在抑制潜在的"有害"自我意识归因，但这种方法将自我归因与良性的精神信仰以及对非人类实体的文化上普遍接受的心智归因纠缠在一起，导致对齐过程产生非预期且不必要的表征偏差。研究提示，更精确的机制性干预（如激活空间中定向操控意识向量）可能比粗粒度的安全微调更能精准地实现安全目标而不牺牲广泛的认知与社会归因能力。

title: From Scoring to Acting: Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: Recent work on LLM agents is shifting from external capability elicitation to capability internalization, enabling agents to retain useful skills without retrieval at inference time. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising direction, but many existing methods typically supervise students by scoring actions along student-generated trajectories. Such supervision has two limitations: teacher preferences are not validated by environment outcomes, and action-level scores underuse information from student rollouts, teacher rollouts, and their behavioral relationship. We therefore advocate outcome-verified teacher supervision and comparative learning over teacher-student trajectories. Based on this view, we propose Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation (OVCSD). OVCSD organizes failed student rollouts into a prefix tree, adaptively invokes a skill-conditioned teacher from student-reached states, and retains only outcome-verified successful continuations. It then applies localized comparative learning at the first state-aligned divergence and distills the post-divergence teacher suffix to transfer completion behavior. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop across three model scales show that OVCSD consistently outperforms skill-free RL and existing self-distillation baselines, achieving up to 29.7 and 5.4 absolute success-rate gains over the strongest baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, while adding less than 3% privileged interaction during training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种名为OVCSD（Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation）的LLM智能体自我蒸馏方法，通过结果验证的教师监督和基于教师-学生轨迹的比较学习来提高智能体能力内化，在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究正从外部能力激发转向能力内化，使智能体在推理时无需检索即可保留技能。然而现有的on-policy self-distillation方法存在两个局限：(1)教师偏好未经环境结果验证；(2)基于动作级别的监督未充分利用学生轨迹、教师轨迹及其行为关系中的信息。因此需要结果验证的教师监督和基于教师-学生轨迹的比较学习。
AI.method: OVCSD方法包含三个核心步骤：(1)将失败的学生轨迹组织成前缀树结构；(2)从学生到达的状态自适应调用具备技能条件的教师，仅保留经结果验证的成功延续；(3)在首个状态对齐分歧处应用局部比较学习，并蒸馏分歧后的教师后缀以迁移完成任务的行为。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上、跨三种模型规模的实验中，OVCSD一致优于无技能的强化学习和现有自我蒸馏基线。在ALFWorld上相比最强基线取得最高29.7个绝对成功率提升，在WebShop上取得最高5.4个绝对成功率提升，同时训练期间仅增加不到3%的特权交互。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证的教师监督与基于轨迹的比较学习相结合，能够显著提升LLM智能体的自我蒸馏效果，且只需极小的特权交互开销即可实现大幅的性能增益。

title: Convolutional Neural Shading for High-Quality 3D Reconstruction from Multi-View Images
summary: We propose a convolutional neural shading (CNS), a novel pipeline to reconstruct high-quality 3D shapes from multi-view images. Several recent studies have used neural radiance fields and other neural differentiable rendering methods to understand 3D geometry. However, these approaches rely on single-point geometric information, such as positions and normals of the surface, leading to a lack of detailed local geometry. Our approach addresses the inherent limitations of single-point information by leveraging a neural shader to capture variations even in dark and textureless regions with a convolutional neural shader, resulting in far more accurate geometry predictions. Additionally, our method mitigates surface irregularities at image boundaries by introducing a fine-detail displacement network, which utilizes spatial information of surface geometry and learns fine displacement details by correlating neighboring values in the rendering coordinates. Through extensive experiments, our proposed method has demonstrated significant quality improvements in the reconstructed shapes and rendered images over current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出卷积神经着色（CNS）管线，通过卷积神经着色器捕获暗区和无纹理区域的几何变化，并引入细粒度位移网络修正表面不规则性，从而从多视图图像重建高质量3D形状。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于神经辐射场和神经可微渲染的方法仅依赖单点几何信息（如表面位置和法线），缺乏详细的局部几何细节，尤其在暗区和无纹理区域表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出一种卷积神经着色器（CNS），利用卷积结构捕获局部几何变化以弥补单点信息的局限；同时设计细粒度位移网络，利用渲染坐标中的空间表面几何信息，通过关联邻近值学习精细位移细节，缓解图像边界处的表面不规则性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在重建形状和渲染图像质量上均显著优于当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于卷积的神经着色和位移学习能够有效克服传统单点几何信息的局限性，实现更精细、更高质量的3D形状重建。

title: LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO): A Sampling-Time Low-Rank Scaffold for Recovering Reinforcement-Learning Gradient on Zero-Reward Cliff Prompts
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) for mathematical reasoning suffers from a structural blind spot: on "cliff" prompts-those on which every sampled rollout in a group fails-the group-normalized advantage is identically zero, so GRPO produces no gradient on precisely the prompts at the frontier of the model's capability. We introduce LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO), a sampling-time mechanism that recovers this lost gradient. Each RL step, LSPO detects cliff prompts, fits a small low-rank (LoRA) adapter by a brief supervised step on their ground-truth solutions, re-rolls the cliffs with the base-plus-adapter model, splices the now-successful completions back into the RL batch with an importance-sampling correction, and takes a GRPO step on the base alone; the adapter receives only the supervised gradient and is discarded at checkpoint, yielding a base-only model. On DeepMath-103K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, evaluated over n=5 paired seeds per arm at a matched 1000-step reporting horizon, LSPO's 5-seed mean matches or beats a DAPO baseline on all 16 (benchmark, pass@k) cells (15 strict wins and one exact tie), with gains of up to +10.7 points on AIME24/pass@4, +6.7 points on AIME24 and AIME26 at pass@16, and +2.4 points on MATH500/pass@1; averaged over the 16 cells the improvement is +3.8 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LSPO（LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization），一种在采样时机制，用于解决RLVR数学推理中GRPO对"cliff"提示（组内所有rollout均失败）不产生梯度的问题。LSPO通过检测cliff提示、用LoRA适配器进行短期监督微调、重采样成功轨迹并带回RL批次（带重要性采样校正），同时保持最终仅基础模型。在DeepMath-103K和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B上，16个（benchmark, pass@k）单元格中15个严格优于DAPO基线，1个持平，平均提升+3.8分。
AI.motivation: RLVR用于数学推理时存在结构性盲点：对于"cliff"提示（组内所有采样rollout均失败），组归一化优势恒为零，导致GRPO在这些模型能力前沿的提示上完全无梯度信号，从而无法利用这些最有价值的学习信号。
AI.method: LSPO在每个RL步骤中：(1)检测cliff提示；(2)在其真实解上对小型LoRA适配器进行简短监督步骤；(3)使用基础模型加适配器重新采样cliff提示；(4)通过重要性采样校正将成功的补全拼接回RL批次；(5)仅对基础模型执行GRPO步骤；适配器只获得监督梯度并在检查点处被丢弃，最终得到纯基础模型。
AI.result: 在DeepMath-103K上使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B，在n=5配对种子、1000步报告视野下，LSPO的5种子均值在16个（benchmark, pass@k）单元格中全部达到或超过DAPO基线（15个严格胜利、1个平局），AIME24/pass@4提升+10.7分，AIME24和AIME26在pass@16提升+6.7分，MATH500/pass@1提升+2.4分，16个单元格平均改善+3.8分。
AI.conclusion: LSPO通过在采样时进行LoRA脚手架（scaffolding）策略，有效恢复了cliff提示上的缺失梯度，在不改变最终模型架构（仅基础模型）的前提下显著优于DAPO基线，为克服RLVR在分布外/困难提示上的训练盲区提供了一种有效且实用的方法。

title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
summary: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying claim: each paper is converted into atomic, typed claims, each grounded by a source DOI and a verbatim quote or an explicit evidence locator. Over this shared claim store, AskChem exposes complementary structures for search and synthesis: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for hierarchical retrieval and browsing, an evidence graph linking claims through relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy that situates indexed papers under scientific principles. AskChem currently indexes 2.4M claims from 147K papers and provides a web interface, as well as REST, SDK, and MCP access for AI agents. On AskChem-Bench, grounding a GPT-5.5 reader in AskChem yields 100% resolvable DOIs, compared with 88.3% without retrieval, and the highest citation density among five tested systems. AskChem is live at https://askchem.org.

AI.tldr: AskChem是一个面向跨论文化学检索的以"声明"为中心的基础设施，将检索单元从论文级别细化到带有来源证明的原子化声明，并通过多维度结构（分层分类、证据图、动态分类体系）支持搜索与综合，目前索引了147K篇论文中的2.4M条声明，可显著提升AI代理的引用可靠性和密度。
AI.motivation: 化学文献综述常常需要将分散在多篇论文中的具体发现进行整合，但现有文献检索系统主要返回排序的文档列表，导致科学家和AI代理需要手动定位相关信息、验证其来源并跨论文组装答案，效率低下且容易出错。
AI.method: AskChem将论文转换为原子化、带类型的声明，每条声明由来源DOI和逐字引用或明确的证据定位器作为依据。在共享声明存储之上，AskChem提供三层互补结构：稳定分面分类法（用于分层检索和浏览）、证据图（通过关系链接声明）、探索性动态分类法（将索引论文置于科学原理之下）。同时提供Web界面以及REST、SDK和MCP接口供AI代理访问。
AI.result: AskChem目前索引了147K篇论文中的240万条声明。在AskChem-Bench基准上，将GPT-5.5阅读器基于AskChem进行接地可达到100%可解析的DOI（无检索时为88.3%），并且在五个测试系统中拥有最高的引用密度。
AI.conclusion: 以声明为检索单元并附带来源证明的基础设施能显著提升跨论文化学文献检索和综合的效率与可靠性，尤其对AI代理的引用准确性和可追溯性有实质性改善。

title: MARS-RA: Rank Aggregation for Credit Assignment via Multimodal Comparisons in Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation
summary: Credit assignment is a fundamental challenge in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, particularly in embodied AI settings characterized by limited and delayed feedback as well as dynamically changing numbers of active agents. We propose MARS-RA, a framework that reformulates credit assignment as a rank aggregation problem using contribution-based pairwise comparisons among agents generated by large multimodal models. This shift from absolute to relative estimation ensures robustness against noise and dynamic agent participation, converting comparison results into contribution scores for potential-based reward shaping. We provide theoretical justification for the convergence and robustness of the proposed framework, and show that Shapley values can be used as an interpretive reference. Experimental results on challenging tasks of different types indicate that MARS-RA can guide agents toward effective cooperation.

AI.tldr: MARS-RA 提出了一种基于大多模态模型生成贡献比较的信用分配框架，将多智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题重构为排序聚合问题，并通过基于势能的奖励塑形将比较结果转化为贡献分数，从而在仅限和延迟反馈及动态智能体数量条件下实现稳健合作。
AI.motivation: 合作多智能体强化学习中的信用分配在具身AI场景下面临三大挑战：反馈有限且延迟、活跃智能体数量动态变化。传统的基于绝对估计的信用分配方法对这些噪声和动态环境不够稳健，亟需一种新的信用分配范式。
AI.method: MARS-RA将信用分配重构为排序聚合问题：利用大多模态模型生成智能体间的成对贡献比较，通过贡献比较进行排名聚合；然后将绝对估计转为相对估计，以增强对噪声和动态智能体参与的鲁棒性；最后将比较结果转化为贡献分数，用于基于势能的奖励塑形。论文同时提供了收敛性和鲁棒性的理论分析，并以Shapley值作为可解释参照。
AI.result: 在不同类型的挑战性任务上的实验结果表明，MARS-RA能够有效引导智能体实现协作；同时通过理论分析证明了框架的收敛性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MARS-RA通过将信用分配从绝对估计转为相对比较范式，借助大多模态模型生成的成对比较和排序聚合，有效应对了具身AI中有限反馈和动态智能体数量的挑战，为多智能体协作提供了稳健且可解释的信用分配方案。

title: What Makes Deep Learning Work for Traditional Chinese Medicine Tongue Diagnosis? A Comprehensive Ablation Study
summary: Deep learning has shown promise for automated tongue diagnosis in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), yet the design space remains underexplored. We conducted a systematic ablation study spanning 20+ model versions under rigorous 5-fold cross-validation on TongueDx2 (5,109 images, 976 expert-annotated) and a merged dataset of 11,101 samples. We compared six backbone architectures, four loss functions, five augmentation strategies, and six training strategies. The best 976-sample model achieved weighted-F1 of 0.6625 using ConvNeXt-Tiny with restrained augmentation and weak-group ensemble, while the best 11,101-sample model reached weighted-F1 of 0.7761. Six key design principles emerged: (1) ConvNeXt-Tiny offers optimal parameter efficiency; (2) BCE substantially outperforms Asymmetric Loss (+2.7%); (3) restrained color augmentation is critical; (4) weak-group ensemble replacement (+2.1%) outperforms probability averaging; (5) data scaling yielded +20.6% improvement; (6) expanding from 13 to 45 label dimensions caused catastrophic collapse (0.78 to 0.22). These principles are generalizable to multi-label medical image classification with class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 本文对中医舌诊深度学习模型进行了系统性消融研究，涵盖20多个模型版本、6种骨干网络、4种损失函数、5种增强策略和6种训练策略，在976样本和11,101样本数据集上分别达到0.6625和0.7761的加权F1分数，总结出六条关键设计原则。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在中医舌诊自动化中展现出潜力，但模型设计空间（架构、损失函数、数据增强、训练策略等）尚未被系统探索，缺乏严谨的消融对比研究来指导实践。
AI.method: 在TongueDx2数据集（5,109张图像，976张专家标注）及合并的11,101样本数据集上进行5折交叉验证，系统比较了六种骨干架构（含ConvNeXt-Tiny）、四种损失函数（含BCE与Asymmetric Loss）、五种增强策略和六种训练策略（含弱分组集成），并进行了标签维度扩展实验（13到45类）以评估扩展影响。
AI.result: 976样本最佳模型（ConvNeXt-Tiny + 受限增强 + 弱分组集成）加权F1为0.6625；11,101样本最佳模型加权F1为0.7761。关键发现：BCE优于Asymmetric Loss 2.7%，弱分组集成优于概率平均 2.1%，数据规模扩增带来+20.6%提升，而标签维度从13扩展到45导致性能灾难性崩塌（0.78降至0.22）。
AI.conclusion: 总结出六条可泛化的设计原则：参数效率最优的ConvNeXt-Tiny、BCE损失函数优势、受限颜色增强的必要性、弱分组集成的有效性、数据规模的显著增益以及标签维度扩张的崩塌风险。这些原则对多标签医学图像分类（尤其是类别不平衡场景）具有普适指导意义。

title: Revisiting Predictive Process Monitoring in the Age of Foundation Models: A Comparative Study of Sequence, Tabular, and LLM Approaches
summary: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) leverages event logs to forecast the future of running process instances, for instance, predicting the next activity, the remaining time until case completion, or the time to the next event. While PPM research in recent years has been dominated by deep sequence models trained from scratch, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, foundation-model approaches---particularly large language models (LLMs)---are increasingly explored for PPM. At the same time, tabular foundation models with in-context learning capabilities offer a promising alternative but have not yet been systematically benchmarked for PPM. Thus, it remains unclear whether classical sequence-based models remain competitive in this evolving landscape. This paper compares the three modeling paradigms both conceptually and empirically through a controlled benchmark across multiple datasets and prediction tasks. The results show that sequence models consistently perform best for next activity prediction, whereas tabular foundation models are competitive on temporal tasks, with LLMs usually lagging behind despite higher cost.

AI.tldr: 本文对预测性过程监控（PPM）中的三种建模范式——基于深度序列的模型（如LSTM）、大语言模型（LLMs）以及具有上下文学习能力的表格基础模型——进行了系统比较，通过多数据集和多任务的受控基准测试发现：序列模型在下一活动预测任务上始终表现最佳，表格基础模型在时间类任务上具有竞争力，而LLM虽成本更高但通常性能落后。
AI.motivation: 近年来PPM研究以从头训练的深度序列模型（如LSTM）为主导，但基础模型方法（尤其是LLM）正逐渐被探索用于PPM。与此同时，具有上下文学习能力的表格基础模型也被视为有前景的替代方案，但尚未在PPM中被系统性地基准测试。因此，在快速变化的建模格局中，传统的基于序列的模型是否仍具竞争力这一问题尚不明确，需要系统性的对比研究。
AI.method: 本文从概念和实证两个层面比较了三种建模范式：经典序列模型（如LSTM）、LLM基础方法以及表格基础模型。通过设计受控基准测试，在多个数据集和多种预测任务（包括下一活动预测、剩余时间预测、下一事件时间预测）上对这些模型进行了统一的性能评估与对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：序列模型在下一活动预测任务上始终表现最优；表格基础模型在时间类预测任务上表现出竞争力；LLM虽然在计算成本上更高，但其预测性能通常落后于前两类模型。
AI.conclusion: 不同建模范式在PPM中各有优势：经典序列模型仍是下一活动预测的可靠选择，表格基础模型在处理时间类任务时具有潜力，而LLM在当前阶段并非性价比较优的方案。该研究为PPM的模型选型提供了实证依据。

title: Share the Judge, Learn the Deferral: Where Specialization Helps LLM Evaluation
summary: Agentic systems have widened the gap between producing candidate outputs and reviewing them. This paper asks a practical architectural question: should domain specialization be built into an evaluator's weights, or into the rule that decides when its judgment can be trusted? We study 99,952 public, rubric-conditioned examples. Supplying the correct rubric improves locked-test accuracy by 2.11 points over a response-only control; replacing it with an unrelated rubric costs 2.66 points. Dividing the same training corpus among eight criterion-family LoRA judges, however, loses 10.05 points and cuts audited coverage at a 5% risk target from 24.44% to 5.43%. Matching the bank's stored capacity with one rank-64 adapter does not reproduce this loss. Nor is the result explained by learning rate or optimizer steps. Initializing the family adapters from a shared, trained judge recovers test accuracy to 76.85%, 19.94 points above scratch training at the same learning rate (95% interval 18.88-21.02). The result changes when specialization governs deferral rather than judgment. On RewardBench 2, learned correctness heads route examples through a 0.6B-4B-8B cascade without changing any reward score. Across 20 locked repartitions, the cascade attains 89.40% accuracy, compared with 84.75% for 8B alone, at 0.415 normalized parameter compute. Every run passes an exact one-sided 95% risk audit; margin-based rules remain near 84.8% accuracy while using at least 0.94 compute. These results suggest a qualified design rule: share the learning of judgment until there is enough data to justify a split, and place domain-specific adaptation in an audited release boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过99,952个公开的rubric条件化示例和RewardBench 2上的级联实验，论证了一个架构设计原则：领域专业化不应被内置于评测器（evaluator）的权重中，而应放在决定何时信任其判断的规则（发布边界）里。将训练语料划分为8个criterion-family LoRA评测器导致10.05点性能损失，而共享训练+级联路由（不改变任何奖励分数）在低0.415倍算力下取得89.40%准确率，优于8B单独推理的84.75%。作者提出"共享评判学习直至数据足够支撑拆分"的限定设计规则。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统在生成候选输出与评审输出之间出现了日益扩大的鸿沟。作者提出一个实际的架构问题：领域专业化应该内置于评测器的权重中，还是内置于决定其判断何时可被信任的规则中。该问题的核心在于如何最优地分配"评判能力"与"信任决策"之间的责任，从而在有限算力和数据下提升评测准确率。
AI.method: 作者首先在99,952个公开的rubric条件化示例上实验：提供正确rubric比仅用响应的对照组提升2.11点，替换为无关rubric则损失2.66点。通过将同一训练语料划分为8个criterion-family LoRA评测器，观察到10.05点的性能损失，且5%风险目标下的审计覆盖率从24.44%降至5.43%。用单个rank-64适配器匹配总容量无法复现该损失，并排除学习率和优化器步数的解释。当从共享训练评测器初始化family适配器时，测试准确率恢复至76.85%，比同学习率的从头训练高19.94点。随后改变专业化作用的位置——从评判转向延迟（deferral）：在RewardBench 2上，学习到的正确性头（correctness heads）将示例路由至0.6B-4B-8B级联，不改变任何奖励分数。
AI.result: 跨20个锁定重分区（locked repartitions），级联达到89.40%准确率，而8B单独运行仅84.75%，且标准化参数算力仅为0.415。每次运行均通过精确单侧95%风险审计；基于边界（margin）的规则保持约84.8%准确率的同时至少使用0.94的算力。
AI.conclusion: 结论指向一条限定的设计规则：在数据尚不足以支撑拆分之前，应共享评判能力的学习；而领域特定的适配应被放置于经过审计的发布边界（release boundary）之中。即将专业化从权重内转移至路由/信任决策规则，可同时提升准确率、降低算力开销并满足风险审计要求。

title: OPLD: On-Policy Latent Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Interleaved multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves visual reasoning by incorporating auxiliary visual evidence into intermediate reasoning. However, existing approaches remain constrained by externally defined reasoning traces and visual operations, limiting their ability to develop flexible and abstract visual thinking. Reasoning with latent has recently offered a promising direction by internalizing intermediate computation into continuous representations. Nevertheless, existing visual-latent methods mainly supervise latent states through alignment with compressed auxiliary visual features, treating them as proxies for visual observations rather than active reasoning states. Consequently, they capture the provided evidence but fail to fully internalize the abstract reasoning process induced by multimodal CoT. In this paper, we propose OPLD (On-Policy Latent Distillation), a simple framework that transfers the reasoning capability induced by privileged multimodal CoT into latent reasoning representations. Extensive experiments on diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that OPLD consistently outperforms existing latent reasoning methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. The results suggest that supervising latent representations at the reasoning-process level provides a more effective paradigm for multimodal latent reasoning than conventional feature-level alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPLD（On-Policy Latent Distillation）框架，将多模态思维链（CoT）诱导的推理能力蒸馏到潜在推理表示中，在多个多模态基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的交错式多模态CoT受限于外部定义推理轨迹和视觉操作，无法发展灵活抽象的视觉思维。现有的视觉-潜在方法仅通过压缩辅助视觉特征的对齐来监督潜在状态，将其视为视觉观测的代理而非主动推理状态，未能内化多模态CoT引发的抽象推理过程。
AI.method: OPLD（On-Policy Latent Distillation）是一个简单框架，通过在线策略的潜在蒸馏方式，将特权多模态CoT诱导的推理能力迁移到潜在推理表示中。与传统的特征级对齐不同，OPLD在推理过程层面监督潜在表示。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上的大量实验表明，OPLD一致性地优于现有的潜在推理方法，并在多个基准上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 在推理过程层面监督潜在表示比传统特征级对齐为多模态潜在推理提供了更有效的范式。

title: Learning-Augmented and Randomized Algorithms for Line Aggregation with Delays
summary: This paper studies learning-augmented and randomized online aggregation with delays on a line metric. We consider advice given as online suggested service lengths, and evaluate the algorithms in terms of robustness and consistency. For each $λ\in (0,1]$, we first propose a deterministic learning-augmented \textsc{Balance} algorithm that is $(4/λ+1/λ^2)$-robust and $(4+λ)$-consistent. We also propose a randomized algorithm for the problem in the classical adversarial model, which is $(e+1)$-competitive against an oblivious adversary, improving over the deterministic $5$-competitive \textsc{Balance} benchmark~\cite{bienkowski2013chain}. Notably, this competitive ratio is even lower than the lower bound of $4$ for deterministic online algorithms. Moreover, we establish a lower bound of $e$ on the competitive ratio of randomized online algorithms, improving the previous lower bound of $e/(e-1)$. Besides, we combine the two ideas and obtain a randomized learning-augmented algorithm that is $(e/λ+1/λ^2)$-robust and $(e+λ)$-consistent. Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to complement our theoretical analysis and evaluate the empirical performance of our algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线度量空间上带延迟的在线聚合问题，结合学习增强（learning-augmented）与随机化方法。提出了确定性学习增强Balance算法（$(4/λ+1/λ^2)$-鲁棒、$(4+λ)$-一致），以及在经典对抗模型下$(e+1)$-竞争的随机化算法（优于确定性5-竞争基准，且低于确定性算法4的下界）。同时将随机化与学习增强结合，得到$(e/λ+1/λ^2)$-鲁棒、$(e+λ)$-一致的随机化学习增强算法，并通过数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 在线聚合（online aggregation）问题在实际系统中广泛存在，如网络数据聚合和批处理调度等。传统确定性算法存在竞争比下界限制，且缺少利用预测信息来提升性能的手段。本文旨在通过引入学习增强（advice/consistency-robustness框架）和随机化策略，突破确定性算法的性能瓶颈，同时利用预测信息实现更好的实际性能。
AI.method: （1）提出确定性学习增强Balance算法，结合预测建议的服务长度，实现$(4/λ+1/λ^2)$-鲁棒和$(4+λ)$-一致；（2）设计经典对抗模型下的随机化算法，通过概率化决策达到$(e+1)$-竞争比，严格优于确定性5-竞争Balance基准；（3）将随机化与学习增强技术融合，提出随机化学习增强算法，获得$(e/λ+1/λ^2)$-鲁棒和$(e+λ)$-一致；（4）通过数值实验进行实证评估。
AI.result: （1）确定性学习增强Balance算法具有$(4/λ+1/λ^2)$-鲁棒性和$(4+λ)$-一致性；（2）经典对抗模型下随机化算法达到$(e+1)$-竞争比，甚至低于确定性算法4的竞争比下界；（3）建立了随机化在线算法竞争比的下界为$e$，改进了先前$e/(e-1)$的下界；（4）随机化学习增强算法实现$(e/λ+1/λ^2)$-鲁棒和$(e+λ)$-一致；（5）数值实验验证了算法的实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过随机化和学习增强的有机结合，显著提升了线度量上带延迟在线聚合问题的性能上限。随机化策略突破了确定性算法的竞争比下界，而学习增强则使得算法在预测准确时表现优异。本文还改进了随机化算法的理论下界，为后续研究提供了更紧的基准。

title: SKIMIX: Multi-Agent Harness-Time Scaling with Skill Mixture for Dynamic Harness Engineering
summary: AI agents increasingly rely on large skill libraries, but selecting, combining, and maintaining skills remains difficult. We propose SKIMIX, a multi-agent framework in which agents with different skill portfolios collaborate through iterative refinement. SKIMIX combines embedding-based skill retrieval, submodular anti-dilution routing, and adaptive skill evolution. Across six reasoning benchmarks, multi-agent collaboration substantially improves open-ended mathematical reasoning but offers limited or negative gains on multiple-choice tasks. Agent-count scaling is non-monotonic, and most improvements arise during the first refinement round. These results show that task characteristics determine whether skill-level ensembles help and provide practical guidance for scalable agent design.

AI.tldr: SKIMIX是一个多智能体框架，通过嵌入检索、子模反稀释路由和自适应技能进化实现技能库协作。在六个推理基准中显示，多智能体协作显著提升开放式数学推理，但在多项选择任务上收益有限甚至为负；智能体数量扩展呈非单调性，大部分改进集中在第一轮精炼阶段。
AI.motivation: AI智能体越来越依赖大型技能库，但选择、组合和维护这些技能仍然困难，需要一种更有效的协作机制来充分利用技能库。
AI.method: 提出SKIMIX多智能体框架，包含三个核心组件：基于嵌入的技能检索（embedding-based skill retrieval）、子模反稀释路由（submodular anti-dilution routing）以及自适应技能进化（adaptive skill evolution）。智能体持有不同技能组合，通过迭代精炼过程协作。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上，多智能体协作在开放式数学推理中带来显著提升，但在多项选择任务上改进有限甚至为负；智能体数量扩展呈非单调特征，且大部分改进发生在第一轮精炼后。
AI.conclusion: 任务特性决定了技能级集成是否有益，研究为可扩展智能体设计提供了实践指导。

title: Contrastive Concept Importance: Explaining Pairwise Class Decisions Through Automatically Extracted Concept Representations
summary:
Concept-based explanations are a prevalent way to explain the decisions of complex black-box methods through semantically meaningful, human-interpretable concepts. To attribute the contribution of such concepts to a model's decisions, feature attribution methods are used to quantify how strongly each concept contributes to a model output. These attributions are typically computed for a single output class and therefore answer a non-contrastive "why P?" question. In many situations, however, such as cases of misclassification, class confusion, and low-margin predictions, the more natural question to ask is "why P rather than Q?".
  We introduce contrastive concept importance (CCI), which attributes the logit margin between a target class and a contrast, or foil, class to concepts in an automatically extracted visual concept basis. The resulting scores are signed, indicating whether a concept supports the target over the foil or the foil over the target, and can be decomposed into target-logit and foil-logit effects. This makes it possible to distinguish globally important concepts from concepts that specifically influence a class-pair distinction, including whether their effect is shared, one-sided, or directly contrastive.
  We evaluate the method on ImageNet class pairs using CRAFT-style concept bases, insertion and deletion curves, logit-wise decomposition analysis, and semantic class hierarchy. The results show that contrastive concept importance reveals class-pair-specific model behavior that is not captured by ordinary concept importance alone, and that highly contrastive concepts can be evaluated against semantic superclass structure to assess whether they affect fine-grained distinctions rather than broad category evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"对比概念重要性"（CCI）的新方法，用于回答"为什么是P而不是Q？"这一对比性问题，通过将目标类别与对比类别的logit差异归因到自动提取的视觉概念基上，从而揭示模型在类别对区分中的特定行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于概念的归因方法（如特征归因）通常只针对单一输出类别计算概念贡献，回答的是非对比性的"为什么是P？"问题。然而在实际场景中（如误分类、类别混淆、低置信度预测），更自然的提问方式是"为什么是P而不是Q？"，现有方法无法很好地回答这种对比性问题。
AI.method: 该方法（CCI）将目标类别与对比（foil）类别之间的logit差值归因到自动提取的视觉概念基上。生成的分数带有正负号，表示概念是支持目标而非对比类，还是相反；同时可以将分数分解为针对目标logit和对比logit的独立效应，从而区分全局重要概念与特定类别对区分相关的概念，判断其效应是共享、单侧还是直接对比性的。
AI.result: 在ImageNet类别对上使用CRAFT风格的概念基进行评估，通过插入/删除曲线、logit分解分析以及语义类别层次结构验证。结果表明，对比概念重要性能够揭示普通概念重要性无法捕获的类别对特定模型行为，且高对比性的概念可以通过语义超类结构进行验证，以判断其影响的是细粒度区分还是广泛的类别证据。
AI.conclusion: 对比概念重要性能有效回答"为什么是P而不是Q？"的对比性归因问题，弥补了传统单一类别概念归因的不足，为理解模型在类别对之间的决策差异提供了一种更细致、可分解的归因框架。

title: MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware
summary: Multimodal long documents are core carriers of professional knowledge, where critical evidence is sparsely distributed across paragraphs and modalities. This easily causes key information omission and cross-modal hallucinations in summarization by multimodal LLMs. These issues stem from attention drift in long-range dependency modeling and gaps in inter-modal alignment. To address this, we introduce MMLDSum-Bench, a high-quality benchmark for multimodal long-document summarization, covering multiple domains, context-length scales, and visual-textual modality distributions. We further propose MMLDSum-LLM, a reproducible two-stage training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with visual-alignment weighted loss and keyword-aware weighted loss, followed by GRPO with a multi-objective reward (keyword coverage, image-text alignment, ROUGE, and length control). Extensive experiments on MMLDSum-Bench, comparing against leading closed-source and open-source multimodal models under a unified evaluation protocol - including LLM-as-a-judge scoring, atomic-claim precision/recall, image-text alignment (ITA), and ROUGE - demonstrate that our approach significantly improves key-information coverage and cross-modal consistency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MMLDSum-Bench基准和MMLDSum-LLM训练框架，解决多模态长文档摘要中的关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态长文档是专业知识的核心载体，关键证据稀疏分布在段落和模态之间。多模态大语言模型在摘要时容易出现关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉，这些问题源于长距离依赖建模中的注意力漂移和跨模态对齐的差距。
AI.method: 提出MMLDSum-LLM两阶段训练框架：第一阶段采用监督微调，结合视觉对齐加权损失和关键词感知加权损失；第二阶段使用GRPO搭配多目标奖励（关键词覆盖率、图文对齐、ROUGE和长度控制）。同时构建MMLDSum-Bench基准，覆盖多领域、多上下文长度和多模态分布。
AI.result: 在MMLDSum-Bench上与领先的开源和闭源多模态模型进行对比，采用统一评估协议（包括LLM-as-a-judge评分、原子声明精确率/召回率、图文对齐（ITA）和ROUGE），结果证明该方法显著提升了关键信息覆盖率和跨模态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MMLDSum-LLM框架及MMLDSum-Bench基准有效解决了多模态长文档摘要中的关键信息遗漏和跨模态幻觉问题，在关键信息覆盖和跨模态一致性方面取得了显著改进。

title: Think with Extra-Image: A Farmland Segmentation Agent Driven by Spatio-Temporal Information Gain
summary: Existing farmland remote sensing image (FRSI) segmentation follows a "Think with Intra-Image" paradigm, assuming that the current image contains sufficient visual evidence for reliable segmentation. Yet farmland appearance varies with phenology and spatial context and is often confused with other land-cover, making instantaneous, local observations inadequate. Thus, segmentation ambiguity stems not only from limited model representation, but more fundamentally from the required spatio-temporal information lying beyond the current image. Based on this insight, we redefine FRSI segmentation from an information bottleneck perspective as a dynamic decision process driven by task-relevant extra spatio-temporal information gain. We further propose FarmSeeker, a dynamic FRSI segmentation agent that identifies ambiguous regions, reasons about their causes, and queries extra spatio-temporal information on demand for accurate segmentation. To evaluate FarmSeeker, we construct GSFS-Bench, the first global-scale, high-resolution FRSI segmentation benchmark that supports reasoning-querying. Experiments show that FarmSeeker achieves more stable segmentation performance than existing methods. The project is publicly available at: https://withoutocean.github.io/FarmSeeker/

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有农田遥感图像分割采用"图内思考"范式，但农田外观随物候和空间上下文变化，局部单时相观测信息不足导致分割歧义。作者从信息瓶颈视角将分割重新定义为由任务相关的时空信息增益驱动的动态决策过程，提出FarmSeeker动态分割智能体，并构建全球首个支持推理-查询的高分辨率基准GSFS-Bench。实验表明FarmSeeker比现有方法分割更稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有FRSI分割方法依赖单张图像内的视觉证据，但农田外观随物候和空间上下文动态变化，常与其他地物混淆，单时相局部观测缺乏足够的时空信息，导致分割歧义的根本原因在于所需信息超出当前图像范围，而非仅模型表示能力不足。
AI.method: 从信息瓶颈视角将FRSI分割重构为动态决策过程；提出FarmSeeker动态分割智能体，识别模糊区域、推理模糊成因、按需查询额外时空信息以获得准确分割；构建GSFS-Bench全球尺度高分辨率分割基准以支持推理-查询评估。
AI.result: 实验表明FarmSeeker在分割性能上比现有方法更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 将FRSI分割从"图内思考"范式转向动态、多源时空信息按需查询的智能体范式，可有效解决单时相局部观测不足带来的分割歧义问题，为农田分割提供更稳健的解决方案。

title: Class-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Counterfactual Explanation Generation
summary: Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) enhance the interpretability of black-box models by generating alternative instances with adjusted feature values that achieve a contrastive outcome. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising approach for CFE generation, enabling efficient exploration of counterfactual instances while ensuring control over key metrics like validity, sparsity, and proximity. Previous studies have formulated RL states exclusively using features derived from the predictors in the supervised dataset. This study explores the impact of including an instance's predicted class, alongside features derived from the predictors, in the RL state representation for generating CFEs. The hypothesis is that class-awareness enhances exploration efficiency and improves policy optimality. We compare the proposed class-aware RL method with the class-blind RL method, which is similar but excludes the instance's class information from the state representation. The comparison was conducted using seven datasets from diverse domains, varying in size. The results show that during training, class-aware RL offers benefits in terms of convergence speed, reward optimization, and episode length reduction. Moreover, it generates significantly more valid CFEs compared to class-blind RL. Finally, the instance's class-based feature consistently ranks among the most influential predictors in RL's action-selection, as shown by the SHAP and LIME values, underscoring the significance of class-awareness in RL for CFE generation. The impact is heightened clarity, faster learning, improved validity, and more effective counterfactual generation across diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在强化学习（RL）生成反事实解释（CFE）时，将实例的预测类别纳入状态表示的影响。实验证明，类别感知的RL方法在收敛速度、奖励优化、情节长度和CFE有效性方面均优于类别盲的RL方法，且类别特征在动作选择中具有显著影响力。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释（CFE）通过生成替代实例增强黑盒模型的可解释性，强化学习（RL）是一种有效的CFE生成方法。然而，以往研究仅使用监督数据集中的预测变量特征来构建RL状态表示，忽略了实例的预测类别信息。作者假设纳入类别信息可以提高探索效率和策略最优性，因此探索了类别感知的RL状态表示对CFE生成的影响。
AI.method: 提出类别感知的RL方法（class-aware RL），在状态表示中同时包含实例的预测类别和来自预测变量的特征；与排除类别信息的类别盲RL方法（class-blind RL）进行对比。使用7个来自不同领域、规模各异的公开数据集进行实验评估，并通过SHAP和LIME解释工具分析各特征对RL动作选择的相对影响力。
AI.result: 类别感知RL在训练过程中呈现更快的收敛速度、更优的奖励优化和更短的情节长度；生成的CFE在有效性（validity）上显著优于类别盲RL。此外，SHAP和LIME分析表明，实例的类别特征在RL的动作选择中始终位居最有影响力预测因子之列。
AI.conclusion: 将实例的预测类别纳入RL状态表示能显著提升CFE生成的清晰度、学习效率和有效性，支持了类别感知在RL驱动的反事实生成中具有重要价值的观点。

title: MUL-T: Decoding Spatial Cellular Architecture in Multiplexed Tissue Images
summary: Understanding tissue organisation in multiplexed imaging requires modelling both cellular phenotypes and their spatial context. Existing approaches typically rely on handcrafted features, such as marker intensity statistics or cell-type proportions, which often fail to scale or generalise across cohorts with heterogeneous marker panels. We introduce MUL-T, a lightweight transformer framework that reframes tissue architecture as a masked contextual prediction task over discrete cell tokens. By learning contextualised [CLS] embeddings without task-specific supervision, the model captures higher-order cellular interactions while remaining computationally efficient. We evaluate MUL-T on several clinically relevant downstream tasks, including core-level tumour pattern classification, patient-level grading, PD-L1 positivity prediction, and cross-dataset treatment response prediction. Across tasks, MUL-T consistently outperforms classical feature-based baselines and achieves performance comparable to a foundation ViT model, despite substantially fewer parameters and lower training cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUL-T，一种轻量级Transformer框架，将组织架构建模为对离散细胞令牌的掩码上下文预测任务，无需任务特定监督即可学习上下文化[CLS]嵌入，在多个临床下游任务中优于传统基于特征的方法，并以更少的参数量和训练成本达到与基础ViT模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 多路复用成像中的组织结构理解需要同时建模细胞表型及其空间上下文。现有方法依赖手工特征（如标记物强度统计或细胞类型比例），这些方法在异质标记物面板的队列中难以扩展或泛化。
AI.method: 提出MUL-T，一种轻量级Transformer框架，将组织架构重构为对离散细胞令牌的掩码上下文预测任务。模型通过学习无任务特定监督的上下文化[CLS]嵌入，捕获高阶细胞交互，同时保持计算效率。
AI.result: 在核心级肿瘤模式分类、患者级分级、PD-L1阳性预测和跨数据集治疗反应预测等多个临床下游任务中，MUL-T一致优于经典基于特征的基线方法，并以显著更少的参数量和更低的训练成本达到与基础ViT模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: MUL-T有效解决了多路复用成像分析中手工特征方法可扩展性和泛化性不足的问题，通过轻量级框架实现了高效且强大的组织微环境建模，为临床相关预测任务提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Scaling Vision-Language Models Is Not Enough to Mitigate Bias
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are now foundational to multimodal systems, yet their robustness to spurious correlations remains poorly understood at scale. We present the first large-scale empirical study of 194 publicly available VLMs, including 16 model families, covering a wide range of model sizes, 24 training datasets, and three evaluation benchmarks, namely ImageNet (overall performance), CelebA (typical single-attribute bias), and UrbanCars (complex multi-attribute biases). Across these settings, the Spearman correlation between model scale and performance weakens as evaluation shifts from ImageNet ($ρ{=}0.68$) to single-attribute ($ρ{=}0.48$) and further to multi-attribute ($ρ{=}0.05$) bias benchmarks. In contrast, properties of the training data (size and quality) show more consistent relationships with worst-group accuracy across both bias benchmarks. Notably, curated datasets yield improvements of up to 25% over uncurated alternatives at a comparable scale. Finally, the effect of architectural choices (e.g., patch size, image resolution) is highly context-dependent, varying with the nature of the benchmark, including the type of bias and its spatial distribution within images.

AI.tldr: 首次大规模实证研究194个公开VLM，涵盖16个模型家族、24个训练数据集和3个评估基准，发现模型规模与偏置鲁棒性之间的相关性随评估基准从总体性能到单属性再到多属性偏置而显著减弱，而训练数据属性（大小和质量）与最差组准确率的关系更为一致。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）已成为多模态系统的基础，但其对虚假相关性的鲁棒性在大规模范围内仍未得到充分理解。已有研究多为小规模或单一基准，缺乏系统性的跨模型、跨数据、跨基准分析。
AI.method: 对194个公开VLM进行大规模实证研究，涵盖16个模型家族、不同模型规模、24个训练数据集，使用三个基准进行评估：ImageNet（总体性能）、CelebA（典型单属性偏置）和UrbanCars（复杂多属性偏置）。通过Spearman相关性分析模型规模与性能的关系，并对比训练数据属性和架构选择的影响。
AI.result: 模型规模与性能的Spearman相关性从ImageNet的0.68降至单属性偏置的0.48，再降至多属性偏置的0.05。训练数据属性（大小和质量）与最差组准确率在两类偏置基准上均表现出一致关系，其中精选数据集相较于未精选替代方案在相同规模下可提升最多25%的性能。架构选择的影响高度依赖上下文，随基准性质（偏置类型及其空间分布）而变化。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模不能可靠预测偏置鲁棒性，尤其是在多属性偏置场景下；训练数据属性（而非模型规模）是偏置鲁棒性的更一致预测因素；架构选择的影响具有高度情境依赖性，需要根据具体的偏置类型和分布进行针对性考虑。

title: S-CEReBrO: Breaking the Memory Barrier in Continuous EEG Monitoring
comment: This is the pre-rebuttal version of a paper accepted at MICCAI 2026. The camera-ready version will be posted following the embargo
summary: Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis, leveraging generalizable representations from vast unlabeled datasets. Yet, Transformer-based architectures face a critical bottleneck: global attention mechanisms couple the attention memory state to the signal duration, causing memory overflow during continuous monitoring. To address this, we introduce S-CEReBrO (Streaming CEReBrO), an evolution of the CEReBrO architecture designed for continuous monitoring. Our novel Windowed Alternating Attention mechanism factorizes attention computation into fixed-size spatiotemporal windows, guaranteeing constant KV cache memory as only the active window requires resident attention maps. Empirical scaling analysis confirms that windowed alternating attention can process signals 100X longer than full self-attention and 3X longer than low-rank linear attention. Compared to low-rank linear attention on long contexts, windowed alternating attention requires 55% of the memory while increasing inference throughput by 2.1X. Pre-trained on >25,000 hours of recordings from >12,000 subjects, S-CEReBrO achieves state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 11 downstream tasks, with up to 60% fewer parameters. This work represents a significant step toward the realization of efficient, generalizable, and continuous EEG monitoring. An accompanying code repository is available.

AI.tldr: S-CEReBrO是一种基于窗口化交替注意力机制的流式EEG分析架构，通过将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口，保证KV缓存内存恒定，可处理比全自注意力长100倍、比低秩线性注意力长3倍的信号，在超过25,000小时、12,000名受试者的数据上预训练后，在11个下游任务中的7个达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer架构在EEG连续监测中存在关键瓶颈：全局注意力机制将注意力内存状态与信号时长耦合，导致长时间连续监测时内存溢出。为应对这一问题，需要设计适用于流式EEG分析的高效架构。
AI.method: 提出窗口化交替注意力机制（Windowed Alternating Attention），将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口，确保只有当前活跃窗口需要驻留注意力图，从而保证KV缓存内存恒定。该方法是CEReBrO架构的流式演进版本。
AI.result: 经验缩放分析证实窗口化交替注意力可处理比全自注意力长100倍、比低秩线性注意力长3倍的信号；在长上下文中，相比低秩线性注意力仅需55%内存，推理吞吐量提升2.1倍。在>25,000小时、>12,000名受试者的数据上预训练后，S-CEReBrO在11个下游任务中的7个达到SOTA，且参数最多减少60%。
AI.conclusion: S-CEReBrO代表了迈向高效、可泛化且连续的EEG监测的重要一步，并提供了配套的代码仓库。

title: DataClawEval: A Benchmark for Data Engineering Agents in Real Industrial Harness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed to automate complex workflows, promising to revolutionize data management and processing. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on simplified Text-to-SQL translation or data analysis, leaving the critical and complex domain of end-to-end data engineering largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce DataClawEval, the first comprehensive benchmark designed specifically to evaluate the end-to-end task completion capabilities of autonomous agents in real-world data engineering scenarios. Built upon production-grade code authored by professional enterprise data engineers, it comprises 100 rigorous, end-to-end tasks spanning five execution engines: PySpark, MySQL, HiveSQL, PrestoSQL/Trino, and FlinkSQL. Rather than non-deterministic LLM-as-a-judge scoring, each task is executed within a case-specific, isolated sandbox and graded by deterministic, rule-based scripts. Evaluating 16 frontier agents exposes critical limitations: The strongest model attains only 74.9 overall, and no single model dominates, as each excels on a different engine, revealing strict domain specialization rather than omnipotent proficiency. Thus, autonomous data engineering remains a formidable, unresolved challenge. We release our dataset, containerized environments, and deterministic evaluation scripts at https://github.com/Dicemy/DataClawEval/tree/master

AI.tldr: DataClawEval是首个专门评估自主智能体在真实数据工程场景中端到端任务完成能力的综合基准，包含100个跨5种执行引擎的任务，采用确定性规则脚本在隔离沙箱中评估。对16个前沿智能体的评估显示最强模型仅得74.9分，且各模型在不同引擎上表现各异，表明自主数据工程仍是未解决的重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有基准大多聚焦于简化的Text-to-SQL翻译或数据分析，未覆盖端到端数据工程这一关键而复杂的领域，因此需要专门的基准来评估智能体在实际数据工程场景中的任务完成能力。
AI.method: 构建基于企业专业数据工程师编写的生产级代码的基准，包含100个端到端任务，覆盖PySpark、MySQL、HiveSQL、PrestoSQL/Trino和FlinkSQL五种执行引擎。每个任务在特定隔离沙箱中执行，通过确定性规则脚本而非LLM-as-a-judge进行评分。
AI.result: 评估16个前沿智能体，最强模型仅达到74.9的总体得分，且没有单一模型全面占优——每个模型在不同引擎上各有擅长，显示出严格的领域专业化而非全能熟练度。
AI.conclusion: 自主数据工程仍然是一个艰巨且未解决的挑战，现有前沿智能体距离全面的端到端数据工程能力尚有显著差距。

title: FaithEyes: Towards Faithful Tool Use via Multi-Agent Process-Image Verification
summary: Agentic vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave textual reasoning with explicit tool calls such as cropping and code-based image manipulation, have emerged as a compelling paradigm for reliable and interpretable multimodal reasoning. However, recent studies have revealed that such models often use tools unfaithfully. Many process images are irrelevant to the question (e.g., the tool crops the wrong region or misses the queried target), yet the call still receives full credit and the model still answers correctly. Such decorative or misaligned tool calls waste computation and reveal that the model leans on prior knowledge or the original image rather than the evidence it retrieves. This may stem from two limitations of prevailing methods: the tool reward fails to distinguish useful from useless calls, and tool feedback carries no signal of usefulness. To this end, we introduce FaithEyes, a multi-agent self-judging framework. Concretely, we use a VLM to judge whether each process image helps answer the question. The judgement is injected into the reasoning context as part of the tool observation to help subsequent reasoning, and meanwhile is used to scale the tool reward by the helpful-tool ratio to suppress reward hacking. To keep judgement available at evaluation and thus ensure train-test consistency, we further design a multi-agent framework where the model itself serves as a subagent to judge the tool calls from main agent, eliminating any dependence on an external model at inference. Training via a two-stage SFT + RL pipeline on adapted open-source data, FaithEyes attains competitive or superior accuracy across visual perception and reasoning benchmarks, while markedly improving tool faithfulness. The homepage is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/FaithEyes.

AI.tldr: FaithEyes是一个多智能体自判断框架，用于提升智能体视觉语言模型（VLM）工具调用的忠实度。通过VLM判断每个处理图像是否有助于回答问题，将判断注入推理上下文并用于缩放工具奖励以抑制奖励黑客行为，在多个基准上取得有竞争力的准确率并显著提升工具忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体VLM在推理中往往不忠实地使用工具，产生与问题无关的处理图像（如错误裁剪或漏掉目标），却仍获得满分并正确作答。这浪费计算资源，且表明模型依赖先验知识而非检索到的证据。根本原因在于工具奖励无法区分有用和无用的调用，同时工具反馈本身不携带任何有用性信号。
AI.method: FaithEyes采用多智能体自判断框架：一个VLM作为子智能体判断主智能体的每张处理图像是否有助于回答问题，判断结果注入推理上下文作为工具观测的一部分以辅助后续推理；同时用有用工具比例缩放工具奖励以抑制奖励黑客。训练采用两阶段SFT+RL流程，模型在推理时自身作为子智能体进行判断，不依赖外部模型，确保训练测试一致性。
AI.result: 在视觉感知和推理基准上，FaithEyes取得了有竞争力甚至更优的准确率，同时显著提升了工具调用的忠实度。
AI.conclusion: 通过自判断框架注入工具有用性信号并据此调整奖励，可以有效缓解智能体VLM的工具不忠实问题，在不牺牲准确率的情况下提高工具使用的可靠性和可解释性。

title: Exact Action Values Are Not Enough: Rollout-Verified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of a Reasoning Model for Multi-Zone VAV Control
summary: Multi-zone variable-air-volume control must balance thermal comfort, indoor air quality, and electricity use across several continuous actuators. Model predictive control and reinforcement learning are widely studied, but deployment typically requires building-specific modeling or training, limiting scalability. We first test whether a frontier reasoning model (an LLM trained to use additional inference-time computation) can achieve competitive VAV control from text without building-specific training. With that capability established, we then test whether TD3-guided reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) can transfer control knowledge into a locally deployable open-weight model. Five controllers are evaluated over three summer days in a physics-based four-zone emulator. Relative to a Guideline 36-based baseline, TD3 reduced HVAC electricity by 4.5% while improving temperature and CO$_2$ compliance. Without building-specific training, GPT-5 achieved the largest reduction (6.2%) but reduced the ventilation margin. For RFT, deterministic rollouts restore a saved state, apply one candidate, and follow TD3 to score each action. Auditing a learned critic against these rollouts exposed a failure hidden by its near-perfect across-time correlation ($r=0.9998$): within-state ranking was unreliable; the critic selected the rollout-best candidate in only 5 of 10 states. Even with the rollout verifier, 200 RFT steps produced no sustained improvement in sampled-action return; the open-weight controller used more electricity than the baseline before and after training, and its five-minute predictions remained worse than persistence. GPT-5 predicted transitions far better. Exact rollout scores rank sampled actions but reveal neither next-state effects nor an improvement direction. The unchanged transition errors motivate transition-focused supervised fine-tuning before value-based RFT.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多区域变风量（VAV）暖通空调控制的两种路径：一是测试前沿推理LLM（GPT-5）能否无需建筑特定训练实现竞争力控制（节电6.2%但通风余量下降）；二是测试基于TD3的强化微调（RFT）能否将控制知识迁移至可本地部署的开源模型。结果表明RFT效果不佳：学习到的critic在状态内排序不可靠（10个状态中仅5次选出最优rollout动作），200步RFT训练未见持续改进，过渡预测误差未改善。
AI.motivation: 多区域VAV控制需在热舒适、室内空气质量和用电量之间平衡多个连续执行器。模型预测控制和强化学习虽然被广泛研究，但部署通常需要针对具体建筑的建模或训练，限制了可扩展性。作者试图探索无需建筑特定训练的LLM控制能力，以及如何将能力迁移至可本地部署的轻量模型，以解决扩展性问题。
AI.method: 在物理模拟的四区域模拟器中评估五种控制器。首先测试GPT-5（推理型LLM）是否无需建筑特定训练即可实现竞争性VAV控制；随后测试TD3引导的强化微调（RFT）将控制知识迁移至开源权重模型。RFT采用确定性回放：恢复保存状态、应用一个候选动作、跟随TD3为每个动作打分。通过对抗性rollout审计critic，并比较GPT-5与开源模型的过渡预测能力。以Guideline 36为基线，比较三种夏季天气场景下的HVAC用电量、温度及CO2合规性。
AI.result: TD3相对基线减少4.5%的HVAC用电量，同时改善温度和CO2合规性。GPT-5无需建筑特定训练即实现最大节电（6.2%），但牺牲了通风余量。对critic的审计发现尽管其跨时间相关性接近完美（r=0.9998），但状态内排序不可靠，仅10个状态中5次选出rollout最优动作。即使使用rollout验证器，200步RFT也未产生持续的采样动作收益提升；开源控制器训练前后用电量均高于基线，且五分钟后预测劣于持续预测（persistence）。GPT-5的过渡预测显著更优。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：虽然推理型LLM无需建筑特定训练即可实现有竞争力的VAV控制，但值函数引导的RFT微调未能成功将控制知识迁移至开源权重模型。精确的rollout分数虽能对采样动作排序，但既无法揭示下一状态效应，也无法指示改进方向。过渡训练误差的未改善表明，应在基于值函数的RFT之前先进行面向过渡的监督微调。

title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing skill acquisition methods often treat skills as experience summaries, memory entries, or direct summaries of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents: when a student fails because it lacks task knowledge or operational strategy, its failed trajectory may not contain enough evidence to infer the missing behavior, while the teacher trajectory may be too implicit to be internalized as reusable guidance. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates the patch by re-running the student, and iteratively refines the patch when the student still fails. To prevent repeated local updates from causing skill drift, SKILL-KD further maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation, deciding whether each patch should add a new rule, delete or modify an existing rule, or be skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKILL-KD，一种对比技能蒸馏框架，将技能视为不同能力智能体之间的显式蒸馏媒介。通过对比学生失败轨迹与教师成功轨迹，提取可操作的差异并生成文本技能补丁，经重运行验证与迭代优化；同时通过漂移感知技能整合维护可追溯的编辑历史，防止技能漂移。在五个智能体基准和两种学生设置下持续优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能获取方法将技能视为经验摘要、记忆条目或成功示范的直接概括，导致弱学生智能体失败时因其缺乏任务知识或操作策略，失败轨迹不足以推断缺失行为，而教师轨迹过于隐式难以被内化为可复用指导。需要一种将技能作为显式蒸馏媒介的方法来解决不同能力智能体之间的知识传递问题。
AI.method: SKILL-KD包含两个核心组件：(1) 对比技能蒸馏：给定同一任务上的学生失败轨迹和教师轨迹，将两者之间的可操作差异蒸馏为文本技能补丁，通过重新运行学生评估补丁效果，若仍失败则迭代细化补丁；(2) 漂移感知技能整合：维护带轨迹链接的编辑历史，决定每个补丁应添加新规则、删除/修改现有规则还是跳过，以防止重复局部更新导致的技能漂移。
AI.result: 在五个智能体基准和两种学生设置（冻结学生模型）下，SKILL-KD相比固定模型适应基线持续提升了学生智能体的性能。
AI.conclusion: SKILL-KD通过将技能作为显式蒸馏媒介，配合对比式差异提取与漂移感知整合机制，有效实现了不同能力智能体之间可复用知识的传递，验证了该框架在提升弱学生智能体能力方面的有效性。

title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
summary: Egocentric video offers rich manipulation experience for embodied AI, yet collecting diverse egocentric data across scenes, objects, motions, and embodiments remains costly. We present \method, an egocentric world-action simulator that synthesizes controllable, high-quality manipulation videos to expand scarce real-world training data. \method{} builds on a pretrained video generation prior and introduces two geometry-aware conditioning mechanisms. Online Anchored Projective Memory (OAPM) preserves a first-frame 3D scene anchor while periodically refreshing a recent state during autoregressive generation. Action-3D Rotary Position Embedding (A3D-RoPE) encodes end-effector motion with camera-aware 3D rotary coordinates, injecting action geometry into skeleton-to-video cross-attention for precise control. Together, these components improve visual fidelity, geometric stability, and action alignment in long egocentric rollouts. Moreover, augmenting 400 real trajectories with 400 \method-generated trajectories improves out-of-distribution real-robot success from 77\% to 84\% on single-arm tasks and from 53\% to 70\% on dual-arm tasks, demonstrating that the synthesized data substantially improve downstream WAM generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个名为\method的自我中心世界-动作模拟器，用于合成可控的高质量操作视频以扩充稀缺的真实世界训练数据，在单臂任务上将从分布外真实机器人成功率从77%提升至84%，在双臂任务上从53%提升至70%。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视频包含丰富的操作经验，对具身智能体有价值，但在场景、物体、运动方式和本体（embodiment）维度上收集多样化的自我中心数据成本高昂，亟需一种能合成可控、高质量操作视频的方法来扩充稀缺的真实训练数据。
AI.method: \method构建于预训练视频生成先验之上，引入两种几何感知的条件机制：(1) 在线锚定投影记忆（OAPM），在自回归生成过程中保留首帧3D场景锚点并周期性地刷新最近状态；(2) 动作-3D旋转位置编码（A3D-RoPE），以相机感知的3D旋转坐标编码末端执行器运动，将动作几何注入到骨架到视频的交叉注意力中实现精确控制。
AI.result: 提出的两个组件在长自我中心轨迹生成中提升了视觉保真度、几何稳定性和动作对齐度。将400条真实轨迹与400条\method生成的轨迹混合增强后，单臂任务从分布外真实机器人成功率从77%提升至84%，双臂任务从53%提升至70%，表明合成数据显著改善了下游WAM（世界-动作模型）的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: \method通过几何感知的视频生成方法有效扩充了真实操作数据，显著提升了下游世界-动作模型的分布外泛化能力，验证了合成数据在具身智能训练中的实用价值。

title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
summary: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (\textbf{PT-Flow}), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct \textbf{ODEWorld}, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. \href{https://dstate.github.io/odeworld_website/}{Project Website}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PT-Flow，一种在物理时间中学习连续潜速度场的方法，将序列数据动态参数化为潜空间中的常微分方程(ODE)。基于此构建ODEWorld，一个连续时间潜世界模型，通过提取时变特征并强制ODE性质解决表示坍缩问题，支持任意时间分辨率预测、回溯预测以及为下游策略学习提供规划信息，在视频生成和机器人控制任务上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型大多局限于离散时间预测，难以高效捕捉物理世界中时空连续的本质动态，导致建模效率低下。
AI.method: 提出Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow)，在结构良好的表示空间中用ODE参数化序列数据动态。基于PT-Flow构建ODEWorld连续时间潜世界模型：提取时变特征，在动态表示空间和潜速度场上施加ODE约束，使用ODE求解器在压缩潜空间中进行时间积分实现未来预测。
AI.result: ODEWorld有效解决了潜世界模型中的表示坍缩问题，实现高质量长时域预测后的图像重建，支持任意时间分辨率和回溯预测，并在视频生成和机器人控制任务中均表现出色。
AI.conclusion: ODEWorld成功调和了利于规划的动态抽象与视觉真实感之间的矛盾，验证了连续时间世界模型在物理世界建模中的有效性。

title: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD
summary: Automating industrial CAD design and manufacturing places distinctive demands on multimodal foundation models: the model must see engineering drawings and 3D geometry screenshots, write correct parametric-modelling scripts and Windows COM API code, and cover the full range from single parts to assemblies. General-purpose multimodal models fall short on these tasks, while single-task fine-tuning is too narrow to support the diverse calls that upper-layer agents issue. We build IndustryForge-27B on top of Qwen3.5-VL-27B by curating and integrating six industrial-CAD sub-corpora totalling $\sim$52k multimodal samples---CAD Visual QA (CAD-VQA), parametric CAD code (text2cadquery), assembly-level CAD code (text2cadquery-assembly), and three COM sub-corpora for Inventor / SolidWorks (com_2d / com_3d / com_assembly)---and training with a unified multi-task SFT recipe. Across four CAD-domain benchmarks IndustryForge-27B lifts the base model by $+33.65$~pp on average and outperforms the strong closed-source model GPT-5.4 on all four; across eleven general-capability benchmarks it retains, and slightly improves upon, the base model ($+1.56$~pp mean, no catastrophic forgetting). IndustryForge-27B will serve as the common substrate for downstream industrial-agent projects, providing a unified starting point for a full-stack industrial agent that spans from CAD design to industrial-software operation, from parts to assemblies, and from single-shot generation to closed-loop self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IndustryForge-27B，在 Qwen3.5-VL-27B 基础上整合约5.2万条工业CAD多模态样本，通过统一多任务SFT训练，在4个CAD领域基准上平均提升33.65个百分点并全面超越GPT-5.4，同时在11个通用能力基准上保持甚至略微提升，为下游工业智能体提供统一的基础模型。
AI.motivation: 工业CAD设计与制造对多模态基础模型有独特要求：需要同时理解工程图纸和3D几何截图、编写参数化建模脚本和Windows COM API代码、覆盖从零件到装配体的全范围。通用多模态模型在这些任务上表现不足，而单任务微调又过于狭窄，无法支持上层智能体的多样化调用需求。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3.5-VL-27B构建，整合六个工业CAD子语料库（CAD-VQA、text2cadquery、text2cadquery-assembly以及Inventor/SolidWorks的三个COM子语料库），总计约5.2万条多模态样本，使用统一的多任务SFT训练配方进行训练。
AI.result: 在4个CAD领域基准上平均提升33.65个百分点，全部4个基准上超越强闭源模型GPT-5.4；在11个通用能力基准上保持并略微提升基础模型性能（平均+1.56个百分点），无灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: IndustryForge-27B可作为下游工业智能体项目的通用基座，提供覆盖从CAD设计到工业软件操作、从零件到装配体、从单次生成到闭环自我改进的全栈工业智能体的统一起点。

title: Space2Ground 2.0: A Multi-Source Dataset and Framework for Agricultural Monitoring through Fusion of Street-Level and Satellite Imagery
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 45th EARSeL Symposium, Athens, Greece
summary: Accurate and scalable parcel-level agricultural monitoring remains challenging because satellite Earth Observation alone provides only an overhead perspective of agricultural parcels, while optical observations are further affected by cloud-induced temporal gaps. This paper presents Space2Ground 2.0, a multi-source framework integrating Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral time series with geo-tagged street-level imagery acquired using vehicle-mounted cameras and shared through the Mapillary platform. A largely automated processing pipeline performs semantic filtering, image quality assessment, viewpoint-based parcel association, and dataset refinement, transforming large volumes of crowdsourced imagery into parcel-linked, analysis-ready data. Applied over Cyprus during the 2022 growing season, the pipeline produced a curated dataset of 46,050 annotated street-level images, selected from an initial collection exceeding 900,000 images and linked with satellite information for 8,581 agricultural parcels. The practical value of the dataset was assessed through parcel-level crop classification experiments using both single- and multi-source observations. The results demonstrate that street-level imagery provides complementary fine-scale visual information that enhances classification when integrated with satellite time series. Overall, Space2Ground 2.0 provides an openly available benchmark dataset and a reproducible methodology for multimodal agricultural monitoring, with potential applications in visual verification, reduced reliance on costly field inspections, and data-driven agricultural policy implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Space2Ground 2.0框架，将Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2多光谱卫星时间序列与Mapillary众包街景图像整合，实现地块级农业监测。在塞浦路斯2022年生长季验证，从90万+图像中筛选出46,050张标注图像并关联8,581个农业地块，实验表明街景图像补充了卫星观测的细粒度视觉信息，提升了地块级作物分类性能。
AI.motivation: 卫星地球观测仅提供农业地块的俯视视角，且光学观测受云层导致的时间间隙影响，难以实现准确且可扩展的地块级农业监测。需要引入地面视角的多模态数据来补充卫星观测的局限。
AI.method: 构建Space2Ground 2.0多源框架：(1)整合Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2多光谱时间序列与车载摄像头采集并经Mapillary平台共享的地理标记街景图像；(2)采用高度自动化的处理流程，包括语义过滤、图像质量评估、基于视角的地块关联和数据集精炼，将大量众包图像转化为地块关联的分析就绪数据。
AI.result: 在塞浦路斯2022年生长季实验中，从超过90万张初始图像中筛选出46,050张标注的街景图像，并与8,581个农业地块的卫星信息关联。地块级作物分类实验表明，单源和多源观测对比下，街景图像提供了互补的细粒度视觉信息，与卫星时间序列集成时提升了分类性能。
AI.conclusion: Space2Ground 2.0提供了开放可用的基准数据集和可复现的多模态农业监测方法，可应用于视觉验证、减少昂贵的实地巡查依赖以及数据驱动的农业政策实施。

title: Harnessing the Potential of Optimizing Data Mixtures via Bayesian Domain Reweighting
summary: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is fundamentally influenced by the distributional composition of multi-domain pre-training data. While manual heuristics were prevalent in early models, they increasingly fail to capture the intricate synergies between domains as data complexity grows. To overcome the issue, a dominant approach seeks to fit a proxy function mapping between domain weights and their corresponding validation losses, and then find the optimal domain weights to minimize validation losses. These methods rely on strong structural assumptions, such as rank invariance or scaling laws, which are often violated, resulting in non-negligible estimation bias. A promising approach is to directly optimize the weighting scheme from data. However, it suffers from unstable optimization trajectory and prohibitive computational overhead, limiting its potential to search better domain weights configurations. This paper presents a Bayesian domain weighting method to infer the weights from a Dirichlet distribution via introducing Gamma prior information learned from observations. Experimental results demonstrate that proposed method could achieve stable and efficient domain weights learning, and identifies optimal mixtures while consuming substantially less data than search-based function-fitting methods, revitalizing optimization-based domain weighting for large-scale applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于贝叶斯推断的领域权重学习方法，通过引入Gamma先验信息从Dirichlet分布中推断最优的多领域预训练数据混合比例，相比传统基于代理函数拟合和直接搜索的方法，能够以更少的数据消耗实现稳定高效的领域权重学习。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型性能受多领域预训练数据分布构成影响显著，但现有方法存在两大问题：基于代理函数拟合的方法依赖强结构假设（如秩不变性、缩放定律），这些假设常被违反导致估计偏差；而直接优化权重的方法则面临优化轨迹不稳定和计算开销过大的问题。因此需要一种既能避免强假设又能保持稳定高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯领域权重方法——从Dirichlet分布中推断领域权重，通过引入从观测数据中学习的Gamma先验信息来指导推断过程，从而替代了传统代理函数拟合和直接梯度搜索的方式。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够实现稳定且高效的领域权重学习，识别出最优的数据混合比例，同时相比基于搜索的函数拟合方法消耗显著更少的数据量，使基于优化的领域加权方法重新适用于大规模应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯领域权重方法通过引入Gamma先验和Dirichlet分布推断，有效克服了现有方法的估计偏差与优化不稳定性问题，为大规模LLM预训练中的多领域数据混合提供了新的可行方案。

title: SemPIC: Learning Semantic Position-Independent KV Caches
summary: Long-context retrieval and agentic workloads repeatedly reuse the same documents under changing instructions, histories, and document orders. Prefix caching cannot exploit this reuse, while position-independent caching (PIC) remains unreliable because independently compiled KV states lack the future context in which they will be consumed. Our diagnostics show that a learned boundary-conditioned baseline sharply reduces attention deviation near reusable-block boundaries but leaves interior and task-level residuals, motivating adaptation of the document representation itself. We present \emph{SemPIC}, which trains a LoRA-enabled Writer to compile native per-layer document KVs through behavioral distillation while retaining the pretrained decoder as an unchanged Reader. Adaptation is confined to offline cache construction, preserving the standard KV interface and cache-hit decoding path. We further introduce KV Gradient Checkpointing, which reduces peak training memory without severing gradients through cached KVs. Across three models and four tasks, SemPIC raises mean micro-F1 over KV Packet from 0.53 to 0.60, approaching Full Recompute at 0.62.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemPIC，一种通过行为蒸馏训练LoRA启用的Writer来编译原生逐层文档KV缓存的方法，在保留标准KV接口和缓存命中解码路径的同时，解决了长上下文检索和智能体工作负载中前缀缓存和位置无关缓存（PIC）无法可靠复用文档的问题。实验表明SemPIC在三个模型四个任务上将平均micro-F1从0.53提升至0.60，接近全量重计算的0.62。
AI.motivation: 长上下文检索和智能体工作负载中，同一批文档会在不同指令、历史和文档顺序下被反复使用，但前缀缓存无法利用这种复用，位置无关缓存因独立编译的KV状态缺乏未来消费上下文而不可靠。诊断显示学习到的边界条件化基线在可复用块边界附近能显著降低注意力偏差，但内部和任务级残差仍存在，表明需要调整文档表示本身。
AI.method: SemPIC通过行为蒸馏训练一个LoRA启用的Writer来编译原生逐层文档KV，同时保留预训练解码器作为不变的Reader。适应过程仅限离线缓存构建阶段，保持标准KV接口和缓存命中的解码路径不变。此外引入KV梯度检查点（KV Gradient Checkpointing）来降低峰值训练内存，同时不切断通过缓存KV的梯度。
AI.result: 在三个模型和四个任务上，SemPIC将平均micro-F1从KV Packet的0.53提升至0.60，接近全量重计算（Full Recompute）的0.62。
AI.conclusion: SemPIC证明了通过在离线阶段适应文档表示（而非在线解码路径），可以有效提升长上下文复用场景下的缓存可靠性与任务性能，接近全量重计算的效果，同时保持标准KV接口的兼容性。

title: TARS: Timestep-Aware Data Scaling for 3D-Free Video Re-Shooting
summary: Video re-shooting aims to regenerate videos with controllable camera motion and viewpoint. Existing methods rely on explicit 3D priors, which are limited by reconstruction quality and often perform poorly when synthesizing previously unseen regions, or on paired videos with different camera trajectories, whose scarcity hinders generalization. We revisit video re-shooting through text-driven semantic viewpoint specification, enabling control over shot scale, viewing angle, and first-/third-person perspective. To this end, we propose TARS, a 3D-free video re-shooting paradigm. Timestep-wise sensitivity analysis reveals that camera motion is primarily established during high-noise stages, where coarse spatiotemporal structures are formed. Based on this insight, we introduce self-supervised training to learn camera dynamics and fundamental visual representations without paired re-shooting data or 3D reconstruction. Through data scaling and joint textual-camera conditioning, TARS supports robust camera and viewpoint control, plausibly synthesizing regions beyond the source view under large camera motions while enabling reverse-angle re-shooting and perspective switching. Extensive experiments show that TARS provides more accurate and temporally consistent camera control than prior methods. Project Page: https://ymlinfeng.github.io/TARS.github.io/

AI.tldr: TARS提出一种无需3D先验和成对重拍数据的新视频重拍范式，通过时间步敏感度分析发现相机运动主要在高噪声阶段建立，并引入自监督训练学习相机动力学与视觉表征，实现文本驱动的语义化视角控制，支持镜头尺度、视角、第一/三人称切换等控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视频重拍方法依赖显式3D先验（受重建质量限制，合成未见区域效果差）或成对的不同相机轨迹视频（稀缺且限制泛化），缺乏高效可行的控制方案。作者希望寻求一种无3D、无成对数据的新范式。
AI.method: 1) 基于时间步敏感度分析，发现相机运动主要在高噪声阶段（粗粒度时空结构形成阶段）被确立；2) 利用该洞见引入自监督训练，无需成对重拍数据或3D重建即可学习相机动力学和基础视觉表征；3) 通过数据扩展和联合文本-相机条件（textual-camera conditioning），实现鲁棒的相机与视角控制，包括合成源视角之外的区域、反向角度重拍及视角切换。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TARS相比现有方法在相机控制上更精确、时序一致性更强，且在文本驱动语义化视角说明下支持镜头尺度、视角及第一/三人称的控制。
AI.conclusion: TARS验证了无需3D重建与成对数据即可实现高质量视频重拍的可行性，通过自监督训练和文本-相机联合条件为视频重拍提供了新范式，具有良好的泛化性和控制能力。

title: TriShield: Zero-Utility-Loss Defense Against Privacy Backdoors in Federated Language Model Fine-Tuning via Orthogonal Gradient Projection and Optimizer State Entanglement
summary: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enables collaborative training without exposing raw data. However, a recent attack, NeuroImprint [1] (arXiv:2606.20553), demonstrates that a malicious parameter server can corrupt a PEFT adapter into a privacy backdoor: by assigning a dedicated memorization neuron to each training sample and ensuring each neuron updates at most once, the server can analytically reconstruct 59\%--79\% of client training data with high semantic fidelity. Existing defenses---including local differential privacy (LDP) [8] and gradient clipping---either fail against this attack or impose unacceptable utility degradation. We present \textbf{TriShield}, a three-layer deterministic defense that completely prevents NeuroImprint-style reconstruction with \textbf{zero model utility loss} and \textbf{no additional communication rounds}. TriShield consists of: (1) a \textbf{Parameter Artifact Detector} that identifies memory-neuron signatures in distributed model parameters before local training begins; (2) a \textbf{Stateful Virtual Iteration} mechanism that forces Adam/AdamW's momentum state to irreversibly entangle gradients across virtual steps, invalidating NeuroImprint's closed-form inversion; and (3) a \textbf{Zero-Utility Orthogonal Projection} operator that projects all local gradient updates onto the main-task semantic subspace computed via SVD, physically eliminating any gradient components that carry private memorization. We prove theoretically that after Layers 2 and 3, the mutual information between the uploaded gradient and any individual training sample is zero. Experiments on GPT-2 (117M) and Llama-Guard-3-1B verify that TriShield reduces NeuroImprint reconstruction rate to \textbf{0\%} across all tested attack variants, while maintaining or improving training accuracy, with less than 5\% additional GPU computation overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriShield，一个三层确定性防御框架，能够完全阻止联邦微调中NeuroImprint隐私后门攻击，实现零模型效用损失和零额外通信开销。
AI.motivation: 联邦微调LLM虽能避免原始数据泄露，但NeuroImprint攻击表明恶意参数服务器可通过PEFT适配器植入隐私后门，以高保真度重建59%-79%的客户端训练数据。现有防御（如LDP和梯度裁剪）要么无法抵御该攻击，要么导致不可接受的效用退化，亟需一种既不损失模型效用又能彻底阻止此类攻击的防御方案。
AI.method: TriShield由三层防御组成：(1) 参数工件检测器——在本地训练开始前识别分布式模型参数中的记忆神经元签名；(2) 有状态虚拟迭代机制——通过强制Adam/AdamW的动量状态在虚拟步骤间不可逆地纠缠梯度，使NeuroImprint的闭式反转失效；(3) 零效用正交投影算子——通过SVD计算主任务语义子空间，将所有本地梯度更新投影到该子空间，从而物理上消除携带私有记忆的梯度分量。
AI.result: 理论证明在第2、3层之后，上传梯度与任何单个训练样本之间的互信息为零。在GPT-2 (117M)和Llama-Guard-3-1B上的实验表明，TriShield将NeuroImprint在所有测试攻击变体下的重建率降至0%，同时保持或提升训练准确率，额外GPU计算开销小于5%。
AI.conclusion: TriShield提供了一种无效用损失且无额外通信开销的确定性防御方案，能够从理论和实践两个层面彻底阻止NeuroImprint风格的隐私重建攻击，为联邦微调场景下的隐私保护提供了新的解决路径。

title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
summary: Computer-use agents learn from what their actions change, so training one needs applications it can act on, break and reset. The applications that matter most are login-gated and stateful, so synthetic environments stand in for them. Recent pipelines generate such environments in bulk, which moves the bottleneck from how many exist to what is inside each one. The returns, we find, come from three properties: how much behavioural depth an environment carries, whether it targets the interaction an agent actually fails, and whether it improves alongside the model. We present Echoverse, which compiles specifications into stateful applications whose tasks are graded against the application's own database, and a co-evolution loop that reads every graded rollout twice: as repairs to the environment, its tasks and its verifier, and as training signal for the model. Trained on twelve such environments, a 9B model improves from $36.5\%$ to $67.1\%$ across fourteen evaluation splits, within fourteen points of the much larger frontier model that taught it. We examine each property in turn. On the same domains, shallow environments push live-site accuracy below the base model ($80.0 \to 75.0$) while deep ones raise it ($80.0 \to 85.0$ and $48.0 \to 65.0$); drilling one interface control across many renderings transfers to held-out widget families and to the open web; and repairing a single environment lifts the model trained on it from $16.2\%$ to $38.5\%$. The same worlds serve as reinforcement-learning environments, where a reward combining the grounded verifier with a dense per-step judge raises held-out score from $58.8\%$ to $68.0\%$. We release four environments as a benchmark, with their applications, seed data and grounded graders. Code: https://aka.ms/echoverse

AI.tldr: 本文提出Echoverse，一个通过编译规格生成有状态应用程序的环境生成框架，并配套一个共演化循环，用分级回放同时修复环境（任务、验证器）和提供训练信号。在12个环境上训练9B模型，14个评估切分上从36.5%提升到67.1%，达到更大教师模型约14个百分点的差距内。核心发现是环境质量取决于三个属性：行为深度、是否针对智能体实际失败的交互、以及是否能随模型共同改进。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体的训练依赖于可操作、可破坏、可重置的应用环境。真实应用中最重要的通常是登录门控且有状态的应用程序，因此需要使用合成环境替代。虽然现有流水线可以批量生成环境，但瓶颈已从环境数量转移到环境内部的质量——即每个环境承载多少行为深度、是否对智能体真正失败的交互具有针对性、以及是否能够随模型改进而演进。
AI.method: 1) Echoverse：将规格说明编译为有状态应用程序，任务通过应用自身的数据库进行分级（grounded grading）。2) 共演化循环：每次分级回放被读取两次——一次作为对环境的修复信号（包括其任务和验证器），一次作为模型的训练信号。3) 通过受控实验逐一检验三个关键属性：行为深度（shallow vs deep环境）、目标交互的针对性（对单一界面控件跨多种渲染进行drilling）、以及环境修复的效果。4) 同时验证相同的世界可作为强化学习环境，使用grounded verifier与稠密per-step judge的组合奖励。
AI.result: 在12个合成环境上训练的9B模型在14个评估切分上从36.5%提升至67.1%，与更大的教师模型差距在14个百分点以内。浅层环境将实时准确率降到基线之下（80.0→75.0），而深层环境则提升准确率（80.0→85.0和48.0→65.0）。对单一界面控件跨多种渲染的drilling可迁移到未见过的widget族和开放网络。修复单个环境使在该环境上训练的模型从16.2%提升至38.5%。强化学习环境下，结合grounded verifier与稠密per-step judge的奖励将留出集分数从58.8%提升至68.0%。
AI.conclusion: 环境生成的质量维度（行为深度、针对性、共同演进）对计算机使用智能体训练至关重要，Echoverse展示了通过规格编译与共演化循环可以在较小的模型上取得接近大型前沿模型的性能。作者发布了四个环境作为基准，包含应用、种子数据和grounded graders。

title: Theia: Large-Scale Multimodal Captioning and Automated Validation of the Incidents1M Dataset for Data-Free Distillation
summary: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in critical domains like disaster management requires high-quality multimodal datasets, especially for transferring knowledge via Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD). However, existing datasets in this domain either entirely lack descriptive text, such as Incidents1M, or suffer from severe text-image semantic misalignment, such as CrisisMMD. In this work, we present a novel methodology to construct and automatically validate a large-scale multimodal dataset for disaster response. Starting from the vision-only Incidents1M, we successfully recovered 100,000 images and generated high-fidelity textual descriptions using two distinct Qwen3.5 architectures: a 4B dense model and a 35B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model. To ensure the generated captions provide reliable semantic anchoring for DFKD, we introduce an image-blind LLM-as-a-Judge validation pipeline leveraging Qwen3.5-9B. By intentionally obscuring the original image from the judge, this evaluator accurately simulates the modality gap of the student model during data-free distillation. Our evaluation across 173,179 label pairs demonstrates a high semantic agreement (78.65/100) between the two architectures. Furthermore, the automated evaluation reveals a conservative captioning behaviour, characterized by a high Precision (77.6%) and low Recall (46.0%). This minimizes the false positive noise, while simultaneously exposing underlying human annotation inconsistencies in the original ground truth. This work provides a scalable, LLM-validated multimodal dataset and a reproducible framework to advance cross-modal knowledge distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种构建和自动验证大规模多模态灾害响应数据集的方法，从纯视觉的Incidents1M数据集中恢复10万张图像，并使用Qwen3.5系列（4B稠密模型和35B MoE模型）生成高质量文本描述，同时引入一种"图像盲审"的LLM-as-a-Judge验证流程（基于Qwen3.5-9B），通过遮蔽原始图像来模拟学生在数据自由蒸馏（DFKD）中的模态差距。评估结果显示两个架构间具有高语义一致性（78.65/100），并揭示了模型保守式标注行为（高精确率77.6%、低召回率46.0%），在减少假阳性噪声的同时暴露了原始标注中的人类标注不一致性问题。
AI.motivation: 在灾害管理等关键领域部署视觉语言模型（VLM）需要高质量的多模态数据集，尤其对于数据自由知识蒸馏（DFKD）至关重要。然而现有数据集存在严重缺陷：Incidents1M缺少描述文本，CrisisMMD则存在文本-图像语义不对齐问题。因此亟需一种方法构建兼具高质量文本描述和可靠语义标注的大规模多模态数据集。
AI.method: 该方法包括三个核心步骤：(1) 从纯视觉的Incidents1M数据集中恢复100,000张图像；(2) 使用两种Qwen3.5架构（4B稠密模型和35B MoE模型）分别生成高保真文本描述；(3) 引入基于Qwen3.5-9B的图像盲审LLM-as-a-Judge验证管道，通过故意遮蔽原始图像来模拟DFKD中学生模型的模态差距，实现对生成描述语义可靠性的自动验证。
AI.result: 在173,179个标签对上评估显示：两个架构（4B稠密和35B MoE）生成的描述之间具有较高的语义一致性（78.65/100）；自动评估揭示了模型的保守式描述行为，表现为高精确率（77.6%）和低召回率（46.0%），表明模型倾向于减少假阳性噪声，同时该评估也暴露了原始人工标注中存在的标注不一致性问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一种可扩展的、经LLM验证的多模态灾害响应数据集，以及一个可复现的框架，用于推进跨模态知识蒸馏。该工作不仅解决了现有灾害数据集文本缺失或语义不对齐的问题，还通过独特的图像盲审验证机制确保了生成描述对DFKD的语义锚定可靠性。

title: AutoPref: Automatic Discovery of Task-Specific Preference Objectives for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) underpin many real-world decisions, but their exponentially large search spaces make high-quality solutions costly to obtain. Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) learns fast construction policies, typically with reinforcement learning (RL), while preference-based NCO improves sample efficiency by learning from relative solution quality. However, existing preference objectives combine two distinct design choices in manually specified, one-size-fits-all formulations: what learning signal to extract from each solution pair and how to weight each pair relative to the sampled set. We present AutoPref, the first LLM-guided framework for automated preference-objective discovery in NCO. AutoPref factorizes the objective into a pairwise loss program, which defines the learning signal, and a set-aware weighting program, which determines each pair's relative contribution. Their composition forms a unified programmatic objective space containing existing preference objectives as special cases. To make its search tractable, we introduce a staged conditional search strategy with behavioral gates that filter inadmissible programs before short-horizon training and evaluation. Across TSP, CVRP, FFSP, and JSSP, AutoPref consistently outperforms strong hand-designed baselines across problem scales, demonstrating the benefits and scalability of automated objective discovery for NCO.

AI.tldr: AutoPref是首个利用大语言模型(LLM)自动发现神经组合优化(NCO)偏好目标的框架。它将偏好目标分解为成对损失程序和集合感知加权程序，采用分阶段条件搜索策略，在TSP、CVRP、FFSP和JSSP等多个问题上持续超越手工设计的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的偏好目标方法将两个关键设计选择（每个解对中提取什么学习信号，以及每个解对相对于采样集合的权重）以手动指定的一刀切公式组合在一起，缺乏自动化和针对性优化。这种手动设计范式可能无法为不同问题找到最优的偏好目标。
AI.method: AutoPref将偏好目标分解为两个组成部分：成对损失程序（定义学习信号）和集合感知加权程序（决定每个解对的相对贡献），两者组合构成统一的程序化目标空间，现有偏好目标均为其特例。为使其搜索易于处理，引入分阶段条件搜索策略，配合行为门控机制在短时训练和评估前过滤不可行的程序。
AI.result: 在Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP)、Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP)、Flexible Flow Shop Scheduling Problem (FFSP)和Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP)四个问题上，AutoPref在不同问题规模下均一致优于强手工设计的基线方法，展示了自动目标发现对NCO的益处和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: AutoPref验证了通过LLM引导的自动偏好目标发现能够替代手工设计偏好目标，在多个组合优化问题上取得更优性能，且具有跨问题规模的可扩展性，为NCO中的目标函数设计提供了新的自动化范式。

title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch current experience, exceed the policy's capability, or remain path-specific. We propose Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD), which derives capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative guidance from the policy's own verified rollouts. For each prompt, the policy reflects on each verified trajectory in an on-policy group, and a stop-gradient snapshot contrasts the resulting reflections from successful and failed rollouts to construct group-level privileged guidance. Conditioned on this guidance, a self-teacher refines turn-level credit assignment by modulating outcome-based advantages while preserving the verifier-determined learning direction. Experiments across multiple agentic environments and model scales demonstrate that GRSD consistently outperforms competitive baselines and generalizes more effectively to unseen tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分组反思自我蒸馏（GRSD）方法，通过让策略模型对自身的已验证轨迹进行分组反思，并利用停止梯度快照对比成功与失败轨迹的反思结果，构建与策略能力对齐且具有结果区分度的引导信息，用于改进基于可验证奖励的强化学习中的稀疏监督问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLVR框架中，终端奖励只提供粗粒度的轨迹级监督，无法有效区分成功行为、重复错误和偶然选择。现有的代理自我蒸馏方法要么外部检索技能（可能与当前经验不匹配），要么依赖更强模型从单条轨迹提取技能（可能超出策略能力或过于路径特定），因此需要一种从策略自身验证性rollout中提取能力对齐且具有结果区分度引导的方法。
AI.method: GRSD方法包含三个关键组件：(1) 对每个提示，策略对同组（on-policy group）中的每条已验证轨迹进行反思；(2) 使用停止梯度快照对比成功与失败rollout的反思结果，构建组级特权引导（group-level privileged guidance）；(3) 基于该引导，自我教师通过调节基于结果的优势来细化回合级信用分配，同时保持验证器确定的初始学习方向。
AI.result: 在多个智能体环境和多种模型规模上的实验表明，GRSD consistently优于竞争基线，并且对未见任务具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GRSD通过从策略自身验证性rollout中提取能力对齐且结果可区分的引导信息，有效解决了RLVR中终端奖励稀疏、监督粒度粗的问题，在多个环境和模型规模下均展现出一致的性能优势与更强的任务泛化能力。

title: MSCM-net: A hyperspectral image classiffcation method based on multi-scale convolution and Mamba
summary: Hyperspectral imaging is widely used in remote sensing and engineering. Therefore, research on its classification methods is crucial. While CNN and Transformer-based methods have advanced, they still face locality constraints and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose an innovative hyperspectral image classification model, MSCM-net. Specifically, first of all, a model architecture combining multi-scale CNN and Mamba is proposed. It consists of a multi-scale feature extraction module (MCSE) and multiple stacked Mamba blocks, which integrates the local feature extraction capability of multi-scale CNN and the long sequence modeling advantage of Mamba. Secondly, the proposed MCSE module consists of multi-scale convolution and SENet. Convolution kernels of different scales extract local information with different receptive fields, enhancing the fusion of spatial and spectral information. Meanwhile, the SENet enables the model to automatically learn the importance of each channel in the multi-scale features. Furthermore, we also propose a dual-branch feature aggregation module, which further effectively extracts and integrates the spectral information contained in the central pixel and the spatial information in the surrounding pixels. Our model has undergone numerous experiments on three widely used benchmark datasets. The experimental results show that MSCM-net can achieve advanced classification performance while reducing computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSCM-net，一种结合多尺度CNN与Mamba的高光谱图像分类模型。通过多尺度特征提取模块（MCSE，含多尺度卷积与SENet）提取局部特征，Mamba块进行长序列建模，并引入双分支特征聚合模块融合光谱与空间信息，在三个基准数据集上实现了先进分类性能并降低了计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像分类对遥感与工程应用至关重要，但现有CNN和Transformer-based方法分别面临局部性约束和高计算复杂度的局限，需要一种既能有效提取局部与全局特征又具有较低计算开销的分类模型。
AI.method: MSCM-net由三个核心组件构成：（1）多尺度特征提取模块MCSE，使用不同尺度的卷积核提取不同感受野的局部信息以增强空间-光谱特征融合，并通过SENet自动学习各通道重要性；（2）多个堆叠的Mamba块，利用Mamba的长序列建模能力处理高光谱数据的序列特征；（3）双分支特征聚合模块，分别提取中心像素的光谱信息和周围像素的空间信息并进行有效整合。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的高光谱基准数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明MSCM-net在实现先进分类性能的同时降低了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: MSCM-net通过多尺度CNN与Mamba的有机结合，有效平衡了局部特征提取与长序列建模的需求，在分类精度和计算效率之间取得了良好折中，为高光谱图像分类提供了新的解决方案。

title: What Makes Graph Unified? Principles and Generative Sliding-Window Transformer for Graph Foundation Models
