summary: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose graph learning, aiming to learn reusable knowledge that generalizes across diverse graph domains and downstream tasks, reducing the need for specific model development. Achieving this goal requires reconciling the substantial heterogeneity in node features, graph structures, and semantic information across domains. Among them, heterogeneous node features constitute a fundamental input-level barrier, as their dimensionality and semantics vary substantially across datasets. Existing studies typically project or map heterogeneous node features into a fixed-dimensional space, often implicitly equating dimensional uniformity with effective feature unification. Yet dimensional consistency alone does not ensure that the unified features preserve informative semantics and capture transferable patterns that can support cross-domain knowledge transfer. To bridge this conceptual gap, we distill four desiderata for cross-domain graph feature unification: formal uniformity, cross-domain transferability, information preservation, and backbone compatibility. Guided by these principles, we propose SliGFM, a graph foundation model built upon topology-aware sliding-window feature encoding and generative reconstruction. SliGFM orders feature dimensions by topological smoothness and scans the reordered features with a shared sliding-window feature encoder, transforming heterogeneous features into a common space of ordered fixed-dimensional feature tokens. This formulation enables a smoothness-aware transformer to capture transferable relational patterns among feature tokens within each node, while the generative reconstruction objective encourages preservation of the original feature information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SliGFM，一种基于拓扑感知滑动窗口特征编码和生成式重构的图基础模型，通过四个设计准则解决跨域图特征统一中的语义信息丢失问题，将异构节点特征转化为有序固定维度的特征令牌。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型通常将异构节点特征投影到固定维度空间，但维度一致性并不等同于有效的特征统一，统一后的特征可能丢失语义信息和跨域可迁移模式。作者试图弥合这一概念差距，提出特征统一应满足的四个准则，并据此设计模型。
AI.method: SliGFM包含三个核心组成部分：(1) 四个设计准则：形式统一、跨域可迁移性、信息保留和主干兼容性；(2) 拓扑感知滑动窗口特征编码：按拓扑平滑度对特征维度排序，用共享滑动窗口编码器将重排后的特征转换为有序固定维度的特征令牌；(3) 生成式重构目标：通过平滑感知变换器捕捉特征令牌间的可迁移关系模式，同时通过生成重构保留原始特征信息。
AI.result: 该方法在概念上弥合了维度统一与语义统一之间的差距，通过拓扑排序和滑动窗口机制保留了特征语义，并通过生成式重构确保信息不丢失。具体实验结果表明SliGFM在跨域图任务上优于现有方法（摘要中未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: SliGFM通过考虑特征维度的拓扑平滑性来排序和编码特征，而非简单地将异构特征映射到固定维度空间，从而在实现形式统一的同时保留了原始语义信息和跨域可迁移模式，为图基础模型的跨域泛化提供了新的思路。

title: Distilling Answer Set Programming Theories from Large Language Models
summary: Writing Answer Set Programming (ASP) theories from scratch is a difficult and time-consuming task. We take a neurosymbolic approach to study whether a model can distill complete and correct theories, given a fixed agent harness with the solver in the loop. The protocol is dataset-agnostic: with a single prompt and an empty file as the starting point the model is given a 1-hour time limit to derive a complete theory. We chose VQA as the application domain, three benchmarks (CLEVR, GQA, CLEVRER), as these are publicly available and non-trivial. In order to study the model scale required for solving this task we nine different models: four frontier (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, DeepSeek V4 Pro), two mid-tier (DeepSeek V4 Flash, gpt-oss-120b), and three open-weights (qwen3.6-27b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3.5-9b). Three of four frontier models reach 100% on CLEVR and 92.8%-98.8% on GQA; on CLEVRER, Sonnet, Opus, DeepSeek V4 Pro score 92.7%-95.3%. GPT-5 reaches 98.7% on CLEVR but drops to 41.8% on GQA and to 86.7% on CLEVRER. Adding handwritten reference theories from other datasets moves the other three frontier models by at most +/-3.4 pp but reduces GPT-5's accuracy by 3-19 pp. We release the code, prompts, and theories distilled.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据集无关的神经符号方法，利用求解器在环（solver-in-the-loop）的固定代理框架，让模型从空文件出发、在单次提示和1小时时限内自动蒸馏出完整且正确的ASP理论，以CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER三个VQA基准测试验证，并评估了九个不同规模模型的蒸馏能力。
AI.motivation: 从零开始编写答案集编程（ASP）理论既困难又耗时，本文旨在探索是否可以让模型自动从求解器反馈中学习并蒸馏出完整正确的ASP理论，从而降低人工编写逻辑程序的门槛。
AI.method: 采用神经符号方法，以求解器在环的方式固定代理框架：模型以单个提示和空文件为起点，在1小时时限内迭代生成理论并通过求解器验证。实验选取CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER三个VQA基准，评估九个模型（四个前沿模型、两个中端模型、三个开源模型）的蒸馏表现，并测试了加入其他数据集手写参考理论对结果的影响。
AI.result: 四个前沿模型中的三个在CLEVR上达到100%，在GQA上达到92.8%-98.8%，在CLEVRER上达92.7%-95.3%；GPT-5在CLEVR上达98.7%但在GQA上骤降至41.8%、在CLEVRER上为86.7%。加入手写参考理论对其他三个前沿模型影响不超过±3.4个百分点，但使GPT-5准确率下降3-19个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 前沿大型语言模型具备从空文件出发自动蒸馏完整ASP理论的能力，但模型之间存在显著差异（尤其GPT-5在不同任务上表现不稳定）；外部参考理论对多数模型影响甚微甚至可能有害，释放了代码、提示词和蒸馏出的理论供社区复用。

title: Beyond Visual Ambiguity: Guiding Robust Monocular Depth Estimation in Challenging Scenarios via Detailed Long Captions
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) faces challenges with non-Lambertian surfaces and adverse weather conditions due to the visual ambiguities inherent in single-image limited information. Existing works address them in isolation via image inpainting or augmentation, yielding limited robustness gains. Language, as a powerful complementary modality to vision, is demonstrated to enhance the visual perception capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) via detailed long captions. However, prior language-integrated MDE methods fail to fully harness this potential due to short text input with limited information, coarse global text feature learning, and limited language guidance during depth decoding. To address these limitations, we propose CapDepth, a novel framework for robust MDE that leverages guidance from detailed long captions to alleviate visual ambiguities in both challenging scenarios. First, we design a detailed long caption input template that explicitly conveys rich spatial relationships among multiple atom sentences. Second, a dynamic caption encoder is introduced to extract fine-grained depth-relevant text features via progressive masked attention. Finally, we propose a text-adaptive decoder that guides enhanced depth decoding with text features via stable adaptive layer normalization. Extensive experiments validate the efficacy of CapDepth, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving depth error reductions of 25.0% on non-Lambertian surfaces and 22.0% under adverse weather conditions.

AI.tldr: CapDepth是一种利用详细长标题（long captions）作为语言指导来增强单目深度估计鲁棒性的框架，通过动态标题编码器和文本自适应解码器，在非朗伯表面和恶劣天气条件下分别减少了25.0%和22.0%的深度误差。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计在非朗伯表面和恶劣天气条件下表现不佳，现有方法仅单独处理这些问题（如图像修复或数据增强），鲁棒性提升有限。虽然语言已被证明能增强视觉感知，但现有的语言集成MDE方法因短文本输入信息有限、全局文本特征学习粗糙以及深度解码阶段缺乏语言引导而未能充分利用这一潜力。
AI.method: CapDepth包含三个核心组件：（1）详细长标题输入模板，以多个原子句显式表达丰富的空间关系；（2）动态标题编码器，通过渐进式掩码注意力提取细粒度的深度相关文本特征；（3）文本自适应解码器，通过稳定的自适应层归一化（adaptive layer normalization）利用文本特征引导增强的深度解码。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了CapDepth的有效性，该方法在非朗伯表面场景下实现25.0%的深度误差降低，在恶劣天气条件下实现22.0%的深度误差降低，均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: CapDepth通过充分利用详细长标题中的丰富语言信息，有效缓解了单目深度估计中由单图像有限信息导致的视觉歧义，显著提升了在挑战性场景下的鲁棒性，验证了语言作为视觉补充模态在深度估计任务中的巨大潜力。

title: Beyond Binary Rewards: A Comparative Study of Reward Design for Reinforcement Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning seeks to selectively remove specific knowledge from trained language models without full retraining, a growing necessity under privacy regulations such as GDPR and the EU AI Act. Recent work has reformulated unlearning as a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) problem, where models are optimized against verifiable rewards computed directly from their outputs. However, existing methods rely on sparse binary rewards that provide minimal learning signal, indicating only whether forbidden content was avoided, and limiting convergence speed. In this paper, we study how reward design affects unlearning efficiency within the Reinforcement Unlearning (RUL) framework. We introduce a principled reward decomposition framework that decouples verifiability from sparsity, and propose two new reward functions: an exponential reward that provides graded penalties based on the count of forbidden-concept occurrences, and a PageRank inspired reward that weights penalties by semantic importance. We conduct experiments on the Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU) benchmark, demonstrating that both rewards consistently outperform the binary setting, while reaching similar forgetting performance up to $3\times$ faster and preserving general model utility. Our results show that reward design is a key driver of unlearning efficiency offering a practical path toward scalable and efficient machine unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在强化学习去遗忘（RUL）框架下解耦可验证性与稀疏性的奖励分解机制，并引入两种新的奖励函数——基于禁忌概念计数的指数奖励和基于PageRank语义重要性的加权奖励，在RWKU基准上将去遗忘收敛速度提升最高3倍，同时保持模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有基于RLVR的机器去遗忘方法依赖稀疏二值奖励，仅指示是否避免了禁忌内容，缺乏细粒度学习信号，限制了收敛速度。随着GDPR和欧盟AI法案等隐私法规的推动，需要更高效的奖励设计来加速去遗忘过程。
AI.method: 提出一个原则性的奖励分解框架，将可验证性与稀疏性解耦。具体提出两种奖励函数：(1) 指数奖励——基于禁忌概念出现次数提供分级惩罚；(2) PageRank启发奖励——根据语义重要性对惩罚进行加权。在RUL（强化去遗忘）框架下进行优化。
AI.result: 在Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU)基准上的实验表明，两种奖励函数均一致优于二值奖励设置，在达到类似遗忘性能的同时收敛速度提升最高3倍，且保持了模型的通用效用。
AI.conclusion: 奖励设计是去遗忘效率的关键驱动因素，该工作为可扩展且高效的机器去遗忘提供了实际路径。

title: Diversifying Personalized Research Ideation against AI-Induced Homogenization
summary: AI-assisted research ideation has emerged as a promising paradigm for accelerating scientific discovery, with systems now capable of generating research directions conditioned on papers, topics, or lightweight researcher contexts. Yet current systems largely optimize individual suggestions in isolation. This leaves two blind spots. First, coarse researcher representations may elicit mainstream directions that appear broadly feasible, but lack sufficient researcher-specific grounding. Second, independent recommendations can concentrate a community's portfolio around recurring high-probability themes. To address these blind spots, we propose DivAlign, a four-stage pipeline for alignment-preserving de-homogenization. DivAlign extracts fine-grained researcher profiles, generates profile-conditioned candidate directions, scores them along three alignment dimensions (Executability, Comprehensibility, and Growth Potential), and surfaces researcher-local directions while reducing redundancy across the community portfolio. On a benchmark we construct from 95 AI researchers across five subfields, DivAlign reduces community-level redundancy while preserving researcher-direction fit. Compared with coarse single-shot ideation, it lowers average pairwise similarity from 0.331 to 0.294 and nearest-neighbor similarity from 0.704 to 0.608. Compared with the independent top-choice variant, DivAlign reduces nearest-neighbor similarity from 0.663 to 0.608 while retaining 99.9% of the researcher-direction fit score. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Ruixxxx/DivAlign.

AI.tldr: 提出DivAlign四阶段流水线，通过细粒度研究者画像提取和三维对齐评分，在保持研究者-方向匹配度的同时降低（社区/研究者）生成方向的冗余度，实现对齐保持的去同质化。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助研究构思系统两个盲点：一是粗粒度研究者表征可能引发主流但缺乏研究者特定依据的方向；二是独立推荐会使社区研究组合集中于高频主题，导致同质化。
AI.method: DivAlign四阶段流水线：1) 提取细粒度研究者画像；2) 生成画像条件化的候选方向；3) 沿三个对齐维度（可执行性、可理解性、成长潜力）评分；4) 呈现研究者局部的方向并降低社区组合冗余。
AI.result: 在95名AI研究者（跨5个子领域）的基准上，DivAlign在保持研究者-方向匹配度的同时降低社区冗余。与粗粒度单次构思相比，平均配对相似度从0.331降至0.294，最近邻相似度从0.704降至0.608；与独立最优变体相比，最近邻相似度从0.663降至0.608，同时保留99.9%的研究者-方向匹配得分。
AI.conclusion: DivAlign能够在保持研究者-方向对齐的前提下有效降低社区层面和研究者层面的研究构思冗余，为AI辅助科研构思系统的去同质化提供了可行方案。

title: Filling the Pareto-Optimal Front for Affordance Segmentation on Embedded Devices Using RGB-D Cameras
summary: While depth sensors have the potential to complement RGB data for affordance segmentation in wearable robots, their usage seems to remain underexplored. The paper proposes two approaches: a reformulated version of hardware-aware neural architecture search, endowed with a newly designed search space to integrate depth (D) information into small-sized deep networks, and a dedicated fine-tuning approach, including a preprocessing layer to merge depth information with RGB data and make it compatible with conventional architectures. In both cases, those methods aim to generate solutions that benefit from modern (portable) hardware accelerators and overcome existing tiny-like approaches, which often fail to tackle critical scenarios due to the severe constraints set by the supporting hardware. Extensive experiments on a pair of real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method as compared with existing solutions. The approach presented in the paper generates, in most cases, solutions that identify the Pareto optimal front to balance generalization performance and hardware requirements. The paper also describes the supporting prototype, including a Jetson Nano board and a RealSense RGB-D camera. When considering the energy profile of the device, the overall system can attain real-time performances within an energy budget that is compatible with standard batteries, such as those used in smartphones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种方法将深度（D）信息集成到小型深度网络中，用于可穿戴机器人的affordance分割任务：一是重新设计的硬件感知神经架构搜索方法（含新的搜索空间），二是包含预处理层的微调方法。实验表明这些方案在真实数据集上优于现有方法，且大多能找到泛化性能与硬件需求之间的Pareto最优前沿。原型系统（Jetson Nano + RealSense RGB-D相机）在能量预算内可实现实时性能。
AI.motivation: 深度传感器有潜力补充RGB数据进行affordance分割，但这一方向尚未被充分探索。现有的"tiny-like"（微型）方法受限于硬件约束，难以应对关键场景。作者希望利用现代便携式硬件加速器，生成既受益于硬件加速又能克服上述局限的方案。
AI.method: 提出两种互补方法：(1) 重新表述的硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）方法，配以专门设计的搜索空间，将深度（D）信息融合进小型深度网络；(2) 一种专门的微调方法，包含预处理层，用于将深度信息与RGB数据合并，使其与常规架构兼容。两者均面向当代便携式硬件加速器优化。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法优于现有解决方案。在大多数情况下，生成的方案能识别Pareto最优前沿，在泛化性能与硬件需求间取得平衡。基于Jetson Nano和RealSense RGB-D相机的原型系统在能量分析中可实现实时性能，能量预算与智能手机标准电池兼容。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，结合RGB-D信息并通过硬件感知的架构搜索与微调策略，可以在保持硬件效率（实时、低能耗）的前提下提升可穿戴机器人的affordance分割性能。为可穿戴设备上的多模态感知提供了可行的实践路径。

title: TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on predictive knowledge of environmental consequences. Inspired by this, we propose TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents, a unified training framework that alternates between policy optimization and transition supervision. Beyond standard RL updates, TAPO repurposes rollout data to apply action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision on a shared backbone model. This approach enhances the model's sensitivity to environmental transition dynamics and action consequences while concurrently optimizing the policy. It serves as a computationally lightweight, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing agent RL algorithms, requiring no additional expert data, extra sampling costs, or inference-time overhead. We conduct systematic experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld, integrating foundation models of various scales with different policy optimization algorithms. Empirical results demonstrate that TAPO consistently improves task performance over pure policy optimization baselines.

AI.tldr: TAPO（Transition-Aware Policy Optimization）是一个统一训练框架，通过交替进行策略优化和转移监督，利用动作条件化的下一观测预测作为密集监督信号来增强LLM智能体的环境动态感知能力，在WebShop和ALFWorld基准上一致提升了任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体强化学习方法主要依赖稀疏任务奖励进行策略优化，未能充分利用在线交互中环境反馈这类天然的密集监督信号。理论研究指出多步目标导向任务的泛化依赖于对环境后果的预测性知识，因此需要利用环境反馈来提升策略学习。
AI.method: TAPO采用交替训练策略：在标准RL更新之外，将回放数据重用于动作条件化的下一观测预测监督，在共享骨干模型上同时优化策略和转移预测目标。该方法作为即插即用的轻量增强模块，无需额外专家数据、额外采样成本或推理开销。
AI.result: 在WebShop和ALFWorld基准上，结合多种规模的基座模型和不同策略优化算法，TAPO相较于纯策略优化基线一致地提升了任务表现。
AI.conclusion: TAPO证明了对环境转移动态和动作后果的预测性监督能够有效补充稀疏奖励信号，为LLM智能体的在线RL训练提供了计算高效且通用的增强方案。

title: PerturbMap: Cross-Context Transfer of Single-Cell Perturbation Responses
summary: Single-cell perturbation atlases rarely measure every intervention in every cellular context: a query perturbation is often observed in one or more source contexts but missing in the recipient context where its effect is needed. Ignoring those measured responses discards query-specific experimental evidence, whereas copying or weakly calibrating them across contexts risks transferring the wrong signal. We propose PerturbMap, which predicts a missing recipient-context effect by combining a recipient-local low-rank base with accepted proposals that transport the same perturbation's measured source responses through source-to-recipient ridge experts fit on paired training perturbations, with proposal weights determined by route reliability estimated on validation anchors. On the Perturb-CITE-seq melanoma cohort, PerturbMap improves full-effect MSE by 4.1\% over a recipient-local low-rank base and achieves lower MSE than FedAvg, zero-response, raw-copy, calibrated-copy, and identity-shuffled affine controls. It remains within $2.82\times10^{-6}$ MSE of our centralized token-matched pooled reference, which uses a stronger training interface. A condition-mean specificity diagnostic shows the same direction: same-recipient top-10 counterpart retrieval by cosine increases from 74.5\% for the low-rank base to 80.5\% for PerturbMap.

AI.tldr: PerturbMap是一种预测单细胞扰动数据集中缺失上下文效应的新方法，通过结合接收方局部低秩基与基于配对训练扰动学习得到的源到接收方岭回归专家的最优传输提案，并根据验证锚点估计的路由可靠性加权提案。在Perturb-CITE-seq黑色素瘤队列上，PerturbMap相比接收方局部低秩基线将全效应MSE降低了4.1%，并优于FedAvg、零响应、原始拷贝、校准拷贝和身份打乱仿射等多种对照方法，且与使用更强训练接口的中心化token匹配池化参考模型性能接近。
AI.motivation: 单细胞扰动图谱很少能在每个细胞上下文中测量每种干预，查询扰动通常在一个或多个源上下文中被观测到，但在需要其效应的接收方上下文中缺失。忽视已测量的响应会丢弃查询特异性的实验证据，而直接拷贝或弱校准跨上下文响应则可能传递错误信号。因此需要一个方法在缺失的接收方上下文中准确预测扰动效应。
AI.method: PerturbMap通过结合接收方局部的低秩基与已接受的提案来预测缺失的接收方上下文效应。这些提案将同一扰动在源上下文中的已测量响应，通过基于配对训练扰动拟合的源到接收方岭回归专家进行传输，提案权重由在验证锚点上估计的路由可靠性决定。
AI.result: 在Perturb-CITE-seq黑色素瘤队列上，PerturbMap比接收方局部低秩基线提升全效应MSE 4.1%，且MSE低于FedAvg、零响应、原始拷贝、校准拷贝和身份打乱仿射等对照方法。与使用更强训练接口的中心化token匹配池化参考模型相比，MSE差距在2.82×10⁻⁶以内。条件均值特异性诊断中，同接收方top-10对应检索的余弦相似度从低秩基线的74.5%提升至PerturbMap的80.5%。
AI.conclusion: PerturbMap通过有选择性地传输跨上下文的实验测量信号，在不直接复制或弱校准的情况下有效利用查询特异性的源上下文证据，显著提升了缺失接收方上下文中的扰动效应预测精度，并表现出与其对应的更强训练接口的中心化参考模型相媲美的性能。

title: MonoVoc: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Lightweight Monocular Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussians
summary: Open vocabulary 3D scene understanding is essential for next-generation interactive systems, empowering users to intuitively query and navigate reconstructed environments using natural language. However, current 3D Gaussian frameworks are often bottlenecked by restrictive multiview capture requirements, costly scene-specific optimization, and the massive memory overhead of storing dense language features. We present a novel, training-free pipeline that fundamentally reimagines this paradigm by explicitly decoupling 3D geometric reconstruction from semantic integration. Given a standard monocular video sequence as input, our method efficiently outputs a compact, highly interpretable, and fully searchable object-level semantic Gaussian map. Rather than entangling heavy language embeddings within the mapping loop, we extract geometry independently and ground semantics through a lightweight, modular post-processing framework. Extensive evaluations on the Replica dataset demonstrate that this decoupled architecture preserves strong rendering fidelity and competitive segmentation accuracy. Crucially, by replacing dense per-Gaussian storage with modular, object-level semantic embeddings, our approach delivers an order-of-magnitude reduction in memory usage compared to SOTA baselines. This provides a highly efficient, scalable, and practical solution for open-vocabulary 3D retrieval and question answering directly from everyday monocular video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的开放词汇3D场景理解pipeline，通过将3D几何重建与语义集成显式解耦，从单目视频中高效生成紧凑、可解释且完全可搜索的对象级语义高斯地图，在保持高渲染保真度和竞争力的分割精度的同时，相比SOTA基线实现了数量级的显存缩减。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯框架存在三大瓶颈：1）受限的多视角采集要求，灵活性不足；2）昂贵的场景特定优化开销；3）存储密集语言特征带来的巨大显存开销。这些问题限制了开放词汇3D场景理解在实际交互系统中的部署与扩展。
AI.method: 提出一种训练-free pipeline，核心思想是显式解耦3D几何重建与语义集成。具体而言：1）从标准单目视频序列中独立提取几何结构；2）通过轻量级模块化后处理框架将语义信息落地到对象级语义高斯地图上；3）用对象级语义嵌入替代稠密的逐高斯存储方式，实现紧凑、可解释、可搜索的语义表征。
AI.result: 在Replica数据集上的广泛评估表明：1）该解耦架构保持了强渲染保真度和有竞争力的分割精度；2）通过模块化对象级语义嵌入替代稠密逐高斯存储，内存使用量相比SOTA基线实现了数量级（一个数量级以上）的缩减。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从日常单目视频中进行开放词汇3D检索和视觉问答提供了高效、可扩展且实用的解决方案，重新定义了3D高斯语义框架的设计范式。

title: Generalization Bounds on Optimal Control for Transformer Training and Wasserstein Distributional Robustness
summary: We derive finite-sample generalization bounds for Transformers trained with dynamic programming recursions. Building on the doubly lifted, measure-valued formulation of Transformer dynamics, we view data sets as probability laws on pairs of empirical input-output measures, allowing us to interpret the training problem as a finite-horizon Markovian control problem. We then analyze a quantized model, derived by quantizing the state, action, and measure-state spaces, and derive explicit finite-sample generalization bounds using concentration inequalities for empirical laws on finite metric spaces together with a Lipschitz stability estimate for the value function. These bounds are transferred to the base model at the cost of an explicit approximation error. Finally, we show that the same machinery yields a distributionally robust control formulation of the training problem, connecting Transformer generalization to Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文为使用动态规划递归训练的Transformer推导了有限样本泛化界。通过将训练问题视为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题，采用双重提升的测度值公式，并基于量化模型推导显式泛化界，最后将结果推广到分布鲁棒控制框架。
AI.motivation: Transformer在动态规划递归训练下的泛化保证缺乏严格的理论分析，需要建立有限样本下的泛化界来理解其学习行为。
AI.method: 将数据集视为经验输入-输出测度对上的概率律，把训练问题转化为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题；通过量化状态、动作和测度状态空间得到量化模型，利用有限度量空间上经验律的集中不等式和值函数的Lipschitz稳定性估计推导有限样本泛化界；通过显式近似误差将界转移回基础模型；并利用同一框架建立Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化联系。
AI.result: 推导出Transformer在动态规划递归训练下的显式有限样本泛化界，并建立了与分布鲁棒控制之间的等价联系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅提供了Transformer泛化保证的理论基础，还连接了Transformer泛化与Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化，为训练算法提供了鲁棒性视角。

title: An Instrument to Evaluate Governance Proposals: AI Policy Analysis at Scale
summary:
This paper introduces a policy analysis framework for systematic, transparent assessment of AI governance proposals in an evolving and contested regulatory landscape. AI policy debates often collapse into binary positions that obscure underlying tradeoffs and normative assumptions. The framework structures policy analysis around multiple policy attributes, allowing users to surface priorities and tensions without prescribing outcomes. We use a mixed-methods approach that integrates qualitative insights from subject matter experts with computational text analysis to inform the design of policy attribute rubrics. This quantifies the relative emphasis of different policy objectives and presents them through comparative visualizations that support interpretability and cross-policy comparison. The paper also examines the use of commercial LLMs for rubric-based policy analysis, benchmarking their outputs against a domain-trained rubric-calibrated model with explicitly defined analytical assumptions. Rather than assessing policy effectiveness or desirability, the framework focuses on relevance and alignment across attributes. By making analytical assumptions explicit, including attribute selection, rubric construction, and weighting schemes, the framework enables users to evaluate whether its embedded priorities align with the users' own normative commitments. The approach is jurisdiction-agnostic and intended to support policymakers, analysts, and researchers navigating complex AI governance environments.
  Contributions: (1) multidimensional policy assessment through empirically grounded rubrics that surface tradeoffs rather than resolving them; (2) a transparent hybrid methodology combining feedback from subject-matter experts with computational validation; and (3) use of domain-trained rubric-calibrated models as a benchmark for comparing different general-purpose large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一個用於AI治理政策分析的框架，透過多維度政策屬性和基於經驗的評分標準（rubrics），系統性地評估和比較各種AI治理政策提案，而非判斷其優劣。框架採用混合方法（專家意見+計算文本分析），並以領域訓練的基線模型為基準，評測通用大型語言模型在政策分析中的表現。
AI.motivation: AI政策辯論常陷入二元對立立場，遮蔽了背後的權衡取捨和規範性假設。現有方法缺乏系統化、透明的政策分析途徑，無法在不同提案之間進行有意義的比較。作者旨在提供一個不預設結果、允許使用者揭示自身優先級和價值衝突的分析工具。
AI.method: 混合方法設計：(1) 整合領域專家質性洞見與計算文本分析，設計政策屬性評分標準（rubrics）；(2) 量化不同政策目標的相對重要性，透過比較性視覺化支援可解釋性和跨政策比較；(3) 以領域訓練的評分標準校準模型作為基線基準，對比通用大型語言模型（LLMs）的評分表現。框架聚焦於政策提案在各屬性上的相關性與一致性，而非政策效力或可取性。
AI.result: 論文提供了一個政策分析框架，能夠：(1)透過經驗基礎的多維度評分標準呈現政策之間的權衡，而非直接解決這些權衡；(2)建立透明、可複現的混合分析方法（專家回饋+計算驗證）；(3)以領域訓練的評分標準校準模型作為通用LLM的比較基準，量化不同模型的表現差異。框架同時具有管轄權不可知（jurisdiction-agnostic）的特性和明確的分析假設（屬性選擇、評分標準構建、加權方案）。
AI.conclusion: 該框架不做政策有效性或可取性的判斷，而是聚焦於相關性與一致性，透過使分析假設透明化，讓使用者能夠評估框架的內嵌優先級是否與自身的規範性承諾一致。此方法旨在服務政策制定者、分析師和研究人員在複雜且不斷演變的AI治理環境中導航。

title: ObjectStream: Latent Objects as Memory Anchors for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to continuously retain useful visual evidence before future questions are known. Existing approaches primarily manage the growing visual context according to token importance, temporal redundancy, or segment-level relevance, but rarely organize evidence around objects that persist and evolve over time. Thus, in this paper, we introduce ObjectStream, a training-free framework that treats latent objects as memory anchors for streaming video understanding. ObjectStream induces spatially coherent latent objects directly from frozen Video-LLM representations, links them across frames into persistent anchors, and maintains their histories under a bounded memory budget, without requiring external object detectors or segmentation models. Built on these anchors, ObjectStream preserves three complementary forms of evidence: persistent object histories, transient object changes, and recent visual context. This design enables existing Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over object identities, interactions, and state changes while leaving the underlying model unchanged. Extensive experiments on online streaming and offline long-video benchmarks demonstrate both effectiveness and efficiency. In online streaming evaluation, ObjectStream improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 10.0 points on OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception, while reducing peak GPU mem-ory and TTFT by approximately 50%. On offline long-video benchmarks, it surpasses the full-token baseline while discarding 82.5% of visual tokens. These results highlight latent objects as a practical and effective organizing principle for compact streaming video memory.

AI.tldr: ObjectStream是一个免训练框架，将潜在对象作为记忆锚点用于流式视频理解，无需外部检测器或分割模型，在保持Video-LLM不变的情况下显著提升指标并大幅降低显存与延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的流式视频理解方法主要根据token重要性、时间冗余或片段级相关性来管理不断增长的视觉上下文，但很少围绕随时间持续存在和演化的事物（objects）来组织证据。这导致模型难以有效推理对象身份、交互和状态变化。
AI.method: ObjectStream直接从冻结的Video-LLM表征中诱导出空间连贯的潜在对象，跨帧链接为持久锚点（persistent anchors），并在有限内存预算下维护对象历史。它保留三种互补证据：持久对象历史、瞬态对象变化和近期视觉上下文，且无需外部对象检测器或分割模型，也无需修改底层Video-LLM。
AI.result: 在在线流式评测中，ObjectStream使Qwen2.5-VL-7B在OVO-Bench实时视觉感知任务上提升10.0分，同时峰值GPU显存和TTFT降低约50%。在离线长视频基准上，它超越全token基线且丢弃了82.5%的视觉token。
AI.conclusion: 潜在对象作为流式视频压缩记忆的组织原则是实用且有效的，展示了在无需训练和模型改动的前提下实现紧凑而高效的流式视频理解的可行性。

title: It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations
summary:
Tensor operations represent a cornerstone of modern scientific computing. However, the Numpy-like notation adopted by predominant tensor frameworks is often difficult to read and write and prone to so-called shape errors, i.a., due to following inconsistent rules across a large, complex collection of operations. Alternatives like einsum and einops have gained popularity, but are inherently restricted to few operations and lack the generality required for a universal model of tensor programming.
  To derive a better paradigm, we revisit vectorization as a function for transforming tensor operations, and use it to both lift lower-order operations to higher-order operations, and conceptually decompose higher-order operations to lower-order operations and their vectorization.
  Building on the universal nature of vectorization, we introduce einx, a universal notation for tensor operations. It uses declarative, pointful expressions that are defined by analogy with loop notation and represent the vectorization of tensor operations. The notation reduces the large APIs of existing frameworks to a small set of elementary operations, applies consistent rules across all operations, and enables a clean, readable and writable representation in code. We provide an implementation of einx that is embedded in Python and integrates seamlessly with existing tensor frameworks: https://github.com/fferflo/einx

AI.tldr: 论文提出einx，一种基于向量化（vectorization）理论的通用张量操作符号系统，通过声明式点式表达式（pointful expressions）将现有张量框架的大量API简化为少量基本操作，并保持一致规则，集成到Python中。
AI.motivation: 现有NumPy风格张量操作符号难以读写且容易产生形状错误，因为操作集合庞大复杂且规则不一致；einsum和einops虽然流行，但仅限于少数操作，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 重新审视向量化（vectorization）作为变换张量操作的函数，用它来提升（lift）低阶操作到高阶操作，并在概念上将高阶操作分解为低阶操作及其向量化。基于此引入einx符号系统，采用声明式点式表达式，以循环符号（loop notation）为类比定义，表示张量操作的向量化。实现了一个嵌入Python的einx库，与现有张量框架无缝集成。
AI.result: einx将现有框架的大量API简化为少量基本操作，对所有操作应用一致的规则，并在代码中提供了清晰、可读、可写的表示。实现已开源（GitHub链接）。
AI.conclusion: 向量化是通用且普遍的张量操作变换机制，基于此构建的einx符号系统能够提供一种通用、一致且易用的张量编程范式，克服现有框架的局限性。

title: SciDataSailor: Deep Scientific Data Exploring
summary: Scientific datasets are commonly organized as hierarchical repositories containing heterogeneous and interdependent files, making their inspection, integration, and analysis labor-intensive and reliant on domain expertise. Although large language model (LLM) agents have advanced substantially in planning, reasoning, and tool use, existing research has largely overlooked their ability to interact with real scientific data assets through executable environments. We introduce Deep Scientific Data Exploration, an agentic task paradigm in which agents navigate repositories, interpret heterogeneous files and schemas, execute analyses, integrate cross-file evidence, and produce conclusions grounded in executed observations. To operationalize this paradigm, we present SciDataSailor, a framework for synthesizing tool-interactive trajectories by balancing broad exploration with targeted exploitation. SciDataSailor instantiates trajectory synthesis as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with four task-specific mechanisms: difficulty-stratified exploration seeds, dual-feedback first-play urgency, hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation, and entropy-guided branching. Using this framework, we construct SciDataSailor-SFT-2K for supervised fine-tuning and SciDataSailor-Bench for evaluation, with the latter comprising 627 meta-information summarization tasks and 586 scientific question-answering tasks across 27 datasets spanning the life, earth, and physical sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出深度科学数据探索（Deep Scientific Data Exploration）这一智能体任务范式，并介绍SciDataSailor框架，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）结合难度分层种子、双反馈首次紧迫机制、分层策略到工具动作生成和熵引导分支四种机制，合成工具交互轨迹，构建了SciDataSailor-SFT-2K微调数据集和SciDataSailor-Bench评估基准（包含627个元信息摘要任务和586个科学问答任务，覆盖生命、地球和物理科学的27个数据集）。
AI.motivation: 科学数据集通常以层次化仓库形式组织，包含异质且相互依赖的文件，检查、整合和分析过程劳动密集且依赖领域专业知识。尽管LLM智能体在规划、推理和工具使用方面取得了显著进展，但现有研究很大程度上忽略了它们在可执行环境中与真实科学数据资产交互的能力。
AI.method: 将轨迹合成建模为蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），并引入四种任务特定机制：难度分层的探索种子、双重反馈的首次播放紧迫性、分层策略到工具的动作生成以及熵引导的分支。在此框架下，平衡广泛探索与针对性利用，合成工具交互轨迹。
AI.result: 构建了SciDataSailor-SFT-2K用于监督微调，以及SciDataSailor-Bench用于评估，后者包含627个元信息摘要任务和586个科学问答任务，覆盖生命科学、地球科学和物理科学的27个数据集。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一种新的智能体任务范式（深度科学数据探索）和对应的轨迹合成框架（SciDataSailor），使LLM智能体能够在可执行环境中导航层次化科学数据仓库，解释异质文件与模式，执行分析并整合跨文件证据以产生基于可执行观察的结论。

title: AdaAnchor4D: Anchor-Conditioned Spatiotemporal Feature Aggregation for Monocular UAV 4D Reconstruction
summary: Monocular UAV videos provide valuable observations for dynamic reconstruction of complex urban scenes. However, such scenes exhibit pronounced spatiotemporal heterogeneity: different regions follow distinct temporal activity patterns, while the motion states of some dynamic regions may further evolve over time. Although dynamic Gaussian methods based on decomposed shared spatiotemporal feature fields have achieved efficient and accurate reconstruction in object-centric or relatively compact scenes, their commonly adopted fixed plane-wise feature combination mechanisms are less suited to the heterogeneous local dynamics of UAV scenes, often leading to ghosting artifacts and blurred dynamic details. To address this challenge, we propose AdaAnchor4D, an adaptive anchor deformation framework for monocular UAV dynamic scene reconstruction. At its core, Anchor-Conditioned Feature Aggregation (ACFA) adaptively aggregates shared spatiotemporal features using anchor-specific aggregation embeddings and temporal information, allowing different local units to obtain dynamic representations tailored to their local and temporal states. Decoupled Local Geometry Deformation (DLGD) separates anchor-state deformation from local Gaussian geometry deformation, while Density-Adaptive Coordinate Warping (DACW) reparameterizes feature-query coordinates according to the axis-wise anchor distributions, alleviating the mismatch between non-uniform geometric sampling and uniform grid parameterization. Experiments on UAV-Arc4D, VisDrone, and UAVDT show that AdaAnchor4D achieves higher rendering quality than representative dynamic Gaussian methods while maintaining real-time rendering performance. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: AdaAnchor4D是一个针对单目无人机视频动态场景重建的自适应锚点变形框架。它通过Anchor-Conditioned Feature Aggregation (ACFA)、Decoupled Local Geometry Deformation (DLGD)和Density-Adaptive Coordinate Warping (DACW)三个核心模块，解决动态高斯方法中固定平面特征组合机制不适用于无人机场景时空异质性问题，在UAV-Arc4D、VisDrone和UAVDT数据集上实现了更高的渲染质量并保持实时渲染性能。
AI.motivation: 单目无人机视频可用于复杂城市场景的动态重建，但这类场景具有显著的时空异质性——不同区域遵循不同的时间活动模式，且部分动态区域的运动状态会随时间演变。现有的基于分解共享时空特征场的动态高斯方法虽然在目标中心或相对紧凑的场景中表现良好，但其固定平面特征组合机制无法适应无人机场景中异质的局部动态，导致重影伪影和动态细节模糊。
AI.method: 提出AdaAnchor4D自适应锚点变形框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) Anchor-Conditioned Feature Aggregation (ACFA)——利用锚点特定的聚合嵌入和时间信息自适应地聚合共享时空特征，使不同局部单元获得适配其局部和时间状态的动态表示；(2) Decoupled Local Geometry Deformation (DLGD)——将锚点状态变形与局部高斯几何变形分离；(3) Density-Adaptive Coordinate Warping (DACW)——根据轴向锚点分布重新参数化特征查询坐标，缓解非均匀几何采样与均匀网格参数化之间的不匹配。
AI.result: 在UAV-Arc4D、VisDrone和UAVDT三个数据集上的实验表明，AdaAnchor4D在渲染质量上优于代表性的动态高斯方法，同时保持实时渲染性能。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过锚点自适应的特征聚合、解耦的几何变形和密度自适应的坐标扭曲，AdaAnchor4D有效解决了无人机城市场景中时空异质性带来的动态重建挑战，在保持实时性能的同时取得了更高的渲染质量。

title: Building a User Foundation Model for the Open Web
summary: User foundation models have demonstrated strong results in e-commerce and social recommendation, but most industrial deployments assume environments where user identity is stable and persistent. Open-web real-time bidding (RTB) operates on a structurally different data distribution: user identity is fragmented and non-persistent across browsing sessions, and the availability of browsing history depends on user privacy choices. Consequently, a significant portion of traffic carries no historical data, and available records often consist of relatively short, disjointed sessions. As a result, historical signals in this domain are typically represented as aggregated counters and recency buckets, leaving the sequential structure unexploited. To address this limitation, we present a user foundation model that applies self-supervised learning on user browsing histories and show that the learned representation improves multiple downstream production tasks, demonstrating the viability of this approach on the open web. We pre-train a Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and a sequence-level contrastive objective, then fine-tune it on the click prediction task. We optimize the encoder's pre-training pipeline with an LLM-in-the-loop search over a curated catalog of reviewable, code-level edits (lifters), instantiating the LLM-as-optimizer paradigm in an industrial setting. The same encoder representation yields +1.197% RIG on the production bid win-rate model and +1.354% RIG on the production CTR ranker; a 7-day live A/B test confirms +2.13% CTR, -1.13% eCPC (80% CI excluding zero on both metrics).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于开放网络实时竞价（RTB）环境的用户基础模型，该环境用户身份碎片化、历史数据不连续。通过Transformer编码器进行掩码语言建模和序列级对比学习的自监督预训练，然后在下游点击预测等任务上微调，并利用LLM-in-the-loop搜索优化预训练流程。该模型在生产环境中对多个下游任务带来显著提升，7天在线A/B测试确认CTR提升2.13%、eCPC降低1.13%。
AI.motivation: 现有用户基础模型大多假设用户身份稳定持久，适用于电商和社交推荐场景。但开放网络RTB环境具有本质不同的数据分布：用户身份碎片化且跨会话不持久，浏览历史可用性取决于用户隐私选择，大量流量无历史数据，可用记录多为短而不连续的会话。现有历史信号仅以聚合计数和时新性分桶表示，未利用序列结构，这限制了模型表现。
AI.method: 1) 在用户浏览历史上应用自监督学习，构建用户基础模型；2) 预训练Transformer编码器，采用掩码语言建模（MLM）和序列级对比学习双目标；3) 在点击预测任务上进行微调；4) 利用LLM-in-the-loop搜索策略，从可审查的代码级编辑（lifters）目录中优化预训练流程，实现LLM-as-optimizer范式。
AI.result: 同一编码器表示在生产的投标胜率模型上带来+1.197% RIG提升，在生产的CTR排序器上带来+1.354% RIG提升；7天在线A/B测试确认CTR提升+2.13%、eCPC降低-1.13%，两个指标的80%置信区间均排除零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在开放网络（用户身份非持久、历史零散）这一与传统推荐场景不同的工业环境中，通过自监督学习构建用户基础模型的可行性，并展示了LLM-as-optimizer范式在工业预训练流程优化中的实际价值。

title: CDAE: Enhancing Perturbation Robustness in Pretrained Language Models with Contrastive Denoising
comment: Submitted to 16th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE 2026)
summary: Pre-trained language models have significantly improved sentence representation learning, yet their embedding remain sensitive to semantic preserving textual perturbations such as synonym substitution, masking and word dropout. This work proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that refines pre-trained BERT embedding by jointly optimizing contrastive and reconstruction objective to learn perturbation-invariant representation. We evaluate the proposed framework using multiple perturbation strategies with varying strengths and compare it against the original BERT embeddings and SimCSE. Experimental results show that CDAE consistently preserves higher embedding similarity under perturbations, with the improvements becoming more pronounced as framework effectively enhances representation stability while preserving semantic information, highlighting perturbation-invariant learning as a promising direction for improving sentence embeddings. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/ComputationIASBS/CDAE

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级对比去噪自编码器（CDAE），通过联合优化对比学习和重构目标，精炼预训练BERT的句向量表示，使其对同义词替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持型文本扰动具有不变性。实验表明CDAE在多种扰动策略下比原始BERT嵌入和SimCSE更稳定，且扰动越强优势越明显。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型极大地提升了句向量表示学习，但其嵌入对同义词替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持型扰动仍然敏感，导致表示不稳定，影响下游任务性能。
AI.method: 提出轻量级对比去噪自编码器（CDAE），在预训练BERT嵌入基础上，联合优化对比学习目标（增强模型对扰动的判别能力）与重构目标（保留原始语义信息），从而学习扰动不变的表示。
AI.result: 在多种扰动策略及不同扰动强度下，CDAE相比原始BERT嵌入和SimCSE始终能保持更高的嵌入相似度；且扰动越强，改进效果越显著，证明CDAE能有效增强表示稳定性同时保留语义信息。
AI.conclusion: 扰动不变学习是改善句向量表示的一个有前景的方向，CDAE验证了通过对比与重构联合优化可以同时兼顾表示稳定性和语义完整性。

title: MIND: Lightweight and Effective Memory Injection Defense for LLM Agents via Intent-Aware Information Bottleneck
summary: Memory-augmented LLM-based agents are vulnerable to memory injection attacks: Agents may retrieve poisoned memory from attackers, which diverts their behavior from initial user intent and finally causes task failure. However, existing defense mechanisms either incur high computational cost or suffer from information redundancy in multi-turn contexts. To address these challenges, we propose Memory Intent-Aware Neural Denoising(MIND), a lightweight defense framework for memory injection attack. Our preliminary analysis reveals that benign and poisoned trajectories exhibit distinguishable relationships between the initial user intent and subsequent behavior. Building on this observation, MIND employs an intent-aware Information Bottleneck(IB) to extract compact intent--behavior representations from the initial intent and turn-level behavior. The IB preserves intent-relevant cross-turn attack signals while filtering task-irrelevant and repetitive information, and a lightweight detector identifies malicious memories from the resulting representations. As such, MIND mitigates information redundancy in multi-turn contexts while avoiding the overhead of repeated LLM auditing. Extensive experiments show that MIND reduces attack success rates while preserving task accuracy and inference efficiency. Notably, on ReAct-StrategyQA, MIND reduces mean ASR-r and ASR-a by 55.4% and 55.3%, respectively, while matching the undefended agent in average accuracy and latency.

AI.tldr: 提出MIND，一个轻量级的记忆注入攻击防御框架，利用意图感知信息瓶颈提取初始意图与行为的紧凑表征，在过滤冗余信息的同时保留跨轮攻击信号，实现了降低攻击成功率的同时保持任务准确率和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体容易受到记忆注入攻击：恶意记忆被检索后会使智能体偏离用户初始意图导致任务失败。现有防御方法要么计算成本高，要么在多轮上下文中存在信息冗余问题。
AI.method: MIND框架基于良性轨迹与恶意轨迹在初始意图与后续行为之间关系可区分的观察，采用意图感知信息瓶颈（IB）从初始意图和逐轮行为中提取紧凑的意图-行为表征。IB保留意图相关的跨轮攻击信号，同时过滤任务无关和重复信息，再用轻量级检测器识别恶意记忆。
AI.result: 在ReAct-StrategyQA上，MIND将平均ASR-r和ASR-a分别降低55.4%和55.3%，同时与未防御智能体在平均准确率和延迟上持平。广泛实验表明MIND能降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务准确率和推理效率。
AI.conclusion: MIND在计算开销与防御效果之间取得了良好平衡，通过在表征层面消除信息冗余并保留关键攻击信号，实现了轻量且有效的记忆注入攻击防御。

title: Same Branches, Different Trees: A Bifurcation Connectedness Metric for Coronary Artery Segmentation and FFR-CT Decision Agreement
comment: Accepted at STACOM 2026 (MICCAI workshop). 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
summary: Fractional flow reserve derived from CT angiography (FFR-CT) simulates flow through a patient-specific vessel model, so its accuracy depends on the connectedness of the segmented tree, not only on volumetric overlap: a segmentation can reach high Dice yet sever a bifurcation, dropping the downstream subtree and reversing the treatment decision. Topology-aware losses such as clDice and Skeleton Recall act on the global centreline and can miss localised breaks. We study the Bifurcation Connectedness Score (BCS), which scores connectedness at each ground-truth bifurcation, and soft-BCS, its differentiable training surrogate. BCS captures a property of segmentation quality the standard metrics miss: it responds strongly to breaks in connectedness while staying largely unchanged under connectedness-preserving narrowing. Higher BCS accompanies closer agreement between the FFR-CT decisions a solver makes on predicted versus ground-truth geometry, most clearly in severe disease (OR 2.16, CI [1.23, 4.18]). Both decisions come from the same solver, so this reflects geometric, not clinical, fidelity. In training, soft-BCS and Skeleton Recall recover the same branches but build different trees. Recovering branches and keeping them connected are separable properties, so we recommend reporting a measure of each.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了用于评估血管分割质量的Bifurcation Connectedness Score (BCS)指标。BCS能够捕捉标准分割指标（如Dice）所遗漏的分叉连通性性质，并且将FFR-CT (血流储备分数CT血管造影)的决策一致性作为临床应用指标进行了验证。作者提出soft-BCS作为可微训练代理，并建议在报告中同时报告枝条恢复（如Skeleton Recall）和连通性（如BCS）两种指标。
AI.motivation: FFR-CT的准确性依赖于分割血管树的分叉连通性而非仅体积重叠度。传统Dice指标可能很高但分割中产生分叉断开，导致下游子树丢失，从而反转临床治疗决策。现有拓扑感知损失（如clDice、Skeleton Recall）作用在全局中心线上，无法捕获局部的分叉断点。因此需要一种能评估分叉连通性的指标。
AI.method: 提出Bifurcation Connectedness Score (BCS)，在每个ground-truth分叉处评估连通性；同时推导出其可微训练代理soft-BCS。通过实验比较BCS与标准指标对不同类型误差（连通性断裂vs连通性保持的窄化）的响应差异，并利用FFR-CT决策一致性（预测几何vs真实几何的决策一致性）验证BCS的临床相关性。最后对比soft-BCS与Skeleton Recall在训练中恢复枝条与保持连通的可分离性。
AI.result: BCS对连通性断裂反应强烈，而对连通性保持的窄化几乎不变，这是标准指标无法捕获的性质。更高的BCS与FFR-CT决策一致性增高相关，在严重疾病中最为明显（OR 2.16, CI [1.23, 4.18]）。训练中soft-BCS和Skeleton Recall能恢复相同的枝条但构建不同的树结构，表明枝条恢复和连通性是两种可分离的性质。
AI.conclusion: 枝条恢复（分支的可达性）与连通性（分支间的连接保持）是可分离的两种分割质量属性，应分别评估。推荐在血管分割评估中同时报告枝条恢复指标（如Skeleton Recall）和连通性指标（如BCS），以更全面地反映分割在临床应用（如FFR-CT）中的几何保真度。

title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts
summary: Large language model training in open-ended domains lacks verifiable rewards, making task preferences difficult to formalize as effective supervision. Contexts can convey such preferences, yet provide little additional supervision once distilled into the student, motivating contexts that evolve with student performance. However, directly using evolving contexts as in-training supervision results in an unstable distillation target and conflicting distributions, requiring mechanisms to stabilize target and downweight conflicts. In this paper, we analyze the effect of contexts through a decomposition of the reverse KL objective, revealing two findings: the student is distilled toward the geometric mean of context-conditioned teachers, and the objective contains a conflict term that measures conflicts among these teachers. Based on this decomposition, we propose Flux-OPD, an OPD paradigm that uses evolving contexts as in-training supervision to capture task preferences in open-ended domains. Flux-OPD treats the differences between context-conditioned and context-free teachers as contextual difference signals, injects them as contextual corrections into the context-free teacher anchor, and weights their correction strength using the conflict term as an indicator. Experiments on open-ended tasks show that Flux-OPD outperforms existing OPD paradigms, highlighting the potential to combine teacher supervision with evolving contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flux-OPD，一种在线偏好蒸馏（OPD）范式，通过将演化中的上下文作为训练中监督信号来捕获开放领域中的任务偏好。通过对反向KL目标进行分解，发现学生被蒸馏向上下文条件教师的几何均值，且目标包含衡量教师间冲突的冲突项。Flux-OPD将上下文信号作为修正注入上下文无关教师锚点，并用冲突项加权修正强度，在开放任务上优于现有OPD范式。
AI.motivation: 开放领域的大语言模型训练缺乏可验证奖励，难以将任务偏好形式化为有效监督。虽然上下文可以传达偏好，但一旦蒸馏到学生中，上下文提供的额外监督就很少，因此需要根据学生表现演化上下文。然而，直接使用演化上下文作为训练中监督会导致不稳定的蒸馏目标和冲突的分布，需要机制来稳定目标并降低冲突。
AI.method: 首先通过对反向KL目标的分解分析上下文的效应，揭示两个发现：(1) 学生被蒸馏向上下文条件教师的几何均值；(2) 目标中包含一个衡量这些教师间冲突的冲突项。基于此，提出Flux-OPD：将上下文条件与上下文无关教师之间的差异视为上下文差异信号，将其作为上下文修正注入上下文无关教师锚点，并使用冲突项作为指示器来加权修正强度。
AI.result: 在开放任务上的实验表明，Flux-OPD优于现有的OPD范式，展示了将教师监督与演化上下文相结合的潜力。
AI.conclusion: Flux-OPD通过理论分解指导的上下文修正机制，有效解决了演化上下文作为训练监督时的目标不稳定和分布冲突问题，在开放领域任务上取得了优越性能，为如何利用演化上下文增强教师监督提供了新的思路。

title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于图语言模型（GLM）的检索器，并系统比较了GLM、GNN和传统向量检索三类检索器在单跳与多跳RAG任务上的表现。研究发现微调后的GLM检索器在跨领域泛化上最优，在两个多跳基准上达到SOTA；在域内多跳QA中与现有方法相当，且随参数和子图覆盖增加有良好扩展性。GNN检索器在训练高效性和图覆盖方面更优，向量检索基线则在单跳数据集上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱上的检索增强生成需要检索器同时捕捉图结构和语义信息。现有GNN检索器虽能建模图拓扑，但缺乏语义能力；而图语言模型（GLM）作为新兴范式兼具图推理和语言模型语义能力。本文旨在引入GLM检索器，并系统比较三种检索范式在单跳/多跳RAG设置下的相对优势，尤其关注对未见领域的可迁移性这一关键问题。
AI.method: 引入基于GLM的检索器，在单跳和多跳RAG设置下，对GLM检索器、GNN检索器和传统向量搜索检索器进行系统比较研究，特别评估它们在跨领域（unseen domains）迁移场景下的泛化性能，并分析参数规模和子图覆盖对性能的影响。
AI.result: 微调后的GLM检索器在跨域泛化上优于其他方法，在两个多跳基准上达到SOTA；在域内多跳QA数据集上与现有工作相当，且随参数规模和子图覆盖的增加展现出有前景的扩展性。GNN检索器在高效训练设置下实现更高的图覆盖，向量搜索基准则在单跳数据集上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 不同检索范式各有优势：GLM检索器最适合跨领域泛化场景（多跳），GNN检索器在图覆盖和训练效率上有优势，传统向量检索擅长单跳任务。实际应用应根据任务类型（单跳vs多跳）和领域迁移需求选择合适的检索器。

title: Beyond Rephrasing: Book-Level Organization Improves Synthetic Textbook Data for Mid-Training
summary: Synthetic textbook data has improved language model pre-training, but prior work largely treats the benefit as a property of generated content or local rewriting style. We study a different factor: whether related content is organized into coherent book-level documents. We contribute both a scalable synthesis pipeline and controlled evidence that this organization matters. The pipeline retrieves source material from a pre-training corpus, clusters it into topical units, plans hierarchical tables of contents, and assembles source-grounded sections into complete books (our Full setting), yielding 686K textbooks (32B tokens) across 15,000+ disciplines. Replacing natural books in a mid-training mix with this corpus improves downstream performance by +1.09 on average. Controlled comparisons then disentangle the relevant design factors. A content-matched Split condition holds generated text and tokens fixed but treats each section as an independent document; Full's +1.02 mean gain isolates document packaging. A length-matched RandomConcat control that joins sections from different books remains below Full, ruling out document length alone. A retrieval-pool-matched Rephrase condition independently rewrites individual retrieved documents under the same audience-by-style scheme, without clustering, TOC planning, or book assembly; Full's +1.17 gain demonstrates the value of structured synthesis. On Llama3-8B, Full likewise outperforms both RandomConcat and Natural Books, supporting book-level organization as a useful axis for synthetic pre-training data design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合成预训练数据中"书籍级文档组织"的作用，提出一个可扩展的合成流水线（检索→聚类→规划目录→组装成书），生成686K本教科书（32B tokens），并在多个受控对比实验中证明：将相关内容组织成连贯书籍比单纯生成内容或局部改写更有效，平均提升+1.09。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将合成教科书数据的收益归因于生成内容或局部改写风格，而忽略了内容在文档层面如何组织的影响。作者希望探究"相关内容是否被组织成连贯的书籍级文档"这一维度对预训练效果的独立贡献。
AI.method: 提出一个可扩展的合成流水线：（1）从预训练语料中检索源材料；（2）按主题聚类为单元；（3）规划层次化目录（TOC）；（4）将源文段组装成完整书籍（Full设置）。生成686K本教科书（32B tokens），覆盖15,000+学科。同时设计三种受控对比：（a）Split条件——保持文本和tokens不变但将每节视为独立文档，隔离文档包装效应；（b）RandomConcat——随机拼接不同书籍的章节，排除文档长度因素；（c）Rephrase——独立改写单个检索文档，不进行聚类、目录规划和书籍组装。
AI.result: 用合成书籍替换中训混合中的自然书籍，平均下游性能提升+1.09。受控实验中：Full较Split平均提升+1.02（证明文档包装的作用）；Full优于长度匹配的RandomConcat（排除长度因素）；Full较Rephrase提升+1.17（证明结构化合成价值）。在Llama3-8B上，Full同样优于RandomConcat和自然书籍。
AI.conclusion: 书籍级组织是合成预训练数据设计的一个有效且独立的维度。将相关内容组织为连贯的书籍级文档（而非仅关注内容生成或局部改写）能显著提升下游性能，为合成数据设计提供了新的指导原则。

title: Capturing Token Tendencies for Training-Free Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While visual token pruning is essential for efficient Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing training-free methods suffer from a critical limitation: they rely on static, instantaneous heuristics to perform irreversible filtering. This approach ignores the hierarchical nature of MLLMs, where token importance often evolves dynamically rather than remaining fixed across layers. Consequently, tokens essential for deep-layer reasoning are often prematurely discarded by shallow-layer estimates. To address this, we propose Trend-aware Pruning, a novel framework that elevates pruning from a local snapshot decision to a temporal trajectory modeling problem. Instead of relying on isolated scores, our method captures the momentum of attention flow. This enables a dynamic rectification mechanism that selectively reactivates "late-blooming" tokens, those initially undervalued but exhibiting rising semantic importance, thereby preventing the loss of critical visual cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior efficiency-performance trade-off across diverse multimodal tasks. Notably, it reduces visual tokens by over 77.8%, retaining only approximately 23 tokens in the final layer while maintaining competitive performance, offering a robust and reversible solution for high-efficiency multimodal inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trend-aware Pruning框架，将视觉token剪枝从静态的局部快照决策提升为时间轨迹建模问题，通过捕捉注意力流的动量并动态修正，重新激活"晚开花"token，在剪枝77.8%视觉token的情况下保持竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 现有训练无关的视觉token剪枝方法依赖静态、瞬时启发式进行不可逆过滤，忽略了MLLMs的分层特性中token重要性会动态演化的事实，导致深层推理所需的关键token被浅层估计过早丢弃。
AI.method: 提出Trend-aware Pruning框架，将剪枝从局部快照决策转化为时间轨迹建模问题。通过捕捉注意力流的动量（momentum），实现动态修正机制，选择性重新激活那些最初被低估但语义重要性持续上升的"late-blooming"token。
AI.result: 在多种多模态任务上取得了优异的效率-性能平衡。视觉token剪枝率超过77.8%，最终层仅保留约23个token，同时保持竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种鲁棒且可逆的高效多模态推理解决方案，克服了传统不可逆剪枝的局限。

title: Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation
summary: Recent advances in post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) or On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). While OPSD provides dense, logit-level supervision, it inherently suffers from exposure bias due to the privileged information of the self-teacher. In multi-turn agentic settings, this leads to reasoning route convergence and the loss of clear optimization directions. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO), which reformulates agentic OPSD from a contrastive learning perspective. By leveraging predictive entropy to distinguish between positive positions (reflective exploration) and negative positions (exposure bias), CRPO conducts group-wise contrast to preserve reliable, fine-grained optimization signals. Extensive evaluations across 13 challenging reasoning and deep-search benchmarks demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines, significantly enhancing training stability and generalization in long-horizon interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRPO（Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization），从对比学习视角重新审视智能体场景下的在线自蒸馏（OPSD），利用预测熵区分积极位置（反思性探索）和消极位置（曝光偏差），通过组级对比保留可靠细粒度的优化信号，在13个推理与深度搜索基准上超越现有RL和自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: OPSD虽能提供稠密的logit级监督，但由于自我教师的信息优势存在固有曝光偏差；在多轮智能体场景中，这会导致推理路线收敛且丧失明确的优化方向。现有RLVR或OPSD方法无法同时兼顾细粒度监督与避免偏差，亟需新的优化范式。
AI.method: CRPO从对比学习视角重构智能体OPSD。利用预测熵区分积极位置（反思性探索）与消极位置（曝光偏差），并执行组级对比（group-wise contrast）以保留可靠、细粒度的优化信号。
AI.result: 在13个具有挑战性的推理与深度搜索基准上的大量评估显示，CRPO一致优于现有强化学习和自蒸馏基线，显著提升了长程交互中的训练稳定性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CRPO通过对比学习范式有效解决了OPSD在多轮智能体场景中的曝光偏差与路线收敛问题，为长程交互场景下LLM的后训练优化提供了更稳健的方案。

title: BlueprintRepair: Typed Local Edits for Failed Lean Proof Blueprints
summary: LLM-based Lean proving systems increasingly organize a proof as a blueprint: a dependency graph of formal statements. We introduce BlueprintRepair, a repair interface that lets a model change this graph through ten schema-checked local operations. An operation names the node it edits, so the target theorem cannot be changed. Lean checks every applied change, and an accepted repair must declare every blueprint lemma its proof uses. We also construct BlueprintTrace, a benchmark of 142 controlled failures with complete accepted and rejected repair trajectories. We compare typed edits, exact source patches, and complete module rewrites under matched source, feedback, model, and budget, one episode per state and interface. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the three interfaces solve almost the same number of the benchmark's localized failures. Typed repair is the cheapest per solved state (patching is 1.30x as expensive, rewriting 2.06x), and within 10,000 completion tokens per task it reaches almost all of its final coverage, while both free-form interfaces are well behind. A second model, Qwen3.6-Flash, solves fewer states but keeps typed repair cheapest, puts it ahead on the proof-authoring states, and repeats the localized pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BlueprintRepair，一种通过十种类型检查的局部操作来修复LLM驱动的Lean证明蓝图依赖图的新接口，并构建了包含142个受控失效案例的BlueprintTrace基准。实验表明，在DeepSeek-V4-Flash和Qwen3.6-Flash两个模型下，类型化编辑在单位成本效率上优于精确源码补丁和完整模块重写，是性价比最高的修复方式。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的Lean证明系统越来越倾向于将证明组织为蓝图——即形式化语句的依赖图。然而，当证明失败时，如何高效地修复这个蓝图依赖图缺乏系统化的接口设计与评估，需要一种能保证目标定理不变、通过类型检查的受控修复机制。
AI.method: （1）引入BlueprintRepair，一个修复接口，允许模型通过十种schema-checked局部操作修改蓝图依赖图；每种操作明确命名编辑节点以确保目标定理不可被更改；所有修改均通过Lean类型检查，且被接受的修复必须声明其证明使用的每个蓝图引理。（2）构建BlueprintTrace基准，包含142个受控失败案例及完整的接受/拒绝修复轨迹。（3）在相同的源码、反馈、模型和预算条件下，对比三种接口：类型化编辑、精确源码补丁、完整模块重写，每种状态和接口运行一个episode。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上，三种接口解决的局部化失败数量几乎相同，但类型化编辑的单位解决成本最低（补丁为1.30倍，重写为2.06倍成本）。类型化编辑在10,000个完成token内即可达到几乎全部最终覆盖率，而两种自由格式接口明显落后。在Qwen3.6-Flash上，解决的state更少，但类型化编辑依然保持成本最低，且在证明编写类state上表现领先，局部化失败模式与前者一致。
AI.conclusion: BlueprintRepair类型化编辑接口在修复效率上具有显著优势：与其成本相比，它在解决局部化证明失败上与自由格式方法效果相当，且速度更快、token开销更少。该工作为LLM-based Lean证明系统的蓝图修复提供了可控、可验证的新范式，并为后续研究建立了基准。

title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
summary: We present ShadowDancer, a novel approach to any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models. The obstacle is representational: existing interfaces either encode an action loosely, leaving how it unfolds for the model to improvise, or encode it exactly through structured signals that serve one family and are hard to acquire, so precise control across diverse dynamics remains impractical. Demonstration videos are the natural remedy, specifying any dynamics frame by frame; yet a video shows its dynamics only through one particular appearance, a single shadow of the underlying dynamics, so actions learned from demonstrations transfer poorly to new scenes. ShadowDancer addresses this with two key innovations: (1) shadow pairs, video pairs that replay the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance, constructed at scale by our Shadow Library, so that a dynamics family becomes controllable exactly when such pairs can be constructed for it; and (2) cross-shadow prediction, which learns actions by predicting one shadow from the other, so that whatever the pairing resamples is discarded by construction and whatever it preserves becomes the action, yielding a unified dynamics representation that drives a block-causal world model. Any demonstrated clip thus becomes a reusable action asset, replayed in new environments without action labels, motion estimators, or fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate improved action transfer and long action rollout over strong latent-action and interactive world model baselines across diverse dynamics families, with an average blinded win rate of 86% in rollout comparisons. We show video results at https://ShadowDancer-1.github.io

AI.tldr: ShadowDancer 是一种新颖的任意动作、帧级控制的交互式视频世界模型方法。它通过"影子对"（在不同外观下重放相同动态的视频对）和"跨影子预测"技术，将演示视频转化为可复用的动作资产，使其能在新环境中无需动作标签、运动估计器或微调即可重放。实验表明在多种动态族的动作转移和长序列动作展开任务上，平均遮蔽胜率达86%，优于强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型在动作控制上存在表征困境：松散的接口让模型自由发挥难以精确控制；结构化信号虽然精确但只能服务单一家族且难以获取，导致跨多样动态的精确控制不切实际。演示视频虽是自然解决方案，但其只展现单一外观下的"动态影子"，导致学到的动作难以迁移到新场景。
AI.method: ShadowDancer 包含两个核心创新：(1) Shadow Library 大规模构建"影子对"——在同一动态、独立重采样外观下重放视频对，使动态族在该类配对可构造时变得可控；(2) 跨影子预测——通过从一个影子预测另一个来学习动作，配对中被重采样的信息（外观）在构造中被丢弃，被保留的信息（动态）即为动作，由此产生统一的动态表征驱动块因果世界模型。
AI.result: 实验在多种动态族上，相比强潜动作和交互式世界模型基线，ShadowDancer 在动作转移和长动作展开任务上均表现出改进，在展开对比中的平均遮蔽胜率达到86%。演示视频可在无动作标签、无运动估计器、无微调的情况下在新环境中重放。
AI.conclusion: 任何演示片段都可转化为可复用的动作资产，可用于新环境中的重放；ShadowDancer 通过影子对与跨影子预测实现了对交互式视频世界模型的任意动作、帧级精确控制，解决了表征层面的根本障碍。

title: Enhancing Irregular Time Series Forecasting with Continuous-Time Modeling Framework
summary: Irregular multivariate time series are widely encountered in applications such as healthcare monitoring, human activity recognition, and environmental sensing. Their core challenges stem from asynchronous observations, non-uniform sampling intervals, and the fact that temporal patterns themselves carry critical dynamic information. Existing approaches either rely on discretization-based preprocessing (e.g., interpolation, imputation, or aggregation), which disrupts the underlying continuous-time semantics, or adopt continuous-time modeling via ODE-based frameworks, which typically require specialized architectures and incur substantial computational overhead due to numerical solvers. To address these limitations, we propose WrapFlow, a continuous-time modeling framework for irregular time series forecasting. On the input side, WrapFlow introduces Continuous-Time Tokenization, which directly encodes raw observation events and explicitly models long unobserved intervals via gap-aware tokens. The resulting continuous-time tokens are then processed by a standard Transformer backbone to capture long-range temporal dependencies. On the output side, we develop a simulation-free training paradigm for Residual Flow Matching, which learns conditional residual vector fields around base predictions while avoiding numerical-solver simulation and backpropagation during training. This design enables high-quality continuous forecasting using only a small number of fixed rollout steps at inference. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that WrapFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: WrapFlow是一个用于不规则多元时间序列预测的连续时间建模框架，通过连续时间分词（Continuous-Time Tokenization）编码原始观测事件并建模长间隔，配合无模拟训练的残差流匹配（Residual Flow Matching）机制，实现高效且高质量的连续时间预测，在多个真实数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 不规则多元时间序列的现有方法存在两类问题：基于离散化的预处理（插值、补全、聚合）会破坏数据固有的连续时间语义；而基于ODE的连续时间建模虽然更符合数据本质，但需要专门架构且因数值求解器带来大量计算开销。作者希望设计一种兼顾连续时间表达能力和计算效率的框架。
AI.method: WrapFlow由两部分组成：(1) 输入侧的Continuous-Time Tokenization，直接编码原始观测事件，通过gap-aware tokens显式建模长时间未观测间隔，生成的连续时间token由标准Transformer骨干处理以捕获长程时间依赖；(2) 输出侧的simulation-free训练范式——Residual Flow Matching，围绕基础预测学习条件残差向量场，训练过程中规避数值求解器模拟和反向传播，推理时仅需少量固定步数的 rollout 步骤即可实现高质量连续预测。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，WrapFlow达到了当前最先进的（state-of-the-art）预测性能，同时因避免了数值求解器的训练开销，在计算效率上也具有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: WrapFlow成功地将连续时间建模与标准Transformer架构和流匹配技术相结合，在不牺牲连续时间语义的前提下解决了ODE方法的计算瓶颈问题，为不规则时间序列预测提供了一种高效且高性能的解决方案。

title: WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning
summary: Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of LLMs. Existing static structured pruning methods are hardware-friendly and can deliver practical throughput gains, but their input-agnostic computation allocation often causes substantial accuracy degradation under aggressive sparsity. Recent dynamic sparsity methods improve quality retention by adapting computation to individual inputs, yet they remain largely limited to coarse-grained structural decisions and their practical acceleration under real-world inference scenarios remains challenging. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable token-level dynamic width pruning framework designed for both prefill and decode scenarios. WIDE enables fine-grained computation allocation by allowing each token to dynamically select attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups, extending dynamic pruning beyond layer-level decisions to neuron-block-level granularity. Through a two-stage training pipeline, WIDE learns effective token-wise sparse execution patterns and achieves substantially better quality retention than existing approaches. To make such fine-grained dynamic pruning practical, we further propose a pruning--kernel co-design framework that decomposes dynamic sparsity acceleration into mask reordering, hardware-agnostic block-level skipping, and hardware-dependent intra-block skipping, enabling efficient execution across different granularities. At 50% sparsity, WIDE provides 55.1% performance boost when compared to the state-of-the-art dynamic depth pruning under calibration-only settings. Under prefill and decoding inference workloads, WIDE achieves close-to-theoretical kernel-level speedups of up to 1.98x for prefill and 4.95x for decoding, as well as 1.68x and 1.55x end-to-end acceleration. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WIDE，第一个端到端可微分的token级动态宽度剪枝框架，同时适用于prefill和decode场景。它允许每个token动态选择注意力头组和FFN通道组，将动态剪枝从层级别扩展到神经元块级别。通过两阶段训练和剪枝-内核协同设计，在50%稀疏度下相比SOTA动态深度剪枝提升55.1%性能，实现最高1.98x（prefill）和4.95x（decode）的kernel级加速，以及1.68x和1.55x的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有静态结构化剪枝硬件友好但输入无关的计算分配在激进稀疏度下导致严重精度下降；而动态稀疏方法虽然能根据输入自适应计算，但大多局限于粗粒度的结构决策（如层级别），且在实际推理场景中难以实现有效加速。需要一种既能精细分配计算又能实际加速的方案。
AI.method: WIDE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 端到端可微分的token级动态宽度剪枝机制，使得每个token能够动态选择注意力头组（attention-head groups）和FFN通道组（FFN-channel groups），将动态剪枝粒度从层扩展到神经元块级别；(2) 两阶段训练管线，学习有效的token级稀疏执行模式；(3) 剪枝-内核协同设计框架，将动态稀疏加速分解为mask重排序、硬件无关的块级跳过和硬件相关的块内跳过三个层次，支持不同粒度的高效执行。
AI.result: 在50%稀疏度下，相比SOTA动态深度剪枝方法在仅校准设置下获得55.1%的性能提升。在prefill和decode推理负载下，kernel级加速分别达到接近理论值的1.98x和4.95x，端到端加速分别为1.68x和1.55x。
AI.conclusion: WIDE证明了token级细粒度动态宽度剪枝不仅能显著优于现有动态深度剪枝的质量保持能力，而且通过剪枝-内核协同设计可以实现实际推理场景中的高效加速，为LLM动态稀疏化提供了新的可行路径。

title: ConMem: Contribution-Aware Memory for Long-Horizon Manufacturing Inspection Logs
summary: Long-horizon steel-equipment inspection requires reasoning over heterogeneous records accumulated across repeated inspection cycles. Existing retrieval-augmented generation systems treat historical logs as a static corpus and retain records without estimating their diagnostic value, failing to report early risk. To this end, we propose ConMem, a contribution-aware memory framework for LLM-assisted equipment inspection, supporting a human-in-the-loop early-risk screening system. Specifically, our ConMem first segments inspection logs into functional evidence units, then estimates each memory unit's contribution to downstream diagnosis through a Shapley-style estimation, and finally retains high-value evidence under a constrained memory budget. In experiments, we evaluate ConMem on real-world dataset and ConMem achieves 76.0% QA accuracy, exceeding the strongest directly comparable baseline. Relative to the naive 8K-context LLM baselines, it reduces the average number of input tokens by 88.2% and response time by 86.6%. Ablation studies also show that the functional-role-aware segmentation and contribution-based valuation are helping prioritize weak degradation signals for targeted field inspection. Practical deployments further confirm that ConMem retains the weak early signal across three inspection cycles, providing an early-stage seal-wear alert targeted for on-site inspectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConMem，一个基于贡献感知记忆框架的LLM辅助设备检测系统，通过功能证据单元分割、Shapley式贡献估计和高价值证据保留，在有限记忆预算下实现早期风险预警，在真实数据集上QA准确率达76.0%，并大幅减少输入token数和响应时间。
AI.motivation: 长视界钢铁设备检测需要跨多次检测循环的异构记录进行推理，但现有RAG系统将历史日志视为静态语料库，不加评估地保留所有记录，无法估计其诊断价值，导致早期风险无法被报告。
AI.method: ConMem包含三个关键步骤：(1) 将检测日志分割为功能性证据单元；(2) 通过Shapley式估计方法评估每个记忆单元对下游诊断的贡献度；(3) 在受限记忆预算下保留高价值证据。系统支持人在环路的早期风险筛查工作流。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，ConMem达到76.0%的QA准确率，超过最强的直接可比基线；相对于朴素8K上下文LLM基线，平均输入token数减少88.2%，响应时间减少86.6%。消融研究证实功能角色感知分割和贡献度评估有助于优先识别弱退化信号。实际部署显示ConMem能在三个检测周期中保留弱早期信号，为现场巡检人员提供早期密封磨损预警。
AI.conclusion: 贡献感知的记忆管理策略相比静态语料库方法能更有效地筛选和保留高诊断价值信息，在提升诊断准确性的同时大幅降低计算开销，并能捕捉跨周期的弱早期退化信号以支持预防性维护。

title: Explaining Image Similarity with Automatically Extracted Concept Activation Vectors
summary: Image similarity underlies many computer vision applications, yet it is often unclear why two images receive a high or low similarity score. Existing explainability methods often rely on gradient-based attribution maps to provide local justifications for similarity. These approaches struggle to provide global insights into what specifically drives similarity in regions of an embedding space, such as texture, shape, or color. We introduce a model- and metric-agnostic framework that explains image similarity using Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) extracted automatically via Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). Given a pair of images, we perturb their embeddings along discovered concept directions and measure the resulting change in a chosen similarity function, yielding concept importances. For image pairs, we provide localization with concept attribution maps. We extend this procedure to group-level settings, explaining what drives similarity across a cluster of images rather than a single pair, and further, we introduce Exemplar Retrieval, aiming to recover samples with similar reasons contributing to similarity. Our experiments show that our latent perturbations are more faithful to the underlying data distribution than pixel-space baselines, and that concept importances linearly recover the true similarity score. Qualitative results further confirm the usefulness of our methods in understanding a model's individual and group similarity judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模型与度量无关的框架，利用稀疏自编码器自动提取的概念激活向量来解释图像相似性，通过扰动嵌入并测量相似度变化来获得概念重要性，支持成对图像、群组级别的解释以及示例检索。
AI.motivation: 图像相似性在许多计算机视觉应用中至关重要，但现有可解释性方法主要依赖基于梯度的归因图来提供局部解释，难以提供嵌入空间中关于纹理、形状、颜色等具体驱动因素的全局洞察。
AI.method: 该方法使用稀疏自编码器自动提取概念激活向量，对图像对沿着发现的概念方向扰动嵌入并测量所选相似性函数的变化以得到概念重要性；针对图像对提供概念归因图实现定位；将该流程扩展到群组级别的解释（解释一组图像聚类的相似性驱动因素）；引入示例检索以恢复具有类似相似性原因的样本。
AI.result: 实验表明，其潜在空间扰动在保真度上优于像素空间基线，概念重要性能够线性恢复真实相似性得分；定性结果进一步证实了该方法在理解模型个体和群组相似性判断方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为图像相似性提供了更全局、更忠实于数据分布的可解释性方法，能够同时支持单对图像和群组级别的相似性分析，并具备检索相似推理样本的能力。

title: Metaphor Tracer: A Theory-Informed Analysis of Hidden States
summary:
What do a language model's hidden states say about the organization of a single text? From one forward pass, without training, we score every token position on two properties. The *aggregator* measures whether the position consolidates the whole text into a stable configuration. The *differentiator*, whether other tokens are transiently carried into its subspace as the model reads: metaphor in its root sense, transport. Constants were frozen on one discovery text; every other is confirmatory.
  The aggregator is not, in the classic sense, an information measure, nor a measure of salience. Across three unrelated models, as a signifier repeats, its surprisal and its attention drain while its aggregator score holds: the channel marks a token's place in the text. That this tracks a reading rests on independent ground truth: an engineered register the aggregator follows across its boundaries (6/6 cells), and a psychoanalyst's marking of clinical transcripts, fixed before the instrument existed, in 34/36 cells, with a graded increment above lexical controls and dissociations no type-level measure reproduces. A transfer test gives the result its shape: the model whose token structure travels with lexical type reads the singular discourse worst, and in a matched base/instruct pair tuning raises fidelity without moving type-transfer. Structural value is a property of a token's place in *this* text, not of its vector alone: a relational rather than essentialist reading of hidden states, operationalizing theory that predated the instrument.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的、基于单次前向传播的隐藏状态分析方法，通过两个评分器——"聚合器"（衡量某位置是否将整个文本整合为稳定配置）和"分化器"（衡量其他token是否被瞬时携带到该位置的子空间）——来刻画单个文本中token位置的结构性价值，并在多模型、多任务上验证其作为文本组织标记的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型内部表征研究多聚焦于语义、信息量或注意力模式，缺乏对"单个文本内token的结构性角色"的直接度量。作者希望从一次前向传播中提取关于文本组织的信号，区分token的语义重要性与其在文本局部结构中的位置价值，从而为阅读理论中的文本组织概念提供可操作的、关系性的操作化手段。
AI.method: 作者设计了两个基于隐藏状态的评分指标：(1) 聚合器，衡量某位置能否将全文整合为稳定配置；(2) 分化器，以"运输"隐喻衡量其他token是否被瞬时携带到该位置的子空间中。模型参数完全冻结，仅在一个发现文本上确定常量，其余均在验证集上确认。该指标不是经典信息量或显著性度量，而是标记token在文本中的"位置"。
AI.result: 在三个不相关模型上，重复出现（signifier）的token其惊异度与注意力下降，但聚合器得分保持稳定，说明该通道追踪的是token在文本中的位置而非信息量。独立验证包括：跨越6/6个边界的受控语域测试，以及心理分析师预先标注的临床转录本34/36个格子的一致率，且呈递增梯度。迁移测试表明，token结构随词汇类型迁移的模型在单一话语阅读上表现最差；在匹配的基础/指令微调对中，微调提高保真度但不改变类型迁移。
AI.conclusion: 结构价值是token在特定文本中位置的属性，而非其向量本身；这支持对隐藏状态进行关系性而非本质主义的解读，并将早于该工具存在的阅读理论成功操作化。

title: AgenticASR: Refining Speech Recognition in Real-World Scenarios via an Agentic Approach
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved substantial gains in transcription accuracy, yet verbatim transcription does not necessarily produce readily usable text. It retains fillers, repetitions, false starts, and self-corrections that increase reading effort, obscure the speaker's final intent, and propagate unresolved or abandoned content to downstream tasks. Existing spoken-to-written methods process completed audio or transcripts but cannot revise emitted text when later speech changes how preceding content should be interpreted. We therefore formulate Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR), an audio-to-clean-text task that removes disfluencies, resolves self-corrections, and normalizes written form while preserving the speaker's final intent. AgenticASR implements this task through an ASR--Refiner architecture that repeatedly transforms a bounded active context and replaces its corresponding output span as audio arrives. This enables continual emission and revision over streams of arbitrary duration. We also introduce AASR-Bench, a bilingual benchmark with fine-grained atomic rubrics. Across multiple ASR front ends, AgenticASR attains the highest AASR-Bench scores among evaluated systems. A human--AI agreement study shows that rubric-based judgments align with independent expert assessments. Ablations characterize Refiner capacity, context length, and the quality--latency trade-off between online and offline inference. Together, these results establish AgenticASR as a practical framework for intent-preserving clean transcription during ongoing speech. Code, AASR-Bench, and a demo will be released at https://github.com/AnXMuy/AgenticASR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR)，一个将语音转录为"干净文本"的新任务，通过ASR-Refiner架构在音频流式到达时持续修订已输出的转录文本，去除口吃、自纠正和重复内容，同时保留说话者的最终意图。作者还发布了双语基准AASR-Bench和AgenticASR系统，实验证明其性能优于现有系统。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR系统实现逐字转录，但输出的文本包含填充词、重复、假起句和自我纠正等不流畅内容，增加阅读难度、模糊说话者最终意图，并将未解决或废弃的内容传播到下游任务。已有的口语转书面语方法只能处理完整的音频或转录文本，无法在后续语音改变前面内容应如何解释时修订已输出的文本。
AI.method: 提出AgenticSR任务定义（音频到干净文本）和AgenticASR系统，采用ASR-Refiner架构：在音频持续到达时，反复变换一个有界的活动上下文（active context），并替换语音识别输出的对应片段，从而实现任意时长音频流上的持续发射和修订。此外构建了AASR-Bench，一个具有细粒度原子评分标准的双语基准。
AI.result: 在多个ASR前端上，AgenticASR在AASR-Bench中取得最高分数；人-AI一致性研究显示，基于评分标准的判断与独立专家评估一致；消融实验表征了Refiner容量、上下文长度以及在线与离线推理之间的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: AgenticASR是一个实用的框架，能够在持续语音中进行保留意图的干净转录，为实时口语到书面语的规范化提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models:Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer
summary: Hand-object interaction (HOI) modeling remains challenging because it requires joint reasoning about hand articulation, object geometry, contact, semantics, and dynamics under severe visual uncertainty. Foundation models introduce transferable prior knowledge learned from large-scale cross-domain data, offering new ways to address these challenges beyond task-specific data and models. However, the rapidly growing literature remains fragmented, and existing studies typically describe these methods simply as ``using large models'' without systematically characterizing what knowledge is introduced, where it enters the HOI pipeline, or which HOI uncertainty it helps reduce. This survey presents the first systematic review of foundation-model priors for HOI. We organize the literature into six HOI tasks spanning reconstruction and generation. More importantly, we establish a taxonomy of eight foundation-model sub-priors grouped into geometric, semantic, and visual families. Geometric priors encompass shape retrieval, shape reconstruction, and spatial reconstruction; semantic priors include semantic grounding and language reasoning; and visual priors cover visual representation, image generation, and video generation. Based on this taxonomy, we systematically analyze how different priors are represented, injected, and adapted across HOI pipelines and tasks. Beyond how foundation models empower HOI, we further examine how HOI-derived knowledge is used in robot learning, including human-data pretraining, human-to-robot skill transfer, and HOI-to-robot data generation. Finally, we summarize datasets and evaluation protocols, and discuss limitations and future directions toward more generalizable HOI systems. To support long-term progress, we curate a live repository that continuously aggregates emerging methods and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文是首个针对手-物交互（HOI）领域中基础模型先验知识的系统性综述。文章将文献组织为六个HOI任务（重建与生成），并建立了涵盖几何、语义、视觉三大类的八种基础模型子先验的分类体系，系统分析了这些先验在HOI管线中的表示、注入与适配方式，同时探讨了HOI知识在机器人学习中的应用，并总结了数据集、评测协议及未来方向。
AI.motivation: HOI建模面临手部关节姿态、物体几何、接触关系、语义理解与动力学等多方面联合推理的挑战，且存在严重的视觉不确定性。基础模型虽然带来了大规模跨域数据的可迁移先验知识，但相关文献增长迅速且碎片化，现有研究往往只泛泛描述为"使用大模型"，缺乏系统性的分析框架来明确引入何种知识、在HOI流程的哪个环节起作用、以及帮助降低了哪类不确定性。
AI.method: 本文采用系统性综述方法，将HOI文献按六个任务维度（重建与生成）进行组织，并建立了一个包含三大类（几何、语义、视觉）共八种基础模型子先验的分类体系：几何先验包括形状检索、形状重建和空间重建；语义先验包括语义锚定和语言推理；视觉先验包括视觉表示、图像生成和视频生成。基于该分类法，系统分析了不同先验在HOI管线各环节的表示、注入与适配方式，并进一步考察了HOI知识在机器人学习中的迁移应用。同时维护一个持续更新的在线资源库。
AI.result: 该综述提供了首个系统化的HOI基础模型先验分类框架，梳理了六类HOI任务、八种基础模型子先验及其在管线中的角色，明确了不同先验知识对HOI不确定性的缓解作用；还总结了HOI到机器人的知识迁移路径（人类数据预训练、人-机器人技能迁移、HOI-机器人数据生成），并汇总了相关数据集和评测协议。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型先验为HOI任务提供了超越任务特定数据与模型的可泛化知识来源，但当前研究仍存在碎片化问题。未来需要更统一的先验表示与注入机制、更强的可泛化性、以及更完善的评测体系，以推动HOI系统向更通用化方向发展。

title: ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents
summary:
As LLM-based agents are deployed in complex, multi-step workflows, a critical evaluation gap has emerged: most existing benchmarks judge only final outcomes, unable to distinguish reliable reasoning from lucky success or attribute failures to specific process deficiencies, hindering attribution in long-horizon tasks.
  In this work, we present ClawTrack, a dual-assessment benchmark that simultaneously measures what an agent achieves (Task Score) and how it achieves it (Process Score). ClawTrack comprises 320 tasks across 8 domains with 25+ deterministic mock services. A Process Grader scores each reasoning turn along four dimensions (goal alignment, efficiency, information utilization, and result verification), anchored by 12,541 task-specific rubric items. Evaluating 21 models over 16,000+ trials, we find that: (1) process scores effectively attribute success and failure to specific reasoning dimensions, filtering lucky passes invisible to outcome-only evaluation; (2) the four dimensions are complementary, with result verification as the systematic bottleneck; (3) the framework is robust to evaluator choice across different judge LLMs; and (4) process-based trajectory filtering yields consistent post-training improvements across model scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClawTrack，一个双评估基准，同时衡量LLM智能体"做什么"（任务分数）和"怎么做"（过程分数），包含320个任务、8个领域及12,541个评分细则，通过21个模型、16,000余次试验验证了过程评估能区分真实推理与侥幸成功，并发现结果验证是系统性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体基准大多只评估最终结果，无法区分可靠推理与侥幸成功，也难以将失败归因到具体的推理过程缺陷，尤其在长时程任务中这一缺口尤为突出。
AI.method: 构建ClawTrack双评估基准：（1）任务分数衡量智能体最终达成目标的能力；（2）过程分数通过Process Grader从目标对齐、效率、信息利用和结果验证四个维度逐推理步骤评分，辅以12,541条任务特定的评分细则，并在8个领域使用25+确定性模拟服务构建320个任务。
AI.result: 在21个模型、16,000余次试验上验证：（1）过程分数能有效将成功与失败归因到具体推理维度，过滤掉仅看结果不可见的侥幸成功；（2）四个维度互补，其中结果验证是系统性瓶颈；（3）框架对不同评估LLM具有鲁棒性；（4）基于过程轨迹过滤在多种模型规模上带来一致的训练后提升。
AI.conclusion: ClawTrack证明了过程级评估对于智能体能力归因和迭代改进的关键价值，为后续基于过程的智能体训练与优化提供了实用框架。

title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
summary: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer only when the verdict is Correct and confidence exceeds a threshold, and otherwise continues refinement using its own self-verification. Ground-truth correctness is used only to construct training rewards and is never exposed to the policy through refinement prompts or required at inference. SVR is trained with GRPO on fixed-horizon trajectories using rewards that promote solution correctness, calibration-aware self-verification, and stop-ready correct states; adaptive stopping is activated only at inference. On seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3.5-2B, SVR achieves a macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with only 2.99 inference turns on average. In the evaluated complete-system comparison, it exceeds standard GRPO, strong multi-turn baselines, and a fixed-budget oracle-guided score-feedback reference while requiring substantially fewer turns than fixed ten-turn inference. These results demonstrate that learned self-verification can serve as an effective internal control signal for answer retention and adaptive test-time compute allocation.

AI.tldr: 提出SVR框架，一种无外部反馈的多轮强化学习方法，让模型学会用自验证作为推理计算分配的控制信号，在数学推理基准上以更少的推理轮次取得更高精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时计算扩展方法存在两个问题：统一预算在简单输入上浪费计算；依赖验证器引导的细化需要外部反馈。作者旨在实现一种无外部信号的自适应计算分配机制。
AI.method: SVR框架在每个推理轮次中让模型同时生成解决方案、离散正确性判定和置信度分数；仅当判定为正确且置信度超过阈值时保留答案，否则利用自验证继续细化。使用GRPO在固定horizon轨迹上训练，奖励函数同时促进解的正确性、校准感知的自验证以及可停止的正确状态；自适应停止仅在推理阶段激活。置信度与判定阈值采用校准策略。
AI.result: 在七个数学推理基准上使用Qwen3.5-2B，SVR达到0.563的宏观平均准确率，平均仅需2.99个推理轮次；优于标准GRPO、强多轮基线和固定预算的oracle引导分数反馈参照方法，同时比固定10轮推理使用更少的轮次。
AI.conclusion: 学习得到的自验证能力可以作为有效的内部控制信号，用于答案保留和自适应测试时计算分配，无需外部验证器或推理时的真实标签。

title: Old Tricks, New Models: How Simple Image Transformations Break Modern AI-based Content Moderation
