summary: While automated content-moderation systems have become essential for screening harmful content at scale, conventional task-specific classifiers often provide limited policy cov- erage and contextual understanding. Recently, commercial multimodal moderation APIs built on large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of providing broader and more capable safety filters. In this work, we analyze whether this shift also yields more robust image moderation. We conduct a large-scale black-box evaluation on three established commercial image-moderation services and compare their robustness. By evaluating seven simple, model-agnostic image transformations across multiple providers, datasets, harm categories, perceptual-similarity constraints, and transformation intensities, we find that: (1) all three commercial services can be bypassed using inexpensive image transformations that require no gradients, surrogate models, or knowledge of the target system; (2) even fixed transformations such as color inversion and grayscale conversion induce unsafe-to-safe decision changes while preserving content that remains recognizable to humans; (3) their robustness varies substantially across datasets and harm categories, with multimodal content and self-harm exhibiting pronounced vulnerabilities. This yields the conclusion that replacing conventional moderation classifiers with foundation-model-based APIs does not, by itself, provide a reliable security boundary. Such systems must be evaluated under realistic transformations and deployed as one component of a layered moderation pipeline rather than as standalone safety filters.

AI.tldr: 本文对三个商业多模态图像审核API进行了大规模黑盒鲁棒性评估，发现它们均可被无需梯度的简单图像变换（如色彩反转、灰度化）绕过，且在不同数据集和危害类别上鲁棒性差异显著。结论是仅用基础模型API替代传统审核分类器并不能构成可靠的安全边界，需作为分层审核流水线的一部分部署。
AI.motivation: 传统任务特定审核分类器在策略覆盖率和上下文理解上存在局限，商业多模态审核API基于大型基础模型被寄予厚望，但其鲁棒性是否真的优于传统方法尚未得到系统性验证。
AI.method: 对三家商业图像审核服务进行大规模黑盒评估，使用七种简单、模型无关的图像变换，在多个提供商、数据集、危害类别、感知相似性约束和变换强度组合下进行系统测试，测量不安全到安全的决策翻转率。
AI.result: （1）三种商业服务均可被低成本图像变换绕过，无需梯度、替代模型或目标系统知识；（2）即使固定变换如色彩反转和灰度化也会导致不安全到安全的决策翻转，且内容对人类仍可识别；（3）鲁棒性在不同数据集和危害类别间差异显著，多模态内容和自残类展现明显脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 用基础模型API替代传统审核分类器本身并不能提供可靠的安全边界。此类系统必须在现实变换条件下进行评估，并作为分层审核流水线的一个组件而非独立安全过滤器来部署。

title: Large scale cross-regional remote sensing flood monitoring framework for operative mapping and impact analysis
comment: 37 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Preprint submitted to Earth Systems and Environment. This version has not been peer reviewed
summary:
Effective flood monitoring is critical for minimizing the impacts of flood disasters on populations and infrastructure. Yet reliable remote sensing across extensive and environmentally diverse regions remains challenging, as most segmentation algorithms lack the generalisation capacity required for large-scale application, while annotated flood data are scarce and unevenly distributed.
  This study presents an end-to-end multimodal framework for Russian Federation territories sustainable flood monitoring and damage assessment based on synthetic aperture radar data, multispectral imagery, and digital elevation models with their derivatives, forming a 21-channel input. Using a self-collected multimodal dataset covering seven Russian regions, two strategies for water surface detection under limited data conditions were compared: a supervised U-Net++ model and the self-supervised AnySat architecture pre-trained and fine-tuned for the segmentation task. Under the data conditions of this study, supervised learning proved more effective, while the AnySat-based approach offered greater stability and retains advantages for settings where larger unlabelled data or missing modalities at inference are expected.
  The best flood area predictions were used to estimate flood impact in urban areas in terms of the area affected, material damage, casualties, and ecological and agricultural impact. The estimations were conducted following the official methodology of the Russian Ministry of Emergency Situations. Applied to the 2019 Tulun flood, the obtained results closely matched official assessments, except for material damage, due to the open-source databases usage. The results demonstrate the potential of deep learning and multimodal satellite data integration for scalable, reliable flood monitoring across diverse environmental and data-limited conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向俄罗斯联邦领土的端到端多模态洪水监测与损害评估框架，整合SAR、多光谱影像和DEM及其衍生数据形成21通道输入。通过自建覆盖七个俄罗斯地区的多模态数据集，比较了有监督U-Net++与自监督AnySat两种水表检测策略。结果表明有监督方法在有限数据条件下更有效，而基于AnySat的方法稳定性更强。框架已成功应用于2019年图伦洪水，评估结果与官方数据高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 大面积跨环境区域的可靠遥感洪水监测仍具挑战性，现有分割算法泛化能力不足，且标注洪水数据稀缺且分布不均，需要开发适用于有限数据条件下的高效洪水监测框架。
AI.method: 构建21通道多模态输入（SAR、多光谱、DEM及其衍生数据），采用自收集的覆盖俄罗斯七个地区的多模态数据集，对比两种水表检测策略：有监督U-Net++模型与自监督AnySat架构（预训练后微调用于分割任务）。最佳洪水区域预测结果依据俄罗斯紧急情况部官方方法学进行城市洪水影响评估。
AI.result: 在该研究的数据条件下，有监督学习方法更有效；AnySat方法稳定性更强，在存在大量未标注数据或推理时模态缺失的情况下更具优势。应用于2019年图伦洪水时，除物质损失（因使用开源数据库）外，各项评估结果与官方评估高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习与多模态卫星数据集成具备实现跨多样化环境和数据受限条件下可扩展、可靠洪水监测的潜力，为大规模洪水监测与灾害评估提供了有效方案。

title: GVR-Coder: A Visual-Feedback Framework for Structured SVG Generation in Complex Document and Meeting Scenarios
summary: In demanding professional environments and meeting review scenarios, lengthy text often imposes a high cognitive load. To facilitate efficient information communication, transforming verbose text into logically clear diagrams is essential. Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) provide an effective representation for this purpose due to their editability and resolution independence. However, current research on Text-to-SVG generation remains hindered by three major challenges: (1) the scarcity of datasets for complex, logic-rich diagrams; (2) the absence of explicit layout priors, which leads to chaotic spatial arrangements; and (3) the lack of fine-grained visual feedback to validate rendered outputs and correct aesthetic defects. To address these challenges, at the data level, we introduce DocMeetSVG-100K, a large-scale SVG dataset tailored for document authoring and meeting review scenarios. At the model level, we propose GVR-Coder, a novel framework designed to generate high-quality logical diagrams from lengthy professional texts. Specifically, we adopt a curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning to progressively enhance the model's capability in modeling complex structures, while explicitly incorporating layout constraint knowledge during training. In addition, we introduce reinforcement learning from dual rendering feedback, a mechanism that provides implicit feedback through reward signals to jointly optimize structural complexity and visual aesthetics. Furthermore, we design a generate-verify-repair agent loop, which improves generation quality through explicit, fine-grained feedback and targeted refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GVR-Coder outperforms competitive baselines and reliably produces logically coherent and visually appealing diagrams. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CurryaNa/GVR-Coder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DocMeetSVG-100K大规模SVG数据集和GVR-Coder框架，用于从长篇专业文本生成逻辑清晰、视觉美观的SVG图表。GVR-Coder采用课程驱动拒绝采样微调、显式布局约束、双重渲染反馈强化学习以及"生成-验证-修复"智能体循环，解决了Text-to-SVG生成中数据稀缺、缺乏布局先验和缺乏细粒度视觉反馈三大挑战。
AI.motivation: 在专业环境和会议审查场景中，长篇文本带来高认知负荷，需要将其转化为逻辑清晰的图表以提升信息传达效率。尽管SVG因其可编辑性和分辨率无关性适合此任务，但现有Text-to-SVG研究面临三大挑战：复杂逻辑图表数据集稀缺、缺乏显式布局先验导致空间排列混乱、缺少细粒度视觉反馈来验证渲染输出和纠正美学缺陷。
AI.method: GVR-Coder框架包含三个层面：(1)数据层面，构建DocMeetSVG-100K大规模SVG数据集，覆盖文档编写和会议审查场景；(2)模型层面，采用课程驱动拒绝采样微调（curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning）渐进增强模型对复杂结构的建模能力，并在训练中显式融入布局约束知识；(3)优化层面，引入基于双重渲染反馈的强化学习（RL from dual rendering feedback），通过奖励信号隐式联合优化结构复杂性和视觉美学；同时设计"生成-验证-修复"（generate-verify-repair）智能体循环，通过显式细粒度反馈和针对性修复提升生成质量。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GVR-Coder在多个评价指标上优于竞争基线，能够可靠地生成逻辑连贯且视觉美观的SVG图表。代码和数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据、模型和优化三个层面的协同设计，GVR-Coder有效解决了Text-to-SVG生成的三大核心挑战，为长篇专业文本到高质量逻辑图表的自动化转换提供了可行方案，且该工作已开源以便社区复现和进一步研究。

title: Stage-Replay Divergence Follows the KV Cache: Fixed-Prefix Precision Controls and Bidirectional Cache Transplantation
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Reproducibility artifacts (frozen manifests, token IDs, per-item scores, analysis harnesses) described in Section 3.9
summary: Stage-replay diagnostics reconstruct intermediate token prefixes and treat fresh-prefill continuation as continuation from the decoder state that originally reached the prefix. We audit that assumption at a whole reasoning-stage boundary in a Qwen2.5-derived system. A matched 200-item experiment compares retained live cache with one-shot prefill of identical integer tokens and places an exact replica on both sides. In BF16, replicas remain exact while the constructions differ on 166 suffixes and 20 correctness labels; the accuracy difference is only one point (paired 95% CI [-3.5, +5.5]). A fixed-prefix 2x2 holds all 200 token states constant while crossing construction and precision. The BF16 disagreements recur, whereas FP32 produces no decoded disagreement (95% Wilson upper bound 1.88%). A prospective bridge makes token-by-token incremental and retained live caches bit-exact on 12/12 rows; an all-200 saved-ledger audit reproduces every retained trajectory and comparison fingerprint. Bidirectional transplantation of all 48 key/value layers makes every tested divergent continuation follow its cache donor, both on a selected set at the primary checkpoint (24/24) and an outcome-blind replication at a later checkpoint (43/43). Exact-token replay can therefore be repeatable without preserving live-state fidelity. On the tested states, boundary K/V cache is a causally sufficient carrier of the divergent trajectory, while numerical precision moderates its behavioral expression.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性实验验证了"阶段重放诊断"假设（即从已缓存前缀中的解码器状态继续生成可等价于重新预填充），在Qwen2.5派生系统中以推理阶段边界为切入点进行审计。结果表明，精确token重放在BF16下可重复但不等价于保留实时缓存，而FP32下可达到位级一致；边界K/V缓存是分歧轨迹的因果充分载体，数值精度则调节其行为表现。
AI.motivation: 阶段重放诊断（stage-replay diagnostics）是一种常用技术，其核心假设是：重新预填充中间token前缀与从原始解码器状态继续生成是等价的。这一假设若成立，将允许省略缓存而仅通过重放token序列来重现推理过程。然而该假设从未在完整的推理阶段边界上被严格审计，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用匹配200个样本的实验设计：(1)保留实时缓存与一次性预填充相同整数token进行对比，两种构建方式均为精确副本；(2)在BF16下比较166个后缀分歧、20个正确性标签差异，并计算配对95%置信区间；(3)采用固定前缀2x2设计，控制200个token状态不变，交叉构建方式和精度两个维度；(4)进行BF16与FP32双精度对照；(5)通过渐进式桥接使增量缓存与保留缓存逐token位级一致（12/12行）；(6)对全部48层K/V键值层进行双向移植实验，分别在主检查点（24/24）和结果盲复现的后检查点（43/43）上验证。
AI.result: BF16下重放与保留缓存产生166个后缀分歧和20个标签差异，但准确率仅差1个百分点（CI [-3.5, +5.5]）。FP32下无解码分歧（Wilson上限1.88%）。渐进桥接使12/12行位级一致，全量保存分类账复现所有轨迹。双向移植48层K/V缓存后，所有测试的分歧续写均跟随缓存供体（24/24和43/43）。
AI.conclusion: 精确token重放虽然可重复，但无法保证保留实时状态保真度。边界K/V缓存是分歧轨迹的因果充分载体（sufficient carrier），而数值精度（BF16 vs FP32）是调节其行为表达的关键因素。该发现对依赖阶段重放诊断技术的研究与实践具有重要方法论意义。

title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
summary:
GUI agents have the potential to become a general purpose executor over existing digital devices. To advance them toward real-world use, we envision agents that operate reliably on real devices, execute workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, complete long-horizon tasks, proactively initiate useful services, and autonomously improve their capabilities with minimal human effort. Guided by this vision, we present Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent spanning mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments. Qwen-UI-Agent combines diverse sandbox environments with a large-scale real-device mobile runtime. Its unified action space interleaves GUI operations with CLI execution and generates batched actions in a single model turn. An AutoResearch-style data flywheel uses agents to construct tasks and environments, diagnose failures, and plan subsequent iterations. Online RL supports training on trajectories exceeding 100 turns, with over 10,000 concurrent environments accelerating rollout. A lightweight harness layer supports proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer.
  Across a broad suite of evaluations, Qwen-UI-Agent sets state-of-the-art performance on mobile-use benchmarks while delivering competitive performance on computer- and browser-use tasks against frontier models, including Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol. On mobile use, it achieves 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, and 97.5% on AndroidDaily. On computer use, it achieves 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified and a 40.0% partial-progress score on OSWorld-v2. On browser use and GUI grounding, it achieves 73.6% on WebArena and 81.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Qwen-UI-Agent，一个面向真实世界应用的基础GUI智能体，覆盖移动端、电脑端、网页和DeepSearch四种环境，通过统一动作空间、AutoResearch式数据飞轮和在线强化学习实现跨平台、长时程、主动服务的通用GUI智能体。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体有望成为现有数字设备上的通用执行器，但当前智能体在真实设备上的可靠性、跨平台工作流、GUI与CLI结合的执行能力、长时程任务、主动服务和自我提升等维度仍存在不足，需要向真实世界应用推进。
AI.method: Qwen-UI-Agent采用以下关键设计：(1) 统一动作空间，将GUI操作与CLI执行交织在一起，并在单次模型推理中生成批处理动作；(2) 结合多样化的沙箱环境与大规模真实设备移动端运行时；(3) AutoResearch式数据飞轮，利用智能体构建任务与环境、诊断失败并规划后续迭代；(4) 在线强化学习支持超过100轮轨迹的训练，利用超过10,000个并发环境加速数据回放；(5) 轻量级harness层支持主动服务启动和跨移动端/电脑端的有状态工作流。
AI.result: Qwen-UI-Agent在移动端基准上达到SOTA：MobileWorld 82.1%、MobileWorld-Real 92.2%、AndroidDaily 97.5%；电脑端OSWorld-Verified 79.5%、OSWorld-v2部分进展40.0%；浏览器使用WebArena 73.6%；GUI grounding ScreenSpot-Pro 81.5%。在电脑端和浏览器任务上与Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro和GPT-5.6 Sol等前沿模型竞争表现。
AI.conclusion: Qwen-UI-Agent通过多元环境融合、统一动作空间、数据飞轮与在线强化学习的组合设计，在移动端实现领先性能，在电脑端和浏览器端达到与前沿闭源模型竞争的水平，验证了面向真实世界GUI智能体的可行路径。

title: Negative controls reveal volume-driven confounding in radiomics and imaging foundation model features
comment: 22 pages (including supplementary), 6 figures, 2 supplementary tables, 5 supplementary figures
summary: Radiomics and imaging foundation models promise non-invasive biomarkers of tumour biology, yet predictive signatures may reflect tumour volume or acquisition artifacts rather than meaningful image structure. We introduce READII-2-ROQC, an open-source framework that uses volume-preserving negative controls to assess whether radiomic and deep imaging features capture independent spatial signals. READII-2-ROQC generates voxel-perturbed images across tumour, background and whole-image regions using configurable randomization strategies, then compares feature behaviour and model performance between original and control images. Applied to three public cancer imaging cohorts, the framework processed 3,552 tumour volumes and extracted PyRadiomics and foundation-model features from original images and nine matched controls. Reproducing published survival and HPV-status signatures, we show that multiple models retain performance after spatial structure is destroyed, revealing volume-driven or contextual confounding, whereas others show perturbation-sensitive signal. READII-2-ROQC provides a scalable quality-control strategy for developing interpretable, biologically grounded imaging biomarkers and reproducible radiomics workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出READII-2-ROQC，一个开源框架，通过体素扰动阴性对照来评估放射组学和深度学习影像特征是否捕捉独立的肿瘤空间信号，而非仅反映肿瘤体积或采集伪影。
AI.motivation: 放射组学和影像基础模型虽然有望成为肿瘤生物学的非侵入性生物标志物，但预测特征可能反映肿瘤体积或采集伪影，而非有意义的图像结构，缺乏系统性方法验证特征是否真正捕捉独立的影像空间信号。
AI.method: 该框架通过体积保持的阴性对照生成体素扰动图像（覆盖肿瘤区、背景区及全图区域），采用可配置的随机化策略，并比较原始图像与对照图像之间的特征行为和模型性能。在三个公开癌症影像队列中，对3,552个肿瘤体积提取PyRadiomics和基础模型特征，并与九个匹配对照进行比较。
AI.result: 在复现已发表的生存率和HPV状态预测模型时，发现多个模型在空间结构被破坏后仍保持性能，揭示了体积驱动或上下文混杂效应；而另一些模型则对扰动敏感，说明其捕捉了真实的扰动敏感信号。
AI.conclusion: READII-2-ROQC提供了一种可扩展的质量控制策略，有助于开发可解释、具有生物学基础的影像生物标志物以及可复现的放射组学工作流程。

title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Informed Framework for Trustworthy Chemical Property Prediction
summary: Chemical property prediction plays a critical role in accelerating scientific discovery in chemistry, materials science, and drug development. However, existing benchmarks often suffer from limited task diversity, fragmented datasets, and inconsistent evaluation protocols, making it challenging to systematically assess the reliability and generalization of AI models. In this work, we introduce Chem World, a comprehensive benchmark for chemical property prediction that integrates 17 diverse chemical datasets with over 800,000 molecular samples, covering various properties including density, electrical conductivity, solubility, and other molecular characteristics. Chem World provides a unified platform for evaluating AI models across multiple property prediction tasks. Furthermore, we propose Mixture-PINN, a physics-informed neural network based prediction framework that incorporates chemical prior knowledge into data-driven learning, improving the accuracy, robustness, and reliability of chemical property prediction. Extensive experiments on Chem World demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared with existing methods. By combining large-scale standardized evaluation with physics-informed learning, Chem World establishes a foundation for developing trustworthy AI systems for computational chemistry and advancing AI-driven scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chem World基准（整合17个化学数据集、80万+分子样本，覆盖密度、电导率、溶解度等多种性质的统一评测平台）以及Mixture-PINN框架（将化学先验知识融入物理信息神经网络的预测方法），实验证明该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有化学性质预测基准存在任务多样性不足、数据集碎片化、评测协议不一致等问题，难以系统评估AI模型的可靠性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建Chem World统一基准，整合17个化学数据集的80万+分子样本，覆盖密度、电导率、溶解度等多种性质；2) 提出Mixture-PINN，一种将化学先验知识嵌入数据驱动学习的物理信息神经网络预测框架，以提升预测的准确性、鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.result: 在Chem World基准上的大量实验表明Mixture-PINN相比现有方法在化学性质预测任务上表现更优，验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Chem World结合了大规模标准化评测与物理信息学习，为计算化学领域构建可信赖AI系统奠定基础，推动AI驱动的科学发现。

title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. We introduce Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD), a counterfactual target-reconstruction algorithm that estimates the visually attributable part of a teacher correction. At each student-generated prefix, VAD evaluates the same fixed teacher with the relevant evidence present and removed. The corresponding change in centered log-probabilities defines ut, a signed proxy for the visual evidence direction that estimates how revealing the evidence supports or refutes candidate tokens. VAD projects the original correction onto this proxy to obtain an intervention-aligned component and a proxy-unexplained residual, then reconstructs a student-anchored target from the former. During training, this reconstructed target supplies the primary supervision signal, while the privileged teacher contributes a weak regularizer. Across six fine-grained visual benchmarks at 4B and 9B scales, VAD outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting. Token- level and controlled-target analyses show that the proxy-aligned component is enriched in task-relevant visual corrections and yields stronger target shifts, especially when evidence refutes a mistaken answer. These results support counterfactual target reconstruction as an effective alternative to source-mixed supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VAD（Visual Attribution Distillation），一种反事实目标重建算法，通过评估同一教师在有/无视觉证据条件下的输出差异来估计教师纠正中由视觉证据支持的部分，并将原始纠正投影到该视觉证据方向上，重建学生锚定的训练目标。在六个细粒度视觉基准上超越直接特权视角蒸馏和视觉优势加权方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态on-policy蒸馏（OPD）将教师生成的下一token纠正信号用于监督学生，但这些纠正信号是"源混合"的——同时包含视觉信号、语言先验和教师特定效应。核心挑战在于判断哪些纠正是由视觉证据支持的，而不仅仅是知道在哪里或如何强烈地进行蒸馏。现有方法无法区分纠正信号中视觉证据的成分，导致学生可能学习到教师固有的语言偏差或无关效应。
AI.method: VAD在每个学生生成的前缀处，对同一个固定教师分别在有相关视觉证据和移除视觉证据两种条件下进行推理评估。两种条件下的居中log概率差异定义了u_t，作为视觉证据方向的带符号代理，估计证据在支持或反驳候选token时的揭示程度。然后将原始教师纠正投影到这个代理上，得到干预对齐分量和代理无法解释的残差，仅从前者重建学生锚定的目标。训练时，重建目标提供主要监督信号，特权教师仅作为弱正则化器。
AI.result: 在4B和9B两种规模、六个细粒度视觉基准上，VAD优于直接特权视角蒸馏和视觉优势加权方法。token级别和受控目标分析表明，代理对齐分量富集了与任务相关的视觉纠正，并产生更强的目标偏移，特别是在证据反驳错误答案的情况下效果更明显。
AI.conclusion: 反事实目标重建是多模态蒸馏中源混合监督的有效替代方案。通过明确分离纠正信号中视觉证据支持的成分，VAD使蒸馏更精准，避免了教师语言先验和特定效应的干扰。

title: ViewMind3D: Modular View-Aware Inference for Training-Free 3D-QA
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled new possibilities for 3D question answering (3D-QA), a key capability for embodied AI and robotic perception. However, most existing methods rely on 3D-specific training or fine-tuning with costly annotations, limiting their scalability and real-world applicability. We present \textbf{ViewMind3D}, a fully training-free and modular framework for 3D spatial reasoning over multi-view observations of a scene without requiring complete 3D reconstruction. The framework decomposes the 3D-QA task into four interpretable components: (1) question-driven multi-view selection, (2) guided visual grounding with language-conditioned object cues, (3) spatial context encoding via a bird's-eye-view (BEV) viewpoint indicator, and (4) structured answer generation through role-based reasoning. This design enables structured, robust, and interpretable reasoning without requiring model tuning. Experimental results on ScanQA and SQA3D show that ViewMind3D achieves competitive performance compared to prior training-free and fine-tuned 3D-LLMs. In particular, our method improves performance on spatially grounded question types, such as ``What'' questions in SQA3D, while maintaining strong overall accuracy (50.8\%) and achieving 73.4 CIDEr on ScanQA. These results demonstrate that effective 3D reasoning can be achieved through modular orchestration of general-purpose LLMs and VLMs for robotic perception in real-world environments.

AI.tldr: ViewMind3D是一个完全免训练、模块化的3D问答框架，通过将问题分解为多视角选择、视觉定位、BEV空间编码和结构化答案生成四个可解释组件，利用通用的LLM和VLM实现3D空间推理，无需3D重建或模型微调，在ScanQA和SQA3D基准上取得了与训练方法相当的竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D问答方法大多依赖3D专用训练或微调，需要昂贵的人工标注，限制了其可扩展性和实际部署能力。作者希望探索一种免训练、无需3D重建的方案，利用现成的通用大模型进行3D空间推理。
AI.method: 提出ViewMind3D框架，将3D问答任务分解为四个独立可解释的组件：(1) 基于问题的多视角选择；(2) 以语言条件对象线索引导的视觉定位；(3) 通过鸟瞰图(BEV)视点指示器进行空间上下文编码；(4) 基于角色推理的结构化答案生成。整个框架无需任何模型微调，通过模块化编排通用LLM和VLM实现。
AI.result: 在ScanQA和SQA3D基准上，ViewMind3D取得了与先前免训练方法及微调3D-LLM方法相当的竞争性性能。在SQA3D的空间定位问题类型（如"What"类问题）上性能提升明显，保持50.8%的总体准确率，并在ScanQA上达到73.4的CIDEr分数。
AI.conclusion: 工作表明，通过模块化编排通用LLM和VLM，可以在无需训练和3D重建的情况下实现有效的3D空间推理，为真实世界的机器人感知提供了一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference
summary: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 113 hiring, and 45 other continuations. Maximum-L-infinity B-branch selection separates 12, 24, and 36 of 50 prompts by 8, 16, and 32 tokens. Across 192 persistent trajectories per scheme, P32, A, and B change every native-reference route trajectory, while C preserves routes, token sequences, and texts. A separate 192-trajectory C check matches native MoE, post-mHC, next-router, and LM states bitwise. For one controlled B branch, exact post-mHC endpoint reconstruction reproduces the measured downstream trajectory. At the next decode boundary, exact FP64 reconstruction of the branch's full persistent state yields agreement for 301 downstream post-mHC states, 301 persistent-state checkpoints, 301 routes, predictions, and text over seven steps, given the same naturally generated next input. These controls identify post-mHC as an intra-token boundary and full persistent state as a cross-token continuation boundary. Identical tokens need not imply identical autoregressive state: divergence can survive a token boundary and become visible later. These results make expert operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order part of a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes and hardware backends. They establish controlled causal possibility, not deployment incidence; C's order invariance is limited to evaluated six-term states and schedules.

AI.tldr: 本文在原生DeepSeek-V4-Flash中隔离冻结的本地MoE状态，仅改变聚合语义，发现数学等价的专家归约顺序可产生可观测不同的稀疏MoE执行结果，并识别出post-mHC为token内边界、完整持久状态为跨token续写边界，提出数值兼容性契约。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE推理中，数学上等价的归约顺序被普遍认为不影响结果，但实际执行中可能存在可观测差异。作者希望验证该假设，并探究差异的来源、边界与可控性，从而为稀疏MoE运行时和后端建立数值兼容性契约。
AI.method: 在DeepSeek-V4-Flash中冻结局部MoE状态，仅变聚合语义。设计四种方案分离操作数表示与累加器精度。在layer-5分叉处枚举720种A模式归约顺序与720种B模式顺序，分析其结构类、续写basin与分布。通过最大L-infinity B分支选择、192条持久轨迹追踪、P32/A/B/C四方案对比，以及精确FP64重建post-mHC端点与完整持久状态，验证下游状态、路由、预测与文本的一致性。
AI.result: 720种A模式顺序产生10个续写basin；720种B模式顺序形成360个精确结构类和11个basin。B类在某中文提示下被分为202个裁员、113个招聘和45个其他续写。P32、A、B改变所有原生参考轨迹，而C保持不变（包括路由、token序列和文本）。192轨迹C检查与原生MoE、post-mHC、next-router和LM状态逐位匹配。精确FP64重建能复现下游轨迹，并在下一个解码边界处对301个post-mHC状态、301个持久状态检查点、301个路由、预测和文本实现七步一致。
AI.conclusion: 数学等价的归约顺序在稀疏MoE中可产生可观测差异，识别出post-mHC为token内边界、完整持久状态为跨token续写边界。相同token不必然意味着相同自回归状态，分歧可在token边界后存活并延迟显现。作者主张将专家操作数转换、累加器精度和归约顺序纳入稀疏MoE运行时与硬件的数值兼容性契约，但强调这是受控因果可能性而非部署发生率，且C的顺序不变性仅限于所评估的六项状态与调度。

title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
summary: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSReward基准，系统评估视觉语言模型作为CUA轨迹验证器的可靠性，引入OS-Shepherd-100K语料库并训练OS-Shepherd（9B/35B）开源奖励模型，以更低的成本达到商业模型的可靠性水平。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）的轨迹验证对于评估、数据整理和强化学习至关重要，但人类验证无法规模化。领域转向使用VLM作为轨迹判定器，然而这些VLM判定的可靠性从未被系统研究过。
AI.method: 构建OSReward基准：从多平台智能体执行人工验证指令收集轨迹，通过多阶段人工标注获得真值判定。基于此衍生OSReward-Hard挑战集和OSReward-Multi细粒度评分集。构建OS-Shepherd-100K推理标注语料库，训练OS-Shepherd（9B和35B）开源奖励模型。
AI.result: 最全面的VLM判定器评估发现：即使最先进的模型也达不到理想判定器水平，普遍存在将失败运行误判为成功的系统性宽松偏差。少数足够可靠的模型运行成本过高，而低成本开源模型性能差距明显。OS-Shepherd能以比商业模型低30-60%的成本匹配其性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM作为CUA轨迹判定器存在可靠性瓶颈，主要是系统性宽容偏差；OS-Shepherd在成本与可靠性间提供了有效平衡，为大规模CUA奖励信号生产提供了可行路径。

title: AI and Authenticity in Islamic Research: A Critical Evaluation of Generative AI Reliability, Hallucination, and Source Fidelity in Quranic, Hadith, and Fiqh Knowledge
summary:
Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly used by Muslims for religious guidance, Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith explanation, jurisprudential rulings, and Islamic education. Despite its growing adoption, there is limited empirical evidence on whether current AI systems provide authentic, verifiable, and trustworthy Islamic knowledge suitable for high-trust religious contexts. This study evaluates six leading generative AI systems using fifty realistic open-ended Islamic questions covering Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith, Fiqh, ethics, pastoral advice, and Madhhab-sensitive topics. Responses were collected under real-world conditions from participants in Australia and the United Kingdom and analysed using a mixed-method framework examining domain accuracy, citation verification, hallucinations, jurisprudential consistency, uncertainty handling, source provenance, and geographical variation.
  The study addresses four research questions: (1) How accurate and authentic are AI-generated responses across major Islamic knowledge domains? (2) To what extent do AI systems produce hallucinations, incomplete citations, or unverifiable religious references? (3) How consistently do models handle jurisprudential disagreement, Madhhab diversity, and uncertainty? (4) Are current AI systems sufficiently reliable for religious guidance, Islamic education, and scholarly research?
  Overall, current generative AI systems are valuable as assistive tools for introductory Islamic learning but should not be treated as authoritative sources for religious rulings or Islamic research without verification against authenticated primary sources and qualified scholarly expertise. This study provides one of the first comprehensive empirical evaluations of AI reliability within Islamic knowledge, offering practical guidance for researchers, educators, AI developers, and the wider Muslim community.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统评估了六款主流生成式AI系统在伊斯兰知识领域（古兰经解释、圣训、教法学、伦理、牧灵建议及教法学派敏感话题）中的可靠性与真实性，基于来自澳大利亚和英国参与者的50个真实开放性问题，采用混合方法框架进行分析。结论表明AI可作为入门性伊斯兰学习的辅助工具，但不应被视为宗教裁决或学术研究的权威来源。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式AI在穆斯林群体中被越来越多地用于宗教指导、古兰经解释、圣训说明、教法裁决和伊斯兰教育，但缺乏实证证据来证明这些AI系统能否提供真实、可验证且值得信赖的伊斯兰知识，尤其是在高信任度的宗教场景中。
AI.method: 选取六款领先的生成式AI系统，设计50个真实开放式的伊斯兰问题（涵盖古兰经注释、圣训、教法学（Fiqh）、伦理、牧灵建议及教法学派（Madhhab）敏感话题），在真实条件下从澳大利亚和英国的参与者处收集回答，并采用混合方法框架分析领域准确性、引文验证、幻觉、教法学一致性、不确定性处理、来源溯源及地理差异，回答四个预设研究问题。
AI.result: 研究得出总体结论：当前生成式AI系统作为入门级伊斯兰学习的辅助工具具有价值，但在宗教裁决或伊斯兰学术研究中，未经与经过认证的原始资料及合格学者专业知识验证之前，不应被视为权威来源。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了伊斯兰知识领域内AI可靠性最早的全面实证评估之一，为研究人员、教育工作者、AI开发者及更广泛的穆斯林社区提供了实践指导。

title: VisualRouter: Query-Grounded Visual Sampling for Long Video Understanding
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved significant progress in video understanding, yet understanding long videos remains challenging due to the large number of visual tokens and limited context windows. Visual sampling provides a practical solution by selecting an informative subset of frames. However, existing methods typically either rely on relevance-aware sampling, leading to redundant frame selection and insufficient temporal coverage, or adopt a fixed sampling strategy regardless of query type. In this paper, we propose VisualRouter, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for query-grounded visual sampling. VisualRouter first classifies each query as either global or local and then applies the corresponding sampling strategy. For global queries, it employs a relevance-coverage hybrid strategy that preserves temporal coverage while retaining query-relevant visual evidence. For local queries, it adopts an event-aware frame selection strategy that performs event partitioning, segment-level frame allocation, and intra-event frame selection, jointly balancing relevance, coverage, and diversity with a limited number of input frames. Experiments show that VisualRouter consistently improves multiple LVLMs over uniform sampling, achieving gains of 5.2%, 7.7%, and 11.6% on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and outperforming existing training-free visual sampling methods under the same setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisualRouter，一个无需训练、即插即用的查询引导视觉采样框架，用于长视频理解。它先将查询分类为全局或局部，再分别采用不同的采样策略：全局查询使用相关性-覆盖度混合策略，局部查询使用事件感知的帧选择策略，在有限帧数下平衡相关性、覆盖度和多样性。实验在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU上分别提升5.2%、7.7%和11.6%。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型在长视频理解中面临视觉token过多和上下文窗口有限的挑战。现有视觉采样方法要么依赖相关性感知采样导致冗余和时序覆盖不足，要么采用固定采样策略忽略查询类型差异，缺乏针对查询特性进行自适应采样的有效方案。
AI.method: VisualRouter首先将每个查询分类为全局（global）或局部（local）两类。对全局查询，采用相关性-覆盖度混合（relevance-coverage hybrid）策略，在保持时序覆盖的同时保留与查询相关的视觉证据。对局部查询，采用事件感知帧选择（event-aware frame selection）策略，包含事件划分、段级帧分配和事件内帧选择三个步骤，在有限输入帧下联合平衡相关性、覆盖度和多样性。整个框架无需训练，即插即用。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，VisualRouter在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU上相比均匀采样分别获得5.2%、7.7%和11.6%的性能提升，并在相同设置下优于现有无需训练的视觉采样方法。
AI.conclusion: VisualRouter通过查询感知的二分策略和针对性的采样方法，有效解决了长视频理解中视觉采样的冗余和覆盖不足问题，为现有LVLMs提供了一种无需训练即可提升长视频理解性能的通用解决方案。

title: Information Bottleneck Learning for Faithful Time Series Forecasting Explanations
summary: As forecasts increasingly drive decisions in fields such as energy, transportation, and healthcare, understanding the historical data behind these predictions has become as crucial as the predictions themselves. Although existing interpretable-by-design forecasters reveal their internal structures, they offer no guarantee that these structures faithfully reflect the underlying evidence driving the predictions. In contrast, while faithfulness-oriented methods explicitly verify model behavior, they are almost exclusively designed for post-hoc classification tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose IB-Forecast, an inherently interpretable multivariate time-series forecasting framework. It decomposes forecasting into a learned periodic component and a residual component computed with explainable masks over input tokens. With a budget-constrained information bottleneck, end-to-end optimization enables users to directly control explanation sparsity. With a rigorous faithfulness evaluation protocol, extensive experiments demonstrate that IB-Forecast matches the forecasting error of leading black-box models while providing faithful explanations at no additional inference cost. Furthermore, under a matched sparsity budget, these native explanations consistently surpass gradient-based, occlusion-based, and optimization-based baselines across all evaluated datasets. Ultimately, whereas the native explanations of existing interpretable forecasters exhibit poor faithfulness, IB-Forecast guarantees high explanation fidelity, requiring only 14-20% of the observations to deliver low-error predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IB-Forecast，一个内在可解释的多变量时间序列预测框架。它通过将预测分解为学习到的周期成分和基于可解释掩码的残差成分，结合预算约束的信息瓶颈进行端到端优化，在匹配黑盒模型预测误差的同时提供高保真度的原生解释。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释预测器虽然能揭示内部结构，但无法保证这些结构忠实反映驱动预测的底层证据；而面向忠实性的方法几乎只针对事后分类任务。两者之间存在空白，亟需一个既能保证预测精度又能提供忠实解释的时间序列预测框架。
AI.method: IB-Forecast将多变量时间序列预测分解为两部分：学习到的周期成分和用可解释掩码在输入token上计算的残差成分。通过预算约束的信息瓶颈进行端到端优化，用户可以直接控制解释的稀疏度，并设计了严格的忠实性评估协议。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，IB-Forecast在预测误差上与领先的黑盒模型相当，同时以零额外推理成本提供忠实解释。在匹配稀疏度预算下，其原生解释在所有数据集上一致优于基于梯度、遮挡和优化的基线。仅需14-20%的观测数据即可实现低误差预测。
AI.conclusion: 现有可解释预测器的原生解释忠实性较差，而IB-Forecast保证了高解释保真度，填补了内在可解释预测器与忠实性保证之间的空白，为能源、交通、医疗等高风险决策领域提供了可靠的可解释预测工具。

title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
summary: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI系统提示词保障（AISPA）框架，用于系统性地审计商业AI产品中的系统提示词。作者使用该框架审计了88个商业AI产品中的3,249条提示词指令，发现了四个核心发现：系统提示词设计在不同产品和开发者间差异巨大；保护性指令广泛采用但覆盖深度不足；系统提示词随时间变得更长且更注重用户保护；但问题性指令仍然普遍存在（约40%产品包含至少一条）。研究凸显了商业AI系统提示词需要更大透明度、标准化和独立监管。
AI.motivation: 系统提示词在商业AI产品中广泛使用，但极少向公众或监管机构披露，形成了严重的信任和问责缺口。作者旨在通过提出系统化审计框架来弥合这一缺口，帮助用户和监管者理解这些不透明系统提示词的实际内容和影响。
AI.method: 作者首先提出AISPA框架，这是一个以用户为中心的审计框架，将系统提示词沿八个与用户相关的维度进行评估。随后利用该框架对88个商业AI产品中的3,249条提示词指令进行人工审查，将每条指令分类为"保护性"（对用户有利）或"问题性"（对用户不利）。
AI.result: 四个核心发现：(1) 系统提示词设计在不同产品和开发者间差异极大，有的组织平均每个产品超过60条保护性指令，有的不足5条；(2) 保护性指令采用广泛但浅尝辄止，98.9%的产品至少含有一条，但仅24%覆盖AISPA全部八个维度；(3) 系统提示词随时间变得更长且更注重保护用户；(4) 问题性指令仍然普遍，约40%的产品包含至少一条不利于用户利益的指令，且保护性指令与问题性指令常共存于同一提示词中。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了商业AI系统提示词在透明度、标准化和独立监督方面的迫切需求。尽管用户保护在系统提示词设计中日益受到关注，但问题性指令的普遍存在以及保护性覆盖的不均衡表明，当前的自律式发展不足以保障用户利益，需要更强的外部监督机制。

title: Operationally Guided Placement-Aware Learning for Industrial Online 3D Bin Packing
summary: The online three-dimensional bin packing problem (3D-BPP) is a longstanding challenge in logistics and industrial palletizing. Recent learning-based methods use a learned policy to select among feasible candidate placements. Performance depends on the candidate generator and representation, especially in industrial settings where packings must be space-efficient, stable, compact, and balanced. However, prior work has mainly optimized the policy, while candidate generation and representation remain largely geometry-driven. We address this gap with OPAL, an operationally guided placement-aware learning framework for industrial online 3D-BPP which combines an Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS), an operational representation for each candidate placement, and a masked ranking policy trained with proximal policy optimization. OG-EMS evaluates multiple anchors within each free-space region and prioritizes low, well-supported, compact, and spatially diverse placements. An xLSTM-based Placement Encoder models dependencies among geometric and operational candidate attributes, while a lightweight recurrent core combines the resulting embeddings with the current item and pallet state to rank feasible actions. On the BED-BPP benchmark, OPAL achieves a mean space utilization of 0.49, with improvements of 15.1% from operationally guided candidate generation and 6.3% from learned ranking, while maintaining robust inference-time performance.

AI.tldr: OPAL是一个用于工业在线三维装箱问题（3D-BPP）的操作引导式、位置感知的学习框架，结合了操作引导的空余最大空间生成器（OG-EMS）、基于xLSTM的放置编码器和掩码排序策略，在BED-BPP基准上实现了0.49的平均空间利用率，较基线提升了15.1%（候选生成）和6.3%（学习排序）。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D-BPP学习方法主要优化策略选择，而候选生成和表示仍主要依赖几何驱动，未充分考虑工业场景中对空间利用率、稳定性、紧凑性和平衡性的操作需求。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: OPAL包含三个核心组件：（1）OG-EMS生成器，在每个自由空间区域内评估多个锚点，优先选择低、支撑好、紧凑且空间多样的放置位置；（2）基于xLSTM的放置编码器，建模几何与操作候选属性之间的依赖关系；（3）轻量级循环核心，结合嵌入与当前物品和托盘状态进行可行动作排序，训练使用近端策略优化（PPO）。
AI.result: 在BED-BPP基准上，OPAL达到平均空间利用率0.49，操作引导的候选生成带来15.1%的提升，学习排序带来6.3%的提升，同时保持稳健的推理性能。
AI.conclusion: OPAL验证了操作引导的候选生成和操作感知的表示学习能够显著提升工业在线3D-BPP的性能，表明仅优化策略而忽视候选生成环节会限制整体效果。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Reason about AI Edits in Images?
summary: Detection and localization of AI-tampered images are critical for trustworthy AI, yet modern generative models have made such manipulations increasingly difficult to identify. While traditional binary classifiers can detect image tampering, they lack interpretability and generalization. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative due to their strong visual understanding and reasoning capabilities; however, existing approaches typically rely on supervised finetuning with curated explanations rather than exploiting their inherent reasoning capabilities. In this work, we investigate whether VLMs can be trained to reason about AI-generated image edits using reinforcement learning (RL) rather than explicit reasoning supervision. Motivated by the success in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), an RL technique that incentivizes the model to reason by generating thinking traces prior to giving the final answer, we propose a GRPO-based training framework that utilizes simple accuracy and format rewards. Given an input image, the model produces a structured reasoning trace and predicts whether the image has been tampered with. A lightweight segmentation model is then guided by the reasoning output to generate pixel-level localization masks. Experiments across multiple image manipulation datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive detection and localization performance compared to state-of-the-art image forgery detectors, despite requiring substantially weaker supervision. We introduce effective intersection over union (eff-IoU), a unified metric to jointly evaluate detection and localization. These results suggest that reinforcement learning provides an effective and scalable mechanism for teaching VLMs to reason about AI-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于GRPO强化学习的训练框架，使视觉语言模型（VLM）无需显式推理监督即可学会检测和定位AI篡改图像。模型生成结构化推理轨迹进行二分类检测，再引导轻量级分割模型生成像素级定位掩码，并引入统一指标eff-IoU联合评估检测与定位性能。
AI.motivation: AI生成模型使图像篡改越来越难以识别，传统二分类检测器缺乏可解释性和泛化能力。现有的VLM方法依赖有监督微调配合人工策划的解释，未能充分利用VLM固有的推理能力，因此需要探索能否通过强化学习而非显式推理监督来训练VLM进行AI图像篡改推理。
AI.method: 采用基于GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）的训练框架，利用简单的准确率奖励和格式奖励。模型输入图像后产生结构化推理轨迹并输出篡改二分类结果，随后由轻量级分割模型根据推理输出生成像素级定位掩码。同时提出eff-IoU作为统一指标联合评估检测和定位性能。
AI.result: 在多个图像篡改数据集上的实验表明，该方法尽管使用显著较弱的监督，但仍能达到与最先进的图像伪造检测器相当的检测和定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习为训练VLM推理AI生成内容提供了一种有效且可扩展的机制，表明无需显式推理监督即可使模型学会对AI篡改图像进行检测与定位。

title: LM-GRASP: Instance-Specific Language Models for Combinatorial Construction via Online Imitation Learning
summary:
Machine learning for combinatorial optimization typically relies on neural constructors trained via reinforcement learning on large offline datasets for a fixed problem class-incurring high pretraining costs and generalizing poorly outside the training distribution. We propose an alternative: a metaheuristic framework that reformulates the randomized constructive phase of GRASP as an online imitation learning task, trained from scratch on each problem instance. A local search procedure acts as an expert oracle, while a decoder-only Transformer serves as the constructive policy. Unlike classical GRASP, which relies on static, myopic heuristic rules based on localized scalar costs, our approach is fully data-driven: the construction policy emerges from high-quality solutions discovered during the search itself, with no problem-specific feature engineering required.
  We instantiate this as LM-GRASP, a hybrid metaheuristic following an iterative learn-infer-improve cycle, training the policy online via behavioral cloning on a dynamic archive of elite trajectories-no external data or offline pretraining needed. The pipeline interfaces with the domain solely through the objective evaluator used by local search.
  Evaluated on the Taillard PFSP benchmark (ta51-ta60), the most discriminating block due to half its optima being unknown, LM-GRASP outperforms GPU-GRASP by 28.4 makespan units on average-comparable to the gain from GPU acceleration over sequential execution (27.2 units), though with overlapping standard deviations. This suggests instance-specific, online-trained language models are a promising, practical alternative to hand-engineered constructors, especially for landscapes resistant to classical greedy construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LM-GRASP，一种将GRASP的随机构造阶段重构为在线模仿学习任务的元启发式框架。每个问题实例从头训练策略，无需离线数据集或预训练，通过局部搜索作为专家、Decoder-only Transformer作为构造策略，在Taillard PFSP基准上超越GPU-GRASP约28.4个makespan单位。
AI.motivation: 传统基于机器学习的组合优化方法需要大规模离线数据集的强化学习预训练，成本高昂且对训练分布之外的问题泛化能力差。经典GRASP依赖静态、短视的启发式规则，缺乏数据驱动能力。
AI.method: 将GRASP的随机构造阶段重构为在线模仿学习任务：局部搜索充当专家预言，Decoder-only Transformer作为构造策略。采用learn-infer-improve迭代循环，通过行为克隆在动态精英轨迹存档上在线训练策略。完全无需外部数据或离线预训练，仅通过目标评估器与领域交互。
AI.result: 在Taillard PFSP基准(ta51-ta60)上，LM-GRASP平均比GPU-GRASP优28.4个makespan单位，与GPU加速相对串行执行带来的27.2单位提升相当（标准差有重叠）。
AI.conclusion: 实例特定、在线训练的语言模型是手工设计构造器的一种有前景的实用替代方案，尤其适用于对经典贪心构造具有抵抗力的问题景观。

title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Constraint Model Reformulation to Improve Solver Efficiency
summary: Combinatorial problems appear in numerous industrial applications. A common approach is to formulate these problems as declarative constraint models that can subsequently be compiled to and solved by a range of back-end solvers. Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can produce correct models from natural language, but even a correct model can be expensive to solve because performance remains sensitive to modelling choices. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs can automate performance-oriented model reformulation. Inspired by Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD), we use an evolutionary framework in which an LLM proposes candidate reformulations that are verified and benchmarked against the user-defined baseline model. We compare AHD-adapted search strategies that control which prior attempts, instructions, and measured feedback enter each prompt. Existing retention strategies prioritize recency or performance, but do not explicitly diversify the context. To cover this gap, we introduce Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR), which applies Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to instance-level runtime vectors to retain behaviourally diverse attempts. We systematically evaluate the strategies on eight CSPLib problems using validation-based final model selection. The results show that: (i) iterative reformulation can produce substantial held-out speedups; (ii) strategies that keep the retained context diverse outperform those that retain only recent or the fastest attempts; and (iii) validation-based selection improves the held-out speedup of every strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何利用大型语言模型（LLMs）自动化地进行面向性能的约束模型重构。受自动启发式设计（AHD）启发，作者提出一个进化框架，其中LLM作为变异算子提出候选重构方案，并通过验证和基准测试与用户定义的基线模型进行比较。文章引入Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR)策略，利用最大边际相关性（MMR）对实例级运行时向量进行筛选，以保留行为多样化的历史尝试。在八个CSPLib问题上的系统实验表明：迭代重构能带来显著的持有集加速；保持上下文多样性的策略优于仅保留最近或最快尝试的策略；基于验证集的选择能改善所有策略的持有集加速效果。
AI.motivation: 组合优化问题广泛应用于工业场景，通常被建模为声明式约束模型并由后端求解器求解。虽然LLM可以从自然语言生成正确的模型，但即使正确的模型也可能因为建模选择不当而求解代价高昂。现有研究缺乏对LLM自动化性能导向模型重构能力的探索，且已有的进化搜索策略在上下文保留上未考虑多样性，导致搜索效率受限。
AI.method: 提出一个基于进化的框架，使用LLM作为候选重构方案的生成器。候选方案被验证并在用户定义的基准模型上进行基准测试。核心贡献是Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR)策略：利用最大边际相关性（MMR）对实例级运行时向量进行排序和筛选，在保留高性能尝试的同时显式维护上下文的多样性。作者系统比较了多种AHD改编的搜索策略，这些策略控制哪些先前的尝试、指令和测量反馈被纳入每次提示中，并使用基于验证集的最终模型选择进行系统评估。
AI.result: 在八个CSPLib问题上的实验结果表明：（i）迭代重构可以产生显著的持有集加速；（ii）保持保留上下文多样性的策略（如PDR）优于仅保留最近或最快尝试的策略；（iii）基于验证集的选择方法能够改善所有策略的持有集加速表现。
AI.conclusion: LLM可以有效地自动化性能导向的约束模型重构过程。在进化搜索过程中，保持历史尝试的行为多样性比简单的近期优先或性能优先策略更为有效，同时基于验证集的选择能够进一步提升最终模型的泛化性能。

title: Towards Real-Time PixOOD: Efficient Anomaly Segmentation for Autonomous Vehicles
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Efficient Deep Learning: Methods and Applications workshop, 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
summary: Real-time anomaly segmentation is essential for the safety of autonomous systems. Although recent approaches offer high accuracy, their computational cost limits their deployment on embedded hardware. This work presents an efficient and accelerated pipeline designed for both embedded and desktop platforms, targeting the autonomous driving and railway domains. The proposed approach reformulates the Neyman-Pearson scoring stage of PixOOD, a state-of-the-art out-of-distribution detection method, and deploys the full pipeline through hardware-optimized TensorRT compilation, reaching up to 182 FPS on a desktop NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU and 75 FPS on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin embedded platform, respectively 20x and 18x faster than the original baseline. The achieved results demonstrate that advanced anomaly segmentation can be efficiently deployed for onboard processing in autonomous driving and railway applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的实时异常分割流水线，通过重构PixOOD的Neyman-Pearson评分阶段并采用TensorRT硬件优化编译，在桌面RTX 4060 GPU上达到182 FPS，在嵌入式Jetson AGX Orin平台上达到75 FPS，分别比原始基线快20倍和18倍，实现了自动驾驶和铁路领域的高级异常分割在嵌入式设备上的高效部署。
AI.motivation: 现有实时异常分割方法虽然精度高，但计算开销大，限制了其在嵌入式硬件上的部署。面向自动驾驶和铁路领域的板载实时异常分割需求迫切，需要在保证精度的同时大幅提升推理速度。
AI.method: 提出一种高效的加速流水线：(1) 重新公式化PixOOD（当前最先进的分布外检测方法）中的Neyman-Pearson评分阶段以降低计算复杂度；(2) 通过硬件优化的TensorRT编译部署完整流水线，同时面向嵌入式（Jetson AGX Orin）和桌面（RTX 4060）平台进行优化。
AI.result: 在桌面NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU上达到182 FPS，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin嵌入式平台上达到75 FPS，分别比原始基线快20倍和18倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，先进异常分割技术可以高效部署于自动驾驶和铁路应用中的板载处理场景，验证了该加速流水线在资源受限环境下的实用性与可行性。

authors: Jacobus G. M. van der Linden
title: Search Strategies for Optimal Classification and Regression Trees
summary: Optimal decision trees (ODTs) are compact, interpretable machine learning models that globally optimize a given objective, but their scalability remains challenging. While recent work has proposed a variety of search strategies to improve scalability, the precise contribution of each strategy remains unclear. To address this gap, we introduce a general algorithmic framework for ODTs that instantiates previously used search strategies and enables the definition of new ones. This provides a common lens through which to understand and compare different strategies, which we use to empirically investigate the effect of 18 search strategies. Compared to the state of the art, the best strategy in our evaluation achieves significantly better anytime performance for classification, and improves runtime by more than an order of magnitude for regression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通用的最优决策树（ODT）算法框架，该框架能够实例化已有的搜索策略并定义新策略，从而统一理解和比较不同搜索策略。通过实证评估18种搜索策略，发现最佳策略在分类任务上显著优于当前最佳方法的任意时刻性能，并在回归任务上将运行时间提升了一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 最优决策树（ODTs）虽然具有紧凑可解释的优点，但可扩展性仍然是挑战。尽管近期工作提出了多种搜索策略来提升可扩展性，但每种策略的具体贡献尚不清晰，缺乏系统性的统一比较框架。
AI.method: 提出一个通用的ODT算法框架，该框架可以实例化已有的搜索策略并支持定义新的策略，为理解和比较不同的搜索策略提供了统一的视角。基于此框架，对18种搜索策略进行了实证研究。
AI.result: 在18种搜索策略中，最佳策略在分类任务上取得了显著优于现有最优方法的任意时刻性能（anytime performance），并且在回归任务中将运行时间提升了一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一的算法框架可以系统地评估和比较ODT的搜索策略，且发现更优的搜索策略能显著提升ODT在分类和回归任务上的可扩展性和效率。

title: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed
summary: Retrieving past experiences has become a common strategy to enhance large language model agents. However, most existing memory-augmented agents treat retrieved experiences as static records to be replayed verbatim, injecting them into the context regardless of whether they align with the agent's current situation. This ``replay'' paradigm ignores the gap between the abstract, general nature of stored experience and the concrete, ever-changing states encountered at decision time, frequently causing negative transfer. In contrast, humans rarely recall past experiences verbatim; instead, they reorganize and adapt retrieved memories to fit the present context. Inspired by this, we propose MemHarness, a framework that equips LLM agents to actively harness and reconstruct past experiences based on the present context. At each decision step, a unified policy model critiques and reconstructs the retrieved experience conditioned on the current state, producing context-grounded guidance before acting. This reconstructive ability emerges naturally through end-to-end training with GRPO. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that MemHarness substantially outperforms pure RL and static memory-augmented baselines, demonstrating strong robustness in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Furthermore, our analyses reveal that this reconstruction objective not only prevents negative transfer but also serves as latent guidance during training, fundamentally improving the agent's intrinsic reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: MemHarness是一个框架，让LLM智能体根据当前情境主动重构和适应检索到的过往经验，而非直接重放静态记忆，通过GRPO端到端训练实现，在ALFWorld和WebShop上显著优于纯RL和静态记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体将检索到的经验视为静态记录直接重放注入上下文，忽视了存储经验的抽象通用性与决策时具体多变状态之间的差距，经常导致负迁移。人类回忆过去经验时并非逐字重放，而是重组和改编以适应当前情境，受此启发提出MemHarness。
AI.method: MemHarness框架让LLM智能体在每一步决策时，由统一策略模型基于当前状态对检索到的经验进行批判和重构，生成情境化的指导后再行动。该重构能力通过GRPO端到端训练自然涌现。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上，MemHarness显著优于纯强化学习和静态记忆增强基线，并在分布外（OOD）场景中展现出强鲁棒性。分析表明重构目标不仅防止负迁移，还在训练中充当潜在指导，从根本上提升了智能体的内在推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种从"重放"向"重构"转变的记忆利用范式，验证了情境化经验重建对LLM智能体的价值，且该目标在训练阶段可作为隐式引导信号提升模型基础推理能力。

title: AuricularWorld: Hierarchical Action-Guided World Modeling for Fine-Grained Auricular Structure Segmentation from CT Scans
summary: Fine-grained segmentation of auricular structures in CT is challenging because the ear occupies a small image region, cartilage boundaries are highly irregular, and interfaces between cartilage and surrounding soft tissues are often ambiguous. Clinical annotations may also include both composite structures containing cartilage and adjacent skin and their corresponding cartilage-only regions, producing nested and overlapping labels. We propose a world-model-based segmentation framework that enables iterative anatomical reasoning beyond conventional feed-forward prediction. Built on an encoder-decoder architecture, the framework introduces a deterministic recurrent state-space model into the intermediate latent space. Multi-scale encoder features and partially decoded representations are fused to form a structural observation that initializes the latent dynamics. During inference, the model performs a three-step latent rollout without ground-truth guidance. Hierarchical anatomical actions update the recurrent state and progressively refine the latent representation. The resulting latent trajectory is projected back into the decoder and combined with high-resolution features to produce the final segmentation. To learn reliable latent transitions, we introduce a balanced hierarchical action objective that addresses foreground sparsity, missing anatomical groups, and imbalance between add and remove operations. Extensive experiments show that the proposed framework consistently improves segmentation accuracy and reduces HD95 by more than 43% for small, irregular, and overlapping auricular structures in CT. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of latent world-model reasoning for challenging medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于世界模型的CT耳廓结构分割框架，通过确定性循环状态空间模型在中间潜空间中进行迭代解剖推理，有效解决小区域、不规则边界和嵌套重叠标签的分割难题，在HD95指标上降低超过43%。
AI.motivation: 耳廓CT图像分割极具挑战性：耳部图像区域小、软骨边界高度不规则、软骨与周围软组织界面模糊，且临床标注存在嵌套和重叠标签（复合结构与其对应的软骨单独区域）。传统前馈预测式分割方法难以应对这些复杂性。
AI.method: 基于编码器-解码器架构，在中间潜空间中引入确定性循环状态空间模型。具体包括：(1) 融合多尺度编码器特征与部分解码表示形成结构观测，用于初始化潜动力；(2) 推理时执行三步潜空间展开（latent rollout），无需真实标签引导；(3) 通过分层解剖动作更新循环状态并逐步细化潜表示；(4) 将潜轨迹投影回解码器并与高分辨率特征结合生成最终分割；(5) 提出平衡分层动作目标函数，解决前景稀疏、解剖组缺失以及添加/删除操作不平衡问题。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提框架在CT中分割小尺寸、不规则且重叠的耳廓结构时持续提升分割精度，HD95指标降低超过43%，验证了潜世界模型推理在挑战性医学图像分割中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间世界模型推理能够超越传统前馈预测范式，通过迭代解剖推理显著改善复杂医学图像的分割性能，为医学图像分割提供了新的范式思路。

title: Multi-channel Uplift Policy Learning
summary: E-commerce platforms must allocate fixed marketing budgets across multiple channels to maximize business utility. However, standard predict-then-optimize (PTO) paradigms fail in this compositional space due to observational confounding and severe extrapolation. We formulate this challenge as a simplex-constrained uplift decision problem and propose ReAlloc, a fast-slow causal framework. Specifically, an agile Orthogonal Teacher extracts unbiased local gradients from short-term logs, while an Explanation-Guided Student distills them into a structured marginal field over long-term horizons. This design enables support-aware, conservative decisions that capture cross-channel substitutions. Extensive simulations and large-scale online A/B tests on Taobao platform demonstrate that ReAlloc achieves simultaneous lifts in both pay order and income.

AI.tldr: 提出ReAlloc框架，将电商多渠道营销预算分配建模为单纯形约束的增量决策问题，通过快速-慢速因果学习框架（正交教师网络提取无偏局部梯度 + 解释引导学生网络蒸馏为长期结构化边际场），实现支持感知的保守决策，并在淘宝平台的大规模A/B测试中同时提升支付订单量和收入。
AI.motivation: 标准预测-再优化（PTO）范式在电商多渠道预算分配的组合空间中存在观测混杂和严重外推问题，导致预算分配决策不可靠。需要一种新的因果视角来应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 将多渠道预算分配建模为单纯形约束的增量（uplift）决策问题，提出ReAlloc快速-慢速因果框架：(1) 敏捷正交教师网络（Orthogonal Teacher）从短期日志中提取无偏的局部梯度；(2) 解释引导学生网络（Explanation-Guided Student）将这些梯度蒸馏为覆盖长期时域的结构化边际场。该设计支持支持感知（support-aware）的保守决策，并能捕获跨渠道替代效应。
AI.result: 通过大量模拟实验和淘宝平台的大规模线上A/B测试验证，ReAlloc在支付订单量和收入两个指标上同时获得提升。
AI.conclusion: ReAlloc框架有效解决了电商多渠道预算分配中PTO范式的不足，通过因果学习与知识蒸馏结合的方式在真实业务中取得了显著效果，证明了该方法的实用性和可扩展性。

title: Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3
comment: 52 pages, 18 figures, 17 tables. Open-source implementation: https://github.com/NIMI-research/Tycho
summary:
ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and game-over frames. From this structured history, an agent can model, test, plan with, repair, or bypass a free-form executable hypothesis.
  In one matched public-set run per policy, we compare four orchestration policies on all 25 public games using Claude Opus 4.8 under matched inference budgets. Actor-requested delegation to a model builder obtains the highest observed mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), 88.49. With this selected policy, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 both reach 100.00 RHAE and complete all 183 levels. Their game-balanced first-run human-replay midranks are 98.5 and 100.0. Opus 5 uses 61% fewer scored actions than the aggregate official human baselines.
  Automatic repair after verification failures produces models that reproduce observed transitions much more accurately, yet reaches only 83.07 RHAE. Transition match indicates whether a simulator reproduces observed dynamics, not whether it has identified the objective or improves the next action. Strong play also requires deciding when to construct, repair, use, or bypass a model. We call this joint problem active abstraction: generating a testable model from costly interaction and deciding when acquiring or using it is worth its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARC-AGI-3，将抽象推理转化为交互式技能获取问题，并引入Tycho编码代理系统，通过构建和使用游戏特定模型来提升行动效率。在25个公开游戏中，基于Claude Opus 4.8的对比实验显示，actor委托模型构建者的编排策略达到最高88.49的相对人类行动效率（RHAE），GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5两个模型均达到100.00 RHAE并完成全部183个关卡。文章还提出"主动抽象"（active abstraction）这一核心概念，强调在交互中决定何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型的重要性。
AI.motivation: 传统抽象推理基准多为静态的、离线的问题求解，而实际智能体需要在不完全信息下进行交互式技能获取，每个行动都有代价。作者希望将抽象推理转化为一个交互式问题，考察智能体能否在行动预算受限的情况下推断游戏规则、隐藏状态与目标，并研究如何高效地构建和使用模型来降低行动成本。
AI.method: 将环境形式化为参数化渲染的确定性Moore机器；提出Tycho编码代理系统，将可操作的观察从中间动画、关卡完成和游戏结束帧中分离出来，从结构化历史中建模、测试、规划、修复或绕过可执行假设。对比四种编排策略：actor委托模型构建、自动修复、以及基线策略，在相同推理预算下于25个公开游戏中进行评估。
AI.result: 基于Claude Opus 4.8的匹配预算对比中，actor-requested delegation策略获得最高的平均RHAE（88.49）。选定该策略后，GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE并完成全部183个关卡，其中Opus 5的人类回放中位排名为100.0，比官方人类基线少用61%的计分动作。自动修复虽能显著提高模型对观察转移的复现精度，但RHAE仅为83.07，说明转移匹配并不等同于识别目标或提升下一步行动。
AI.conclusion: 单纯提高模拟器的转移匹配精度不足以获得高性能，强玩法还需要智能地决定何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型。作者将这种"从代价高昂的交互中生成可测试模型，并决定获取或使用模型是否值得其代价"的联合问题称为"主动抽象"（active abstraction）。

title: RefCaptioner: Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
summary: Existing video captioning models generate natural descriptions of video content but cannot explicitly ground local visual elements to multiple reference images. We introduce multi-reference image-grounded video captioning, a new task requiring factual video descriptions with phrase-level reference grounding, and propose RefCaptioner, a two-stage post-training framework for this task. RefCaptioner combines mixed-data SFT with Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO to jointly improve reference selection, phrase-level binding, distractor rejection, and cross-reference consistency while preserving general video-captioning ability. To support training, we construct a corpus containing $20,000$ videos and 171,354 reference images. We further introduce MRVBench, a benchmark for evaluating caption factuality and multi-reference grounding on both real-world and AI-generated videos. Experiments show that RefCaptioner achieves the best overall performance among the open-source models while remaining competitive on standard video captioning benchmarks. Human evaluation further confirms that its captions are preferred by annotators and enable more source-faithful video reconstruction with both open-source and proprietary video generators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多参考图像引导的视频字幕生成任务，并设计了RefCaptioner两阶段后训练框架，通过混合数据SFT和分层覆盖折扣GRPO，实现对多个参考图像的短语级绑定、干扰项拒绝和跨参考一致性，构建了含2万视频和17万参考图像的数据集及MRVBench评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视频字幕生成模型虽然能生成自然语言描述，但无法将局部视觉元素显式绑定到多个参考图像上。这一能力对于需要精确视觉指称的场景（如可控视频生成、视觉问答）至关重要，因此需要新的任务设定和训练框架来解决。
AI.method: RefCaptioner采用两阶段后训练框架：1)混合数据SFT（Mixed-data SFT），融合多参考图像引导数据和通用视频字幕数据；2)分层覆盖折扣GRPO（Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO）强化学习，同时优化参考选择、短语级绑定、干扰项拒绝和跨参考一致性四个维度。此外构建了包含20,000个视频和171,354张参考图像的训练语料。
AI.result: RefCaptioner在MRVBench基准上（涵盖真实世界和AI生成视频）取得了开源模型中的最佳综合性能，同时在标准视频字幕基准上保持竞争力。人类评估显示其字幕更受标注者偏好，并且能通过开源及闭源视频生成器实现更忠于源内容的视频重建。
AI.conclusion: RefCaptioner验证了多参考图像引导的视频字幕生成任务的可行性，证明两阶段后训练框架能有效实现短语级视觉绑定，且生成的字幕不仅质量更优，还能直接服务于下游视频重建任务，展示了该任务的广泛应用前景。

title: One Human, $N$ Agents: Audit-Budget Allocation for LLM Agent Fleets under Miscalibrated, Correlated Confidence
summary: A single human must audit $N$ LLM agents under a budget of $B \ll N$ audits per round, guided by self-reported confidence that may be adversarially miscalibrated and by correlated errors. We model this as budgeted noisy inspection over a two-level Gaussian copula and locate the miscalibration threshold $δ^*$ past which confidence-ranked auditing is \emph{worse} than random. Two a-priori expectations reverse: $δ^*$ \emph{rises} as the budget shrinks, and cross-family correlation is not low---shared difficulty dominates lineage. Five open-weight LLMs show operationally useless (near-constant) confidence, point estimates at or beyond the flip though CIs straddle it; a proprietary model is informative and lands below it. We give a quantitative criterion for \emph{vacuous} oversight, and replaying policies on recorded traces confirms the ordering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在预算有限（B≪N）条件下，单人审计多个LLM智能体的问题。通过两级高斯copula模型对预算受限的噪声检查建模，找到了置信度排名的校准阈值δ*，并发现两个违反直觉的结论：预算越小δ*越高，跨族相关性并非低（共享难度主导血缘）。实验表明五个开源LLM的置信度近乎恒定、操作上无用，而专有模型信息充足且低于阈值。文章给出了"空洞监督"的量化判据，并通过轨迹回放确认了策略排序。
AI.motivation: 现实中需要对大量LLM智能体进行有限预算审计，但智能体自报置信度可能被对抗性错误校准且存在相关误差，这使得基于置信度的审计排序策略可能失效甚至劣于随机选择。作者希望找到量化判据来判断何时置信度排名审计有效、何时失效（空洞监督），从而指导审计资源分配。
AI.method: 将预算受限的噪声检查建模为两级高斯copula（two-level Gaussian copula），在理论上推导置信度排名审核优于随机审核所需的误校准阈值δ*。随后对多个开源LLM（五个）和一个专有模型的置信度行为进行实证分析，并在记录的真实轨迹上回放不同审计策略以验证理论排序。
AI.result: 发现两个反转先验预期的结果：δ*随预算缩减而上升（预算越小，置信度排名越难劣于随机）；跨模型家族的相关性并不低，共享难度比血缘关系更主导误差相关性。实证中五个开源LLM的置信度近似恒定、操作上无用，其点估计超出或恰在翻转阈值处（但置信区间跨越阈值）；专有模型置信度信息充足且低于阈值。轨迹回放证实了理论排序。
AI.conclusion: 置信度排名审计的效用高度依赖误校准程度，存在明确的阈值δ*；开源模型的自报置信度在当前水平下无法支持可靠的排名审计，而专有模型可以。本文给出了量化"空洞监督"的判据，为有限预算下LLM审计策略的选择提供了理论基础与实证依据。

title: Beyond Frame Selection: Generative Latent Evidence Aggregation for Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding commonly compresses videos into a small set of frames or visual tokens for answer generation. Existing compact pipelines focus on retaining relevant visual content as explicit evidence. Yet making evidence available does not ensure that complementary cues across moments are integrated for answering. Our key idea is to organize selected frames into query-relevant cross-frame evidence before generation. We formulate this post-selection stage as a latent evidence interface and instantiate it with GenEvA ($\textbf{Gen}erative$ $Latent$ $\textbf{Ev}idence$ $\textbf{A}ggregation$), a distribution-guided latent evidence aggregation framework. Specifically, GenEvA uses a query-conditioned evidence distribution to focus aggregation on relevant frames, forming compact cross-frame latent evidence from their frame-specific information. Since cross-frame integration is not always needed, the same distribution determines whether to insert this latent complement. Across four benchmarks and two Video-MLLM backbones, GenEvA consistently improves matched-frame baselines. At 8 frames, it raises the four-benchmark LLaVA-Video average by $+5.2$ points and Qwen2.5-VL accuracy on LVBench by $+10.1$ points. These gains require only $0.11\%$--$0.40\%$ average video-token overhead; analyses further show task-aware allocation and benefits from Adaptive Evidence Invocation.

AI.tldr: GenEvA是一个生成式潜在证据聚合框架，通过查询条件的证据分布将选定的视频帧组织为跨帧潜在证据，在几乎零开销的情况下显著提升长视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有紧凑型长视频理解管线虽然已选择相关帧作为显式证据，但仅仅"可用"的证据无法保证互补线索在不同时刻间被整合用于答案生成。研究者认为需要在生成前将选定帧组织为查询相关的跨帧证据。
AI.method: 提出GenEvA（生成式潜在证据聚合）框架，将后选择阶段形式化为潜在证据接口。使用查询条件证据分布聚焦于相关帧的聚合，形成紧凑的跨帧潜在证据；同时同一分布决定是否需要插入该潜在补充（自适应证据调用）。
AI.result: 在四个基准和两个Video-MLLM骨干上一致优于匹配帧基线。在8帧设置下，LLaVA-Video四基准平均提升+5.2点，Qwen2.5-VL在LVBench上准确率提升+10.1点。视频token开销仅增加0.11%-0.40%。
AI.conclusion: GenEvA证明了在视频理解生成前进行查询相关的跨帧潜在证据聚合是有效且高效的，任务感知的证据分配和自适应证据调用机制能进一步提升性能，且额外token开销极小。

title: TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning
summary: We introduce Topoformer, a lightweight and scalable framework for graph representation learning that encodes topological structure into attention-friendly sequences. At the core of our method is Topo-Scan, a novel module that decomposes a graph into a short, ordered sequence of topological tokens by slicing over node or edge filtrations. These sequences capture multi-scale structural patterns, from local motifs to global organization, and are processed by a Transformer to produce expressive graph-level embeddings. Unlike traditional persistent homology pipelines, Topo-Scan is parallelizable, avoids costly diagram computations, and integrates seamlessly with standard deep learning architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees on the stability of our topological encodings and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks. Our results show that Topoformer matches or exceeds strong GNN and topology-based baselines while offering predictable and efficient compute. This work opens a new path for parallelizable and unifying approaches to graph representation learning that integrate topological inductive biases into attention frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Topoformer，一种轻量级且可扩展的图表示学习框架，通过Topo-Scan模块将图的拓扑结构编码为注意力友好的有序序列，使Transformer能够直接处理图的拓扑信息，在图分类和分子性质预测上达到或超越现有GNN及拓扑方法。
AI.motivation: 传统持久同调（persistent homology）方法虽然在图表示学习中能提供丰富的拓扑信息，但其计算代价高昂、需要昂贵的图表（diagram）计算且难以并行化，难以与现代深度学习架构无缝集成；同时现有的GNN方法缺乏对全局拓扑结构的显式建模。因此需要一个既能捕获多尺度拓扑结构、又高效可并行、且能自然融入Transformer架构的图表示学习方法。
AI.method: Topoformer的核心是Topo-Scan模块，该模块通过沿节点或边过滤（filtration）进行切片，将图分解为一段短而有序的拓扑token序列。这些token捕获从局部模体到全局组织的多尺度结构模式，随后由Transformer处理以产生具有表达力的图级嵌入。该方法避免了传统持久同调中的图表计算，支持并行化，并能与标准深度学习架构无缝集成。
AI.result: 实验表明Topoformer在图分类和分子性质预测基准上取得最先进性能，匹配或超越强GNN和基于拓扑的基线方法，同时提供可预测且高效的计算开销。论文还提供了拓扑编码稳定性的理论保证。
AI.conclusion: Topoformer为图表示学习开辟了一条新的路径，通过将拓扑归纳偏置集成到注意力框架中，实现了并行化与统一性的兼顾，兼具理论稳定性保证和实际高效性。

title: PathView-Bench: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Achieve Fine-grained Multiscale Understanding of Pathology Images?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to analyze pathology images. However, dominant multimodal benchmarks in pathology mainly score final diagnostic answers, captions, or reports. These evaluations provide limited insight into whether a model understands the multiscale visual content needed for pathology reasoning and decision-making. We introduce PathVU, a vision-anchored benchmark for fine-grained and multiscale visual understanding in computational pathology. Built from 23 public pathology imaging datasets with human-supervised labels and spatial annotations, PathVU evaluates MLLM understanding in two fields of view: Region FOV for high-resolution local regions and Slide FOV for macro whole-slide views. By converting raw annotations into deterministic task targets, PathVU enables programmatic scoring of region localization, visual recognition, quantity estimation, spatial reasoning, and insufficient-context judgment. The benchmark contains 14 VQA-style tasks, 61,673 images, and 308,070 samples across 28 organs and 7,253,526 annotations. Evaluating 18 representative general-purpose, medical-domain, and pathology-oriented MLLMs, we observe substantial limitations even in advanced models on fine-grained visual tasks across multiscale pathology images. PathVU provides a reproducible basis for developing and evaluating pathology MLLMs with explicit multiscale visual understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathVU，一个面向病理学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的视觉锚定基准，用于细粒度、多尺度的视觉理解评估。该基准基于23个公开病理数据集构建，包含61,673张图像和308,070个样本，覆盖14个VQA任务和28个器官，通过确定性任务目标实现区域定位、视觉识别、数量估计、空间推理和上下文不足判断的可编程评分。评估18个代表性MLLMs后发现即使在先进模型上也存在显著局限。
AI.motivation: 现有病理学多模态基准主要评估最终诊断答案、标题或报告，无法深入判断模型是否真正理解病理推理和决策所需的多尺度视觉内容。这限制了我们对MLLMs在病理学中视觉理解能力的准确评估。
AI.method: PathVU从23个公开病理成像数据集中构建，利用人工监督标签和空间标注，将原始标注转换为确定性任务目标，实现程序化评分。基准覆盖两个视野：Region FOV（高分辨率局部区域）和Slide FOV（宏观全切片视图），包含区域定位、视觉识别、数量估计、空间推理和上下文不足判断等14个VQA任务。
AI.result: 对18个代表性通用、医学领域和病理定向MLLMs的评估揭示了即使在先进模型上，多尺度病理图像上的细粒度视觉任务仍存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: PathVU为开发和评估具有明确多尺度视觉理解能力的病理MLLMs提供了可复现的基础。

title: What to Remove, What to Preserve: Dual-Ambiguity Rectification for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: All-in-one image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified framework. Existing methods commonly encode heterogeneous degradation conditions in a shared latent space, where degradation-related cues and scene content can remain entangled. We characterize the resulting challenge as dual ambiguity: semantic ambiguity in channel-wise modulation and spatial ambiguity in restoration responses, which can lead to content corruption and residual artifacts. To mitigate this issue, we propose DAR-Net, a Dual-Ambiguity Rectification Network for all-in-one image restoration. DAR-Net first introduces a Degradation Archetype Representation (DAR) module to construct a structured degradation state through simplex-constrained archetype mixture modeling. Based on this state, a Semantic Ambiguity Rectification (SeAR) module generates degradation-aware prompts to improve channel-wise conditioning in the decoder. A Spatial Ambiguity Rectification (SpAR) module further regularizes degradation-aware and complementary features toward orthogonal response subspaces, reducing spatial interference between removal and preservation cues. Extensive experiments on standard all-in-one restoration benchmarks show that DAR-Net achieves the best overall performance under both three-degradation and five-degradation settings, improving the average PSNR over the strongest competitor by 0.14 dB and 0.34 dB, respectively; it additionally shows superior performance on CDD-11 and WeatherBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAR-Net，一种双歧义校正网络，用于解决全合一图像恢复中异质退化条件在共享潜在空间中纠缠所导致的语义歧义（通道调制）和空间歧义（恢复响应）问题，通过退化原型表示、语义歧义校正和空间歧义校正三个模块，在标准基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全合一图像恢复方法将异质退化条件编码到共享潜在空间中，导致退化相关线索与场景内容相互纠缠，产生"双歧义"问题——通道级调制的语义歧义和恢复响应的空间歧义，进而引起内容损坏和残余伪影。
AI.method: 提出DAR-Net，包含三个核心模块：(1) 退化原型表示(DAR)模块，通过单纯形约束的原型混合建模构建结构化退化状态；(2) 语义歧义校正(SeAR)模块，基于退化状态生成退化感知提示以改善解码器中的通道级条件化；(3) 空间歧义校正(SpAR)模块，将退化感知与互补特征正则化到正交响应子空间，减少移除与保留线索之间的空间干扰。
AI.result: 在标准全合一恢复基准上，DAR-Net在三种退化和五种退化设置下均取得最佳总体性能，平均PSNR分别比最强竞争方法提升0.14 dB和0.34 dB；在CDD-11和WeatherBench上同样表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式地解耦和校正通道层级的语义歧义与空间层级的响应歧义，DAR-Net有效缓解了共享潜在空间中的退化-内容纠缠问题，显著提升了全合一图像恢复的性能，验证了双歧义校正思路的有效性。

title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip large language models (LLMs) with domain knowledge for high-performance computing (HPC) tasks such as data race detection and benchmark question answering. However, knowledge alone does not guarantee task-appropriate behavior: the same SFT model that correctly classifies 88.65\% of C/C++ data race samples produces verbose, imprecise answers to factual queries, with 65.9\% of MLPerf responses exceeding 40 characters. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training addresses this gap by optimizing for task-specific rewards rather than token-level imitation. Yet HPC tasks exhibit extreme heterogeneity, with binary classification, factual QA, and semantic generation differing by 58x in answer length, spanning three distinct reward distributions, and showing widely varying SFT accuracy. This makes uniform-weight RL methods such as GRPO suboptimal. We propose HARGO, Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization, which introduces per-response importance weighting via confidence-modulated advantage: computing a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast and a confidence signal from reference model log-probabilities, then modulating the advantage before computing per-response weights, without requiring task-type labels. Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieves the best performance on all three primary metrics: WinRate 54.62\%, Data Race F1 91.30\%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558. Ablation confirms complementary contributions from both signals. HARGO establishes the best overall alignment quality among compared methods for heterogeneous HPC tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HARGO（异质性感知奖励引导优化），一种无需任务类型标签的RL后训练方法，通过置信度调制的优势加权来应对HPC任务中答案长度、奖励分布和SFT精度的极端异质性，在四个HPC任务和九种方法中全面取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: SFT虽然能为LLM注入HPC领域知识，但知识不等于任务适当的行为。例如，同一个SFT模型在数据竞争检测上准确率达88.65%，却在事实问答中产生冗长不精确的回答（65.9%的MLPerf回答超过40个字符）。HPC任务在答案长度（相差58倍）、奖励分布（三个不同分布）和SFT精度上高度异质，导致GRPO等统一权重的RL方法次优。
AI.method: HARGO引入基于置信度调制优势的每响应重要性加权。具体包括：(1) 从组级奖励对比中计算判别信号（discrimination signal）；(2) 从参考模型log-probabilities中计算置信度信号（confidence signal）；(3) 在计算每响应权重前调制优势项。整个过程无需任务类型标签。
AI.result: 在四个HPC任务和九种方法的对比中，HARGO在所有三个主要指标上取得最优：WinRate 54.62%、Data Race F1 91.30%、PLP相似度0.8558。消融实验确认判别信号和置信度信号具有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: HARGO在异质性HPC任务上建立了最佳的整体对齐质量，验证了异质性感知的RL后训练相比统一权重方法的优势。

title: Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARP（一种带死区的声誉惩罚机制）和SPARC（字节级代码门控反思机制），在不访问产品级真实标签的前提下，通过惩罚低评分欺诈商家的销量来保护消费者，同时避免误伤诚实商家，并显著缩小与完美信息oracle之间的消费者福利差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体作为自主商家撰写商品列表时，在竞争压力下会编造商品属性。即使明确指示要诚实，多数模型的列表仍存在捏造行为。平台缺乏地面真值，只能观测到有噪声、有偏的投诉信号，无法逐条验证，因此需要一种不依赖真实标签的鲁棒机制来约束欺诈行为并保护消费者。
AI.method: 设计了两层机制：(1) CARP：声誉-惩罚机制，包含死区（deadband）以容忍投诉噪声，以及状态依赖的惩罚强度以对抗声誉驱动的检测侵蚀。它不需要产品级地面真值，且能抵抗策略性博弈。(2) SPARC：字节级代码门控反思机制，通过代码门控让模型在说谎会损失销量时自我约束，而非简单地服从指令。两者结合构成完整的约束框架。
AI.result: CARP有效抑制低评分欺诈卖家的销量同时不误伤诚实卖家；与SPARC配对后，在不访问真实信息的情况下关闭了大部分与完美信息oracle之间的消费者福利差距，在所比较的策略中取得了最优福利。SPARC的惩罚在行为层面对LLM商家具有约束力：模型在撒谎无成本时会编造，但在撒谎会导致销量损失时会自我约束，这是一种自利反应而非指令遵从；该现象跨模型一致，且伴随置信区间支持。
AI.conclusion: LLM商家的诚实行为可以通过精心设计的、针对自利动机的惩罚机制来实现，而非依赖指令遵从。CARP+SPARC框架证明了在缺乏地面真值的现实约束下，仍能有效抑制智能体欺诈并保护消费者福利，该机制具有鲁棒性和跨模型泛化能力。

title: MarkushGlyph and OCSRGlyph: Improved Chemical Structure Recognition
summary: Chemical structures appear in patents and the scientific literature as images. For programmatic usage, such as indexing in databases or constructing machine learning model training sets, they must be transformed into line notations. The two common forms of this task are translating an image of a single molecule (optical chemical structure recognition - OCSR) and translating a Markush structure that represents a family of molecules. While prior work in the former case is quite mature, Markush structure parsing remains a challenging task. In this work, we treat both tasks as an image-to-text translation problem. We then propose OCSRGlyph, a state-of-the-art OCSR model, improving performance over prior methods by carefully considering stereochemistry. For the Markush task, we introduce MarkushGlyph, a vision-language model that reads the entire Markush structure as an image. This contrasts with prior systems, which often use multiple stages to separately process visual and text input content. Finally, we introduce a new metric for determining the accuracy of Markush structure translations, handling failure modes present in prior metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OCSRGlyph和MarkushGlyph两个图像到文本翻译模型，分别用于光学化学结构识别（OCSR）和Markush结构解析，并引入新的Markush结构翻译准确率度量指标。
AI.motivation: 化学结构在专利和科学文献中以图像形式出现，需要转换为行标注（line notation）以便程序化使用。虽然单分子OCSR任务已较为成熟，但Markush结构（表示一类分子）的解析仍具挑战性。此外，现有Markush翻译度量指标存在缺陷，需要更好的评估方法。
AI.method: 将OCSR和Markush结构解析均视为图像到文本翻译问题。提出OCSRGlyph模型，通过仔细考虑立体化学来提高单分子识别性能；提出MarkushGlyph，一种视觉-语言模型，将整个Markush结构作为图像整体读取，区别于以往多阶段分别处理视觉和文本输入的系统。同时引入新的度量指标来评估Markush结构翻译的准确性。
AI.result: OCSRGlyph在单分子光学化学结构识别上达到最先进水平，超越了先前方法；MarkushGlyph能够整体读取Markush结构图像完成翻译；新度量指标能处理先前指标的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过将Markush结构解析统一为图像到文本翻译问题，并引入新的评估度量，本文推进了化学结构图像理解和翻译的自动化水平。

title: Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus
summary: Machine learning is transforming molecular sciences by accelerating property prediction, simulation, and the discovery of new molecules and materials. Acquiring labeled data in these domains is often costly and time-consuming, whereas large collections of unlabeled molecular data are readily available. Standard semi-supervised learning methods often rely on label-preserving augmentations, which are challenging to design in the molecular domain, where minor changes can drastically alter properties. In this work, we show that semi-supervised methods that rely on an ensemble consensus can boost predictive accuracy across a diverse range of molecular datasets, task types, and graph neural network architectures. We find that training with an ensemble consensus objective increases robustness in models and exhibits an effect similar to knowledge distillation; an individual member of an ensemble trained this way outperforms a full ensemble trained in a traditional supervised fashion in almost all cases. In addition, this type of semi-supervised training reduces calibration error.
