AI.tldr: 本文提出利用集成共识（ensemble consensus）作为半监督目标来提升分子性质预测的性能，无需设计标签保持的数据增强。这种方法在多种分子数据集、任务类型和GNN架构上均能提升预测精度，且单个集成成员的表现优于传统监督训练的全集成，同时降低了校准误差。
AI.motivation: 分子科学领域获取标注数据成本高昂且耗时，而大量未标注分子数据容易获得。标准半监督学习方法依赖标签保持的数据增强，但在分子领域，微小的结构变化就可能导致性质发生显著改变，因此难以设计有效的增强策略。
AI.method: 采用基于集成共识（ensemble consensus）的半监督学习方法：利用未标注数据训练多个模型，使其预测在未标注样本上达成一致，从而利用一致性正则化作为训练目标。
AI.result: 该方法在多种分子数据集、任务类型和图神经网络架构上均能提升预测精度；训练后的单个集成成员在几乎所有情况下优于传统监督训练的全集成；此外，该方法还降低了模型的校准误差，并增强了模型鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于集成共识的半监督学习方法无需设计复杂的标签保持增强策略，可有效利用未标注分子数据提升预测性能，同时带来类似知识蒸馏的效应和更好的校准性能。

title: Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners
summary: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出感知-纠正蒸馏（PCD），一种无标签方法，通过下游失败与师生分歧的乘积（软AND门）来识别可纠正的感知失败，从而在多模态推理蒸馏中提供更精准的稠密监督，在多个基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 同策略蒸馏为多模态推理器提供稠密监督，但其轨迹级奖励无法区分失败源于感知还是后续推理。现有的感知成功率（PSR）估计存在模糊性，低成功率无法区分感知不足与推理困难，因此需要一种能准确定位可纠正感知失败的方法。
AI.method: PCD方法的核心是：利用下游失败和师生分歧作为互补的证据，两者的乘积形成一个软AND门，只有当两种证据同时存在时才增强蒸馏信号。该规则通过贝叶斯证据组合推导，并证明乘法是唯一的、在任一证据缺失时归零的归一化双线性门。PCD还采用分离的感知-推理回滚和均值保持权重，确保推理目标不变。
AI.result: 在8个基准上，PCD将8B→2B的宏平均从OPD的44.50提升至47.28，32B→8B从56.94提升至61.22。在匹配的2B消融实验中，移除PCD导致留出平均下降2.22分，移除分离回滚下降0.88分。
AI.conclusion: 有效的多模态蒸馏不仅取决于教师预测什么，还取决于识别何时感知是适当的纠正目标。PCD通过区分感知失败与推理失败，提供了一种更精准的蒸馏信号，显著优于现有同策略蒸馏方法。

title: ScaFE: Data-Efficient Scar Classification with LLM-Generated Clinical Feature Programs
summary: Classifying pathological scars from clinical photographs requires distinguishing keloids from hypertrophic scars despite limited expert-labeled data and substantial acquisition variation across hospitals. End-to-end image models remain data-dependent, whereas sending photographs to a hosted vision-language model (VLM) may conflict with local data-governance requirements and yields decisions that are difficult to reproduce and audit. We introduce ScaFE (Scar Feature Engineering), which transfers clinical knowledge from a large language model (LLM) into deterministic, executable feature programs instead of asking the model to diagnose images. A web-enabled LLM retrieves clinical evidence and synthesizes programs that measure visually assessable scar attributes. Candidate programs execute in a restricted local environment, and only aggregate validation statistics and feature-level SHAP summaries are returned for iterative repair and refinement; raw images and patient-level outputs remain local. A lightweight Random Forest then operates on the resulting structured representation. On 600 photographs from three hospitals under leave-one-site-out evaluation, ScaFE achieves 81.0% site-macro balanced accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline, BiomedCLIP, by 10.0 percentage points. With only 10% of the development data, ScaFE retains 72.0% balanced accuracy and an 11.8-point lead. Iterative refinement also raises the executable-program rate from 66.7% to 95.0%, with verified evidence for 91.7% of the final features. These results show that LLM knowledge can support data-efficient, cross-site medical image classification through local and auditable feature programs rather than direct VLM decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaFE（疤痕特征工程）方法，利用大语言模型将临床知识转化为可执行的确定性特征程序，用于病理性疤痕（瘢痕疙瘩与增生性疤痕）的图像分类。在600张来自三家医院的图像、留一站点评估下，ScaFE达到81.0%的站点宏平衡准确率，比最强基线BiomedCLIP高出10.0个百分点，且仅用10%开发数据仍保持11.8个百分点的领先优势，同时通过迭代精修将程序可执行率从66.7%提升至95.0%。该方法在保证数据本地化与可审计性的同时，实现了数据高效、跨站点的医学图像分类。
AI.motivation: 病理性疤痕分类面临两大挑战：一是专家标注数据有限且不同医院间的图像采集差异大，端到端图像模型数据依赖性过强；二是将照片发送至云端视觉语言模型（VLM）存在数据治理合规风险，且决策难以复现和审计。因此需要一种既能利用LLM临床知识又能在本地执行、可审计的分类方案。
AI.method: ScaFE采用"知识转移而非直接诊断"的策略：1) 利用联网LLM检索临床证据并综合生成可度量的疤痕视觉属性特征程序；2) 候选程序在受限的本地环境执行，仅返回聚合验证统计量和特征级SHAP摘要用于迭代修复和精修，原始图像和患者级输出始终留在本地；3) 使用轻量级随机森林对生成的结构化表征进行分类。
AI.result: 在三院600张照片的留一站点评估中，ScaFE达到81.0%的站点宏平衡准确率，超过最强基线BiomedCLIP 10.0个百分点；仅在10%开发数据下仍保持72.0%平衡准确率和11.8个百分点的领先；迭代精修将可执行程序率从66.7%提升至95.0%，91.7%的最终特征具有验证过的证据支持。
AI.conclusion: LLM知识可以通过局部、可审计的特征程序而非直接的VLM决策来支持数据高效、跨站点的医学图像分类，验证了"LLM知识工程化"范式在医学影像领域优于"LLM直接决策"范式的有效性。

title: Beyond Geometric Complementarity: Coherent Overlap in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models route each token to multiple experts, suggesting a geometric account of their benefit: co-selected experts should contribute distinct representation directions. Existing evidence often conflates route coherence, candidate quality, and candidate-by-context interaction. We distinguish these quantities using an Expert Subspace Separation Index (ESSI), matched-route residuals, and a prefix-controlled $2\times2$ factorial; frozen-route interventions and a controlled Top-$k$ study assess functional value. Three paired contrasts organize the findings. First, across six MoE architectures, expert subspaces overlap substantially, yet actual routes explain token representations better than matched alternatives. Second, across the 39 factorial cells in OLMoE, Mixtral, and DeepSeek, the selected candidate explains more of the residual representation than the strongest unselected rival in every cell, yet the actual prefix narrows this advantage throughout: all interactions are negative, and every 95% confidence interval lies below zero. Third, this geometric narrowing does not imply functional redundancy: adding later experts improves next-token prediction in 24 of 39 frozen-route comparisons, while the other 15 estimates are inconclusive; a controlled training study also favors Top-2 over Top-1 in all three seeds. We call this joint pattern coherent overlap: routing selects token-relevant experts from a shared geometric neighborhood, while useful multi-expert computation persists without disjoint linear coverage. Separating these quantities clarifies why geometric similarity alone cannot determine redundancy or pruning value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了专家子空间分离指数（ESSI）、匹配路由残差和前缀控制的2×2析因实验等工具，将稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型中路由一致性、候选质量和候选-上下文交互三个概念分离。通过三个配对对比在六个MoE架构及OLMoE、Mixtral、DeepSeek的39个析因单元上发现：专家子空间重叠显著但实际路由优于匹配替代方案；被选专家始终比最强未选对手解释更多残差，但实际前缀在所有单元中均缩小了这一优势（所有交互为负）；几何上的收窄并不意味功能性冗余，添加后期专家在24/39个冻结路由比较中改善预测。论文将这一模式称为"连贯重叠"（coherent overlap），并指出几何相似性本身无法决定冗余性或剪枝价值。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE语言模型将每个token路由到多个专家，暗示其收益的几何解释：共同被选的专家应贡献不同的表征方向。但现有证据往往混淆了路由一致性、候选质量和候选-上下文交互这三个独立概念，导致对MoE工作机制的理解不够精确。
AI.method: 论文引入三个分析工具：（1）专家子空间分离指数（ESSI）用于量化专家子空间的重叠程度；（2）匹配路由残差用于比较实际路由与匹配的替代路由在解释token表征上的差异；（3）前缀控制的2×2析因实验用于分离候选质量和候选-上下文交互。同时采用冻结路由干预和有对照的Top-k训练研究来评估功能价值。
AI.result: 三个配对对比的结果：（1）六个MoE架构中专家子空间显著重叠，但实际路由比匹配替代方案更好地解释token表征；（2）在39个析因单元中，被选候选在所有单元中都比最强未选对手解释更多残差，但实际前缀在所有单元中缩小了这一优势，所有交互为负且95%置信区间均低于零；（3）几何收窄并非功能冗余：冻结路由比较中24/39改善预测，对照训练研究在三个种子中Top-2均优于Top-1。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了"连贯重叠"（coherent overlap）这一模式：路由从共享的几何邻域中选择与token相关的专家，而无需不相交的线性覆盖即可维持有用的多专家计算。区分这些数量有助于澄清为何几何相似性本身不能决定冗余性或剪枝价值。

title: How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUA) are being deployed to browse the web and operate desktop software, yet their benchmark scores are still commonly produced by brittle scripted oracles. A score is the output of a pipeline in which tasks can be stale, trajectories can omit decisive visual evidence, evaluators can reject valid alternatives, and aggregate reports can hide the cause of failure. We organize these problems into a reliability framework spanning task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, and reporting. We then audit 150 public failure-scored trajectories from five web, enterprise-workflow, and desktop-control benchmarks, find that 15.3\% of FAIL verdicts are wrong: 10.7\% are evaluator false negatives and 4.7\% are broken tasks. For genuine failures, a three-tier diagnostic taxonomy shows that verification/feedback and planning failures dominate execution/grounding errors, while a single scalar success rate can not explain. We connect these findings to newer long-horizon CUA benchmarks and derive stage-specific design rules for CUA evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地审计了计算机使用代理（CUA）基准测试的可靠性，分析了从任务构建、轨迹观察、评分到报告四个环节的问题，通过对150条公开失败轨迹的审计发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的，并提出了一套分阶段的设计规范来改进CUA评估。
AI.motivation: 尽管CUA（计算机使用代理）正被广泛部署于网页浏览和桌面软件操作，但其基准测试分数仍常由脆弱的脚本化判官生成。这类评分管线存在任务过时、轨迹缺乏关键视觉证据、评估器拒绝合理替代方案以及聚合报告隐藏失败原因等问题，导致基准分数无法真实反映CUA能力。
AI.method: 作者首先构建了一个涵盖任务构建、轨迹观察、评分和报告四个环节的可靠性框架；随后从五个网页、企业工作流和桌面控制基准中审计了150条公开的失败评分轨迹，量化评估器误判与损坏任务的比例；最后提出一个三层诊断分类法，将真实失败划分为验证/反馈错误、规划错误和执行/接地错误，并据此推导分阶段设计规则。
AI.result: 审计发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的，其中10.7%属于评估器假阴性（评估器错误拒绝有效方案），4.7%属于损坏的任务。在真实失败中，验证/反馈和规划错误占主导，而非执行/接地错误，且单一标量成功率无法解释失败的具体成因。
AI.conclusion: CUA基准评估的可靠性需要系统性改进。作者将审计发现与更新的长时程CUA基准关联，针对评估流程的不同阶段制定了具体的设计规则，以提升基准分数的可信度和可诊断性。

title: MIND: Multimodal Intent-Driven Network via Diffusion Transformers for Medical Image Fusion
summary: Medical image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from diverse imaging modalities to support clinical diagnosis. Existing methods typically apply uniform fusion rules globally, lacking a deep understanding of diagnostic intents and pathological structures. To address these limitations, we propose MIND, a Multimodal Intent-Driven Network via Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for medical image fusion. Specifically, we utilize BioMedGPT to generate intent-driven fusion texts from source images, guiding the fusion process with pathology-aware diagnostic intents. To combat the loss of 2D spatial continuity caused by 1D sequence flattening in DiTs, we design a Multi-scale Latent Adapter. This module explicitly extracts source image features before serialization, injecting them into the network via strict dimensional alignment to effectively supplement image features. To resolve the semantic shift caused by decoupling image outputs from diagnostic intents, we design a medical semantic consistency loss. This loss ensures deep semantic locking between fused images and fusion texts while maintaining the stability of the underlying physical manifold reconstruction. Comprehensive experiments on the Harvard, BraTS, and GFP datasets reveal that MIND delivers superior fusion quality, significantly improves downstream brain tumor segmentation accuracy, and enables flexible interactive fusion, holding significant promise for intent-driven intelligent clinical decision support systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了MIND（Multimodal Intent-Driven Network），一种基于扩散Transformer（DiTs）的多模态意图驱动医学图像融合网络，通过BioMedGPT生成意图驱动文本、多尺度潜在适配器保留2D空间连续性、医学语义一致性损失确保融合图像与诊断意图深度对齐，在Harvard、BraTS和GFP数据集上实现优越融合质量并显著提升下游脑肿瘤分割精度。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像融合方法通常全局应用统一的融合规则，缺乏对诊断意图和病理结构的深度理解，导致融合结果不能很好地服务于临床诊断需求。
AI.method: 1) 利用BioMedGPT从源图像生成意图驱动的融合文本，以病理感知的诊断意图引导融合过程；2) 设计多尺度潜在适配器（Multi-scale Latent Adapter），在序列化前显式提取源图像特征并严格按维度对齐注入网络，解决DiTs中1D序列扁平化导致的2D空间连续性损失；3) 设计医学语义一致性损失，实现融合图像与融合文本之间的深度语义锁定，同时保持底层物理流形重建的稳定性。
AI.result: 在Harvard、BraTS和GFP数据集上的综合实验表明，MIND实现了优越的融合质量，显著提升了下游脑肿瘤分割的准确性，并支持灵活交互式融合。
AI.conclusion: MIND通过意图驱动机制将诊断意图深度融合到医学图像融合过程中，在融合质量和下游任务性能上均优于现有方法，为意图驱动的智能临床决策支持系统提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Measuring Distortion in the Empty Regions of Dimensionality Reduction Scatterplots with the Gap Index
summary: Quality metrics play a crucial role in the proper use of dimensionality reduction projections for visual analysis of high-dimensional data. They quantify the degree of distortion of a projection compared to the high-dimensional data and provide a reliable indication of how confident users can be in the structures they see in the resulting layouts. However, most popular metrics focus on capturing direct relationships between points (e.g., distances or neighborhoods) while neglecting distortions in empty areas of the layout, even though these often compose visually relevant features of a 2D layout. In this paper, we introduce the Gap Index (GI), a quality metric for 2D projections that captures visual distortion by measuring spatial distortion in empty areas of a projection. It does so by decomposing the space into empty triangles, which are then compared to their high-dimensional counterparts to compute the deformation. This per-triangle deformation can be aggregated into a single scalar value or overlaid on a projection to visualize regional distortion patterns. Results show that, contrary to popular quality metrics, the GI is sensitive to small structural deformations that have high visual impact. It is also fast to compute and interpretable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gap Index (GI)，一种用于二维降维投影的质量度量指标，通过将投影空间分解为空白三角形并与其高维对应三角形比较来量化空白区域的视觉畸变。
AI.motivation: 现有的投影质量度量指标主要关注点之间的直接关系（如距离或邻域），而忽略了布局中空白区域的畸变，尽管这些空白区域往往构成二维布局中视觉上显著的特征。因此需要一个能够捕捉空白区域视觉畸变的度量指标。
AI.method: 将投影空间分解为若干空白三角形，将每个三角形与其在高维空间中的对应三角形进行比较，计算逐三角形的形变量。该形变可以聚合为单一标量值，也可以叠加在投影上以可视化区域性的畸变模式。
AI.result: 与流行的质量度量指标相反，GI对具有高视觉影响的小型结构性形变敏感，且计算速度快、可解释性强。
AI.conclusion: Gap Index为二维投影的视觉质量评估提供了新的视角，弥补了现有度量在空白区域畸变捕捉方面的不足，具有计算高效和可解释的优点。

title: HyperClaim: Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Hypergraph Reasoning for Video Misinformation Detection
summary: Video misinformation detection is often approached through global multimodal fusion or free-form multimodal reasoning. Both paradigms can under-represent localized authenticity cues that arise from coupled interactions among query phrases, contextual text, and short temporal spans of frames. Because such interactions are inherently higher-order, pairwise graph formulations are insufficient to capture multi-way cross-modal dependencies, whereas hypergraphs offer a suitable representation for these relations. We propose HyperClaim, a discriminative temporal hypergraph framework for sample-level authenticity classification. Using the title or benchmark-provided paired text as a claim-like query, HyperClaim constructs a sparse heterogeneous hypergraph over query tokens, evidence tokens, and sampled frames; applies confidence-aware filtering and source budgeting to form compact text-frame and short-range temporal evidence units; performs adaptive soft-incidence reasoning with residual text-video calibration; and aggregates textual, visual, and hyperedge states through a discrepancy-aware readout. Without relying on generated rationales or external tool calls, HyperClaim preserves fine-grained cross-modal and temporal structure that global fusion tends to flatten. Under the FactGuard temporal protocol, it achieves 83.7%, 82.0%, and 87.3% accuracy on FakeSV, FakeTT, and FakeVV, respectively, outperforming strong discriminative and reasoning-centric baselines. Learned incidence and attention weights further reveal token- and frame-level structure.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperClaim，一个基于判别式时间超图框架的视频虚假信息检测方法，通过构建异构超图捕获查询词组、上下文文本与短时间帧段之间的高阶跨模态交互，在FactGuard协议下于FakeSV、FakeTT和FakeVV数据集上分别达到83.7%、82.0%和87.3%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚假信息检测方法（全局多模态融合或自由形式多模态推理）会低估由查询词组、上下文文本和短时序帧段之间耦合相互作用产生的局部真实性线索。这类交互本质上是高阶的，成对图结构无法充分建模多路跨模态依赖，而超图更适合表示这类关系。
AI.method: HyperClaim构建稀疏异构超图，节点包括查询词组(token)、证据文本token和采样帧。具体包括：(1)以标题或基准测试提供的配对文本作为类查询(query)；(2)采用置信度感知过滤和源预算机制形成紧凑的文本-帧及短程时序证据单元；(3)执行自适应软关联(soft-incidence)推理，配合残差文本-视频校准；(4)通过差异感知读取(d discrepancy-aware readout)聚合文本、视觉和超边状态。该方法无需依赖生成的推理理由或外部工具调用。
AI.result: 在FactGuard时间协议下，HyperClaim在FakeSV、FakeTT和FakeVV数据集上分别达到83.7%、82.0%和87.3%的准确率，优于强判别式和推理式基线。学习到的关联权重和注意力权重进一步揭示了token级和帧级结构。
AI.conclusion: HyperClaim通过超图建模高阶跨模态和时序交互，保留了全局融合往往压平化的细粒度跨模态和时序结构，在视频虚假信息检测上取得了SOTA性能，且不依赖外部工具或生成式推理。

title: Finding Change in Satellite Archives from Text: How to Combine Before-and-After Images Efficiently
summary: Operational Earth observation increasingly calls for answering queries such as ``find the image pairs where a new building appeared.'' This means searching an archive of before-and-after (bi-temporal) satellite image pairs and ranking each pair by how well it matches a natural-language description of the change. The component that performs this match, the fusion module that combines the ``before'' and ``after'' views, must be run at query time across many candidate pairs, so its speed largely sets the cost of every search. We present a controlled comparison of how to build that module. Using one fixed image encoder (a frozen CLIP model) and one training recipe for all variants, we evaluate eight designs drawn from three families: attention, state-space models (Mamba), and learned compression (our Temporal Bottleneck Fusion, TBF). Each design is tested on two benchmarks (LEVIR-CC and Dubai-CC) with ten random seeds, so the reported differences are statistically grounded. We outline three findings: first, a training-free two-stage search (a cheap difference model that shortlists candidates, followed by attention fusion that re-ranks them) matches or exceeds full-fusion recall on LEVIR-CC while cutting query cost $10$-$15\times$, with comparable R@1/R@5 on Dubai-CC; second, the linear-time scan of Mamba, attractive on paper, gives no speed benefit at the patch counts typical of vision transformers ($L{=}196$): the scan is limited by memory bandwidth, whereas attention maps cleanly onto parallel hardware; and third, compressing the fused representation (TBF) reduces parameters by $2.3\times$ and latency by $1.6\times$ for a change-only BLEU-1 cost of $0.007$, although more aggressive compression quietly discards change-relevant detail that aggregate metrics fail to reveal.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了双时相卫星影像变化检索中的八种融合模块设计（注意力、状态空间模型Mamba、学习压缩TBF三大类），在LEVIR-CC和Dubai-CC基准上各用十个随机种子进行受控实验。主要发现包括：两阶段免训练搜索可降低10-15倍查询成本且召回率不降；Mamba在线性扫描上的理论优势在视觉Transformer典型patch数量下因内存带宽限制无法兑现；TBF压缩在微小的BLEU-1代价下实现2.3倍参数缩减和1.6倍延迟降低，但过度压缩会悄然丢失变化相关信息。
AI.motivation: 运营性地球观测需要从大规模双时相卫星影像档案中根据自然语言描述检索变化（如"新建筑出现"）。融合模块在查询时需跨大量候选影像对运行，其推理速度直接决定搜索总成本。然而，现有研究缺乏对融合模块设计的系统性、受控比较，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用单一冻结的CLIP图像编码器和统一训练配置，对三大类共八种融合设计进行控制对比：注意力机制、状态空间模型（Mamba）、学习压缩（提出的Temporal Bottleneck Fusion, TBF）。每个设计在LEVIR-CC和Dubai-CC两个基准上用十个随机种子测试，确保结果有统计显著性。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：(1) 训练免的两阶段搜索（廉价差分模型粗筛+注意力融合精排）在LEVIR-CC上匹配或超越全融合召回率，查询成本降低10-15倍； (2) Mamba的线性时间扫描在patch数量L=196时无速度优势，原因是扫描受限于内存带宽，而注意力能很好映射到并行硬件； (3) TBF压缩使参数减少2.3倍、延迟降低1.6倍，仅损失0.007的BLEU-1变化精度，但更激进的压缩会悄悄丢弃变化相关细节，而聚合指标无法揭示这一点。
AI.conclusion: 融合模块的设计选择对双时相变化检索的查询成本至关重要。两阶段搜索策略是最务实的成本-性能折中方案；Mamba的理论复杂度优势在当前的视觉Transformer规模下难以兑现；学习压缩（TBF）提供了参数和延迟上的有效缩减，但需警惕过度压缩导致的变化细节丢失。研究为构建高效的变化检索系统提供了经验性的设计指导。

title: Encryption-Compatible Clustered Federated Learning via Distributed Expectation-Maximization over Metadata
summary: Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) addresses data heterogeneity in federated settings by grouping clients with similar data distributions to enable effective training. Existing methods face a trade-off between privacy preservation, communication cost, and computational efficiency. We formalize this as the CFL trilemma, according to which improving two of these dimensions comes at the expense of the third. A prominent paradigm relies on metadata (i.e., low-dimensional representations of client datasets shared with the server) to enable communication- and computation-efficient clustering. However, such approaches are not compatible with standard FL privacy-preserving mechanisms. To address this limitation, we propose FLAMECHE, which reformulates metadata-based CFL as a distributed Expectation-Maximization (EM) procedure, restricting server updates to additive operations while preserving efficiency. This design enables compatibility with practical secure FL schemes. We conducted extensive experiments on multiple datasets under various heterogeneous scenarios. Results show that FLAMECHE improves the effectiveness of client models. It enables encryption-compatible metadata-based clustering, enhancing its positioning within the CFL trilemma.

AI.tldr: FLAMECHE提出了一种基于分布式期望最大化（EM）的元数据聚类联邦学习方法，通过将服务器更新限制为加性操作，解决了聚类联邦学习（CFL）中隐私保护、通信成本和计算效率三者之间的权衡问题（CFL三难困境），实现了与加密方案兼容的元数据聚类。
AI.motivation: 聚类联邦学习面临隐私保护、通信成本和计算效率之间的固有权衡（CFL三难困境）。现有基于元数据的方法虽在通信和计算效率上有优势，但与标准联邦学习的隐私保护机制不兼容，需要一种能在三者之间取得更好平衡的方法。
AI.method: FLAMECHE将基于元数据的CFL重新表述为分布式期望最大化（EM）过程，通过限制服务器更新仅使用加性操作来保持计算效率，从而实现对实际安全联邦学习方案的兼容性（如加密方案）。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种异质性场景下的广泛实验表明，FLAMECHE显著提升了客户端模型的有效性，并实现了加密兼容的元数据聚类，改善了其在CFL三难困境中的定位。
AI.conclusion: FLAMECHE通过在EM框架下设计加性操作的服务器更新机制，成功弥合了元数据聚类与隐私保护之间的鸿沟，为CFL三难困境提供了一种更优的解决方案。

title: When Specifications Conflict: A Symmetry-Based Framework for Measuring LLM Preferences
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly required to integrate multiple sources of information that may be inconsistent or conflicting. However, there is still a lack of controllable and attributable methods for analyzing how models resolve conflicts between competing specifications. We propose a controlled experimental framework for studying model preferences under conflicting specifications. By constructing specifications with explicit conflicts, the framework enables model choices between competing specifications to be directly observed and analyzed. A symmetry-based design further reduces confounding factors, allowing preferences across representation types to be compared systematically.
  We evaluate the framework on an executable mathematical benchmark with 550 conflict instances spanning 11 function families, comparing four representation types: pure natural language, formal language, naturalized formal language, and input--output examples. Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family.
  We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受控实验框架，用于研究大型语言模型在相互冲突的规范之间如何进行偏好选择。该框架通过显式构造冲突规范、采用对称性设计减少混淆因素，在包含550个冲突实例、11个函数族的可执行数学基准上进行评估，发现模型表现出系统性偏好而非随机行为，偏好顺序为：形式语言≈自然化形式语言>纯自然语言>输入-输出示例。框架还扩展到了布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域等异构规范冲突场景。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型日益需要整合可能不一致或冲突的多种信息来源，但目前缺乏可控且可归因的方法来分析模型如何在竞争性规范之间解决冲突。
AI.method: 提出受控实验框架：1) 构造具有显式冲突的规范对，直接观察模型在两个竞争规范之间的选择；2) 采用基于对称性的实验设计以减少混淆因素，使不同表征类型之间的偏好可被系统性比较；3) 在550个冲突实例、11个函数族的可执行数学基准上评估四种表征类型（纯自然语言、形式语言、自然化形式语言、输入-输出示例）的偏好。
AI.result: 模型表现出系统性偏好模式而非随机行为，偏好排序一致为：形式语言≈自然化形式语言>纯自然语言>输入-输出示例。示例效应取决于模型能力和函数族。框架进一步扩展到布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域的异构规范冲突，证明其跨任务和规范形式的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为测量LLM如何解决竞争性信息来源之间的冲突提供了统一方法，有助于理解模型在冲突规范下的行为模式，并适用于多种任务和规范形式。

title: ROAD: Reciprocal-Objective Alignment of Discriminative Semantics for 3D Shape Generation
summary: High-fidelity 3D generation predominantly relies on scaling model capacity and data, which incurs prohibitive computational costs. This paradigm typically requires learning geometry from scratch and overlooks the rich semantic and structural priors already encapsulated in discriminative 3D foundation models. We contend that leveraging the profound understanding of the 3D world possessed by these discriminative models can significantly reduce generative cost. To this end, we propose ROAD, a framework that reduces the training cost of 3D generation by transferring these rich discriminative priors into diffusion transformers. To address the inherent semantic-structural heterogeneity between generative and discriminative latents, we introduce a reciprocal-objective alignment strategy. This method synergizes Holistic Semantic Condensing to enforce global semantic coherence and Structural Optimal Alignment, which is formulated as a bipartite matching problem to rigorously align microscopic geometric details between disparate latent spaces. The 3D foundation model is only used for training-time supervision of alignment and is not used at inference, incurring no additional inference cost. Compared with the industrial baseline Step1X-3D, the proposed ROAD achieves highly competitive generation performance with only 1.5% of the training data and significantly reduces training costs, effectively reducing the computational overhead of high-fidelity 3D generation. Code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/ROAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROAD框架，通过将判别式3D基础模型中的丰富语义和结构先验迁移到扩散Transformer中，大幅降低高保真3D生成模型的训练成本。仅需工业基线Step1X-3D的1.5%训练数据即可达到高度竞争性的生成性能。
AI.motivation: 当前高保真3D生成主要依赖扩大模型容量和数据规模，计算成本高昂；且这类方法通常从零学习几何表示，忽视了判别式3D基础模型已封装的丰富语义和结构先验。作者认为利用这些判别式模型对3D世界的深刻理解可显著降低生成成本。
AI.method: 提出ROAD框架，核心包含两部分：1) 将判别式3D基础模型的先验知识迁移到扩散Transformer中；2) 为应对生成式与判别式潜在空间之间的语义-结构异质性，引入互逆目标对齐策略，包括整合语义压缩（Holistic Semantic Condensing）保证全局语义一致性，以及结构最优对齐（Structural Optimal Alignment）——建模为二部图匹配问题以严格对齐不同潜在空间间的微观几何细节。判别式模型仅用于训练时监督，推理时无需额外开销。
AI.result: 与工业基线Step1X-3D相比，ROAD仅使用1.5%的训练数据即可获得高度竞争的生成性能，显著降低训练成本和高保真3D生成的計算开销。
AI.conclusion: 利用判别式3D基础模型的先验可以有效替代大规模数据和计算资源的堆叠，通过精心设计的潜在空间对齐策略实现低成本、高保真的3D生成，为3D生成领域提供了新的效率范式。

title: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger
summary: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LedgerMind，一种基于结构化证据账本的溯源约束多模态代理推理框架，通过将工具输出标准化为证据账本状态、强制推理引用账本条目、在实体和数值层检查接地性，并以类型化状态转换实现修复，从而提升多模态问答代理的轨迹级忠实度与答案准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态问答代理评估主要依赖最终答案准确率，这一聚合信号无法区分正确答案是基于接地证据、语言先验还是偶然误差抵消得到的。研究者希望揭示并解决被最终准确率掩盖的四类系统性失败模式：无支撑的中间推理、引证型实体幻觉（Phantom Grounding）、简单查询上的过度推理、以及修复阶段的放大问题。
AI.method: LedgerMind将多模态代理轨迹建模为溯源约束状态机：(1) 工具输出被标准化为结构化证据账本作为轨迹状态；(2) 下游推理和决策声明只能引用活跃的账本条目；(3) 在实体和数值级别检查接地性；(4) 修复通过类型化状态转换实现，不能引入无工具产生溯源的內容。系统包含三层接地协议、自适应双路径调度器（根据问题复杂度匹配推理深度）、以及带形式化溯源非放大保证的事件触发验证-修复引擎。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准和骨干MLLM上的实验表明，LedgerMind同时提升了答案准确率和轨迹级忠实度，有效缓解了最终答案准确率所掩盖的四类失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过将溯源约束引入代理轨迹的每个环节（从证据收集到推理声明再到修复操作），LedgerMind验证了轨迹级忠实度评估和结构化证据管理可以成为提升多模态代理可靠性的有效范式，为超越最终答案准确率的评估与推理方法提供了新方向。

title: MixFrag: Fragility-Guided Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Vision Transformers
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as an effective solution for deploying Vision Transformers (ViTs) on resource-constrained devices. However, existing PTQ methods typically employ uniform bit-widths across transformer components, overlooking their heterogeneous sensitivity to quantization and leading to inefficient precision allocation. In this paper, we propose {MixFrag, a fragility-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework for Vision Transformers. MixFrag first estimates component-level quantization fragility by measuring the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between full-precision and isolated quantized output distributions using a small calibration set. It then formulates bit allocation as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP), enabling adaptive layer-wise precision assignment under a target bit budget. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K across multiple Vision Transformer architectures demonstrate that MixFrag achieves competitive classification performance under practical mixed-precision settings. Furthermore, evaluations on COCO object detection and instance segmentation show that MixFrag achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing mixed-precision PTQ methods, improving the previous best method by up to 9.6 AP under the challenging MP3/MP3 setting. Additional analyses validate the proposed fragility metric and demonstrate its strong correlation with the learned bit allocation. These results establish MixFrag as an effective framework for mixed-precision post-training quantization of Vision Transformers.

AI.tldr: MixFrag是一个基于脆弱性引导的混合精度后训练量化（PTQ）框架，用于视觉Transformer（ViT）。它通过KL散度衡量各组件对量化的敏感度（脆弱性），并将位宽分配建模为多选背包问题（MCKP），在目标比特预算下实现自适应的逐层精度分配。在ImageNet-1K分类和COCO检测/分割任务上取得了竞争性甚至最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法通常对所有Transformer组件采用统一的位宽，忽略了不同组件对量化的敏感度存在显著差异，导致精度分配效率低下，无法在有限的比特预算下充分发挥模型各部分的潜力。
AI.method: 首先通过测量全精度与隔离量化输出分布之间的KL散度来估计组件级别的量化脆弱性；然后将位宽分配问题建模为多选背包问题（MCKP），在给定目标比特预算下实现自适应的逐层精度分配。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上跨多种ViT架构取得了有竞争力的分类性能；在COCO目标检测和实例分割任务上，在MP3/MP3设置下相比先前最优方法提升了高达9.6 AP，达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: MixFrag被验证为一种有效的ViT混合精度后训练量化框架，其脆弱性度量与学习的位宽分配具有很强的相关性，为异构敏感度感知的精度分配提供了可靠依据。

title: Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs
summary: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入分层多级蒙特卡洛(MLMC)神经评论家估计器，解决了平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)中神经评论家的偏差-成本权衡问题，并开发了一种原始-对偶自然演员-评论家算法，实现了最优性差距和约束违反均为O~(T^{-1/2})阶的收敛保证，这是无限时域平均奖励CMDP中首个具备阶最优收敛保证的结果。
AI.motivation: 尽管在平均奖励CMDP中，使用线性评论家的原始-对偶演员-评论家方法已被充分理解，但将其阶最优收敛保证扩展到神经评论家仍然是一个未解决的问题。核心难点在于神经评论家估计中存在根本性的偏差-成本权衡：在神经正切核(NTK)分析下，降低评论家偏差会大幅增加评论家优化成本，从而阻碍原始-对偶框架下的阶最优收敛。
AI.method: 引入分层多级蒙特卡洛(MLMC)神经评论家估计器，在轨迹采样和评论家优化两个维度同时进行去偏。该估计器能够在仅付出对数期望样本成本的情况下，获得长时评论家优化运行的偏差水平。在此基础上，构建了一个原始-对偶自然演员-评论家(NAC)算法。
AI.result: 算法实现了最优性差距和约束违反均为O~(T^{-1/2})阶的收敛率。这是无限时域平均奖励CMDP中首个针对一般策略参数化和神经评论家的阶最优收敛保证，且无需预先知道底层混合时间。该结果即使在无约束场景下也是新颖的。
AI.conclusion: 通过MLMC技术解决了神经评论家估计中的偏差-成本权衡瓶颈，为安全关键强化学习在平均奖励CMDP框架下提供了首个阶最优的理论保证，适用于一般策略参数化与神经评论家，消除了对混合时间先验知识的依赖。

title: QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

AI.tldr: QuantWAMs是一个专为世界行动模型（WAMs）设计的后训练量化（PTQ）框架，通过共享基元离群校准、联合训练目标显著性分析和固定干预滚动审计三种策略，在W4A4主导设置下使模拟指标与FP16仅差0.2-0.7个百分点，峰值内存降至FP16的29%，并提供1.4-1.6倍块级加速。
AI.motivation: WAMs联合预测未来观测和动作，但其迭代去噪和闭环执行使高效部署成本高昂。现有PTQ方法依赖开环目标、同质模型假设和与部署不符的校准分布，难以适用于WAMs，因此需要一种将量化决策与模型结构、滚动分布和任务目标对齐的PTQ框架。
AI.method: QuantWAMs提出三种策略：(1)共享基元离群校准，仅跨坐标兼容模块汇集激活证据；(2)联合训练目标显著性，从视频-动作联合梯度计算经验Fisher分数，在校准稳定的层粒度上分配权重精度；(3)固定干预滚动审计，利用可达闭环状态修订去噪步骤的保护调度，且不改变精度预算。
AI.result: 在Fast-WAM和LingBot-VA上，跨RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及AgiBot G2真实机器人操控任务进行评估。W4A4主导设置下模拟均值与FP16相差0.2-0.7个百分点；真实机器人实验验证了三个操控任务的部署可行性；视频和动作块的峰值权重-激活内存降至FP16的约29%，块级加速为1.4-1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: QuantWAMs通过将量化决策与部署上下文对齐，有效解决了WAMs后训练量化的适配问题，在维持任务性能的前提下显著降低了内存占用并提升了推理速度，验证了量化WAMs在真实机器人操控场景中的部署可行性。

title: Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees
summary: Computer-use agents often fail on transient GUI events because they produce the correct action only after the relevant window has already closed. We identify the main cause as expensive autoregressive decoding on the decision-time critical path. We propose Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT), which eliminates this delay without modifying the underlying model. During idle screen periods, the same frozen multimodal model constructs a bounded conditional policy tree with observable guards, pre-authorized actions, and branch-specific deadlines. The tree is sized to cover the model's own decoding latency. When an event occurs, a lightweight observer matches change-gated frames to a prepared branch and immediately executes the corresponding action without generating new text. In paired trials with pre-registered endpoints and exact McNemar tests, AAPT improves the success rate from 0.50 to 0.79 within a contested decision window ($p=1.8\times10^{-3}$), while producing no incorrect actions. Both open-loop and predict-and-replan baselines achieve zero success because they still decode during execution. A preparation-time sweep shows that the gain emerges where the latency-based tree-sizing rule predicts, and ablations reveal three key requirements: fast observer decoding, valid tree planning, and accurate branch routing. A pre-registered oracle probe rejects our initial hypothesis and instead points to branch routing as the causal bottleneck. We further reproduce the effect on an independent general-purpose multimodal model over 126 paired trials ($p=4.9\times10^{-13}$). On an external benchmark, AAPT matches the overall performance of a reactive baseline, although the two methods exhibit complementary strengths. Together, these results suggest that AAPT performs best when candidate actions can be enumerated in advance, whereas reactive execution remains stronger when they cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应预期策略树（AAPT），通过在多模态模型空闲时预构建有界条件策略树，消除了计算机使用智能体在决策关键路径上的自回归解码延迟，在瞬时GUI事件处理上将成功率从0.50提升至0.79（p=1.8×10^-3），并在独立通用多模态模型上复现（126对试验，p=4.9×10^-13）。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体在瞬态GUI事件上经常失败，因为在相关窗口关闭后才产生正确动作。根本原因是昂贵的自回归解码位于决策时关键路径上，导致响应延迟。
AI.method: AAPT利用空闲屏幕时期，用相同的冻结多模态模型构建有界条件策略树，包含可观察的守卫条件、预授权动作和分支专属截止时间。树的大小根据模型自身解码延迟来确定。事件发生时，轻量级观察器将变更门控帧与预构建分支匹配，无需生成新文本即可立即执行对应动作。
AI.result: 在预先登记的配对试验（精确McNemar检验）中，AAPT将决策窗口内成功率从0.50提升至0.79（p=1.8×10^-3），且无错误动作产生。开环与预测-再规划基线因解码延迟均获得零成功率。预备时间扫描确认增益出现在延迟建模预测的位置。消融实验揭示三个关键要求：快速观察器解码、有效树规划、准确分支路由。预注册的oracle探针推翻了初始假设，指出分支路由是因果瓶颈。效果在独立通用多模态模型上复现（126对试验，p=4.9×10^-13），在外部基准上整体表现与反应式基线相当但各有优势。
AI.conclusion: AAPT在候选动作可预先枚举的场景中表现最佳，而反应式执行在候选动作无法预枚举的场景中仍然更强。研究揭示了延迟消除而非模型改进是提升瞬态事件处理能力的关键，并指出分支路由是主要瓶颈。

title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
summary: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks, rather than merely equipping them with a sophisticated yet inefficient reasoning paradigm. In this work, we rethink agentic visual reasoning through two key dimensions of tool use: Mode Adaptiveness (MA) and Tool Effect (TE). Mode Adaptiveness characterizes whether an MLLM can recognize when tools are truly necessary and invoke them accordingly, thereby avoiding unnecessary computational overhead while improving performance on challenging problems that require tool assistance. Tool Effect characterizes the actual impact of tool use: tools should extend the model's capabilities on problems unsolvable through text-only reasoning, while avoiding additional errors on problems that the model can already solve without tools. We conduct a comprehensive analysis to quantify these two properties and empirically reveal that existing agentic visual reasoning models exhibit limited Mode Adaptiveness, while the gains produced by tool use on hard examples are largely offset by the harm introduced on easy examples that the models can already solve. Motivated by these observations, we propose Beacon, a novel agentic visual reasoning model that achieves stronger overall performance, improved Mode Adaptiveness, and genuine tool-induced performance gains. At the core of Beacon are the Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward and the Hint-Guided Capability Expansion mechanism in the reinforcement learning stage, which respectively encourage adaptive tool invocation based on task necessity and strengthen the model's tool-use capability on the most challenging problems. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate the strong overall performance of Beacon and its substantial improvements in both Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Beacon，一个智能体视觉推理模型，通过重新思考工具使用的两个维度（模式自适应性MA和工具效应TE），揭示了现有模型在自适应工具调用和真实工具增益上的不足，并通过必要性感知自适应奖励和提示引导能力扩展机制在强化学习阶段实现改进，最终在多个基准上取得更优性能和显著的MA/TE提升。
AI.motivation: 智能体视觉推理的核心目标是提升多模态大语言模型在复杂任务上的成功率，而非仅仅配备复杂但低效的推理范式。现有智能体视觉推理模型存在两个问题：一是模式自适应性有限（模型无法判断何时真正需要工具，导致不必要计算开销）；二是工具效应不佳（工具使用在困难样本上带来的增益被简单样本上引入的额外错误所抵消）。这些观察揭示了现有方法在工具使用上的本质缺陷，亟需改进。
AI.method: 提出Beacon模型，其核心包含两个强化学习阶段的机制：(1) 必要性感知自适应奖励（Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward），鼓励模型基于任务必要性进行自适应的工具调用；(2) 提示引导能力扩展机制（Hint-Guided Capability Expansion），增强模型在最困难问题上的工具使用能力。同时提出了两个量化工具使用的维度框架：模式自适应性（Mode Adaptiveness, MA）和工具效应（Tool Effect, TE），用于系统分析模型在工具使用上的表现。
AI.result: 在多个不同基准上的广泛实验表明，Beacon在整体性能上表现优异，同时在模式自适应性和工具效应两个维度上都取得了实质性改进，证明了其在自适应工具调用和真实工具增益方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 智能体视觉推理需要同时优化工具使用的自适应性和有效性。Beacon通过强化学习中的必要性感知奖励和提示引导能力扩展机制，成功实现了性能、模式自适应性和工具效应的协同提升，为智能体视觉推理提供了更系统的设计思路。

title: On-Policy and Off-Policy Learning for Large Action Spaces
summary: This thesis studies policy learning in interactive systems where an agent observes a context, selects an action from a very large set, and receives partial feedback. The main framework is contextual bandits, with two paradigms: on-policy learning, where the agent interacts sequentially with the environment and minimizes regret, and off-policy learning, where it learns from logged data collected by a logging policy. In large action spaces, both settings face major challenges: inefficient exploration, sparse data coverage, high-variance importance weights, extrapolation bias, and difficult optimization landscapes. The first part develops structured Bayesian methods for on-policy learning. We introduce meTS, a mixed-effect extension of Thompson sampling, and dTS, which leverages diffusion-inspired priors to model dependencies between actions. These methods share information across actions and yield regret guarantees depending on an effective number of actions. The second part addresses off-policy learning. We propose sDM, a structured direct method based on latent variables, show that optimization error can dominate estimation error in large action spaces, and introduce concave, efficiently optimizable policy-weighted log-likelihood objectives. Finally, we develop differentiable pessimistic methods based on exponential smoothing and PAC-Bayesian bounds to control the bias-variance trade-off of regularized importance-sampling estimators.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究大规模行动空间下的上下文强盗问题，涵盖在线策略学习和离线策略学习两个范式。在线部分提出混合效应汤普森采样（meTS）和基于扩散先验的dTS方法；离线部分提出结构化直接方法sDM、可高效优化的策略加权对数似然目标，以及基于指数平滑和PAC-Bayesian界的可微悲观方法。
AI.motivation: 在大规模行动空间中，上下文强盗问题面临探索效率低下、数据覆盖稀疏、重要性权重高方差、外推偏差严重以及优化景观困难等核心挑战。无论是在线学习还是离线学习场景，这些难题都制约了现有方法的性能，亟需结构化方法来共享行动间信息并控制偏差-方差权衡。
AI.method: 论文分两部分提出方法：在线学习方面，提出meTS（混合效应汤普森采样）和dTS（利用扩散启发式先验建模行动间依赖关系），通过共享行动间信息获得依赖于有效行动数的遗憾保证。离线学习方面，提出基于潜变量的结构化直接方法sDM；证明大规模行动空间中优化误差可能主导估计误差，并引入可高效优化的凹策略加权对数似然目标；最后开发基于指数平滑和PAC-Bayesian界的可微悲观方法，用于控制正则化重要性采样估计器的偏差-方差权衡。
AI.result: 所提出的方法能够在大规模行动空间中实现行动间信息共享，在线方法获得遗憾保证（与有效行动数相关）；离线方法表明优化误差在大行动空间中可主导估计误差，并提出对应的可优化目标与悲观估计方法，有效控制偏差-方差权衡。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统性地解决了大规模行动空间下上下文强盗的在线与离线学习难题，通过结构化贝叶斯先验、潜变量模型、凹优化目标及可微悲观方法，为不同类型的学习范式提供了具有理论保障且可高效实现的解决方案。

title: When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence
comment: 25 pages, including references and supplementary material; 3 figures and 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead
summary: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"派生特征过度信任"（DFOT）概念，指下游LLM将实例依赖有效性的派生测量当作直接事实使用。以生理感测为案例，通过两个测试（D1/D2）和五个估计量量化该失效，并在50,000条PPG-ECG配对记录上验证了ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏基线方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 随着派生测量越来越多地被直接嵌入LLM管道中作为事实使用，但其有效性依赖于具体实例，LLM可能错误地将这些测量赋予直接事实的认知地位或在有效范围之外使用，导致下游决策错误。现有评估框架缺乏对这一系统性失效模式的统一定义和量化。
AI.method: 提出了DFOT（派生特征过度信任）的形式化定义，包含两个诊断测试：D1测试LLM是否接受被离线ECG反驳的PPG派生心律（冲突过度信任），D2测试LLM在误导性病史下是否拒绝对离体验证可靠的PPG心律（情境诱导错误）。定义了五个估计量：COTR（冲突过度信任率）、CIR（情境诱导错误率）、CRR（正确修复率）、ESRM（证据特异性修复边际）和UHR（效用伤害率）。采用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线方法，ECG仅提供训练监督和离线参考，不展示给LLM。
AI.result: 在协议锁定的187名患者测试集上，基线方法在四个修复和特异性端点上的改进为1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间均排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4至+1.7）。框架不依赖于特定可靠性生成器，具有通用性。
AI.conclusion: DFOT提供了一个统一的评估目标，用于衡量和比较LLM在派生测量上的过度信任问题，为更强有力的缓解方法的开发和评估提供基准。

title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
summary: Visual generation increasingly requires high-resolution images, long videos, and multimodal context, making the quadratic cost of full attention prohibitive. We introduce Chimera, a hybrid visual diffusion backbone with a principled scaling recipe. Chimera processes text, image, and video tokens in one raster-ordered stream without positional embeddings. It combines Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) for long-context state tracking with O(N) complexity, interleaved Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for direct global interaction, and modality-aware short convolutions for local spatiotemporal context. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers expand capacity while controlling activated compute. To scale this heterogeneous architecture, we introduce HeteroP, a module-wise scheme that transfers hyperparameters across width and depth according to each tensor's functional fan-in and model depth. HeteroP yields a consistently tuned family used to fit Chinchilla-style compute-optimal laws for activated model size, training-token count, and image-video data ratio. Guided by these laws, we train an 11B-parameter Chimera with 2B activated parameters. Experiments show three results. First, measured by pretraining diffusion loss, the dense backbone is 1.7x as compute-efficient as a matched full-attention Wan-2.1 2B baseline, while the complete system reaches 7.3x. Second, without length-specific fine-tuning, Chimera extrapolates zero-shot from 5-second training clips to 30-second videos, with only 6.5% FID degradation in the last five seconds. Third, the fitted laws show that compute-optimal image pretraining divides compute nearly evenly between activated model size and training-token count, whereas video pretraining modestly favors model size at higher budgets. These results establish a foundation for designing and scaling efficient long-context diffusion architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chimera，一种混合视觉扩散骨干架构，结合Kimi Delta Attention（线性复杂度）、交错多隐头潜在注意力（MLA）、模态感知短卷积和稀疏MoE，并引入HeteroP模块级放缩方案来拟合Chinchilla式计算最优律。最终训练出11B参数（2B激活）的模型，相比全注意力基线在扩散损失上实现7.3x计算效率提升，且无需长度特定微调即可从5秒训练片段零样本外推到30秒视频。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成日益需要高分辨率图像、长视频和多模态上下文，而全注意力的二次方计算成本已变得不可承受，亟需一种兼顾长上下文、全局交互和局部时空建模的高效扩散架构，并需要一套系统化的放缩方案来指导大规模训练。
AI.method: Chimera采用无位置嵌入的栅格序列输入，组合三种注意力机制：KDA处理长上下文状态追踪（O(N)复杂度）、交错MLA实现直接全局交互、模态感知短卷积捕获局部时空上下文；同时引入稀疏MoE扩展容量但控制激活计算。放缩方面提出HeteroP方案，按各张量的功能扇入和模型深度跨宽度与深度迁移超参数，从而构建一致的模型族来拟合Chinchilla风格的计算最优律（涉及激活模型大小、训练token数、图像-视频数据比例）。
AI.result: 实验表明三个关键结果：(1) 密集骨干比匹配的全注意力Wan-2.1 2B基线在扩散损失上计算效率高1.7x，完整系统达7.3x；(2) 无需长度特定微调，Chimera可从5秒训练片段零样本外推至30秒视频，最后5秒仅6.5% FID退化；(3) 拟合的定律显示图像预训练的最优计算分配在激活模型大小和训练token数间几乎均分，而视频预训练在更高算力预算下略偏向模型大小。
AI.conclusion: Chimera及其HeteroP放缩方案为设计高效长上下文扩散架构和系统化放缩提供了坚实基础，证明了混合注意力+MoE+无位置嵌入的架构在计算效率和长序列泛化能力上的显著优势。

title: QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization
summary: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

AI.tldr: 提出QQWorld框架，用分位数-分位数（QQ）匹配目标替代Epps-Pulley（EP）正则化来改进潜在世界模型的潜在分布质量，通过保持尾部样本的有效矫正梯度，提升规划成功率并增强高斯对齐度。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型（如LeWM）通过EP目标将潜在分布正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但EP的矫正梯度在尾部孤立样本上会迅速消失，导致重尾偏差无法被充分控制，进而影响规划性能。
AI.method: 提出QQWorld：1）用分位数-分位数匹配目标替代EP，直接将投影后的潜在样本与秩匹配的高斯分位数对齐，在尾部保持有效矫正梯度；2）设计跨批次QQ（cross-batch QQ），利用先前批次的分离样本来扩大有效排序池，并分析其偏差-方差权衡。
AI.result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld有效提升了LeWM的平均规划成功率，同时持续获得更好的高斯对齐度和更薄的潜在分布尾部。
AI.conclusion: QQ匹配目标相较于EP正则化能更有效地约束潜在分布尾部，从而提升潜世界模型的规划性能，验证了通过改进潜在分布正则化策略来增强模型能力的可行性。

title: A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization
summary: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UNICON（UNified In-Context Operator Networks），一个跨学科的数值智能基础模型。UNICON能够从图结构示例的上下文中推断科学与社会系统中的预测关系，并将其应用于新任务，无需针对特定学科重新训练，即可在训练中未见的领域接近专家水平表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型展示了基于语言上下文的智能能力，但知识获取与应用不应局限于语言范畴。科学和社会系统本质上依赖数值上下文，需要能够从数值上下文中获取并应用知识的模型，即"数值智能"。现有方法缺乏跨学科通用的数值智能基础模型。
AI.method: UNICON通过图结构示例作为上下文，从同一系统的多个示例中推断共享的预测关系，并将该关系应用于来自同一系统的查询。模型采用统一的架构处理跨学科数据，并可结合语言模型智能体进一步增强性能。训练语料的多样性被认为是提升跨学科泛化能力的关键因素。
AI.result: UNICON在多个科学与社会系统中接近专家级表现，包括训练中未见过的学科。结合语言模型智能体后，UNICON在训练中未见学科上超越了最先进的专家模型。此外，训练语料多样性被证明能有效提升对未见学科的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: UNICON确立了数值智能作为基础模型能力的新范式，展示了在数值上下文中的上下文学习能力可以跨学科泛化，为更广泛的人工智能生态系统奠定了基础。

title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
summary: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the-wild videos through self-supervision and use it to explicitly reason about how the physical world evolves. Accordingly, PhiZero adopts a reason-then-render paradigm: it first infers future world evolution as a physical-language sequence and then renders the inferred transitions into videos. Extensive experiments across generation and understanding benchmarks validate the ability of PhiZero to model physically coherent world evolution. We further show its potential for realistic and interactive world modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.

AI.tldr: PhiZero是一个基于"物理语言"（一种紧凑的离散世界状态转移表示）构建的物理世界模型，采用"先推理后渲染"（reason-then-render）范式：先以物理语言序列推断未来的世界演化，再将其渲染为视频。该方法通过自监督从野外视频中学习物理语言，在生成和理解基准上均验证了其能建模物理一致的世界演化，并展现出在交互式世界建模、细粒度动作条件模拟和零样本运动迁移方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理世界模型通常直接在像素空间预测未来视频，使底层世界动力学隐含在高维视觉预测器中，缺乏显式的物理推理能力。作者受人类能够从视觉经验中抽象出预测结构并用自然语言组织显式推理的启发，希望引入一种紧凑、可解释的离散表示来显式推理物理世界的演化过程。
AI.method: PhiZero提出"物理语言"（physical language），一种紧凑的离散表征用于表示世界状态转移。该方法首先通过自监督方式从野外视频中学习物理语言，然后采用"先推理后渲染"的范式：模型先根据当前世界状态推断未来的物理语言序列（即显式推理世界如何演化），再将推断出的状态转移序列渲染为视频。
AI.result: 在生成和理解基准上的大量实验验证了PhiZero能够建模物理一致的世界演化。此外，该方法在真实且交互式的世界建模、细粒度动作条件模拟以及零样本运动迁移等任务上均展现出良好的潜力。
AI.conclusion: PhiZero通过在物理语言层面进行显式推理，弥合了高维视觉预测与人类可解释推理之间的鸿沟，为物理世界建模提供了一种更具可解释性和可控性的新路径，并在多项任务上证明了其有效性与泛化能力。

title: QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.

AI.tldr: QAdapt是一个噪声自适应的神经预解码框架，用于表面码量子纠错。它通过捕获综合征数据中的局部时空相关性，顺序适应不断变化的噪声条件并缓解灾难性遗忘，将残差综合征转发给传统全局解码器。在110种合成分布外噪声配置中持续降低逻辑错误率，在Google Willow基准数据上实现最高5.79%的逻辑错误率降低和9.32%的后端解码延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 容错量子计算不仅受物理噪声限制，还受经典解码器处理快速产生的综合征数据的延迟限制。硬件噪声具有强、异构和非平稳特性，且模拟到硬件的分布偏移会严重损害固定神经解码器的性能。因此需要一个能够适应硬件噪声变化的预解码框架。
AI.method: QAdapt包含三个关键组件：(1) 捕获综合征数据中的局部时空相关性；(2) 顺序适应演化的噪声条件，同时缓解灾难性遗忘；(3) 将残差综合征转发给传统全局解码器，实现与现有解码生态系统的兼容。
AI.result: 在110种合成的分布外噪声配置中，QAdapt持续降低逻辑错误率；在Google Willow基准数据上，无需目标域微调即可实现最高5.79%的逻辑错误率降低和9.32%的后端解码延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: QAdapt提供了一种实用且与解码器兼容的方法，在演化的硬件噪声条件下提高了量子纠错的鲁棒性和后端解码效率。

title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
summary: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time. Existing datasets fragment this experience across viewpoints, modalities, or spatial scales, leaving the full perception-action loop only partially observed. We introduce the Ambient Capture Engine (ACE), a human-centric data engine that transforms real home environments into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized recording studios. ACE operates at two complementary scales: a table-scale configuration resolves hand-object manipulation, while a room-scale configuration captures whole-body motion, locomotion, and interactions across a furnished home. ACE records egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, full-body and articulated hand motion, object geometry and 6-DoF trajectories, audio, and tactile signals as a unified multisensory stream. Using ACE, we build ACE-Data-0, comprising 150 hours and 17M video frames across 200 task categories, performed by 50 participants in 2 environments, for a total of 75,000 interaction episodes. The dataset spans atomic manipulation, long-horizon chains of household activities, and human-scene interaction, while preserving natural behavioral variation through goal-level rather than step-by-step instructions. We further introduce a hierarchical benchmark that progresses from signals to scene components and then to interactions. Evaluations of state-of-the-art methods expose substantial gaps under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long temporal horizons. ACE-Data-0 provides synchronized human demonstrations with aligned perceptual, kinematic, and contact supervision, offering a scalable foundation for imitation learning, world models, vision-language-action systems, and embodied AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACE（Ambient Capture Engine），一个将真实家庭环境转变为空间校准、时间同步录制工作室的人为中心的数据引擎，并构建了ACE-Data-0数据集（150小时、1700万帧、75000个交互片段），涵盖全身运动、灵巧操作、物体状态、音频和触觉等多模态同步数据，同时引入分层基准测试，展现SOTA方法在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时间跨度下的明显不足。
AI.motivation: 具身智能面临根本性数据瓶颈：现有数据集将第一人称感知、全身运动、灵巧操作、物体状态、声音和触觉等多模态体验割裂在不同的视角、模态或空间尺度下，导致完整的感知-行动闭环仅被部分观测。需要一个能同时捕捉这些维度协同演化过程的数据引擎。
AI.method: ACE在两种互补尺度上运行：桌面尺度配置解析手-物操作细节，房间尺度配置捕捉全身运动、移动和家居交互。ACE同步记录第一人称与多视角外置视频、全身与关节手部运动、物体几何与6自由度轨迹、音频和触觉信号作为统一多感官流。基于ACE构建ACE-Data-0数据集，采用目标级而非逐步指令来保留自然行为变异性。
AI.result: ACE-Data-0包含150小时、1700万视频帧、200个任务类别、50名参与者在2个环境中完成的75000个交互片段。数据集覆盖原子操作、长时间家庭活动链和人-场景交互。引入的分层基准（从信号到场景组件再到交互）对SOTA方法的评估显示其在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时间跨度下存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: ACE-Data-0提供对齐的感知、运动学和接触监督的同步人类演示，为模仿学习、世界模型、视觉-语言-动作系统和具身AI提供了可扩展的基础，有望突破具身智能的数据瓶颈。

title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
summary: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU memory constraints. We present ReToken, a single learnable embedding trained as an explicit retrieval target that selects a sparse set of query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache. Trained on only a small image-QA dataset, ReToken yields consistent gains across image and video benchmarks: on Visual Haystacks it improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points (>20% relative), and on LVBench it transfers zero-shot to long video for an 8.0-point gain with Qwen3VL-8B. Thanks to its lightweight design, both training and long-video inference fit on a single H100. Code is available at: https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken

AI.tldr: ReToken 是一种可学习的检索目标嵌入，从预填充的视觉 KV 缓存中为查询选择稀疏的相关视觉 token，从而解决视觉-语言模型在长视觉上下文下的性能退化与 GPU 内存瓶颈问题，并在图像和视频基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长视觉上下文对视觉-语言模型构成挑战：随着干扰项（distractors）增多，模型性能严重退化；同时一次性处理所有 token 在 GPU 内存限制下计算不可行。因此需要一种高效且可扩展的机制来选择性关注与查询相关的视觉信息。
AI.method: 提出 ReToken，一个单一的可学习嵌入（learnable embedding），通过显式检索目标训练，可从预填充的视觉 KV 缓存中选出一组稀疏的、与查询相关的视觉 token。该嵌入仅在小规模图像问答数据集上训练，训练和推理均轻量化设计。
AI.result: 在 Visual Haystacks 基准上，ReToken 使 Qwen3VL-8B 提升 13.4 分、InternVL3.5 提升 12.4 分（相对提升超过 20%）；在 LVBench 长视频基准上以零样本方式迁移，为 Qwen3VL-8B 带来 8.0 分的提升。由于设计轻量，训练与长视频推理均可在单张 H100 GPU 上完成。
AI.conclusion: ReToken 通过轻量级可学习检索目标实现了高效、准确的长视觉上下文处理，在图像和视频任务上均表现出一致的性能提升，且资源开销极低，具备良好的可扩展性和零样本迁移能力。

title: Oracle-Budgeted Molecular Optimization with Short-Term Graph Memory
summary: Molecular optimization is commonly performed under a limited oracle budget, which makes deciding what to evaluate as important as deciding what to generate. We introduce short-term graph memory, a plug-in module that preserves the generator architecture and native update rule while learning from previously evaluated molecules to prioritize subsequent oracle queries. The module maintains an online graph neural surrogate that pre-screens each round's candidate pool, so the fixed oracle budget is spent on molecules with higher predicted utility. Applied to a fragment-based generator on a standard molecular optimization benchmark, it improves the mean top-10 score at no extra oracle cost and never falls behind the base on any oracle; the gain extends to all four generators we tested at a tight budget of one thousand calls. We then analyze how surrogate-guided selection interacts with the exploration and exploitation behavior of different generators. Its benefit at larger budgets is consistent with two properties of the backbone: how broadly it searches, and how effectively its native search already exploits oracle feedback. We provide a simple way to spend a fixed oracle budget more selectively, and evidence on which generators benefit from it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的短期图记忆模块，通过在线图神经网络代理对候选分子池进行预筛选，在有限oracle预算下优先评估效用更高的分子，从而提升分子优化的top-10分数，且不增加oracle调用成本。
AI.motivation: 分子优化通常在有限oracle预算下进行，决定评估什么与决定生成什么同等重要。现有方法往往关注生成策略而忽视了有限预算下的选择性评估问题。
AI.method: 提出"短期图记忆"（short-term graph memory）即插即用模块：保留生成器架构和原生更新规则，维护一个在线图神经网络替代模型（surrogate），对每轮候选池进行预筛选，从而将有限的oracle预算集中在预测效用更高的分子上。
AI.result: 在标准分子优化基准上，该模块应用于片段生成器时平均top-10分数提升，且在任何oracle上都不落后于基线；在1000次调用的紧预算下，增益扩展到全部四个测试生成器。分析表明其在更大预算下的收益与主干的搜索广度和原生搜索利用oracle反馈的有效性一致。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种在固定oracle预算下更选择性分配资源的简单方法，并明确了哪些生成器类型能从该策略中获益。

title: LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean
summary: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个在Lean定理证明器中实现的形式化验证框架，用于约束编程，同时处理公式变换层的语义保持验证和求解器层的证书验证，实现端到端的可信约束求解流程。
AI.motivation: 约束编程是调度、规划、配置和验证等领域解决复杂组合问题的核心技术，但信任其求解结果需要在两个层面提供保证：求解前应用的改写（reformulation）必须保持语义；求解器必须产生正确的答案。现有的方法通常缺少对这两个层面的统一形式化验证。
AI.method: 在Lean定理证明器中引入一个形式化框架，具备两层次的验证能力：(1) 公式层面，可参数化地证明问题族（problem family）的等价性、等可满足性（equisatisfiability）以及对称性破坏约束的正确性；(2) 实例层面，通过翻译后端将求解器产生的证书检查转换到外部格式（MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB）进行验证。两个层面结合形成端到端工作流，无需信任外部求解器即可确立约束问题的可满足性或不可满足性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架的已验证对称性破坏在实践中效果显著：每个问题族只需一个参数化证明，可在所有实例规模上复用，将求解器搜索开销降低最多达2×10^7倍；同时，整个Lean内部的证书验证开销可控，最大实例的验证仅需几分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在定理证明器中同时覆盖约束编程的两个验证层面（公式变换和求解器证书），提供了不依赖外部求解器信任的端到端可信求解流程，且在实际效率上展现出明显优势。

title: Cybersecurity Detection Classification with Reasoning-enabled Language Models
summary: A major issue in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) is alert fatigue, as the number of detections reported is more than staff can triage in a given day. Prior work prompts or fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to emit a triage label directly, but does not train them to reason about whether a detection is a genuine threat. We train a chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning-enabled triage classifier on real, human-labeled Windows endpoint detections by combining automated prompt optimization, self-training, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. We find that CoT reasoning also degrades the label-token probabilities that automated triage relies on, so we separately train a calibrator that reads the full reasoning trace and estimates the probability that the verdict is correct. Our system reaches 82.6% test accuracy and, at the high-confidence operating point that governs automated triage, improves benign recall by 43.0% and malicious recall by 18.3% over a direct-label LLM classifier. We further show that the trained calibrator is necessary - an untrained confidence judge collapses high-confidence recall to zero - and that a finetuned 30B model significantly outperforms frontier general-purpose models, motivating targeted training over scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合CoT推理、自动化提示优化、自训练和可验证奖励强化学习的端到端告警分流分类器，并训练了一个校准器来读取完整推理轨迹并估计判决正确概率，解决了CoT推理导致标签token概率失真、进而影响自动分类置信度评估的问题。系统在真实Windows端点检测数据上达到82.6%测试准确率，在高置信度工作点下良性召回率提升43.0%、恶意召回率提升18.3%。
AI.motivation: 安全运营中心（SOC）面临严重的告警疲劳问题——告警数量远超分析师当天的处理能力。现有方法直接提示或微调LLM输出分流标签，但并未训练模型对检测是否为真实威胁进行推理。此外，CoT推理会降低标签token概率，从而破坏依赖该概率的自动化分流机制。
AI.method: 在真实、人工标注的Windows端点检测数据上，训练一个启用CoT推理的分流分类器。训练流程结合了自动化提示优化、自训练（self-training）以及带可验证奖励的强化学习。另外单独训练一个校准器（calibrator），它读取完整的推理轨迹并估计判决正确的概率，以弥补标签token概率退化的问题。
AI.result: 系统达到82.6%的测试准确率。在管控自动化分流的高置信度工作点下，相比直接标签LLM分类器，良性召回率提升43.0%，恶意召回率提升18.3%。实验还表明：未经训练的置信度判断会使高置信度召回率降至零，证明训练校准器是必需的；微调的30B模型显著优于前沿通用模型，说明相比堆规模，定向训练更具价值。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了CoT推理结合校准器的两阶段架构是提升SOC自动化告警分流效果的有效方案，并揭示了"定向训练优于扩大模型规模"的重要结论，为安全领域的LLM部署提供了实践指导。

title: A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports
summary: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EndoCLIP，一个基于125,756个病灶级图像-文本配对训练（从280,476份常规结肠镜报告中逐步恢复）的结肠镜视觉语言基础模型。它在病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中均优于通用及生物医学视觉语言编码器，在良恶性分类的线性探针上接近12名内镜医师在盲法研究中的表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管常规结肠镜报告中包含了丰富的专家描述（病灶外观、大小、位置），但这些报告是对整个过程的总结而非对单个帧的标注，导致临床发现与对应图像之间仅存在弱关联。因此，视觉语言模型在结肠镜领域未被充分利用，缺乏将报告知识迁移到图像理解的可扩展监督信号。
AI.method: 从280,476份常规结肠镜报告中逐步恢复出125,756个病灶级图像-文本配对，构建训练数据集。基于这些配对训练EndoCLIP视觉语言基础模型，使其能够学习病灶级文本描述与对应图像之间的对齐关系。
AI.result: 在病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中，EndoCLIP在零样本和线性探针设置下均优于通用和生物医学视觉语言编码器。在良恶性分类中，其线性探针性能接近12名内镜医师在盲法研究中的专家水平。
AI.conclusion: 恢复发现-帧对应关系可以将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使临床目标能够以语言形式指定，而无需为每个任务单独标注，从而显著提升结肠镜领域视觉语言模型的应用潜力。

title: Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation
summary: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合星上推理与生成式数据增强的工作流程，用于解决近地轨道纳米卫星空中监视的两个瓶颈：下行带宽有限和航空器数据集稀缺且类别不平衡。在6U立方星上使用低功耗边缘张量加速器执行推理，并通过低秩适配微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类图像，经中间检测器伪标注后与经典增强样本合并。结果显示，平衡后的数据集使全局mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811，量化检测器可适配片上内存并在轨运行25-30帧/秒。
AI.motivation: 传统纳米卫星采用“弯管式”架构被动收集并传输TB级原始遥测图像到地面处理，受限于有限的星间下行带宽，导致决策延迟；同时开放航空器卫星数据集稀缺且严重类别不平衡，使标准检测器难以学习少数类航空器的鲁棒表征。这两个相互关联的瓶颈迫切需要一种联合解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一个结合两部分的联合工作流：(1) 在6U立方星上搭载低功耗边缘张量加速器执行星上推理，实现本地目标检测；(2) 通过低秩适配(LoRA)微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类航空器图像，由中间检测器自动伪标注并融合经典数据增强样本，构建平衡训练数据集。检测器经量化以适配片上内存。
AI.result: 平衡数据集使全局mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811；量化后的检测器适配星上内存，可在轨处理25-30帧/秒。
AI.conclusion: 计算实验表明，该工作流可作为纳米卫星实时自主空中监视的决策支持工具，克服了传统弯管式架构中卫星仅作为被动数据采集器的局限性，实现星上自主处理与智能决策。

title: A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks
summary:
Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，将Swin Transformer视觉感知与J48决策树派生的IF-THEN模糊推理相结合，用于污水管道缺陷严重度评估，在五类高度不平衡数据集上相比纯图像分类显著提升准确率(17.9%)、平衡准确率(12.2%)、Macro F1(23.0%)和MCC(17.3%)。
AI.motivation: 现有自动污水管道严重度评估依赖直接图像分类形成"黑箱"，视觉缺陷与最终严重度分数之间的关联是隐式的，缺乏可解释性和可追溯的推理过程。
AI.method: 框架解耦神经感知与符号推理：感知模块使用Swin Transformer直接从图像预测14个多标签检查CODE等级；推理模块使用Weka J48决策树在真实CODE和严重度标签上训练，将决策路径转换为19条固定IF-THEN模糊规则；推理通过模糊逻辑实现，采用t-norm激活CODE条件并加权规则置信度，再以s-norm组合生成类别证据，评估了Product、Łukasiewicz和Hamacher三种算子对。
AI.result: 在包含3,244张图像、覆盖五个高度不平衡严重度类别的数据集上，相较纯图像分类，准确率提升17.9%、平衡准确率提升12.2%、Macro F1提升23.0%、MCC提升17.3%。真实标签通过五个独立大语言模型对原始检查员笔记的共识分析稳健生成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持竞争性类别平衡性能的同时，实现了从预测CODE等级到规则支持再到严重度证据的可追溯推理，弥合了视觉缺陷与最终严重度评分之间的解释性鸿沟。

title: Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors
summary: Many real-world graphs support multiple predictive tasks over the same underlying structure, creating an opportunity to reuse supervision across node classification (NC) and link prediction (LP). However, existing evaluations often rely on incompatible splits, observed-graph assumptions, and negative sampling rules, making conclusions about same-graph cross-task transfer unreliable. We formalize same-graph NC-LP transfer and propose a leakage-free protocol that fixes node and edge splits, uses a shared message-passing graph that excludes evaluated edges, and employs fixed negatives for LP. Across three backbones (GCN, GraphSAGE, GPS), we find that transfer is strongly directional and predictable: NC $\to$ LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs, while LP $\to$ NC is fragile and can even degrade accuracy under naive representation reuse. LP $\to$ NC becomes reliably positive mainly in a structure-dominant regime where LP is easy but NC is unsaturated, suggesting that LP acts as structural pretraining. Finally, we introduce the CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint NC+LP utility when a shared encoder must serve both tasks, and show that simple dataset statistics, especially homophily, can guide mechanism choice and help avoid negative transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了同图上的节点分类（NC）与链接预测（LP）跨任务迁移问题，提出无泄漏评估协议，发现NC→LP在同质图上稳定有益，而LP→NC通常脆弱甚至有害，仅在结构主导且LP易学、NC未饱和时才有正向收益。作者还提出CoTask Score（CTS）总结共享编码器下的联合任务效用，并用同质性等简单图统计量指导机制选择。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的许多图需要在同一底层结构上支持多个预测任务（NC和LP），存在复用监督信号的潜在机会。然而，现有评估常使用不兼容的数据划分、不同的观测图假设和不同的负采样规则，导致关于同图跨任务迁移的结论不可靠。需要一个规范化的协议来正确评估NC与LP之间的迁移效果。
AI.method: （1）形式化定义同图NC-LP迁移问题；（2）提出无泄漏评估协议：固定节点和边划分、共享排除被评估边的消息传递图、LP使用固定负样本；（3）在三种骨干网络（GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS）上进行系统实验；（4）提出CoTask Score（CTS）指标总结共享编码器的联合NC+LP效用；（5）利用图统计特征（如同质性）指导迁移机制选择。
AI.result: 迁移具有很强的方向性和可预测性：NC→LP在同质图上稳定有益；LP→NC在朴素表示复用时脆弱甚至可能降低准确率；LP→NC仅在结构主导条件下（LP容易而NC未饱和）才稳定为正，表明LP可作为结构预训练。CTS指标可有效总结联合任务效用，简单数据集统计量（尤其同质性）能帮助选择机制并避免负迁移。
AI.conclusion: 同图NC-LP迁移的方向性差异显著，不应笼统假设跨任务迁移有益。需要一个无泄漏的标准化协议来指导实际工程中的任务共享决策。同质性等图属性可作为有效的迁移方向预测因子，CTS提供了一个统一的评价框架来权衡共享编码器下的双任务性能。

title: SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination
summary: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将供应链补货计划中的多个耦合决策（品类选择、供应商分配、补货频率、配送路线）统一建模为复合策略模型，通过共享操作表征和端到端系统效用进行联合优化。在叮咚买菜和京东的真实运营数据上验证，SCOPE持续优于各决策独立优化及实践基线方法。
AI.motivation: 供应链中的补货计划涉及多个决策环节（品类组合、货源分配、补货频率、配送路线），这些决策在运营上高度耦合，但现实中常由不同部门通过独立系统分别优化，导致缺货、库存积压和不必要的运输成本。现有方法缺乏对跨部门操作耦合的端到端协调。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE复合策略模型：将供应链实体表示为token，通过共享操作表征进行上下文化，每种token类型映射到对应的决策接口。每个决策基于此前决策形成的部分计划逐步构建，完整计划则用共享的系统级效用函数进行评估。在生鲜零售补货场景中实例化，考虑服务频率、品类组合、容量压力和路网路由之间的强交互。
AI.result: 在叮咚买菜和京东两个不同补货层级的大规模供应链真实运营数据上，SCOPE在两种场景下均一致优于分别优化各决策阶段的方法以及供应链运营中常用的实践基线。
AI.conclusion: 学习并协调跨部门运营耦合能够产生更有效的端到端供应链决策，表明供应链AI应从孤立的决策模块迈向统一的操作规划。

title: APO: Unsupervised Atomic Policy Optimization for 3D Structure Prediction of Atomic Systems
summary: Predicting the 3D structures of atomic systems is fundamental to advancing material science and drug discovery. While flow-matching models (, FlowDPO) have recently shown promise in this domain, their performance relies heavily on alignment with ground-truth coordinates via supervised preference learning. However, obtaining experimental labels for novel crystal phases or de novo proteins is prohibitively expensive, creating a bottleneck for structural modeling in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we propose (Atomic Policy Optimization), a fully unsupervised alignment framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth reference structures. APO adapts group-relative policy optimization to 3D atomic environments, utilizing a novel dual-reward mechanism: (i) a that reinforces the policy's dominant latent structural modes through eigen-decomposition of sample similarities, and (ii) a that enforces thermodynamic stability. Our framework enables the model to ``self-correct'' by identifying physically plausible configurations within sampled groups. Extensive benchmarks on crystal and antibody structure prediction demonstrate that APO consistently outperforms fully supervised baselines, achieving a new state-of-the-art in match rates and structural fidelity. Furthermore, we show that APO effectively straightens probability paths, significantly improving inference efficiency. Our results suggest that intrinsic physical consistency can serve as a superior guide for alignment compared to noisy, supervised coordinate matching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APO（原子策略优化），一种完全无监督的3D原子结构对齐框架，通过组相对策略优化和双奖励机制（潜在结构模态奖励+热力学稳定性奖励）实现自校正，在晶体和抗体结构预测上超越完全监督基线，达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配模型（如FlowDPO）在3D原子结构预测中依赖与真实坐标的监督偏好对齐，但获取新颖晶相或全新蛋白质的实验标签成本极高，形成数据稀缺场景下的瓶颈。因此需要一种无需地面真值参考结构的无监督对齐框架。
AI.method: APO将组相对策略优化（GRPO）适配到3D原子环境，核心包含：1）双奖励机制：基于样本相似性特征分解的潜在结构模态奖励（强化策略主导结构模式）+ 热力学稳定性奖励；2）在采样组内识别物理上合理的构象实现模型"自校正"；3）通过内在物理一致性引导对齐，无需监督坐标匹配。
AI.result: 在晶体和抗体结构预测基准上，APO一致优于完全监督基线，在匹配率和结构保真度上取得新SOTA；同时有效拉直概率路径，显著提升推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 内在物理一致性可以作为比噪声监督坐标匹配更优的对齐引导信号，暗示无监督物理驱动对齐在原子结构建模中具有更大潜力。
